name: The Umrah Rules, 2025

metadata.title: Umrah Rules, 2025
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Hajj and Umrah (Regulation) Act, 2024 to regulate Umrah operations in Pakistan. They establish definitions, create a policy committee, set criteria for registering Umrah Group Organizers, and outline conditions for sub-agents and service provider agreements.

name: The Finance Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2026
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2026. It amends specific laws, including the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act and the Customs Act, to update tax rates and regulatory provisions.

name: The Export Processing Zone Rule, 2026

metadata.title: The Export Processing Zone Rules, 2001
metadata.number: Sub-Chapter 3 of Chapter XII of Customs Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules define key terms related to Export Processing Zones and establish procedures for importing goods from abroad or the Tariff Area. They outline conditions for customs clearance, tax exemptions for machinery, and specific entitlements for investors regarding vehicle imports based on investment quantum.

name: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) (Repeal) Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) (Repeal) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016, with specific exceptions for certain subsections. It validates all previous actions, orders, and rights taken under the repealed Act as if they were always lawful.

name: The Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws relating to the registration, licensing, and training of nurses, nurse practitioners, midwives, midwifery associates, and nurse auxiliaries in Pakistan. It establishes the Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council and defines key terms related to nursing education, examinations, and healthcare facilities.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Prohibition of Plastic Book Covers) Act, 2026

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory (Prohibition of Plastic Book Covers) Act, 2026
metadata.repeals: All other laws, rules, and regulations inconsistent with the provisions of this Act
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the sale, offer for sale, or distribution of books covered in single-use plastic within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It aims to safeguard the environment by promoting sustainable packaging practices while providing specific exemptions for biodegradable materials, reusable covers, and archival preservation needs.

name: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2026

metadata.title: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to repeal the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016. It preserves the validity of all actions, orders, and rights acquired under the repealed Act while exempting a specific subsection of section 7 from the repeal.

name: The Daanish University Islamabad Act, 2026

metadata.title: Daanish University Islamabad Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Daanish University in Islamabad to foster excellence in emerging technologies like AI and quantum computing. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its corporate structure and governing bodies.

name: The Nippon Institute of Advanced Sciences Act, 2026

metadata.title: Nippon Institute of Advanced Sciences Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Nippon Institute of Advanced Sciences in Sheikhpura as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy, allowing it to manage its own budget, employ staff, and award degrees without external interference on policy matters.

name: The Virtual Assets Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Virtual Assets Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a dedicated regulatory authority known as the Pakistan Virtual Asset Regulatory Authority (PVARA) to license, regulate, and supervise virtual assets and service providers. It aims to ensure investor protection, transparency, and market integrity while providing a legal framework to combat money laundering and terrorist financing involving virtual assets.

name: The Off-the Grid (Captive Power Plants) Removal of Difficulties Order, 2026

metadata.title: The Off-the Grid (Captive Power Plants) Removal of Difficulties Order, 2026
metadata.summary: This Order is made by the President under section 10 of the Off-the Grid (Captive Power Plants) Levy Act, 2025 to remove difficulties in giving effect to that Act. It specifies that the levy rate for captive power consumers of gas companies other than SSGCL and SNGPL shall be based on the self-power generation cost calculated from the sale price of natural gas or RLNG supplies.

name: The Domestic Violence (Prevention and Protection) Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Domestic Violence (Prevention and Protection) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an effective system for the protection, relief, and rehabilitation of women, men, transgender individuals, children, and vulnerable persons against domestic violence. It defines key terms such as 'domestic violence' and 'domestic relationship' to institutionalize necessary safeguards and measures for preventing abuse within households.

name: The Daanish Schools Authority Act, 2026

metadata.title: Daanish Schools Authority Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Daanish Schools Authority to regulate and manage Daanish Schools for providing quality education to destitute children. It defines the composition of the Authority, including the Prime Minister as Chairperson, and outlines its powers regarding curriculum, inspections, scholarships, and student welfare.

name: S.R.O. 60(I)/2026.- Withdraw of Special Economic Zones (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026

metadata.title: Special Economic Zones (Amendment) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.repeals: Special Economic Zones (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This notification withdraws the Special Economic Zones (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026. It was issued by the President of Pakistan under Article 89(2)(b) of the Constitution on January 14, 2026.

name: The Biological and Toxin Weapons Convention (Implementation) Act, 2026

metadata.title: Biological and Toxin Weapons Convention (Implementation) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production and Stockpiling of Bacteriological (Biological) and Toxin Weapons and on their Destruction, 1972. It extends to the whole of Pakistan and defines key terms related to biological agents, toxins, and peaceful purposes.

name: The National Commission for Minorities Rights Act, 2025

metadata.title: National Commission for Minorities Rights Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Commission for Minorities Rights to safeguard and promote the social, economic, political, and legal rights of minorities in Pakistan. It defines the composition of the Commission, including a Chairperson, minority members from provinces and territories, and ex-officio representatives from various ministries.

name: The King Hamad University of Nursing and Associated Medical Sciences Act, 2025

metadata.title: The King Hamad University of Nursing and Associated Medical Sciences Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the King Hamad University of Nursing and Associated Medical Sciences as a public sector university in Islamabad. It provides for the university's incorporation, perpetual succession, and its capacity to manage property and finances.

name: The Asaan Karobar Act, 2025

metadata.title: The Asaan Karobar Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework for a modern, simple, and transparent regulatory regime in Pakistan. It creates the Pakistan Regulatory Registry and the Pakistan Business Portal to remove cumbersome procedures affecting business, trade, and investment.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority (Verification, Revocation and Cancellation o f Identity Documents) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: The National Database and Registration Authority (Verification, Revocation and Cancellation of Identity Documents) Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: These regulations prescribe the procedures for verifying, revoking, impounding, confiscating, and cancelling identity documents issued under the National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000. They establish the constitution, powers, and functioning of Verification Boards at Zonal, Regional, and Headquarters levels to handle suspect cases involving forged, counterfeit, or ineligible identity cards.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority (Application For Pakistan Origin Card) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: The National Database and Registration Authority (Application For Pakistan Origin Card) Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for issuing Pakistan Origin Cards (POC) to specific categories of individuals, including Ex-Pakistanis and foreign nationals with Pakistani ancestry. They define eligibility criteria, required documentation, card design standards, and the benefits associated with holding a valid POC.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority (Procurement) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: National Database and Registration Authority (Procurement) Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: These Regulations regulate and standardize the procurement of goods, works, and services for the National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA). They aim to ensure transparency, fair competition, efficiency, and integrity while harmonizing NADRA's procedures with existing laws like the PPRA Ordinance. The document applies to all procurements initiated by NADRA Headquarters, regional offices, and its corporate entities.

name: Prudential Regulations for Small and Medium Enterprise Financing, 2025

metadata.title: Prudential Regulations for Small and Medium Enterprise Financing, 2025
metadata.amends: Prudential Regulations for Small and Medium Enterprise Financing (issued in 2003)
metadata.summary: The State Bank of Pakistan issued these regulations to revise and institutionalize policies for sustainable, responsible, and inclusive SME finance. The document aims to remove structural barriers, encourage the use of technology, and foster partnerships with fintechs to unlock the potential of Pakistan's SME sector.

name: The NADRA (Digital Identity) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: NADRA (Digital Identity) Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the legal framework for digital identity management and authentication services provided by the National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA). They define key terms such as authentication, biometric data, and consent while outlining the scope of these rules across Pakistan.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority (National Data Exchange Layer) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: National Database and Registration Authority (National Data Exchange Layer) Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the National Data Exchange Layer (NDEL) under the National Database and Registration Authority. They define key terms related to authentication, data processing, and digital identity management to facilitate secure interoperability between the Authority and on-boarded entities.

name: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Temporary Uplinking Permission Regulations-2025

metadata.title: Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Temporary Uplinking Permission Regulations-2025
metadata.summary: This document notifies regulations governing temporary uplinking permissions for satellite transmission within Pakistan. It defines key terms such as uplinking, permission holders, and specific technologies like SNG and DSNG, while outlining application procedures, fees, and duration limits for both long-term and short-term permissions.

name: The National Information Technology Board (Appointment, Powers and Functions of Chief Executive Officer) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: National Information Technology Board (Appointment, Powers and Functions of the Chief Executive Officer) Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes the appointment process, eligibility criteria, term of office, and powers for the Chief Executive Officer of the National Information Technology Board. It also outlines provisions for appointing an Acting CEO in cases of vacancy or temporary inability to perform duties.

name: The Federal Government Defined Contribution Pension Fund Scheme Rules, 2024

metadata.title: The Federal Government Defined Contribution Pension Fund Scheme Rules, 2024
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Federal Government Defined Contribution Pension Fund Scheme for eligible federal employees. They define key terms such as employee and employer contributions, pensionable pay, and the roles of pension fund managers under the Public Finance Management Act, 2019.

name: SRO 1524(I)/2025. Notification Issued Under Section 5(1)(xi) of the National Forensics Agency Act, 2014 Regarding Appointment of Absorbed Employee

metadata.title: Notification appointing employees at National Forensics Agency
metadata.summary: This notification approves the appointment of specific employees absorbed under the National Forensics Agency Act, 2024. It designates Al-Hasanat Rasul Mirjahid as Director General and lists other staff members with their respective designations effective from February 27, 2025.

name: The Export-Import Bank of Pakistan (Human Resources) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: Export-Import Bank of Pakistan (Human Resources) Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: This document notifies the Human Resources Regulations for the Export-Import Bank of Pakistan, effective immediately. It establishes core objectives regarding recruitment, professional conduct, and compensation structures while defining key terms related to employees and allowances.

name: SRO 1366(I)/2025 Exemption of Digitally Ordered Goods and Services Supplied from Outside Pakistan from Digital Presence Proceeds Tax

metadata.title: Digital Presence Proceed Tax
metadata.summary: This notification clarifies that the Digital Presence Proceed Tax does not apply to digitally ordered goods and services supplied from outside Pakistan. It is issued under section 15 of the Digital Presence Proceeds Tax Act, 2025 by the Federal Government.

name: SRO 1334(I)/2025. Notification Regarding Levy Rate on Captive Power Plants

metadata.title: The Grid (Captive Power Plants) Levy Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This notification sets the levy rate at 238 Rupees per Million British Thermal Units under section 3 of the Grid (Captive Power Plants) Levy Act, 2025. It was issued by the Federal Government through the Petroleum Division on July 23, 2025.

name: S.R.O. 1318 (I)/2025 — Establishment of the Pakistan Virtual Asset Regulatory Authority

metadata.title: Notification establishing the Pakistan Virtual Asset Regulatory Authority
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the Pakistan Virtual Asset Regulatory Authority under the powers of the Virtual Assets Ordinance, 2025. It was issued by the Federal Government through the Cabinet Secretariat on July 21, 2025.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Waqf Properties (Shrines Management) Rules, 2025

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Wagqf Properties (Shrines Management) Rules, 2025
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for managing Waqf properties, specifically shrines and allied mosques, within the Islamabad Capital Territory. They define the appointment and responsibilities of the Waqf Manager, outline committee structures based on shrine income, and regulate financial powers and lease contracts.

name: The Hajj Policy Committee (Composition, Functions and Procedure) Rules, 2025

metadata.title: The Hajj Policy Committee (Composition, Functions and Procedure) Rules, 2025
metadata.summary: These rules establish the composition, functions, and procedures for the Hajj Policy Committee constituted under the Hajj and Umrah (Regulation) Act, 2024. The committee is responsible for formulating Hajj policies, allocating quotas to service providers, and ensuring the welfare of pilgrims.

name: S. R. O. 1279(I)/2025 — Authorization of Officers under Federal Excise Act, 2005

metadata.title: The Federal Excise Duty (Authorization of Officers) Notification, S.R.O. 1279(1)/2025
metadata.summary: This notification authorizes specific revenue and excise officers to exercise powers regarding cigarettes in retail outlets, warehouses, and on roads. It outlines the conditions under which these officers can seize cigarettes lacking valid tax stamps or possessing fake stamps, followed by mandatory reporting and deposit procedures.

name: The Frontier Constabulary (Re-organization) Ordinance, 2025

metadata.title: Frontier Constabulary (Re-organization) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and re-enacts the law relating to the Frontier Constabulary, transforming it into the Federal Constabulary. It establishes a new civil armed force empowered to address evolving challenges in public safety, national security, and emergency response across Pakistan.

name: SRO 1192(I)/2025.Notification Regarding Grant of Recognition to Armed Forces Institute of Cardiology / National Institute of Heart Disease, Rawalpindi for Diploma in Cardiology

metadata.title: Notification granting recognition to the Armed Forces Institute of Cardiology/National Institute of Heart Disease, Rawalpindi
metadata.amends: Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This notification grants recognition to the Armed Forces Institute of Cardiology/National Institute of Heart Disease in Rawalpindi for its Diploma in Cardiology qualification. It directs the addition of this new institution and related entries into the Third Schedule of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022.

name: The New Energy Vehicles Adoption Levy Act, 2025

metadata.title: New Energy Vehicles Adoption Levy Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act imposes and collects a levy on internal combustion engine vehicles to promote the adoption of new energy vehicles in Pakistan. The levy applies to both manufactured and imported vehicles, with proceeds designated for promoting new energy vehicle adoption. It defines specific categories of vehicles, including new energy motor vehicles and trucks, and outlines collection methods similar to import duties and sales tax.

name: The Digital Presence Proceeds Tax Act, 2025

metadata.title: Digital Presence Proceeds Tax Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a new tax regime known as the Digital Presence Proceeds Tax to address tax base erosion caused by multinational enterprises operating in the digital sector without physical presence. It defines key terms such as digitally delivered services, e-commerce, and online marketplaces to determine chargeability. The legislation aims to ensure tax fairness and protect public revenue by aligning taxation with value creation principles in the modern digital economy.

name: The Finance Act, 2025

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2025
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance, 1961; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 2025. It amends several existing laws, including the Stamp Act, 1899, the Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance, 1961, and the Customs Act, 1969, to introduce new levies and administrative structures.

name: The Public Private Partnership Authority (P3WP) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: Public Private Partnership Authority (P3WP) Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the functions and powers of the Public Private Partnership Working Party (P3WP) under the Public Private Partnership Authority Act, 2017. They define key terms, outline procedures for meetings and quorums, and mandate the disclosure and recusal of members regarding conflicts of interest.

name: NOTICE OF CONCLUSION OF SUNSET REVIEW PURSUANT TO REMAND ORDER BY APPELLATE TRIBUNAL AND CONTINUATION OF DEFINITIVE ANTI-DUMPING DUTIES ON DOUTPED IMPORTS OF HYDROGEN PEROXIDE INTO PAKISTAN ORIGINATING IN AND/OR EXPORTED FROM BANGLADESH

metadata.title: Notice of Conclusion of Sunset Review Pursuant to Remand Order by Appellate Tribunal and Continuation of Definitive Anti-Dumping Duties on Dumped Imports of Hydrogen Peroxide into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from Bangladesh
metadata.summary: This notice announces the National Tariff Commission's decision to continue definitive anti-dumping duties on dumped imports of Hydrogen Peroxide from Bangladesh for another five years. The continuation follows a sunset review conducted pursuant to a remand order by the Anti-Dumping Appellate Tribunal, which found a likelihood of dumping and injury to the domestic industry.

name: The off the Grid (Captive Power Plants) Levy Act, 2025

metadata.title: The Off-the Grid (Captive Power Plants) Levy Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act imposes an off-the-grid levy on natural gas or RLNG consumption by captive power plants in Pakistan. The collected funds are designated for reducing power generation tariffs across all consumer categories.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Child Marriage Restraint Bill, 2025

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Child Marriage Restraint Bill, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act aims to restrain the solemnization of child marriages within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines key terms such as 'child', 'child marriage', and 'child trafficking', while establishing strict registration requirements for Nikahs involving parties under eighteen years of age.

name: Notice of Final Determination and Levy of Definitive Anti-dumping Duty on Dumped Imports of BOPP Self Adhesive Tapes in Jumbo Rolls into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People’s Republic of China

metadata.title: Notice of Final Determination and Levy of Definitive Anti-dumping Duty on Dumped Imports of BOPP Self Adhesive Tapes in Jumbo Rolls into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People's Republic of China
metadata.summary: The National Tariff Commission issued a notice imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty of 26.76 percent ad valorem on dumped imports of BOPP Self Adhesive Tapes in jumbo rolls from China. This decision follows an investigation that found the domestic industry suffered injury due to price undercutting and depression caused by these imports, effective from January 31, 2025.

name: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping Duties Levied on Dumped Imports of Anti-dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Hydrogen Peroxide Imported from Belgium, China, Indonesia, Korea, Chinese Taipei, Thailand and Turkey

metadata.title: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping Duties Levied on Dumped Imports of Hydrogen Peroxide Imported from Belgium, China, Indonesia, Korea, Chinese Taipei, Thailand and Turkey
metadata.summary: This notification informs stakeholders about the impending expiry of anti-dumping duties on Hydrogen Peroxide imports from specific countries. The National Tariff Commission states that these duties will terminate on September 02, 2025, unless a sunset review application is filed by the domestic industry within forty-five days.

name: Notice of Initiation of Anti-dumping Investigation Against Alleged Dumped Imports of Cefadroxil Originating in and/or Exported from the People's Republic of China

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Anti-dumping Investigation Against Alleged Dumped Imports of Cefadroxil Originating in and/or Exported from the People's Republic of China
metadata.summary: This notification initiates an anti-dumping investigation into Cefadroxil imports from China following an application by M/s Pharmagen Limited. The National Tariff Commission determined that the evidence provided was sufficient to justify the investigation into whether dumped prices are causing material injury to Pakistan's domestic industry.

name: SRO 866(I)/2025. Approval of Niazi Dental College, Sargodha for Training of Fifty BDS Students Annually

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 866(I)/2025
metadata.amends: Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This notification approves Niazi Dental College in Sargodha to train fifty BDS students annually for degree awarding by the University of Health Sciences, Lahore. It also directs the addition of a new entry for this college and its dental surgery program to the Third Schedule of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022.

name: Constitution of Inquiry Committee to Probe Irregular Extension of Security Firm Contract by National Book Foundation — Notification No. F. No. 1-13/2024/FEPT-Org

metadata.title: Notification constituting Inquiry Committee
metadata.summary: This notification establishes an Inquiry Committee under the Ministry of Federal Education and Professional Training to investigate irregularities regarding a contract extension at the National Book Foundation. The committee is tasked with probing undue favor given to a security firm, fixing responsibility for violations of PPRA rules, and submitting a report within fourteen days.

name: Prudential Regulations for Microfinance Banks (Mfbs)

metadata.title: Prudential Regulations for Microfinance Banks (MFBs)
metadata.summary: These Prudential Regulations establish a proportional regulatory framework for Microfinance Banks (MFBs) in Pakistan to promote innovation and stability. The document categorizes rules into Risk Management, Corporate Governance, and Operations to address business growth and technological innovations in the sector.

name: SRO 762(I)2025. The National Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Authority of Pakistan (Staff Service) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: National Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Authority of Pakistan (Staff Service) Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the staff service framework for the National Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Authority of Pakistan. They define various posts, appointing authorities, and methods for initial appointments, promotions, transfers, and deputations within the Authority.

name: The Tariff for Cellular Mobile Telecommunication Services Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: Tariff for Cellular Mobile Telecommunication Services Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the tariff framework for cellular mobile telecommunication services in Pakistan, applying to all licensed operators. They distinguish between Significant Market Power (SMP) and non-SMP operators, setting specific notification periods and approval requirements for tariff changes based on operator status.

name: SRO 749(I)/2025 Extension of Societies Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2024 for further 120 days.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2024
metadata.summary: This document is a notification extending the Societies Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2024 for an additional period of one hundred and twenty days. The extension takes effect from April 27, 2025, pursuant to a resolution passed by the Senate on April 25, 2025.

name: The National Agri-trade and Food Safety Authority Ordinance, 2025

metadata.title: National Agri-trade and Food Safety Authority Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Agri-trade and Food Safety Authority (NAFSA) to regulate quality aspects of agro-chemicals, agricultural produce, plants, animals, and related products. It aims to facilitate international and inter-provincial trade by ensuring compliance with recognized sanitary and phytosanitary measures and quality standards.

name: SRO 708(I)/2025. Recognition of Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur Mir’s under the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022 (IV of 2023)
metadata.summary: This notification grants recognition to Khairpur Medical College for training one hundred MBBS students per annum. It directs the addition of this institution to the First Schedule of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022, for degree awarding by the Peoples University of Medical and Health Sciences for Women Nawabshah-Shaheed Benazirbad.

name: SRO 535(I)/2025. Recognition of Master of Science in Public Health Awarded by Zia Uddin University, Karachi

metadata.title: S.R.O. 534(l)/2025
metadata.amends: Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This notification grants recognition to the National University of Medical Sciences, Rawalpindi for its Master of Science in Public Health and Master of Science in Healthcare Administration qualifications. It directs the addition of these new entries to the Second Schedule of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022.

name: SRO 534(I)/2025. Notification Regarding Recognition of MS (Public Health) and MS (Health Care Administration) Awarded by National University of Medical Sciences, Rawalpindi

metadata.title: S.R.O. 534(l)/2025
metadata.amends: Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This notification grants recognition to the National University of Medical Sciences, Rawalpindi for its Master of Science in Public Health and Master of Science in Healthcare Administration qualifications. It directs the addition of these new entries to the Second Schedule of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022.

name: The Special Purpose Fund (General) Rules, 2025

metadata.title: Special Purpose Fund (General) Rules, 2025
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for creating and managing special purpose funds under the Public Finance Management Act, 2019. They define fund purposes, financing methods, management committee structures, investment guidelines, budgeting, accounting requirements, and dissolution procedures.

name: The Grants-in-Aid Rules, 2025

metadata.title: The Grants-in-Aid Rules, 2025
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Federal Government to sanction and issue grants-in-aid to various public and private entities. They define specific procedures for applications, approval criteria, reporting requirements, and the distinction between recurring and non-recurring grants under the Public Finance Management Act, 2019.

name: The Non-Lapsable Fund (Maintenance and Utilization) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: Non-Lapsable Fund (Maintenance and Utilization) Regulations, 2025
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the maintenance and utilization of the NADRA Fund under the National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000. They define key financial terms, outline the sources of fund establishment including budgetary allocations and fees, and set procedures for maintaining accounts and managing expenditures.

name: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (Certification of Associated Professionals in the Financial Services) Regulations, 2025

metadata.title: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (Certification of Associated Professionals in the Financial Services) Regulations, 2025
metadata.amends: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (Certification of Associated Professionals in the Financial Services) Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes requirements for the certification of associated professionals in Pakistan's financial services markets. It mandates that individuals engaged in selling or distributing financial products must hold a valid certificate issued by a notified institute to continue their activities.

name: Cessation of Standing Committees Consequent upon Merger of Ministries/Divisions — Notification No. F. 2(1)/2024-Com-I

metadata.title: Notification No. F. 2(1)/2024-Com-I
metadata.summary: This notification declares that certain Standing Committees cease to exist effective February 4, 2025. The dissolution is a consequence of the merger of Ministries/Divisions vide Cabinet Division Notification No. S.R.O 83(1)/2025 dated February 4, 2025.

name: Constitution of Committee to Monitor Prices of Essential Commodities in Islamabad during Ramzan — Notification No. F. No. 5/3/2025-ICT-I

metadata.title: Notification constituting a committee to monitor prices of essential commodities in Islamabad during Ramzan
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a committee to monitor the prices of essential commodities in Islamabad during Ramzan. The committee is chaired by the Federal Minister for Interior and Narcotics Control and includes various other government officials. Its terms of reference require effective monitoring and ensuring a decrease in prices within 48 hours, with updates provided to the Prime Minister.

name: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping Duties Levied on Imports of Liner Alkyl Benzene Sulphonic Acid Imported from People’s Republic of China, the Republic of India, the Republic of Indonesia, Islamic Republic of Iran, the Republic of Korea and Chinese Taipei

metadata.title: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping Duties Levied on Imports of Linear Alkyl Benzene Sulphonic Acid Imported from People's Republic of China, the Republic of India, the Republic of Indonesia, Islamic Republic of Iran, the Republic of Korea and Chinese Taipei
metadata.summary: This notice informs stakeholders that anti-dumping duties on Linear Alkyl Benzene Sulphonic Acid imported from specific countries will expire on May 25, 2025. It further states that domestic producers may file a sunset review application with the National Tariff Commission within forty-five days of publication to prevent this expiry.

name: S. R. O. 315(I)/2025 — Notification of SEZ Committee for GH2 Industries (Private) Limited Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zone

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 315 (I) /2025
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the SEZ Committee for the 'GH2 Industries (Private) Limited Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zone' and defines its composition. It outlines the committee's responsibilities, including enforcing benefits, overseeing enterprises, and regulating plot sales within the zone.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority (National Data Repository) Regulations, 2024

metadata.title: National Database and Registration Authority (National Data Repository) Regulations, 2024
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the National Data Repository (NDR) to serve as a centralized multi-purpose data repository for synergy among government databases. They constitute an NDR Team responsible for managing the repository, defining its functions, and overseeing data usage for governance and security purposes.

name: S. R. O. 251(I)/2025 — Approval and Notification of Sole Enterprise SEZ Application by SEZ Authority Punjab

metadata.title: Notification approving Etihad Industrial Park as a Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zone
metadata.summary: This notification approves the application for Etihad Industrial Park in Lahore to be established as a Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zone. The approval is granted by the Approvals Committee under the Special Economic Zones Act, 2012 and the Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zones Regulations 2020.

name: S. R. O. 250(I)/2025 — Approval and Notification of Sole Enterprise SEZ Application by SEZ Authority Sindh

metadata.title: S. R. O. 250(I)/2025
metadata.summary: This notification approves a sole enterprise special economic zone application received from the SEZ Authority Sindh. It outlines specific terms and conditions for development, operations, land usage, and regulatory compliance required of the developer.

name: S. R. O. 249(I)/2025 — Approval and Notification of Sole Enterprise SEZ Application by SEZ Authority Sindh

metadata.title: Notification approving Risesincs Steel (Private) Limited Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zone
metadata.summary: This notification approves the application for a Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zone submitted by Risesincs Steel (Private) Limited in Thatta, Sindh. It outlines specific terms and conditions regarding construction timelines, land usage restrictions, environmental compliance, and reporting requirements for the developer.

metadata.summary: This notification outlines the procedure for the Board Nominations Committee (BNC) of the Railways Division to identify and recommend candidates for Independent Director positions on State-Owned Enterprises. name: No. 509 - No. F.5-17-2024-Com - Inclusion of Adviser on Political & Public Affairs as Member in Cabinet Committee on Monitoring Sugar Exports

name: No. 506 - No. F.5-22-2024-Com - Constitution of Committee on Virtual University of Pakistan

name: No. 505 - No. F.5-21-2024-Com - Constitution of Committee on Regulation of Foreign Funding to Domestic NGOs and INGOs

metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a committee to regulate foreign funding received by domestic and international non-governmental organizations. name: No. 504 - No. 4-1-2024-Min-I - Circular regarding Rules of Business, 1973

metadata.title: Circular regarding Rules of Business, 1973
metadata.summary: This document serves as a circular and memorandum from the Cabinet Division regarding the Rules of Business, 1973. metadata.title: S.R.O. 129(I) of 2024
metadata.summary: This notification transfers assets, including lands, machinery, and funds, from the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority to the newly established Bureau of Aircraft Safety Investigations. It designates specific office complexes in Rawalpindi, Karachi, and Lahore for the Bureau's headquarters and regional offices while directing the Pakistan Airports Authority to facilitate staff accommodation during the transition.

metadata.summary: This notification determines that officers and experts attached to the newly established Bureau of Aircraft Safety Investigations shall remain on their previous terms and conditions until new appointments are made. name: The Finance Act, 2024

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2024
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance, 1961; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2024. It amends several existing laws, including the Stamp Act, 1899, the Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance, 1961, and the Customs Act, 1969.

name: The International Islamic Institute for Peace (IIIP) Act, 2024

metadata.title: International Islamic Institute for Peace (IIIP) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the International Islamic Institute for Peace (IIIP) in the private sector with principal seats at Islamabad and Narowal. It grants the institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, powers, and functions regarding education and research.

name: The Appointment of Director General of the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Rules, 2024

metadata.title: The Appointment of Director General of the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Rules, 2024
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for appointing the Director General of the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority. They define the selection committee, its composition, and the procedures for inviting applications, shortlisting candidates, conducting interviews, and making recommendations to the Prime Minister.

name: Prudential Regulations for Corporate /Commercial Banking (Risk Management and Operations)

metadata.title: Prudential Regulations for Corporate/Commercial Banking (Risk Management and Operations)
metadata.summary: This document outlines prudential regulations for corporate and commercial banking issued by the State Bank of Pakistan. It covers risk management and operations, including definitions, exposure limits, security requirements, and asset maintenance rules.

name: S. R. O. 802(I)/2024. Notification of Provisional Inland Freight Equalization Margin (IFEM) for Petroleum Products

metadata.summary: This notification provisionally determines inland freight equalization margins and prescribed prices for various petroleum products including kerosene, diesel, and gasoline. name: Constitution of Committee on Export of Wheat Products — Notification No. 7-3/2024-Min-I

metadata.title: Committee on Export of Wheat Products
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a Committee on the export of wheat products under the Rules of Business, 1973. The committee includes members from the Ministries of Finance, National Food Security, and Commerce to assess local stocks and recommend exports.

name: The Cash Management & Treasury Single Account Rules, 2024

metadata.title: Cash Management & Treasury Single Account Rules, 2024
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for cash management and the operation of Treasury Single Accounts by the Federal Government of Pakistan. name: The Federal Ziauddin University Act, 2024

metadata.title: Federal Ziauddin University Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Ziauddin University at Islamabad and provides for its incorporation as a body corporate. name: The Toshakhana (Management and Regulation) Act, 2024

metadata.title: Toshokhana (Management and Regulation) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and regulation of Toshokhana, which serves as a repository for gifts received by public office holders and private members of official delegations. name: The Islamabad University of Health Sciences and Emerging Technologies, Islamabad Act, 2024

metadata.title: Islamabad University of Health Sciences and Emerging Technologies, Islamabad Act
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad University of Health Sciences and Emerging Technologies (IUHT) in Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession.
