metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority's notification S.R.O. No. 1915(1) / 2023
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for petroleum products refined in Pakistan and imported into the country. It specifies rates for petroleum levy, inland freight equalization margin, dealer commission, distributor margin, general sales tax, and the maximum ex-depot sale price.

name: Constitution of Cabinet Committee on 9th May, 2023 Incidents and its Terms of Reference — Notification No. F.13/1/2024-Com

metadata.title: Cabinet Committee on 9th May, 2023 Incidents
metadata.summary: This order constitutes a Cabinet Committee to investigate the incidents of May 9, 2023. The committee is tasked with identifying responsible parties, analyzing causes, and recommending preventive measures to strengthen national security.

name: Inclusion of Co-opted Members in the Cabinet Committee on 9th May, 2023 Incidents — Notification No. F.13/1/2024-Com

metadata.title: Notification dated 12th January, 2024
metadata.summary: This notification includes specific Co-opted Members in the composition of a Cabinet Committee regarding incidents on 9th May, 2023. It lists the Minister for Defence, Minister for Foreign Affairs, and Minister for Information Technology and Telecommunication as included members.

name: S.R.O. 33(I)/2024 — Notification of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas for Dhok Sultan X-1 Well

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 33 (1/2024)
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for natural gas produced from the Dhok Sultan X-1 well of the Dhok Sultan Block. It sets a specific price of Rs. 3.00 for gas sold by Pakistan Petroleum Limited to Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited under agreed specifications.

name: S.R.O. 06(I)/2024 — Maximum LPG Price Notification in Supersession of S.R.O. (I)/2023

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 06(1)/2024
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the maximum regulated prices for indigenous and imported LPG at all levels of the supply chain, effective from January 1, 2024. It details specific price components including producer prices, petroleum levies, GST, marketing margins, distribution margins, and transportation costs per metric ton or cylinder.

name: S.R.O. 05(I)/2024.— Amendment to the Pakistan Engineering Council Bye-laws, 1976

metadata.title: Pakistan Engineering Council Bye-laws, 1976 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This notification directs an amendment to the Pakistan Engineering Council Bye-laws, 1976. Specifically, it substitutes dates and numerical values within bye-law 65 regarding the Governing Body's powers.

name: SRO 1899(I)/2023. Notification Regarding Grant of Recognition to NUST School of Health Sciences, Islamabad for MBBS Training

metadata.title: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022 (Amendment)
metadata.amends: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This notification grants recognition to NUST School of Health Sciences, Islamabad for training MBBS students. It amends the First Schedule of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022 by adding a new entry for the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery degree program.

name: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Internet Protocol Television (IPTV) Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2023

metadata.title: Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Internet Protocol Television (IPTV) Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for licensing and operating Internet Protocol Television (IPTV) services in Pakistan. They define key terms related to IPTV infrastructure, content, and subscriber management while setting eligibility criteria for license applicants.

name: Notice of Termination of Sunset Review of Polyester Filament. Yarn Pursuant to Termination of Anti-dumping Investigation against Dumped Imports of PFY into Pakistan Originating in and /or Exported from the People’s Republic of China and Malaysia

metadata.title: Notice of Termination of Sunset Review of Polyester Filament Yarn Pursuant to Termination of Anti-dumping Investigation against Dumped Imports of PFY into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People's Republic of China and Malaysia
metadata.summary: This notification announces the termination of a sunset review regarding Polyester Filament Yarn (PFY) imports from China and Malaysia. The decision follows the termination of the original anti-dumping investigation on November 07, 2023, pursuant to an order by the Anti-dumping Appellate Tribunal.

name: Notice of Conclusion of Sunset Review of the Anti-Dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Polyvinyl Chloride Resin (Suspension Grade) into Pakistan Originating in and / or Exported from the People’s Republic of China, Chinese Taipei, Republic of Korea and Kingdom of Thailand

metadata.title: Notice of Conclusion of Sunset Review of the Anti-Dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Polyvinyl Chloride Resin (Suspension Grade) into Pakistan Originating in and / or Exported from the People's Republic of China, Chinese Taipei, Republic of Korea and Kingdom of Thailand
metadata.summary: This notification announces the conclusion of a sunset review conducted by the National Tariff Commission regarding anti-dumping duties on PVC resin imports from China, Chinese Taipei, Korea, and Thailand. Based on the analysis, the Commission determined that terminating these duties would likely lead to a continuation of dumping and material injury to the domestic industry, resulting in a decision to continue the definitive anti-dumping duties for another three years.

name: The Gun and Country Club Procurement Regulations 2023

metadata.title: Gun and Country Club Procurement Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: This document establishes the procurement regulations for the Gun and Country Club, effective immediately upon publication. It defines key terms related to bidding, contracts, and suppliers while outlining principles for fair, transparent, and economical procurement processes.

name: The Pakistan Single Window Integrated Risk Management System Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Single Window Integrated Risk Management System Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Pakistan Single Window Integrated Risk Management System (IRMS) to apply trade controls and risk mitigation measures on import, export, and transit goods in a coordinated manner. The document defines key terms such as government agencies, the IRMS platform, and post-clearance audits, while outlining the implementation of risk channels and the constitution of inter-agency and agency-level Risk Management Committees.

name: The Investment Ombudsman (Appointment, Terms and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Investment Ombudsman (Appointment, Terms and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the appointment process, terms, and conditions of service for the Investment Ombudsman under the Foreign Investment (Promotion and Protection) Act, 2022. They define eligibility criteria, tenure, powers, functions, and residual matters regarding the Ombudsman's secretariat.

name: SRO 1566(I)/2023. Enforcement of Pakistan Airports Authority Act, 2023.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Airports Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This notification appoints November 10, 2023, as the date on which The Pakistan Airports Authority Act, 2023 comes into force. It was issued by the Federal Government under the Ministry of Aviation in exercise of powers conferred by section 1 of the said Act.

name: S. R. O. 1531(I)/2023 — Notification of SEZ Committee for Sundar Green Special Economic Zone

metadata.title: Notification regarding SEZ Committee for 'Sundar Green Special Economic Zone'
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the composition of the Special Economic Zone (SEZ) Committee for the 'Sundar Green Special Economic Zone'. It outlines the committee's responsibilities, including enforcing benefits, overseeing enterprises, and managing plot sales or leases within the zone.

name: Notice of Conclusion of Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duty Imposed on Dumped Imports of Continuous Casting (Steel) Billets into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People’s Republic of China

metadata.title: Notice of Conclusion of Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duty Imposed on Dumped Imports of Continuous Casting (Steel) Billets into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People's Republic of China
metadata.summary: This notification announces the conclusion of a sunset review conducted by the National Tariff Commission regarding anti-dumping duties on continuous casting steel billets from China. The Commission determined that terminating the duty would likely lead to a recurrence of dumping and material injury to the domestic industry, resulting in a decision to continue the definitive anti-dumping duty at 24.04 percent for three years.

name: No. 12/1/2023-RA-I/STZA – Notification Regarding Appointment of Members of BoG, STZA

metadata.title: Notification appointing Members of the Board of Governors of Special Technology Zones Authority
metadata.summary: This notification appoints various officials and industry experts as members of the Board of Governors for the Special Technology Zones Authority (STZA). The appointments are made under section 6(2) of the Special Technology Zones Authority Act, 2021 for a four-year term.

name: The Federal Prosecution Service Act, 2023

metadata.title: Federal Prosecution Service, Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Criminal Prosecution Service and defines the powers and functions of prosecutors within Pakistan. It outlines the administrative structure, appointment procedures for the Prosecutor General, and the qualifications required for service members.

name: No. 497 - No. 1488-Sr.JS (LED-II) - Constitution of committee to engage with M-s Coniston regarding Pakistan Steel Mills liability dispute

metadata.title: Notification constituting a committee to settle dispute between Pakistan Steel Mills and M/s Coniston
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a committee to address a liability dispute between Pakistan Steel Mills and M/s Coniston. The committee was formed following the approval of the Prime Minister to determine an amicable way forward for settling the issue.

name: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping duties imposed on Dumped Imports of Cold Rolled Coils/ Sheets into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from Canada and Russian Federation

metadata.title: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping duties imposed on Dumped Imports of Cold Rolled Coils/ Sheets into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from Canada and Russian Federation
metadata.summary: This notification announces the impending expiry of definitive anti-dumping duties on cold rolled coils and sheets imported from Canada and the Russian Federation, set to terminate on September 19, 2024. It informs domestic industry producers that they may file a sunset review application with the National Tariff Commission within forty-five days if they wish to extend these duties.

name: S. R. O. 1456(I)/2023 — Amendments in S.R.O. 995(I)/2023 Dated 31st July 2023

metadata.title: Notification bearing S.R.O. 995(I)/2023 (amended by S.R.O. 1456(0)/2023)
metadata.summary: This notification amends a previous Board of Investment directive regarding the Challenge Special Economic Zone. It substitutes specific terms to remove references to 'Fashion' from the zone's name and related designations.

name: S. R. O. 1351(I)/2023 Notification Regarding Exercise of Powers under Sections 279 to 283 and 285 of the Companies Act, 2017 by the Company Bench of the High Court

metadata.title: Notification No. S.R.O. 1351(1)/2023
metadata.repeals: Finance Division's Notification No. S.R.O 840(I)/2017 and Notification No. S.R.O. 1126(1)/2019
metadata.summary: This notification transfers the powers of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan regarding public interest, large, and medium-sized companies to the Company Bench of the High Court. It applies to entities classified under the Third Schedule of the Companies Act, 2017, excluding public sector companies to the extent of the Federal Government.

name: S. R. O. 1331(I)/2023 Notification Regarding Issuance of Further Shares for Cash or Consideration Other Than Cash (Private Companies)

metadata.title: S.R.O. 1331(1)/2023
metadata.summary: This notification by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan outlines specific conditions for private companies issuing further shares to persons other than existing shareholders. It details requirements regarding board approval, shareholder special resolutions, issue pricing, and the necessity of recent valuations for non-cash considerations.

name: No. 498 - S.R.O. 1188(I)-2023 - Pakistan Oil Refining Policy 2023 for Upgradation of existing-Brown Refineries

metadata.title: Pakistan Oil Refining Policy 2023 for Upgradation of Existing/ Brown Refineries
metadata.summary: This notification introduces the Pakistan Oil Refining Policy 2023, specifically designed for the upgradation of existing and brownfield refineries. The policy outlines the strategic importance of local refineries for fuel security, economic development, and foreign exchange savings while addressing the lack of new refinery projects in recent decades.

name: The Registration (Manner and Conditions for Entities providing Electric Power Services) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Registration (Manner and Conditions for Entities Providing Electric Power Services) Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the manner and conditions for entities to register with the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority for providing electric power services. They specify required documentation, including details of services, company certificates, strategic plans, financial statements, and proof of technical and human resources.

name: The Eligibility Criteria (Transmission Licences) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Eligibility Criteria (Transmission Licences) Rules, 2023
subjects: Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997
metadata.summary: These rules establish the eligibility criteria for granting transmission licences to operate as national grid companies, provincial grid companies, or special purpose transmission companies. They specify requirements regarding company registration, solvency, technical resources, IT strategies, and coordination with system operators under the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997.

name: The Eligibility Criteria (Market Operator Licence) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Eligibility Criteria (Market Operator Licence) Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the eligibility criteria for granting a market operator licence under the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997. They specify requirements regarding company registration, financial solvency, technical resources, and public service obligations such as transparency and payment collection.

name: The Eligibility Criteria (Electric Power Trader Licences) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Eligibility Criteria (Electric Power Trader Licences) Rules, 2023
subjects: Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997
metadata.summary: These rules establish the eligibility criteria for granting electric power trader licences under the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997. They define key terms such as applicant, commercial code, and grid code while outlining specific requirements regarding solvency, strategic business plans, technical resources, and public service obligations.

name: The Eligibility Criteria (Electric Power Supplier Licences) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Eligibility Criteria (Electric Power Supplier Licences) Rules, 2023
subjects: Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997
metadata.summary: These rules establish the eligibility criteria for granting electric power supply licences in Pakistan. They define key terms related to power supply, affiliates, and regulatory authorities under the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997. The document outlines specific requirements applicants must meet, including SECP registration, solvency, strategic business plans, and human resource standards.

name: The Eligibility Criteria (Distribution Licences) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Eligibility Criteria (Distribution Licences) Rules, 2023
subjects: Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997
metadata.summary: These rules establish the eligibility criteria for granting distribution licences under the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997. They specify requirements regarding company registration, solvency, technical resources, IT strategy, and service quality that applicants must fulfill before submitting a licence application.

name: The Islamabad Food Authority (Appointment and Conditions of Service) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The Islamabad Food Authority (Appointment and Conditions of Service) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: This document frames regulations regarding the appointment and conditions of service for employees of the Islamabad Food Authority. It defines key terms, outlines committee constitutions, and establishes rules for initial appointments, qualifications, age limits, and post creation.

name: The Trade Dispute Resolution Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Trade Dispute Resolution Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive regime in Pakistan for the swift and effective resolution of disputes related to the export and import of goods and services, including those involving e-commerce. It creates a Trade Dispute Resolution Commission with exclusive supervisory and enforcement jurisdiction to handle these international trade disputes through negotiations, determinations, and alternative dispute resolution mechanisms.

name: S.R.O. 1022(I)/2023 – OGRA Financial Regulations (Amendment)

metadata.title: The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Financial Regulations (Amendment) Notification, 2023
metadata.amends: The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Financial Regulations, 2005
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Financial Regulations, 2005. It inserts a new Grade Pay Scale Span for Executive Staff Sr.No. 1 in Appendix-B of the regulations.

name: The National Telecommunication Corporation Employees (Service) Regulations, 2023

metadata.title: National Telecommunication Corporation Employees (Service) Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the terms and conditions of employment for regular and temporary employees of the National Telecommunication Corporation (NTC). They define key concepts such as appointment types, allowances, duties, and the roles of various authorities within the corporation.

name: The Pakistan Civil Aviation Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Civil Aviation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law for the better regulation and control of civil aviation in Pakistan. It also confers certain duties and powers on the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority.

name: The National Logistics Corporation Act, 2023

metadata.title: National Logistics Corporation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Logistics Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the re-organization of existing logistics bodies and defines the Corporation's functions, including multi-modal logistics services and infrastructure development.

name: The Gun and Country Club Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Gun and Country Club Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Gun and Country Club in Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the regulation, administration, and management of the club's affairs, including the appointment of an Administrator by the Prime Minister.

name: The Pakistan Air Safety Investigation Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Air Safety Investigation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a framework for the better investigation of accidents and other incidents arising from aircraft navigation in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'accident', 'incident', and 'aircraft', and outlines the scope of application to citizens, registered aircraft, and foreign operators within Pakistani jurisdiction.

name: The National Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Authority Act, 2023

metadata.title: National Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Authority in Pakistan to address money laundering and terrorism financing as existential threats. The legislation creates a body corporate with administrative and financial powers to unify state response, coordinate international efforts, and implement necessary strategic planning.

name: The Anti-Dumping Duties Rules, 2022

metadata.title: The Anti-Dumping Duties Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Anti-Dumping Duties Act, 2015 to regulate investigations and reviews regarding dumping. They establish requirements for applications, define key terms like 'fair selling price' and 'non-injurious price', and mandate the creation of public and official files for interested parties.

name: The Pakistan Sovereign Wealth Fund Act, 2023

metadata.title: Pakistan Sovereign Wealth Fund Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Sovereign Wealth Fund to be owned and controlled by the Federal Government. The Fund aims to contribute to sustainable economic development through the optimal management of its funds and assets according to international standards.

name: The Pakistan Airports Authority Act, 2023

metadata.title: Pakistan Airports Authority Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Airports Authority to improve the administration, operation, and development of airports and air transport services in Pakistan. It applies to all airports and air navigation services except those used exclusively by the armed forces.

name: The Pakistan General Cosmetics Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan General Cosmetics Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the quality, standard, labeling, packing, manufacturing, storage, distribution, and sales of general cosmetics in Pakistan. It establishes the Pakistan General Cosmetics Regulatory Authority as an autonomous body under the Ministry of Science and Technology to oversee these matters.

name: The Film and Drama Finance Fund Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Film and Drama Finance Fund Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Film and Drama Finance Fund (FDFF) to promote screen tourism, film and drama production, and provide financial support to artists. The fund sources money from statutory bodies, private organizations, investments, and a one-time seed grant from the Federal Government.

name: S. R. O. 986(I)/2023 Approval and Notification of SEZ Application by SEZ Authority Sindh

metadata.title: S. R. O. 986(1)/2023
subjects: Dhabeji ZKB Public Economic & Management Partnership Limited
metadata.summary: This notification approves the application for a Special Economic Zone (SEZ) submitted by Dhabeji ZKB Public Economic & Management Partnership Limited in Sindh. It outlines specific terms and conditions regarding construction timelines, land title requirements, utility provisions, and adherence to the Special Economic Zones Act, 2012.

name: The SBP Banking Services Corporation Rules, 2023

metadata.title: SBP Banking Services Corporation Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These Rules establish the short title and commencement for the SBP Banking Services Corporation. They define key terms such as Acting Managing Director, Board, Governor, and Managing Director within the context of the SBP Banking Services Corporation Ordinance, 2001.

name: The Public Private Partnership Authority (Human Resources) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: Public Private Partnership Authority (Human Resources) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the human resources framework for the Public Private Partnership Authority, including definitions, service structure, and appointment methods. They specify procedures for hiring via contracts, advancement, or deputation, along with requirements for competitive selection and probation periods.

name: The Public Private Partnership Authority (Financial Management) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: Public Private Partnership Authority (Financial Management) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: This document approves the Financial Management Regulations for the Public Private Partnership Authority (P3A). It establishes responsibilities, policies, and procedures for the financial management of the Authority, including definitions for assets, liabilities, and accounting workflows.

name: The Salary of Judges of the High Court's Order, 2023

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2023
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2022
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary scales for judges of the High Courts in Pakistan, setting the pay for the Chief Justice at Rs. 1,139,251 and for other judges at Rs. 1,095,434 per month. The order comes into force immediately and is deemed effective from July 1, 2023.

name: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2023

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2023
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2022 (P.O. No. I of 2022)
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the salaries for the Chief Justice of Pakistan and other Judges of the Supreme Court. It comes into force immediately and is deemed effective from July 1, 2023.

name: The Finance Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2023
metadata.amends: Petroleum products (petroleum levy) Ordinance, 1961; Members of parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2023. It also amends several existing laws, including the Petroleum products (petroleum levy) Ordinance, 1961, the Members of parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974, and the Customs Act, 1969.

name: The Maternity and Paternity Leave Act, 2023

metadata.title: Maternity and Paternity Leave Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for maternity and paternity leave facilities for employees of public and private establishments under the administrative control of the Federal Government. It specifies the duration of leave based on birth order, defines key terms like 'employee' and 'establishment', and outlines penalties for contravention.

name: The Trained Paramedical Staff Facility Act, 2023

metadata.title: Trained Paramedical Staff Facility Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the facility of trained paramedical staff in public and private educational institutions within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It mandates that both federal and private institutions ensure immediate medical assistance and first aid are available to students whenever needed.

name: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council (Postgraduate Education) Regulations, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council (Postgraduate Education) Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for postgraduate medical and dental education in Pakistan under the authority of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council. They outline procedures for program recognition, student admission policies, training standards, and evaluation processes for clinical and basic science courses.

name: S. R. O. 740(I)/2023 Notification for Acquisition or Holding of Shares of National Clearing Company of Pakistan Limited by LSE Ventures Limited

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 740(D/2023
metadata.summary: This notification authorizes LSE Ventures Limited to acquire or hold shares of National Clearing Company of Pakistan Ww Limited. The authorization is granted by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan under specific powers conferred by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan Act, 1997 and related Clearing House regulations.

name: Notification of Receipt of Application for Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duties levied on Dumped Imports of Color Coated Coils/ Sheets into Pakistan Originating in and /or Exported from China and South Africa

metadata.title: Receipt of Application for Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duties levied on Dumped Imports of Color Coated Coils/ Sheets into Pakistan Originating in and /or Exported from China and South Africa
metadata.number: A.D. C. No. 51/ 2017/ NTC/ CCC/ SSR/ 2023
metadata.summary: This notification informs interested parties that the National Tariff Commission received an application from M/s. International Steels Limited regarding a sunset review of anti-dumping duties on color coated coils from China and South Africa. The decision to process this application is currently pending because the Commission is not yet constituted under Section 4(1) of the National Tariff Commission, 2015.

name: Kalam Bibi International Women Institute Bannu Act, 2023

metadata.title: Kalam Bibi International Women Institute Bannu Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Kalam Bibi International Women Institute Bannu by upgrading the existing Women Campus of the University of Bannu. It grants the new institute corporate status, academic, financial, and administrative autonomy, and provides for its powers to acquire property and employ staff.

name: Pir Roshan Institute of Progressive Sciences and Technologies, Miranshah Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Pir Roshaan Institute of Progressive Sciences and Technologies, Miranshah Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pir Roshaan Institute of Progressive Sciences and Technologies located in Miranshah, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It grants the institute a corporate status with perpetual succession and provides for its academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

name: Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Supreme Court (Review of Judgments and Orders) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates and strengthens the Supreme Court of Pakistan's power to review its own judgments and orders under Article 188 of the Constitution. It enlarges the Court's jurisdiction by equating the scope of review on facts and law with that of an appeal under Article 185.

name: The Pakistan Institute of Research and Registration of Quality Assurance Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Research and Registration of Quality Assurance Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Institute of Research and Registration of Quality Assurance in the private sector. It provides for the incorporation of the institute as a body corporate, defines its structure including the Board of Governors and Academic Council, and outlines its powers to acquire property and set up campuses across Pakistan.

name: No. 496 - S.R.O. 597(I)-2023 - Pakistan Oil Refining Policy 2023 for New-Greenfield Refineries

metadata.title: Pakistan Oil Refining Policy 2023 for New/ Greenfield Refineries
metadata.summary: This notification formally adopts the Pakistan Oil Refining Policy 2023 specifically for new and greenfield refineries. The document outlines the strategic importance of refineries for fuel security, economic growth, and defense needs while addressing the current lack of new refinery projects in Pakistan over the last decade.

name: Constitution of Search and Nomination Committee for recomendations of suitable pesons to be appointed as membes of PMDC

metadata.title: Notification constituting Search and Nomination Committee for recommendations of suitable persons to be appointed as Members of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a Search and Nomination Committee to recommend suitable persons for appointment as Members of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council. The committee includes the Federal Minister for NHSR&C, the Secretary of the Ministry, Joint Secretaries, and nominated professors from the medical profession.

name: The Members of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) Immunities and Privileges Act, 2023

metadata.title: Members of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) Immunities and Privileges Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides immunities and privileges to members of the Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) of Pakistan. It establishes specific safeguards against arrest, including exemptions from preventive detention during sessions and restrictions on arrests within parliamentary precincts.

name: S. R. O. 515(I)/2023 — Withdrawal of Federal Excise Notification S.R.O. 178(I)/2023

metadata.title: Notification No. S.R.O. 515(I)/2023
metadata.repeals: Notification No. S.R.O. 178(I)/2023
metadata.summary: This notification is issued by the Federal Board of Revenue under the powers of the Federal Excise Act, 2005. It rescinds a previous notification dated February 14, 2023.

name: The Pakistan Maritime Zones Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Maritime Zones Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The law relating to territorial sea and maritime zones of Pakistan
subjects: United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Pakistan's territorial sea and maritime zones. It gives effect to the provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, 1982, ratified by Pakistan.

name: The Supreme Court (Practice and Procedure) Act, 2023

metadata.title: Supreme Court (Practice and Procedure) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes specific practices and procedures for the Supreme Court of Pakistan, including the constitution of benches by a committee led by the Chief Justice. It mandates that matters involving public importance or constitutional interpretation be heard by larger benches and grants parties the right to appoint counsel of their choice for review applications.

name: The National University of Pakistan Act, 2023

metadata.title: National University of Pakistan Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National University of Pakistan (NUP) as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, including the Board of Governors, Academic Council, and various other bodies.

name: The Inter-Boards Coordination Commission Act, 2023

metadata.title: Inter-Boards Coordination Commission Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act re-constitutes and re-structures the existing Inter-Boards Committee of Chairmen as the Inter-Boards Coordination Commission (IBCC). The IBCC serves as a corporate body responsible for standardizing examinations, authenticating equivalence and attestation of qualifications, and promoting curricular activities across intermediate and secondary education boards in Pakistan.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Place of Provision of Services) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory (Place of Provision of Services) Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules define the place of provision for various taxable services, specifically focusing on advertisements across different media including TV, radio, internet, and billboards within the Islamabad Capital Territory. They establish specific locations for service provision based on the type of broadcast or medium used, such as satellite uplinking stations or terrestrial signal locations.

name: The nominations of members (Council) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Nominations of Members (Council) Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for nominating members to the Allied Health Professionals Council, including the constitution of a search and nomination committee. They also define terms related to the Council's operations, such as the appointment of the President, resignation processes, and age restrictions for members.

name: The Lawyers Welfare and Protection Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Advocates Welfare and Protection Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to provide welfare and protection for advocates in Pakistan. It defines acts of violence against advocates, including harassment, assault, and coercion, and prescribes punishments for such offenses.

name: The Pakistan Single Window Trade Data Dissemination, Exchange and Utilization Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Single Window Trade Data Dissemination, Exchange and Utilization Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the dissemination, exchange, and utilization of trade data within the Pakistan Single Window (PSW) system. name: The Pakistan Global Institute Act, 2023

metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Pakistan Global Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession. metadata.summary: These rules establish prohibition of corporal punishment committees within educational institutions in the Islamabad Capital Territory. The document defines committee composition, outlines functions such as complaint investigation and child support, and sets procedures for registering and handling abuse cases.

metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for various petroleum products including High Speed Diesel, Motor Gasoline, and E-10 Gasoline. metadata.title: S.R.O. 95(1)/2023
metadata.summary: This notification provisionally determines the inland freight equalization margin (IFEM) for various petroleum products. It applies to refined products produced in Pakistan and imports, effective from January 29, 2023.

metadata.title: S.R.O. 94(1)/2023
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for petroleum products refined in Pakistan and imported into the country. It specifies rates for petroleum levy, inland freight equalization margin, dealer and distributor commissions, general sales tax, and the maximum ex-depot sale price effective from January 29, 2023.

name: S.R.O. 93(I)/2023 – Amendment to OGRA Service Regulations, 2005

metadata.title: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Service Regulations (Amendment) Notification
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Service Regulations, 2005
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Service Regulations, 2005 to update pay scales and allowances for regular employees effective January 1, 2023. It specifically replaces Appendix-B with new pay scales, revises the Cost of Living Allowance calculation, and increases the Mileage Allowance from Rs. 10 to Rs. 15 per kilometer.

name: The State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act, 2023

metadata.title: State-owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the governance and operation of state-owned enterprises owned and controlled by the Federal Government. It aims to ensure effective service delivery and fiscal discipline by specifying principles governing these enterprises, authorizing the formation of certain entities, and establishing requirements for ownership and accountability.

name: The Pakistan Single Window (Evidence of Identity) Regulations, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Single Window (Evidence of Identity) Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the requirements for evidence of identity for users participating in the Pakistan Single Window (PSW) system for cross-border trade. They specify the necessary identification documents, such as NTN, CNIC, and CUIN, depending on whether the applicant is a Pakistani national or a foreign entity. The document also outlines the electronic procedure for verifying user credentials through the PSW portal, including biometric verification and the issuance of user identities.

metadata.summary: This notification designates Mr. Fahd Haroon as the Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Public Communication & Digital Platforms with immediate effect. The designation is made by the Prime Minister under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: S. R. O. 67(I)/2023.- Notification Regarding Non-Applicability of IFRS 9 (Expected Credit Losses Method) on Financial Assets Relating to Circular Debt

metadata.title: Notification regarding exemption of IFRS 9 requirements for companies holding financial assets due from the Government
metadata.summary: This notification exempts companies holding financial assets due from the Government of Pakistan regarding circular debt from applying IFRS 9 Expected Credit Losses Method. Instead, these companies must follow the relevant requirements of IAS 39 for the specified financial years ending on or before December 31, 2024.

name: S. R. O. 47(I)/2023.— Notification of SEZ Committee for Roshan Sun Tao Paper Mills (Private) Limited Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zone

metadata.summary: This notification establishes the Special Economic Zone (SEZ) Committee for Roshan Sun Tao Paper Mills (Private) Limited Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zone. It defines the committee's composition and outlines its terms of reference, which include administering SEZ benefits, enforcing rules, and facilitating between enterprises and government regulators.

It declares the maximum ex-depot sale price for specific products like Kerosene Oil effective from January 16, 2023.

name: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022

metadata.title: Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law regarding the registration of medical practitioners and dentists in Pakistan. It establishes a uniform minimum standard for qualifications and reconstitutes the Medical and Dental Council.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Prohibition of Interest on Private loans Act, 2023

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Prohibition of Interest on Private Transactions Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the business and practices of private money-lending and advancing loans or transactions based on interest within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines key terms such as 'money lender', 'interest', and 'molest' to establish legal boundaries for financial activities.

name: The Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) Act, 2023
metadata.repeals: The Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Act, 2021 and establishes the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS). It defines key terms regarding hospitals and super-specialty professionals, outlines provisions for engaging highly skilled medical personnel, and details the transfer of assets and liabilities from the dissolved institute to the concerned division under the Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University.

name: The Public Private Partnership Authority (Direct Contracting of IFIs as Transaction Advisers) Regulations, 2023

metadata.title: The Public Private Partnership Authority (Direct Contracting of IFIs as Transaction Advisers) Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for implementing agencies to hire International Financial Institutions (IFIs) as transaction advisers on a direct contracting basis. They outline the specific criteria for project eligibility, the approval process managed by the Board of the Public Private Partnership Authority, and the selection procedures for IFIs.

name: SRO 05(I)/2023.- Designate the Courts of Mr. Humayun Dilawar, Additional District and Sessions Judge (West), Islamabad to Try The Offences

metadata.title: The Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This notification designates specific courts in Islamabad to try offences under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021. It was issued by the Federal Government in consultation with the Chief Justice of the Islamabad High Court on January 4, 2023.

name: S. R. O. 01(I)/2023. Notification of Sales Tax Exemption on Repatriated Contingent Owned Equipment (COE) of Civil Armed Forces

metadata.title: S. R. O. 01(1)/2023
metadata.summary: This notification exempts the whole of sales tax on old Contingent Owned Equipment (COE) or used stores belonging to the Civil Armed Forces. The exemption applies specifically to items repatriated and arrived at Karachi Port after the completion of the United Nations Peacekeeping mission in Darfur, Sudan.

name: The Pakistan Registration of Medical and Dental Practitioners Regulations, 2023

metadata.title: The Pakistan Registration of Medical and Dental Practitioners Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the online registration and maintenance of registers for medical and dental practitioners in Pakistan. They define specific categories of registration, including provisions for foreign nationals seeking temporary registration for study or institutional service.

name: No. 487 - No. 3-3-2017-Min.I - Conferment of status of Minister of State on Mr. Ashfaq Tola, Chairman, Reforms and Resource Mobilization Commission

metadata.summary: This notification confers the status of Minister of State on Mr. Ashfaq Tola, who serves as Chairman of the Reforms and Resource Mobilization Commission (RRMC). The appointment is effective immediately and requires him to work on a pro bono basis.

metadata.summary: This notification grants six days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Asad Mahmood, the Federal Minister for Communications. name: No. 482 - No. 3-2-2022-Min-I - Re-designation of Mr. Attaullah Tarar as Special Assistant on Interior and Legal Affairs

metadata.summary: This notification re-designates Mr. Attaullah Tarar as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Interior and Legal Affairs with the status of Federal Minister. The change takes effect immediately under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: The Access to the Media (Deaf) Persons Act, 2022

metadata.title: Access to the Media (Deaf) Persons Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act ensures that deaf persons in Pakistan have access to information through broadcast media using Pakistan Sign Language. It mandates the appointment of sign language interpreters for news, entertainment, and other programs on national broadcasters and private channels within specific timeframes after the Act's commencement.

name: No. 486 - No. 2-1-2022-Min-I - Ex-Pakistan leave for Mr. Ahad Cheema, Adviser to the Prime Minister on Establishment

metadata.summary: This notification designates Mr. Shaharyar Ali Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Privatisation with the status of Minister of State. The appointment takes immediate effect and is issued by the Cabinet Division in accordance with rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 484 - No. 3-2-2022-Min-I - Appointment of Rana Mubashir Iqbal, MNA as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister
