metadata.summary: This notification appoints Rana Mubashir Iqbal, MNA, as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister with the status of Federal Minister. The appointment takes immediate effect under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 480 - No. F.4-7-2015-Cab - Constitution of the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)

metadata.title: Notification constituting the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC) with a specific composition of Federal Ministers and secretaries. The committee is tasked with examining fresh legislation, amendments, and rules to ensure they align with the Constitutional scheme and government policy before being placed before the Cabinet.

name: The Foreign Investment (Promotion and Protection) Act, 2022

metadata.title: Foreign Investment (Promotion and Protection) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the promotion and protection of certain qualified foreign investments in Pakistan. It aims to improve the investment climate by offering tax incentives and ensuring the ease of transferring and repatriating foreign investments.

name: The Smart Institute of Sciences & Technology Act, 2022

metadata.title: Smart Institute of Sciences & Technology Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Smart Institute of Sciences & Technology in the private sector at Rawalpindi. It grants the institute perpetual succession, a common seal, and academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

name: The Asset Backed Securitization Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: Asset Backed Securitization Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the offer of debt securities, including redeemable capital and sukuk, by special purpose vehicles under the securitization process. They establish eligibility criteria, operational conditions, and obligations for special purpose vehicles, including requirements for registration, capital maintenance, and asset management in the interest of investors.

name: The Pakistan Single Window Trade Data Dissemination, Exchange and Utilization Rules, 2022

metadata.title: The Pakistan Single Window Trade Data Dissemination, Exchange and Utilization Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the dissemination, exchange, and utilization of trade data within the Pakistan Single Window (PSW) system. They define key terms such as 'Trade Data' and 'Data Recipient', mandate confidentiality measures for all entities involved, and outline authorized purposes for sharing information including public policy analysis and international integration.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (System Operator) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (System Operator) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for licensing system operators under the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority. They define key terms related to power system planning, dispatch, and ancillary services required for a stable electricity grid.

name: No. 481 - No. F.4-7-2015-Cab - Nomination of additional members to the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)

metadata.title: Notification of members of Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Muhammad Ishaq Dar and Mr. Asad Mahmood as members of the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC). It is issued by the Prime Minister in continuation of a previous notification dated November 8, 2022.

name: The Inter-Governmental Commercial Transactions Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Inter-Governmental Commercial Transactions Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to facilitate inter-governmental economic and commercial transactions between Pakistan and foreign states. It empowers the Federal Government to enter into G2G agreements and constitutes a Cabinet Committee to oversee negotiations, approve agreements, and grant regulatory exemptions necessary for these transactions.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Open Access (Interconnection and Wheeling of Electric Power) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Open Access (Interconnection and Wheeling of Electric Power) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for open access to the national electric power system, covering interconnection and wheeling of electric power. They define key terms such as generation facilities, network licensees, and use of system agreements under the authority of the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority.

name: The Capital Value Tax Rules, 2022

metadata.title: The Capital Value Tax Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for levying and collecting Capital Value Tax on assets in Pakistan. They outline requirements for filing electronic declarations, converting asset values to rupees, and submitting quarterly or annual statements by relevant authorities.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Domestic Workers Act, 2022

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Domestic Workers Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the employment of domestic workers within the Islamabad Capital Territory to safeguard their safety, dignity, and basic rights. It prohibits the employment of children under sixteen years of age and establishes specific entitlements for domestic workers.

name: The Dyslexia Special Measures Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Dyslexia Special Measures Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides for special measures regarding the education of children suffering from dyslexia and associated disorders. It establishes rights to inclusive education, mandates identification procedures, requires instructional accommodations, and outlines provisions for special educators and therapists.

name: The Export-Import Bank of Pakistan Act, 2022

metadata.title: Export-Import Bank of Pakistan Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Export-Import Bank of Pakistan as the official export credit agency to support and promote international trade. It provides for matters connected with trade financing, insurance, equity participation, and services to enhance the country's competitiveness in global markets.

name: S. R. O. 1910(I)/2022.— Notification Regarding Delegation of Powers and Functions of the Commission to the Head of Department, Adjudication Department-I

metadata.title: Relevant Regulation of the Listed Companies (Code of Corporate Nature of powers/functions Governance) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: This notification delegates specific powers and functions of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan to the Head of Department, Adjudication Department-I. It authorizes the delegated authority to impose penalties for non-compliance with regulations regarding listed companies and licensed entities.

name: Notification Regarding Modification of Effective Date for Applicability of IFRS 9 for Non-Banking Finance Companies and Modarabas

metadata.title: Notification modifying the effective date for applicability of International Financial Reporting Standard 9
metadata.summary: This notification modifies the effective date for applying International Financial Reporting Standard 9 (IFRS 9) to Non-Banking Finance Companies and Modarabas. The new applicability is set for reporting periods or years ending on or after June 30, 2024, with permission for earlier application.

name: The Issuance of Convertible Debt Securities through Right Offer Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: Issuance of Convertible Debt Securities through Right Offer Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the issuance of convertible debt securities by listed companies through a right offer to existing shareholders. They establish specific conditions, procedural requirements, and timelines for board approvals, public dissemination, and subscription mechanics.

name: No. 472 - No. F.10(3)DD(Q)-2016 - Appointment of members of the Central Ruet-e-Hilal Committee

metadata.title: Notification appointing members of the Central Ruet-e-Hilal Committee
metadata.summary: This notification appoints three individuals as members of the Central Ruet-e-Hilal Committee with immediate effect. The appointments remain in force until further orders are issued by the Ministry.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Security of Information Technology and Operational Technology) Regulations, 2022.

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Security of Information Technology and Operational Technology) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish minimum standards for licensees, registered persons, and generation companies to ensure safe and reliable electric power services. They mandate that all stakeholders maintain their information systems against unauthorized access and implement safeguards to protect critical infrastructure data within the national grid.

name: Notice of Conclusion of Sunset Review of the Anti-Dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Galvanized Steel Coils/Sheets of thickness ranging from 0.15mm to 2.75mm into Pakistan Originating in and / or Exported from the People’s Republic of China

metadata.title: Notice of Conclusion of Sunset Review of the Anti-Dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Galvanized Steel Coils/Sheets of thickness ranging from 0.15mm to 2.75mm into Pakistan Originating in and / or Exported from the People's Republic of China
metadata.summary: This notification announces the conclusion of a sunset review conducted by the National Tariff Commission regarding anti-dumping duties on galvanized steel coils and sheets from China. Based on findings that dumping would likely continue and domestic injury would recur if duties were removed, the Commission decided to extend these definitive anti-dumping duties for another five years starting February 08, 2022.

name: The Fixed Broadband Quality of Service (QoS) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: Fixed Broadband Quality of Service (QoS) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations define Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Fixed Broadband services to establish quantifiable benchmarks for Quality of Service. They apply to all Broadband Service Providers in Pakistan and outline the testing methodology, definitions, and responsibilities regarding end-to-end service quality.

name: The Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan (Financial) Rules, 2022

metadata.title: Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan (Financial) Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules govern the financial administration, control, and accounting management of the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan. They apply to all financial transactions, investments, and asset disposal within the organization's head office and registries.

name: The Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan (Service) Rules, 2022

metadata.title: The Registered Designs Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Federal Government under section 31 of the Registered Designs Ordinance, 2000 to regulate applications and registrations. They establish definitions, fee structures, required forms, article classification, and document filing standards for designs in Pakistan.

name: The National Metrology Institute of Pakistan Act, 2022

metadata.title: National Metrology Institute of Pakistan Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Metrology Institute of Pakistan as an apex body to implement a unified national measurement system. It provides for the infrastructure required to support legal metrology and quality assurance in accordance with international practices.

name: S. R. O. 1651(I)/2022 — Notification Granting Special Economic Zone Status to Khairpur Industrial Estate

metadata.title: Notification No. S.R.O. 1651(1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification declares the Sindh Economic Zone Management Company (SEZMC) as the successor to the Project Directorate Khairpur SEZ. Consequently, SEZMC is appointed as the Developer for the Khairpur Special Economic Zone effective immediately.

name: S.R.O. 1609(I)/2022 – Determination of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas from Mela Field

metadata.title: Notification determining the wellhead price of agreed specification gas produced from Mela field
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for agreed specification gas produced from the Mela field. The specified price is set at US $2.7588 per MMBTU for sales between Oil and Gas Development Limited and Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited.

name: S.R.O. 1589(I)/2022 – Exemption of FED on Donations to Prime Minister’s Flood Relief Fund, 2022

metadata.title: Notification exempting federal excise duty on donations to Prime Minister's Flood Relief Fund, 2022
metadata.summary: This notification exempts federal excise duty leviable on donations received in the Prime Minister's Flood Relief Fund, 2022. It is issued under the powers of section 16 of the Federal Excise Act, 2005 and takes effect from August 5, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 1590(I)/2022 – Amendments to the Second Schedule of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: S. R. O. 1590(I)/2022
metadata.summary: This order amends the Second Schedule to the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001. It grants tax exemptions for donations made to the Prime Minister's Flood Relief Fund, 2022, effective from August 5, 2022.

name: The National Information Technology Board Act, 2022

metadata.title: National Information Technology Board Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Information Technology Board (NITB) to facilitate e-governance across Pakistan. It defines the Board's structure, composition, and powers to develop software applications for Federal Ministries and divisions while ensuring standardization and interoperability.

name: No. 479 - S.R.O. 1555(I)-2022 - Pakistan Navy Hydrographic Department re-designated as National Hydrographic Office

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 1555(1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification designates the Pakistan Navy Hydrographic Department (PNHD) to perform the functions of a National Hydrographic Office on behalf of the Government of Pakistan. It also re-designates the Hydrographer Pakistan Navy as the Hydrographer of Pakistan to support safety of navigation and fulfill international commitments.

name: Appointment of Malik Muhammad Ahmad Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister with the Status of Federal Minister — Notification No. 3-2/2022-Min-I

metadata.title: Notification appointing Malik Muhammad Ahmad Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Malik Muhammad Ahmad Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister with the status of Federal Minister. The appointment takes immediate effect and is issued by the Cabinet Secretariat under the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: S.R.O. 1534(I)/2022 – Determination of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas from Chhutto-1, NIM Concession

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 1534(1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for agreed specification gas sold by Oil and Gas Development Company Limited to Sui Southern Gas Company Limited. The specified price is set at US $ 2.5686 per MMBTU, effective from July 01, 2022, to December 31, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 1502(I)/2022 – Determination of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas from Sohrab Deep Field, Mirpurkhas Block

metadata.title: Notification determining wellhead gas price for Sohrab Deep field
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead gas price for natural gas produced from the Sohrab Deep field in the Mirpurkhas Block. The specified price is USD 5.8989 per KIMBTU for sales by United Energy Pakistan Limited to Sul-Southern Gas Company Limited, effective from July 1, 2022, to December 31, 2022.

name: The Modaraba Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: The Modaraba Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: This document contains amendments to the Modaraba Regulations, 2021, made by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan under powers conferred by the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and control) Ordinance, 1980. It defines key terms such as Certificates of Musharakah, financial services modaraba, exposure, and finance within the context of Islamic financing modes.

name: No. 478 - No. 2-1-2022-Min-I - Ex-Pakistan leave for Rana Sana Ullah Khan, Federal Minister for Interior

metadata.title: Grant of Leave to Rana Sana Ullah Khan
metadata.summary: This notification grants ten days of ex-Pakistan leave to Rana Sana Ullah Khan, the Federal Minister for Interior. The leave is authorized from August 11th to August 20th, 2022, under powers conferred by the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.

name: No. 477 - No. 2-3-2022-Min-I - Appointment of Sardar Ayaz Sadiq, MNA as Federal Minister for Economic Affairs and Political Affairs

metadata.title: The Gazette of Pakistan, Extra., August 13, 2022
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Sardar Ayaz Sadiq as the Federal Minister for Economic Affairs and Political Affairs. The appointment was made by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister under Article 92 of the Constitution, effective immediately.

name: No. 476 - No. 2-1-2022-Min-I - Ex-Pakistan leave for Mr. Abid Hussain Bhayo, Federal Minister for Privatisation

metadata.title: Grant of Leave to Mr. Abid Hussain Bhayo
metadata.summary: This notification grants ten days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Abid Hussain Bhayo, the Federal Minister for Privatisation. The leave is valid from August 1st to August 10th, 2022, pursuant to powers under the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.

name: No. 475 - No. 2-3-2020-Min-I - Designation of Mr. Ehsanullah Reki as Minister of State for Defence Production

metadata.title: Notification designating Mr. Ehsanullah Reki as Minister of State for Defence Production
metadata.summary: This notification designates Mr. Ehsanullah Reki as the Minister of State for Defence Production with immediate effect. The designation is made by the Prime Minister under rule 3(4) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 501 - No. F.5-15-2022-Com - Constitution of Special Cabinet Committee for Appointment of Chairman, Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan

metadata.title: Notification constituting a Special Cabinet Committee for Appointment of Chairman, Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a Special Cabinet Committee to handle the appointment of the Chairman of the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan (IPO-P). The committee includes Ministers from Commerce, Law & Justice, Communications, and Maritime Affairs, with support provided by the Commerce Division.

name: No. 474 - No. F.5-3-2022-Com - Inclusion of SAPM on Government Effectiveness as Special Invitee in Economic Coordination Committee (ECC)

metadata.title: Notification regarding inclusion of SAPM on Government Effectiveness as 'Special Invitee' in the Economic Coordination Committee
metadata.summary: This notification includes the SAPM on Government Effectiveness as a 'Special Invitee' in the composition of the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC). The action was taken by the Prime Minister under rule 17(2) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: S.R.O. 1342(I)/2022 – Determination of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas from Saleh Gas Field, Mirpurkhas Block

metadata.title: Notification determining wellhead gas price for Saleh gas field
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead gas price for natural gas produced from the Saleh gas field in the Mirpurkhas Block. The specified price is US $5.8989 per MMBTU for sales between United Energy Pakistan and Sui-Southern Gas Company Limited, effective from July 1, 2022 to December 31, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 1341(I)/2022 – Determination of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas from Sofiay Gas Field, Mehar Block

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 1341 (1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for specification natural gas sold by M/s UEP Alpha Limited to Sui-Southern Gas Company Limited. The price is set at US $ 5.8989 per MMBTU for the period from July 01, 2022 to December 31, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 1340(I)/2022 – Determination of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas from Thebo Gas Field, Mirpurkhas Block

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 1340 (1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead gas price for natural gas produced from Thebo Gas Field (Thebo-f Discovery) in Mirpur Khas Block. It sets the price at US $5.8989 per MMBTU for sales by United Energy Pakistan Limited to Sui-Southern Gas Company Limited, effective from July 1, 2022, to December 31, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 1337(I)/2022 – Determination of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas from Kamal North Field, Khipro Block

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 1337 (1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for natural gas sold by United Energy Pakistan Limited to Sui-Southern Gas Company Limited. The specified price is US $2.6655 per MMBTU for gas produced from the Kamal North field of Khipro Block, effective from July 1, 2022, to July 19, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 1336(I)/2022 – Determination of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas from Sutiari Deep-01 Field, Khipro Block

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 1336 (1/2022)
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for natural gas produced from the Sutiari Deep-01 field of Khipro Block. The specified price is US $5.8989 per MMBTU for sales by United Energy Pakistan Limited to Sui-Southern Gas Company Limited between July 1, 2022 and December 31, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 1335(I)/2022 – Determination of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas from Saqib Gas Field, Mubarak Block

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 1335 (1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for natural gas sold by M/s UEP Alpha Limited to Sui-Southern Gas Company Limited. The specified price is US $3.2179 per MMBTU, effective from July 01, 2022, to December 31, 2022.

name: S. R. O. 1314(I)/2022 — Amendments in Notification No. 1(30)/2015-SEZ Dated 26th December 2019 Relating to M-3 Industrial City (M-3IC), Faisalabad

metadata.title: The Special Economic Zones (Amendment) Notification, 2022
metadata.summary: This document contains a series of statutory notifications issued by the Board of Investment to amend specific SEZ regulations. The amendments update the authorized signatory for various Special Economic Zones across Pakistan, substituting the Director General (SEZ) or nominated officers as the responsible authority.

name: S.R.O. 1200(I)/2022 – Makori East Gas Wellhead Price Notification

metadata.title: S. R. O. 1200(I)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead gas price for natural gas of agreed specification sold by M/s MOL Pakistan Oil & Gas Co. B.V to Sui-Northern Gas Pipelines Limited. The price is set at US $ 3.8355 per MMBTU for the period from July 01, 2022 to December 31, 2022.

name: No. 502 - No. F.5-13-2022-Com - Constitution of Cabinet Committee on Election in Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT)

metadata.title: Notification constituting a Cabinet Committee regarding Election in Islamabad Capital Territory
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a specific Cabinet Committee to review the stance of the Election Commission of Pakistan regarding elections in the Islamabad Capital Territory. The committee is tasked with submitting recommendations within 24 hours based on proposals from the Interior Division and advice from the Law and Justice Division.

name: The Companies Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: Companies Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: This document publishes a draft of the Companies Regulations, 2022 proposed by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. The regulations are made under powers conferred by section 512 of the Companies Act, 2017 for public information and comment.

name: The National Rahmatul-Lil-Aalameen Wa Khatamun Nabiyyin Authority Act, 2022

metadata.title: National Rahmatul-Lil-Aalameen Wa Khatamun Nabivyin Authority Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Rahmatul-Lil-Aalameen Wa Khatamun Nabivyin Authority to promote research on the Seerat of Prophet Muhammad and address contemporary social challenges. The Authority is tasked with guiding the youth, reviewing literature, building institutional linkages, and promoting Seerat Chairs in higher education.

name: S.R.O. 1069(I)/2022 – Petroleum Products Price Notification

metadata.title: S.R.O. 1069 (1)/2022
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority's notification S.R.O. No. 1008 (1/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for various petroleum products including High Speed Diesel, Motor Gasoline, and Kerosene Oil. It specifies the rates for petroleum levy, inland freight, dealer commissions, distributor margins, and general sales tax applicable from July 15, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 1068(I)/2022 – IFEM Notification

metadata.title: S.R.O. 1068(1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification provisionally determines inland freight equalization margins (IFEM) for various petroleum products including kerosene, diesel, and gasoline. It also specifies dealer commissions, distributor margins, general sales tax rates, and declares the maximum ex-depot sale prices for these products.

name: S.R.O. 1067(I)/2022 – Petroleum Products Price Notification

metadata.title: S.R.O. 1067(1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for petroleum products refined in Pakistan and imported, including specific rates for petroleum levy, inland freight equalization margin, dealer commissions, distributor margins, and general sales tax. It establishes the maximum ex-depot sale price for kerosene oil applicable to designated locations and depots of Oil Marketing Companies.

name: The International Institute of Science, Arts and Technology Act, 2022

metadata.title: International Institute of Science, Arts and Technology Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the International Institute of Science, Arts and Technology as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, powers, and functions.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Microgrid) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Microgrid) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for granting licenses to construct, own, and operate microgrids in Pakistan. They define specific criteria for microgrids, such as voltage limits and connection restrictions to the national grid, and outline the application process for eligible individuals or entities.

name: The Asset Backed Securitization Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: Asset Backed Securitization Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: This document publishes draft regulations governing the Asset Backed Securitization process in Pakistan. It establishes conditions, obligations, and operational rules for Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) offering debt securities through public offers or private placements.

name: The National Institute of Health (NIH) Employees Revised (Service) Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: National Institute of Health (NIH) Revised (Service) Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: This notification promulgates the Revised (Service) Regulations for the National Institute of Health, effective immediately. The document outlines procedures for appointments, promotions, and seniority while defining key terms such as employee, misconduct, and penalty within the context of the institute's service rules.

name: S.R.O. 819(I)/2022 – Petroleum Products Price Notification

metadata.title: The Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Notification
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority's notification S.R.O. No.784 (I) / 2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for petroleum products refined in Pakistan and imported into the country. It specifies rates for petroleum levy, inland freight equalization margin, dealer commissions, distributor margins, general sales tax, and maximum ex-depot sale prices effective from June 16, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 818(I)/2022 – IFEM Notification for Petroleum Products

metadata.title: Notification on Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy)
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority's notifications S.R.O. No. 781(1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification provisionally determines inland freight equalization margins for various petroleum products including High Speed Diesel, Motor Gasoline, and Kerosene. It establishes maximum sale prices that include ex-refinery parity prices, levies, and distributor/dealer margins for specific locations.

name: S.R.O. 817(I)/2022 – Petroleum Products Price Notification

metadata.title: S.R.O. 817(1)/2022
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority's notification S.R.O. No. 783(1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for various petroleum products refined in Pakistan and imported. It includes rates for petroleum levy, inland freight equalization margin, dealer commission, distributor margin, and general sales tax to declare the maximum ex-depot sale price.

name: Notice of Initiation of Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duties levied on Dumped Imports of Polyvinyl Chloride Resin Suspension Grade into Pakistan Originating in and / or Exported from the People’s Republic of China, Chinese Taipci, Republic of Korea and Kingdom of Thailand

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duties levied on Dumped Imports of Polyvinyl Chloride Resin Suspension Grade into Pakistan Originating in and / or Exported from the People's Republic of China, Chinese Taipci, Republic of Korea and Kingdom of Thailand
metadata.summary: This notification initiates a sunset review of anti-dumping duties on dumped imports of Polyvinyl Chloride Resin (Suspension Grade) from China, Chinese Taipei, South Korea, and Thailand. The review was requested by M/s Engro Polymer and Chemicals Limited following the impending expiry of these duties scheduled for June 2022.

name: Notice of Initiation of Anti-Dumping Investigation on Alleged Dumped Imports of Vinyl/ PVC Flooring Originating in and/or Exported from the People’s Republic of China into Pakistan

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Anti-Dumping Investigation on Alleged Dumped Imports of Vinyl/ PVC Flooring Originating in and/or Exported from the People's Republic of China into Pakistan
metadata.summary: The National Tariff Commission initiated an anti-dumping investigation into Vinyl/PVC flooring imported from China following an application by a domestic producer. The investigation aims to determine if the imported goods are being dumped and if this practice is causing injury to the local industry.

name: ESTACODE (EDITION-2021)

metadata.title: The ESTACODE (Edition-2021)
metadata.summary: This document is the consolidated Edition-2021 of the ESTACODE, published by the Pakistan Public Administration Research Centre (PPARC). It compiles updated administrative and establishment manuals, incorporating recent amendments while striking out obsolete instructions to serve as a comprehensive tool for government decision-making.

name: S.R.O. 699(I)/2022 – Wellhead Gas Price Notification (Pandhi-1)

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 699(1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for agreed specification gas sold by Oil and Gas Development Company Limited to Sui-Southern Gas Company Limited. The specified price is US $2.5702 per MMBTU, effective from January 1, 2022, to June 30, 2022.

name: No. 500 - No. F.4-7-2015-Cab - Constitution of the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)

metadata.title: Notification constituting the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC) with a specific composition of Federal Ministers and other officials. The committee is tasked with examining fresh legislation and amendments to ensure they align with the Constitutional scheme and government policy before being placed before the Cabinet.

name: No. 473 - No. 3-1-2022-Min.II - Removal of Mr. Omer Sarfraz Cheema as Governor of the Punjab

metadata.title: Notification for removal of Governor of the Punjab
metadata.summary: This notification removes Mr. Omer Sarfraz Cheema from the office of Governor of the Punjab with immediate effect. The Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is designated to perform the functions of Acting Governor until a new appointment is made.

name: S.R.O. 615(I)/2022.— Designated Courts of Additional District & Session Judges as Special Court in Punjab

metadata.title: Notification designating Special Courts in the Punjab
metadata.summary: This notification designates specific Additional District & Sessions Judges as Special Courts in the Punjab province. It is issued under the powers of section 3(3) of the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021.

name: SRO. 613(I) 2022 Designate the Court of Mr. Muhammad Atta Rabbani, AD & S Judge Islamabad as Special Court in the Islamabad Capital Territory.

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O.613(I)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification designates the Court of Mr. Muhammad Atta Rabbani as a Special Court in the Islamabad Capital Territory. The designation is made under section 3(3) of the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Electric Power Trader) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Electric Power Trader) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority to license and regulate electric power traders in Pakistan. They define key terms, outline licensing procedures, specify trader functions such as trading and aggregation, and set requirements for fees and tariffs.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Performance Standards (Electric Power Suppliers) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Performance Standards (Electric Power Suppliers) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish performance standards for electric power suppliers in Pakistan, including capacity obligations and definitions related to licensing. They are made under the powers of the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997 by the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Market Operator) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Market Operator) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for granting a licence to the market operator under the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority. They define key terms related to electric power markets, commercial codes, and system operations while outlining the specific functions and responsibilities of the market operator.

name: No. 471 - No. F.1(1)-2021-24-C-II - Cessation of Senator Sherry Rehman as Chairperson of Senate Standing Committee on Foreign Affairs

metadata.title: Notification No. F. 1 (1)/2021-24/C-II
metadata.summary: This notification informs that Senator Sherry Rehman ceases to be the Chairperson of the Senate Standing Committee on Foreign Affairs upon her appointment as Federal Minister. The change in position takes effect from April 19, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 575(I)/2022 – Amendment in the OGRA Service Regulations, 2005

metadata.title: Notification amending the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Service Regulations 2005
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Service Regulations 2005
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Service Regulations 2005 to introduce special increments for employees upon superannuation and after completing 20 or 30 years of service. It also adds a facility for dialysis treatment for kidney disease and specifies conditions regarding performance, disciplinary history, and conduct required to receive these benefits.

name: Notice of Initiation of Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of One-Sided Coated Duplex Board-Grey Back into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People’s Republic of China, the Republic of Indonesia and the Republic of Korea

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of One-Sided Coated Duplex Board-Grey Back into Pakistan
metadata.summary: This notification initiates a sunset review of anti-dumping duties imposed on dumped imports of One-Sided Coated Duplex Board (Grey Back) originating from China, Indonesia, and Korea. The National Tariff Commission has accepted an application filed by domestic industry representatives to determine if the expiry of these duties would lead to a recurrence of dumping and injury to the local industry.

name: The Export Policy Order, 2022

metadata.title: Export Policy Order, 2022
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the export policy for Pakistan under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950. It outlines general rules for exporting goods, including exceptions for specific schedules, restrictions on exports to India, and conditions for exporting samples, gift parcels, and relief goods.

name: Revision of the Composition of the Planning Committee of the National Security Committee (NSC) — Notification No. NSD-II/2/2021-NSC(36)

metadata.title: Notification regarding revised composition of the Planning Committee of the NSC
metadata.summary: This notification approves the revised composition of the Planning Committee of the National Security Committee (NSC) as decided in its 36th meeting. It also outlines updated Terms of Reference for the committee, including responsibilities for identifying security issues, conducting research, and preparing materials for Parliament.

name: The Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Rules, 2021

metadata.title: Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Rules, 2021
metadata.repeals: Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Rules, 2021 notified vide Notification No. S. R. O. 85
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Act, 2021 to regulate the administration of medical teaching institutes. They cover topics including fund management, budget preparation, bank account operations, expenditure procedures, and the constitution of sub-committees.

name: S. R. O. 517(I)/2022.— Amendments in Customs Rules Previously Published Vide S.R.O. 426(I)/2022

metadata.title: The Customs Rules (Amendment) Notification, S.R.O. 517(I)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification directs further amendments to the Customs Rules, 2001 under section 219 of the Customs Act, 1969. It specifically adds a provision requiring the Collector or Director to revise reserve prices for lots after every three consecutive auctions if they remain undisposed.

name: S. R. O. 500(I)/2022.— Further Amendments in the Sales Tax Rules, 2006

metadata.title: Sales Tax Rules, 2006
metadata.summary: This notification directs the Federal Board of Revenue to amend the Sales Tax Rules, 2006. Specifically, it substitutes Form STR-7 with a new version for the submission of sales tax and federal excise returns.

name: S.R.O. 493(I)/2022 – Wellhead Gas Price (Latif South-1 Well)

metadata.title: Notification determining the wellhead price of natural gas produced from Latif South-1 well
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for natural gas produced from the Latif South-1 well in the Latif Concession. The specified price is Rs. 5.00 per unit, applicable to sales by M/s UEP Becta GmbH to M/s Sui Southern Gas Company Limited.

name: S.R.O. 483(I)/2022 – Wellhead Gas Price Notification (Baudero-01 Discovery)

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 483(D/2022)
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for natural gas of agreed specification produced from the Baudero-01 discovery in the Mirpur Khas Block. It applies specifically to gas sold by M/s United Energy Pakistan Limited to Sui Southern Gas Company Limited at the agreed delivery point.

name: S.R.O. 471(I)/2022 – Determination and Notification of Wellhead Price of Agreed Specification Natural Gas from Chanda Field

metadata.title: Wellhead Gas Price
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for agreed specification gas sold by Oil and Gas Development Company Limited to Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited from the Chanda field. It supersedes previous statutory notifications regarding these prices and lists specific pricing periods in US dollars per MMBTU starting from July 1, 2008.

name: S.R.O. 470(I)/2022 – Determination and Notification of Wellhead Price of Agreed Specification Natural Gas from Zarghun South Field

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 470(12)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead price for natural gas produced from the Zarghun South Field sold by M/s Mari Petroleum Company Limited to Sui Southern Gas Company Limited. It specifies a price of Rs. 5.00 for gas of agreed specification and lists specific US$/MMBTU rates for conventional and tight gas from designated formations during January to June 2022.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Consumer Eligibility Criteria (Distribution Licensees) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Consumer Eligibility Criteria (Distribution Licensees) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the eligibility criteria for persons to obtain electricity connections from distribution licensees in Pakistan. They define key terms related to distribution systems, metering, and inspection while outlining requirements such as application forms, charge deposits, and technical certification.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Consumer Eligibility Criteria (Electric Power Suppliers) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Consumer Eligibility Criteria (Electric Power Suppliers) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the eligibility criteria for consumers applying to competitive electric power suppliers in Pakistan. They define key terms such as 'competitive supplier' and 'supplier of last resort' within the context of the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997. The document outlines specific requirements applicants must meet, including filing applications via the Consumer Supply Manual, residing within a supplier's service territory, and maintaining a valid electricity connection.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Distribution) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Distribution) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for licensing and regulating the distribution business of electric power in Pakistan. They define key terms related to distribution licensees, technical codes, consumer eligibility, and financial charges such as connection fees and use of system costs.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Registration) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Registration) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for registering persons providing specific electric power services incidental to generation, transmission, distribution, supply, sale, or trading. They define key terms related to the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority and outline the requirements for obtaining registration under section 25A of the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997.

name: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping Duties Levied on Imports of Continuous Casting Steel Billets into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from China

metadata.title: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping Duties Levied on Imports of Continuous Casting Steel Billets into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from China
metadata.summary: This notice informs stakeholders that definitive anti-dumping duties on continuous casting steel billets from China will expire on June 22, 2022. It outlines the procedure for the domestic industry to file a sunset review application with the National Tariff Commission within forty-five days of publication if they wish to extend the duties.

name: S. R. O. 402(I)/2022.— Amendments in Notification No. 1(30)/2015-SEZ Dated 26th December 2019 Relating to Korangi Creek Industrial Park, Karachi

metadata.title: Notification No. 1(30)2015-SEZ
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Board of Investment's Notification No. 1(30)2015-SEZ regarding the Korangi Creek Industrial Park. The amendments update specific entries to substitute new officer designations and add a reference to the Special Economic Zones Rules 2013.

name: The Allied Health Professionals Council Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Allied Health Professionals Council Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Allied Health Professionals Council in Pakistan to set uniform standards for basic and higher qualifications in various allied health disciplines. It consolidates laws regarding the registration of professionals, regulates their education, training, practice, and functions, and defines key terms related to qualifications and institutions.

name: S.R.O. 379(I)/2022 – Determination and Notification of Prescribed Prices, Petroleum Levy, IFEM, and Maximum Ex-Depot Sale Prices for Petroleum Products

metadata.title: S.R.O. 379(1/2022

metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for various petroleum products including High Speed Diesel, Motor Gasoline, and E-10 Gasoline. It specifies rates for petroleum levy, inland freight equalization margin, dealer commissions, distributor margins, general sales tax, and maximum ex-depot sale prices effective from March 1, 2022.

name: S.R.O. 378(I)/2022 – Provisional Determination and Notification of Inland Freight Equalization Margin (IFEM) for Petroleum Products

name: S.R.O. 377(I)/2022 – Determination of Prescribed Prices, Petroleum Levy, IFEM, and Maximum Ex-Depot Sale Prices for Petroleum Products

metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for petroleum products, specifically kerosene oil, refined in Pakistan and imported. name: S.R.O. 376(I)/2022 – Notification of Maximum Producer Price, Marketing & Distribution Margins, and Consumer Price for Indigenous LPG

metadata.summary: This notification establishes the maximum producer and consumer prices for indigenous LPG, including specific breakdowns for marketing, distribution, and transportation margins. It sets these effective rates from March 1, 2022, superseding a previous S.R.O. issued on January 31, 2022.

name: Notice of Initiation of Sunset Review of Anti-dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Coated Bleached Paperboard/Folding Box Paperboard with White Back into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from China

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Sunset Review of Anti-dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Coated Bleached Paperboard/Folding Box Paperboard with White Back into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from China
metadata.summary: This notification initiates a sunset review of anti-dumping duties on dumped imports of coated bleached paperboard from China. The National Tariff Commission determined there is a likelihood of dumping continuing or recurring if the duties expire, which would likely cause material injury to the domestic industry.

name: S. R. O. 253 (I)/2022.— Notification for Designate of Officers as Registrar under the Companies Act, 2017

metadata.title: S.R.O. 253 (1)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification designates specific officers of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) as registrars under section 254 of the Companies Act, 2017. The change follows the merger of National Industrial Parks Development & Management Company Ltd. into PIDC, which took effect on October 31, 2021.

name: The Passports Rules, 2021

metadata.title: The Passports Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Passports Act, 1974 and the Foreigners Act, 1946 to regulate matters relating to immigration and passports. They define key terms such as 'minor' and 'custodial parent', specify conditions for entering or departing Pakistan, and establish criteria for creating new passport offices.

name: Notice of Initiation of Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duties levied on Dumped Imports of Galvanized Steel Coils/Sheets into Pakistan Originating in and / or Exported from the People's Republic af China

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duties levied on Dumped Imports of Galvanized Steel Coils/Sheets into Pakistan Originating in and / or Exported from the People's Republic of China
metadata.summary: This notification initiates a sunset review of anti-dumping duties on galvanized steel coils and sheets imported from China. The review was requested by domestic producers following the impending expiry of the definitive duties imposed in 2017, which were set to expire on February 8, 2022.

name: Notice of Final Determination on Dumped Imports of Cold Rolled Coils/Sheets into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from Chinese faipet, European Union, Republic of Korea and Socialist Republic of Vietnam and Imposition of Definitive Anti-dumping Duties thereof

metadata.summary: This notification announces the National Tariff Commission's final affirmative determination regarding dumped imports of cold-rolled steel coils and sheets from specific exporting countries. Consequently, definitive anti-dumping duties are imposed on these products effective from August 23, 2021, for a period of five years to remedy material injury to the domestic industry.

name: Notification Regarding Adoption of Accounting Standard for Common Control Transactions

metadata.title: Accounting Standard: Accounting of Common Control Transactions
metadata.summary: This notification directs companies to follow the new Accounting Standard for Common Control Transactions when preparing financial statements on or after June 30, 2022. The standard was developed by the Accounting Standards Board of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan and approved by its Council in August 2021. It establishes principles for recognizing, measuring, and disclosing business combinations under common control and group restructuring transactions that are currently excluded from IFRS 3.

name: Regulations for Lender of Last Resort (LOLR) Facility under Section 17G of the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956

metadata.title: Regulations for Lender of Last Resort (LOLR) Facility under Section 17G of the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the State Bank of Pakistan to provide a Lender of Last Resort (LOLR) facility to solvent scheduled banks facing temporary liquidity shortages. The facility is designed as an exceptional measure to prevent bank failure and system-wide distress when market funding sources are exhausted, secured by adequate collateral.

metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead gas price for natural gas produced from the Sumar Deep of Mirpurkhas Block. It specifies the agreed prices in US dollars per MMBTU for various periods between May 2018 and December 2021, applicable to sales by United Energy Pakistan Limited to Sui Southern Gas Company Limited.

It sets specific prices in US dollars per MMBTU for various periods from January 2014 through December 2020, superseding a previous notification dated December 08, 2020.

name: The Aircraft (Accident and Incident Investigation) Rules, 2021

metadata.title: The Aircraft (Accident and Incident Investigation) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for investigating aircraft accidents and incidents within Pakistan. They define key terms such as 'investigation', 'contributing factors', and 'operator' to ensure standardized procedures for accident prevention.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Prohibition of Corporal Punishment Act, 2021

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Prohibition of Corporal Punishment Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits all forms of corporal punishment against children in workplaces, educational institutions, child care settings, and the juvenile justice system within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines 'corporal punishment' broadly to include physical force causing pain or discomfort, as well as non-physical cruel and degrading treatments like humiliation or threats.

name: The Al-Karam International Institute Act, 2021

metadata.title: Al-Karam International Institute Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Al-Karam International Institute as a private sector body corporate with its main campus at Bhera. The institute is granted academic, financial, and administrative autonomy to conduct research, offer education, and award degrees.

name: The COVID-19 (Prevention of Hoarding) Act, 2021

metadata.title: COVID-19 (Prevention of Hoarding) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of hoarding of scheduled articles during the emergent situation caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. It defines offenses related to hoarding, grants powers for search and seizure without a warrant, and outlines penalties including imprisonment and fines.

name: The Pakistan Nursing Council (Emergency Management) Ordinance, 2021

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nursing Council (Emergency Management) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the emergency management of the Pakistan Nursing Council when the Senate and National Assembly are not in session. It appoints the Director General Health as Administrator, dissolves the existing Executive Committee, and outlines powers for conducting inspections and holding elections to restore the Council's normal functioning.

name: The Federal Government Employees Housing Authority's Employees (Service) Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: Federal Government Employees Housing Authority's Employees (Service) Regulations, 2020
metadata.amends: Federal Government Employees Housing Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the service regulations for employees of the Federal Government Employees Housing Authority. It defines key terms such as appointment, misconduct, and pay, while specifying the scope of application to whole-time employees excluding contract or daily wage workers.

name: The University of Islamabad Act, 2021

metadata.title: The University of Islamabad Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, including the Patron, Chancellor, Board of Governors, and Vice-Chancellor.

name: The Hyderabad Institute for Technical and Management Sciences Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Hyderabad Institute for Technology and Management Sciences Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Hyderabad Institute for Technology and Management Sciences as a degree-awarding institution located in Hyderabad. It grants the institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, powers, and purposes.

name: The National College of Arts Institute Act, 2021

metadata.title: The National College of Arts Institute Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes the National College of Arts, Lahore, which was previously constituted under an Ordinance from 1985. It establishes the college as a corporate body with academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Charities Registration, Regulation and Facilitation Act, 2021

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Charities Registration, Regulation and Facilitation Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the registration, regulation, and facilitation of charities within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a Charities Registration Authority to oversee these entities and define their functions.

name: The International Court of Justice (Review and Re-consideration) Act, 2021

metadata.title: International Court of Justice (Review and Reconsideration) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides the right of review and reconsideration for foreign nationals regarding orders and judgments of military courts in Pakistan. It allows these individuals to file petitions before a High Court concerning their rights under Article 16 of the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations, specifically addressing issues like denial of consular access.

name: The National Accountability Bureau Ordinance, 1999

metadata.title: National Accountability Bureau Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Accountability Bureau (NAB) to eradicate corruption and hold accountable individuals accused of corrupt practices. It provides for the detection, investigation, prosecution, and speedy disposal of cases involving corruption, misuse of power, and misappropriation of state assets.

name: The Inland Revenue Uniform Rules, 2021

metadata.title: Inland Revenue Uniform Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the wearing of uniforms for all ranks of the Inland Revenue Services to maintain discipline and establish a sense of order. The document details specific uniform requirements, including authorized summer and winter attire for male officers, as well as provisions for grants to purchase these uniforms.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Ordinance, 2021

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and rationalizes the local government system in the Islamabad Capital Territory to ensure the effective discharge of public services. It defines key terms related to administration, elections, and authorities within the territory.

name: No. 466 - No. 2-8-2018-Min-I - Appointment of Mr. Shahzad Nawaz as Special Assistant on Culture, Arts and related Communications

metadata.title: Appointment of Mr. Shahzad Nawaz as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Culture, Arts and related Communications
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Shahzad Nawaz as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Culture, Arts and related Communications with immediate effect. The appointment is made in an honorary capacity under the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 465 - No. 2-1-2020-Min-I - Cancellation of ex-Pakistan leave granted to Mr. Noor-ul-Haq Qadri, Federal Minister for Religious Affairs

metadata.summary: This notification cancels four days of ex-Pakistan leave granted to Mr. Noor-ul-Haq Qadri, the Federal Minister for Religious Affairs and Inter-faith Harmony. The leave period covered was from November 8th to November 11th, 2021.

name: No. 464 - No. F.5-2-2018-Com - Appointment of Mr. Shaukat Fayaz Ahmed Tarin as Chairman, Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC)

name: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping Duties Levied on Imports of Bleached Board/ Folding Box Board with White Back into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from China

name: The Federal Government Employees Housing Authority Joint Venture Projects Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: Federal Government Employees Housing Joint Venture Projects Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the joint venture projects undertaken by the Federal Government Employees Housing Authority (FGEHA). They define key terms related to construction agreements, land banking, and the roles of various partners in the housing schemes.

metadata.summary: These regulations govern the joint venture projects undertaken by the Federal Government Employees Housing Authority (FGEHA). They define key terms related to construction agreements, bidders, and various joint venture models such as turn-key and land sharing. The document outlines the authority's powers under Section 26 of the FGEHA Act, 2020 to establish these rules for collaboration with private sector partners.

name: The Public Properties (Removal of Encroachment) Administrative Procedures Rules, 2021

metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Public Properties (Removal of Encroachment) Ordinance, 2021 to establish administrative procedures for removing encroachments. metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Rahmatul-Lil-Aalameen Authority to promote research on the Seerat of Prophet Muhammad and address contemporary social challenges. metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure, oversight mechanisms, and safeguards for the removal and blocking of unlawful online content in Pakistan. name: The Special Technology Zones Authority Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Special Technology Zones Authority Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Special Technology Zones Authority to provide institutional and legislative support for the technology sector in Pakistan. name: The Securities and Exchange Commission (Re-insurance Brokers) Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: Securities and Exchange Commission (Re-insurance Brokers) Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the registration of re-insurance brokers with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. They define eligibility criteria, including requirements for paid-up capital, statutory deposits, and fit-and-proper standards for both domestic and foreign entities.

name: The Financial Management and Powers of Principal Accounting Officers Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: Financial Management and Powers of Principal Accounting Officers Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: This regulation approves the framework for financial management and defines the powers of principal accounting officers within Federal Government Ministries and Divisions. It establishes eligibility criteria, designation processes by the Prime Minister, and outlines specific responsibilities regarding resource use, budget preparation, and expenditure accountability.

name: The Financial Management and Powers of Principal Accounting Officers Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: Financial Management and Powers of Principal Accounting Officers Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for financial management and designate principal accounting officers within Federal Government Ministries, Divisions, and attached departments. They define the responsibilities of these officers regarding resource usage, budget formulation, and adherence to financial propriety under the Public Finance Management Act, 2019.

name: S.R.O. 289(I)/2021 – Provisional Determination and Notification of Inland Freight Equalization Margin (IFEM)

metadata.title: S.R.O. 289(I)/2021
metadata.summary: This notification determines inland freight equalization margins (IFEM) for various petroleum products including High Speed Diesel, Motor Gasoline, and Kerosene Oil. It applies to depots located in specific areas and allows for secondary freight charges in designated regions like Balochistan and Northern Areas.

name: S.R.O. 288(I)/2021 – Determination and Notification of Prescribed Prices, Petroleum Levy, IFEM, Margins and Maximum Ex-Depot Sale Prices of Petroleum Products

metadata.title: S.R.O. 288(1)/2021
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for petroleum products refined in Pakistan and imported into the country. It specifies rates for petroleum levy, inland freight equalization margin, dealer commission, distributor margin, general sales tax, and the maximum ex-depot sale price.

name: S.R.O. 290(I)/2021 – Petroleum Product Prices & Levies

metadata.title: Notification regarding prescribed prices for petroleum products
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority's notification S.R.O. No. 226(1)/2021
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for various petroleum products including High Speed Diesel, Motor Gasoline, and E-10 Gasoline. It establishes maximum ex-depot sale prices by incorporating factors such as petroleum levy, inland freight margins, dealer commissions, and general sales tax.

name: Notice of Initiation of Anti-Dumping Investigation on Alleged Dumped Imports of Cold Rolled Coils/Sheets Originating in and/or Exported from the European Union, Republic of Korea, Chinese Taipei and Vietnam into Pakistan

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Anti-Dumping Investigation on Alleged Dumped Imports of Cold Rolled Coils/Sheets Originating in and/or Exported from the European Union, Republic of Korea, Chinese Taipei and Victnam into Pakistan
metadata.summary: This notice initiates an anti-dumping investigation into cold rolled coils and sheets originating from the European Union, Republic of Korea, Chinese Taipei, and Vietnam. The investigation aims to determine if these products are being dumped into Pakistan and if such dumping causes injury to the domestic industry producing like products.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority (Alien Registration Card) Rules, 2021

metadata.title: The National Database and Registration Authority (Alien Registration Card) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the registration of foreigners in Pakistan, excluding nationals of Afghanistan and holders of specific Pakistani visas. They define eligibility criteria, outline procedures for issuing Alien Registration Cards and work permits, and mandate the reporting of vital events such as births, deaths, and marriages.

name: S.R.O. 226(I)/2021 – Determination and Notification of Prescribed Prices, IFEM, Margins and Maximum Ex-Depot Sale Prices of Petroleum Products

metadata.title: Notification regarding petroleum product prices
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority's notification S.R.O. No. 159(1)/2021
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for various petroleum products including High Speed Diesel, Motor Gasoline, Kerosene, Light Diesel Oil, and E-10 Gasoline. It establishes maximum ex-depot sale prices by incorporating rates for petroleum levy, inland freight, dealer commissions, distributor margins, and general sales tax.

name: S.R.O. 225(I)/2021 – Provisional Determination and Notification of Inland Freight Equalization Margin (IFEM) for Petroleum Products

metadata.title: S.R.O. 225(1)/2021
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority's notification S.R.O. No. 158(1)/2021
metadata.summary: This notification provisionally determines the inland freight equalization margin (IFEM) for various petroleum products including Kerosene Oil, High Speed Diesel, and Motor Gasoline. It applies to locations specified by the OMCs and allows for secondary freight charges in specific areas of Balochistan, Azad Kashmir, and Northern Areas per GoP policy.

name: S.R.O. 224(I)/2021 – Determination of Prescribed Prices, Petroleum Levy, IFEM, and Maximum Ex-Depot Sale Prices of Petroleum Products in Pakistan

metadata.title: S.R.O. 224(1)/2021
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for petroleum products, specifically kerosene oil, refined in Pakistan and imported. It establishes rates for petroleum levy, inland freight equalization margin, dealer commission, distributor margin, and general sales tax to declare the maximum ex-depot sale price.

name: S.R.O. 222(I)/2021 – Determination and Notification of Wellhead Price of Natural Gas from Rizq-2 Well (Kirthar Block) Sold to Sui Southern Gas Company Limited

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 222(1)/2021
metadata.summary: This notification determines the wellhead gas price for natural gas produced from the Rizq-2 well of the Kirthar Block. The price is set at US $4.8363/MMBTU for sales by Polish Oil & Gas Company to Sui Southern Gas Company Limited, effective from January 1, 2021, to June 30, 2021.

name: The Transportation of Coastal Goods Rules, 2020

metadata.title: The Transportation of Coastal Goods Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules amend the Customs Rules, 2001 by adding a new chapter specifically for the transportation of coastal goods. They establish procedures for consignor notification, vessel manifest filing, and customs inspections at loading ports to regulate cargo movement between Pakistani ports.

name: The Government Polytechnic Institute for Women (GPIW) Fund Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: Government Polytechnic Institute for Women (GPIW) Fund Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the management and operational framework for the Government Polytechnic Institute for Women (GPIW) Fund. They define the fund's sources, management committee composition, permissible expenditures, and administrative procedures in accordance with the Public Finance Management Act 2019.

name: The Islamabad Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Islamabad Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Real Estate Regulatory Authority to regulate and promote the real estate sector in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It aims to protect buyer interests by ensuring transparent transactions for plots, apartments, and buildings, while also creating an Appellate Tribunal for speedy dispute resolution.

name: S. R. O. 159(I)/2021 – Determination of Petroleum Product Prices

metadata.title: S.R.O. 159(1) / 2021
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority's notification S.R.O. No. 54(1)/2021
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for various petroleum products including High Speed Diesel, Motor Gasoline, and E-10 Gasoline. It specifies the rates for petroleum levy, inland freight margins, dealer commissions, distributor margins, and general sales tax applicable to retail outlets and direct consumer sales.

name: S. R. O. 158(I)/2021 – Notification of Inland Freight Equalization Margin (IFEM)

metadata.title: S.R.O. 158(D/2021)
metadata.summary: This notification provisionally determines the inland freight equalization margin (IFEM) for various petroleum products including kerosene oil, high speed diesel, and motor gasoline. It sets specific rates for these margins effective from February 1, 2021, under the authority of the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority.

name: S. R. O. 157(I)/2021 – Determination of Prescribed Prices of Petroleum Products

metadata.title: S.R.O. 157(D/2021)
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for petroleum products, specifically Kerosene Oil, refined in Pakistan and imported. It establishes rates for petroleum levy, inland freight equalization margin, dealer commission, distributor margin, and general sales tax to declare a maximum ex-depot sale price.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority (Appointment and Emoluments of Chairman and Members) Rules, 2020

metadata.title: National Database and Registration Authority (Appointment and Emoluments of Chairman and Members) Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the mode of appointment and emoluments for the Chairman and members of the National Database and Registration Authority. They define the required competence, experience, and integrity criteria for candidates in various fields such as computer science, law, and administration.

name: S. R. O. 103(I)/2021 — Publication of Draft Further Amendments in the Customs Rules, 2001

metadata.title: Draft Amendments in the Customs Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: This notification publishes draft amendments to the Customs Rules, 2001 regarding procedures for imports and exports at border customs stations. It introduces new definitions for electronic manifests (IGM/EGM) and outlines specific data entry and processing steps for gate-in and gate-out operations.

name: No. 428 - No. F.5-2-2018-Com - Re-constitution of the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC)

metadata.title: Notification re-constituting the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council
metadata.amends: Cabinet Division's Notification No.F. 5/2/2018- Com, dated 28th April, 2020
metadata.repeals: Cabinet Division's Notification No.F. 5/2/2018- Com, dated 28th April, 2020
metadata.summary: This notification re-constitutes the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC) in supersession of a previous order from April 2020. It lists the specific ministers and secretaries appointed to serve on the committee, along with other officers invited to attend meetings as needed.

name: The Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Rules, 2021

metadata.title: Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for applying for Letters of Administration or Succession Certificates under the Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2020. They define key terms, outline requirements for applications including document submission and biometric verification, and establish processes for issuing duplicate or amended certificates along with fee structures.

name: The Public Private Partnership Authority (P3WP) Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: The Public Private Partnership Authority (P3WP) Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the Public Private Partnership Working Party (P3WP) under the Ministry of Law & Justice. They define the P3WP's functions, meeting procedures, quorum requirements, and rules regarding conflict of interest for its members.

name: The Public Private Partnership Authority (Approvals and Process Flow) Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: The Public Private Partnership Authority (Approvals and Process Flow) Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for project identification and the submission of project concept proposals to the Public Private Partnership Authority. They define specific requirements for implementing agencies regarding technical overviews, economic viability analyses, and legal impact assessments before a project proceeds to the qualification stage.

name: No. 427 - No. F.5-3-2018-Com - Re-constitution of the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC) of the Cabinet

metadata.title: Notification re-constituting various Cabinet Committees
metadata.repeals: Cabinet Division's earlier Notifications of even number issued from time to time
metadata.summary: This notification re-constitutes the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC) and other Cabinet Committees with immediate effect. It details the new composition of these committees, including Ministers, Secretaries, and special invitees, while stating that their Terms of Reference remain unchanged.

name: The Zainab Alert, Response and Recovery (Recruitment) Rules, 2020

metadata.title: Zainab Alert, Response and Recovery (Recruitment) Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules establish the recruitment framework for the Director General of the Zainab Alert, Response and Recovery Agency. They define eligibility criteria, probation periods, leave entitlements, and deputation terms in accordance with the Civil Servant Act, 1973.

name: Notice of Final Determination and Imposition of Definitive Anti- dumping Duties on Dumped Imports of Inorganic Yellow Chrome Pigment from Republic of India and Republic of Korea

metadata.title: Notice of Final Determination and Imposition of Definitive Anti-dumping Duties on Dumped Imports of Inorganic Yellow Chrome Pigment from Republic of India and Republic of Korea
metadata.summary: The National Tariff Commission issued a final determination regarding dumped imports of Inorganic Yellow Chrome Pigment from India and Korea. Following an investigation that found material injury to the domestic industry, definitive anti-dumping duties were imposed on these imports effective August 25, 2020.

name: The Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zone, Regulations 2020

metadata.title: Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zone, Regulations 2020
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes the framework for Sole Enterprise Special Economic Zones (SESEZ) under the Board of Investment. It defines specific policy parameters, including land ownership requirements, equity financing thresholds, and auditing standards for zone enterprises.

name: The Mobile Phone Repeaters Technical Standards and Operations Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: Mobile Phone Repeaters Technical Standards and Operations Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations establish technical standards and operational requirements for mobile phone repeaters in Pakistan. They mandate compliance with specific ETSI and FCC standards, require certification by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority, and set rules regarding frequency usage and interference prevention.

name: The Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Rules, 2020

metadata.title: The Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedures for the registration and protection of geographical indications for goods in Pakistan. They define key terms, establish fee structures, specify document filing requirements, and outline signature protocols under the Geographical Indications (Registration and Protection) Act, 2020.

name: The Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Rules, 2020

metadata.title: The Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Geographical Indications (Registration and Protection) Act, 2020 to establish procedures for the registration and protection of geographical indications for goods. The document defines key terms, prescribes fees payable to the Director General of IPO-Pakistan, and sets standards for filing documents and forms.

name: The National Institute of Health (Re-organization) Ordinance, 2020

metadata.title: The National Institute of Health (Re-organization) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Institute of Health (NIH) as an autonomous corporate body to manage health institutes and centers across Pakistan. It aims to reorganize the national health infrastructure for research, disease prevention, and managing health emergencies.
