name: The Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Ordinance, 2020

metadata.title: Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes special investigation teams and special courts to ensure the expeditious redressal of rape and sexual abuse crimes against women and children. It provides for efficacious procedures, speedy trials, and specific evidence rules related to these offenses.

name: The Corporate Insurance Agents Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: The Corporate Insurance Agents Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for corporate insurance agents in Pakistan, covering both life and non-life insurers as well as takaful operators. They define key terms such as bancassurance, agency agreements, and specific roles like bank insurance executives to regulate distribution through various channels including technology-based platforms.

name: The Special Technology Zones Authority Ordinance, 2020

metadata.title: Special Technology Zones Authority Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Special Technology Zones Authority to provide institutional and legislative support for the technology sector in Pakistan. It aims to develop a competitive ecosystem that attracts foreign direct investment, fosters collaboration between academia and industry, and accelerates technological development through high-tech interventions.

name: No. 426 - S.R.O. 1276(I)-2020 - Further extension of time period of Commission of Inquiry into shortage of Petroleum Products

metadata.title: Commission of Inquiry to probe into the shortage of Petroleum Products
metadata.summary: This notification extends the time period for the Commission of Inquiry investigating the shortage of petroleum products until December 21, 2020. The commission is directed to complete its probe by this extended deadline, adhering to previously notified terms of reference.

name: No. 425 - No. 2-8-2018-Min-I - Appointment of Malik Muhammad Amir Dogar MNA as Special Assistant on Political Affairs

metadata.title: Notification appointing Malik Muhammad Amir Dogar MNA as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Malik Muhammad Amir Dogar MNA as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs. The appointment is made in an honorary capacity and takes effect immediately.

name: The Critical Telecom Data and Infrastructure Security Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: Critical Telecom Data and Infrastructure Security Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations establish security requirements for critical telecom data and infrastructure held by Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) licensees. They mandate the formation of cybersecurity steering committees, the development of internal policies, and the implementation of physical and environmental security measures.

name: The Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Ordinance, 2020

metadata.title: The Federal Medical Teaching Institutes Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance re-organizes Federal medical teaching institutes and their affiliated hospitals into a corporate body to provide autonomy. The primary objectives are to enhance service performance, effectiveness, and efficiency for quality healthcare and education in Pakistan.

name: No. 424 - No. 2-8-2018-Min-I - Acceptance of resignation of Mr. Shahzad Syed Qasim as Special Assistant on Coordination of Marketing

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-8/2018-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification records the acceptance by the Prime Minister of the resignation tendered by Mr. Shahzad Syed Qasim. The resignation is from his post as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Coordination of Marketing and Development of Mineral Resources, effective from November 4, 2020.

name: No. 423 - No. 2-8-2018-Min-I - Appointment of Mr. Raoof Hasan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Information

metadata.title: Notification appointing Mr. Raoof Hasan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Information
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Raoof Hasan as the Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Information in an honorary capacity. The appointment takes immediate effect and is issued by the Cabinet Division of the Government of Pakistan.

name: No. 422 - S.R.O. 1112(I)-2020 - Extension of time period of Commission of Inquiry into shortage of Petroleum Products

metadata.title: Commission of Inquiry to probe into the recent shortage of Petroleum Products
metadata.summary: This notification extends the time period for a Commission of Inquiry investigating a recent shortage of petroleum products. The extension adds six weeks to the commission's duration, which was initially set for thirty days starting from July 28, 2020.

name: The Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Rules, 2020

metadata.title: The Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act, 2018 to define specific terms and outline actions for investigating officers upon receiving information about trafficking. They establish definitions for key concepts such as 'victim', 'commercial sex act', and 'informed consent' to guide enforcement under the Act.

name: The Prevention of Smuggling of Migrants Rules, 2020

metadata.title: The Prevention of Smuggling of Migrants Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules are made under Section 14 of the Prevention of Smuggling of Migrants Act, 2018 by the Federal Government. They come into force immediately and provide definitions for terms used in the Act, such as 'Agency', 'authorized officer', 'controlled delivery', and various types of documents and persons.

name: Notice of Termination of Anti-dumping Investigation on Dumped Imports of Certain Electrical Capacitors into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People’s Republic of China

metadata.title: Notice of Termination of Anti-dumping Investigation on Dumped Imports of Certain Electrical Capacitors into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People's Republic of China
metadata.summary: This notice announces the termination of an anti-dumping investigation regarding electrical capacitors imported from China. The investigation was initiated by the National Tariff Commission but ended because the applicant, Khawaja Electronics (Pvt.) Limited, withdrew their application on September 28, 2020.

name: Notice of Initiation of Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Hydrogen Peroxide Imported from Bangladesh

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Sunset Review of Anti-Dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Hydrogen Peroxide Imported from Bangladesh
metadata.summary: This notification initiates a sunset review of anti-dumping duties imposed on dumped imports of Hydrogen Peroxide from Bangladesh. The National Tariff Commission received an application from domestic producers requesting this review due to the impending expiry of the current duties, with the goal of determining if dumping and injury would likely continue or recur.

name: No. 421 - No. 2-1-2020-Min.I - Ex-Pakistan leave for Mr. Nadeem Babar, Special Assistant on Petroleum Division

metadata.title: Notification granting Ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Nadeem Babar
metadata.summary: This notification grants five days of Ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Nadeem Babar, who serves as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on the Petroleum Division with the status of Minister of State. The leave is valid from November 2nd to November 6th, 2020.

name: No. 420 - No. 2-8-2018-Min-I - Corrigendum correcting date of Notification from 1st October, 2019 to 1st October, 2020

metadata.title: Corrigendum to Notification No. 2-8/2018-Min-I(i)
metadata.summary: This document serves as a corrigendum issued by the Cabinet Division to correct the date of issue for a specific notification. It states that the original date of October 1, 2019, should be read as October 1, 2020.

name: No. 419 - No. 2-8-2018-Min-I - Appointment of Dr. Waqar Masood Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Revenue

metadata.title: Appointment of Dr. Waqar Masood Khan
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Dr. Waqar Masood Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Revenue with the status of Minister of State. The appointment takes immediate effect and is issued by the Joint Secretary under the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 418 - No. 2-8-2018-Min-I(i) - Re-designation of Mr. Shahzad Syed Qasim as Special Assistant on Coordination of Marketing & Mineral Resources

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-8/2018-Min-I(i)
metadata.summary: This notification re-designates Mr. Shahzad Syed Qasim from Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Power Division and Coordination of Marketing and Development of Mineral Resources to a new role focusing solely on the coordination of marketing and development of mineral resources. The order takes immediate effect, and he will hold the status of Minister of State.

name: No. 417 - No. 2-8-2018-Min-I - Appointment of Mr. Tabish Gauhar as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Power

metadata.title: Notification appointing Mr. Tabish Gauhar as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Power
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Tabish Gauhar as the Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Power with immediate effect. The appointment is made in an honorary capacity under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 414 - Postal Services Wing Corrigendum - Correction in S.R.O 644(I)-2020 regarding Assistant Accounts posts

metadata.title: Corrigendum
metadata.amends: Recruitment Rules for the Pakistan Post Office Department under the Ministry of Communications
metadata.summary: This document serves as a corrigendum issued by the Ministry of Communications to amend the Recruitment Rules for the Pakistan Post Office Department. It specifically updates the distribution percentages for posts, including the Assistant Accounts Officer (BS-17), subject to promotion.

name: No. 413 - S.R.O. 1022(I)-2020 - Withdrawal of notification No. 1-5-2020-Lit-III dated 19-08-2026 ab initio

metadata.title: S.R.O. 1022
metadata.repeals: Notification No. 1/5/2020/Lit-II dated 19-08-2020
metadata.summary: This notification withdraws a previous notification dated 19-08-2020 ab initio. It confirms that the Members and Terms of Reference for the Commission remain as previously notified on 28-07-2020.

name: No. 412 - No. 1(12)-2020-SO(P)-131 - Constitution of Project Steering Committee under National Poverty Graduation Programme (NPGP)

metadata.title: Notification constituting the Project Steering Committee under National Poverty Graduation Programme (NPGP)
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes the Project Steering Committee for the National Poverty Graduation Programme (NPGP). The committee includes representatives from various divisions such as Finance, Economic Affairs, and BISP, along with the CEO of the Pakistan Poverty Alleviation Fund. It outlines the committee's terms of reference, including strategic advisory roles, performance reviews, and approval of work plans and budgets.

name: Notice of Initiation of Sunset and Change Circumstances Reviews of the Anti-dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Polyester Staple Fiber from the People’s Republic of China

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Sunset and Change Circumstances Reviews of the Anti-dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Polyester Staple Fiber from the People's Republic of China
metadata.summary: This notification initiates sunset and change of circumstances reviews regarding anti-dumping duties on Polyester Staple Fiber imported from China. The National Tariff Commission determined there is a prima facie case for these reviews based on applications received from domestic applicants and representations from industry associations.

name: No. 411 - No. 2-6-2018-Min.I - De-notification of appointment of Mr. Shehryar Afridi as Minister of State for States & Frontier Regions

metadata.title: De-notification of appointment of Mr. Shehryar Afridi
metadata.summary: This notification approves the de-notification of Mr. Shehryar Afridi's appointment as Minister of State for States & Frontier Regions and Narcotics Control. The change takes effect immediately upon issuance.

name: No. 410 - No. 3-3-2017-Min.I - Conferment of status of Minister of State on Mr. Shehryar Afridi, MNA-Chairman, Parliamentary Committee on Kashmir

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-3/2017-Min.I.
metadata.summary: This notification confers the status of Minister of State on Mr. Shehryar Afridi, who is an MNA and Chairman of the Parliamentary Committee on Kashmir. The appointment takes immediate effect under powers conferred by Rule 15(1)(g) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 409 - No. F.4-7-2015-Cab - Re-constitution of the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)

metadata.title: Notification constituting the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC) with a specific composition including Federal Ministers and the Attorney General. It outlines the committee's Terms of Reference to examine fresh legislation, amendments, and their alignment with the Constitutional scheme and government policy before they are placed before the Cabinet.

name: The Counter-measures for High Risk Jurisdictions Rules, 2020

metadata.title: The Counter-measures for High Risk Jurisdictions Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These Rules empower the Federal Government to establish and maintain a list of high-risk countries based on FATF recommendations or strategic deficiencies in AML/CFT regimes. They mandate reporting entities to apply enhanced due diligence measures, such as obtaining additional customer information and senior management approval, when conducting business with persons from listed jurisdictions.

name: The AML/CFT Sanctions Rules, 2020

metadata.title: The AML/CFT Sanctions Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These Rules are made under the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010 to establish sanctions for contraventions of AML/CFT provisions. They define key terms and empower regulatory authorities and Oversight Bodies for SRBs to impose monetary penalties, license revocations, prohibitions, and other disciplinary actions on reporting entities or individuals.

name: The Anti-Money Laundering and Combating Financing of Terrorism Regulations for Cost and Management Accountants Reporting Firms

metadata.title: Anti-Money Laundering and Combating Financing of Terrorism Regulations for Cost and Management Accountants Reporting Firms
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish requirements for Cost and Management Accountants reporting firms regarding Anti-Money Laundering and Combating Financing of Terrorism. They define key terms such as Politically Exposed Persons and Reporting Firms, and mandate that firms conduct risk assessments, implement appropriate controls, and maintain updated policies approved by senior management.

name: No. 408 - No. 15-4-2020-Admn-I - Constitution of Directory Retirement Committee in the Cabinet Division for BPS-16 & below

metadata.title: Notification constituting the 'Directory Retirement Committee' in the Cabinet Division (Main)
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a 'Directory Retirement Committee' within the Cabinet Division (Main). The committee is authorized to handle cases regarding Civil Servants in BPS-16 and below, established under section 3 of Rule-4 of the Civil Servants (Directory Retirement from Service), Rules, 2020.

name: The Federal Board of Revenue Anti Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Regulations for DNFBPs, 2020

metadata.title: Federal Board of Revenue Anti Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Regulations for DNFBPs, 2020
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes the framework for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Countering Financing of Terrorism (CFT) measures applicable to Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions (DNFBPs). It specifically targets real estate agents, jewelers, and accountants who are not regulated by other professional bodies. The document defines key terms such as Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), close associates, and enhanced due diligence requirements for these sectors.

name: The Professional Clearing Members Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: The Professional Clearing Members Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for licensing and regulating professional clearing members under the Securities Act, 2015. They define key terms related to customer accounts, custody services, and scheduled banks while outlining the application process and conditions for granting licenses.

name: The (Anti Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism) Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (Anti Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism) Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations are made by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan under section 6A of the Anti Money Laundering Act, 2010. They establish definitions for key terms such as regulated persons, politically exposed persons, and due diligence measures to combat money laundering and terrorist financing.

name: The Import Policy Order, 2020

metadata.title: Import Policy Order, 2020
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the import policy for Pakistan effective immediately. It defines key terms related to imports, outlines payment procedures, and specifies goods that are banned or restricted from entry into the country.

name: The ICT Rights of Persons with Disability Act, 2020

metadata.title: The ICT Rights of Persons with Disability Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to protect and effectively ensure the rights and inclusion of persons with disabilities in line with Islamic Injunctions and the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. It aims to recognize their official status and dignity in society by addressing barriers and ensuring equal opportunities in education, social, economic, and cultural activities.

name: The Medical Tribunal Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Medical Tribunal Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a special judicial tribunal to efficiently and expeditiously hear and decide disputes arising from the actions of authorities regulating various sectors of the medical field in Pakistan. It provides for the constitution, jurisdiction, powers, and tenure of the Medical Tribunal, which replaces the jurisdiction of regular courts for specific medical offenses and appeals against apex authorities.

name: The Pakistan Medical Commission Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Pakistan Medical Commission Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of the medical and dental professions in Pakistan. It establishes a uniform minimum standard for basic and higher medical education, training, and the recognition of qualifications.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Waqf Properties Act, 2020

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Waqf Properties Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the proper management, supervision, and administration of Waqf properties within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes the roles of a chief administrator and other officials responsible for overseeing these religious endowments.

name: No. 405 - No. 2-1-2020-Min-I - Ex-Pakistan leave for Dr. Ishrat Hussain, Adviser to the Prime Minister on Institutional Reforms

metadata.title: Notification granting Ex-Pakistan leave to Dr. Ishrat Hussain
metadata.summary: This notification grants two weeks of Ex-Pakistan leave to Dr. Ishrat Hussain, who serves as Adviser to the Prime Minister on Institutional Reforms and Austerity. The leave is authorized for the period from September 14 to September 28, 2020.

name: No. 406 - No. 2-1-2020-Min-I - Ex-Pakistan leave for Mr. Shahzad Syed Qasim, Special Assistant on Power Division

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-1/2020-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification grants three days of Ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Shahzad Syed Qasim, who serves as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Power Division & Coordination of Marketing and Development on Mineral Resources. The leave is authorized for the period from September 8 to September 10, 2020.

name: S.R.O. 813(I)/2020 – Petroleum Products Price Notification

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 813(1)/2020
metadata.amends: Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority's notification S.R.O. No. 722(1)/2020
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for various petroleum products including High Speed Diesel, Motor Gasoline, and E-10 Gasoline. It specifies the rates for petroleum levy, inland freight, dealer commissions, distributor margins, general sales tax, and the maximum ex-depot sale price.

name: S.R.O. 812(I)/2020 – Provisional IFEM for Petroleum Products Refined and Imported in Pakistan

metadata.title: S.R.O. 812(1)/2020
metadata.summary: This notification provisionally determines inland freight equalization margins and declares maximum ex-depot sale prices for various petroleum products. It applies to dealers, distributors, and general sales tax rates as specified in the accompanying table.

name: S.R.O. 811(I)/2020 – Petroleum Products Price Notification

metadata.title: S.R.O. 811(1)/2020
metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices for petroleum products, specifically Kerosene Oil, refined in Pakistan and imported. It establishes rates for petroleum levy, inland freight equalization margin, dealer and distributor commissions, general sales tax, and declares the maximum ex-depot sale price.

name: The Pakistan Islands Development Authority Ordinance, 2020

metadata.title: Pakistan Islands Development Authority Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Islands Development Authority to manage and develop islands within Pakistan's internal and territorial waters. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its powers to acquire property and establish schemes for development.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Trust Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Trust Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to the registration, administration, and monitoring of trusts within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It addresses gaps in the previous Trust Act of 1982 regarding effective financial monitoring and evaluation.

name: Notice of Initiation of Sunset and Changed Circumstances Review of Anti-dumping Duty Levied on Dumped Imports of Sorbitol Solution Originating in and/or Exported from the Republic of India into the Islamic Republic of Pakistan

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Sunset and Changed Circumstances Review of Anti-dumping Duty Levied on Dumped Imports of Sorbitol Solution Originating in and/or Exported from the Republic of India into the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This notification initiates a sunset and changed circumstances review regarding anti-dumping duties on Sorbitol 70% solution imported from India. The National Tariff Commission determined there is sufficient evidence to justify the review due to allegations that duty expiry would lead to continued dumping and injury, as well as significant changes in Indian production circumstances.

name: S. R. O. 737(I)-2020 Notification Regarding Mandatory Membership of Credit Bureaus for Electricity Supply Companies

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 737(I)/2020
metadata.summary: This notification mandates companies supplying electricity to become members of the credit bureau established under the Credit Bureaus Act, 2015. It requires these entities to furnish information in accordance with the specified requirements and regulations of that Act.

name: No. 404 - No. F.4-7-2015-Cab - Constitution of the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)

metadata.title: Notification constituting the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC) with a specific composition of members including Federal Ministers, the Attorney General, and Secretaries. The committee is authorized to examine cases regarding fresh legislation, amendments to existing laws, and proposed rules, providing recommendations to the Cabinet.

name: No. 403 - No. 2-8-2018-Min-I - Appointment of Dr. Faisal Sultan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on National Health Services

metadata.title: Notification appointing Dr. Faisal Sultan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Dr. Faisal Sultan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination. He is granted the status of Federal Minister with immediate effect under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: The Mutual Legal Assistance (Criminal Matters) Act, 2020

metadata.title: Mutual Legal Assistance (Criminal Matters) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act enacts a law relating to mutual legal assistance in criminal matters and connected ancillary matters for the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'central authority', 'proceeds of crime', and 'instrumentalities of crime' to facilitate cooperation with foreign countries.

name: No. 402 - S.R.O. 657(I)-2020 - Appointment, Promotion & Transfer rules for Computer Operator (BS-16) in the Management Service Wing

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 657(1)/2020
metadata.summary: This notification lays down the methods, qualifications, and conditions for appointment to the upgraded post of Computer Operator (BS-16) in the Management Service Wing under the Establishment Division. It specifies eligibility criteria for initial appointments, promotions from Data Entry Operators, and transfers, including age limits and educational requirements.

name: No. 401 - No. 2-8-2018-Min-I - Appointment of Malik Amin Aslam Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Climate Change

metadata.title: The Gazette of Pakistan, Extra., August 4, 2020
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Malik Amin Aslam Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Climate Change. The appointment is made with the status of Federal Minister and takes effect immediately.

name: No. 400 - No. 2-7/2018-Min-I(i) - Appointment of Mirza Shahzad Akbar as Adviser to the Prime Minister on Accountability and Interior

metadata.title: Notification appointing Mirza Shahzad Akbar as Adviser to the Prime Minister on Accountability and Interior
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mirza Shahzad Akbar as Adviser to the Prime Minister on Accountability and Interior with the status of a Federal Minister, effective immediately. Consequently, his previous role as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Accountability and Interior is terminated upon this appointment.

name: No. 399 - No. 2-7/2018-Min-I - Removal of Malik Amin Aslam Khan from the office of Advisor to the Prime Minister on Climate Change

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-7/2018-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification removes Malik Amin Aslam Khan from the office of Advisor to the Prime Minister on Climate Change. The removal is effective immediately and retains his status as a Federal Minister.

name: No. 385 - No. 2-8/2018-Min.I -APPOINTMENT OF SPECIAL ASSISTANT TO THE PRIME MINISTER ON CLIMATE CHANGE WITH THE STATUS OF FEDERAL MINISTER

metadata.title: The Gazette of Pakistan, Extra., August 4, 2020
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Malik Amin Aslam Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Climate Change. The appointment is made with the status of Federal Minister and takes effect immediately.

name: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Employees' Pension Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: PEMRA Employees' Pension Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: This document notifies the PEMRA Employees' Pension Regulations, 2020, which apply to regular employees of the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority. The regulations define terms related to pension eligibility, service calculation, and various types of pensions such as superannuation and invalidity.

name: The Cash Management (Treasury Single Account) Rules, 2020

metadata.title: Cash Management (Treasury Single Account) Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Public Finance Management Act, 2019 to establish procedures for cash management and treasury operations. They define key terms related to government accounts and outline specific protocols for withdrawals from the Federal Consolidated Fund, including direct debit advice requirements and cash buffer maintenance.

name: No. 397 - No. 2-8/2018-Min-I - Re-designation of Mr. Shahzad Syed Qasim as Special Assistant on Power Division and Coordination of Marketing

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-8/2018-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification re-designates Mr. Shahzad Syed Qasim from his role as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Coordination of Marketing & Development of Mineral Resources. He is now appointed as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Power Division and Coordination of Marketing & Development of Mineral Resources with immediate effect.

name: Notice of Impendins Expiry of Anti-dumping Duty Levied on Imports of Sorbitol 70% Solution Imported from the Republic of India

metadata.title: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping Duty Levied on Imports of Sorbitol 70% Solution Imported from the Republic of India
metadata.summary: This notice informs stakeholders that the definitive anti-dumping duty on Sorbitol 70% Solution imported from India will terminate on August 24, 2020. The document outlines the procedure for domestic industries to file a sunset review application with the National Tariff Commission before the duty expires.

name: Notice of Preliminary Determination of Antidumping Investigation on Dumping of Certain Electrical Capacitors into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People’s Republic of China

metadata.title: Notice of Preliminary Determination of Antidumping Investigation on Dumping of Certain Electrical Capacitors into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People's Republic of China
metadata.summary: The National Tariff Commission initiated an antidumping investigation regarding electrical capacitors imported from China into Pakistan. Following a preliminary determination, the Commission found that while individual dumping margins could not be calculated due to lack of exporter information, a country-wide dumping margin of 24.47 percent was established for China.

name: No. 396 - No. F.12(2)/2018-PA(NA) - Change of portfolio of Malik Karamat Ali Khokhar, MNA from National Security to Information & Broadcasting

metadata.title: Notification No.F.12(2)/2018-PA(NA)
metadata.summary: This notification orders the immediate change of portfolio for Malik Karamat Ali Khokhar from National Security Division to Information & Broadcasting Division. The order was issued by the Prime Minister through the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs on June 8, 2020.

name: No. 395 - No. 2-1/2020-Min-I - Ex-Pakistan leave for Mr. Nadeem Afzal Gondal, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister

metadata.title: Notification granting leave to Mr. Nadeem Afzal Gondal
metadata.summary: This notification grants thirty days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Nadeem Afzal Gondal, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Parliamentary Coordination. The leave is effective from June 12, 2020, until July 11, 2020.

name: No. 394 - No. F.5/10/2020-Com - Constitution of the Cabinet Committee on Institutional Reforms (CCIR)

metadata.title: Notification constituting the Cabinet Committee on Institutional Reforms (CCIR)
metadata.summary: This notification officially constitutes the Cabinet Committee on Institutional Reforms (CCIR) with immediate effect. It lists the specific members of the committee, including ministers and special assistants to the Prime Minister, along with invited secretaries from various divisions.

name: The Securities and Exchange Commission (Re-insurance Brokers) Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: Securities and Exchange Commission (Reinsurance Brokers) Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the registration and licensing of reinsurance brokers in Pakistan. They define key terms, set eligibility criteria including capital requirements, and outline the application procedures for both domestic and foreign entities seeking to operate as reinsurance brokers under the Securities and Exchange Commission.

name: No. 393 - No. F.19-CM-2020-D - Constitution of Committee to examine cases of appointments made without approval of the Federal Government

metadata.title: Notification constituting a Committee to examine and finalize cases of appointments made without approval
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a committee under the Cabinet Secretariat to examine and finalize appointment cases made without Federal Government approval since August 18, 2016. The committee includes representatives from the Establishment, Cabinet, and Law & Justice Divisions and must complete its task within one month.

name: No. 391 - No. F.5/4/2018-Com - Inclusion of Minister for Information and Broadcasting as Member of the Cabinet Committee on Energy (CCoE)

metadata.title: Notification including Minister for Information and Broadcasting as Member of the Cabinet Committee on Energy
metadata.summary: This notification includes the Minister for Information and Broadcasting as a Member of the Cabinet Committee on Energy (CCoE). The decision was made by the Federal Cabinet under rule 17(2) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: The International Court of Justice (Review and Re-consideration) Ordinance, 2020

metadata.title: International Court of Justice (Review and Re-consideration) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the right of review and re-consideration by foreign nationals regarding orders and judgments of Military Courts in Pakistan. It empowers High Courts to examine cases where consular access under the Vienna Convention was denied, potentially causing prejudice to a foreign national's defense rights.

name: No. 2-8/2018-Min-I - Appointment of Mr. Mohammad Shehzad Arbab as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Establishment

metadata.title: Appointment of Mr. Mohammad Shehzad Arbab as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Establishment
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Mohammad Shehzad Arbab as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Establishment with the status of Federal Minister. The appointment takes immediate effect and is issued by the Prime Minister under specific rules of business.

name: No. 2-6/2018-Min-I - Withdrawal of additional portfolio of Narcotics Control from Mr. Shehryar Afridi

metadata.title: The Cabinet Division's Notification of even number dated 8th April, 2020
metadata.summary: This notification addresses the status of a previous Cabinet Division order regarding the withdrawal of an additional portfolio from Mr. Shehryar Afridi. It declares that the earlier notification concerning this specific portfolio change is treated as withdrawn.

name: No. 387 - No. 2-6/2018-Min-I - Withdrawal of additional portfolio of Narcotics Control from Mr. Shehryar Afridi

metadata.title: Notification regarding withdrawal of additional portfolio
metadata.summary: This notification announces the withdrawal of the additional portfolio for Narcotics Control from Mr. Shehryar Afridi, who serves as the Minister of State for States and Frontier Regions. The change takes immediate effect and is issued by the Prime Minister under the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 386 - No. 2-7/2018-Min-I - Removal of Mr. Mohammad Shehzad Arbab from the office of Adviser to the Prime Minister on Establishment

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-7/2018-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification announces the removal of Mr. Mohammad Shehzad Arbab from his office as Adviser to the Prime Minister on Establishment with the Status of Federal Minister. The action was taken by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister and takes effect immediately.

name: Reconstitution of Cabinet Committee on State Owned Enterprises (CCoSOEs) — Notification No. F. 5/8/2018-Com

metadata.title: Notification re-constituting the Cabinet Committee on State Owned Enterprises
metadata.amends: Cabinet Division's earlier Notifications of even number dated 28th December, 2018 and dated 29th April, 2019
metadata.summary: This notification partially modifies earlier Cabinet Division notifications to re-constitute the Cabinet Committee on State Owned Enterprises (CCoSOEs). It outlines the new composition of the committee, including specific ministers and advisers assigned roles as Chairman or Member.

name: The Competition (Exemption) Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: The Competition (Exemption) Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These Regulations empower the Competition Commission of Pakistan to grant exemptions for prohibited agreements under the Competition Act, 2010. They establish procedures for individual, template, and block exemptions based on specific criteria such as market share and agreement restrictions.

name: Appointment of Syed Shibli Faraz as Federal Minister for Information and Broadcasting — Notification No. 2-6/2018-Min-I

metadata.title: Notification appointing Syed Shibli Faraz as Federal Minister
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Syed Shibli Faraz as the Federal Minister for Information and Broadcasting. The appointment was made by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister, effective April 28, 2020.

name: Removal of Dr. Firdous Ashiq Awan from the Office of Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Information and Broadcasting — Notification No. 2-8/2018-Min-I-(i)

metadata.title: Notification removing Dr. Firdous Ashiq Awan from the office of Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Information and Broadcasting
metadata.summary: This notification announces the removal of Dr. Firdous Ashiq Awan from the office of Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Information and Broadcasting. The action was taken by the Prime Minister with immediate effect.

name: Appointment of Lt. General (Retd.) Asim Saleem Bajwa as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Information and Broadcasting — Notification No. 2-8/2018-Min-I

metadata.title: Notification appointing Lt. General (Rtd.) Asim Saleem Bajwa as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Information and Broadcasting
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Lt. General (Rtd.) Asim Saleem Bajwa as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Information and Broadcasting in an honorary capacity. The appointment takes immediate effect and is made by the Prime Minister under specific rules of business.

name: The Secured Transactions Registry Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: The Secured Transactions Registry Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for user accounts and the filing of financing, modification, and termination statements within the Secured Transactions Registry. They define specific account types, such as client and search-only accounts, and outline procedures for establishing these accounts, including verification and inactivity closure rules. Additionally, the document mandates specific statistical information to be included in financing statements and provides functionality for filing prior security interests during a transitional period.

name: The Corporate Insurance Agents Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: The Corporate Insurance Agents Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for corporate insurance agents, including life and non-life insurers as well as takaful operators. They define key terms such as bancassurance, certification processes, and the roles of designated executives within agency agreements.

name: Cancellation of Ex-Pakistan Leave Granted to the Governor of Punjab — Notification No. 3-2/2018-Min-II

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-2/2018-Min-II
metadata.repeals: Notification of even number dated 12th March, 2020
metadata.summary: This notification cancels the ex-Pakistan leave granted to the Governor of Punjab from March 12, 2020, to March 18, 2020. It supersedes a previous notification issued by the same division on March 12, 2020.

name: Notification Regarding Oversight of Divisions/Departments by the Commissioners of SECP

metadata.title: S.R.O. 324()/2020
metadata.summary: This notification assigns specific divisions and departments of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan to individual Commissioners for oversight. It supersedes a previous order dated August 28, 2019, and becomes effective from April 20, 2020.

name: The COVID-I9 (Prevention of Smuggling) Ordinance,2020

metadata.title: COVID-19 (Prevention of Smuggling) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to prevent the smuggling of scheduled articles during the emergent situation caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. It defines key terms such as 'smuggling' and 'scheduled articles' and establishes specific penalties for individuals found guilty of smuggling goods or foreign currency, with imprisonment terms varying based on the value of the items involved.

name: The COVID-l9 (Prevention of Hoarding) Ordinance, 2020

metadata.title: COVID-19 (Prevention of Hoarding) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to prevent hoarding of scheduled articles during the emergent situation caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. It defines offenses related to hoarding, grants powers for search and seizure without a warrant, and establishes penalties including imprisonment and fines.

name: The Pakistan Housing Authority Foundation Employees (Service) Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: Pakistan Housing Authority Foundation Employees (Service) Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: This document establishes the service regulations for employees of the Pakistan Housing Authority Foundation (PHA Foundation). It defines key terms, outlines the scope of application, and details procedures regarding appointments, promotions, transfers, and probation periods.

name: Revised Office Timings for Federal Government Offices as a Measure to Contain the Spread of COVID-19 — Notification No. 6/1/2007-D-2

metadata.title: NOTIFICATION No. 6/1/2007-D-2
metadata.summary: This notification establishes specific office timings for Federal Government offices in Islamabad to contain the spread of the Corona Virus (COVID-19). The new schedule applies immediately and remains in effect until Tuesday, April 7, 2020, unless modified or withdrawn earlier.

name: The Geographical Indications (Registration and Protection) Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Geographical Indications (Registration and Protection) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and effective protection of geographical indications for goods originating in Pakistan. It establishes legal means to prevent unfair competition and protect the reputation of products based on their specific geographical origin.

name: Notice of Final Determination and Imposition of Definitive Anti-dumping Duty on Dumped Imports of Cold Rolled Coils/Sheets/Strips into Pakistan Originating in and/ or Exported from Canada and the Russian Federation

metadata.title: Notice of Final Determination and Imposition of Definitive Anti-dumping Duty on Dumped Imports of Cold Rolled Coils/Sheets/Strips into Pakistan Originating in and/ or Exported from Canada and the Russian Federation
metadata.summary: This notice announces the National Tariff Commission's final determination to impose a definitive anti-dumping duty on cold rolled steel coils, sheets, and strips imported from Canada and the Russian Federation. The imposed duty rate is 13.94 percent ad valorem of the C&F price, effective from September 20, 2019, for a period of five years.

name: The legal Aid and Justice Authority Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Legal Aid and Justice Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Legal Aid and Justice Authority to provide legal, financial, and other assistance for access to justice for poor and vulnerable segments of society in criminal cases. It defines the composition of the Authority's Board, outlines its management structure, and sets procedures for meetings and appointments.

name: The Zainab Alert Response and Recovery Act, 2020

metadata.title: Zainab Alert Response and Recovery Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Zainab Alert Response and Recovery Agency (ZARRA) to address the issue of missing and abducted children in Pakistan. It provides legal provisions for raising alerts, responding to incidents, and recovering children under the age of eighteen who are at risk of violence, abuse, or trafficking.

name: The Companies (Further Issue of Shares) Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: The Companies (Further Issue of Shares) Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the further issue of shares by companies, including right shares, bonus shares, and employee stock option schemes. They establish definitions for terms related to share issues and outline specific conditions that listed companies must comply with when issuing right shares under the Companies Act, 2017.

name: Grant of Seven Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mr. Nadeem Babar, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Petroleum Division with the Status of Minister of State — Notification No. 2-1/2020-Min.I

metadata.title: Grant of leave to Mr. Nadeem Babar
metadata.summary: This notification grants seven days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Nadeem Babar, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Petroleum Division. The leave is granted with the status of Minister of State from March 13 to March 19, 2020.

name: Appointment of Ms. Tania S. Aidrus as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Digital Pakistan — Notification No. 2-8/2018-Min-I

metadata.title: Notification appointing Ms. Tania S. Aidrus as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Digital Pakistan
metadata.summary: This notification announces the appointment of Ms. Tania S. Aidrus as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Digital Pakistan. The appointment is made with immediate effect under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: Declaration of the Year 2020 as the “Year of Blue Economy” — Notification No. 7-2/2020-Min-I

metadata.title: Notification declaring Year 2020 as the 'Year of Blue Economy'
metadata.summary: This notification declares the year 2020 as the 'Year of Blue Economy' in Pakistan. The declaration aims to bring maritime activities into focus for national economic development and explore the full potential of ocean activities.

name: The Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to protect and secure the property rights of women against harassment, coercion, force, or fraud. It establishes a mechanism where the Ombudsman can initiate proceedings to restore ownership or possession if no court case is pending, and directs authorities to take necessary steps to confer title back to the complainant.

name: Notice of Initiation of Newcomer Review of Anti-dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Polyester Filament Yarn from People’s Republic of China and Malaysia

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Newcomer Review of Anti-dumping Duties Imposed on Dumped Imports of Polyester Filament Yarn from People's Republic of China and Malaysia
metadata.summary: This notice initiates a newcomer review of anti-dumping duties on Polyester Filament Yarn (PFY) imported from China and Malaysia. The National Tariff Commission received an application from M/s Suzhou Rusheng Chemical Fiber Co., Ltd claiming it is not related to existing exporters subject to duties. Consequently, no anti-dumping duty will be imposed, but a cash deposit equal to the residual rate of 11.35% is required.

name: The Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order (Repeal) Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order (Repeal) Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the President's Order No. 15 of 1980, which governed court dress and modes of address for superior courts in Pakistan. The legislation received presidential assent on February 1, 2020, and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: Condolence on the Demise of Mr. Naeem-ul-Haque, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs — Notification No. 2-8/2018-Min.I

metadata.title: No. 2-8/2018-Min.I.
metadata.summary: This notification announces the death of Mr. Naeem-ul-Haque, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs. It records the Government's appreciation for his services and extends condolences to his bereaved family.

name: The Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2020

metadata.title: Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an efficacious and speedy mechanism for the issuance of Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates to facilitate property inheritance. It empowers the National Database and Registration Authority to issue these certificates while aiming to curb fraud and forgery.

name: Grant of Nine Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Dr. Shireen M. Mazari, Federal Minister for Human Rights — Notification No. 2-1/2020-Min-I

metadata.title: No. 2-1/2020-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification grants nine days of ex-Pakistan leave to Dr. Shireen M. Mazari, the Federal Minister for Human Rights. The leave is authorized from January 24th to February 1st, 2020, under powers conferred by the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.

name: Merger of Ministry of Postal Services with Ministry of Communications and Withdrawal of Additional Portfolio — Notification No. 2-6/2018-Min-I

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-6/2018-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification announces the merger of the Ministry of Postal Services with the Ministry of Communications. Consequently, the Minister for Communications will cease to hold the additional portfolio of Postal Services.

name: Inclusion of FBR Officers in the Prime Minister’s Task Force on Civil Services Reforms — Notification No. F. 42/CM/2018-Cab

metadata.title: Notification approving inclusion of officers in the Prime Minister's Task Force on Civil Services Reforms
metadata.summary: This notification approves the inclusion of new members representing the Federal Board of Revenue and the Police Service into the Prime Minister's Task Force on Civil Services Reforms. It also specifies that these new members will replace existing representatives from those services while keeping other members and terms of reference unchanged.

name: Constitution of Committee on the Cabinet’s Decision of 11 February 2020 — Notification No. F. 04-CM-2020-M(Pt.)

metadata.title: Notification constituting a committee for finalization of the results of Census-2017
metadata.summary: This notification establishes a committee to deliberate on and finalize the results of the Census-2017. The committee is headed by the Minister for Maritime Affairs and includes other ministers as members, with the Planning, Development & Special Initiatives Division providing secretariat support.

name: Notice of Initiation of Anti-dumping Investigation on Alleged Dumping of Certain Electrical Capacitors into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People’s Republic of China

metadata.title: Notice of Initiation of Anti-dumping Investigation on Alleged Dumping of Certain Electrical Capacitors into Pakistan Originating in and/or Exported from the People's Republic of China
metadata.summary: The National Tariff Commission initiates an investigation into alleged dumping of specific electrical capacitors from China into Pakistan. The investigation aims to determine if these dumped prices are causing injury to the domestic industry producing similar products.

name: The Naya Pakistan Housing and Development Authority Act, 2020

metadata.title: Naya Pakistan Housing and Development Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Naya Pakistan Housing and Development Authority to plan, develop, construct, and manage real estate development schemes and projects. It aims to provide housing as a basic necessity of life for citizens through both profit and non-profit initiatives.

name: The Federal Government Employees Housing Authority Act, 2020

metadata.title: Federal Government Employees Housing Authority Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Government Employees Housing Authority to plan and develop housing schemes for serving, retired, and other specified federal government employees. The Authority is created as a body corporate with powers to acquire land, manage properties, and regulate housing projects within the specified area.

name: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping Duties Levied on Imports of Biaxially Oriented Poly Propylene (BOPP) Film into Pakistan Originating in and/ or Exported from the People’s Republic of China, Sultanate of Oman, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and United Arab Emirates

metadata.title: Notice of Impending Expiry of Anti-dumping Duties Levied on Imports of Biaxially Oriented Poly Propylene (BOPP) Film into Pakistan Originating in and/ or Exported from the People's Republic of China, Sultanate of Oman, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and United Arab Emirates
metadata.summary: This notification announces the impending expiry of definitive anti-dumping duties on Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene (BOPP) film imported from China, Oman, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE. The National Tariff Commission decided to continue these duties until August 03, 2020, unless a sunset review is initiated by the domestic industry before that date.

name: The Type Approval Technical Standards Regulations, 2019

metadata.title: Type Approval Technical Standards Regulations, 2019
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the technical standards and procedures for obtaining type approval for terminal equipment in Pakistan. They mandate that all such equipment must conform to specific safety, interoperability, and electromagnetic compliance requirements set by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority.

name: The White Listing of IP Addresses Regulations, 2019

metadata.title: White Listing of IP Addresses Regulations, 2019
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedure for the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority to white-list IP addresses for authorized Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) usage. They define eligibility criteria, required documentation, and specific usage thresholds for various entities including licensees, international call centers, and educational institutions.

name: The PEMRA (Eigibility Criteria and Bidding Procedure for Satellite TV Licensing) Regulations 2014 as Amended in 2019

metadata.title: PEMRA (Eligibility Criteria and Bidding Procedure for Satellite TV Broadcasting Station Licensing) Regulations, 2014 as Amended in 2019
metadata.amends: PEMRA (Eligibility Criteria and Bidding Procedure for Satellite TV Broadcasting Station Licensing) Regulations, 2014
metadata.summary: This notification amends the PEMRA Regulations of 2014 to update eligibility criteria and bidding procedures for satellite TV broadcasting station licences. It defines key terms such as 'advertisement', 'annual fee', and 'foreign content' while specifying requirements for applicants, including minimum paid-up capital and restrictions on foreign ownership.

name: The Landing Rights Permission Regulations-2016 as Amended in 2019

metadata.title: PEMRA Landing Rights Permission Regulations-2016 as Amended in 2019
metadata.summary: This notification amends the PEMRA Landing Rights Permission Regulations of 2016 to provide guidelines for granting landing rights to foreign satellite TV channels. It outlines specific eligibility criteria, such as capital requirements and operational history, along with a detailed list of documents required for application.

name: Specification of Minimum Paid-Up Capital for Incorporation of a Corporate Restructuring Company Act, 2019

metadata.title: Circular S.R.O. 1566(1)/2019
metadata.summary: This notification specifies the minimum paid-up capital required for incorporating a corporate restructuring company. The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan, in consultation with the State Bank of Pakistan and with Ministry of Finance approval, sets this amount at Rs. 500 million.

name: Reconstitution of Awards Sub-Committee on Science, Engineering & Education for Pakistan Civil Awards — Notification No. 8/1/91-Awards-I

metadata.title: Notification reconstitution of Awards Committees
metadata.summary: This notification reconstitutes various Awards Committees responsible for scrutinizing and recommending nominees for Pakistan Civil Awards. It lists the specific members, including government officials and non-official advisors, for sub-committees on Science/Engineering/Education, Arts/Literature, Social Welfare, and the Main Awards Committee.

name: The Pakistan Plant Quarantine Rules, 2019

metadata.title: The Pakistan Plant Quarantine Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Pakistan Plant Quarantine Act, 1976 to establish phytosanitary regulations for plant imports and trade. The document provides definitions for key terms such as 'commodity', 'consignment', and specific agricultural items like cotton and cut flowers to ensure pest-free movement of goods.

name: S.R.O. 1461(I)/2019 – Application of Sections 8B and 23 of the Sales Tax Act to Federal Excise Duty

metadata.title: The Federal Excise Act, 2005 (Notification S.R.O. 1461(I)/2019)
subjects: Applicability of Sales Tax Act Provisions
metadata.summary: This notification declares that specific provisions of the Sales Tax Act, 1990 are applicable mutatis mutandis to federal excise duty levied in sales tax mode. It extends these provisions to goods specified in the Second Schedule to the Federal Excise Act, 2005.

name: Inclusion of Minister for Economic Affairs as Member of the Cabinet Committee on China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CCoCPEC) — Notification No. F.5/7/2018-Com

metadata.title: Notification regarding inclusion of Minister for Economic Affairs in the composition of Cabinet Committee on China-Pakistan Economic Corridor
metadata.summary: This notification officially includes the Minister for Economic Affairs as a member of the Cabinet Committee on China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CCoCPEC). The decision was made by the Prime Minister under rule 17(2) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: The Corporate Restructuring Companies Rules, 2019

metadata.title: The Corporate Restructuring Companies Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for granting licenses to carry on business as a corporate restructuring company in Pakistan. They define eligibility criteria for promoters and directors, outline the application process including fees and forms, and specify conditions for license validity and refusal.

name: The Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order (Repeal) Ordinance, 2019

metadata.title: The Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order (Repeal) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to repeal the Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order, 1980. It was issued under Article 89 of the Constitution because the Senate and National Assembly were not in session.

name: The Legal Aid and Justice Authority Ordinance, 2019

metadata.title: The Legal Aid and Justice Authority Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Legal Aid and Justice Authority to provide legal, financial, and other assistance for access to justice in criminal cases. It specifically targets the poor and vulnerable segments of society who are unable to afford legal representation. The document outlines the establishment, management, composition of the governing Board, and definitions related to legal aid services.

name: The Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Ordinance, 2019

metadata.title: The Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to protect and secure the property rights of women against harassment, coercion, force, or fraud. It establishes a mechanism where the Ombudsman can initiate proceedings to restore ownership or possession if no court case is pending, and directs authorities to take necessary steps to confer title back to the complainant.

name: The Letters of Administration and Succession Certificate Ordinance, 2019

metadata.title: Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a mechanism for the National Database and Registration Authority to issue Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates more efficiently. It aims to curb fraud and forgery by creating a dedicated Succession Facilitation Unit within the Authority.

name: The Whistleblower Protection and Vigilance Commission Ordinance, 2019

metadata.title: Whistleblower Protection and Vigilance Commission Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Whistleblower Protection and Vigilance Commission to facilitate mechanisms for reporting corruption and protecting whistleblowers from disadvantageous measures. It defines key terms such as 'Whistleblower', 'Authority', and 'Disadvantageous Measures' to outline protections against actions like dismissal, discrimination, or intimidation.

name: The Pakistan Medical Commission Ordinance, 2019

metadata.title: Pakistan Medical Commission Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of the medical and dental professions in Pakistan. It establishes a uniform minimum standard for basic and higher medical education, training, and the recognition of qualifications.

name: The Medical Tribunal Ordinance, 2019

metadata.title: The Medical Tribunal Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a special judicial tribunal to efficiently and expeditiously hear and decide disputes arising from matters pertaining to the medical and health sectors in Pakistan. It provides for the constitution of the tribunal, including its chairman and members, defines its jurisdiction, tenure, and powers, and ensures that no other court can take cognizance of matters falling within its jurisdiction.

name: Appointment of Mr. Muhammad Qasim Khan Suri as Acting Speaker of the National Assembly — Notification No. 8(1)/2018-Estt.I. (185)

metadata.title: Notification No. 8(1)/2018-Estt. I. (185)
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Muhammad Qasim Khan Suri as the Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly to act as Speaker. This arrangement takes effect from September 21, 2019, replacing Mr. Asad Qaiser who is abroad on a visit.

name: The Listed Companies (Code of Corporate Governance) Regulations, 2019

metadata.title: The Listed Companies (Code of Corporate Governance) Regulations, 2019
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the Code of Corporate Governance for listed companies in Pakistan, applying a 'comply or explain' approach to most provisions. They mandate specific requirements regarding board composition, including limits on directorships, diversity, independent directors, female representation, and the separation of the chairman and chief executive officer roles.

name: Revision of Terms and Fees for Advocates and Advocates-on-Record Conducting Cases on Behalf of the Federal Government — Notification No. F.5/6/2007-LA

metadata.title: Notification regarding fresh terms and fee for conducting cases on behalf of the Federal Government
metadata.summary: This notification approves new fee structures for advocates and Advocates-on-Record representing the Federal Government in various courts. It specifies payment rates for civil suits, appeals, writ petitions, and cases handled by AORs in the Supreme Court, including provisions for identical cases and remanded matters.

name: Notice of Preliminary Determination on Dumped Imports of Cold Rolled Coils/Sheets/Strips in to Pakistan Originating in and/ or Exported from Canada and the Russian Federation

metadata.title: Notice of Preliminary Determination on Dumped Imports of Cold Rolled Coils/Sheets/Strips in to Pakistan Originating in and/ or Exported from Canada and the Russian Federation
metadata.summary: The National Tariff Commission issued a notice regarding a preliminary affirmative determination on dumped imports of cold-rolled steel coils, sheets, and strips from Canada and the Russian Federation. Based on the investigation, the Commission imposed a provisional anti-dumping duty at a rate of 13.94 percent ad valorem to prevent material injury to the domestic industry.

name: Prorogation of the Senate Session upon Conclusion of Business — Notification No. F. 4(8)/2019-Legis

metadata.title: Notification proroguing the Senate session
metadata.summary: This notification announces the prorogation of the Senate session in Pakistan. The President exercised powers under Article 54 of the Constitution to conclude business on September 3, 2019.

name: The National Information Technology Board Ordinance, 2019

metadata.title: National Information Technology Board Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Information Technology Board (NITB) to provide for cross-cutting e-governance applications and initiatives. It defines the Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlines its composition including a Chairman, members, and a Chief Executive Officer, and sets the rules for their appointment and tenure.

name: The Local Taxes and Levies Drawback (Non-Textile) Order, 2018

metadata.title: Local Taxes and Levies Drawback (Non-Textile) Order, 2018
metadata.summary: This Order provides drawback benefits for non-textile exports made from July 1, 2018, to June 30, 2021. It establishes specific conditions and rates for these benefits, including performance-based increments and additional allowances for exports to non-traditional markets.

metadata.amends: Cabinet Division's Notification Nos.10/1/2011-NPS dated 9th December, 2011 and subsequent Notifications bearing No. 06/Prog-II/2012 dated 13-07-2012 & No.1/4/2015-Accounts-II dated 11-09-2015

name: The Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act, 2018

metadata.title: Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides effective measures to prevent and combat trafficking in persons, with a specific focus on women and children. It establishes criminal offenses for recruitment, transportation, or harboring of victims through force, fraud, or coercion, while also defining protections for victims and witnesses.

name: The Credit and Suretyship (Conduct of Business) Rules, 2018

They define key terms such as collateral, guarantee, and insurer, and specify the types of contracts of guarantee or bond that an insurer may issue.

name: The FATA Interim Governance Regulation, 2018

metadata.title: The FATA Interim Governance Regulation, 2018
metadata.repeals: The Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes an interim system for the administration of justice, maintenance of peace, and good governance in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas (FATA). It also repeals the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901, pending the merger of FATA with the Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

name: S.R.O. 656(1)-2018 Notification of LLP Registration Offices under Section 52 of the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2017 read with Regulation 30 of the LLP Regulations, 2018

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 656(1/2018
metadata.summary: This notification designates specific locations across Pakistan as Registration Offices for Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs). It is issued under the powers of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan pursuant to the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2017.

name: The Sir Syed-CASE (Center for Advanced Studies in Engineering) Institute of Technology Islamabad Act, 2018

metadata.title: Sir Syed-CASE (Center for Advanced Studies in Engineering) Institute of Technology, Islamabad Act 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sir Syed-CASE (Center for Advanced Studies in Engineering) Institute of Technology, Islamabad as a non-profit body corporate. It provides for the institute's powers to conduct education, research, award degrees, and manage its property and staff.

name: The Institute for Art and Culture Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Institute for Art and Culture Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Institute for Art and Culture in Pakistan. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its powers to provide education, conduct research, and offer scholarships in arts and culture.

name: S. R. O. 627(I)/2018 — Rescission of Notification S.R.O. 561(I)/2018

name: The Prevention of Smuggling of Migrants Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Prevention of Smuggling of Migrants Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides effective measures to prevent the smuggling of migrants by land, sea, and air while promoting international cooperation. It defines key terms such as 'migrant', 'smuggling of migrants', and 'organized criminal group' and establishes punishments for those who intentionally engage in or attempt to engage in migrant smuggling.

name: The Foreign Assets (Declaration and Repatriation) Act, 2018

metadata.title: Foreign Assets (Declaration and Repatriation) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the declaration and repatriation of assets and income held outside Pakistan. It defines key terms such as foreign assets, fair market value, liquid assets, and holders of public office to regulate these financial holdings.

name: The Finance Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2018. It also amends several existing laws, including the Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance, 1961 and the Customs Act, 1969.

name: The Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking (Repeal) Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking (Repeal) Act, 2018

metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking Act, 1977. It received the assent of the President on May 22, 2018, and came into force immediately.

name: The Islamabad Healthcare Regulation Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Islamabad Healthcare Regulatory Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad Healthcare Regulatory Authority to provide a regulatory framework for healthcare services in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It aims to ensure quality health care by implementing specific standards within the sector and defines key terms related to healthcare professionals, establishments, and services.

name: The Juvenile Justice System Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Juvenile Justice System Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a framework for the criminal justice system and social reintegration of juveniles in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'juvenile', 'diversion', and 'heinous offence' to guide alternative processes and judicial proceedings.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Child Protection Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Child Protection Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection and care of children in the Islamabad Capital Territory from physical or mental violence, injury, neglect, maltreatment, exploitation, and abuse. It defines key terms such as 'child', 'child abuse', and 'guardian', and establishes factors for determining the best interest of a child.

name: The National Civic Education Commission Act, 2018

metadata.title: National Civic Education Commission Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Civic Education Commission to foster civic competence and responsibility among citizens. The Commission is tasked with educating people on fundamental rights, developing courses for constitutional objectives, and promoting values such as unity, tolerance, and respect for laws.

name: The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, relief, and rehabilitation of the rights of transgender persons in Pakistan. It establishes mechanisms for self-perceived gender identity recognition and registration with government departments like NADRA while prohibiting discrimination in employment, healthcare, education, and other public services.

name: The Voluntary Declaration of Domestic Assets Ordinance, 2018

metadata.title: Voluntary Declaration of Domestic Assets Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the voluntary declaration of domestic assets held in Pakistan to address non-reporting and under-reporting issues. It applies to citizens, companies, and associations except holders of public office, their spouses, and dependant children, while excluding assets derived from criminal offences.

name: The Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Ordinance, 2018

metadata.title: Prevention of Trafficking in Persons Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides effective measures to prevent and combat trafficking in persons, with a specific focus on women and children. name: S.R.O. 561(I)/2018 – Fixed Excise Duty on Specified Goods

metadata.title: The Federal Excise Act, 2005 (Notification S.R.O.561(I)/2018)
metadata.summary: This notification directs the Federal Board of Revenue to levy and collect excise duty on locally produced cigarettes based on their printed retail price per thousand. It specifies different duty rates for three categories of cigarette packs depending on whether their price exceeds four thousand five hundred rupees, falls between two thousand nine hundred and twenty-five and four thousand five hundred rupees, or does not exceed two thousand nine hundred and twenty-five rupees.

name: The COMSATS University Islamabad Act, 2018

name: No. 151 - No. 2-3/2017-Min-I - Allocation of the Power Division portfolio to Sardar Awais Ahmed Khan Leghari, Federal Minister

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-3/2017-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification allocates the portfolio of Power Division to Sardar Awais Ahmed Khan Leghari, Federal Minister, with immediate effect. It confirms that the Prime Minister issued this allocation under rule 3(4) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: S.R.O. 989(I)/2017 — Amendment in the Composition of the Examining Body under the Ministry of National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 989(1)/2017

metadata.summary: This notification partially modifies a previous notice regarding the composition of an Examining Body for homeopathic doctors. It updates the member list by replacing Homeopathic Doctor Rao Ghulam Murtaza with Homeopathic Doctor Prof. Akhlaq Ahmad at serial No. III.

name: The National Commission on the Rights of Child Act,2017

metadata.title: The National Commission on the Rights of Child Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a National Commission on the Rights of Child to exercise powers and perform functions related to child rights in Pakistan. The legislation defines the composition of the Commission, including ex-officio members from various divisions and elected representatives, as well as provisions for appointments, terms of office, and disqualifications.

name: The Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides protections to prevent unauthorized acts regarding information systems and establishes related offences. It also creates mechanisms for the investigation, prosecution, trial, and international cooperation concerning these crimes.

name: The Elections Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Elections Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends, consolidates, and unifies the laws relating to the conduct of elections in Pakistan. It provides definitions for key terms such as candidate, election expenses, and electoral areas, and establishes the framework for the Election Commission's operations.

name: Draft- The Professional Clearing Members (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: Professional Clearing Members (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: This document publishes draft regulations proposed by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan regarding professional clearing members. It outlines the licensing procedures, definitions, and conditions for granting and renewing licenses to companies providing clearing, settlement, and custody services.

name: The Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act mandates the compulsory teaching of the Holy Quran in all educational institutions within the Islamabad Capital Territory and those owned by the Federal Government. It requires recitation of the Naazrah Quran for grades I to V and translation for grades VI to XII, ensuring the entire Quran is covered by grade XII.

name: No. 2-5/2017-Min-I — Appointment of Mr. Haroon Khan and Mr. Nasir Iqbal Bosal as Special Assistants to the Prime Minister

metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Haroon Khan and Mr. Nasir Iqbal Bosal as Special Assistants to the Prime Minister with immediate effect. The appointment was made by the Prime Minister under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 150 - No. 2-5/2017-Min-I - Appointment of Mr. Haroon Khan and Mr. Nasir Iqbal Bosal as Special Assistants to the Prime Minister

metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Haroon Khan and Mr. Nasir Iqbal Bosal as Special Assistants to the Prime Minister of Pakistan. The appointments take immediate effect under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 2-5/2017-Min-I — Assignment of Functions and Grant of Status to Special Assistants to the Prime Minister
