metadata.summary: This notification assigns functions and status to Special Assistants to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs, Economic Affairs, Media Affairs, Law, and Institutional Reforms. It also allocates portfolios and Federal Minister status to Advisers on Political Affairs, National History and Literary Heritage Division, IRSA Affairs, and Aviation.

metadata.summary: This notification appoints Lt. Gen. (Retd) Nasser Khan Janjua HI (M) as the National Security Adviser with immediate effect. The terms and conditions of this appointment are to be issued separately.

metadata.title: Notification appointing Advisers to the Prime Minister
metadata.summary: This notification appoints four individuals as Advisers to the Prime Minister of Pakistan with immediate effect. The appointment was made by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister under clause (1) of Article 93 of the Constitution.

name: No. 145 - No. F.5/5/2017-Com - Reconstitution of the Cabinet Committee on Restructuring (CCOR)

metadata.title: Notification reconstituting the Cabinet Committee on Restructuring (CCOR)
metadata.summary: This notification reconstitutes the Cabinet Committee on Restructuring (CCOR) with a specific composition of ministers and secretaries. It also designates the Minister for Finance, Revenue & Economic Affairs to chair meetings in the absence of the Prime Minister.

name: No. 146 - No. 3-2/2016-Min.II - Allowing the Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to visit Kabul for Pakistan's 70th Anniversary celebrations

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-2/2016-Min.II
metadata.summary: This notification grants permission for the Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to make an official visit to Kabul on August 14, 2017. During this absence, the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly is authorized to perform the Governor's functions under Article 104 of the Constitution of Pakistan.

name: No. 3-2/2016-Min-II — Permission for Official Visit of the Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to Kabul and Authorization of the Speaker to Perform the Functions of Governor (14 August 2017)

metadata.summary: This notification grants permission for the Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to undertake a one-day official visit to Kabul on August 14, 2017, to attend celebrations marking Pakistan's 70th Anniversary. During this absence, the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly is authorized to perform the Governor's functions under Article 104 of the Constitution of Pakistan.

name: No. F. 5/5/2017-Com. — Reconstitution of the Cabinet Committee on Restructuring (CCOR)

metadata.title: Notification reconstitution of the Cabinet Committee on Restructuring (CCOR)
metadata.summary: This notification reconstitutes the Cabinet Committee on Restructuring (CCOR) with a specific composition of members including the Prime Minister as Chairman and various Ministers and Secretaries. It also designates the Minister for Finance, Revenue & Economic Affairs to chair meetings in the absence of the Prime Minister.

metadata.title: Notification reconstitution of the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC)
metadata.summary: This notification reconstitutes the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC) of the Cabinet under the Government of Pakistan. It details the specific members and secretaries appointed to the committee, with the Prime Minister serving as Chairman and the Minister for Finance acting as a member.

name: The Salary of Judges of the High Court Order, 2017

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2017
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2016
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes new salary amounts for the Chief Justice and other Judges of High Courts in Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President on August 15, 2017, and is deemed to have taken effect from July 1, 2017.

name: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2017

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2017
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2016
metadata.summary: This Order establishes new salary amounts for the Chief Justice of Pakistan and other Judges of the Supreme Court, effective from July 1, 2017. It explicitly repeals the previous Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order issued in 2016.

name: No. 2-3/2017-Min-I — Appointment of Mr. Daniyal Aziz and Mr. Mumtaz Ahmed Tarar as Federal Ministers and Syed Ayaz Ali Shah Sheerazi and Mir Dostain Khan Domki as Ministers of State

metadata.summary: This notification appoints Daniyal Aziz and Mumtaz Ahmed Tarar as Federal Ministers, along with Syed Ayaz Ali Shah Sheerazi and Mir Dostain Khan Domki as Ministers of State. The appointments were made under Article 92 of the Constitution on the advice of the Prime Minister, and the oath of office was administered by the President on August 10, 2017.

name: No. 144 - No. F.5/3/2017-Com - Reconstitution of the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC)

metadata.title: Notification reconstituting the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC)
metadata.summary: This notification reconstitutes the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC) of the Cabinet. It lists the specific members, including the Prime Minister as Chairman and various Ministers and Secretaries as Members or Special Invitees.

metadata.summary: This notification lists the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State appointed by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister under Article 92 of the Constitution. It records that these officials were administered the oath of office by the President on August 4, 2017.

name: No. 2-3/2017-Min-I — Appointment of Federal Ministers and Ministers of State

metadata.title: Notification appointing Federal Ministers and Ministers of State
metadata.summary: This notification records the appointment of various Federal Ministers and Ministers of State by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister. It further states that these officials were administered the oath of office by the President on August 4, 2017.

name: No. 141 - No. 2-2/2017-Min-I - Oath of office of Mr. Shahid Khaqan Abbasi as Prime Minister of Pakistan

metadata.title: Notification regarding the oath of office of Mr. Shahid Khaqan Abbasi
metadata.summary: This notification announces that Mr. Shahid Khaqan Abbasi took the oath of office as Prime Minister of Pakistan on August 1, 2017. The oath was administered before the President in accordance with Article 91(5) of the Constitution.

name: No. 2-2/2017-Min-I — Assumption of Office by Mr. Shahid Khaqan Abbasi as Prime Minister of Pakistan

metadata.title: Notification regarding the oath of office of Mr. Shahid Khaqan Abbasi
metadata.summary: This notification announces that Mr. Shahid Khaqan Abbasi took the oath of office as Prime Minister of Pakistan on August 1, 2017. The oath was administered in terms of Article 91(5) of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan before the President.

name: The Futures Brokers (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Futures Brokers (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for licensing and regulating futures brokers in Pakistan. They define eligibility criteria, including sponsor requirements and financial resources, necessary for obtaining a license from the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan.

name: The Listed Companies (Substantial Acquisition of Voting Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Listed Companies (Substantial Acquisition of Voting Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for substantial acquisition of voting shares and takeovers in listed companies. They mandate specific disclosure timelines for acquirers and target companies regarding share acquisitions, rumors, and negotiations.

name: No. 8/1/91-Awards-I — Reconstitution of Committees for Scrutiny and Recommendation of Nominees for Pakistan Civil Awards

metadata.title: Notification reconstitution of Committees for Pakistan Civil Awards
metadata.summary: This notification reconstitutes various committees responsible for scrutinizing and recommending nominees for the conferment of Pakistan Civil Awards. It establishes specific sub-committees for Science, Engineering, Education, Arts, and Literature, as well as a main awards committee, listing their respective members and advisors.

name: The Companies (Incorporation) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Companies (Incorporation) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: This document notifies the Companies (Incorporation) Regulations, 2017, issued by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan under the Companies Act, 2017. It establishes procedures for reserving company names, including combined or separate applications, and outlines restrictions on prohibited words in company names.

name: The Audit Oversight Board (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: Audit Oversight Board (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedures for the conduct of business, meetings, and decision-making processes for the Audit Oversight Board (AOB). They define key terms, outline meeting notice requirements, minute-keeping protocols, and provisions regarding committees and authentication of decisions.

name: No. 140 - No. 2-1/2017-Min-I - Grant of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Miftah Ismail, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-1/2017-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification grants five days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Miftah Ismail, who serves as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister and Chairman of the Board of Investment. The leave is effective from July 8th to July 12th, 2017.

name: No. 2-1/2017-Min-I — Grant of Five Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mr. Miftah Ismail, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister/Chairman, Board of Investment (8–12 July 2017)

metadata.title: Notification granting leave to Mr. Miftah Ismail
subjects: Special Assistant to the Prime Minister
metadata.summary: This notification grants five days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Miftah Ismail, who serves as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister and Chairman of the Board of Investment. The leave is valid from July 8th to July 12th, 2017.

name: The Futures Exchanges (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Futures Exchanges (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for licensing and operating futures exchanges in Pakistan. They outline the application process, eligibility criteria, infrastructure requirements, and conditions under which the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan grants licenses.

name: The Finance Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2017. It also amends specific sections of the Customs Act, 1969, including provisions related to controlled delivery, uniform rules, and customs duty refunds.

name: The Senate Secretariat Services Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Senate Secretariat Services Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment and terms and conditions of service for persons in the Senate Secretariat. It applies to all employees within the Secretariat wherever they may be located.

name: The Witness Protection, Security and Benefit Act, 2017

metadata.title: Witness Protection, Security and Benefit Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a robust framework for the protection, security, and benefit programs for witnesses involved in serious offenses. It creates a Witness Protection Advisory Board to oversee policies and functions, while defining specific measures such as identity changes, relocation, and financial aid for protected persons.

name: No. 3-2/2015-Min-II — Grant of Ex-Pakistan Leave to Malik Muhammad Rafique Rajwana, Governor of the Punjab, and Authorization of the Speaker to Perform the Functions of Governor (3 June–13 July 2017)

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-2 /2015-Min-II
metadata.repeals: Notification of even number dated 25th April, 2017
metadata.summary: This notification grants ex-Pakistan leave to Malik Muhammad Rafique Rajwana, the Governor of the Punjab, from June 3, 2017, to July 13, 2017. During his absence, the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is authorized to perform the functions of the Governor under Article 104 of the Constitution.

name: The Alternative Dispute Resolution Act, 2017

metadata.title: Alternative Dispute Resolution Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to ensure inexpensive and expeditious alternative dispute resolution systems in Pakistan. It mandates courts to refer civil matters listed in the Schedule to ADR processes unless specific exceptions apply, such as when parties disagree or no resolution is possible.

name: The Companies Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Companies Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act reforms and re-enacts the law relating to companies in Pakistan. It aims to facilitate corporatization, promote technology use in business, protect stakeholder interests, and provide mechanisms for resolving corporate disputes.

name: S.R.O. 407(I)/2017 – Levy of Federal Excise Duty on Fixed Basis

metadata.title: The Federal Excise Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This notification directs the Federal Board of Revenue to levy and collect excise duty on locally produced cigarettes based on their printed retail price. It specifies different duty rates for three categories of cigarettes depending on whether their price exceeds, falls between, or does not exceed certain thresholds per thousand units.

name: Draft- The Whistleblowing Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: Whistleblowing Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for protected disclosures and whistleblowing within companies and regulated persons administered by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. They define key terms such as 'whistleblower', 'protected disclosure', and 'original information', while outlining the duties and conduct expected from those making disclosures.

name: No. 139 - No. F.4(7)/2015-Cab - Assignment of additional mandate to the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)

metadata.title: Notification No. F..4(7)/2015-Cab.
subjects: Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases
metadata.summary: This notification re-constitutes the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC) with a mandate to examine cases for fresh legislation and amendments. It further assigns an additional task to the CCLC to dispose of cases relating to rules to be framed or amended by the Federal Government.

name: No. F. 4(7)/2015-Cab. — Expansion of the Mandate of the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC) to Examine and Dispose of Rules Framed or Amended by the Federal Government

metadata.title: Notification No. F. 4(7)/2015-Cab.
subjects: Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases
metadata.summary: This notification re-constitutes the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC) with a mandate to examine cases of fresh legislation and amendments to existing laws. It further assigns an additional task to the CCLC to dispose of cases relating to rules to be framed or amended by the Federal Government.

name: The Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2017

metadata.title: Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the incorporation, regulation, and winding up of limited liability partnerships as body corporates in Pakistan. It establishes these entities as separate legal persons with perpetual succession, distinct from their partners.

name: The Public Offering Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Public Offering Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the process of issuing securities to the general public by public limited companies and other bodies. They define key terms related to bids, book building, and various roles such as underwriters and bankers to an issue within the context of the Securities Act, 2015.

name: The Public Offering (Regulated Securities Activities Licensing) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Public Offering (Regulated Securities Activities Licensing) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for licensing persons carrying out regulated securities activities in Pakistan, including roles as bankers to an issue, consultants, underwriters, and debt securities trustees. They define key terms related to these activities and set forth prohibitions against unlicensed individuals performing such functions.

name: The Pakistan Council for Science and Technology Act, 2017

metadata.title: Pakistan Council for Science and Technology Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Council for Science and Technology as a body corporate to advise the Federal Government on national policies regarding science, technology, and innovation. The Council is empowered to conduct policy research, formulate proposals, maintain databases, and promote collaboration between academia, industry, and international organizations.

name: The Centralized Customer Protection Compensation Fund Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Centralized Customer Protection Compensation Fund Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish a centralized customer protection compensation fund to be operated by securities exchanges in Pakistan. The document outlines the definitions, provisions for the fund's establishment, methods for determining its minimum size, sources of contributions, and procedures for settling customer claims arising from defaulters.

name: The Voluntary Pension System Rules, 2005

metadata.title: The Voluntary Pension System Rules, 2005
metadata.summary: This document contains amendments to the Voluntary Pension System Rules, 2005, issued by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan with Federal Government approval. The specific notification (S.R.O. 300 (I)/2017) dated April 28th, 2017, directs further amendments to be made in the existing rules.

name: The Securities and Futures Advisers (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: Securities and Futures Advisers (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the licensing and operational requirements for securities advisers and futures advisers in Pakistan. They define key terms such as advertisements, asset management companies, and non-banking finance companies within the context of these regulations.

name: Housing Finance Prudential Regulations

metadata.title: Housing Finance Prudential Regulations
metadata.summary: These regulations establish a separate set of prudential rules specifically for housing finance issued by the State Bank of Pakistan to facilitate banks and DFIs in enhancing their housing finance portfolios. The document outlines requirements for risk assessment, internal policy frameworks, and minimum standards that financial institutions must follow when providing financing for residential construction or purchase.

name: Draft- The Futures Exchanges (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Futures Exchanges (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: This document publishes the draft of the Futures Exchanges (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2017, made by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. It invites objections or suggestions from the public within fourteen days regarding the proposed regulations before they are finalized.

name: The Pakistan Climate Change Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Pakistan Climate Change Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act is enacted to meet Pakistan's obligations under international climate change conventions and to address the effects of climate change. It provides for the establishment of comprehensive adaptation and mitigation policies, plans, programmes, projects, and other necessary measures.

name: The Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of Commissions of Inquiry by the Federal Government to investigate matters of public importance. It grants these commissions specific powers, including summoning witnesses, seizing documents, ordering police investigations, and punishing contempt.

name: The Public Private Partnership Authority Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Public Private Partnership Authority Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a regulatory framework to facilitate public private partnerships in Pakistan for infrastructure development. It creates an independent Public Private Partnership Authority and defines terms related to agreements, implementing agencies, and project proposals.

name: The Provisions of the Corporate Restructuring Companies Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Corporate Restructuring Companies Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This notification appoints February 7, 2017, as the date when all provisions of the Corporate Restructuring Companies Act, 2016 come into force. The exception is section 1 of the said Act, which does not take effect on this date.

name: The Hindu Marriage Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Hindu Marriage Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the solemnization of marriages by Hindu families and addresses matters ancillary and incidental thereto. It establishes conditions for marriage, registration procedures, and the appointment of marriage registrars within specific provinces and the Islamabad Capital Territory.

name: The Pakistan National Accreditation Council Act, 2017

metadata.title: Pakistan National Accreditation Council Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan National Accreditation Council to oversee the accreditation of conformity assessment bodies. It aims to improve the quality of products, services, and management systems in alignment with national and international standards for sustainable socio-economic development.

name: No. 138 - No. F.10(2)/2015-HRM(40) - Cessation of Molana Abdul Ghafoor Haideri from acting as Chairman of the Senate

metadata.title: Notification on the return of Mian Raza Rabbani
metadata.summary: This notification announces the cessation of Molana Abdul Ghafoor Haideri's acting role as Chairman Senate. This change took effect upon the return of Mian Raza Rabbani from abroad on March 3, 2017.

name: No. 137 - No. 3-3/2013-Min-I - Designation of Sardar Mehtab Ahmed Khan as Adviser to the Prime Minister on Aviation

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-3/2013-Min-I
metadata.summary: This notification designates Sardar Mehtab Ahmed Khan as Adviser to the Prime Minister on Aviation with the status of Federal Minister. A subsequent corrigendum corrects his name by removing the surname 'Abbasi'.

name: No. 3-3/2013-Min-I — Designation of Sardar Mehtab Ahmed Khan as Adviser to the Prime Minister on Aviation with the Status of Federal Minister

name: The Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act, 2017

metadata.title: Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits holding property in benami names and restricts the right to recover or transfer such properties. It establishes a mechanism and procedure for the confiscation of benami property along with related matters.

name: The Insurance Rules, 2017

metadata.title: The Insurance Rules, 2017
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan under the Insurance Ordinance, 2000 to regulate insurance business in Pakistan. They define key terms such as agents and related parties, set qualifications for actuaries, classify restricted types of insurance business, and specify requirements for applications for insurer registration.

name: No. 2-1/2017-Min-I (ii) — Grant of Five Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Barrister Zafarullah Khan, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Law (4–8 February 2017)

metadata.title: null
metadata.summary: This notification grants five days of Ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Zafarullah Khan, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Law. The order was issued by the Prime Minister and published in the Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary on February 8, 2017.

name: The Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies (Non-Textile) Order, 2017

metadata.title: Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies (Non-Textile) Order, 2017
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the drawback of local taxes and levies on non-textile exports from Pakistan. It specifies eligibility criteria for manufacturing-cum-exporting units, defines key terms such as 'DGTO' and 'SBP', and outlines the procedure for filing claims through authorized banks.

name: The Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies 2016-17

metadata.title: Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies 2016-17
metadata.summary: This Order provides drawback benefits on local taxes and levies for manufacturing-cum-exporting units in the textile sector. It outlines eligibility criteria, claim procedures involving associations and banks, and establishes penalties for fraudulent claims.

name: No. 135 - No. 2-1-2017-Min-I- Grant of leave to Mian Riaz Hussain Pirzada, Minister for Inter Provincial Coordination

name: No. 3-3/2016-Min-II — Death of Mr. Saiduzzaman Siddiqui, Governor of Sindh

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-3/2016-Min-II
metadata.summary: This notification announces the death of Mr. Saiduzzaman Siddiqui, the Governor of Sindh, on January 11, 2017. It expresses the Government of Pakistan's appreciation for his services and extends condolences to his bereaved family.

name: No. 134 - No. S.R.O. 10(KE)/2017 - Technology Upgradation Fund (TUF) Order 2016 to support investment in Textile Machinery and Technology

metadata.title: Technology Upgradation Fund (TUF) Order 2016 for Textile Sector
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Technology Upgradation Fund scheme to support investment in upgrading textile machinery and technology. It provides one-time financial support for purchasing and installing new imported machinery while defining eligibility criteria, definitions, and specific restrictions for manufacturers.

name: The Technology Upgradation Fund (TUF) Order 2016 for Textile Sector

metadata.title: Technology Upgradation Fund (TUF) Order 2016 for Textile Sector
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Technology Upgradation Fund (TUF) Scheme to support investment for upgrading textile machinery and technology. It provides one-time financial support to eligible manufacturers for purchasing and installing new imported machinery, aiming to improve technological configuration and increase overall investment in the sector.

name: The Debt Securities Trustees Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Debt Securities Trustees Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for licensing and regulating debt securities trustees in Pakistan. They define eligibility criteria, application procedures, and operational requirements for persons acting as debt securities trustees under the Securities Act, 2015.

name: The Competition Commission (Duties and Responsibilities of Registrar) Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: Competition Commission (Duties and Responsibilities of Registrar) Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: This regulation outlines the duties, responsibilities, and powers of the Registrar of the Competition Commission of Pakistan. It establishes the organizational setup for the Registrar's office and details specific functions such as receiving applications, maintaining records, and issuing notices.

name: The Competition (Merger Control) Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: The Competition (Merger Control) Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for merger control within Pakistan, defining key terms such as acquisition, amalgamation, and intended mergers. They specify the circumstances under which a merger is deemed to have occurred and apply to all undertakings involved in mergers doing business in Pakistan.

name: No. 129 - No. 9-12/2014.DDC(P)(Vol-III) - Addition of under-mentioned molecules to the Schedule of the Drug Pricing Policy

metadata.title: Notification adding molecules to the Drug Pricing Policy 2015
metadata.summary: This notification adds specific biological drug molecules to the Drug Pricing Policy 2015 under Schedule II. It lists new entries including Aflibercept, Belimumab, and others with their respective therapeutic uses and indications.

name: F. No. 9-12/2014-DDC(P)(Vol-III) — Addition of Molecules to the Schedule of the Drug Pricing Policy, 2015

metadata.title: Notification adding molecules to the Drug Pricing Policy-2015
metadata.summary: This notification adds specific biological drug molecules to the schedule of the Drug Pricing Policy-2015. The document lists new entries with their designated prices and therapeutic indications for inclusion in the official pricing list.

name: The Plant Breeders Rights Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Plant Breeders' Rights Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act encourages the development of new plant varieties and protects the rights of breeders in Pakistan. It provides provisions for scientific researchers and farmers while ensuring compliance with international TRIPS agreements regarding plant variety protection.

name: No. 2-1/2015-Min-I — Grant of Four Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Senator Kamran Michael, Minister for Human Rights (12–15 December 2016

metadata.title: Notification granting leave to Senator Kamran Michael
metadata.summary: This notification grants four days of ex-Pakistan leave to Senator Kamran Michael, who serves as the Minister for Human Rights. The leave is effective from December 12, 2016, to December 15, 2016.

name: No. 9/1/2016-Imp.I — Constitution of a Committee for Strengthening the Federal Government Artists Welfare Fund

metadata.title: Notification constituting a committee to explore ways and means to enhance the Federal Government Artists Welfare Fund
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a committee to explore ways and means to enhance the Federal Government Artists Welfare Fund. The committee is chaired by the Secretary, Cabinet Division, with members from the Finance Division and President Secretariat.

name: No. 136 - No. S.R.O. 17(KE)/2017 - Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies 2016-17 Order for the Textile Sector

metadata.title: Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies 2016-17
metadata.summary: This Order provides drawback benefits for manufacturing-cum-exporting units in Pakistan on exports exceeding a 10% increase over the previous year. It outlines eligibility criteria, claim procedures involving textile associations and the State Bank of Pakistan, and establishes penalties for fraudulent claims.

name: No. 3-8/2013-Min.II — Permission for Official Visit of the Governor of Balochistan to China

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-8/2013-Min. I1
metadata.summary: This notification grants permission to the Governor of Balochistan to undertake an official visit to China from November 14 to 23, 2016. During this absence, the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly is authorized to perform the Governor's functions under Article 104 of the Constitution.

name: No. 128 - No. S.R.O. 1206(I)/2016 - Terms and conditions for appointment of Chief Editor, Urdu Dictionary Board, Karachi

metadata.title: S.R.O. 1206(I)/2016
metadata.summary: This notification lays down the terms and conditions for the appointment of the Chief Editor of the Urdu Dictionary Board, Karachi. It outlines the method of appointment via promotion or initial appointment, the composition of search and selection committees, and the prerequisites required for the position.

name: No. F. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Appointment of Mr. Sherjeel Adnan Sheikh as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Constitutional Affairs

metadata.title: Notification appointing Mr. Sherjeel Adnan Sheikh as Special assistant to the Prime Minister on Constitutional Affairs
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Sherjeel Adnan Sheikh as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Constitutional Affairs with immediate effect. The appointment was made by the Prime Minister under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. F. 1(1)/2016-SW&SE — Closure of the Devolution Section of the Ministry of Social Welfare & Special Education

metadata.title: Notification No. F. 1 (1)/2016-SW&SE
metadata.summary: This notification announces the immediate closure of the Devolution Section within the defunct Ministry of Social Welfare & Special Education. It further stipulates that residual matters, including employee issues and legal cases from the defunct ministry, will be handled by the concerned Ministries or Divisions to whom functions were assigned under the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 5/2/2013-Com. — Appointment of Mir Hazar Khan Bijarani as ECNEC Member Representing Sindh

metadata.title: Notification approving the nomination of Mir Hazar Khan Bijarani as Member of ECNEC
metadata.summary: This notification approves the nomination of Mir Hazar Khan Bijarani as a Member of the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC) representing Sindh. The appointment replaces Syed Murad Ali Shah and was made by the Prime Minister on the advice of the Cabinet Division.

name: No. F.1(1)/2016-Devo.Cell — Closure of the Devolution Section of the Ministry of Special Initiatives

metadata.title: Notification No. F.1 (1)/2016-Devo.Cell
metadata.summary: This notification announces the immediate closure of the Devolution Section within the defunct Ministry of Special Initiatives. It further stipulates that residual matters, including employee issues and legal cases, will be handled by concerned Ministries or Divisions assigned these functions under the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. F. 4-7/2015-Cab. — Reconstitution of the Cabinet Committee for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC)

metadata.title: Notification reconstitution of the Standing Committee of the Cabinet for Disposal of Legislative Cases
metadata.summary: This notification reconstitutes the Standing Committee of the Cabinet for Disposal of Legislative Cases (CCLC) with a specific composition of members. The committee is tasked with examining fresh legislation and amendments to existing laws before recommending them to the Cabinet.

name: The Companies Ordinance, 2016

metadata.title: The Companies Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reforms and re-enacts the law relating to companies in Pakistan. It aims to facilitate corporatisation, promote the corporate sector, and regulate entities while protecting stakeholder interests.

name: The Members Election of the Commission (Salary, Allowances, Perks and Privileges) Act, 2016

metadata.title: Members of the Election Commission (Salary, Allowances, Perks and Privileges) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salary, allowances, perks, and privileges of the members of the Election Commission of Pakistan. It stipulates that these benefits shall be equivalent to those admissible to a Judge of a High Court.

name: The Credit Bureaus Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: Credit Bureaus Regulations
metadata.summary: These regulations are issued by the State Bank of Pakistan under powers conferred by Section 43 of the Credit Bureaus Act, 2015. They establish governance requirements for credit bureaus, including fitness and propriety tests for key personnel, board composition rules, and restrictions on shareholding by financial institutions.

name: No. 3-2/2016-Min.II — Grant of Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mr. Iqbal Zafar Jhagra, Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Authorization of the Speaker to Perform the Functions of Governor

metadata.title: Governors' Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Order, 1975
metadata.summary: This notification grants ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Iqbal Zafar Jhagra, Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, from August 18 to August 23, 2016, to proceed to Abu Dhabi. During his absence, the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly is authorized to perform the functions of the Governor under Article 104 of the Constitution.

name: The Deposit Protection Corporation Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Deposit Protection Corporation Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Deposit Protection Corporation as a subsidiary of the State Bank of Pakistan to protect small depositors and ensure financial stability. It outlines the Corporation's functions, including collecting premiums from member institutions and compensating depositors in the event of a failed institution.

name: The Clearing Houses (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: The Clearing Houses (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for licensing and operating clearing houses in Pakistan. They define key terms, outline the application process including fees and required documents, and set compliance requirements under the Securities Act, 2015 and the Futures Market Act, 2016.

name: Prudential Regulations for Consumer Financing

metadata.title: Prudential Regulations for Consumer Financing
metadata.summary: This document presents an updated version of the Prudential Regulations for Consumer Financing issued by the State Bank of Pakistan, incorporating amendments made between January 31, 2011, and June 30, 2016. It covers risk management and operational aspects related to consumer financing facilities such as credit cards, auto loans, and personal loans.

name: The Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies (Non-Textile) Order, 2016

metadata.title: The Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies (Non-Textile) Order, 2016
metadata.amends: The Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies (Non-Textile) Order, 2015
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the drawback of local taxes and levies on non-textile exports made during the financial years 2015-16 and 2016-17. It establishes eligibility criteria based on enhanced export performance exceeding ten percent and outlines the roles of associations, chambers, and relevant government departments in verifying claims.

name: The Support for Plant and Machinery for Agro Processing (SME) Order, 2016

metadata.title: Support for Plant and Machinery for Agro Processing (SME) Order, 2016
metadata.summary: This Order provides financial incentives for the import of new plant and machinery used in agro-processing sectors. It offers a hundred percent markup support on costs nationwide, with fifty percent support specifically for underdeveloped regions like Rural Sindh and Balochistan.

name: The Technology Up-Gradation Fund Order, 2016

metadata.title: The Technology Up-Gradation Fund Order, 2016
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Technology Up-Gradation Fund to provide financial benefits for the import of new plant and machinery required for technology upgradation in specific sectors. It outlines eligibility criteria for manufacturers, including tax compliance and restrictions on concurrent financing schemes, while defining the roles of trade associations and authorized banks in verifying claims.

name: The Brand and Certification Development Support order 2016

metadata.title: Brand and Certification Development Support order 2016
metadata.summary: This order facilitates intellectual property registration for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in the export sector of Pakistan. It establishes eligibility criteria, defines roles for associations and the Intellectual Property Organization, and outlines procedures for claiming brand registration fees through nominated banks.

name: The Product Development Incentive Order, 2016

metadata.title: The Product Development Incentive Order, 2016
metadata.summary: This Order provides a fifty per cent matching grant of up to five million rupees for specified plant and machinery to improve product design and encourage innovation in SMEs and export sectors. It establishes eligibility criteria, defines key terms such as 'manufacturer' and 'SME', and outlines the roles of trade associations in verifying claims and ensuring compliance with financing restrictions.

name: The Corporate Restructuring Companies Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Corporate Restructuring Companies Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and regulates corporate restructuring companies in Pakistan. It defines the business scope of these companies, which includes managing non-performing assets and restructuring distressed commercial entities.

name: The Financial Institutions (Secured Transactions) Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Financial Institutions (Secured Transactions) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the creation of security interests over movable property to secure obligations owed by customers to financial institutions. It also establishes a secured transactions registry and aims to clarify, expand, define, amend, and codify laws relating to these security interests.

name: The National Energy Efficiency and Conservation Act, 2016

metadata.title: National Energy Efficiency and Conservation Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes institutions and mechanisms to ensure the effective conservation and efficient use of energy in Pakistan. It defines key terms related to energy sectors, audits, and authorities necessary for implementing these procedures.

name: The Finance Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2016. It also amends specific provisions in the Customs Act, 1969 and the Sales Tax Act, 1990.

name: All Provisions of the Futures Market Act, 2016 Except PART IV Come into Force

metadata.title: The Futures Market Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This notification appoints June 15, 2016, as the date for the commencement of provisions under the Futures Market Act, 2016. It specifies that PART IV of the Act will not come into force on this date.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Wheeling of Electric Power) Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Wheeling of Electric Power) Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: This document contains the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Wheeling of Electric Power) Regulations, 2016. It was issued by NEPRA to facilitate the wheeling of power services for transmission licensees and distribution companies.

name: The Equity Participation Fund (Repeal) Act, 2016

metadata.title: Equity Participation Fund (Repeal) Act, 2016
metadata.repeals: Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970. It received the assent of the President on May 4, 2016, and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Inland Revenue Reward Rules, 2016

metadata.title: The Inland Revenue Reward Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules establish a framework for registering informers who provide evidence leading to the detection and recovery of evaded taxes. They define eligibility criteria, registration procedures, and the process for submitting information regarding tax evasion, fraud, or corruption.

name: No. 2-1/2015-Min-I — Reduction in Ex-Pakistan Leave Period Availed by Mr. Imtiaz Ahmed Shaikh

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-1/2015-Min-I.
metadata.amends: Notification of even number dated 30th March, 2016
subjects: Special Assistant to the Prime Minister
metadata.summary: This notification from the Cabinet Secretariat supersedes a previous order regarding Mr. Imtiaz Ahmed Shaikh's leave entitlement. It specifies that he availed only two days of ex-Pakistan leave instead of the originally granted seven days for the period in March 2016.

name: Draft- The Valuers Registration and Governance Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: The Valuers Registration and Governance Regulations, 2016
subjects: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This document publishes draft regulations proposed by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan for the registration and governance of valuers. It establishes eligibility criteria, defines key terms such as 'Valuer' and 'Misconduct', and categorizes valuers into five specific panels based on the types of assets they are authorized to evaluate.

name: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Conversion Act, 2016

metadata.title: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conversion of the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation into a public limited company under the Companies Ordinance, 1984. It deems the Corporation to have been converted into a public company effective from the date of promulgation, transferring all assets and liabilities without further registration.

name: The Futures Market Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Futures Market Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the futures market and matters connected therewith. It defines key terms such as 'accredited', 'associate', 'clearing house', and 'commodity' to establish a legal framework for trading activities.

name: The Licensed Persons (Obligation under Voluntary Winding-up) Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: The Licensed Persons (Obligation under Voluntary Winding-up) Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: These Regulations prescribe the procedure for licensed persons to satisfy the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding investor claims before filing a winding-up petition. They establish requirements for obtaining prior approval from the Commission, including necessary documents and certificates from exchanges and clearing houses.

name: The State Life Insurance Corporation (Re-Organization and conversion) Ordinance, 2016

metadata.title: State Life Insurance Corporation (Re-organization and Conversion) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the re-organization and conversion of the State Life Insurance Corporation into a public limited company known as the State Life Insurance Company Limited. It facilitates the incorporation of this new entity under the Companies Ordinance, 1984, and mandates the transfer of all assets, liabilities, contracts, and policies from the former corporation to the new company.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Re-designation of Barrister Zafarullah Khan from Human Rights Division to Law

metadata.title: Notification re-designating Barrister Zafarullah Khan
metadata.summary: This notification re-designates Barrister Zafarullah Khan from Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Human Rights Division to Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Law. The appointment carries the status of a Minister of State and takes effect immediately.

name: No. 2-1/2015-Min-I — Grant of Seven Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mr. Imtiaz Ahmed Shaikh, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister (25–31 March 2016)

metadata.title: Notification granting leave to Mr. Imtiaz Ahmed Shaikh
metadata.summary: This notification grants seven days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Imtiaz Ahmed Shaikh, who serves as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister. The leave period is specified from March 25th to March 31st, 2016.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Cessation of Office of Mr. Ashtar Ausaf Ali as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Law with the Status of Minister of State

metadata.title: The Gazette of Pakistan, Extra., April 2, 2016
metadata.summary: This order directs that Mr. Ashtar Ausaf Ali shall immediately cease to hold the office of Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Law with the status of Minister of State. The directive is issued by the Prime Minister in exercise of powers under the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 2-5/2013-Min-I — Cessation of Additional Charge of Law and Justice Held by Mr. Pervaiz Rashid

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-5/2013-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification records the decision by the Prime Minister regarding ministerial portfolios. It specifies that Mr. Pervaiz Rashid, who serves as the Minister for Information, Broadcasting and National Heritage, shall cease to hold the additional charge of Law and Justice immediately.

name: No. 2-5/2013-Min-I — Re-designation of Mr. Zahid Hamid from Minister for Climate Change to Minister for Law and Justice

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-5/2013-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification re-designates Mr. Zahid Hamid as the Minister for Law and Justice with immediate effect, while he temporarily retains the additional portfolio of Climate Change. Consequently, he ceases to hold the additional portfolio of Human Rights.

name: The Publication of Laws of Pakistan Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Publication of Laws of Pakistan Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act ensures the publication of the text of the laws of Pakistan is free from errors of reproduction, updating, and printing. It establishes a Cell to review proposed publications and registers publishers, while exempting public sector organizations and legislatures from registration but requiring them to issue certificates of accuracy.

name: The Pakistan Health Research Council Act, 2016

metadata.title: Pakistan Health Research Council Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution and reorganization of the Pakistan Medical Research Council, renaming it the Pakistan Health Research Council. It grants the new body administrative and financial autonomy to function efficiently in promoting health research across various medical fields.

name: S.R.O. 253(I)/2016 – Amendment in Functions and Jurisdiction of DG Intelligence & Investigation (Amendment of S.R.O. 117(I)/2015)

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 253(I)/2016
metadata.summary: This notification directs amendments to Notification S.R.O. 117(1)/2015 issued by the Federal Board of Revenue. The changes involve inserting specific expressions regarding 'Large Taxpayers Unit-II, Karachi' into a table within the referenced notification.

name: S.R.O. 252(1)/2016 – Amendments to S.R.O. 116(1)/2015 under Sales Tax Act, 1990

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 252(1)/2016
metadata.summary: This notification amends Notification S.R.O. 116(1)/2015 regarding sales tax on rents. It directs the insertion of 'Large Taxpayers Unit-II, Karachi' into specific entries within the relevant table.

name: The Gas (Theft Control and Recovery) Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Gas (Theft Control and Recovery) Act
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prosecution of cases involving gas theft and other offences related to gas. It also establishes a procedure for the expeditious recovery of amounts due, including fines, penalties, and outstanding sums payable to Gas Utility Companies.

name: The Telecommunication Consumer Protection (Amendment) Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: Telecommunication Consumer Protection (Amendment) Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: This document amends the Telecommunication Consumer Protection Regulations, 2009 by inserting new clauses and a new regulation regarding commercial practices. It defines terms such as 'Cost of Subscription', 'Permissible Incentives', and 'Lottery' while establishing requirements for operators to provide prior information to the Authority before launching promotional schemes.

name: No. F. 1-9/2015-DC(YA) — Closure of the Devolution Section of the Ministry of Youth Affairs

metadata.title: Notification No. F. 1-9/2015-DC(YA)
metadata.summary: This notification announces the immediate closure of the Devolution Section within the defunct Ministry of Youth Affairs. It further stipulates that residual matters, including employee issues and legal cases, will be handled by the concerned Ministries or Divisions to whom the devolved functions have been assigned under the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. F. 1(1)/2015-Legis — Vacation of Senate Seat of Senator Iqbal Zafar Jhagra upon Appointment as Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

metadata.title: Notification regarding vacancy of Senator Iqbal Zafar Jhagra
metadata.summary: This notification declares the seat of Senator Iqbal Zafar Jhagra in the Senate as vacant. The vacancy occurred due to his appointment as Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, effective from March 4, 2016.

name: The Pakistan Halal Authority Act, 2016

metadata.title: The Pakistan Halal Authority Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Halal Authority to promote trade, commerce, and exports of Halal articles and processes. It defines key terms related to Halal certification, standards, and the composition of the governing Board.

name: No. 2-1/2015-Min-I — Grant of Seven Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mr. Muhammad Baligh-ur-Rehman, Minister of State for Federal Education & Professional Training and Interior & Narcotics Control (27 February–4 March 2016)

metadata.title: Notification granting leave to Mr. Muhammad Baligh-ur-Rehman
metadata.summary: This notification grants seven days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Muhammad Baligh-ur-Rehman, who serves as Minister of State for Federal Education & Professional Training and Interior & Narcotics Control. The leave is effective from February 27th to March 4th, 2016.

name: No. 1/1/2015-Awards-I — Conferment of Civil Awards by the President of Pakistan (Independence Day 2015)

metadata.title: Notification No. 1/1/2015-Awards-I
metadata.summary: This notification confers civil awards on Pakistani and foreign dignitaries for the occasion of Independence Day, 2015. The awards are scheduled to be decorated on March 23, 2016.

name: The Central Depositories (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: Central Depositories (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: This document establishes the Central Depositories (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016, made by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan under the Securities Act, 2015. It outlines the procedures for applying for a license to operate as a central depository, including required fees, documentation, and eligibility criteria. The regulations also specify conditions that must be met on an ongoing basis for maintaining a license.

name: No. 3-1/2014-Min-II — Acceptance of Resignation of Sardar Mehtab Ahmad Khan as Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-1/2014-Min-II
metadata.summary: This notification records the acceptance of the resignation tendered by Sardar Mehtab Ahmad Khan from the office of Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It further directs that the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly shall perform the functions of the Governor until a new appointment is made.

name: The Islamabad Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Act, 2016

metadata.title: Islamabad Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad Subordinate Judiciary Service Tribunal to handle matters regarding the terms and conditions of service for members of the subordinate judiciary in the Islamabad Capital Territory. The Tribunal has exclusive jurisdiction over these issues, including disciplinary actions, and possesses powers similar to a civil court to enforce attendance, compel document production, and examine witnesses.

name: The Companies (E-Voting) Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: The Companies (E-Voting) Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for listed companies in Pakistan to conduct general meetings using electronic voting systems managed by authorized intermediaries. They define key terms such as 'e-voting', 'Intermediary', and 'cyber security', and set out eligibility requirements for intermediaries, including security standards and accreditation certificates.

name: No. 2-1/2015-Min-I — Grant of Eight Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mr. Imtiaz Ahmed Shaikh, Special Assistant to the Prime Minister

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-1/2015-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification grants eight days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Imtiaz Ahmed Shaikh, who serves as the Special Assistant to the Prime Minister. The leave period is specified from January 15th to January 22nd, 2016.

name: The Bankers to an Issue of Securities Rules, 2015 Draft

metadata.title: The Bankers to an Issue of Securities Rules, 2015
metadata.summary: This document publishes the draft of the Bankers to an Issue of Securities Rules, 2015 for public information and solicits objections or suggestions within thirty days. The rules establish the framework for licensing banks to act as bankers to an issue, defining eligibility criteria such as being a scheduled bank with presence in all provinces and having an e-IPO system.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Interconnection for Renewable Generation Facilities) Regulation, 2015

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Interconnection for Renewable Generation Facilities) Regulation, 2015
metadata.summary: This regulation facilitates the interconnection of renewable energy projects with electrical networks managed by distribution or transmission companies. It establishes specific technical criteria, voltage levels, and loss limits for connecting facilities ranging from small hydro to wind and solar projects.

name: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Conversion Ordinance, 2015

metadata.title: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Conversion) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conversion of the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation into a public limited company. It deems the Corporation to have been converted into a public company effective from the date of promulgation, transferring all assets and liabilities without further conveyance.

name: The NEPRA (Supply of Electric Power) Regulations, 2015

metadata.title: NEPRA (Supply of Electric Power) Regulations, 2015
metadata.summary: These regulations establish a framework for regulating the supply of electric power by Distribution Companies to other entities under O&M Agreements. They define key terms related to distribution, generation, and authorized agents within the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority's jurisdiction.

name: The National University of Medical Sciences Act, 2015

metadata.title: National University of Medical Sciences Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National University of Medical Sciences and provides for matters connected therewith. It defines various terms related to the university's structure, including its Academic Council, Board of Governors, Chancellor, and affiliated colleges.

name: The Reporting and Disclosure (of Shareholding by Directors, Executive Officers and Substantial Shareholders in Listed Companies) Regulations, 2015

metadata.title: The Reporting and Disclosure (of Shareholding by Directors, Executive Officers and Substantial Shareholders in Listed Companies) Regulations, 2015
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the reporting and disclosure requirements for beneficial ownership of equity securities by directors, executive officers, and substantial shareholders in listed companies. They specify the forms to be used for notifying changes in shareholding, maintaining registers of director interests, and reporting gains from short-term trading.

name: The Capital University of Science and Technology Act, 2015

metadata.title: Capital University of Science and Technology Act, 2015
subjects: Capital University of Science and Technology
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Capital University of Science and Technology at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, including the Patron, Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and Board of Governors.

name: The Salary of Judges of the High Court Order, 2015

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2015
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary rates for the Chief Justice and other Judges of High Courts in Pakistan. It specifies a monthly salary of Rs. 648,436 for the Chief Justice and Rs. 623,497 for other judges, effective from July 1, 2015.

name: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2015

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2015
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2015 (P.O. No. 2 of 2015)
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the salaries for the Chief Justice of Pakistan and other Judges of the Supreme Court, effective from July 1, 2015. It simultaneously repeals the application of the Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2015 to Supreme Court judges.

name: The National Tariff Commission Act, 2015

metadata.title: The National Tariff Commission Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The National Tariff Commission Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act reforms and repeals the National Tariff Commission Act, 1990 to establish a reconstituted National Tariff Commission. It defines the qualifications for members, outlines their terms of office, and specifies the Commission's functions regarding trade measures and domestic industry assistance.

name: The Anti-Dumping Duties Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Anti-Dumping Duties Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Anti-Dumping Duties Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act reforms and repeals the Anti-Dumping Duties Ordinance, 2000 to align Pakistani law with WTO provisions regarding anti-dumping duties. It establishes a framework for investigating dumping and injury related to goods imported into Pakistan.

name: The Countervailing Duties Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Countervailing Duties Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act reforms and repeals the Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2001 to align Pakistani law with WTO agreements on subsidies. It establishes a framework for investigating subsidies and imposing countervailing duties to offset injurious subsidization on imported goods.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Alternative & Renewable Energy) Distributed Generation and Net Metering Regulations, 2015

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Alternative & Renewable Energy) Distributed Generation and Net Metering Regulations, 2015
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish a framework for regulating distributed generation using alternative and renewable energy sources, specifically solar and wind. They also set out the rules for net metering practices within the distribution system of licensed companies.

name: The Credit Bureaus Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Credit Bureaus Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the incorporation and functioning of credit bureaus in Pakistan to collect and disseminate credit information regarding debtors. It defines key terms such as 'credit bureau', 'credit institution', and 'adverse action' to facilitate efficient credit distribution.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Act, 2015

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an elected local government system for the Islamabad Capital Territory to devolve political, administrative, and financial responsibilities. It aims to promote good governance, effective service delivery, and transparent decision-making through institutionalized public participation at the local level.

name: The Competition Appellate Tribunal Rules, 2015

metadata.title: The Competition Appellate Tribunal Rules, 2015
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedural framework for filing appeals before the Competition Appellate Tribunal under the Competition Act, 2010. They define key terms such as 'authorized representative' and 'impugned order', specify requirements for submitting appeal memorandums including language and formatting, and set a sixty-day limitation period for lodging appeals.

name: The Book Building Regulations, 2015

metadata.title: The Book Building Regulations, 2015
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for conducting public offerings of shares through the book building process in Pakistan. They define key terms such as eligible investors, bid prices, and the roles of issuers and book runners to regulate share subscription.

name: The Sales Tax Special Procedure (Withholding) Rules, 2007 Updated upto 30-06-2015

metadata.title: The Sales Tax Special Procedure (Withholding) Rules, 2007
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for withholding agents to deduct and deposit sales tax on purchases of taxable goods and services. They specify the responsibilities of withholding agents, registered suppliers, and collectors regarding the deduction amounts and payment balances.

name: The Finance Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2015
metadata.amends: Customs Act, 1969; Workers Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971; Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 2015. It amends several existing laws, including the Customs Act, 1969, regarding exemptions for national security and transhipment rules, as well as updating salaries in the Members of Parliament Act.

name: The Trade Development Authority of Pakistan, Financial Rules, 2014

metadata.title: Trade Development Authority of Pakistan, Financial Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules establish the financial procedures and definitions for the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan (TDAP). They define key terms such as 'Accounts', 'Audit', and various officer roles to ensure proper recording and maintenance of financial transactions in accordance with the TDAP Act, 2013.

name: The TDAP Service Rules, 2014

metadata.title: TDAP Service Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: This document notifies the Service Rules and Financial Rules made by the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan (TDAP) under Section 35 of the TDAP Act, 2013. The rules regulate and improve the employment and service conditions for all employees working in the Authority, including officers, civil servants, and contract employees.

name: The Federal Services Medical Attendance Rules, 1990

metadata.title: The Federal Services Medical Attendance Rules, 1990
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the conditions for medical attendance and treatment for government servants in Pakistan. They define eligible personnel, authorized medical officers, and the scope of services including hospitalization, diagnostics, and medicines available at government hospitals.

name: S. R. O. 479(I)/2015 — Amendment in Notification S.R.O. 116(I)/2015 under the Sales Tax Act, 1990

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. No. 479(1)/2015
metadata.summary: This notification amends Notification S.R.O. No. 116(I)/2015 by adding a new entry regarding specific sections and classes of persons assigned to the Deputy Director or Commissioner Intelligence & Investigation (IR). The amendment is issued by the Federal Board of Revenue under powers conferred by the Sales Tax Act, 1990.

name: S. R. O. 478(I)/2015 — Amendment in S.R.O. No. 117(I)/2015

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. No. 478(1)/2015
metadata.summary: This notification amends Notification S.R.O. No. 117(I)/2015 by adding a new entry to the table of dutiable goods under the Federal Excise Act, 2005. The amendment updates the classification details for Deputy Director or Commissioner Assistant or Assistant Director-III, Commissioner Intelligence & Investigation (Inland Revenue) and assigns specific sections and classes of persons.

name: S. R. O. 481(I)/2015 — Levy of Federal Excise Duty on Specified Goods at Fixed Rates

metadata.title: S. R. O. 481 (I)/2015
metadata.summary: This notification directs the Federal Board of Revenue to levy and collect excise duty on locally produced cigarettes based on their retail price. It specifies different duty rates for cigarettes with a retail price exceeding Rs. 3,350 per thousand versus those not exceeding that amount.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Market Operator Registration, Standards and Procedure) Rules, 2015

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Market Operator Registration, Standards and Procedure) Rules, 2015
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for registering market operators under the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority. They define key terms related to power market operations, including the roles of the system operator and transmission company, and outline the application process and eligibility criteria for registration.

name: The Gas Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Gas Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the validation, imposition, levy, and collection of a development cess on natural gas in Pakistan. It specifies that the collected funds shall be utilized for infrastructure projects such as the Iran-Pakistan Pipeline and TAPI.

name: The Securities Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Securities Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates laws for the regulation of the securities industry and the protection of investors. It defines key terms such as 'associated', 'auditor', 'bank', and 'Commission' to establish a comprehensive legal framework.

name: The Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies Order, 2015

metadata.title: Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies Order, 2015
metadata.amends: Drawback of Local Taxes and Levies Order, 2015 (Notification No. S.R.O. 177 (1)/2015)
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the drawback of local taxes and levies on enhanced exports of specific products at a rate of 4% of their FOB value. It outlines eligibility criteria, the role of associations in verifying claims, and the procedural steps exporters and banks must follow to submit and receive payments.

name: The Publications of Laws of Pakistan (Regulation) Ordinance, 2015

metadata.title: The Publication of Laws of Pakistan (Regulation) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a regulatory framework to ensure the publication of laws in Pakistan is free from errors of reproduction, updating, and printing. It creates a specific 'Laws of Pakistan Cell' within the Federal Government to register publishers, review proposed publications, and certify their accuracy before issuance.

name: The General Election 2013 Inquiry Commission Ordinance, 2015

metadata.title: General Elections 2013 Inquiry Commission Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a judicial commission comprising three Supreme Court judges to inquire into the organization and conduct of the General Elections 2013. The Commission is empowered to determine if the elections were impartial, free from manipulation, and if the results reflected the true mandate of the electorate.

name: The Underwriters Rules, 2015

metadata.title: the underwriters Rules, 2015
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the registration of underwriters with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. They define eligibility criteria, application procedures, and the matters considered when granting a certificate of registration.

name: The Subscribers Antecedents Verification Regulations, 2015

metadata.title: Subscribers Antecedents Verification Regulations, 2015
metadata.summary: These regulations establish procedures for the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority to verify subscriber antecedents for all mobile communications service licensees. They mandate that SIMs be sold only through authorized channels with real-time verification against the NADRA database to ensure accurate data maintenance.

name: S.R.O. 236(I)/2015 — Restoration of the Pakistan Oilseed Development Board and Its Application to FATA

metadata.title: Notification restoring the working of Pakistan Oilseed Development Board
metadata.summary: This notification restores the working of the Pakistan Oilseed Development Board as it was in force in Islamabad immediately before this issuance. The provisions apply to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas (FATA) with immediate effect, subject to specific modifications regarding their application.

name: The Research Analyst Regulations, 2015

metadata.title: Research Analyst Regulations, 2015
metadata.summary: This document publishes draft regulations governing Research Analysts, Research Entities, and Research Reports within the Pakistani securities market. It defines key terms such as 'Research Analyst', 'Investment Advisor', and 'Research Report' to establish the scope of activities subject to regulation.

name: The Senate (Election of Members dor Federally Administered Tribal Areas)(Repeal) Order, 2015

metadata.title: The Senate (Election of Members from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) (Repeal) Order, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Senate (Elections of Members from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 2015
metadata.summary: This President's Order repeals the Senate (Elections of Members from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 2015. It also revives two previously repealed instruments: Notification No. S.R.O. 746 (1)/75 dated July 7, 1975, and the Senate (Election of Members from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 2002.

name: No. 4-11/2008-Min-I — Conferment of Minister of State Status on Ms. Marvi Memon

metadata.title: Grant of status of Minister of State to Ms. Marvi Memon
metadata.summary: This notification grants the status of Minister of State to Ms. Marvi Memon, who is the Chairperson of the Benazir Income Support Programme. The appointment takes immediate effect and was issued by the Prime Minister under specific rules of business.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I (i) — Conferment of Minister of State Status on Barrister Zafarullah Khan

metadata.title: Notification appointing Mr. Ashtar Ausaf Ali and granting status to Barrister Zafarullah Khan
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Ashtar Ausaf Ali as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Law with the status of Minister of State, effective immediately. It also grants the status of Minister of State to Barrister Zafarullah Khan, who serves as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Parliamentary Affairs.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Appointment of Mr. Ashtar Ausaf Ali as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Law

metadata.title: Notification appointing Mr. Ashtar Ausaf Ali and granting status to Barrister Zafarullah Khan
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Ashtar Ausaf Ali as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Law with the status of Minister of State, effective immediately. It also grants the status of Minister of State to Barrister Zafarullah Khan, who serves as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister for Parliamentary Affairs.

name: The Drawback of Local Taxes And Levies Order, 2015

metadata.title: Drawback of Local Taxes And Levies Order, 2015
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the availability of drawback on local taxes and levies for enhanced exports made during the fiscal year 2013-14. It specifies eligibility criteria, including a minimum export increase of 10% over the previous year and requirements for valid NTN numbers and tax returns.

name: The National Tariff Commission Ordinance, 2015

metadata.title: National Tariff Commission Ordinance, 2015
metadata.repeals: National Tariff Commission Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the National Tariff Commission Act, 1990, and re-enacts it with necessary reforms. It establishes the National Tariff Commission as a body corporate comprising five members appointed by the Federal Government to handle trade remedy laws including anti-dumping and safeguard measures.

name: The Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2015

metadata.title: Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2014
metadata.repeals: Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reforms and repeals the Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2001 to align Pakistani law with WTO provisions on subsidies. It establishes a framework for investigating subsidies and imposing countervailing duties to offset injurious subsidization on imported goods.

name: The Anti-dumping Duties Ordinance, 2015

metadata.title: Anti-dumping Duties Ordinance, 2015
metadata.repeals: Anti-Dumping Duties Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reforms and repeals the Anti-Dumping Duties Ordinance, 2000 to align Pakistan's laws with Article VI of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade. It establishes a framework for investigating dumping and injury regarding goods imported into Pakistan and provides for the imposition of anti-dumping duties in the public interest.

name: S. R. O. 156(I)/2015 — Extension of Special Economic Zones Act, 2012 to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas

metadata.title: The Special Economic Zones Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This notification directs that the Special Economic Zones Act, 2012 applies to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas with immediate effect. It is issued by the President in exercise of powers under clause (3) of Article 247 of the Constitution.

name: No. 3-7/2013-Min-II — Appointment of the Speaker, Provincial Assembly Punjab, as Acting Governor of the Punjab

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-7/2013-Min-I
metadata.summary: This notification addresses the vacancy in the office of Governor of the Punjab Province caused by Mr. Mohammad Sarwar's resignation. Consequently, the President has nominated the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to perform the functions of Governor until a new appointment is made.

name: No. 3-7/2013-Min-II — Acceptance of Resignation of Mr. Mohammad Sarwar as Governor of the Punjab

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-7/2013-Min-II
metadata.summary: This notification records the acceptance of the resignation tendered by Mr. Mohammad Sarwar from the office of Governor of the Province of Punjab. It was issued by the President of Pakistan on January 29, 2015.

name: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2015

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2015
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2013 (P.O. No. 6 of 2013)
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary scales for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It sets specific monthly amounts for the Chief Justice and other judges at both levels, effective from July 1, 2014.

name: No. 2-1/2015-Min-I (iii) — Grant of Five Days Leave to Barrister Zafarullah Khan, Special Assistant to the Prime Ministe

metadata.summary: This document contains three notifications issued by the Cabinet Secretariat regarding leave grants to specific government officials. The Prime Minister approved six days of ex-Pakistan leave for Mr. Irfan Siddiqui, five days for Prof. Ahsan Iqbal, and five days for Barrister Zafarullah Khan during January 2015.
