name: No. 5/2/2013-Com. — Appointment of Mr. Muzafar Said as ECNEC Member Representing Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

metadata.title: Notification No. 5/2/2013-Com.
metadata.summary: This notification nominates Mr. Muzafar Said as a Member of the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC) representing Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. He replaces Mr. Siraj-ul-Haq, who is an ex-Senior Minister for Finance.

name: No. 24-108/2010(HR) — Charges and Disciplinary Action against Mr. Abdul Waheed Sheikh

metadata.title: Order imposing major penalty of removal from service
metadata.summary: This order imposes a major penalty of removal from service on Deputy Director Abdul Waheed Sheikh of the Frequency Allocation Board (FAB). The decision follows disciplinary proceedings initiated in July 2014 regarding charges of commission and omission, where the employee failed to respond to show cause notices and attempted to resign during active proceedings. The Authority determined that resignation was not permissible while disciplinary action was pending and ordered immediate removal with back-dated absence without pay.

name: No. HPA-20 (Vol-15) — Reduction in Rank of Mr. Gul Faraz under the FAB Employees (Service) Regulations, 2014

metadata.title: Notification No. HPA-20(Vol-15)
metadata.summary: This notification imposes a major penalty of reduction to a lower post on Mr. Gul Faraz, Director (P&R) of the Frequency Allocation Board. The penalty is issued after he failed to submit a written defense or appear before the authority regarding charges under the FAB Employees (Service) Regulations, 2014.

name: No. 4-17/2013-Min-I — Appointment of Ms. Leila Khan as Chairperson, Prime Minister’s Youth Programme

metadata.title: Notification No. 4-17/2013-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification designates Ms. Leila Khan as the Chairperson of the Prime Minister's Youth Programme on an honorary basis. She will serve without receiving any pay or perks for this assignment.

name: No. 7-11/2014-Min-I — Appointment of Ms. Marvi Memon as Coordinator for Counseling Services Programme for APS Peshawar

metadata.title: Notification No. 7-11/2014-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification designates Ms. Marvi Memon, Member National Assembly, as the coordinator for a special program on counseling services. The program specifically addresses post-traumatic stress affecting students and bereaved families of Army Public School in Peshawar.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Conferment of Minister of State Status on Mr. Miftah Ismail

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-4/2013-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification grants the status of Minister of State to Mr. Miftah Ismail. He holds the position of Special Assistant to the Prime Minister and Chairman of the Board of Investment.

name: No. 3-7/2013-Min.II — Ex-Pakistan Leave Availed by Mr. Mohammad Sarwar, Governor of the Punjab

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-7/2013-Min-II
metadata.amends: Cabinet Division Notification No. 3-7/2013-Min-II dated 28th November, 2014
metadata.summary: This notification partially modifies a previous Cabinet Division Notification regarding the leave of Mr. Mohammad Sarwar. It grants him ex-Pakistan leave from December 9 to December 17, 2014.

name: No. 2-5/2013-Min-I — Allocation of Additional Charge of Science and Technology to Rana Tanveer Hussain

metadata.title: Notification assigning additional portfolio of Science and Technology to Rana Tanveer Hussain
metadata.summary: This notification assigns the additional portfolio of Science and Technology to Rana Tanveer Hussain, who is the Minister for Defence Production. The assignment takes immediate effect under rule 3(4) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. F. 5/6/2013-Com. — Reconstitution of the Cabinet Committee on Restructuring (CCOR)

metadata.title: Notification reconstitution of the Cabinet Committee on Restructuring (CCOR)
metadata.amends: Cabinet Division's Notification of even number dated 11th December, 2013
metadata.summary: This notification reconstitutes the Cabinet Committee on Restructuring (CCOR) with a specific list of members including various Ministers and the Secretary, Cabinet Division. It outlines the committee's terms of reference to review administrative structures, rightsize ministries for efficiency, and restructure boards of autonomous bodies and public sector enterprises.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Competitive Bidding Tariff (Approval Procedure) Regulations, 2014

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Competitive Bidding Tariff (Approval Procedure) Regulations, 2014
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedure for approving tariffs arrived at through a competitive bidding process administered by NEPRA. They define key terms related to electric power generation and outline guidelines for relevant agencies conducting bids, including requirements for technology specifics and transparency. The document also sets forth the application process for seeking approval of competitive bidding tariffs from the Authority.

name: No. 2-7/2013-Min-I — Grant of Four Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mr. Shahid Khaqan Abbasi, Minister for Petroleum and Natural Resources

metadata.title: Grant of leave to Mr. Shahid Khaqan Abbasi
metadata.summary: This notification grants four days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Shahid Khaqan Abbasi, the Minister for Petroleum and Natural Resources. The leave is valid from November 1st to November 4th, 2014.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Appointment of Barrister Zafarullah Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Parliamentary Affairs

metadata.title: Notification appointing Barrister Zafarullah Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Parliamentary Affairs
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Barrister Zafarullah Khan as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Parliamentary Affairs with immediate effect. The appointment was made by the Prime Minister under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Appointment of Dr. Musadik Malik as Official Spokesperson to the Prime Minister

metadata.summary: This notification designates Dr. Musadik Malik as the Official Spokesperson of the Prime Minister. The designation is made by the Prime Minister under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 3-7/2013-Min.II — Extension of Ex-Pakistan Leave of Mr. Mohammad Sarwar, Governor of the Punjab

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-7/2013-Min.II
metadata.summary: This notification grants ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Mohammad Sarwar, the Governor of Punjab, extending his absence from September 11 to September 23, 2014. During this period, the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of Punjab is authorized to perform the functions of the Governor under Article 104 of the Constitution.

name: The Gas Infrastructure Development Cess Ordinance, 2014

metadata.title: The Gas Infrastructure Development Cess Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the validation, imposition, levy, and collection of a development cess on natural gas in Pakistan. It establishes the rates for this cess, outlines its utilization for specific infrastructure projects like the Iran-Pakistan Pipeline, and grants powers to the Federal Government to make rules and amend schedules.

name: No. 2-7/2013-Min-I (ix) — Grant of Nine Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mr. Zahid Hamid, Minister for Science and Technology

metadata.title: Grant of leave to Mr. Zahid Hamid
metadata.summary: This notification grants nine days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Zahid Hamid, the Minister for Science and Technology. The leave period runs from July 26th to August 3rd, 2014.

metadata.summary: This notification grants an eighteen-day extension to ex-Pakistan leave for Molana Abdul Ghafoor Hyderi, the Minister of State for Postal Services. metadata.title: The Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975

name: No. 2-7/2013-Min-I (iv) — Grant of Eight Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Prof. Ahsan Iqbal, Minister for Planning, Development & Reform

name: No. 2-7/2013-Min-I(i) — Grant of 13 Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mr. Ahsan Iqbal, Minister for Planning and Development

metadata.title: Grant of Leave to Mr. Ahsan Iqbal
metadata.summary: This notification grants 13 days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Ahsan Iqbal, the Minister for Planning and Development. The leave period runs from July 31, 2013, to August 12, 2013, pursuant to powers under the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.

name: No. 2-7/2013-Min-I — Grant of 13 Days Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mrs. Saira Afzal Tarar, Minister of State for National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination

metadata.title: Notification granting leave to Mrs. Saira Afzal Tarar
metadata.summary: This notification grants 13 days of Pakistan leave to Mrs. Saira Afzal Tarar, who serves as the Minister of State for National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination. The leave period is specified from August 1st to August 13th, 2013.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Appointment of Kh. Zaheer Ahmed, Advocate High Court, as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister with the Status of Minister of State

metadata.title: Notification appointing Kh. Zaheer Ahmed as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister
metadata.summary: This notification announces the appointment of Kh. Zaheer Ahmed as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister with the status of a Minister of State. The appointment takes immediate effect and is issued by the Prime Minister under the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. F. 5/2/2013-Com — Inclusion of the Minister for Information, Broadcasting and National Heritage as Special Invitee to Meetings of the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC)

metadata.title: Notification of the Prime Minister to include the Minister for Information, Broadcasting and National Heritage in the list of Special Invitees for meetings of the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council
metadata.summary: This notification directs the inclusion of the Minister for Information, Broadcasting and National Heritage in the list of Special Invitees. This applies to all agenda items at meetings of the Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (ECNEC).

name: No. 1(15)/2009-Dir(Legal) – Constitution of ICT SEZ Authority

metadata.title: Notification regarding the composition of Islamabad Capital Territory SEZ Authority
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the official composition of the Islamabad Capital Territory SEZ Authority (ICT-SEZA) under the powers of the SEZs Act, 2012. It lists specific government officials and private sector nominees designated to serve as members, including the Chairman, Vice Chairperson, and various Secretary-level representatives from different ministries.

name: No. F. 5/3/2013-Com — Inclusion of the Minister for Information, Broadcasting and National Heritage as Member of the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC) of the Cabinet

metadata.title: Notification including the Minister for Information, Broadcasting and National Heritage in the composition of the Economic Coordination Committee
metadata.summary: This notification includes the Minister for Information, Broadcasting and National Heritage as a Member in the composition of the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC). It was issued by the Prime Minister under rule 17(2) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: The Surveying and Mapping Ordinance, 2013

metadata.title: Surveying and Mapping Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution and regulation of the Survey of Pakistan. It aims to regulate surveying and mapping activities, including aerial photography, remote sensing, and digital mapping, while ensuring the speedy disposal of related cases.

name: The Finance Act, 2013

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 2013. It also amends and enacts certain laws, including the Customs Act, 1969, the Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974, the Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act 1975, and the Sales Tax Act, 1990.

name: No. 2-5/2013-Min-I — Re-allocation of Portfolios to Ministers and Ministers of State

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-5/2013-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification re-allocates specific government portfolios to the Minister and Minister of State with immediate effect. The changes involve assigning Law, Justice, and Human Rights to Mr. Zahid Hamid and Privatization to Engr. Khurram Dastgir Khan.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Appointment of Dr. Musadik Malik as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister with the Status of Minister of Stat

metadata.title: Notification appointing Dr. Musadik Malik as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister
metadata.summary: This notification announces the appointment of Dr. Musadik Malik as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister with the status of Minister of State. The appointment takes immediate effect and is issued by the Cabinet Secretary under rule 4(6) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 2-2/2013-Min.I(i) — Cessation of Office of Members of the Federal Caretaker Cabinet upon the End of the Caretaker Government

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-2/2013-Min.I(i)
metadata.summary: This notification lists the Federal ministers whose offices ceased immediately following the cessation of Justice (Retd) Mir Hazar Khan Khoso as caretaker Prime Minister. It details the specific portfolios held by each affected minister at the time of their removal.

name: No. 3-2/2013-Min.I — Cessation of Office of Dr. Shahid Amjad Chaudhry, Adviser to the Prime Minister on Finance, Revenue, Planning and Development, Economic Affairs and Statistics

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-2/2013-Min.1
metadata.summary: This notification announces the cessation of Justice (Retd) Mir Hazar Khan Khoso's office as care-taker Prime Minister. Consequently, Dr. Shahid Amjad Chaudhry has ceased to hold his advisory offices with immediate effect.

name: The FATA University Regulation, 2013

metadata.title: The FATA University Regulation, 2013
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes the FATA University in F.R. Kohat to provide quality education of international standards to talented students in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It defines the University as a body corporate with perpetual succession, granting it academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while outlining its composition and powers.

name: The Abolition of the Discretionary Quotas in Housing Schemes Act, 2013

metadata.title: The Abolition of the Discretionary Quotas in Housing Schemes Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes all discretionary quotas in housing schemes within the public sector to ensure allotments are made fairly, equitably, and transparently. It applies to any scheme owned, controlled, or financed by federal government authorities or state-owned enterprises.

name: No. 2-2/2013-Min-I — Appointment of Dr. Sania Nishtar as Focal Person and Coordinator of the Federal Government for Health-Related Subjects

metadata.title: Notification appointing Dr. Sania Nishter as Focal Person and Coordinator
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Dr. Sania Nishter as the Focal Person and Coordinator of the Federal Government for health-related subjects. This appointment is in addition to her existing duties as Federal Minister for Education and Trainings, Science & Technology and Information Technology.

name: S. R. O. 329(I)/2013 — Transfer of Jurisdiction of M/s Egyptian Pakistani Telecommunication Services Company (Pvt.) Ltd.

metadata.title: Corrigendum Order
metadata.summary: This document serves as a corrigendum order issued by the Federal Board of Revenue to correct specific details in a previous transfer of jurisdiction order regarding M/s Unicol Limited. It substitutes an incorrect STRN number with the correct one and amends related orders concerning the jurisdiction of various Regional Tax Offices.

name: S. R. O. 328(I)/2013 — Transfer of Case from RTO Lahore to RTO Islamabad

metadata.title: S. R. O. 328 (I)/2013
metadata.summary: This order transfers jurisdiction over the case of M/s Gentek Geotechnical Engineering from the Chief Commissioner Inland Revenue, RTO, Lahore to the Chief Commissioner Inland Revenue, RTO, Islamabad. The transfer is made under powers conferred by specific sections of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001, Sales Tax Act, 1990, and Federal Excise Act, 2005.

name: No. 8-3/2003-Min-II — Grant of Ex-Pakistan Leave to Dr. Ishrat Ul Ebad Khan, Governor of Sindh, and Performance of Functions of Governor by the Speaker, Provincial Assembly Sindh

metadata.title: Governor's Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Order, 1975
metadata.summary: This notification grants ex-Pakistan leave to Dr. Ishrat Ul Ebad Khan, the Governor of Sindh, for the period from April 8th to April 10th, 2013. During his absence, the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh is authorized to perform the Governor's functions under Article 104 of the Constitution.

name: No. 2-2/2013-Min-I — Allocation of the Portfolio of Capital Administration and Development Division to Dr. Younis Soomro, Minister for Housing and Works

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-2/2013-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification allocates the portfolio of Capital Administration and Development Division to Dr. Younis Soomro, Minister for Housing and Works. The allocation is made with immediate effect under rule 3(4) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: The Trade Organizations Rules, 2013

metadata.title: The Trade Organizations Rules, 2013
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Trade Organizations Act, 2013 to regulate trade organizations in Pakistan. They define various types of entities such as chambers, associations, and women's chambers while establishing eligibility criteria for obtaining a government license.

name: No. 3-1/2013-Min.I — Termination of the Status of Federal Minister/Minister of State Granted to Certain Dignitaries

metadata.title: Notification terminating the status of Federal Minister/Minister of State
metadata.summary: This notification issued by the Prime Minister terminates the status of Federal Minister or Minister of State granted to eleven specific dignitaries. The action is taken under rule 15(1)(g) read with Serial No. 1A of Schedule V-A of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: The Global Change Impact Studies Centre Act, 2013

metadata.title: Global Change Impact Studies Centre Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Global Change Impact Studies Centre (GCISC) as a body corporate to conduct scientific investigations on climate change. The Centre is tasked with studying impacts on sectors like water, agriculture, and energy, while collaborating with domestic and foreign entities for research and capacity building.

name: The National Counter Terrorism Authority Act, 2013

metadata.title: National Counter Terrorism Authority Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Counter Terrorism Authority Pakistan as an independent body answerable to the Prime Minister. The Authority is tasked with coordinating state responses, formulating strategies, and managing intelligence data to combat terrorism and extremism.

name: No. 2-3/2012-Min.I(ii) — Acceptance of Resignation of Dr. Muhammad Farooq Sattar as Minister for Overseas Pakistanis

metadata.title: Resignation of Dr. Muhammad Faroog Sattar
metadata.summary: This order records the acceptance of the resignation tendered by Dr. Muhammad Faroog Sattar, who served as the Minister for Overseas Pakistanis. The resignation is effective from February 17, 2013, pursuant to clause (3) of Article 92 of the Constitution.

name: No. 1-3/2009-Min-I(i) — Conferment of the Status of Federal Minister on Dr. Asim Hussain

metadata.title: Notification No.1-3/2009-Min-I(i)
metadata.summary: This notification confers the status of Federal Minister on Dr. Asim Hussain, the Honorary Personal Physician to the President. It specifies that while he will not receive a salary or perquisites, he is entitled to benefits such as telephone, transport, TA/DA, staff, and residence in Islamabad.

name: De-notification of Sardar Shahjehan Yousaf as Minister of State for Education and Trainings

metadata.title: Notification de-notifying the appointment as Minister of State of Sardar Shahjehan Yousaf
metadata.repeals: appointment as Minister of State of Sardar Shahjehan Yousaf Minister of State for Education and Trainings
metadata.summary: This notification de-notifies the appointment of Sardar Shahjehan Yousaf as Minister of State for Education and Trainings. The action was taken by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister under Article 92(3) of the Constitution with effect from March 5, 2013.

name: The Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University, Islamabad, Act, 2013

metadata.title: Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University, Islamabad, Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University in Islamabad as an autonomous body corporate. It incorporates the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences into the new university structure and defines the university's functions, including instruction, research, degree conferral, and inspection of affiliated institutions.

name: The Federal Ombudsmen Institutional Reforms Act, 2013

metadata.title: Federal Ombudsmen Institutional Reforms Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes institutional reforms to standardize and harmonize laws regarding Federal Ombudsmen institutions. It aims to enhance the effectiveness of these offices to provide speedy relief to citizens and ensure their administrative and financial autonomy.

name: The Defence Housing Authority Islamabad Act, 2013

metadata.title: Defence Housing Authority Islamabad Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Defence Housing Authority Islamabad to carry out land development schemes and projects. Its primary purpose is to provide welfare, financial security, and housing for the bereaved families of martyrs, war injured, disabled, and other defence force personnel.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Private Educational Institutions (Registration and Regulation) Act, 2013

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Private Educational Institutions (Registration and Regulation) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad Capital Territory Private Educational Institutions Regulatory Authority (ICT-PEIRA) to oversee private educational institutions in the territory. It provides for the registration, regulation, and functioning of these institutions to ensure transparency, discipline, and uniform academic standards.

name: The My University Islamabad Act, 2013

metadata.title: My University Islamabad Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes MY University Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, powers, and purposes.

name: The South Asian Strategic Stability Institute University Islamabad Act, 2013

metadata.title: South Asian Strategic Stability Institute University Islamabad Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the South Asian Strategic Stability Institute (SASSI) University in Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, including the Patron, Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and Board of Governors.

name: The Dar-ul-Madina International University Islamabad Act, 2013

metadata.title: Dar-ul-Madina International University Islamabad Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Dar-ul-Madina International University as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, including the Patron, Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and Board of Trustees.

name: The Pakistan Onshore Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Rules, 2013

metadata.title: The Pakistan Onshore Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Rules, 2013
metadata.summary: These rules regulate petroleum rights in the onshore areas of Pakistan, excluding coal bed methane. They establish definitions for terms such as commercial discovery, crude oil, and delivery points to govern exploration and production activities.

name: The Pakistan Academy of Letters Act, 2013

metadata.title: The Pakistan Academy of Letters' Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Academy of Letters as an autonomous body corporate to promote Pakistani languages and literature. It provides for the welfare of the writers' community throughout Pakistan and outlines the structure, functions, and powers of the Academy's Board of Governors.

name: The Trade Development Authority of Pakistan Act, 2013

metadata.title: Trade Development Authority of Pakistan Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan under the administrative control of the Ministry of Commerce. It creates a dedicated body corporate responsible for maximizing exports and providing structured support to stakeholders in trade policy formulation. The legislation also transfers assets and liabilities from existing export promotion bodies to the new Authority.

name: The Trade Organizations Act, 2013

metadata.title: The Trade Organizations Act, 2013
metadata.repeals: The Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and regulation of trade organizations in Pakistan. It establishes a framework to ensure appropriate representation of all genders and business sectors while defining the purpose, roles, and operational guidelines for these organizations.

name: The Investigation for Fair Trial Act, 2013

metadata.title: Investigation for Fair Trial Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the powers of law enforcement and intelligence agencies to use modern investigative techniques for preventing scheduled offences. It provides a legal framework for collecting evidence through methods like covert surveillance, wire tapping, and communication interception while ensuring fair trial procedures and judicial oversight.

name: Formation of Sub-Committee on Structure of Pay and Allowances of Regulatory Authorities

metadata.title: Constitution of Sub Committee on Structure of Pay and Allowances of Regulatory Authorities
metadata.summary: This notification constitutes a Sub-Committee on Regulatory Bodies with immediate effect. The committee is tasked with discussing and examining the pay structure and recruitment process of regulatory bodies, and its recommendations will be submitted to the Pay and Pension Commission or Finance Division.

name: The Pakistan telecommunication Authority's Chairman and Member (Appointment and Qualifications) Rules, 2013

metadata.title: Pakistan Telecommunication Authority's Chairman and Member (Appointment and Qualifications) Rules, 2013
metadata.summary: These rules establish the appointment procedures and qualifications for the Chairman and Members of the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority. They specify that appointments are made by the Federal Government, outlining eligibility criteria such as Pakistani citizenship and educational requirements.

name: The Federal Ombudsman Institutional Reforms Ordinance, 2013

metadata.title: Federal Ombudsmen Institutional Reforms Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance aims to make institutional reforms for standardizing and harmonizing laws relating to Federal Ombudsmen. It seeks to enhance the effectiveness of these offices to provide speedy relief to citizens and ensure their administrative and financial autonomy.

name: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2013

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2013
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2011
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes the monthly salaries for the Chief Justice and other judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts. It also repeals the previous Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2011.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Appointment of Mr. Irfan Siddiqui as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on National Affairs with the Status of Federal Minister

metadata.title: Notification No. 3-4/2013-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Mr. Irfan Siddiqui as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on National Affairs with the status of a Federal Minister, effective immediately. It also grants four days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mr. Imtiaz Ahmed Shaikh, another Special Assistant to the Prime Minister.

name: The Prohibition of Non-degradable Plastic Products (manufacturing, sale and usage) Regulations 2013

metadata.title: The Prohibition of Non-degradable Plastic Products (Manufacturing, Sale and Usage) Regulations, 2013
metadata.summary: These regulations prohibit the import, manufacture, stockpiling, trade, supply, distribution, sale, or use of non-degradable scheduled plastic products in the Islamabad Capital Territory. They establish requirements for the registration of pro-degradant additives, specific marking and color standards for oxo-biodegradable products, and penalties for contravention.

name: No. 3-4/2013-Min-I — Appointment of Capt. Shujaat Azim as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on Honorary Basis

metadata.title: Appointment of Capt. Shujaat Azim as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Capt. Shujaat Azim as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister on an honorary basis with immediate effect. He is assigned to look after the work of the Aviation Division.

name: No. 2-5/2013-Min.I — Appointment of Federal Ministers and Minister of State

metadata.title: Notification appointing Federal Ministers and Minister of State
metadata.summary: This notification appoints specific individuals as Federal Ministers and Minister of State under Article 92 of the Constitution. The appointed officials were administered the oath of office by the President on January 16, 2014.

name: PROCLAMATION OF ASIF ALI ZARDARI

metadata.title: Proclamation
metadata.summary: This Proclamation directs the Governor of Balochistan to assume the functions of the provincial government due to a situation where the government cannot be carried on in accordance with the Constitution. It further stipulates that the Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers must immediately cease holding office, while granting the Governor discretion to impose necessary conditions for exercising these powers.

name: Nomination of the Minister for Climate Change as Member of the ECC

metadata.title: Notification No. 5/3/2007-Com.
metadata.summary: This notification includes the Minister for Climate Change as a Member in the composition of the Economic Coordination Committee (ECC) of the Cabinet. It is issued by the Prime Minister under Rule 17(2) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: The Special Economic Zones Rules, 2013

metadata.title: The Special Economic Zones Rules, 2013
metadata.summary: These Rules are made by the Board of Investment under powers conferred by Section 40 of the Special Economic Zones Act, 2012. They establish the framework for the administration, oversight, and operation of Special Economic Zones in Pakistan, including procedures for applications, development agreements, and incentives.

name: S. R. O. 508(I)/2013 — Levy of Fixed Federal Excise Duty on Imported Oilseeds

metadata.title: S. R. O. 508(I)/2013
metadata.summary: This notification levies a fixed federal excise duty of forty paisa per kilogram on oilseeds at the import stage. This duty is imposed in lieu of the federal excise duty previously payable at the production or manufacturing stage of vegetable ghee or cooking oil.

name: S. R. O. 507(I)/2013 — Levy of Fixed Federal Excise Duty on Locally Produced Oil for Vegetable Ghee and Cooking Oil Manufacturers

metadata.title: S. R. O. 507(I)/2013
metadata.summary: This order levies a fixed federal excise duty of one rupee per kilogram on locally produced oil purchased by manufacturers of vegetable ghee and cooking oil. It replaces the previous ad valorem duty rate of 16% applicable to these products.

name: The Right to Free and Compulsory Education Act,2012

metadata.title: The Right to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for free and compulsory education for all children aged five to sixteen years in schools within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes fundamental rights for children to receive education without fees and outlines obligations for the appropriate government regarding infrastructure, admission, and curriculum standards.

name: The Indonesia-Pakistan Preferential Trade Agreement Rules of Origin, 2012

metadata.title: Indonesia-Pakistan Preferential Trade Agreement Rules of Origin, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish the criteria for determining the origin of products traded between Pakistan and Indonesia under their Preferential Trade Agreement. They define terms such as 'wholly obtained' and 'non-originating materials' to specify which goods qualify for preferential concessions.

name: Notification of Resignation of Dr. Nadeem Ehsan, Minister of State for Overseas Pakistanis

metadata.title: Resignation of Dr. Nadeem Ehsan
metadata.summary: This notification records the resignation of Dr. Nadeem Ehsan from his office as Minister of State for Overseas Pakistanis. The resignation was tendered to the President on November 29, 2012, pursuant to clause (3) of Article 92 of the Constitution.

name: Allocation of the Portfolio of Privatization to Mr. Jam Muhammad Yousaf, Federal Minister

metadata.title: Notification assigning the portfolio of Privatization to Mr. Jam Muhammad Yousaf
metadata.summary: This notification assigns the portfolio of Privatization to Mr. Jam Muhammad Yousaf with immediate effect. The assignment is made by the Prime Minister under rule 3(4) of the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: Grant of Additional Portfolios to Senator Saleem H. Mandviwala

metadata.title: Notification No. 2-3/2012-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification re-designates Senator Saleem H. Mandviwala as Minister of State for Finance, Revenue, Economic Affairs, Statistics and Planning & Development with immediate effect. Additionally, the document assigns him the additional charge of Chairman, Board of Investment.

name: Reconstitution of CDCP Operational Steering Committee in Supersession of Earlier Notification

metadata.title: Notification reconstitution of the CDCP Operational Steering Committee
metadata.summary: This notification reconstitutes the CDCP Operational Steering Committee with a specific composition of members from various government divisions and agencies. It supersedes an earlier notification dated July 14, 2011, and outlines the committee's terms of reference regarding budget review, progress monitoring, and policy decision-making.

name: The Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Act, 2012

metadata.title: Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan as an autonomous body to manage intellectual property rights comprehensively. The legislation aims to foster creative thinking, stimulate creativity, and attract investment by providing institutional arrangements for these matters.

name: The Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan Act,2012

metadata.title: Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan to ensure effective coordination and enforcement regarding therapeutic goods. It aims to bring harmony in inter-provincial trade and regulate the manufacture, import, export, storage, distribution, and sale of drugs and related products.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Procedure for filing appeal before the Authority) Regulations, 2012

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Procedure for filing appeal before the Authority) Regulations, 2012
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the specific procedure for filing appeals before the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA). They define key terms, set a thirty-day limitation period for filing appeals, prescribe the required format and supporting documents, and outline the scrutiny process by the Registrar.

name: The Services of Pakistan (Redressal of Under Representation) Ordinance, 2012

metadata.title: Services of Pakistan (Redressal of Under-Representation) Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance addresses the under-representation of specific provinces and areas in the Service of Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to appoint officers from Sindh, Balochistan, and the Federally Administered Tribal Areas by transfer to Senior Joint Secretary or Additional Secretary posts.

name: S. R. O. 1159(I)/2012 — Transfer of Tax Case of M/s Gas Net Filling Station, Bannu, KPK to Chief Commissioner Inland Revenue, RTO Peshawar

metadata.title: S. R. O. 1159 (1)/2012
metadata.summary: This order transfers jurisdiction over a specific case involving M/s Gas Net Filling Station Bannu from the Chief Commissioner Inland Revenue to the RTO, Peshawar. The transfer is made under powers conferred by sections of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001, Sales Tax Act, 1990, and Federal Excise Act, 2005.

name: S.R.O. 1144(I)/2012 – Jurisdiction Transferred from RTO-II to LTU Karachi

metadata.title: Order transferring jurisdiction over the case of M/s. Lottee Powergen Pvt. Ltd.
metadata.summary: This order transfers jurisdiction over the case of M/s. Lottee Powergen Pvt. Ltd. from the Chief Commissioner Inland Revenue, RTO-II Karachi, to the Chief Commissioner Inland Revenue, LTU, Karachi. The transfer is made under powers conferred by specific sections of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001, Sales Tax Act, 1990, and Federal Excise Act, 2005.

name: S.R.O. 1128(I)/2012 – Amendment in S.R.O. 777(I)/2011

metadata.title: Notification No. S.R.O. 777(I)/2011
metadata.summary: This notification directs an amendment to Notification No. S.R.O. 777(I)/2011 issued by the Federal Board of Revenue. The amendment adds a specific reference to Chapter XIII of the Federal Excise Rules, 2005 in the relevant table columns.

name: The Special Economic Zones Act,2012

metadata.title: Special Economic Zones Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the creation, development, and efficient operation of special economic zones in Pakistan. It establishes a legal and regulatory framework to encourage domestic and international investors to promote industrial infrastructure.

name: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Rules, 2012

metadata.title: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010 to regulate the removal and transplantation of human organs and tissues. They establish procedures for donor authorization, duties of transplant surgeons, composition of evaluation boards, and conditions for registering medical institutions.

name: The Contempt of Court Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Contempt of Court Act, 2012
metadata.repeals: The Contempt of Court Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the law regarding contempt of courts in Pakistan. It defines various acts that constitute contempt, outlines punishments including imprisonment or fines, and provides specific exemptions for fair comments and official duties.

name: The Finance Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2012
metadata.amends: Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance, 1961; Natural Gas (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1967; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2012. It also amends several existing laws, including those related to petroleum levies, natural gas surcharges, and customs regulations.

name: The Validation Ordinance, 2012

metadata.title: The Validation Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates all acts, orders, and instruments done by the former Prime Minister Syed Yousaf Raza Gillani between April 26, 2012, and June 19, 2012. It declares these actions valid despite any Supreme Court orders or judgments regarding his disqualification and ensures no legal proceedings can be initiated against authorities for acts performed during this period.

name: The National Commission of Human Rights Act, 2012

metadata.title: National Commission for Human Rights Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Commission for Human Rights to promote and protect human rights in Pakistan. It defines the composition of the Commission, including a Chairperson and members from various provinces and minority communities, and outlines their appointment process through the Federal Government and Parliamentary Committee.

name: S. R. O. 563(I)/2012 — Exemption of Default Surcharge and Penalties on Sales Tax and Federal Excise Duty

metadata.title: Sales Tax & Federal Excise S.R.O. 563(I)/2012
metadata.summary: This notification exempts the default surcharge and penalties payable by persons with outstanding sales tax or Federal Excise Duty due to illegal input tax adjustment. The exemption is conditional upon paying the outstanding principal amount of tax by June 25, 2012.

name: The Pakistan Telecommunication Employees Trust Fund (Pension) Rules, 2012

metadata.title: Pakistan Telecommunication Employees Trust Fund (Pension) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Pakistan Telecommunication Employees Trust Fund (Pension) under the authority of the Board of Trustees. They define key terms related to pensionable pay, beneficiaries, and retirement conditions while outlining requirements for information submission and document filing.

name: The Stock Exchange (Corporatisation, Demutualization and Integration) Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Stock Exchanges (Corporatisation, Demutualization and Integration) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the corporatisation and demutualization of stock exchanges in Pakistan to facilitate their integration. It also covers matters ancillary to these processes aimed at developing the country's capital markets.

name: The Pakistan Trade Control of Wild Fauna and Flora Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Pakistan Trade Control of Wild Fauna and Flora Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Federal Government to give effect to the United Nations Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora. It establishes prohibitions on the export, re-export, and import of endangered species without valid permits and outlines penalties for contravention.

name: The NFC Institute of Engineering and Technology Multan Act, 2012

metadata.title: NFC Institute of Engineering and Technology Multan Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the NFC Institute of Engineering and Technology Multan with degree-awarding status to enhance higher education quality. It grants the institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while merging existing NFC Institute employees and students into the new entity.

name: The OGRA Natural Gas (Regulated Third Party Access) Rules, 2012

metadata.title: The OGRA Natural Gas (Regulated Third Party Access) Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for regulated third-party access to natural gas pipelines in Pakistan. They define key terms related to capacity, custody transfer, and system operations under the jurisdiction of the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority.

name: The Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Ordinance, 2012

metadata.title: Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan as an autonomous body to manage intellectual property rights. It aims to foster creative thinking, stimulate creativity, and attract investment by protecting copyrights, trademarks, patents, and other related rights within Pakistan.

name: The Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University Act, 2012

metadata.title: Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University at Islamabad as a non-profit body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy, including the power to employ staff and manage property independently of government interference regarding resource allocation policies.

name: The Private Power and Infrastructure Board Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Private Power and Infrastructure Board Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Private Power and Infrastructure Board (PPIB) to implement power policies and develop projects in the private sector. The PPIB is designed as an independent body corporate to facilitate private investment, provide a one-window facility for investors, and coordinate with provincial governments on power projects.

name: The Drug Regulatory Agency of Pakistan Ordinance, 2012

metadata.title: Drug Regulatory Agency of Pakistan Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Drug Regulatory Agency of Pakistan as an autonomous body under the administrative control of the Federal Government. It aims to provide effective coordination and enforcement of the Drugs Act, 1976, while bringing harmony in inter-provincial trade regarding drugs and therapeutic goods. The document also defines key terms such as 'Drug', 'Medical device', and 'Therapeutic goods' for the purposes of regulation.

name: The Carriage by Air Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Carriage by Air Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Montreal Convention and other related international conventions concerning international carriage by air. It consolidates existing laws and applicable international conventions regarding air carriage, establishing their force of law within Pakistan subject to specific exceptions.

name: S.R.O. 47(1)/2012 – Levy of Federal Excise Duty on Specified Services

metadata.title: Sales Tax S.R.O.47(1)/2012
metadata.summary: This notification levies Federal Excise Duty on specific air travel services within Pakistan and for international journeys. It establishes new duty rates for passengers traveling to or from the SAARC region, Middle East, Africa, Afghanistan, Europe, Far East, China, USA, Canada, Australia, South America, and others.

name: The Takaful Rules, 2012

metadata.title: The Takaful Rules, 2012
subjects: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan
metadata.summary: These rules are proposed by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan to regulate Takaful business in the country. They define key terms related to Takaful operations, including various types of contracts, funds, and authorized operators. The document also seeks public opinion on these proposed rules before their final enactment.

name: Grant of Federal Minister Status to the Pir Syed Fazal Ali Shah Jeelani Chairman, Federal Land Commission

metadata.title: Notification granting status of Federal Minister to Pir Syed Fazal Ali Shah Jeelani
metadata.summary: This notification grants the status of Federal Minister to Pir Syed Fazal Ali Shah Jeelani, who is the Chairman of the Federal Land Commission. The appointment takes immediate effect and was issued by the Prime Minister under the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: S. R. O. 1159(I)/2011 — Transfer of Tax Cases from RTO Lahore to Directorate of Intelligence & Investigation, Lahore

metadata.title: Transfer of the Jurisdiction of 07 FIRs from Regional Tax Office, Lahore to the Directorate of Intelligence and Investigation (IR) Lahore
metadata.summary: This notification transfers the jurisdiction of seven specific First Information Reports (FIRs) from the Regional Tax Office in Lahore to the Directorate of Intelligence and Investigation (IR) in Lahore. The transfer covers investigation, prosecution, and ancillary matters for listed taxpayers under the Sales Tax Act, 1990 and Federal Excise Act, 2005.

name: S. R. O. 1158(I)/2011 — Amendment of Jurisdiction of LTU Islamabad Cases to RTO Islamabad/Rawalpindi

metadata.title: S. R. O. 1158 (1)/2011
metadata.amends: The Sales Tax Act, 1990; The Federal Excise Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This order amends the jurisdiction of the Large Taxpayers Unit (LTU) in Islamabad regarding specific taxpayer cases. It transfers these cases to either the Regional Tax Office in Islamabad or Rawalpindi, effective immediately.

name: Sanction of Ex-Pakistan Leave to Mir Israrullah Khan Zehri

metadata.title: Grant of leave to Mir Israrullah Khan Zehri
metadata.summary: This notification grants four days of ex-Pakistan leave to Mir Israrullah Khan Zehri, the Minister for National Food Security and Research. The leave is effective from December 13, 2011, pursuant to powers under Section 17 of the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.

name: Leave Notification – Haji Khuda Bux Rajar, Minister for Narcotics Control

metadata.title: Notification granting leave to Haji Khuda Bux Rajar
metadata.summary: This notification grants 15 days of leave to Haji Khuda Bux Rajar, the Minister for Narcotics Control. The leave is effective from December 13, 2011, and was issued under Section 17 of the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.

name: Engr. Shaukat Ullah Granted Four Days Ex-Pakistan Leave

metadata.title: Notification granting leave to Engr. Shaukat Ullah
subjects: Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This notification grants four days of ex-Pakistan leave to Engr. Shaukat Ullah, the Minister for States and Frontier Regions. The leave is effective from December 24, 2011, pursuant to powers under Section 17 of the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.

name: The Gas Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2011

metadata.title: Gas Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition and collection of a gas infrastructure development cess on natural gas consumers, excluding the domestic sector. The collected funds are designated for specific infrastructure projects like the Iran-Pakistan Pipeline and TAPI, as well as price equalization for alternative fuels.

name: Shahzada Jamal Nazir Appointed Adviser to Ministry of National Regulations and Services

metadata.title: Notification appointing Shahzada Jamal Nazir as Adviser to the Ministry of National Regulations and Services
subjects: Ministry of National Regulations and Services
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Shahzada Jamal Nazir as Adviser to the Ministry of National Regulations and Services with immediate effect. It also grants him the status of Minister of State in accordance with the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: Prof. Zafar Iqbal Appointed New Chairman and Dean of SZPGMI

metadata.title: Notification appointing Prof. Zafar Iqbal as Chairman and Dean, SZPGMI
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Prof. Zafar Iqbal as the Chairman and Dean of the Sheikh Zayed Postgraduate Medical Institute (SZPGMI) in Lahore with immediate effect. The terms and conditions for this appointment are to be issued separately.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Consumers Protection) Rules, 2011

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Consumers Protection) Rules, 2011
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Federal Government under section 12 of the Islamabad Capital Territory Consumers Protection Act, 1995. They establish procedures for consumer associations, define key terms like 'damage' and 'manufacturer', and set standards for pricing, receipts, and complaint handling in the Islamabad Capital Territory.

name: The Salary Of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2011

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010
metadata.summary: This President's Order determines the salaries for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It specifies new monthly salary amounts for the Chief Justice, other Supreme Court judges, Chief Justices of High Courts, and other High Court judges.

name: S. R. O. 822(I)/2011 — Restriction on Adjustment of Federal Excise Duty on Specified Goods

metadata.title: S. R. O. 822(I)/2011
metadata.summary: This order directs the Federal Board of Revenue to restrict duty adjustments on specific raw materials and semi-finished goods used in manufacturing. The restriction limits such adjustments to the extent of the duty payable on the final goods produced.

name: S. R. O. 821(I)/2011 — Requirement to Mention CNIC or NTN of Unregistered Persons on Invoices

metadata.title: S. R. O. 821(I)/2011
metadata.summary: This notification directs registered manufacturers, importers, and exporters to include specific identification numbers on invoices when supplying taxable or dutiable supplies to unregistered persons. The requirement mandates that these invoices must contain either the computerized National Identity Card number or the National Tax Number of the unregistered recipient.

name: The Career Structure for Health Personnel Scheme Ordinance, 2011

metadata.title: Career Structure for Health Personnel Scheme Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the appointment, terms, and conditions of service for health personnel serving in Federal health institutions and related organizations under the Federal Government. It establishes a new Career Structure Scheme that replaces existing Basic Pay Scales with Health Personnel Pay Scales, while providing an optional transition period for existing employees to choose between the old structure or the new scheme.

name: S. R. O. 776(I)/2011 — Appointment of Officers for Exercising Powers and Duties under the Sales Tax Act, 1990

metadata.title: S. R. O. 776 (I)/2011
metadata.summary: This notification appoints specific officers from the Directorate General Intelligence and Investigation within the Inland Revenue to exercise powers under the Sales Tax Act, 1990. It supersedes a previous notification dated February 2, 2010, by defining which officers can perform duties related to specific sections of the Act.

name: S. R. O. 775(I)/2011 — Notification of Appointment of Officers for Handling Cases under the Sales Tax Act, 1990

metadata.title: S. R. O. 775 (1)/2011
metadata.summary: This notification appoints officers from the Directorate General Intelligence and Investigation to serve as Inland Revenue officers under the Sales Tax Act, 1990. It specifies their designations and the particular sections of the Act for which they are authorized to exercise powers.

name: S. R. O. 774(I)/2011 — Notification of Appointment of Officers for Handling Cases under the Federal Excise Act, 2005

metadata.title: S. R. O. 774 (1)/2011
metadata.summary: This notification appoints specific officers of the Directorate General Intelligence and Investigation, Federal Board of Revenue, to serve as officers of Inland Revenue. These appointed officers are authorized to exercise powers and discharge duties under specified sections of the Federal Excise Act, 2005 regarding cases initiated on or before June 30, 2011.

name: The Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Act, 2011

metadata.title: Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Act, 2011
metadata.repeals: Arbitration (Protocol and Convention) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the recognition and enforcement of arbitration agreements and foreign arbitral awards in Pakistan pursuant to the United Nations Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards, 1958. It establishes exclusive jurisdiction for courts to adjudicate matters related to this Act and outlines procedures for staying legal proceedings in favor of arbitration.

name: The Industrial Relation Ordinance, 2011

metadata.title: Industrial Relations Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and rationalizes the law regarding the formation of trade unions and the improvement of relations between employers and workmen. It specifically applies to the Islamabad Capital Territory and trans-provincial establishments, excluding certain government services and security-related entities.

name: The Finance Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2011
metadata.amends: Customs Act, 1969; Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974; Finance Act, 1989; Sales Tax Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 2011. It also amends several existing laws including the Customs Act, 1969; Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974; Finance Act, 1989; and Sales Tax Act, 1990.

name: The National Vocational and Technical Training Commission Act, 2011

metadata.title: National Vocational and Technical Training Commission Act 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Vocational and Technical Training Commission as an autonomous body to regulate, coordinate, and provide policy direction for vocational and technical training in Pakistan. It creates a Board to manage the Commission's affairs, defines its composition including government secretaries and private sector representatives, and outlines the procedures for meetings and decision-making.

name: The General Statistics (Reorganization) Act, 2011

metadata.title: General Statistics (Reorganization) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reorganization of the statistical system in Pakistan through the merger of certain organizations. It establishes the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics to produce reliable, authentic, timely, and transparent data compatible with national economic and socio-economic development requirements.

name: The Competition (Reward Payment to Informants) Regulations, 2014

metadata.title: The Competition (Reward Payment to Informants) Regulations, 2014
metadata.summary: These regulations establish a framework for the Competition Commission of Pakistan to grant financial rewards to informants who provide information regarding prohibited activities under the Competition Act, 2010. The document outlines the criteria for reward calculation, the process for approaching the Commission, and provisions for confidentiality and payment stages.

name: The Islamabad High Court Establishment (Appointment and Conditions of Service) Rules 2011

metadata.title: The Islamabad High Court Establishment (Appointment and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2011
metadata.summary: These rules govern the establishment, appointment, and conditions of service for officers and staff of the Islamabad High Court. They define key terms related to recruitment, promotion, seniority, and the powers of the Chief Justice regarding court administration.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Civil and Sessions Courts Ministerial Establishments Service Rules, 2011

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Civil and Sessions Courts Ministerial Establishment Service Rules, 2011
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the ministerial establishment of the Islamabad Capital Territory Civil and Sessions Courts. They define key terms such as appointing authority, appointment types, and various committees relevant to the service.

name: The Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reorganization and conversion of the Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan (IDBP) into a public limited company known as the Industrial Development Bank Limited. It establishes the new company, transfers all assets, liabilities, contracts, and proceedings from IDBP to the new entity, and deems the new company to be a banking company pending the grant of a specific license.

name: The Islamabad Judicial Service Rules, 2011

metadata.title: The Islamabad Judicial Service Rules, 2011
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Islamabad Judicial Service for the Islamabad Capital Territory under the supervision of the Islamabad High Court. They define the establishment, constitution, strength, and recruitment procedures for various judicial posts including District and Sessions Judges and Civil Judges.

name: The Frequency Allocation Board (Release of Funds) Rules, 2011

metadata.title: The Frequency Allocation Board (Release of Funds) Rules, 2011
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for the Frequency Allocation Board to prepare, approve, and manage its budget estimates. They also outline the process for releasing funds, maintaining accounts, conducting audits by the Auditor-General, and adhering to public procurement regulations.

name: The Pakistan Institute of Fashion and Design Act, 2011

metadata.title: Pakistan Institute of Fashion and Design Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reconstitution of the Pakistan Institute of Fashion and Design, Lahore, granting it the power to award degrees. It establishes the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession and academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

name: The Arbitration (International Investment Disputes) Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Arbitration (International Investment Disputes) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act implements the International Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of other States. It establishes procedures for the registration and enforcement of awards rendered under the Convention within Pakistani High Courts.

name: S. R. O. 201(I)/2011 — Amendment in Notification No. S.R.O. 649(I)/2005 Relating to Federal Excise Duty

metadata.title: Notification No. S.R.O. 200 (1)/2011
metadata.summary: This notification amends a previous order regarding the Federal Excise Act, 2005. It specifies that goods brought from non-tariff areas in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, FATA, and PATA to tariff areas are subject to specific provisions effective from January 1, 2010.

name: S. R. O. 200(I)/2011 — Notification Granting Federal Excise Duty Exemption to Goods from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, FATA and PATA

metadata.title: S. R. O. 200(I)/2011
metadata.summary: This notification exempts goods produced in specific non-tariff areas of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, FATA, and PATA from duties under the Federal Excise Act, 2005. The exemption applies when these goods are brought to tariff areas, excluding sectors such as cement, sugar, beverages, and cigarettes.

name: The Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority Act, 2011

metadata.title: The Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority (ERRA) to manage post-disaster recovery efforts. The Authority is empowered to conduct damage assessments, formulate development programs, and oversee the reconstruction of infrastructure and housing in affected areas.

name: S. R. O. 165(I)/2011 — Authorization of Officers of Directorate-General of Post Clearance Audit to Exercise Powers of Inland Revenue Officers

metadata.title: S. R. O. 165(I)/2011
metadata.summary: This notification directs specific officers of the Directorate-General of Post Clearance Audit to exercise powers vested in Inland Revenue officers. It applies to cases of import under sections 22, 23, 25, 26, 45, and 46 of the Federal Excise Act, 2005, along with relevant chapters of the Federal Excise Rules, 2005.

name: The Securities (Leveraged Markets and Pledging) Rules, 2011

metadata.title: The Securities (Leveraged Markets and Pledging) Rules, 2011
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for leveraged market contracts, including securities lending and borrowing, margin financing, and margin trading. They define key terms such as authorized intermediaries, lenders, borrowers, and financees, and outline the requirements for entities to act as authorized intermediaries under the supervision of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan.

name: The Protection against harassment of women at the workplace Rules, 2010

metadata.title: Protection against harassment of women at the workplace Rules, 2010
metadata.amends: Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Federal Government under the Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010 to establish procedures for handling workplace harassment complaints. They define key terms like 'Ombudsman' and 'District Court', mandate the designation of competent authorities, and outline the process for filing complaints, conducting inquiries by committees, and imposing penalties.

name: The Islamabad Fire Prevention and Life Safety Regulations 2010

metadata.title: The Islamabad Fire Prevention and Life Safety Regulations, 2010
metadata.summary: These regulations were made by the Capital Development Authority to provide effective provisions for fire prevention and life safety measures in buildings and premises within the Islamabad Capital Territory. They define key terms such as 'building', 'occupier', and 'standards', and grant powers to nominated authorities for inspecting properties, sealing buildings, and enforcing safety measures.

name: The GPRS/EDGE Service Quality of Service Standards Regulations, 2010

metadata.title: GPRS / EDGE Service Quality of Service Standards Regulations, 2010
metadata.summary: These regulations establish quality of service standards for GPRS and EDGE cellular mobile services in Pakistan. They define specific testing factors such as availability, latency, link speed, throughput, and retainability to ensure consumer satisfaction.

name: The Subscribers Antecedents Verification Regulations, 2010

metadata.title: Subscribers Antecedents Verification Regulations, 2010
metadata.summary: These regulations establish procedures for mobile communication service licensees to register and verify subscriber antecedents using the NADRA database. They mandate specific documentation requirements, such as CNICs for nationals or passports for foreigners, before selling SIM cards.

name: The Telecommunication System Clock, Time & Date Synchronization Regulations, 2010

metadata.title: Telecommunication System Clock, Time & Date Synchronization Regulations, 2010
metadata.summary: These regulations mandate that all telecommunication licensees in Pakistan must synchronize their system clocks and dates to ensure error-free data recovery and accurate record reconciliation. The rules establish specific technical requirements for primary reference clocks, secondary servers, and network time protocols applicable to various network elements.

name: S. R. O. 1141(I)/2010 — Transfer of Tax Jurisdiction of M/s. Ishaq Textile Mills Ltd.

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 1141(I)/2010
metadata.summary: This notification transfers the jurisdiction of a specific tax case involving M/s. Ishaq Textile Mills Ltd from the Large Taxpayers Unit in Karachi to the Regional Tax Office in Faisalabad. The transfer applies immediately to Income Tax, Sales Tax, and Federal Excise matters under the relevant ordinances and acts.

name: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010 (PO. No. 1 of 2010)
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary scales for judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It specifies monthly payments for the Chief Justice of Pakistan, other Supreme Court judges, the Chief Justice of a High Court, and other High Court judges.

name: The National Disaster Management Act, 2010

metadata.title: The National Disaster Management Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a National Disaster Management System for Pakistan to handle unforeseen situations arising from natural or man-made causes. It creates the National Disaster Management Commission, chaired by the Prime Minister, responsible for laying down policies, plans, and guidelines for disaster management across the country.

name: The Degree Awarding Status to Dawood College of Engineering and Technology Karachi Act, 2010

metadata.title: Degree Awarding Status to Dawood College of Engineering and Technology, Karachi Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act grants degree awarding status to Dawood College of Engineering and Technology, Karachi. It reconstitutes the college as a body corporate with perpetual succession and academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

name: The Sacked Employees (Re-instatement) Act, 2010

metadata.title: The Sacked Employees (Re-instatement) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to persons in corporation, autonomous, semi-autonomous, or government service who were dismissed, removed, or terminated between November 1996 and October 1999. It applies to individuals appointed during a specific earlier period (November 1993 to November 1996) who faced dismissal due to various reasons including misconduct, absence, or organizational closure.

name: The Competition Act, 2010

metadata.title: The Competition Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Competition Commission of Pakistan to maintain and enhance competition in all spheres of commercial and economic activity. It aims to protect consumers from anti-competitive behavior while enhancing economic efficiency across the country.

name: The Appellate Tribunal Inland Revenue Rules, 2010

metadata.title: Appellate Tribunal Inland Revenue Rules, 2010
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Appellate Tribunal Inland Revenue and define its powers, sittings, language, and procedural requirements for filing appeals. They specify the roles of various officials, including the Chairperson, members, and Registrar, while outlining the format and content necessary for appeal memorandums.

name: The Benazir Income Support Programme Act, 2010

metadata.title: Benazir Income Support Programme Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Benazir Income Support Programme as a body corporate to provide financial assistance and social protection to economically distressed persons and families. Its primary objectives include enhancing the financial capacity of poor people, implementing targeted programs for underprivileged groups, and reducing poverty through equitable wealth distribution.

name: The Islamabad High Court Act, 2010

metadata.title: Islamabad High Court Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad High Court for the Islamabad Capital Territory in pursuance of Article 175 of the Constitution. It defines the court's composition, jurisdiction, and powers while ensuring the continuation of existing subordinate courts and tribunals under its supervision.

name: The Exit from Pakistan (Control) Rules, 2010

metadata.title: Exit from Pakistan (Control) Rules, 2010
metadata.repeals: Exit from Pakistan (Control) Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules establish grounds for prohibiting persons from leaving Pakistan, including involvement in corruption, terrorism, or significant financial defaults. They also define conditions under which individuals remain on an exit control list and outline the procedure for serving prohibition orders.

name: The Finance Act, 2010

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning on July 1, 2010. It amends several existing laws, including the Petroleum Products (Surcharge) Ordinance, 1961 and the Customs Act, 1969, primarily to substitute terms like 'development surcharge' with 'petroleum levy' and update references to other tax acts.

name: S. R. O. 399(I)/2010 — Rescission of Notification No. S.R.O. 650(I)/2005 under the Federal Excise Act, 2005

metadata.title: S.R.O. 399(1/2010
metadata.repeals: Notification No. S.R.O. 650(1)/2005
metadata.summary: This notification rescinds Notification No. S.R.O. 650(1)/2005 issued by the Federal Board of Revenue. It was published on June 5, 2010, and takes effect from July 1, 2010.

name: The Alternative Energy Development Board Act, 2010

metadata.title: Alternative Energy Development Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Alternative Energy Development Board (AEDB) as an autonomous body to implement policies and projects in alternative and renewable energy technologies. The legislation aims to assist in the development of indigenous technological bases for diversified energy generation while achieving sustainable economic growth.

name: The Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 2010

metadata.title: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 2010
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the distribution of revenues and certain grants-in-aid among the Federation and Provinces of Pakistan in pursuance of Article 160 of the Constitution. It establishes the divisible pool taxes, assigns specific percentages to provinces based on multiple indicators, and outlines payment mechanisms for royalties on crude oil and development surcharges on natural gas.

name: The Institute of Space Technology Act, 2010

metadata.title: Institute of Space Technology Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Space Technology in Islamabad as a degree-awarding body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy, including the power to employ staff and manage property.

name: The Benazir Income Support Programme Ordinance, 2010

metadata.title: Benazir Support Programme Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Benazir Income Support Programme as a body corporate to provide financial assistance and social protection to economically distressed persons and families. It outlines the programme's objectives, which include enhancing the financial capacity of the poor, implementing targeted policies for underprivileged groups, and reducing poverty through equitable wealth distribution.

name: The Defence Housing Authority Islamabad Ordinance, 2010

metadata.title: Defence Housing Authority Islamabad Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Defence Housing Authority Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition and powers of the Authority's Governing Body and Executive Board, outlining their roles in administration and policy guidance.

name: The Arbitration (International Investment Disputes) Ordinance, 2010

metadata.title: The Arbitration (International Investment Disputes) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to implement the International Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of other States. It establishes procedures for registering awards rendered under the Convention in the High Court and grants them force equivalent to a judgment for execution purposes.

name: The Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Ordinance, 2010

metadata.title: Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.repeals: Arbitration (Protocol and Convention) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recognition and enforcement of arbitration agreements and foreign arbitral awards in Pakistan pursuant to the United Nations Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards, 1958. It establishes exclusive court jurisdiction over related matters and outlines procedures for staying legal proceedings or enforcing foreign awards.

name: The Pakistan Institute of Development Economics Act, 2010

metadata.title: Pakistan Institute of Development Economics Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act grants degree awarding status to the Pakistan Institute of Development Economics in Islamabad. It reconstitutes the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession, academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

name: The Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010

metadata.title: Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of money laundering and the combating of terrorism financing. It also establishes provisions for the forfeiture of property derived from or involved in these activities, along with related matters.

name: The Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 2010

metadata.title: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 2010
metadata.repeals: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1997 (P.O. No. I of 1997)
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the framework for distributing net proceeds from federal taxes, oil royalties, and natural gas revenues between the Federal Government and the Provinces. It specifies the composition of the divisible pool, allocation percentages for provinces including a guaranteed sum for Balochistan, and repeals the previous 1997 Order.

name: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010

metadata.title: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the removal, storage, and transplantation of human organs and tissues for therapeutic purposes in Pakistan. It establishes an Evaluation Committee to oversee donation processes, defines legal standards for brain death and donor eligibility, and sets rules for both living and deceased donors.

name: The Monitoring and Reconciliation of Telephony Traffic Regulations, 2010

metadata.title: Monitoring and Reconciliation of Telephony Traffic Regulations, 2010
metadata.summary: These regulations empower the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority to monitor and enforce accurate presentation of total traffic terminated through licensee networks. They apply to all licensees and access providers for purposes including billing verification, detecting grey traffic, and ensuring service quality. The document mandates the establishment of monitoring systems by licensees within a specified timeframe.

name: The National Command Authority Act, 2010

metadata.title: The National Command Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Command Authority to provide complete command and control over research, development, production, and use of nuclear and space technologies. It defines the composition of the Authority, including the Prime Minister as Chairman and various ministers and military chiefs as members, and outlines its powers to supervise strategic organizations.

name: The Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010
