metadata.title: Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions to protect women from harassment at the workplace in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'harassment', 'employee', and 'employer', and mandates that every organization establish an Inquiry Committee within thirty days of enactment to handle complaints.

name: S.R.O. 165(I)/2010 – Partial Sales Tax Exemption on Supplies in Designated Areas

metadata.title: The Sales Tax (Exemption) Order, 2010
metadata.summary: This order exempts fifty percent of the leviable sales tax rate on specific goods supplied by registered persons in designated districts. The exemption applies to all goods except cement, sugar, beverages, and cigarettes.

name: S.R.O. 164(I)/2010 – Sales Tax Exemption on Industrial Electricity Supply in Designated Areas

metadata.title: Sales Tax (Exemption) Order, 2010
metadata.summary: This order exempts sales tax on the supply of electricity by Peshawar Electric Supply Company or other registered companies to manufacturing units in specific districts. The exemption does not apply to the cement, sugar, beverages, and cigarette sectors.

name: S.R.O. 163(I)/2010 – Partial Exemption of Federal Excise Duty in Specified Areas

metadata.title: S.R.O. 163(I)/2010
metadata.summary: This notification exempts federal excise duty on goods for services rendered in specific districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The exemption applies to rates exceeding those listed in the table from January 1, 2010, until December 31, 2019.

name: S.R.O. 162(I)/2010 – Partial Exemption of Central Excise Duty in Specified Areas

metadata.title: S.R.O. 162(I)/2010
metadata.summary: This notification exempts central excise duty on goods produced or services rendered in specific Federally Administered Tribal Areas from January 1, 2010, to June 30, 2010. The exemption applies only when the duty rate exceeds zero percent and explicitly excludes the cement, sugar, beverages, and cigarette sectors.

name: S.R.O. 161(I)/2010 – Central Excise Duty Relief for Registered Persons in Specified Agencies

metadata.title: S.R.O. 161(1)/2010
metadata.summary: This notification exempts registered persons in specific Federally Administered Tribal Areas from additional duties and penalties on outstanding central excise amounts. The exemption applies provided the principal duty is paid by June 30, 2010, and explicitly excludes the cement, sugar, beverages, and cigarette sectors.

name: S.R.O. 160(1)/2010 – Exemption of Default Surcharge and Penalties for Specified Districts

metadata.title: Sales Tax and Federal Excise
metadata.summary: This notification exempts registered persons in specific districts from paying default surcharges and penalties on outstanding sales tax or federal excise duties. The exemption applies only if the principal amount of duty is paid by June 30, 2010, and explicitly excludes the cement, sugar, beverages, and cigarette sectors.

name: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2009
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary scales for the Chief Justice and other judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts of Pakistan. It also repeals the previous Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2009.

name: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Repeal) Act, 2010

metadata.title: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Repeal) Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000. It restores the application of the Civil Servants Act, 1973 and related rules for disciplinary matters concerning government servants.

name: S. R. O. 81(I)/2010 — Federal Excise Duty Exemption on Advertisements in Periodicals and Deposit of Collected Duty

metadata.title: The Federal Excise Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This notification exempts federal excise duty on advertisements in periodicals with immediate effect. It also directs that excise duty collected from July 1, 2009 until the date of this notification be deposited in the Government Treasury under the Federal Excise Act, 2005.

name: The Sacked Employees (Reinstatement) Ordinance, 2010

metadata.title: Sacked Employees (Reinstatement) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides relief to persons dismissed, removed, or terminated from corporation, autonomous, semi-autonomous, or Government service between November 1993 and December 1998. It mandates the immediate reinstatement of eligible employees on a scale higher than their substantive post at the time of termination.

name: S.R.O. 57(I)/2010 – Empowerment of Officers of DG Intelligence & Investigation under Federal Excise Act, 2005

metadata.title: FEDERAL EXCISE
metadata.summary: This notification invests officers of the Directorate-General of Intelligence and Investigation with powers under specific sections of the Federal Excise Act, 2005. It supersedes a previous notification dated July 1, 2005.

name: S. R. O. 56(I)/2010 — Appointment of Officers to Exercise Powers Under the Sales Tax Act, 1990 in Supersession of S.R.O. 48(I)/2008

metadata.title: Sales Tax S.R.O. 56(1)/2010
metadata.repeals: Notification No. S.R.O.48(1)2008
metadata.summary: This notification appoints specific officers of the Directorate General of Intelligence and Investigation to exercise powers under the Sales Tax Act, 1990. It supersedes Notification No. S.R.O.48(1)2008 by defining which officers can handle cases related to specified sections of the Act.

name: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Rules, 2009

metadata.title: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Rules, 2009
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority under the powers of section 39 of the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002. The document defines key terms related to broadcasting services, cable systems, and licensing, while also establishing procedures for Authority meetings.

name: The Alternative Energy Development Board Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Alternative Energy Development Board Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Alternative Energy Development Board (AEDB) as an autonomous body to implement policies and projects in alternative or renewable energy technologies. The AEDB aims to assist in the development and generation of such energy to achieve sustainable economic growth, foster technology transfer, and build an indigenous technological base.

name: The Institute of Space Technology Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Institute of Space Technology Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Institute of Space Technology in Islamabad as a degree-awarding body corporate. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, including the Chancellor, Senate, and various committees.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Private Education Institutions (Regulation and Promotion) Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Promotion) Ordinance, 2009
subjects: Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Regulatory Authority to oversee privately managed educational institutions in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It provides for the registration, regulation, and promotion of these institutions to ensure transparency, discipline, and uniform academic standards.

name: The Defence Housing Authority Islamabad Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Defence Housing Authority Islamabad Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Defence Housing Authority Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition and powers of the Governing Body and Executive Board responsible for the authority's administration.

name: The Trade Development Authority of Pakistan Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Trade Development Authority of Pakistan Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan under the administrative control of the Ministry of Commerce. It creates a body corporate dedicated to maximizing exports and providing structured support for trade policies and development initiatives.

name: The National Command Authority Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: National Command Authority Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Command Authority to provide complete command and control over research, development, production, and use of nuclear and space technologies. It defines the composition of the Authority, including the Prime Minister as Chairman and various ministers and military chiefs as members, and outlines its powers to supervise strategic organizations.

name: The Trade Organization Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The Trade Organizations Ordinance, 2009
metadata.repeals: The Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration and regulation of trade organizations across Pakistan. It establishes a licensing framework to ensure appropriate representation of all genders and business sectors while defining operational responsibilities and codes of corporate governance.

name: The Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of money laundering and the forfeiture of property derived from or involved in such activities. It establishes definitions for key terms including financial institutions, reporting entities, and predicate offences to facilitate investigation and prosecution by designated agencies.

name: The Pakistan Institute of Development Economics Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Pakistan Institute of Development Economics Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance grants degree-awarding status to the Pakistan Institute of Development Economics (PIDE) in Islamabad. It reconstitutes the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession, academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

name: The Competition Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The Competition Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for free competition in all spheres of commercial and economic activity to enhance efficiency and protect consumers from anti-competitive behavior. It establishes the Competition Commission of Pakistan to maintain and enhance competition while addressing matters connected therewith.

name: The National Disaster Management Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The National Disaster Management Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a National Disaster Management System for Pakistan to handle unforeseen situations effectively. It creates the National Disaster Management Commission, led by the Prime Minister, to formulate policies, plans, and guidelines for disaster management across the country.

name: The Arbitration (International Investment Disputes) Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Arbitration (International Investment Disputes) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance implements the International Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for the registration and enforcement of awards rendered under the Convention, granting them the same force as High Court judgments regarding pecuniary obligations.

name: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of the removal, storage, and transplantation of human organs and tissues for therapeutic purposes in Pakistan. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'brain dead' and 'donor', sets rules for living and post-mortem donations, and creates Evaluation Committees to oversee the process.

name: The Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority (ERRA) as an autonomous organization to manage post-disaster activities. It provides for damage assessment, recovery, reconstruction, and rehabilitation of areas affected by the earthquake.

name: The Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreement and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.repeals: Arbitration (Protocol and Convention) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recognition and enforcement of arbitration agreements and foreign arbitral awards in Pakistan pursuant to the United Nations Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards, 1958. It applies to the whole of Pakistan and comes into force immediately, deeming itself effective from October 3, 2007.

name: The Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan as a body corporate to protect intellectual property rights. It creates a Policy Board under the administrative control of the Federal Government and outlines the organization's functions, powers, and meeting procedures.

name: The Public Defender and Legal Aid Office Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The Public Defender and Legal Aid Office Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes and maintains a Public Defender and Legal Aid Office to provide free legal assistance, advice, and representation to indigent persons in Pakistan. It defines the roles of the Chief Public Defender, Additional Chief Public Defenders, District Public Defenders, and Public Defenders, outlining their appointment terms, qualifications, functions, and administrative control under the Government.

name: S. R. O. 803(I)/200.— Draft Amendment in the Income Tax Rules, 2002

metadata.title: S. R. O. 803 (I)/2009
metadata.summary: This order publishes a draft amendment to the Income Tax Rules, 2002, proposed by the Federal Board of Revenue. The amendment mandates electronic filing for income tax refunds in company cases starting from the Tax Year 2009 and requires mandatory electronic filing for companies and specified entities under section 170 of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001.

name: S. R. O. 802(I)/2009 — Exemption of Federal Excise Duty on Advertisements in Newspapers

metadata.title: S. R. O. 802 (I)/2009
metadata.summary: This notification exempts federal excise duty on advertisements in newspapers with immediate effect. It also directs that excise duty collected from July 1, 2009 until the date of issuance be deposited in the Government Treasury.

name: The Benazir Income Support Program Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Benazir Income Support Programme Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Benazir Income Support Programme as a body corporate to provide financial assistance and social protection to economically distressed persons and families. It outlines the programme's objectives, including enhancing the financial capacity of the poor, implementing targeted policies for underprivileged groups, and reducing poverty through equitable wealth distribution.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Uniform System of Accounts) Rules, 2009

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Uniform System of Accounts) Rules, 2009
metadata.summary: These rules establish a uniform system of accounts for licensees under the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA). They mandate the maintenance of separate books of accounts, the filing of quarterly, semi-annual, and annual regulatory reports, and the retention of records for ten years. The document also outlines penalties for non-compliance and procedures for exemptions based on small-scale operations.

name: The National Vocational and Technical Education Commission Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: National Vocational and Technical Education Commission Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Vocational and Technical Education Commission (NAVTEC) as an autonomous body to regulate, coordinate, and provide policy direction for technical and vocational education in Pakistan. It creates a Board with specific members from various ministries and the private sector to manage the Commission's affairs.

name: The Prevention of Electronic Crimes Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Prevention of Electronic Crimes Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of actions directed against the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic systems, networks, and data. It establishes mechanisms for the punishment of such actions as well as for the investigation, prosecution, and trial of related offences.

name: The Public Defender and Legal Aid Office Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The Public Defender and Legal Aid Office Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes and maintains a Public Defender and Legal Aid Office to provide free legal assistance, advice, and representation to indigent persons throughout Pakistan. It aims to promote justice by ensuring equal protection of law for those who cannot afford an advocate in courts or during police investigations.

name: The Customs / Sales Tax

metadata.title: The Customs / Sales Tax Federal Board of Revenue Notification
metadata.summary: This notification exempts customs duty and sales tax on the temporary importation of goods for subsequent exportation. It outlines specific conditions regarding applications, bank guarantees, processing timelines, and requirements for value addition before re-export.

name: The Sacked Employees (Reinstatement) Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The Sacked Employees (Reinstatement) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides relief to persons dismissed, removed, or terminated from corporation, autonomous, semi-autonomous, or Government service during specific periods between 1993 and 1998. It mandates the reinstatement of these employees on a scale higher than their substantive post at the time of termination.

name: The Pakistan Onshore Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Rules, 2009

metadata.title: The Pakistan Onshore Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Rules, 2009
metadata.summary: These rules regulate petroleum rights in the onshore areas of Pakistan, excluding those relating to Coal Bed Methane. They establish definitions for terms such as commercial discovery, exploration wells, and arms length sales, and provide frameworks for reconnaissance permits, exploration licences, and development leases.

name: The Benazir Income Support Program Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Benazir Income Support Programme Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Benazir Income Support Programme as a body corporate to provide financial assistance and social protection to economically distressed persons and families. It creates an autonomous authority to coordinate targeted programs aimed at reducing poverty and promoting equitable wealth distribution for low-income groups.

name: The Natural Gas (Well-head Price) Regulations, 2009.

metadata.title: The Natural Gas (Well-head Price) Regulations, 2009
metadata.summary: These regulations empower the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority to determine and notify well-head prices for natural gas. They establish procedures for producers to submit applications for price determination, define key terms related to gas production and sales, and outline penalties for non-compliance.

name: The Public Defender and Legal Aid Office Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The Public Defender and Legal Aid Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes and maintains the Public Defender and Legal Aid Office throughout Pakistan to provide free legal services to indigent persons. It creates a structured hierarchy of public defenders, including a Chief Public Defender, to ensure equal protection of law and advocate for an effective justice system.

name: The Prevention of Electronic Crimes Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Prevention of Electronic Crimes Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of actions directed against the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic systems, networks, and data. It establishes mechanisms for the investigation, prosecution, and trial of offences related to the misuse of such systems.

name: The Trade Organization Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: The Trade Organisations Ordinance, 2007
metadata.repeals: The Trade Organizations Ordinance 1961 (XLV of 1961)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration and regulation of trade organisations and business sectors at all levels in Pakistan. It establishes a framework to define the purpose, roles, and responsibilities of these organisations while ensuring they do not distribute profits to members.

name: The National Command Authority Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: National Command Authority Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Command Authority to exercise complete command and control over research, development, production, and use of nuclear and space technologies. It defines the composition of the Authority, including the President as Chairman and various ministers and military chiefs as members, and outlines its powers to supervise strategic organizations and manage related personnel matters.

name: The competition Commission of Pakistan (Service) Manual, 2007

metadata.title: Competition Commission of Pakistan (Service) Manual, 2007
metadata.summary: This document serves as the Service Manual for the Competition Commission of Pakistan, established under the Competition Ordinance, 2007. It outlines general definitions regarding posts and employees, along with specific regulations concerning appointments, promotions, adhoc positions, and deputation terms.

name: The Competition Commission (Expenditure and Investment) Regulations, 2007

metadata.title: Competition Commission (Expenditure and Investment) Regulations, 2007
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the Competition Commission (Expenditure and Investment) Regulations, 2007 to govern the financial administration of the Competition Commission of Pakistan. They define the CCP Fund, outline permissible expenditures, regulate loan raising powers, and prescribe accounting and auditing procedures for the Commission.

name: The Competition Commission of Pakistan (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2007

metadata.title: Competition Commission of Pakistan (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2007
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the short title and commencement date for the Competition Commission of Pakistan (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2007. They define the interpretation of terms by referencing the Competition Ordinance, 2007, and outline procedures for calling meetings, conducting business, recording minutes, and the roles of the Chairman and Secretary.

name: S.R.O. 1066(1)-2007 Notification Regarding Appointment of Members of the Federal Board of Revenue under the Federal Board of Revenue Act, 2007

metadata.title: Notification appointing members of the Federal Board of Revenue
metadata.summary: This notification appoints specific individuals as members of the Federal Board of Revenue in pursuance of the Federal Board of Revenue Act, 2007. The appointed members represent various functional areas including Income Tax, Sales Tax, Customs, Legal, and Audit.

name: S. R. O. 1071 (1)-2007 Notification for Distribution of Powers and Functions of the Federal Board of Revenue under the Federal Board of Revenue Rules, 2007

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 1071(1)/2007
metadata.summary: This notification distributes the necessary powers, functions, and business of the Federal Board of Revenue among its members. It assigns specific statutory duties to the Member (Direct Tax), Member (Sales tax and Federal Excise), and Member (Customs) based on their respective acts.

name: The Dawood College of Engineering and Technology, Karachi Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: The Dawood College of Engineering and Technology, Karachi Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance grants degree-awarding status to the Dawood College of Engineering and Technology, Karachi. It reconstitutes the college as a body corporate with perpetual succession, academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

name: The National Reconciliation Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: The National Reconciliation Ordinance, 2007
metadata.amends: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898; The Representation of the People Act, 1976; The National Accountability Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance aims to promote national reconciliation and remove the vestiges of political vendetta in Pakistan. It amends several existing laws, including the Code of Criminal Procedure and the National Accountability Ordinance, to allow for the withdrawal of prosecutions against individuals falsely involved due to political reasons and to establish special ethics committees.

name: The Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.repeals: Arbitration (Protocol and Convention) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recognition and enforcement of arbitration agreements and foreign arbitral awards in Pakistan pursuant to the United Nations Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards, 1958. It establishes exclusive jurisdiction for High Courts to adjudicate matters related to these awards and repeals the earlier Arbitration (Protocol and Convention) Act, 1937.

name: The Alternative Energy Development Board Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Alternative Energy Development Board Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Alternative Energy Development Board (AEDB) as an autonomous body to implement policies and projects in alternative or renewable energy technologies. It defines the Board's objectives, structure, and the appointment terms for its Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, and Members.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Promotion) Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Promotion) Ordinance, 2007
subjects: Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Regulatory Authority to register, regulate, and promote privately managed educational institutions in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It aims to ensure transparency, proper discipline, and uniformity in academic standards, curricula, and staff qualifications across these institutions.

name: The Trade Development Authority of Pakistan Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Trade Development Authority of Pakistan Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan as a body corporate under the administrative control of the Ministry of Commerce. It aims to promote exports, provide effective support for trade policies, and clarify institutional linkages between the government and the private sector.

name: The National Disaster Management Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: The National Disaster Management Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a national disaster management system for Pakistan to handle unforeseen situations arising from natural or man-made causes. It creates the National Disaster Management Commission, chaired by the Prime Minister, and outlines its powers to formulate policies, approve plans, and oversee funding for disaster mitigation.

name: The Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan as a body corporate to protect intellectual property rights. It creates a Policy Board responsible for setting objectives and administering the organization under the administrative control of the Cabinet Division.

name: The Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan (Re-organization and Conversion) Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan (Re-organization and Conversion) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the re-organization and conversion of the Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan into a public limited company incorporated under the Companies Ordinance, 1984. It establishes the new entity as 'Industrial Development Bank Limited' and facilitates the transfer of all assets, liabilities, contracts, and proceedings from the former bank to the new company.

name: The Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of money laundering and the forfeiture of property derived from or involved in such activities. It establishes definitions for key terms including financial institutions, predicate offences, and the Financial Monitoring Unit to facilitate investigation and prosecution.

name: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of the removal, storage, and transplantation of human organs and tissues for therapeutic purposes in Pakistan. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'brain dead', 'donor', and 'transplantation', while setting out rules for voluntary donation by living persons and deceased donors.

name: The Supreme Court Judges (Pensionary Benefits) Order, 2007

metadata.title: The Supreme Court Judges (Pensionary Benefits) Order, 2007
metadata.summary: This Order provides for pensionary benefits to Judges of the Supreme Court who ceased to hold office in pursuance of Article 3 of the Oath of Office (Judges) Order, 2007. metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Institute of Space Technology in Islamabad as a degree-awarding institution. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, including the Chancellor, Senate, and various councils.

name: The National Defence University Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: National Defence University Ordinance, 2006
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Defence University as a body corporate with perpetual succession. name: The Defence Housing Authority Islamabad Ordinance, 2007

metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Defence Housing Authority Islamabad as a body corporate to manage housing and development projects. It defines the composition of the Governing Body and Executive Board, outlining their respective powers and administrative functions.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Islamabad Capital Territory Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Promotion) Regulatory Authority to oversee private educational institutions in the territory. name: The Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Recognition and Enforcement (Arbitration Agreements and Foreign Arbitral Awards) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recognition and enforcement of arbitration agreements and foreign arbitral awards in Pakistan pursuant to the United Nations Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards, 1958. name: The Trade Development Authority of Pakistan Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Trade Development Authority of Pakistan Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan as a body corporate under the administrative control of the Ministry of Commerce. name: The National Vocational and Technical Education Commission Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: National Vocational and Technical Education Commission Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Vocational and Technical Education Commission to regulate, coordinate, and provide policy direction for technical and vocational education in Pakistan. name: The National Institute of Oceanography Act, 2007

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Institute of Oceanography as a body corporate to conduct research and promote marine sciences. It outlines the institute's functions, including data management, training programs, and coordination with international organizations.

name: The Alternative Energy Development Board Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Alternative Energy Development Board Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Alternative Energy Development Board (AEDB) as an autonomous body to implement policies and projects in alternative or renewable energy technologies. metadata.title: Pakistan Council of Research in Water Resources Act, 2007
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Council of Research in Water Resources to conduct, coordinate, and promote research in water resources. metadata.title: Notification No. F. 8(1)DBKG-IV/92

The exemption covers AAJHC's shareholding in Prime Commercial Bank Limited and was issued based on recommendations from the State Bank of Pakistan.

name: The Cantonments Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Cantonments Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to cantonments in Pakistan. It also reconstructs and regulates local self-government within cantonment areas.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Delegation of Powers) Regulations, 2002

metadata.title: The Privatisation Commission (Delegation of Powers) Regulations, 2002
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for delegating specific powers and functions to the Chairman, Secretary, and officers of the Privatisation Commission. They define the scope of delegated authority, outline conditions under which cases must be referred to the Board or Chairman for approval, and specify procedures for exercising discretion.

name: The National Institute of Folk and Traditional Heritage (Lok Virsa) Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: National Institute of Folk and Traditional Heritage (Lok Virsa) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the reconstitution of the National Institute of Folk and Traditional Heritage (Lok Virsa). Its primary purpose is to effectively preserve indigenous cultural heritage and project the true identity of Pakistan through research, documentation, and the promotion of living arts and crafts.

name: S. R.O. 800 (I)/2002. Notification of Wellhead Price of Sara/Suri Gas Supplied to WAPDA

metadata.title: Notification No. S.R.O. 806 (5/2602)
metadata.summary: This notification fixes the wellhead price for Sara/Suri gas sold by Tullow (Pakistan) Developments Limited to the Water and Power Development Authority. The agreed rate is set at Rs. 87.34 per Mcft, effective from July 1, 2002.

name: The Pakistan Postal Services Management Board Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Pakistan Postal Services Management Board Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Postal Services Management Board to manage the Pakistan Post Office Department. It defines the Board's structure, membership composition, appointment terms, and administrative powers.

name: The National Textile University Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The National Textile University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Textile University at a national level to provide education and research facilities in textile technology. It creates an autonomous body with powers to determine courses, award degrees, conduct research, and affiliate with other institutions.

name: Prudential Regulations for Infrastructure Project Financing (IPF)

metadata.title: Prudential Regulations for Infrastructure Project Financing (IPF)
metadata.summary: These Prudential Regulations establish guidelines for banks and Development Financial Institutions (DFIs) to assess the cash flow generating capacity of infrastructure projects. They emphasize technical feasibility, comprehensive risk assessment, project insurance, and monitoring during the loan tenure. The regulations also address environmental impact considerations and encourage the adoption of Islamic banking modes for infrastructure financing.

name: The Natural Gas Tariff Rules, 2002

metadata.title: The Natural Gas Tariff Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority under the powers of section 41 of the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002. They establish procedures for determining natural gas tariffs, defining key terms related to licensing and consumer categories, and outlining requirements for licensees to file petitions regarding revenue requirements and tariff modifications.

name: The Armed Forces Civil General Transport Companies and Requisition of Civil Transport Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Armed Forces Civil General Transport Companies and Requisition of Civil Transport Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the raising of civil general transport companies and the requisition of civil transport for the Armed Forces. It allows these actions to be taken at short notice to meet logistics requirements before a formal declaration of emergency, specifically in response to unpredictable adversary activities.

name: The Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to boilers and pressure vessels in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'boiler', 'pressure vessel', and 'manufacturer' while establishing regulations for their design, manufacture, inspection, and registration.

name: The Federal Universities Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Federal Universities Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution and restructuring of universities set up by the Federal Government in Pakistan. Its primary objective is to grant autonomy to these institutions while improving governance and management to enhance the quality of higher education.

name: The Federal Urdu University of Arts, Sciences and Technology, Islamabad Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Federal Urdu University of Arts, Sciences and Technology, Islamabad Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the Federal Urdu University of Arts, Sciences and Technology in Islamabad. It defines the university's structure, including its constituent colleges, authorities, and governing bodies such as the Senate and Syndicate.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Agricultural Produce Markets Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the better regulation of the purchase and sale of agricultural products within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes markets for these products and defines key terms such as 'agricultural produce', 'dealer', and 'market' to facilitate this regulation.

name: The Higher Education Commission Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Higher Education Commission Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Higher Education Commission to improve and promote higher education, research, and development in Pakistan. It defines the Commission as a body corporate with perpetual succession, headquartered in Islamabad, and outlines its composition including a Chairperson, Secretary, and various nominated members.

name: The Virtual University Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Virtual University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Virtual University of Pakistan with its principal seat in Islamabad. It grants the university corporate status and powers to provide instruction, conduct research, award degrees, and utilize emerging technologies like satellite and internet for education.

name: The Electronic Transactions Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Electronic Transactions Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recognition and facilitation of documents, records, information, communications, and transactions in electronic form. It also establishes a framework for the accreditation and certification of service providers to ensure the authenticity and integrity of electronic data.

name: The Aga Khan University Examination Board Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Aga Khan University Examination Board Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Aga Khan University Examination Board to conduct examinations at various academic levels across Pakistan and abroad. It grants the Board autonomy to develop assessment methods, administer tests in multiple languages, and collaborate with other educational bodies while following national curricula.

name: The Listed Companies (Substantial Acquisition of Voting Shares and Takeovers) Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Listed Companies (Substantial Acquisition of Voting Shares and Take-overs) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for a fair and equal treatment to investors and establishes an efficient system for the substantial acquisition of voting shares and take-overs of listed companies. It was promulgated by the President under emergency provisions to address immediate circumstances requiring action.

name: The Press Newspapers, News Agencies and Books Registration Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Press, Newspapers, News Agencies and Books Registration Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to news agencies, publications, and printing presses in Pakistan. It establishes a regulatory framework requiring declarations from printers, publishers, and news agencies to operate legally.

name: The Protection of Breast Feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Protection of Breast-feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance aims to ensure adequate nutrition for infants and young children by promoting breastfeeding and regulating the marketing of designated products. It establishes definitions for terms such as 'infant', 'designated product', and 'health worker' while prohibiting the sale or promotion of feeding bottles, teats, and pacifiers.

name: The Foundation University Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Foundation University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Foundation University at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, and Board of Governors, and grants it powers to provide instruction, conduct research, admit students, and award degrees regardless of religion or race.

name: The Karachi Port Security Force Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Karachi Port Security Force Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution, regulation, and establishment of the Karachi Port Security Force. It outlines the force's functions to maintain law and order, prevent offenses within port limits, and ensure safety for goods and property in the Karachi Port Area.

name: The Associated Press of Pakistan Corporation Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Associated Press of Pakistan Corporation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Associated Press of Pakistan as a corporation to ensure its effective operation and streamline its management. It aims to add professionalism, independence, and autonomy to the agency to enable it to obtain international services and build trust among the public.

name: No. 109 - No. 4-15-98-Min.I - Transfer of administrative control of Pakistan Telecommunication Authority to Cabinet Division

metadata.title: Notification transferring administrative control of Pakistan Telecommunication Authority
metadata.summary: This notification transfers the administrative control of the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority from the Ministry of Science and Technology to the Cabinet Division. The transfer is effective immediately as of October 15, 2002.

name: The Cantonments Local Government (Elections) Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Cantonments Local Government (Elections) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conduct of local government elections in cantonments to ensure grassroots participation. It establishes adequate linkages and fiscal arrangements between Cantonment Local Government and the District Government, adhering to the spirit of the Cantonment Act, 1924.

name: The Gwadar Port Authority Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Gwadar Port Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Gwadar Port Authority as a body corporate to manage the Gwadar Deep Water Port. It provides for the planning, construction, operation, management, and maintenance of the port area and associated facilities.

name: The Riphah International University Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Riphah International University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of Riphah International University at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's powers, including instruction, research, degree conferral, and the ability to establish campuses abroad.

name: No. 109 - No. (not found) - Cabinet Division notification (text unreadable)

metadata.title: Notification No. 4-15/98-Min. I
metadata.summary: This notification transfers the administrative control of the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority from the Ministry of Science and Technology to the Cabinet Division. The transfer is effective immediately.

name: The Prohibition of Smoking and Protection of Non-Smokers Health Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Prohibition of Smoking and Protection of Non-Smokers Health Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits smoking and other tobacco uses in places of public work or use and in public service vehicles to protect the health of non-smokers. It also bans the advertisement of tobacco products, restricts sales to minors, and limits the storage and distribution of cigarettes near educational institutions.

name: The Islamabad Transfusion of Safe Blood Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Islamabad Transfusion of Safe Blood Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the transfusion of safe and healthy blood and blood products in the Islamabad Capital Territory to prevent the spread of viruses and infective agents. It establishes the Islamabad Blood Transfusion Authority to oversee the registration, licensing, and monitoring of blood banks within the territory.

name: The National Judicial (Policy Making) Committee Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: National Judicial (Policy Making) Committee Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Judicial (Policy Making) Committee to coordinate and harmonize judicial policy across Pakistan. The Committee is headed by the Chief Justice of Pakistan and includes members from federal and provincial courts, with functions focused on improving judicial performance and setting service standards.

name: The Agricultural Development Bank of Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Agricultural Development Bank of Pakistan (Reorganization and Conversion) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the reorganization and conversion of the Agricultural Development Bank of Pakistan into a public limited company incorporated under the Companies Ordinance, 1984. It aims to ensure good governance, autonomy, and the delivery of high-quality financial services while transferring all assets, liabilities, and undertakings of the bank to the new company.

name: The Federally Administrative Tribal Areas Local Government (Elections) Regulation, 2002

metadata.title: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas Local Government (Elections) Regulation, 2002
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for holding elections to establish local governments in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas and Frontier Regions. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan under emergency powers following the October 1999 proclamation.

name: The Prevention and Control of Human Trafficking Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Prevention and Control of Human Trafficking Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to prevent and control human trafficking and to protect victims. It defines key terms such as 'human trafficking', 'victim', and 'organized criminal group' and establishes punishments for various offences related to trafficking, including slavery, forced labour, and child exploitation.

name: The Cotton Standardization Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Cotton Standardization Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Cotton Standards Institute to promote quality control of cotton and related matters. It defines key terms such as 'bale', 'cotton', and 'grade' while setting up a Board of Directors comprising representatives from various government ministries, agricultural departments, and industry associations.

name: The Health Services Academy Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Health Services Academy Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Health Services Academy in Islamabad as an autonomous body with perpetual succession. It outlines the academy's functions, which include providing instruction and training in health sciences, conducting research, and awarding degrees in collaboration with Quaid-i-Azam University.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conduct of local government elections in the Islamabad Capital Territory and related matters. It defines key terms such as 'local area', 'Council', and 'elector', and establishes the composition of local areas including Unions and the City District.

name: The Defamation Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Defamation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal provisions regarding defamation and matters connected thereto in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as author, editor, publisher, and distinguishes between slander and libel while establishing specific defences and privileges.

name: S. R. O. 647(I)/2002. Notification Regarding Determination of Prescribed Prices and Maximum Ex-Depot Sale Prices of Petroleum Products

metadata.summary: This notification determines the prescribed prices, maximum ex-depot sale prices, and various margins for petroleum products refined in Pakistan and imported. It applies to High Speed Diesel sold through retail outlets and directly to consumers across specified locations.

name: The Election of Members of Senate from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas (Repeal) Order, 2002

metadata.title: Conduct of General Elections (Tenth Amendment) Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002 by substituting a clause regarding the election of members from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It also omits Article 8C of the said Order.

name: The Defence Housing Authority Lahore Order, 2002

metadata.title: Defence Housing Authority Lahore Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the reconstitution of the Defence Housing Authority at Lahore. It establishes the Authority as a body corporate and defines its management structure, including the Governing Body and Executive Board.

name: The Legal Framework (Removal of Difficulty) Order, 2002

metadata.title: Legal Framework (Removal of Difficulty) Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order was promulgated by the Chief Executive to remove difficulties arising from the inability to summon sessions of all four provincial Assemblies on the same day. It authorizes the Governor to continue acting in their capacity until the Chief Minister takes the oath of office, notwithstanding any provisions in the Constitution or other laws.

name: The Election of Members of Senate from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas Order, 2002

metadata.title: Election of Members of Senate from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the conduct and manner of elections for members of the Senate from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It defines key terms related to candidates, election agents, and polling procedures, and empowers the Election Commission to organize these elections.

name: Exemption of National Bank of Pakistan from Section 19 Regarding Cash Dividend Payment for 2001 — Notification No. F. 1(4)BKG.III/2002/2407-1522

metadata.title: Notification No. F. 1(4)BKG, 111|2002|2407-1522
metadata.summary: This notification declares that Section 19 of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 does not apply to the National Bank of Pakistan regarding cash dividends for the year ended December 31, 2001. The declaration was made by the Federal Government in exercise of powers under Section 93 of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962, based on a recommendation from the State Bank of Pakistan.

name: The Legal Framework Order, 2002

metadata.title: Legal Framework Order, 2002
metadata.amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973
metadata.summary: This Order provides for a smooth transition following general elections scheduled for October and November 2002. It amends the Constitution of 1973 to revive it with specific changes regarding political parties, the Chief Executive's role, and the election of office-bearers.

name: Exemption of Platinum Commercial Bank Limited from Section 14(1)(iv) Regarding Voting Rights — S.R.O. 101(I)/2002

metadata.summary: This notification declares that specific provisions regarding voting rights under the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 do not apply to Platinum Commercial Bank Limited. The exemption concerns the management of Pak-Libya Holding Company's shareholding in the bank.

It is issued under the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002, superseding a previous notification dated January 22, 2002.

The prices are set at Rs. 106.77 per BTU for the ex-Bhangali area and Rs. 38.88 per Mcf for the ex-Dhurnal area, effective from July 1, 2002.

name: The Police Order, 2002

metadata.title: The Police Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order is promulgated by the Chief Executive to reconstruct and regulate the police force in Pakistan. It establishes the police's obligation to function according to the Constitution, laws, and democratic aspirations while defining their roles, duties, and responsibilities.

name: The Small and Medium Enterprises Development Authority Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Small and Medium Enterprises Development Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Small and Medium Enterprises Development Authority as an autonomous body under the Federal Government. Its primary purpose is to encourage and facilitate the development and growth of small and medium enterprises in Pakistan through policy making, resource provision, and support services.

name: The Transfer of Offenders Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Transfer of Offenders Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of Pakistani citizens convicted abroad to Pakistan and foreign citizens convicted in Pakistan to their home countries. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'offender', 'Competent Authority', and 'specified country' to facilitate these transfers based on mutual agreements.

name: S. R. O. 466(I)/2002. Notification Regarding Declaration of Prescribed Prices for Mari Gas Company Limited

metadata.title: S.R.O. 466(D/2002
metadata.summary: This notification prescribes applicable prices for Mari Gas Company Limited regarding specific consumers under the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002. It supersedes a previous Federal Government Notification dated March 21, 2002, to the extent of its application to Mari Gas Company Limited.

name: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas Local Government Elections Order, 2002

metadata.title: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas Local Government Elections Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the Chief Election Commissioner to conduct local government elections in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It grants the Commissioner authority over electoral roll preparation, ward delimitation, and necessary procedural measures, while also providing legal protections for actions taken in good faith under this Order.

name: The Safeguard Measures Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Safeguard Measures Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides a legal framework for imposing safeguard measures in Pakistan to address serious injury or threat of serious injury caused by increased imports. It aims to give effect to Article XIX of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, 1940, and the Agreement on Safeguards. The document establishes definitions for key terms like 'domestic industry' and outlines the process for investigating imported products.

name: The National Commission for Human Development Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: National Commission for Human Development Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Commission for Human Development as an autonomous body to implement social sector programmes. Its objectives include supporting government departments and NGOs in areas such as primary education, literacy, income generation, and basic health care services.

name: The Political Parties Order, 2002

metadata.title: The Political Parties Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the formation, organization, and regulation of political parties in Pakistan to foster a democratic environment. It establishes requirements for party constitutions, membership rules, and prohibits foreign-aided parties or those undermining national sovereignty.

name: The Privatisation Commission Staff Car Regulations, 2002

metadata.title: Privatisation Commission Staff Car Regulations, 2002
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the purchase, maintenance, and use of staff cars by the Privatisation Commission. They define eligible officers, specify conditions for official and private use, set petrol limits, and outline procedures for requisitioning vehicles.

name: The Small Claims and Minor Offences Courts Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Small Claims and Minor Offences Courts Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and enacts the law relating to small claims and minor offences in Pakistan. It establishes Small Claims and Minor Offences Courts with exclusive jurisdiction over suits not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees and specific minor offences, aiming for inexpensive and expeditious disposal.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Fees pertaining to Tariff Standards and Procedure) Regulations, 2002

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Fees pertaining to Tariff Standards and Procedure) Regulations, 2002
metadata.summary: This document notifies the regulations concerning fees for the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority related to tariff standards and procedures. It establishes specific fee amounts for various categories of licensees, consumers, and requests, effective immediately upon notification.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Members Travelling Allowance/ Daily Allowance) Regulations, 2001

metadata.title: Privatisation Commission (Members Travelling Allowance/Daily Allowance) Regulations, 2001
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the entitlement to travelling and daily allowances for members of the Board of the Privatisation Commission. They define specific allowance rates for official and non-official members, including airfare, railfare, taxi charges, and hotel accommodation costs.
