metadata.title: The Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This notification specifies M/s. Pak-Oman Investment Company (Pvt.) Limited under section 3A of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962. It was issued by the Federal Government's Finance Division on May 13, 2002.

name: The Public Procurement Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Public Procurement Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Public Procurement Regulatory Authority to regulate the procurement of goods, services, and works in the public sector. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to improve governance, management, transparency, and accountability in public procurement processes.

name: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas Compulsory Primary Education Regulation, 2002

metadata.title: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas Compulsory Primary Education Regulation, 2002
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes compulsory primary education for children aged five to ten years in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It defines key terms such as 'child', 'parent', and 'primary education', mandates parental attendance, outlines reasonable excuses for non-attendance, and prescribes penalties for parents or employers who fail to comply with school attendance orders.

name: Exemption of Meezan Bank Limited from Section 14(1)(iv) Regarding Voting Rights — S.R.O. 56(I)/2002

metadata.title: Notification regarding exemption for Meezan Bank Limited and Societe Generale Bank under the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This notification declares that specific provisions of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962, do not apply to Meezan Bank Limited regarding voting rights held by designated foreign and Islamic banks. It also exempts Societe Generale Bank from shareholder approval requirements for its merger with Meezan Bank Limited, subject to other legal terms and State Bank approval.

name: The National Education Foundation Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The National Education Foundation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Education Foundation as a body corporate to restructure and manage educational initiatives in Pakistan. Its primary objective is to provide quality education through public-private partnerships, specifically targeting disadvantaged groups including children below the poverty line, minorities, and those in remote rural areas.

name: The Referendum Order, 2002

metadata.title: Referendum Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order provides for a referendum to be held on April 30, 2002, asking citizens if they support General Pervez Musharraf continuing as President of Pakistan. It establishes the Election Commission and Returning Officers to conduct the vote across the whole of Pakistan as a single constituency.

name: No. 108 - No. 1(4)/2002-CDN - Merger of the Department of Petroleum and Energy Resources with the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources

metadata.title: Notification No. 1(4)|2002|CDN
subjects: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources
metadata.summary: This notification announces the decision to merge the Department of Petroleum and Energy Resources with the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources. The merger is effective from July 1, 2002, following approval by the competent authority based on recommendations from the Committee on Restructuring and Rightsizing.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority (Pakistan Origin Card) Rules, 2002

metadata.title: The National Database and Registration Authority (Pakistan Origin Card) Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules were framed by the Federal Government under powers conferred by the National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000. They establish procedures for registering eligible foreigners of Pakistan origin and their family members to issue Pakistan Origin Cards as proof of digital identity.

name: The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority to foster competition and increase private investment in the petroleum industry. It aims to protect public interest while respecting individual rights and providing effective regulations for matters connected therewith.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Compulsory Primary Education Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Compulsory Primary Education Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes compulsory primary education for children aged five to ten years in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines the roles of parents and a Union Committee on Education, outlines procedures for enforcing school attendance, and prescribes penalties for non-compliance.

name: The Privatisation Commission Employees (Appointment and Terms and Conditions of Service) Regulations, 2002

metadata.title: Privatisation Commission Employees (Appointment and Terms and Conditions of Service) Regulations, 2002
metadata.summary: These regulations provide for the appointment of officers and staff members of the Privatisation Commission. They also establish the terms and conditions of service for these employees, excluding the Chairman and Secretary.

name: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (PEMRA) to regulate broadcast and cable television stations in Pakistan. It aims to improve media standards, enlarge content choices, facilitate public access to mass media, and ensure transparency in governance.

name: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2002

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2002
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 1998
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the monthly salaries for the Chief Justice and other judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts of Pakistan. It also repeals the previous Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 1998.

name: The Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002

metadata.title: Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the conduct of general elections in Pakistan to elect members of the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies. It outlines the allocation of seats, including those reserved for women and technocrats, and establishes procedures for electoral rolls and constituency delimitation under emergency powers.

name: The Natural Gas Regulatory Authority (Lincencing) Rules, 2002

metadata.title: The Natural Gas Regulatory Authority (Licencing) Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules establish the licensing framework for the Natural Gas Regulatory Authority (NGRA) under the powers of the Natural Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2000. They define key terms related to gas infrastructure and operations, set criteria for granting licenses, and outline the Authority's duty to balance consumer and licensee interests.

name: No. 107 - No. F.1(17)-AR.II/99 & F.1(17)-AR.III/99 - Declaration of the Chief Commissionerate for Afghan Refugees, Islamabad as an Attached Department of the KANA & States Frontier Regions Division

metadata.title: Declaration of Chief Commissionerate for Afghan Refugees Islamabad as an Attached Department of the Kashmir and States Frontier Regions Division
metadata.summary: This notification declares the Chief Commissionerate for Afghan Refugees (CCAR) in Islamabad as an attached department of the Kashmir and States Frontier Regions Division. It withdraws a previous office order from August 2000 and assigns specific functions to the revived CCAR, including monitoring programs, issuing NOCs for vehicles, managing UNHCR warehouses, and coordinating repatriation efforts.

name: No. 107 - No. F.1(17)-AR.II/99 & F.1(17)-AR.III/99 - Declaration of the Chief Commissionerate for Afghan Refugees, Islamabad as an Attached Department of the KANA & States Frontier Regions Division

metadata.title: Declaration of Chief Commissionerate for Afghan Refugees Islamabad as an Attached Department of the Kashmir and States Frontier Regions Division
metadata.summary: This notification declares the Chief Commissionerate for Afghan Refugees (CCAR) in Islamabad as an attached department of the Kashmir and States Frontier Regions Division. It withdraws a previous office order from August 2000 and assigns specific functions to the revived CCAR, including monitoring programs, issuing NOCs for vehicles, managing UNHCR warehouses, and coordinating repatriation efforts.

name: The Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance protects the communal properties of minority communities in Pakistan from unauthorized sale, transfer, or purchase. It mandates that any transaction involving such properties requires a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Federal Government, issued based on recommendations from the National Commission for Minorities.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority's (Fines) Rules, 2002

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Fines) Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules empower the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority to impose financial penalties on delinquents who violate the Act or applicable documents. The document outlines the procedure for seeking explanations, admitting violations, and issuing show cause notices before fines are imposed.

name: The Private Security Companies Rules, 2001

metadata.title: The Private Security Companies Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Chief Commissioner of Islamabad Capital Territory under the Private Security Companies Ordinance, 2001 to regulate private security companies. They establish procedures for granting licenses, defining terms like 'applicant' and 'Ordinance', and setting requirements for staff employment, training, and possession of arms.

name: The National Kashmir Committee Order, 2002

metadata.title: The National Kashmir Committee Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order constitutes the National Kashmir Committee to project the Kashmir cause internationally and mobilize world opinion for its settlement. It outlines the committee's composition, appointment procedures, terms of office, privileges, allowances, and administrative arrangements.

name: The Election Commission Order, 2002

metadata.title: The Election Commission Order, 2002
metadata.repeals: The Extension in the term of Chief Election Commissioner Order, 2000 (Chief Executive Order No. 9 of 2000)
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Election Commission of Pakistan, defining its composition, powers, and duties during the state of emergency. It outlines the appointment criteria for the Chief Election Commissioner and provides for an Acting Commissioner when the office is vacant or the holder is unable to perform functions.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Hiring of Financial Advisor) Regulations, 2001

metadata.title: Privatisation Commission (Hiring of Financial Advisor) Regulations, 2001
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedures for the Privatisation Commission to hire a financial advisor for major privatisations. They define key terms, outline the initiation and advertising processes, and detail the steps for short-listing interested parties and evaluating their technical and financial proposals.

name: The Federal Investigation Agency (Inquiries and Investigations) Rules, 2002

metadata.title: The Federal Investigation Agency (Inquiries and Investigations) Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules outline the procedures for the Federal Investigation Agency to initiate inquiries and investigations, either on its own initiative or upon receiving complaints. They define key terms, establish authority hierarchies based on pay scales for approving actions against public servants, and set protocols for case registration, dropping cases, and reporting arrests.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority Employees (Service) Regulations, 2002

metadata.title: National Database and Registration Authority Employees (Service) Regulations, 2002
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes the terms and conditions of service for employees of the National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA). It specifically addresses the need to provide continuity and regulate the service of contractual technical and professional personnel who have gained on-job experience. The regulations apply to all NADRA employees unless an option is exercised pursuant to a specific clause.

name: NA- The National Database and Registration Authority (Application for National Identity Card) Regulations, 2002

metadata.title: National Database and Registration Authority (Application for National Identity Card) (Amendment) Regulations, 2020
metadata.amends: National Database and Registration Authority (Application for National Identity Card) Regulations, 2002
metadata.summary: This notification amends the National Database and Registration Authority (Application for National Identity Card) Regulations, 2002 to update definitions regarding data acquisition units and relevant information. It introduces provisions for electronic fee deposits, requires non-Muslim applicants to make specific declarations, and updates regulations concerning biometric data acquisition and application forms.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority (National Identity Card) Rules, 2002

metadata.title: The National Database and Registration Authority (National Identity Card) Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the powers of the National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000 to regulate the issuance and management of National Identity Cards. They define key terms such as biometrics, digital identity, and family composition data relevant to the Citizen Database.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Valuation of Property) Rules, 2001

metadata.title: The Privatisation Commission (Valuation of Property) Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Privatisation Commission with the approval of the Federal Government to establish procedures for the valuation of property being privatised. They define key terms such as 'adviser' and 'valuer', outline the manner in which valuations are conducted, and describe the process for preparing valuation notes and recommending reference prices to the Cabinet.

name: The Juvenile Justice Rules, 2001

metadata.title: The Juvenile Justice Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Pakistan to establish procedures for juvenile justice within the Islamabad Capital Territory. They define key terms, outline the establishment and management of borstal institutions, and set standards for legal assistance and the admission of juveniles.

name: The Import of Engineering Goods (Control) Order, 2001

metadata.title: Import of Engineering Goods (Control) Order, 2001
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the import of engineering goods in Pakistan by granting price preferences to bidders offering locally manufactured items. It mandates public sector agencies to procure requirements from within the country and encourages local industry through specific financial incentives and development contracts.

name: No. 106 - No. 4-15/89-Min - Endorsement of the Cabinet Division memorandum to the Law, Justice and Human Rights Division

metadata.title: Copy of the Cabinet Division's Memorandum
metadata.summary: This document is a copy of a memorandum from the Cabinet Division dated November 26, 2001. It was endorsed for information purposes by the Law, Justice and Human Rights Division in December 2001.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Hiring of Valuers) Regulations, 2001

metadata.title: Privatisation Commission (Hiring of Valuers) Regulations, 2001
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the Privatisation Commission to hire independent valuers for assessing properties being privatised. They define key terms such as 'Ordinance' and 'Valuer', outline the procedure for selecting a valuer from an approved panel based on quoted rates, and specify the required terms of reference for valuation.

name: Exemption of Saudi-Pak Commercial Bank Limited from Section 14(1)(i) Regarding Voting Rights — S.R.O. 754(I)/2001

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 754 (1)/2001
metadata.summary: This notification declares that specific provisions regarding voting rights under the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 do not apply to the Saudi-Pak Commercial Bank Limited. The exemption relates specifically to the management of the Saudi Pak Industrial and Agricultural Investment Company.

name: Exemption of Saudi-Pak Commercial Bank Limited from Section 14(1)(i) Regarding Voting Rights — S.R.O. 754(I)/2001

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 754 (1)/2001
metadata.summary: This notification declares that specific provisions regarding voting rights under the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 do not apply to the Saudi-Pak Commercial Bank Limited. The exemption relates specifically to the management of the Saudi Pak Industrial and Agricultural Investment Company.

name: Exemption of Bank Alfalah Limited from Section 14(1)(iv) Regarding Voting Rights — S.R.O. 755(I)/2001

metadata.title: S.R.O. 755(I/2001
metadata.summary: This notification declares that specific provisions regarding voting rights under Section 14 of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 do not apply to Bank Alfalah Limited. The decision was made by the Federal Government on the recommendation of the State Bank of Pakistan.

name: The Regional Development Finance Corporation and Small Business Finance Corporation (Amalgamation and Conversion) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: Regional Development Finance Corporation and Small Business Finance Corporation (Amalgamation and Conversion) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the amalgamation of the Regional Development Finance Corporation (RDFC) and the Small Business Finance Corporation (SBFC). It further mandates their conversion into a single public limited company under the Companies Ordinance, 1984.

name: The Microfinance Institutions Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Microfinance Institutions Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the establishment, business, and operations of microfinance institutions in Pakistan. It aims to promote these institutions to provide financial support to poor persons, particularly women, for poverty mitigation and social welfare.

name: No. 105 - No. F.1(22)-AR.III/2001 - Endorsement of the Kashmir Affairs & Northern Affairs notification to the Law, Justice and Human Rights Division

metadata.title: Notification No.F.1(22)-AR.III/2001
metadata.summary: This document is a notification dated October 9, 2001, issued by the Section Officer of the Law, Justice and Human Rights Division in Islamabad. It serves to endorse a copy of the Kashmir Affairs & Northern Areas Notification No.F.1(22)-AR.III/2001 for information purposes.

name: No. 104 - No. F.1(22)-AR.IV/2001 - Revival of the Office of the Chief Commissioner, Afghan Refugees, Islamabad as an Attached Department under the Kashmir Affairs and SAFRON Division

metadata.title: Revival of the Office of the Chief Commissioner, Afghan Refugees
metadata.summary: This notification revives the Office of the Chief Commissioner for Afghan Refugees in Islamabad with immediate effect. The office is established as an Attached Department under the Kashmir Affairs and Northern Areas and States and Frontier Regions Division.

name: The Pakistan Merchant Shipping Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: Merchant Shipping Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to merchant shipping in Pakistan. It also provides for matters connected therewith and incidental thereto, including ship registration, nationality, and coastal shipping operations.

name: No. 103 - No. 1/7/86-ICT-I - Declaration of the Office of the Chief Commissioner, Islamabad Capital Territory, as an Attached Department of the Ministry of Interior

metadata.title: Notification No. 1|7|86-ICT
metadata.summary: This notification declares the Office of the Chief Commissioner, Islamabad Capital Territory, as an Attached Department of the Ministry of Interior. The change takes effect from March 16, 2009.

name: The Income Tax Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: Income Tax Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to income tax in Pakistan. It provides for matters ancillary to income tax and defines key terms such as accumulated profits, assessment, and dividend distributions.

name: The Pakistan Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Rules, 2001

metadata.title: The Pakistan Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These Rules are made under the powers of section 2 of the Regulation of Mines and Oil fields and Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948. They establish regulations for petroleum exploration, production, permits, licences, and leases within Pakistan.

name: The Financial Institutions (Recovery of Finances) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Financial Institutions (Recovery of Finance) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.repeals: The Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans, Advances, Credits and Finances), Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans, Advances, Credits and Finances), Act, 1997, with certain modifications. It defines key terms such as 'financial institution', 'customer', and 'finance' to establish duties for customers regarding their obligations to financial institutions.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Tax on Services) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Tax on Services) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy of sales tax on services rendered or provided within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a fifteen percent tax rate and extends various provisions of the Sales Tax Act, 1990 to its collection and enforcement.

name: The Pakistan Madrasah, Education (Establishment and Affiliation of Model Dini Madaris) Board Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: Pakistan Madrasah Education (Establishment and Affiliation of Model Dini Madaris) Board Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Madrasah Education Board to oversee Model Dini Madaris and ensure uniformity in educational standards. It aims to integrate specialized Islamic education with the general education system while maintaining the autonomous character of these institutions.

name: The Privatisation (Modes and Procedure) Rules, 2001

metadata.title: The Privatisation (Modes and Procedure) Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules establish the manner and procedure for carrying out the privatisation programme under the Privatisation Commission Ordinance, 2000. They define specific terms such as 'adviser' and 'negotiated sale process', outline steps for due diligence and bidding, and set forth additional modes of privatisation including public offerings and sales to parties with pre-emptive rights.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Authentication of Documents Under Common Seal) Regulations, 2001

metadata.title: The Privatisation Commission (Authentication of Documents Under Common Seal) Regulations, 2001
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedures for authenticating documents under the common seal of the Privatisation Commission. They define key terms, specify which documents require authentication, and outline the requirements for maintaining a register of authenticated documents.

name: Exemption of Specified Banks from Section 14(iv) of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 — Notification No. F. 1(3) BKG (R&S)/2001-999

metadata.title: Notification exempting National Bank of Pakistan, Habib Bank Limited, United Bank Limited and Allied Bank of Pakistan from section 14(iv) of the Banking Companies Ordinance 1962
metadata.summary: This notification exempts four specific banks from the provisions of section 14(iv) of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962. The exemption is granted by the Federal Government on the recommendation of the State Bank of Pakistan and takes immediate effect.

name: The Oil and Gas Development Corporation (Re-organization) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: Oil and Gas Development Corporation (Re-organization) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conversion of the Oil and Gas Development Corporation into a public limited company named Oil and Gas Development Company Limited. It clarifies that all assets, liabilities, rights, and pending legal proceedings of the Corporation are automatically transferred to the new Company as of its incorporation date.

name: The Duty and Tax Remission for Export

metadata.title: Duty and Tax Remission for Exports
metadata.summary: This document establishes Sub-Chapter 7 of Chapter XII of the Customs Rules 2001, outlining the framework for duty and tax remission for exports (DTRE). It defines key terms such as 'acquisition', 'export', and 'Regulatory Authority' while specifying eligibility criteria for exporters and restrictions on certain goods like raw sugar and cooking oil.

name: The Customs Rules, 2001

metadata.title: The Customs Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules consolidate various customs procedures and regulations applicable in Pakistan. They cover topics including definitions, import/export processes, valuation methods, warehousing, and dispute resolution mechanisms.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 2001. It amends the Central Excises Act, 1944, and the Petroleum products (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1961.

name: No. 101 - No. 4-1/2001-Min - Allocation of Anti Dumping Duties, Countervailing and Safeguard Laws to the Commerce Division

metadata.title: Allocation of the Subject 'Anti Dumping Duties, Countervailing and Safeguard Laws'
metadata.summary: This order allocates the subject 'Anti Dumping Duties, Countervailing and Safeguard Laws' to the Commerce Division. It directs that necessary amendments will be made to the Rules of Business, 1973 in due course.

name: The Controller General of Accounts (Appointment, Functions Powers) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Controller General of Accounts (Appointment, Functions and Powers) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the separation of accounting functions and the appointment of a Controller General of Accounts. It defines key terms, transfers accounting duties from the Auditor-General to the new office, and outlines the specific functions and powers of the Controller General.

name: The Auditor General's (Functions, Powers and Terms and Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Auditor-General's (Functions, Powers and Terms and Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance determines the terms and conditions of service, term of office, powers, and functions of the Auditor-General of Pakistan. It establishes that the Auditor-General shall hold office for a fixed term of five years or until reaching the age of sixty-five, whichever is earlier.

name: The Brokers and Agents Registration Rules, 2001

metadata.title: Brokers and Agents Registration Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the registration of brokers and agents with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. They define eligibility criteria, application procedures, and the validity period for certificates of registration.

name: The Import and Export of Gold, Gold Jewellery and Gemstones Order, 2001

metadata.title: Import and Export of Gold, Gold Jewellery and Gemstones Order, 2001
metadata.repeals: all previous Notifications governing the following procedures for regulating the export of gold jewellery and gemstones and for import of gold and gemstones and other raw materials
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the export of gold jewellery and gemstones, as well as the import of gold, gemstones, and related raw materials in Pakistan. It establishes specific procedures for exporters, including membership requirements for recognized associations, the maintenance of a Jewellery Pass Book, and rules regarding advance payments and repatriation of sale proceeds.

name: The National Zakat Foundation (Merger in the Bait-UI-Mal) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The National Zakat Foundation (Merger in the Bait-ul-Mal) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the merger of the National Zakat Foundation into the Bait-ul-Mal. It was promulgated by the President under emergency powers due to the suspension of the National Assembly and Senate.

name: Exemption of Gulf Commercial Bank Limited from Section 14(1)(iv) Voting Rights Restriction — S.R.O. 65(I)/2001

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 65 (KE)/2001
metadata.summary: This notification declares that Section 14(1)(iv) of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 does not apply to Gulf Commercial Bank Limited regarding voting rights. Specifically, it exempts the Pakistan Industrial Investment Corporation from restrictions on exercising its voting right in respect of its shareholding in the bank.

name: No. 100 - No. (not found) - Notification issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (text unreadable)

metadata.title: Notification No. O&M-115/2000
metadata.summary: This notification transfers the administrative control of the Ghazi Iqbal Din Shaheed Hostel from the Ministry of Housing and Works to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The transfer includes officers, staff, budget for the current financial year, and inventory equipment, effective January 6, 2000.

name: The Board of Investment Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Board of Investment Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Board of Investment (BOI) to promote, encourage, and facilitate both local and foreign investment in Pakistan. It defines the composition of the Board, including its President, Vice-President, Chairman, and members from various sectors, and outlines their appointment processes and terms.

name: No. 98 - No. 4-22/90-Min.I - Insertion of a footnote under serial number 36 of Schedule-III to the Rules of Business, 1973

metadata.title: Office Memorandum on the Status of the Office of the Auditor General of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Office Memorandum clarifies the status of the Office of the Auditor General of Pakistan following the grant of administrative and financial powers equivalent to a Ministry or Division. It specifies that a footnote was inserted into Schedule-III of the Rules of Business, 1973, to reflect this new categorization despite the office remaining an attached department.

name: The Venture Capital Companies and Venture Capital Funds Rules, 2001

metadata.title: Venture Capital Companies and Venture Capital Funds Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the business of venture capital companies and venture capital funds in Pakistan. They establish eligibility conditions, definitions, and requirements for obtaining a licence from the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan.

name: The Mental Health Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Mental Health Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to mentally disordered persons, covering their care, treatment, and property management. It also provides for community care initiatives and measures to promote mental health while preventing mental disorders.

name: The Islamabad Rent Restriction Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: Islamabad Rent Restriction Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the relations between landlords and tenants of rented premises in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It was promulgated by the President under emergency powers following the suspension of the National Assembly and Senate in October 1999.

name: The Pakistan Nuclear Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nuclear Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Nuclear Regulatory Authority as the competent national body for regulating nuclear safety and radiation protection. It also defines the extent of civil liability for nuclear damage resulting from any nuclear incident.

name: The Civil Servants (Validation of Rules) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Civil Servants (Validation of Rules) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain rules made under the Civil Servants Act, 1973 and related actions taken immediately before its commencement. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan during the state of emergency declared on October 14, 1999.

name: The Textile Quota Management Policy Order, 2001

metadata.title: Textile Quota Management Policy Order, 2001
metadata.summary: This Order establishes regulations and procedures for the management and allocation of textile quotas under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950. It supersedes the previous Textile Quota Management Policy Order of 2000 and defines specific terms related to quota servicing, carry-forward, and bilateral agreements.

name: The Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Countervailing Duties Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to provisions of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade regarding subsidies and countervailing measures. It establishes a framework for investigating and determining subsidies and injury related to goods imported into Pakistan, while also amending and consolidating existing laws on this subject.

name: The Manufacturing Bond Rules, 2001

metadata.title: Manufacturing Bond Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules define terms related to warehousing, including manufacturing bonds and various types of bonded warehouses. They establish the licensing process for operating warehouses, specifying required documents such as site plans, tax certificates, and financial records.

name: No. 97 - No. 4-25/2000-Min.I - Setting up of the Ministry of Communications and Railways by merging the two Ministries

metadata.title: Setting up of Ministry of Communications and Railways
metadata.summary: This order establishes the Ministry of Communications and Railways by merging the existing Ministry of Communications and the Ministry of Railways. The new ministry will consist of two divisions: the Communications Division and the Railways Division.

name: The Anti-Dumping Duties Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: Anti-Dumping Duties Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the imposition of anti-dumping duties to offset dumping in Pakistan. It establishes a framework for investigating and determining dumping and injury related to goods imported into the country.

name: The Securities and Exchange Policy Board (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2000

metadata.title: The Securities and Exchange Policy Board (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2000
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedure and conduct of business for the Securities and Exchange Policy Board under the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan Act, 1997. They cover meeting notices, quorum requirements, minute recording, committee formation, and travel entitlements for members.

name: The Patents Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: Ordinance No. LXI of 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the protection of inventions in Pakistan. It establishes the Patent Office, defines patentability criteria such as novelty and industrial application, and outlines restrictions on officers regarding patent acquisition and information disclosure.

name: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2000

metadata.title: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2000
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the short title and commencement date for the conduct of business by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. They define the procedures for calling meetings, presiding over sessions, recording minutes, and outlining the specific powers and duties of the Chairman and Secretary.

name: No. 96 - No. 4-24/2000-Min.I - Creation of the Ministry of Privatisation comprising the Privatisation Division

metadata.title: Creation of Ministry of Privatisation
metadata.summary: This notification approves the creation of the Ministry of Privatisation within the Government of Pakistan. It consists of a single division designated as the Privatisation Division and mandates consequential amendments to the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 95 - No. 14(10)/95-Tech.I - Transfer of the Engineering Development Board (EDB) to the Industries & Production Division

metadata.title: Notification No. 14(10)|95-Tech
metadata.amends: Notification No. 4(37)PD/I&C|95 dated 4th October, 1995; Notification No. 4(37) PD|T&C|96 dated 25th September, 1996; Notification No. 4(37)PD|I&C|97 dated 7th November, 1997
metadata.summary: This notification approves the transfer of the Engineering Development Board (EDB) from the Planning and Development Division to the Industries & Production Division with immediate effect. It further stipulates that the Chairman of the EDB shall be appointed from outside the Industries & Production Division, reflecting the status of a Minister of State.

name: The Non-performing Assets and Rehabilitation of Industrial Undertakings (Legal Proceedings) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: Non-performing Assets and Rehabilitation of Industrial Undertakings (Legal Proceedings) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for expeditious legal remedies regarding non-performing assets and the recovery of outstanding amounts payable to banks and financial institutions. It aims to make these assets attractive for privatization and promote national economic revival through provisions for restructuring, rehabilitation, sale, transfer, and realization of such assets.

name: No. 94 - No. 4-18/2000-Min.I - Transfer of SUPARCO from the Cabinet Division to the Defence Division

metadata.title: Transfer of Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO) from Cabinet Division to Defence Division
metadata.summary: This order transfers the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO) from the Cabinet Division to the Defence Division effective September 10, 2000. Necessary amendments to the Rules of Business, 1973 will be made subsequently.

name: The Chemical Weapons Convention Implementation Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Chemical Weapons Convention Implementation Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect in Pakistan to the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production, Stockpiling and use of Chemical Weapons and on their Destruction. It was promulgated by the President under emergency powers due to the suspension of the National Assembly and Senate.

name: No. 93 - No. 4-15/98-Min.I - Placement of PTA under the Information Technology and Telecommunications Division instead of the Cabinet Division

metadata.title: Memorandum on Placement of the Pakistan Telecommunications Authority (PTA)
metadata.amends: Memorandum of even number dated 6th September 2000
metadata.summary: This memorandum modifies a previous decision regarding the administrative placement of the Pakistan Telecommunications Authority (PTA). It confirms that the PTA will remain under the Information Technology and Telecommunications Division rather than being transferred to the Cabinet Division.

name: The Privatization Commission Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Privatisation Commission Ordinance, 2000
metadata.repeals: The Federal Government's Notification No. F 5(1) Adm-t/g| dated 22, January, 1991 and other related notifications issued from time to time establishing and reconstituting the Privatisation Commission
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Privatisation Commission to implement the Federal Government's privatisation policy. It provides for a fair and transparent process, utilizes proceeds for debt retirement and poverty alleviation, and creates a mechanism to resolve related disputes.

name: The Registered Layout-Design of Integrated Circuits Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: Registered Layout-Designs of Integrated Circuits Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal system for the registration and protection of layout-designs of integrated circuits in Pakistan. It aims to fulfill obligations under international agreements like the WTO and TRIPS while promoting technological development.

name: The Registered Designs Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Registered Designs Ordinance, 2000
metadata.repeals: law relating to the protection of industrial designs
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the law relating to the protection of industrial designs in Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President under emergency provisions due to the suspension of the National Assembly and Senate.

name: The National Highways Safety Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The National Highways Safety Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for safe driving on national highways and matters connected thereto. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan under emergency provisions following the suspension of the National Assembly and Senate in October 1999.

name: Exemption of Directors of Privatized and Private Banks from Section 15B Requirements — S.R.O. 569(I)/2000

metadata.title: Notification No. 569 (1D/2000)
metadata.summary: This notification declares that section 15B of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 does not apply to directors of privatized banking companies and private banks. The exemption applies only to directors who are not in default regarding dues owed to any bank or financial institution or on account of tax payment defaults, as per an affidavit prescribed by the State Bank of Pakistan.

name: The COMSATS Institute of Information Technology Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: COMSATS Institute of Information Technology Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the COMSATS Institute of Information Technology as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the institute powers to provide instruction in computer and IT technology, admit students, confer degrees, prescribe courses, conduct research, and manage property.

name: The Pakistan Insurance Corporation (Re-Organization) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Pakistan Insurance Corporation (Reconstitution) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the reconstitution of the Pakistan Insurance Corporation into a public limited company under the Companies Ordinance, 1984. It details the vesting of the Corporation's rights, property, and liabilities into the new Company, including provisions for employee transfers and share issuance to existing shareholders.

name: The Establishment of the Office of Federal Tax Ombudsman Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Office of Federal Tax Ombudsman Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Office of the Federal Tax Ombudsman in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'Federal Tax Ombudsman', 'Inspection Team', and 'Relevant Legislation' which includes various tax acts and ordinances.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Shops, Business and Industrial Establishments (Security) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Shops, Business and Industrial Establishments (Security) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the security of shops, business, and industrial establishments within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It empowers the Government to issue orders regulating measures for the safety of property and persons connected with these establishments.

name: The Pakistan Aeronautical Complex Board, Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Pakistan Aeronautical Complex Board Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Aeronautical Complex Board Kamra to manage and administer aeronautical factories. It provides for the composition of the Board, including a Chairman and five members appointed by the Federal Government, and outlines their terms of office and functions.

name: The National Commission on the Status of Women Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: National Commission on the Status of Women Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Commission on the Status of Women to promote women's emancipation and eliminate discrimination. The Commission is tasked with examining government policies, reviewing laws affecting women's rights, and making recommendations to achieve gender equality.

name: The National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences in Islamabad. It incorporates the university as a body corporate with powers to acquire property, provide education and training, conduct research, and award degrees.

name: The National University of Modern Languages Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The National University of Modern Languages Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National University of Modern Languages (NUML) as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university full autonomy to govern its academic and administrative functions, including determining courses of study, conducting examinations, awarding degrees, and pursuing research.

name: The Survey for Documentation of National Economy Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: Survey for Documentation of National Economy Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes survey teams to investigate the non-reporting and under-reporting of assets, income, and taxable activities in Pakistan. It mandates the use of specific questionnaires for data collection regarding manufacturing, sales, and economic activities while imposing criminal penalties for refusing to provide information or providing false details.

name: The Budgetary Provisions Order, 2000

metadata.title: The Budgetary Provisions Order, 2000
metadata.summary: This Order provides for certain budgetary provisions in pursuance of the Proclamation of Emergency issued on October 14, 1999. It mandates the preparation of Annual Budget Statements and Schedules of Authorised Expenditure by the Federal Government and Provincial Governments before the commencement of each financial year.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Generation) Rules, 2000

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Generation) Rules, 2000
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority under section 46 of the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997. They come into force immediately upon publication and provide definitions for terms related to generation business, ancillary services, and grid operations.

name: The High Court Judges (Service Benefits) Order, 2000

metadata.title: High Courts Judges (Service Benefits) Order, 2000
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the retirement and pension benefits of High Court Judges who ceased to hold office following the Oath of Office (Judges) Order, 2000. It stipulates that judges with less than five years of service may plead as advocates, while those with five or more years are deemed retired at age sixty-two for full pension purposes.

name: The Secretariat Allowance (Rescission of Orders, etc.) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Secretariat Allowance (Rescission of Orders, etc.) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance rescinds certain orders and instruments that granted Secretariat Allowances to Federal Government employees in various secretariats. It deems these orders as always having been rescinded since July 1, 1988, while ensuring that allowances already paid remain valid and non-recoverable.

name: The ad-hoc members of the Shariat Appellate Bench (Allowance for Attending of Sittings) Order, 2000

metadata.title: ad hoc members of the Shariat Appellate Bench (Allowance for Attending of Sittings) Order, 2000
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the payment of allowances to ad hoc members of the Shariat Appellate Bench appointed from the panel of Ulema. It specifies sitting allowances, travelling allowances, and other privileges such as accommodation and official car usage while attending sittings.

name: The Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers the power to award degrees on the Pakistan Institute of Engineering and Applied Sciences in Islamabad. It establishes the institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its powers regarding instruction, research, degree conferment, and campus establishment.

name: The National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Database and Registration Authority to manage multipurpose databases, networking, and interfacing of data. It aims to modernize registration systems for efficient public service delivery while minimizing corruption and inefficiency.

name: No. 92 - No. 4-4/2000-Min.I - Transfer of the subject of Minorities Affairs to the Culture Division

metadata.title: Transfer of the subject Minorities Affairs to the Culture, Sports, Tourism and Youth Affairs
metadata.summary: This order transfers the subject 'Minorities Affairs' from the Religious Affairs, Zakat & Ushr and Minorities Affairs Division to the Culture, Sports, Tourism and Youth Affairs Division. Consequently, it re-designates the relevant ministries and divisions to reflect this administrative change.

name: The Holders of Representative Offices Laws (Suspension of Operation) Order, 2000

metadata.title: Holders of Representative Offices Laws (Suspension of Operation) Order, 2000
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the suspension of operation of certain laws relating to holders of representative offices in Pakistan. It applies to members of the National Assembly, Senate, and Provincial Assemblies, as well as their respective chairs, speakers, and parliamentary secretaries during the period these assemblies are suspended.

name: The Bahria University Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Bahria University Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Bahria University at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university full autonomy to govern its academic and administrative functions, including determining courses of study, selecting students, awarding degrees, and conducting research.

name: The Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits ostentatious displays and wasteful expenses related to marriages and ceremonies in Pakistan. It specifically bans the decoration of venues with lights, the use of fireworks or crackers, and the serving of meals other than hot and cold soft drinks at wedding halls or clubs.

name: The Textile Quota Management Policy Order, 2000

metadata.title: Textile Quota Management Policy Order, 2000
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes procedures for the management and allocation of textile quotas in Pakistan. It establishes a Quota Supervisory Council to oversee implementation, verify entitlements, and audit allocations by Textile Associations.

name: No. 91 - No. 4-16/99-Min.I - Creation of Telecommunications Division and Information Technology Division in the Ministry of Science & Technology

metadata.title: Office Memorandum No.4-16/99-Min.I
metadata.summary: This Office Memorandum announces the creation of the Telecommunications Division and the Information Technology Division within the Ministry of Science & Technology, effective immediately. It also states that consequential amendments are being made to the Rules of Business to reflect this new structure.

name: The Companies (Asset Backed Securitization) Rules, 1999

metadata.title: The Companies (Asset Backed Securitization) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the registration and operation of Special Purpose Vehicles in Pakistan. They define key terms related to asset-backed securitization, including originators, investors, and future receivables. The document outlines eligibility criteria for registration, the application process, and provisions for cancelling registration if specific conditions are not met.

name: The Appointment of Provincial Ministers and Oath of Office Order, (Order No. 8 of 1999)

metadata.title: Appointment of Provincial Ministers and Oath of Office Order (Order No. 8 of 1999)
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the framework for appointing Provincial Ministers and forming Cabinets in each province of Pakistan, with the Governor as the head. It outlines the procedures for appointment, resignation, oath-taking, and the powers of the Governor regarding Cabinet decisions and ministerial terms.

name: The Appointment of Federal Ministers and Oath of Office Order, (Order No. 7 of 1999)

metadata.title: Appointment of Federal Ministers and Oath of Office Order
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the appointment process for Federal Ministers and the composition of the Cabinet under the Chief Executive. It outlines the duties, tenure, resignation procedures, and the specific oath of office that ministers must take before entering their roles.

name: The Appointment of National Security Council and Oath of Office Order, (Order No.6 of 1999)

metadata.title: Appointment of National Security Council and Oath of Office Order
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the National Security Council and designates the Chief Executive as its Chairman. It outlines the composition of the Council, the tenure of its members, and the specific matters upon which the Council is to deliberate and advise the Chief Executive.

name: The Powers and Functions of the Governors Order, (Order No. 5 of 1999)

metadata.title: The Powers and Functions of the Governors Order
metadata.summary: This Order defines the powers and functions of Governors in Pakistan, aligning them with those under the Constitution while subject to specific provisions of Provisional Constitution Order No.1 of 1999. It grants Governors the authority to call upon Armed Forces for assistance when deemed necessary with approval or direction from the Chief Executive.

name: The Governors Appointment and Oath of Office Order, (Order No. 4 of 1999)

metadata.title: Governors Appointment and Oath of Office Order
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the appointment of Governors for each Province by the President on the advice of the Chief Executive. It outlines the tenure, salary, resignation procedures, and specific oaths required before a Governor enters office.

name: The Provisional Constitution Order, 1999

metadata.title: Provisional Constitution Order No. I of 1999
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a Provisional Constitution following the Proclamation of Emergency on October 14, 1999. It places Pakistan under the control of the Armed Forces and designates the Chief Executive as the head of state, suspending the National Assembly, Senate, and Provincial Assemblies while allowing courts to function with specific limitations against the Chief Executive.

name: The Proclamation of Emergency, 1999

metadata.title: Provisional Constitution Order No. I of 1999
metadata.summary: This Order was promulgated by the Chief Executive of Pakistan following a Proclamation of Emergency on October 14, 1999. It establishes the legal framework for the provisional constitution during the emergency period.

name: The Karachi Electric Supply Corporation (Removal from Service) Ordinance, 1999

metadata.title: The Karachi Electric Supply Corporation (Removal from Service) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the removal of persons from the service of the Karachi Electric Supply Corporation. It empowers the Corporation to retire or remove employees without assigning reasons, subject to specific procedural requirements and additional pay provisions.

name: The Export Development Fund Act, 1999

metadata.title: Export Development Fund Act, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Export Development Fund to strengthen infrastructure for promoting exports. It defines the composition of the Board of Administrators and outlines the purposes for which the fund's money can be utilized, including training institutes and market development.

name: No. 90 - No. 4-9/99-Min.I - Inclusion of the "Prime Minister's Grievances Wing" in Schedule-III to the Rules of Business, 1973

metadata.title: Inclusion of 'Prime Minister's Grievances Wing' in Schedule-III to the Rules of Business, 1973
metadata.summary: This notification declares the Prime Minister's Grievances Wing as an attached department of the Cabinet Division. Consequently, this wing is included in Schedule-III to the Rules of Business, 1973.

name: No. 89 - No. 4-5/99-Min.I - Creation of Capital Administration and Development Division in the Ministry of Interior

metadata.title: Office Memorandum No.4-5/99-Min.I
metadata.summary: This Office Memorandum directs the creation of a new division named 'Capital Administration and Development Division' within the Ministry of Interior with immediate effect. The document lists the updated composition of the Ministry, which now includes the Interior Division, Narcotics Control Division, and the newly created Capital Administration and Development Division.

name: The Karachi Electric Supply Corporation (Removal from service) Ordinance, 1999

metadata.title: Karachi Electric Supply Corporation (Removal from service) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Karachi Electric Supply Corporation to retire or remove employees from service without assigning reasons or after providing a fourteen-day opportunity to show cause. It mandates that retired persons receive additional pay for three months in addition to their standard retiring benefits.

name: The Marriage Functions (Ostentatious Displays) Ordinance, 1999

metadata.title: The Marriage Functions (Ostentatious Displays) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits wasteful expenses on marriages and related ceremonies in Pakistan. It specifically bans the use of lights for decoration, fireworks, crackers, and serving meals other than soft drinks at wedding venues like hotels and restaurants.

name: The Islamabad Multi-Unit Buildings (Sub-Division) Regulation, 1999

metadata.title: The Islamabad Multi-Unit Buildings (Sub-Division) Regulation, 1999
metadata.summary: This Regulation governs the vertical and horizontal sub-division of multi-unit buildings within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines key terms such as 'unit', 'common areas', and 'Managing Committee' while establishing rules for applications, agreements, insurance, and the transfer of units.

name: S.R.O. 472(I)/99 — Exemption of Directors of Bolan Bank Limited from Section 15B of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: S.R.O. 472(99)
metadata.summary: This notification declares that the provisions of section 15B of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 shall not apply to specific directors of Bolan Bank Limited for a period of one year. The exemption is conditional upon the directors providing an affidavit confirming they are not in default on bank dues or tax payments.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Distribution) Rules, 1999

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Distribution) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority under the powers of the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997. They establish definitions and procedures related to the distribution business, including terms for licensees, consumers, and applicable technical codes.

name: Variation of Statutory Requirements for Banking Companies Regarding Deposits Against KESC Term Certificates — S.R.O. 299(I)/99

metadata.title: S.R.O. 299(I)/99
metadata.summary: This notification varies the requirements under section 29 of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 regarding banking companies that paid eleven and a half billion rupees for term certificates issued by KESC. It stipulates that upon depositing specific documents with the State Bank of Pakistan, these payments are deemed to have been secured by unencumbered approved securities until the actual issue of the Term Finance Certificates.

name: No. 88 - No. F.8(1)99-Cord(1); No. F.8(1)99-Cord(2) - Substitution of the Special Selection Board provision; publication of candidate returned for PP-37 Mianwali-II

metadata.title: Notification regarding election results for PP-37 Mianwali-II
metadata.summary: This notification publishes the name of the candidate returned to the Provincial Assembly of Punjab from constituency PP-37 Mianwali-II. It is issued by the Chief Election Commissioner of Pakistan in pursuance of the Representation of the People Act, 1976.

name: No. 88 - No. F.8(1)99-Cord(1); No. F.8(1)99-Cord(2) - Substitution of the Special Selection Board provision; publication of candidate returned for PP-37 Mianwali-II

metadata.title: Notification regarding election results for PP-37 Mianwali-II
metadata.summary: This notification publishes the name of the candidate returned to the Provincial Assembly of Punjab from constituency PP-37 Mianwali-II. It is issued by the Chief Election Commissioner of Pakistan in pursuance of the Representation of the People Act, 1976.

name: No. 88 - No. F.8(1)99-Cord(1); No. F.8(1)99-Cord(2) - Substitution of the Special Selection Board provision; publication of candidate returned for PP-37 Mianwali-II

metadata.title: Notification regarding the name of the candidate returned to Provincial Assembly of Punjab
metadata.summary: This notification publishes the name of the candidate returned to the Provincial Assembly of Punjab from constituency PP-37 Mianwali-II. It is issued by the Election Commission of Pakistan in pursuance of the Representation of the People Act, 1976.

name: S.R.O. 148(I)/99 — Exemption of Directors of Metropolitan Bank Limited from Section 15B of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: S.R.O. 148(I)/99
metadata.summary: This notification declares that section 15B of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 shall not apply for one year to six specific directors of Metropolitan Bank Limited. The exemption is conditional upon the directors providing an affidavit confirming they are not in default on bank dues or tax payments.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Tariff Standards and Procedure) Rules, 1998

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Tariff Standards and Procedure) Rules, 1998
metadata.summary: These rules establish the tariff standards and procedures for the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA). They define key terms related to electric power regulation and outline the specific process for filing petitions regarding tariff determination, modification, or revision.

name: The Offences in respect of Electricity (Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1998

metadata.title: Offences in respect of Electricity (Emergency provisions) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Armed Forces of Pakistan to act in aid of civil power to combat rampant electricity theft. It establishes special trial courts under the Pakistan Army Act for the speedy prosecution and conviction of offenders, overriding standard criminal procedures.

name: The Contempt of Court Ordinance, 1998

metadata.title: The Contempt of Court Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the exercise of powers by courts to punish for contempt in Pakistan. It defines various types of contempt, including civil and criminal, and outlines punishments such as imprisonment or fines.

name: The Foreign Exchange (Temporary Restrictions) Act, 1998

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange (Temporary Restrictions) Act, 1998
metadata.repeals: The Foreign Exchange (Temporary Restrictions) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Act imposes temporary restrictions on dealings in foreign exchange held by persons in Pakistan as of May 28, 1998. It suspends the right to withdraw, transfer, or pay out foreign exchange without prior permission from the State Bank of Pakistan, while allowing conversion into rupees at the official rate.

name: The Pakistan Armed Forces (Acting in Aid of the Civil Power) Ordinance, 1998

metadata.title: Pakistan Armed Forces (Acting in Aid of the Civil Power) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance enumerates the powers and duties of the Armed Forces when acting in aid of civil power under Article 245 of the Constitution. It establishes specific courts to try offences related to civil commotion, defines such commotion, and outlines procedures for investigation, trial, appeals, and punishment.

name: No. 85 - No. 10/3/98-C.I(NDO); No. 2(12)-APRO/93 - Notification of National Database Organization as attached department of Interior Division; forfeiture of periodical "Nauroz"

metadata.title: Notification notifying the National Database Organization as an attached department of Interior Division
metadata.summary: This notification officially designates the National Database Organization as an attached department of the Interior Division. It was issued by the Federal Government on August 19, 1998, in pursuance of a Cabinet Division order.

name: No. 84 - No. 10/3/98-C.I(NDO); No. 2(12)-APRO/93 - Notification of National Database Organization as attached department of Interior Division; forfeiture of periodical "Nauroz"

metadata.title: Notification regarding the Urdu Fortnightly 'NAUROZ'
metadata.summary: This notification declares that the Urdu Fortnightly titled 'NAUROZ' contains subversive material against Pakistan. Consequently, it attracts the provisions of section 99-A Cr. P.C.

name: No. 85 - No. 10/3/98-C.I(NDO); No. 2(12)-APRO/93 - Notification of National Database Organization as attached department of Interior Division; forfeiture of periodical "Nauroz"

metadata.title: Notification No. 2 (12)-APRO|93
metadata.summary: This notification declares that copies of the Urdu publication 'NAUROZ' contain subversive material against Pakistan under section 99-A of the Cr. P.C. Consequently, all copies of this specific issue are forfeited to the Government within the Islamabad Capital Territory with immediate effect.

name: The Eradication of Corrupt Business Practices Ordinance,1998

metadata.title: The Eradication of Corrupt Business Practices Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the eradication of corrupt business practices within Pakistan. It defines specific terms such as 'company', 'contract', and 'corrupt business practice', and establishes strict liability offenses with penalties including imprisonment up to seven years or fines.

name: The Authority for Aiwan-e-Iqbal Ordinance, 1998

metadata.title: The Authority for Aiwan-e-Iqbal Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Authority for Aiwan-e-Iqbal as a body corporate to manage and maintain the Aiwan-e-Iqbal Complex in Lahore. It outlines the constitution of the Authority, including a Board of Governors and an Executive Committee, and defines their functions such as propagating Allama Iqbal's teachings and promoting research into his thoughts.

name: S.R.O. 137(I)/98 — Appointment of Lt. Col. Tafseer Ahmad Lodhi as AA and QMG, FFRC, Abbottabad

metadata.title: Notification appointing Lt. Col. Tafseer Ahmad Lodhi as AA and QMG, FFRC, Abbottabad
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Lt. Col. Tafseer Ahmad Lodhi as Assistant Adjutant and Quartermaster General (AA and QMG) for the Forward Reserves Centre (FFRC) in Abbottabad. It is issued pursuant to sections of the Cantonments Act, 1924, following the resignation of the previous officer.

name: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan Act, 1997

metadata.title: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan to regulate capital markets and supervise corporate entities. It defines the Commission's structure, including the appointment of Commissioners and a Chairman, and outlines its powers as a body corporate.

name: The Regulation of Generation Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power in Pakistan. It establishes the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority and defines key terms related to the electricity sector.

name: The Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Pakistan Fish Inspection and Quality Control Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the quality and promotes the export of fish and fishery products from Pakistan. It establishes requirements for the registration of fish processing plants and exporters, defines key terms related to fish and inspection, and creates an Inspection Committee to oversee industry standards.

name: The Pakistan Environment Protection Act, 1997

metadata.title: Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, conservation, rehabilitation, and improvement of the environment. It also addresses the prevention and control of pollution while promoting sustainable development.

name: The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Act, 1997

metadata.title: Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act determines the number of judges for the Supreme Court of Pakistan. It specifies that there shall be sixteen judges other than the Chief Justice.

name: The National Highways Safety Ordinance, 1997

metadata.title: National Highways Safety Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for safe driving on national highways and addresses related matters. It defines key terms such as motor vehicle, driver, and national highway to establish the framework for traffic regulations.

name: The Natural Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 1997

metadata.title: The Natural Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to natural gas in Pakistan. It establishes a regulatory authority to improve the efficiency and availability of natural gas transportation and distribution services through increased private ownership and improved regulation.

name: No. 83 - No. 4-20/97-Min.I - Creation of Parliamentary Affairs Division by bifurcating the Law, Justice, Human Rights and Parliamentary Affairs Division

metadata.title: Office Memorandum No.4-20/97-Min.
metadata.summary: This Office Memorandum directs the immediate bifurcation of the Law, Justice, Human Rights and Parliamentary Affairs Division into two separate entities. The new structure creates a distinct Law, Justice and Human Rights Division alongside a newly formed Parliamentary Affairs Division.

name: S.R.O. 152(KE)/97 — Authorization of Al Meezan Investment Finance Company Limited to Use the Word “Bank” in Its Name

metadata.title: NOTIFICATION
metadata.summary: This notification authorizes ALMEEZA INVESTMENT FINANCE COMPANY LTD. to use the word 'BANK' in its name. The authorization is granted under the powers of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962, and requires meeting specific conditions set by a previous order.

name: The Federal Judicial Academy Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Federal Judicial Academy Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Judicial Academy to provide proper training for judicial officers and court personnel. Its primary aim is to improve the professional competence of judges and enhance the quality of justice administered in the courts.

name: The Anti-terrorism Act, 1997

metadata.title: Anti-terrorism Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of terrorism and sectarian violence in Pakistan. It also establishes provisions for the speedy trial of heinous offences connected to these issues.

name: The Finance Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1997
metadata.amends: Stamps Act, 1899; Central Excises Act, 1944; Wealth Tax Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1997. It also amends several existing laws, including the Stamps Act, 1899, the Central Excises Act, 1944, and the Wealth Tax Act, 1963.

name: The Legal Reforms Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Legal Reforms Act, 1997
metadata.amends: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898; The Law Reforms Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 and the Law Reforms Ordinance, 1972 to update provisions regarding magistrate powers and case transfers. It specifically inserts new sections and modifies existing clauses within the schedules of the amended laws.

name: The Marriages (Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses) Act, 1997

metadata.title: Marriages (Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses) Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits wasteful and ostentatious expenses related to marriages and associated ceremonies in Pakistan. It specifically bans the decoration of venues with lights, the use of fireworks or explosives, and the serving of meals at public places like hotels or clubs during wedding events.

name: The National University of Sciences and Technology Act, 1997

metadata.title: The National University of Sciences and Technology Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National University of Sciences and Technology at Islamabad as a fully autonomous body. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Board, and constituent colleges, while granting it powers to determine courses, award degrees, conduct research, and manage its own administration.

name: The Central Depositories Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Central Depositories Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment and operation of book-entry systems used by central depository companies to transfer securities. It defines key terms related to accounts, issuers, and the handling of securities within the central depository system.

name: The Heavy Industries Board Act, 1997

metadata.title: Heavy Industries Board Act, 1997

metadata.repeals: Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Regulation and Control) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to repeal the Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Regulation and Control) Act, 1974. It was issued because the National Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary under Article 89 of the Constitution.

name: The Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1991

metadata.title: Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1991
metadata.repeals: The Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1975; The Distribution of Revenues Order, 1983
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the framework for distributing net proceeds from specific federal taxes and duties between the Federation and Provinces of Pakistan. It details the calculation methods for revenue sharing based on population, crude oil production, and natural gas well-head production, while also specifying annual grants-in-aid amounts for each province.

name: The Pakistan Telecommunication Corporation Ordinance, 1991

metadata.title: The Pakistan Telecommunication Corporation Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Telecommunication Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition and powers of the Board, including the appointment of Directors by the Federal Government, and outlines the Corporation's functions to establish and maintain telecommunications services throughout Pakistan.

name: The Employment of Children Act, 1991

metadata.title: The Employment of Children Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children in specific occupations and regulates their working conditions across Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'child' and 'adolescent' and establishes limits on working hours, rest intervals, and prohibited times for work.

name: No. 14 - No. (unreadable) - Forfeiture to Government of all copies of the book 'The Hundred' by Michael H. Hart

metadata.title: The Hundred
metadata.summary: This notification declares that all copies of the book titled 'The Hundred' by Michael H. Hart are forfeited to the Government. The forfeiture is based on the presence of derogatory references to the Holy Prophet found in the book, which attracts provisions under Section 99-A of the Criminal Procedure Code.

name: Ministry of Industries Rules Of Business With Assignment To Look After 20 11 1973

metadata.title: Notification No. 8 (27)/90-Dev-WaHenEAS
metadata.summary: This notification declares the Textile Commissioner's Organization as a permanent department under the Ministry of Industries. The organization was previously set up as an attached department on November 20, 1973, to independently look after the industries of the textile sector.

name: The National Highway Authority Ordinance, 1991

metadata.title: The National Highway Authority Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Highway Authority to plan, develop, operate, and maintain national highways and strategic roads in Pakistan. It creates a corporate body with perpetual succession headquartered in Islamabad, comprising an Executive Board and a National Highway Council led by the Prime Minister.

name: No. 12 - No. 2(13)/86 - Allocation of functions relating to Environment and Urban Affairs Divisions

metadata.title: The Rules of Business
