metadata.summary: This notification is issued by the Federal Government pursuant to Rule 2(4)(ii) of the Rules of Business. It pertains to matters involving the Environment and Urban Development Divisions.

name: S.R.O. 181(KE)/90 — Specification of Leasing Companies under Section 3A of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: Notification No. R.O. 181(KE)/90
metadata.summary: This notification specifies leasing companies as defined in a previous Finance Division notification for the purposes of Section 3A of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962. It was issued by the Federal Government through the Ministry of Finance and Economic Affairs on September 2, 1990.

name: No. 11 - No. 4-14/90-Min.I - Amendments in the Rules of Business, 1973 inserting the Ministry of Population Welfare in Schedule I

metadata.title: Notification No. 4-14/90-Min.I.
metadata.summary: This notification directs the President to amend the Rules of Business, 1973, under Articles 90 and 99 of the Constitution. The amendments insert a new entry for the Ministry of Population Welfare in Schedule I and substitute an existing entry regarding the Population Welfare Division.

name: No. 10 - S.R.O. 79(KE)-90 Amendment in Recruitment Rules for DESTO posts in Defence Production Division

metadata.title: The Gazette of Pakistan, Extra., April 19, 1990
metadata.amends: Recruitment Rules for the posts in the DESTO under the Ministry of Defence (Defence Production. Division), notified vide S. R. O. 112(KE)|88
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Recruitment Rules for specific posts within the DESTO under the Ministry of Defence. It substitutes existing entries regarding qualifications and experience for Head Chowkidar and H.S.M. (Photography) posts.

name: No. 9 - S.R.O. 78(KE)90 - Declaration of DESTO as an Attached Department of the Defence Production Division

metadata.title: S.R.O. 78(I)/90
metadata.summary: This notification declares the Defence Science and Technology Organization (DESTO) as an Attached Department of the Defence Production Division, Ministry of Defence. The department is to be headed by a Chief Scientist and Scientific Adviser.

name: No. 10 - No. 104/28/88-Min. I - Re-organization of Prime Minister's Secretariat; Mr. U.A.G. Isani to be addressed as Secretary to the Prime Minister

metadata.title: RE-ORGANIZATION OF PRIME MINISTER'S SECRETARIAT
metadata.summary: This notification from the Cabinet Division of the Government of Pakistan announces a change in the address for correspondence regarding the Prime Minister's office. It specifies that Mr. U.A.G. Isani will be addressed as 'Secretary to the Prime Minister' instead of 'Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister'. The document instructs all relevant secretaries and additional secretaries to take further action in accordance with these instructions.

name: The Martial Law Regulation No. 60 (Repeal) Act, 1989

metadata.title: The Martial Law Regulation No. 60 (Repeal) Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Regulation No. 60
metadata.summary: This Act repeals Martial Law Regulation No. 60, which pertained to educational institutions in the Islamabad Capital Territory. The legislation received presidential assent on October 30, 1989, and came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: No. 8 - No. 104/28/88-Min. - Deletion of Ministry of Housing & Works and Population Welfare Division; inclusion under the Principal Secretary

metadata.title: RE-ORGANIZATION OF PRIME MINISTER'S SECRETARIAT
metadata.summary: This notification reorganizes the allocation of ministries within the Prime Minister's Secretariat. It specifically directs that the Ministry of Housing, Works and Population Welfare be moved from the Secretary to the Prime Minister's Wing to the Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister.

name: Re-org nization of Prime Minister's Secretariat

metadata.title: Re-organization of Prime Minister's Secretariat
metadata.summary: This order outlines the re-organization of the Prime Minister's Secretariat following structural changes. It details the allocation of various ministries and corporations to specific wings within the secretariat, defining their responsibilities for processing cases and obtaining orders from the Prime Minister.

name: AUTHORIZATION OF OFFICERS TO SIGN ORDERS, INSTRUCTIONS, AGREEMENTS AND CONTRACTS ON PARTICULAR OCCASIONS

metadata.title: Authorization of Officers to Sign Orders, Instructions, Agreements and Contracts on Particular Occasions
metadata.summary: This Office Memorandum directs that officers listed in Schedule IV of the Rules of Business, 1973 may authenticate orders and instruments made in the name of the President. It further suggests that for specific occasions involving agreements with foreign countries, the Prime Minister may authorize other officers to sign on behalf of Pakistan if they hold equivalent status to the foreign signatory.

name: No. 5 - S.R.O. 612(I)/89 - Amending the Senate (Finance Committee) Rules, 1973 so that the Committee's approval is not required for amounts not exceeding Rs. 20,000

metadata.title: The Senate (Finance Committee) Rules, 1973
metadata.summary: This notification directs amendments to the Senate (Finance Committee) Rules, 1973 under Article 88 of the Constitution. Specifically, it modifies Rule 17 by substituting punctuation and adding a proviso that exempts cases involving amounts not exceeding Rs. 20,000 from requiring Finance Committee approval.

name: The Senate (Finance Commiltee) Rules, 1973

metadata.title: The Senate (Finance Committee) Rules, 1973
metadata.summary: This notification directs amendments to the Senate (Finance Committee) Rules, 1973 under Article 88 of the Constitution. Specifically, it modifies Rule 17 by substituting punctuation and adding a proviso that exempts cases involving amounts not exceeding Rs. 20,000 from requiring Finance Committee approval.

name: INCLUSION OF DIRECTORATE OF CLINICAL TRAINING, KARACHI AS ATTACHED DEPARTMENT IN SCHEDULE III TO THE RULE OF BUSINESS, 1973

metadata.title: Notification regarding inclusion of Directorate of Clinical Training, Karachi as attached department
metadata.summary: This notification declares the Directorate of Clinical Training, Karachi as an attached department of the Population Welfare Division. Consequently, it amends Schedule III to the Rules of Business, 1973, by including this new department in the schedule.

name: TRANSACTION OF GOVERNMENT BUSINESS UNDER THE RULES OF BUSINESS, 1973 AFTER ASSUMPTION OF OFFICE BY THE PRIME MINISTER

metadata.title: Transaction of Government Business under the Rules of Business, 1973 after assumption of office by the Prime Minister
metadata.summary: This notification forwards copies of two Office Memorandums dated June 6, 1988, and December 3, 1988. The documents address the transaction of government business under the Rules of Business, 1973, specifically following the assumption of office by the Prime Minister.

name: TRANSACTION OF GOVERNMENT OF BUSINESS, 1973 BUSINESS UNDER THE RULES AFTER ASSUMPTION OF OFFICE B Y THE PRIME MINISTER,

metadata.title: Office Memorandum No. 104/13/88-Min
metadata.summary: This document is an Office Memorandum from the Cabinet Division of the Government of Pakistan dated June 6, 1988. It directs that a previous reference regarding the subject matter be treated as withdrawn.

name: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Baluchistan (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1987

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Baluchistan (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1987
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies specific laws currently in force in the Province of Baluchistan to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas. Upon its commencement, any existing local laws, instruments, customs, or usages corresponding to these applied laws cease to have effect in the said areas.

name: The Special Courts for Speedy Trials Ordinance, 1987

metadata.title: Special Courts for Speedy Trials Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Special Courts in Pakistan to ensure the speedy trial of specific offences deemed sensational or shocking to public morality. It grants these courts powers similar to High Courts and mandates strict procedural timelines to prevent delays in investigation and adjudication.

name: The Finance Act, 1987

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1987
metadata.amends: Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1987. It also amends several existing laws, including the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923, the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944, and the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947.

name: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1987

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1987
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies specific laws currently in force in the North-West Frontier Province to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas. It also stipulates that any existing local laws, customs, or usages corresponding to these applied laws shall cease to operate upon its commencement.

name: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1987

metadata.title: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1987
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies specific laws previously in force in the North-West Frontier Province to the whole of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It also stipulates that any existing local laws, instruments, customs, or usages corresponding to the applied provisions shall cease to have effect upon the Regulation's commencement.

name: The Capital Issues (Continuance of Control) Act (Application to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province) Regulation, 1987

metadata.title: The Capital Issues (Continuance of Control) Act, 1947 (Application to Provincially Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1987
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the Capital Issues (Continuance of Control) Act, 1947 to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province. It also causes any corresponding local laws in those areas to cease operating upon its commencement.

name: S. R. O. 43(KE) 86 Notification Regarding Revocation of Trade Organization Licence

metadata.title: S. R. O. 43(KE) 86
metadata.summary: This notification announces the revocation of a licence granted to the Pakistan Overseas Employment Promoters' Association under the Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961. Consequently, the Registrar has struck the association's name off the register of companies and published this decision in the official Gazette.

name: The Pakistan Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Rules, 1986

metadata.title: Pakistan Petroleum (Exploration and Production) Rules, 1986
metadata.summary: These Rules are made under the powers of the Regulation of Mines and Oil fields and Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948. They establish the framework for reconnaissance permits, exploration licences, and development and production leases within Pakistan.

name: S. R. O. 190 (I)/86.- Revocation of Licence of Pakistan Overseas Employment Promoters Association Under Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: Statutory Notification S.R.O. 190(1)/86
metadata.summary: This notification was issued by the Ministry of Commerce on February 24, 1986. It serves as a public notice regarding an action taken in the public interest involving trade organizations.

name: No. S.R.O. 192(I)-86 - No. S.R.O. 192(I)-86 - Form of circular to members with notice offering new shares under section 86(3) of the Companies Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: The Companies Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This order prescribes a specific form of circular to be sent to members alongside notices offering new shares. It is issued under the powers conferred by section 86(3) of the Companies Ordinance, 1984.

name: S. R. O. 1244 (I)/85.- Amendments to Articles of Association of Pakistan Seafood Industries Association to Include Commercial Seafood Exporters

metadata.title: Amendment to the article of association of Pakistan Seafood Industries Association
metadata.amends: article of association of Pakistan Seafood Industries Association
metadata.summary: This notification amends the article of association of the Pakistan Seafood Industries Association to enroll commercial exporters of seafood as members. It specifies that individuals, firms, or companies engaged in processing seafood are eligible for membership, with a limit of one membership per entity.

name: S.R.O. 658(I)/85 — Determination of Interest-Free Domestic Operations of Banking Companies

metadata.title: S.R.O. 658(I)/85
metadata.summary: This notification declares that domestic operations of banking companies are free of interest effective from July 1, 1985. It is issued under the powers conferred by section 26A of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962.

name: S.R.O. 658(I)/85 — Determination of Interest-Free Domestic Operations of Banking Companies

metadata.title: Notification regarding termination of interest on domestic deposits
metadata.summary: This notification exercises powers under the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 to terminate interest on domestic deposits of banking companies. The termination becomes effective from July 1, 1985.

name: The National College of Arts Ordinance, 1985

metadata.title: The National College of Arts Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers the power upon the National College of Arts in Lahore to award degrees. It also provides for matters connected with or ancillary to this power, including definitions for terms like 'Board', 'Chairman', and 'College'.

name: No. S.R.O. 94(I)-85 - No. S.R.O. 94(I)-85 - Approval of Ghulam Muhammad Fecto Foundation, Karachi under section 47 of the Income Tax Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: S. R.O. 93 of 1985
metadata.summary: This order approves the Gulammammad Feqto Foundation in Karachi for tax exemption purposes under the Income Tax Ordinance, 1979. The approval applies specifically to the year ending on December 31, 1985.

name: S.R. O. 91 (I)/85.- Amendment in the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Rawalpindi Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Rawalpindi

metadata.title: S.R.O. 91(I) of 1985
metadata.amends: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Rawalpindi Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Rawalpindi
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Rawalpindi Chamber of Commerce and Industry. The amendment excludes Federal Territory Islamabad from the Chamber's territorial jurisdiction.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Industrial Regulation, 1985

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Industrial Regulation, 1985
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes the framework for planning and development of industries within the Islamabad Capital Territory under the authority of the Capital Development Authority. It classifies industrial establishments into specific categories based on investment size, foreign exchange requirements, and conformity with national policy to regulate their setup during the Sixth Plan period.

name: The Capital Development Authority Conduct of Business Regulation, 1985

metadata.title: The Capital Development Authority Conduct of Business Regulation, 1985
metadata.summary: This Regulation is made by the Capital Development Authority under powers conferred by Section 51 of the Capital Development Authority Ordinance, 1960. It establishes rules for the allocation of business, organization of the Secretariat and Wings/Directorates, general procedures for disposing of cases, and individual or collective responsibilities within the Authority.

name: The Banking Tribunals Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: The Banking Tribunals Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a machinery for the recovery of finance provided by banking companies under systems not based on interest. It creates Banking Tribunals with specific powers to handle civil claims and criminal offences arising from such financial arrangements.

name: The Referendum Order, 1984

metadata.title: The Referendum Order, 1984
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a referendum to ascertain the views of the people of Pakistan regarding the Islamization of laws and the preservation of the national ideology. It mandates that elections for the National Assembly, Senate, and Provincial Assemblies be completed by March 23, 1985, and sets the referendum date for December 19, 1984.

name: The Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the dissolution of the Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation and related matters. It authorizes the Federal Government to direct the transfer of the Corporation's projects, properties, shares, and business to specific companies or subsidiaries.

name: No. S.R.O. 938(I)-84 - No. S.R.O. 938(I)-84 - Methods, qualifications and conditions for Assistant Director (Unani) and Assistant Director (Homeopathy) BPS-17

metadata.title: S. R. O 938 (1) 84
metadata.summary: This notification lays down the methods, qualifications, and conditions for appointing Assistant Directors in Unani and Homoeopathy under the Health Division. It specifies that posts shall be filled by initial appointment or transfer, details age and experience requirements with specific relaxations, and establishes a one-year probation period.

name: S. R. O. 936 (I)/84.- Empowerment of Officer to Perform Functions of Director of Trade Organizations

metadata.title: S.R.O. 936(I)/84
metadata.summary: This notification empowers Mr. Riaz Ahmad Sialik to perform the functions of the Director of Trade Organizations under the Trade Organizations Ordinance 1961. The appointment is effective from October 22, 1984, and remains in force until further orders.

name: The Qanun-e-Shahadat, 1984

metadata.title: The Qanun-e-Shahadat, 1984
metadata.summary: This Order revises, amends, and consolidates the law of evidence in Pakistan to align it with Islamic injunctions from the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It applies to all judicial proceedings in courts, tribunals, and authorities exercising judicial powers, excluding arbitrators.

name: The Companies Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: The Companies Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for the incorporation, regulation, and administration of companies in Pakistan. It covers preliminary definitions, court jurisdiction, corporate authority powers, company formation requirements, prospectus regulations, and share transfer procedures.

name: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas (Exclusion of Jurisdiction of Federal Shariat Court) Order,1984

metadata.title: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas (Exclusion of Jurisdiction of Federal Shariat Court) Order, 1984
metadata.summary: This Order declares that the jurisdiction of the Federal Shariat Court does not extend to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It further stipulates that all laws in force in these areas are deemed valid and cannot be challenged before any court.

name: The Judges of the Federal Shariat Court (Assignment of Functions) Order, 1984

metadata.title: The Judges of the Federal Shariat Court (Assignment of Functions) Order, 1984
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the President to modify the term of appointment for Judges of the Federal Shariat Court, assign them other offices, or require them to perform specific functions. It ensures that judges performing these assigned duties receive the same salary, allowances, and privileges as the Chief Justice or a Judge of the court.

name: No. S.R.O. 818(I)-84 - No. S.R.O. 818(I)-84 - Publication of the bye-laws for the collection and recovery of taxes and fees and refund thereof in Havelian Cantonment

metadata.title: Bye-Laws for the Collection and Recovery of Taxes and Fees and Refund Thereof in the Havelian Cantonment
metadata.summary: These bye-laws regulate the collection, recovery, and refund of taxes and fees within the Havelian Cantonment. They define key terms such as 'Act', 'Board', and 'Executive Officer', establish procedures for maintaining demand registers, and specify payment schedules for various taxes including profession tax, house tax, and octroi.

name: S.R.O. 641(I)/84 — Specification of Corporations and Companies under Section 3A of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: S.R.O. 641 (I) of 1984
metadata.summary: This notification specifies certain corporations and companies for the purposes of section 3A of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962. It lists entities such as the National Development Finance Corporation and The Bankers Equity Limited among others designated by the Federal Government.

name: The Islamabad Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Rules, 1984

metadata.title: The Islamabad Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Rules, 1984
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedures for the registration and renewal of certificates for real estate agents and motor vehicles dealers in Islamabad. They define key terms, specify application forms and fees, outline security deposit requirements, and establish the authority's powers to verify applicant particulars before granting a certificate.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: Wirlcss Telegraphy Act, 1933; Central Excise and Salt Act, 1944; Wealth tax Act, 1963; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 1984. It also amends several existing laws, including the Wireless Telegraphy Act, 1933; Central Excise and Salt Act, 1944; Wealth Tax Act, 1963; and Customs Act, 1969.

name: The Anti-Islamic Activities of the Quadiani Group, Lahori Group and Ahmadis (Prohibition and Punishment) Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: The Anti-Islamic Activities of the Quadiani Group, Lahori Group and Ahmadis (Prohibition and Punishment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860); Code of Criminal Procedure 1898 (Act V of 1898); West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends existing laws to prohibit the Quadiani group, Lahori group, and Ahmadis from engaging in activities deemed anti-Islamic. It specifically adds new sections to the Pakistan Penal Code regarding the misuse of epithets reserved for holy personages and prohibits members of these groups from posing as Muslims or propagating their faith in a manner that outrages Muslim religious feelings.

name: The Islamabad Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: The Islamabad Real Estate Agents and Motor Vehicles Dealers (Regulation of Business) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the business of real estate agents and motor vehicle dealers within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes requirements for registration, defines key terms, and outlines procedures for obtaining and renewing certificates of practice.

name: The Offences in Respect of Banks (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: The Offences in Respect of Banks (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Special Courts to ensure the speedy trial of specific offences committed in respect of banks. It defines key terms such as 'bank', 'scheduled offence', and 'Special Court', and outlines the constitution, jurisdiction, and procedural powers of these courts.

name: The Exit from Pakistan (Control) Rules, 1983

metadata.title: Exit from Pakistan (Control) Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Federal Government under section 5 of the Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance, 1981. They specify how orders regarding exit control are served and clarify that staff refusal to serve an order does not affect immigration authorities' powers.

name: The Import of Goods (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: Import of Goods (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of a development surcharge on specific goods imported through the Karachi customs port. The collected funds are intended to reimburse the Karachi Port Trust for expenditures incurred on constructing the Jinnah Bridge over China Creek.

name: The Pakistan Nuclear Safety and Radiation Protection Ordinance, 1984

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nuclear Safety and Radiation Protection Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of nuclear safety and radiation protection in Pakistan. It establishes the powers of the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission to make regulations, orders, and codes of practice necessary for these purposes.

name: The Customs Act, 1969 (Application to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1984

metadata.title: The Customs Act, 1969 (Application to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1984
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the Customs Act, 1969 to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It extends to the whole of these areas and comes into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Pakistan Environmental Protection Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: Pakistan Environmental Protection Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control of pollution and the preservation of the living environment in Pakistan. It establishes a regulatory framework including the Pakistan Environmental Protection Council and defines key terms such as pollutants, effluents, and industrial activities.

name: The Boiler Act, 1923 (Application to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1983

metadata.title: The Boilers Act, 1923 (Application to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1983
metadata.repeals: any law, instrument, custom or usage having the force of law corresponding to the provisions of the Boilers Act, 1923 in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the Boilers Act, 1923 to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It stipulates that upon commencement, any existing laws or customs in those areas corresponding to the said Act shall cease to have effect.

name: The Jute (Repeal) Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: Jute (Repeal) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.repeals: Jute Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the President of Pakistan on December 22, 1983. Its sole purpose is to repeal the Jute Ordinance, 1962.

name: The National College of Textile Engineering (Governing Body and Cess) Order, 1983

metadata.title: National College of Textile Engineering (Governing Body and Cess) Order, 1983
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a Board of Governors to manage the National College of Textile Engineering in Faisalabad, formerly known as the West Pakistan College of Textile Technology. It provides for the constitution of the Board, defines its powers to administer the college and raise funds through a cess, and outlines procedures for member appointments and property vesting.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Traffic Offences (Special Courts) Rules, 1983

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Traffic Offences (Special Courts) Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Administrator of the Islamabad Capital Territory to regulate Special Courts established under the Traffic Offences (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1981. The document outlines provisions regarding court sittings, the appointment of public prosecutors, maintenance of case records, and the staffing requirements for these courts.

name: The Interim Orders (Period of Validity) Order, 1983

metadata.title: The Interim Orders (Period of Validity) Order, 1983
metadata.summary: This Order specifies that interim orders suspending actions under the Colonization of Government Lands (Punjab) Act, 1912 regarding horse breeding lands will cease to have effect after six months unless decided earlier. It applies specifically to the Province of Punjab and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Transfer of Population Welfare Programme (Field Activities) Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: Transfer of Population Welfare Programme (Field Activities) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of field activities of the Population Welfare Programme from the Federal Government to the Provincial Governments. It outlines the specific powers, functions, and responsibilities that vest in the provinces upon this transfer while retaining certain federal functions like policy and planning.

name: No. 7 (6)83-T. O.- Direction Regarding Membership of Trade Associations and Chambers of Commerce for Exporters of Surgical Goods, Sports Goods and Gloves

metadata.title: Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This order directs persons and firms engaged in exporting surgical goods, sports goods, and gloves to become members of their respective registered trade associations and local Chambers of Commerce and Industry. It is issued under the powers conferred by section 13(1) of the Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961.

name: The Distribution of Revenues Order, 1983

metadata.title: The Distribution of Revenues Order, 1983
metadata.summary: This Order distributes the sum assigned to Provincial Governments under Article 3 of the Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1975. The distribution is based on the respective population percentages of Punjab, Sind, North-West Frontier Province, and Baluchistan.

name: The Ex-Employees of the Former Government of East Pakistan (Appointment to Federal Posts) Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: The Ex-Employees of the Former Government of East Pakistan (Appointment to Federal Posts) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of former employees of the Government of East Pakistan to posts under the Federal Government. It establishes that service rendered under the former government counts towards seniority and pension eligibility in the Federal Government.

name: The Islamabad Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Rules, 1983

metadata.title: The Islamabad Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Federal Government under section 41 of the Islamabad Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Ordinance, 1979. They establish the framework for the Board of Wildlife Management, defining its composition, functions, powers, and procedures regarding permits, licenses, and wildlife management within the Islamabad Capital Territory.

name: The Partition Act, 1893

metadata.title: The Partition Act, 1893
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to partition in suits involving immovable property. It provides procedures for shareholders to request a sale of property or to buy shares at a court-ordered valuation, including rules on reserved bidding and costs.

name: The Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: The Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners to regulate the architectural and town planning professions. It constitutes the Council as a body corporate with defined membership requirements, experience criteria, and powers to acquire property and enter contracts.

name: The Aga Khan University Order, 1983

metadata.title: The Aga Khan University Order, 1983
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Aga Khan University as a fully autonomous body corporate in Pakistan. It defines the university's purpose to promote knowledge and technology, specifically focusing on health sciences, while granting it freedom to govern academic functions, award degrees, and manage its resources.

name: The Transfer of High Court Judges (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1983

metadata.title: The Transfer of High Court Judges (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1983
metadata.summary: This Order determines the allowances and privileges for High Court judges transferred to another court or appointed to a different office. It grants a monthly allowance of 1,500 rupees in addition to salary and provides rent-free accommodation and an official car if the judge's family does not join them at the new location.

name: The Import of Goods (Anti-dumping and Countervailing Duties) Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: Import of Goods (Anti-dumping and Countervailing Duties) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy of additional duties to check and regulate the dumping of imported goods and the import of subsidized goods. It defines key terms such as anti-dumping duty, countervailing duty, normal value, and export price within the context of Pakistani trade law.

name: The Establishment of the Office of Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983

metadata.title: Establishment of the Office of Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) Order, 1983
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the office of the Wafaqi Mohtasib (Ombudsman) to diagnose, investigate, and redress injustices caused by mal-administration within the Federal Government. It defines key terms such as 'mal-administration' and outlines the appointment, tenure, powers, and conditions of service for the Mohtasib.

name: The Network Analyser Study Centre (Transfer to WAPDA) Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: Network Analyser Study Centre (Transfer to WAPDA) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of the Network Analyser Study Centre in Lahore to the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (WAPDA). It outlines the financial terms of the transfer, clarifies that land and building ownership remains with the Federal Government, and details the conditions under which civil servants employed at the Centre are transferred to WAPDA or terminated with compensation.

name: No. S.R.O. 920(I)-82 - No. S.R.O. 920(I)-82 - Prohibition of bringing into Pakistan any copy of the Urdu weekly Hayat and extracts thereof under section 36 of the Customs Act, 1969

metadata.title: S. R. O. 920/82
metadata.summary: This order prohibits the import of specific copies of the Urdu weekly 'Aazad Baluchistan' into Pakistan by air, sea, or land. It also bans translations of the Holy Quran by N.J. Dawood and any documents containing extracts from that translation.

name: The National Press Trust (Appointment of Chairman) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The National Press Trust (Appointment of Chairman) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The National Press Trust (Appointment of Chairman) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of the Chairman of the National Press Trust and addresses matters ancillary thereto. It establishes that the President shall appoint a person of eminence, repute, and integrity as Chairman, who holds office during the pleasure of the President.

name: No. S.R.O. 119(I)-82 - No. S.R.O. 119(I)-82 - Further amendment to S.R.O. 707(I)-81 inserting tariff heading 70.17 Glass Ampoules at 40% ad valorem

metadata.title: The Customs (Amendment) Notification, 1982
metadata.summary: This notification amends a previous Customs Notification by adding a new tariff heading for Glass Ampoules with a 40% ad valorem duty. It is issued under the powers of the Customs Act, 1969.

name: The Capital Development Authority (Imposition of Taxes) Rules, 1981

metadata.title: The Capital Development Authority (Imposition of Taxes) Rules, 1981
metadata.summary: These rules empower the Federal Government to impose taxes under the Capital Development Authority Ordinance, 1960. They establish procedures for publishing preliminary proposals, hearing public objections, and finalizing tax rates or levies.

name: The Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Federal Government to prohibit specific persons or classes of persons from leaving Pakistan, even if they hold valid travel documents. It establishes procedures for reviewing such prohibitions and prescribes imprisonment as a penalty for contravening these orders.

name: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the employment, rehabilitation, and welfare of disabled persons in Pakistan. It establishes a National Council at the federal level and Provincial Councils to formulate policies and coordinate efforts regarding the survey, medical treatment, and training of disabled individuals.

name: The Traffic Offences (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The Traffic Offences (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Special Courts to ensure the speedy disposal of cases related to traffic offences throughout Pakistan. It defines the composition of these courts, granting them powers equivalent to a Magistrate of the first class under the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.

name: The Pakistan Agricultural Research Council Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: Pakistan Agricultural Research Council Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution and reorganization of the Pakistan Agricultural Research Council. It establishes the Council as a body corporate with defined functions, powers, and management structures including a Board of Governors and an Executive Committee.

name: The Inspection Agencies (Registration and Regulation) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: Inspection Agencies (Registration and Regulation) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the business of pre-shipment inspection for goods exported from or imported into Pakistan. It establishes an Authority and a Council to oversee inspections, mandates the registration of inspection companies, and prohibits unregistered entities from issuing inspection certificates.

name: No. S.R.O. 1110(I)-81 - No. S.R.O. 1110(I)-81 - Amendment of the Warrant of Institution of the President's Medal for Pride of Performance to include sports and nursing

metadata.title: Import Trade Control Order
metadata.summary: This order amends the Import Policy Order, 1981 by updating specific monetary figures in paragraph 18. The amendment substitutes 'Rs. 2.5 million' with 'Rs. 3 million' within a specific sub-paragraph regarding import controls.

name: S.R.O. 684 (I)/81.- Recognition and Classification of Towels Manufacturers Association of Pakistan, Karachi as ‘A’ Class Trade Organization

metadata.title: S.R.O. 684 (1)/81
metadata.summary: This notification recognizes the Towels Manufacturers Association of Pakistan as an 'A' class trade organization. It is issued under the Trade Organisations Ordinance, 1961.

name: The Ehtram-e-Ramazan Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The Ehteram-e-Ramazan Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes measures to observe the sanctity of the month of Ramazan throughout Pakistan. It prohibits fasting individuals from eating, drinking, or smoking in public places and restricts the serving of food in hotels and restaurants during fasting hours, while also mandating the closure of cinemas and theatres after sunset.

name: S.R.O. 634 (I)/81.- Recognition and Classification of Pakistan Agricultural Machinery and Implements Manufacturers Association, Peshawar as ‘B’ Class Trade Organization

metadata.title: S.R.O. 634 (1)/81
metadata.summary: This order publishes the name of the Pakistani Agricultural Machinery and Implements Manufacturers Association as a registered trade organization. The Federal Government recognizes and classifies this entity as a 'B' class organization under the Organizations Ordinance 1961.

name: The Chairman and Members of Federal Land Commission (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: Chairman and Members of Federal Land Commission (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain orders passed by the Chairman or a Member of the Federal Land Commission before its commencement. It deems these orders validly passed under specific regulations regarding property distribution and dispute settlement in Dir, Swat, and Chitral.

name: The State Immunity Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: The State Immunity Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: law relating to the immunity of States from the Jurisdiction of courts
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the immunity of States from the jurisdiction of Pakistani courts. It establishes general rules for immunity while defining specific exceptions, such as cases involving commercial transactions, employment contracts, or when a State submits to jurisdiction.

name: The Federal and Provincial Cabinets Order, 1981

metadata.title: The Federal and Provincial Cabinets Order, 1981
metadata.repeals: The Federal Minister's Oath of Office Order, 1978 (P. O. No. 9 of 1978)
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the composition and appointment procedures for the Federal and Provincial Cabinets, including the roles of Federal Ministers, Ministers of State, and Provincial Ministers. It outlines their tenure during the pleasure of the President or Governor, conditions for resignation, and the specific oath of office they must take.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Workers Children Education Cess (Utilization) Rules, 1981

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Workers Children Education Cess (Utilization) Rules, 1981
metadata.summary: These Rules were made by the Administrator of the Islamabad Capital Territory to regulate the utilization of funds collected under the Workers Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972. They establish a District Committee of Management comprising government officials, labor welfare representatives, and nominees from workers and employers to oversee scholarship and stipend distribution.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Education Cess Rules, 1981

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Education Cess Rules, 1981
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Administrator of the Islamabad Capital Territory under Section 6 of the Workers' Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972. They establish procedures for employers to submit returns and pay an education cess based on the number of workers employed in establishments within the territory.

name: The Census Ordinance, 1959 (Application to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1981

metadata.title: The Census Ordinance, 1959 (Application to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1981
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the provisions of the Census Ordinance, 1959 to the whole of the Tribal Areas. It was made by the President in pursuance of the Proclamation of July 5, 1977, and comes into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Rules, 1981

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Rules, 1981
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Administrator of Islamabad Capital Territory to define terms, assign powers to excise officers, and regulate medical examinations for intoxicants under the Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979. They also establish limits on the detention period for accused persons and outline the authority of various officers in enforcing prohibition laws within the territory.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration) Order, 1980

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration) Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the executive authority for the Islamabad Capital Territory to be exercised by the President, either directly or through an appointed Administrator. It also stipulates that certain persons serving under the Government of the Punjab in connection with the territory immediately before this Order shall continue to serve there until further orders.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration) (Repeal) Order, 1980

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration) (Repeal) Order, 1980
metadata.repeals: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order repeals the Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration) Order, 1970. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan on December 31, 1980, and came into force on January 1, 1981.

name: The Islamic University Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: Islamic University Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Islamic University with its principal seat at Islamabad. It creates a body corporate endowed with powers to provide instruction, conduct research, award degrees, and manage property while orienting its work towards Shariah and Islamic learning.

name: The Punjab Minor Canals (Application to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas of Khyber Agency) Regulation, 1980

metadata.title: The Punjab Minor Canals (Application to the Federally Administered Tribal Area of Khyber Agency) Regulation, 1980
metadata.repeals: null
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the Punjab Minor Canals Act, 1905, to the Federally Administered Tribal Area of Khyber Agency. It extends all applicable rules, notifications, and orders made under that Act to the specified area as they stood immediately before this Regulation's commencement.

name: The Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order, 1980

metadata.title: The Superior Courts (Court Dress and Mode of Address) Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the attire for judges of superior courts in Pakistan, specifying requirements for sittings and state functions. It also mandates changes to how judges are addressed, replacing traditional titles like 'My Lord' with 'Sir' or 'Mr. Justice'.

name: The Acting as Agents of Moallims (prohibition) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The Acting as Agents of Moallims (Prohibition) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits persons from acting as agents for Moallims (guides) during the Haj season in Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to publish an official list of approved Moallims and forbids solicitation or inducement to select specific guides, prescribing penalties for violations.

name: S. R. O. 911 (I)/80.— Publication of Recognized and Classified Trade Organizations under Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: S. R. O. 911
metadata.summary: This notification lists registered Trade Organizations recognized and classified under the Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961. It specifically names the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Chamber of Commerce and Industry as a Class 'A' Chamber and the Pakistan Industrial Fasteners Manufacturers Association as a Class 'B' Association.

name: The Settlement of Disputes of Immovable Property (chitral) Order, 1980

metadata.title: Settlement of Disputes of Immovable Property (Chitral) Order, 1980
metadata.amends: Settlement of Disputes of Immovable Property (Chitral) Regulation, 1974
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the settlement of disputes regarding immovable property in the former State of Chitral. It establishes procedures for determining ownership and interest disputes involving tenants, landlords, and ex-Mehtars, allowing appeals to the Provincial Government or Federal Government as appropriate.

name: The Distribution of Property (Chitral) Order, 1980

metadata.title: Distribution of Property (Chitral) Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the distribution and determination of properties in the former State of Chitral, distinguishing between State property and private property of the ex-Mehar. It vests State property in the Provincial Government (North-West Frontier Province) as of March 15, 1978, and establishes mechanisms for reviewing orders related to these properties.

name: The National Institute of Health Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The National Institute of Health Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Institute of Health as a body corporate with headquarters in Islamabad. It outlines the Institute's functions, which include advising the government on disease control, conducting research, producing vaccines, and analyzing drug quality.

name: The Admiralty Jurisdiction of High Courts Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: Admiralty Jurisdiction of High Courts Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: law relating to Courts of Admiralty
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the Admiralty jurisdiction of High Courts in Pakistan. It defines specific terms such as 'ship', 'goods', and 'territorial waters' and outlines the scope of jurisdiction for the Sind, Baluchistan, Lahore, and Peshawar High Courts regarding claims related to ships, aircraft, salvage, towage, and other maritime matters.

name: The Pakistan Defence Officers Housing Authority Order, 1980

metadata.title: The Pakistan Defence Officers Housing Authority Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Pakistan Defence Officers Housing Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition and powers of the Governing Body and Executive Board responsible for managing the Authority's affairs, including property acquisition and development schemes.

name: The National Development Volunteer Programme (Repeal) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: National Development Volunteer Programme (Repeal) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.repeals: National Development Volunteer Programme Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the National Development Volunteer Programme Act, 1973. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan on July 21, 1980, and is deemed to have taken effect from June 1, 1980.

name: The National Sport Trust (Repeal) ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: National Sports Trust (Repeal) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.repeals: National Sports Trust Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the National Sports Trust Act, 1972. Upon repeal, all rights, properties, assets, debts, liabilities, and obligations of the National Sports Trust are transferred to the Pakistan Sports Board, and any legal proceedings or contracts involving the Trust are deemed to involve the Board.

name: The Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration of modaraba companies and regulates their floatation, management, and control. It defines key terms such as 'modaraba', 'Modaraba Certificate', and 'modaraba company' while establishing the role of a Registrar appointed by the Federal Government.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Sales Tax Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1980. It also amends specific sections of the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944, and the Sales Tax Act, 1951.

name: The Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Transfer Of Managed Establishment) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Transfer of Managed Establishments) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of certain managed establishments relating to maritime shipping and matters connected thereto. It empowers the Federal Government to offer the transfer of shares or proprietary interests in these establishments to specified persons under terms set out in a Schedule.

name: The Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr in Pakistan. It establishes the legal framework for these Islamic financial obligations to assist the needy, indigent, and poor, operating under the authority of the President.

name: The Election Commission (reconstitution) order, 1980

metadata.title: The Election Commission (Reconstitution) Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Order reconstitutes the Election Commission of Pakistan by ceasing the office of the Chief Election Commissioner and members immediately before its commencement. It empowers the President to appoint a Supreme Court or High Court Judge to act as Chief Election Commissioner upon the vacancy.

name: S.R. O. 558 (I)/80 Empowerment of Deputy Secretary to Perform Functions of Director of Trade Organizations

metadata.title: Notification No. 1 (2)/79-T.O.
metadata.summary: This notification empowers Mr. Sharif Ijaz Ghauri, Deputy Secretary in the Ministry of Commerce, to perform the functions of the Director of Trade Organizations. It is issued under the powers of clause (4) of section 2 of the Trade Organization Ordinance, 1961 and supersedes a previous notification dated April 1, 1980.

name: The National Training Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: The National Training Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes National and Provincial Training Boards to regulate and promote vocational training facilities across various fields in Pakistan. It provides for the financing of training programs, defines key terms such as 'establishment' and 'industry', and outlines the constitution and functions of the National Board.

name: The Pakistan Institute of International Affairs (Administration) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: Pakistan Institute of International Affairs (Administration) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper administration of the affairs of the Pakistan Institute of International Affairs. It establishes an Administrator and a Managing Committee appointed by the Federal Government to manage the Institute's assets, liabilities, and operations immediately following its enactment.

name: The Export Processing Zones Authority Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: Export Processing Zones Authority Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Export Processing Zones Authority to manage the planning, development, and management of export processing zones in Pakistan. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines the constitution, duties, and functions of its Board and Chairman.

name: The Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1980

metadata.title: Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.repeals: Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1959 (II of 1960)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the immediate dissolution of the Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation. It authorizes the Federal Government to transfer the Corporation's undertakings, properties, and employees to another body or authority before dissolving the entity.

name: The Cigarette (Printing of Warning) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Cigarettes (Printing of Warning) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance mandates the printing of specific health warnings in English and Urdu on cigarette packets to inform consumers about the dangers of smoking. It prohibits the manufacture, sale, or possession of cigarettes that do not display these required warnings.

name: The Employees of Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Allocation to Provinces) Order, 1979

metadata.title: Employees of the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Allocation to Provinces) Order, 1979
subjects: Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority
metadata.summary: This Order allocates employees of the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority to specific provinces based on their service history or permanent residence. It was issued by the President of Pakistan in exercise of powers under the Province of West Pakistan (Dissolution) Order, 1970.

name: The Islamabad Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Islamabad Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, and management of wildlife within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It also establishes a National Park in the territory and sets up a Wildlife Management Board to oversee these functions.

name: The Constitution of Local Council (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1979

metadata.title: The Constitution of Local Councils (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1979
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the constitution of Local Councils in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It defines the structure, composition, and functions of these councils, including Agency Councils, Frontier Region Councils, and Town Committees.

name: The Notification Relating to Election (Rescission) Order, 1979

metadata.title: Notifications Relating to Election (Rescission) Order, 1979
metadata.repeals: Notifications issued by the Election Commission under section 11 or section 11A of the Representation of the People Act 1976 on or after the 25th day of September, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order rescinds all notifications issued by the Election Commission under specific sections of the Representation of the People Act, 1976, dated on or after September 25, 1979. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan in pursuance of the Proclamation of July 5, 1977.

name: The Notification Relating to Elections (Rescission) Order, 1979

metadata.title: Notifications Relating to Election (Rescission) Order, 1979
metadata.repeals: Notifications issued by the Election Commission under section 11 or section 11A of the Representation of the People Act 1976 on or after the 25th day of September, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order rescinds all notifications issued by the Election Commission under specific sections of the Representation of the People Act, 1976, dated on or after September 25, 1979. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan in pursuance of the Proclamation of July 5, 1977.

name: The Criminal Law (Special Provisions) (Application to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Baluchistan) Regulation, 1979

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Special Provisions) (Application to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Baluchistan) Regulation, 1979
metadata.repeals: The Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901
metadata.summary: This regulation applies the Criminal Law (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1968 to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Baluchistan. It repeals the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901, and transfers pending criminal cases from the old regulation to a tribunal constituted under the new ordinance.

name: The Pakistan Animal Quarantine (Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: Pakistan Animal Quarantine (Import and Export of Animals and Animal Products) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the import, export, and quarantine of animals and animal products to prevent the introduction or spread of diseases. It defines key terms such as 'animal', 'animal product', and 'quarantine' while granting the Federal Government power to prohibit or restrict trade through notifications.

name: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Basis of Elections) Order, 1979

metadata.title: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Basis of Elections) Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the basis for elections to the National and Provincial Assemblies in Pakistan, specifically focusing on proportional representation. It outlines procedures for compiling votes, calculating seat entitlements for political parties, and declaring results while excluding independent candidates and those with less than five percent of the vote.

name: The Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Board to examine and certify films for public exhibition in Pakistan. It regulates the exhibition of films by cinematographs, prohibiting uncertified films from being shown publicly except in specific residential circumstances.

name: The Cantonments (Urban Immovable Property Tax and Entertainments Duty) Order, 1979

metadata.title: The Cantonments (Urban Immovable Property Tax and Entertainments Duty) Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the levy and collection of urban immovable property tax and entertainments duty within cantonments in Pakistan. It stipulates that these taxes shall cease to be levied by provincial authorities and instead be collected by Cantonment Boards, with proceeds shared between the Provincial Government and the Board.

name: The Capital Territory Local Government Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Capital Territory Local Government Ordinance, 1979
metadata.repeals: The Order and the Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961 (XLIV of 1961)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of local government institutions within the Capital Territory. It defines various terms related to local administration, such as Union Councils and rural areas, and establishes that it overrides other laws relating to local government.

name: The Central Excise Duty on Sugar (Validation) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: Central Excise Duty on Sugar (Validation) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the levy and collection of central excise duty on an enhanced rate for stocks of sugar held by sugar mills on June 7, 1975. It declares that such duty was validly levied and collected, making it non-refundable and recoverable if unpaid.

name: The Income-Tax Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: Income-tax Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for income tax in Pakistan, including definitions, administration, and charge of tax. It outlines procedures for assessment, computation of total income, allowances, relief, payment methods, and recovery mechanisms.

name: The Zakat and Ushr (Organization) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: Zakat and Ushr (Organisation) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a formal organization for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr in Pakistan. It creates various councils and committees at federal, provincial, and local levels to manage these Islamic financial obligations.

name: The Islamabad (Upkeep of Cleanliness) Regulations, 1979

metadata.title: The Islamabad (Upkeep of Cleanliness) Regulations, 1979
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish rules for the upkeep of cleanliness within the Municipal limits of Islamabad, specifically addressing the deposit and removal of clippings and debris. They define key terms such as 'Debris' and 'Public Place' and outline penalties for violations, including fines and imprisonment under the Capital Development Authority Ordinance.

name: The Development of Industries (Federal Control) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: Development of Industries (Federal Control) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.repeals: Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1972. It provides for the dissolution of the Board established under that Act and mandates the transfer of its assets, liabilities, and employees to the Federal Government or specified corporations.

name: The Auqaf (Federal Control) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Auqaf (Federal Control) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.repeals: The Auqaf (Federal Control) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Auqaf (Federal Control) Act, 1976. It provides for the transfer of waqf property administration from the Federal Administrator General to the respective Provincial Governments and outlines the vesting of rights, liabilities, and officers to the Provinces.

name: The Pakistan National Shipping Corporation Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: Pakistan National Shipping Corporation Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan National Shipping Corporation by amalgamating the National Shipping Corporation and the Pakistan Shipping Corporation. It defines the new corporation's functions, powers, and structure to operate safe and efficient shipping services for coastal and international routes.

name: The Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: The Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans) Ordinance, 1978 with certain modifications. It establishes special courts and provides mechanisms for securing and repaying loans outstanding on its commencement date.

name: The Emigration Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Emigration Ordinance, 1979
metadata.repeals: The Emigration Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Emigration Act, 1922 with certain modifications. It establishes the legal framework for regulating emigration from Pakistan to other countries and outlines the duties of the Director General and Protectors of Emigrants.

name: The Trade Organization Ordinance, 1961 (Application to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1979

metadata.title: The Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961 (Application to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1979
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the Trade Organisations Ordinance, 1961 to the Tribal Areas of Pakistan. It was made by the President under powers derived from the Proclamation of July 5, 1977, and the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1977.

name: The Law Commission Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Law Commission Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Law Commission for Pakistan to systematically review and reform existing laws. The Commission is tasked with modernizing statutes, simplifying procedures, and ensuring consistency with Islamic social justice while also improving legal education standards.

name: No. S.R.O. 198(I)-79 - No. S.R.O. 198(I)-79 - Amendment of the Pakistan Citizenship Rules, 1952 adding fee for applications under section 16A of the Act

metadata.title: S. R. O. 198 (1)/79
metadata.summary: This order directs the Federal Government to amend the Pakistan Citizenship Rules, 1952 by adding a new entry regarding fees for applications under section 16A of the Act. The amendment specifically inserts serial number 20 into the Table of Fees in the Schedule with a fee of Rs. 30.00.

name: The Protection of Rights in Industrial Property Order, 1979

metadata.title: The Protection of Rights in Industrial Property Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order protects the rights of persons regarding industrial property used in production, manufacturing, or mineral extraction. It establishes that no person shall be deprived of their industrial property except according to law and provides mechanisms for determining adequate compensation if deprivation occurs.

name: The Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979

metadata.title: The Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order modifies existing laws regarding the prohibition of intoxicants to align them with Islamic injunctions from the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It defines key terms such as 'intoxicant', 'manufacture', and 'sale', and establishes penalties for importing, exporting, manufacturing, selling, or possessing intoxicants.

name: The Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal provisions for the execution of the punishment of whipping in Pakistan. It establishes specific conditions, such as medical examinations and weather constraints, that must be met before carrying out the punishment.

name: The Offence of Qazf (Enforcement of Hadd) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Offence of Qazf (Enforcement of Hadd) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.repeals: section 561 of the Code
metadata.summary: This Ordinance modifies the existing law regarding the offence of qazf to bring it in conformity with the Injunctions of Islam as set out in the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It defines specific conditions under which qazf is liable to hadd or tazir punishments and outlines the proof required for such offences.

name: The Offence of Zina (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Offence of Zina (Enforcement of Hadood) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance brings the law relating to the offence of zina into conformity with the Injunctions of Islam as set out in the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It defines specific conditions under which zina is liable to hadd punishment, such as stoning for muhsan offenders or whipping for others, and outlines procedures regarding consent and coercion.

name: The Offences Against Property (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The Offences Against Property (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance modifies the existing law relating to certain offences against property to bring it in conformity with the Injunctions of Islam as set out in the Holy Quran and Sunnah. It defines specific terms such as 'hadd', 'hirz', and 'nisab' regarding theft liable to hadd punishment, and establishes requirements for proof of theft.

name: The National Finance Commission Order, 1979

metadata.title: The National Finance Commission Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the National Finance Commission to recommend the distribution of net tax proceeds between the Federation and Provinces. It also empowers the President to make grants-in-aid to provincial governments and amend revenue distribution laws as necessary.

name: The Dealerships (Cancellation of Agreements and Contracts) Order, 1979

metadata.title: The Dealerships (Cancellation of Agreements and Contracts) Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the Federal Government and its controlled agencies to terminate arrangements, agreements, or contracts with dealers without notice. It explicitly states that no compensation is payable for such terminations and bars courts from granting injunctions or entertaining proceedings against actions taken in good faith under this Order.

name: The National Institute of Electronics Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The National Institute of Electronics Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Institute of Electronics as a body corporate headquartered in Islamabad. It defines key terms related to electronics and outlines the Institute's functions, which include research, design, development, training, and coordination with other national centers.

name: The Managed Cement of Establishments (Payment to Corporation) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: Ordinance No. II of 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the payment of certain amounts by managed cement establishments to the State Cement Corporation of Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'Corporation' and 'unit', establishes the obligation for units to pay fixed amounts per metric ton of cement produced and sold after March 24, 1976, and grants the Federal Government power to fix these amounts via notification.

name: The National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (Administration) Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: The National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (Administration) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper administration of the National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases in Karachi. It incorporates the Institute as a body corporate, vests its powers in a newly constituted Governing Body, and outlines the Institute's functions including treatment, research, and training.

name: The Shariat Benches of Superior Courts Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Shariat Benches of Superior Courts Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order establishes Shariat Benches in High Courts and a Shariat Appellate Bench in the Supreme Court of Pakistan. It empowers these benches to examine laws for repugnancy to the Injunctions of Islam as laid down in the Holy Quran and Sunnah.

name: The Cement Stockists (Cancellation of Agreements and Contracts) Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Cement Stockists (Cancellation of Agreements and Contracts) Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the State Cement Corporation of Pakistan and associated entities to terminate agreements with stockists without notice regarding cement sales. It explicitly states that no compensation is payable for such terminations and bars courts from granting injunctions or entertaining proceedings against those acting in good faith under this Order.

name: The Governors and Acting Governors (Appointment) Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Governors and Acting Governors (Amendment) Order, 1978
metadata.amends: The Governors and Acting Governors (Appointment) Order, 1978
metadata.repeals: The Governor's Oath of Office Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order amends the appointment and functions of Governors and Acting Governors in Pakistan. It repeals the previous Governor's Oath of Office Order, 1977, and establishes new provisions for appointments, resignations, acting arrangements, and the oath of office.

name: The Federal Minister's Oath of Office Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Federal Minister's Oath of Office Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This order prescribes the oath of office to be taken by persons appointed as Federal Ministers in Pakistan. It outlines the specific duties, allegiance, and ethical standards required of a Federal Minister, including preserving Islamic ideology and avoiding conflicts of interest.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1978. It amends the Income-tax Act, 1922 to provide tax incentives for industrial undertakings and modifies provisions regarding motor vehicles tax collection.

name: The Staple Cotton (Excise Duty) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: Staple Cotton (Excise Duty) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of excise duty on staple cotton produced by ginning factories and sold to textile mills. It defines key terms such as 'staple cotton', 'factory', and 'sale price', and establishes specific duty rates based on whether the producing factory is in the public or private sector.

name: The Land Reforms Regulation (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: Land Reforms Regulation (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain orders passed by the Chairman or a Member of the Federal Land Commission before its commencement. It deems these orders to have been validly passed and effective under the authority conferred by an order of the Federal Government.

name: The Islamabad Club (Administration) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: Islamabad Club (Administration) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper administration of the affairs of the Islamabad Club following its dissolution. It vests all assets, liabilities, and legal proceedings of the dissolved company into an appointed Administrator and establishes a Managing Committee to advise on future organizational and financial measures.

name: The Flying Clubs (Appointment of Administrators) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Flying Clubs (Appointment of Administrators) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of Administrators to manage the affairs of Flying Clubs when the existing Committee is unable to function properly. It outlines the powers, remuneration, and tenure of the Administrator, as well as procedures for their termination and penalties for obstructing them.

name: The West Pakistan Abolition of Estate Duty (Agricultural Lands) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Abolition of Estate Duty (Agricultural Lands) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Abolition of Estate Duty (Agricultural Lands) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to repeal the West Pakistan Abolition of Estate Duty (Agricultural Lands) Act, 1958. It also stipulates that certain words inserted by the repealed Act shall be deemed never to have formed part of the Estate Duty Act, 1950.

name: The Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a summary procedure for the recovery of loans from banking companies in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'banking company', 'borrower', and 'loan' to include various financial accommodations and guarantees.

name: The Baluchistan Constabulary (Repeal) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: Baluchistan Constabulary (Repeal) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: Baluchistan Constabulary Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Baluchistan Constabulary Act, 1975. It was promulgated by the President under the Proclamation of July 5, 1977, due to circumstances requiring immediate action.

name: The Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Trust and Peoples Foundation Trust (Re-naming and Administration) Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Trust and Peoples Foundation Trust (Re-naming and Administration) Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order re-names the Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Trust to the Sheikh Zayed Bin Sultan Alnahyan Trust and the Peoples Foundation Trust to the Sheikh Sultan Trust. It also amends the respective deeds of these trusts and vests their powers in a new Board of Trustees appointed by the President.

name: The Corporation Employees (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: Corporation Employees (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance invests the President with specific powers regarding persons in Corporation service. It allows for the removal or reversion of such individuals appointed or promoted between January 1, 1972, and July 5, 1977, without notice if deemed necessary in the public interest.

name: The Islamic Development Bank Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Islamic Development Bank Ordinance, 1978
