metadata.summary: This Ordinance implements the international agreement for the establishment and operation of the Islamic Development Bank. It provides legal force to specific provisions of the Agreement regarding the Bank's status, immunities, and financial obligations within Pakistan.

name: The Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences (Repeal) Ordinance, 1978

metadata.title: The Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences (Repeal) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: The Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences Act, 1976 (Act XX of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan on January 4, 1978, to repeal the Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences Act, 1976. It extends to the whole of Pakistan and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Razmak Cadet College Regulation, 1977

metadata.title: Razmak Cadet College Regulation, 1977
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the establishment of a Cadet College at Razmak to promote education in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It defines key terms such as the Board, Chairman, and College, and outlines the composition and powers of the Board of Governors.

name: The Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Federal Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Federal Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Federal Public Service Commission Act, 1973 with certain modifications. It establishes the composition of the Commission, outlines appointment procedures for members and staff, and defines their terms of office and conditions of service.

name: The Federal Security Force (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: Federal Security Force (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.repeals: Federal Security Force Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan on November 30, 1977, to repeal the Federal Security Force Act, 1973. It came into force on December 1, 1977, and includes provisions regarding the status of officers and employees under the repealed Act.

name: The Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Disqualification for Membership) Order, 1977

metadata.title: The Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Disqualification for Membership) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order establishes Special Courts to inquire into and decide cases of misconduct by high-ranking officials, including the President, Governors, Ministers, and Assembly members. It defines specific types of misconduct such as bribery, corruption, and maladministration occurring after December 1970. The legislation outlines the composition of these courts and the procedures for referring cases to them.

name: The Holders of Representative Offices (Punishment for Misconduct) Order, 1977

metadata.title: Punishment for Misconduct by Holders of Representative Offices Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes punishment for holders of representative offices who commit misconduct after December 1970. It defines specific offenses including illegal gratification, misappropriation of public property, and disproportionate assets, establishing a Special Court to try such cases.

name: The High Court Judges (Scrutiny of Appointments) Order, 1977

metadata.title: The High Court Judges (Scrutiny of Appointments) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Supreme Judicial Council of Pakistan to scrutinize the appointments of Additional Judges. It grants the Council powers similar to the Supreme Court for enforcing attendance and producing documents, as well as the power to punish for contempt.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 22

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 22
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order directs three specific individuals to surrender themselves to the Sub-Martial Law Administrator in Sector-2, Rawalpindi by July 25, 1970. The order mandates that if these persons fail to comply with the surrender deadline, they will be charged under Martial Law Regulation No. 40 and tried in absentia for contravention of said regulation.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 21

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 91
metadata.summary: This order directs specific individuals to surrender themselves to the authorities. Failure to comply by the prescribed date and time will result in being charged under MLR-40 and tried in absentia.

name: The Enemy Property (Continuance of Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Enemy Property (Continuance of Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of specific provisions from the Defence of Pakistan Rules regarding trading with enemies and controlling enemy firms. It ensures the continued administration of property belonging to such entities despite the repeal of the previous Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971.

name: The Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Defence of Pakistan (Continuance of Requisitions) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of emergency powers regarding requisitioned land following the repeal of the Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971. It outlines procedures for releasing land from requisition, determining compensation based on previous provisions, and granting the Federal Government authority to manage such lands.

name: The Defence of Pakistan (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: Defence of Pakistan (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.repeals: Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971. It also provides indemnity to the Government against any legal proceedings related to the repealed Ordinance or its notifications.

name: The Cotton Ginning Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Cotton Ginning Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.repeals: Cotton Ginning Control and Development Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Cotton Ginning Control and Development Act, 1976. It provides for matters connected with and incidental to the repeal of the aforementioned Act.

name: The Rice Milling Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Rice Milling Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Rice Milling Control and Development Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to repeal the Rice Milling Control and Development Act, 1976. It provides for the immediate return of establishments previously taken over by the Corporation to their previous management upon delivery of possession.

name: The Flour Milling Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Flour Milling Control and Development (Repeal) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Flour Milling Control and Development Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Flour Milling Control and Development Act, 1976. It provides for the return of establishments previously acquired by the Corporation to their previous management and outlines provisions regarding employee continuity and compensation.

name: The Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977

metadata.title: The Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the holding of elections to the two Houses of Parliament and the Provincial Assemblies in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as the Election Commission and establishes the number of seats, including ten reserved for women, based on existing delimitation acts.

name: The Election Commission Order, 1977

metadata.title: The Election Commission Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Election Commission for the forthcoming general elections in Pakistan. It defines the qualifications for the Commissioner and members, outlines their duties including appointing election tribunals, and sets forth the oath of office.

name: The Chief Election Commissioner (Oath of Office) Order, 1977

metadata.title: The Chief Election Commissioner (Oath of Office) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the oath of office to be taken by the Chief Election Commissioner of Pakistan. The oath must be administered by the Chief Justice of Pakistan at a time appointed by him.

name: The Special Tribunals (Abolition) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: Special Tribunals (Abolition) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes the Special Tribunals constituted under the Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971. It provides for the transfer of pending cases to competent criminal courts and stipulates that offences under related rules shall be tried by those courts.

name: The High Court Judges (Oath of Office) Order, 1977

metadata.title: The High Court Judges (Oath of Office) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the oath of office to be taken by every Judge of a High Court before the Governor of the concerned Province. It mandates that judges swear allegiance to Pakistan and agree to discharge duties honestly in accordance with the law and the code of conduct issued by the Supreme Judicial Council.

name: The Finance Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1977. It primarily amends the Income-tax Act, 1922, to update provisions regarding income definitions, depreciation allowances, and tax return procedures.

name: The Legal Tender (Inscribed Notes) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Legal Tender (Inscribed Notes) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides that certain bank notes bearing political, religious, or commercial inscriptions shall cease to be legal tender. It empowers the Federal Government to specify the date via notification when these notes stop being valid for payment and releases the State Bank of Pakistan from obligations to exchange them.

name: The Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 1977

metadata.title: Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Baluchistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961; The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961; The Punjab Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961; The Sind Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Act provides for price control and the prevention of profiteering and hoarding of essential commodities throughout Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to regulate prices, production, movement, and distribution of these commodities through notified orders.

name: The Prevention of Gambling Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Prevention of Gambling Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of gambling within Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'common gaming-house' and 'gaming', and establishes penalties for owning or keeping such establishments.

name: The Civil Courts (Suspension of Powers) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Ordinance to suspend the power of Courts to make certain declarations or orders under the Specific Relief Act, 1877, or the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This Ordinance suspends the power of courts to make certain declarations or orders under the Specific Relief Act, 1877 and the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. It specifically prohibits High Courts from issuing orders regarding persons detained in areas where the Armed Forces are acting in aid of civil power or against accused persons under specific clauses of the Pakistan Army Act, 1952.

name: The Letters Patent and Code of Criminal Procedure (Suspension of Powers) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: Ordinance No. XX of 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance suspends the power of High Courts to make certain orders regarding persons detained in areas where the Armed Forces are acting in aid of civil power. It also suspends proceedings commenced after April 21, 1977, that involve the exercise of such powers.

name: The Prohibition Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Prohibition Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the manufacture, sale, and consumption of intoxicating liquors throughout Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'intoxicating liquor', 'manufacture', and 'sale' and establishes penalties including imprisonment or fines for violations.

name: The Organization of the Islamic Conference (Immunities and Privileges) Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Organization of the Islamic Conference (Immunities and Privileges) Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Organization of the Islamic Conference (Immunities and Privileges) Ordinance, 1977 (VII of 1977)
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Agreement on Immunities and Privileges of the Organization of the Islamic Conference. It grants the Organization juridical personality, immunity from legal process for its property and assets, and inviolability for its premises and archives.

name: The Prevention of Smuggling Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Smuggling Prevention Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the effective prevention of smuggling and related matters within Pakistan. It establishes definitions for terms such as 'associate', 'property', and 'smuggling', and grants powers to Federal or Provincial Governments to order the arrest and detention of individuals suspected of engaging in smuggling to maintain essential community supplies.

name: The Customs Act (Application to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1977

metadata.title: The Customs Act (Application to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1977
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the Customs Act, 1969 to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Baluchistan. It extends to the whole of these areas and comes into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Organization of the Islamic Conference (Immunities and Privileges) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: Ordinance on Immunities and Privileges of the Organization of the Islamic Conference
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect in Pakistan to the Agreement on Immunities and Privileges of the Organization of the Islamic Conference. It grants the Organization juridical personality, immunity from legal process for its property and assets, and inviolability for its premises and archives.

name: The Prevention of Smuggling Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Prevention of Smuggling Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the effective prevention of smuggling and related matters within Pakistan. It establishes provisions for preventive detention to maintain essential community supplies and defines key terms such as 'associate', 'relative', and 'smuggling'.

name: The Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Federal Bank for Cooperatives Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and provides for its regulation. It defines key terms such as 'Bank', 'Board', and various liability types relevant to cooperative societies.

name: The Pakistan Railways Police Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Antiquities (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: Antiquities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Antiquities Act, 1975 by omitting specific words and clauses in section 15. It also repeals the Antiquities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976.

name: The Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Disqualification for Membership) Act, 1976

metadata.title: Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Disqualification for Membership) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the disqualification of certain persons from being elected or chosen as, and from being, a member of Parliament or a Provincial Assembly. It defines misconduct as corruption or bribery and outlines specific cases where charges must be enquired into by a Division Bench of the High Court.

name: The Holders of Representative Offices (Prevention of Misconduct) Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) Act, 1972 to address specific legal provisions regarding land transfer. It also repeals the Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977.

name: The Land Reforms Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for further land reforms to ensure a more equitable distribution of wealth in Pakistan. It establishes specific limits on individual land holdings based on irrigation status and introduces provisions for the exchange of excess land.

name: The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1977

metadata.title: The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the taxation of agricultural income on a uniform basis across Pakistan. It also gives effect to other financial proposals made by the Federal Government.

name: The Finance (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: Finance (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the taxation of agricultural income on a uniform basis across Pakistan. It also gives effect to other financial proposals made by the Federal Government.

name: The Land Reforms Ordinance, 1977

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for further land reforms to ensure a more equitable distribution of wealth in Pakistan. It amends section 2 of the Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) Act, 1972 and establishes restrictions on the ownership and possession of irrigated and unirrigated land.

name: The Contempt of Court Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Contempt of Court Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act enacts a specific law relating to contempt of court in Pakistan, defining what constitutes contempt and providing exceptions for fair comments and true statements. It establishes the jurisdiction of High Courts and the Supreme Court to take cognizance of such offenses and prescribes punishments including imprisonment or fines.

name: The Employees' Old-Age Benefits Ordinance, 1975

metadata.title: The Employees' Old-Age Benefits Ordinance, 1975
metadata.repeals: law relating to old-age benefits for the persons employed in industrial, commercial and other organisations
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the law concerning old-age benefits for persons employed in industrial, commercial, and other organizations. It establishes an Employees' Old-Age Benefits Institution and a Board of Trustees to manage the fund and administer insurance for insured persons.

name: The National Insurance Corporation Ordinance, 1975

metadata.title: National Insurance Corporation Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Insurance Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the corporation's management by a Board of Directors, its initial capital provided by the Federal Government, and definitions of key terms including public property and statutory corporations.

name: The Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Chairman of the Senate and the Speaker of the National Assembly. It also defines related terms such as family, maintenance, official business, and official residence in the context of these offices.

name: The Foreign Cultural Associations (Regulation of Functioning) Act, 1975

metadata.title: Foreign Cultural Associations (Regulation of Functioning) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the functioning of foreign cultural associations in Pakistan to ensure they do not act prejudicially to national ideology or security. It establishes requirements for registration, financial accountability, and restrictions on government servants joining such associations.

name: The Airports Security Force Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Airports Security Force Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and regulation of the Airports Security Force to ensure security at all aerodromes, airports, aircraft, and civil aviation installations. It outlines the functions of the Force, including safeguarding against unlawful interference, maintaining law and order, and operating fire services within airport limits.

name: The Cutting of Trees (Prohibition) Act, 1975

metadata.title: Cutting of Trees (Prohibition) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the cutting, felling, or damaging of trees within a five-mile belt along Pakistan's external frontiers without specific approval. It defines key terms such as 'tree' and 'local formation commander' and establishes penalties including imprisonment for violations.

name: The General Statistics Act, 1975

metadata.title: The General Statistics Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes specific authorities for the collection and coordination of statistics to support economic and other forms of planning. It provides a legal framework for constituting councils and authorities at both federal and provincial levels to manage statistical operations across Pakistan.

name: The Antiquities Ordinance, 1975

metadata.title: The Antiquities Ordinance, 1975
metadata.repeals: The law relating to the preservation and protection of antiquities
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the law concerning the preservation and protection of antiquities in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'antiquity', 'immovable antiquity', and 'national monument' to establish a legal framework for their safeguarding.

name: The Foreign Cultural Associations (Regulation of Functioning) Ordinance, 1975

metadata.title: Foreign Cultural Associations (Regulation of Functioning) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the functioning of foreign cultural associations operating within Pakistan. It establishes requirements for registration, mandates specific operational restrictions to protect national ideology and security, and outlines procedures for the dissolution of such associations by the Federal Government.

name: The Pakistan Engineering Council Ordinance, 1975

metadata.title: Pakistan Engineering Council Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of the engineering profession in Pakistan by constituting a body known as the Pakistan Engineering Council. It establishes the Council as a corporate entity with defined composition, including nominated members from the Federal Government, Provincial Governments, and Universities, along with provisions for its Chairman and Vice-Chairman.

name: The Airports Security Force Ordinance, 1975

metadata.title: The Airports Security Force Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution and regulation of the Airports Security Force to ensure security at all aerodromes, airports, aircraft, and civil aviation installations. It outlines the force's functions, which include safeguarding against unlawful interference, operating fire services, protecting against hazards like birds and pollution, and maintaining law and order in conjunction with the police.

name: The Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the Board's jurisdiction over institutions in specific territories and outlines its composition, including members appointed by the government, elected representatives, and directors from various educational bodies.

name: The Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1975

metadata.title: Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Chairman of the Senate and the Speaker of the National Assembly. It details specific financial benefits including base salary, equipment allowance, transport rights, and official residence provisions.

name: The Governors' Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Order, 1975

metadata.title: The Governors' Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Order, 1975
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salaries, allowances, and privileges for Governors of Pakistan to ensure they can discharge their duties conveniently and with dignity. It defines specific terms such as 'acting Governor', 'family', and 'furniture' while establishing rules for official residence, transport costs, and travel privileges.

name: The Federal Adaptation of Laws Order, 1975

metadata.title: The Federal Adaptation of Laws Order, 1975
metadata.summary: This Order was made by the President of Pakistan to adapt existing laws in force immediately before the commencement day to align with the Constitution. It directs specific substitutions and omissions in various statutes, such as replacing references to 'Central' with 'Federal' and updating government titles.

name: The Malaria Eradication Board (Repeal) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Malaria Eradication Board (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Malaria Eradication Board Ordinance, 1961 (XVIII of 1961)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Malaria Eradication Board Ordinance, 1961. It provides for the transfer of the Board's officers and employees to the Federal Government and assigns all rights, properties, assets, debts, liabilities, obligations, contracts, and legal proceedings of the Board to the Federal Government upon repeal.

name: The Validation of Laws Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Validation of Laws Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain President's Orders, Martial Law Regulations, and other laws made between March 25, 1969, and December 19, 1971. It declares the specific laws listed in the Schedule to have been validly made by competent authority.

name: The Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salaries, allowances, and privileges for Federal Ministers and Ministers of State in Pakistan. It defines specific monetary amounts for salary, equipment allowance, sumptuary allowance, and travel expenses upon taking up or laying down office.

name: The Prime Minister's Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975

metadata.title: Prime Minister's Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Prime Minister of Pakistan. It provides for expenses related to official residence, travel, equipment, and discretionary sums while defining terms such as 'family', 'furniture', and 'official residence'.

name: The President’s Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975

metadata.title: The President's Salary, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salary, allowances, and privileges of the President of Pakistan to enable him to discharge his duties conveniently and with dignity. It specifies the annual salary, equipment allowance, travel expenses for taking up or laying down office, and entitlements regarding official residence and transport.

name: The Chief Election Commissioner (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975

metadata.title: Chief Election Commissioner (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Insurance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975 (VI of 1975)
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Chief Election Commissioner. It stipulates that the Commissioner shall receive the same benefits as a Judge of the Supreme Court and outlines specific rules regarding leave entitlements and subscription to the General Provident Fund.

name: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1975

metadata.title: Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1975
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies specific laws currently in force in the North-West Frontier Province to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas. It was made by the President under Article 247 of the Constitution and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Senate (Election) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Senate (Election) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conduct of elections to the Senate and related matters. It establishes the administrative machinery, including the roles of Returning Officers and Polling Officers, and outlines procedures for nominations, scrutiny, and polling.

name: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1975

metadata.title: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1975
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies specific laws to the whole of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It was made by the President under Article 247 of the Constitution and comes into force immediately.

name: The Finance Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1975. It also amends certain laws, specifically making detailed amendments to the Income-tax Act, 1922.

name: The Decorations Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Decorations Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Decorations Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conferment by the President of decorations to recognize gallantry, meritorious service in the Armed Forces, or academic distinction. It also restricts citizens and persons in Pakistan's service from accepting foreign decorations without Federal Government approval.

name: The Archival Material (Preservation and Export Control) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Archival Material (Preservation and Export Control) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation and control of the export of archival material of national significance in Pakistan. It defines specific criteria for what constitutes archival material, establishes the role of the Director and Advisory Committee, and sets penalties for unauthorized export.

name: The Area Study Centres Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Area Study Centres Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Area Study Centres within universities in Pakistan to study contemporary societies affecting the nation's interest. It outlines the functions of these centres, the composition and powers of their Boards of Governors, and provisions for directors, academic committees, and funding.

name: The Baluchistan Constabulary Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Baluchistan Constabulary Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the Baluchistan Constabulary and matters connected therewith. It establishes the force under the Federal Government, defines key terms, outlines the appointment of officers, and sets rules regarding control, administration, and specific offenses within the constabulary.

name: The North-West Frontier Province Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Peshawar) Act, 1975

metadata.title: North-West Frontier Province Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Peshawar) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Peshawar) Ordinance, 1975 (N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. IV of 1975)
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to remove and prevent traffic congestion while regulating vehicular traffic within the Municipal Committee limits of Peshawar. It establishes provisions for bus stands, defines powers for the Commissioner regarding land acquisition and regulation, and outlines penalties for contraventions.

name: The North-West Frontier Province Urban Planning Act, 1975

metadata.title: North-West Frontier Province Urban Planning Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a system of urban planning for the North-West Frontier Province to integrate physical, economic, and social planning at all government levels. It creates an institutional framework and designates government agencies with necessary powers to formulate integrated development policies and coordinate provincial planning with federal efforts.

name: The North-West Frontier Province Suppression of Crimes Act, 1975

metadata.title: North-West Frontier Province Suppression of Crimes Act, 1975
metadata.amends: North-West Frontier Province (Villages and Small Towns Patrol and Protection) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Suppression of Crimes Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to deal more effectively with offences against life and property in the North-West Frontier Province during a state of emergency. It establishes provisions for imposing fines on inhabitants who abet crimes, fail to assist authorities, harbor offenders, or suppress evidence, as well as rules regarding appeals, legal representation, and judicial immunity.

name: The Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of Fishing) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of Fishing) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act regulates fishing activities within the exclusive fishery zone of Pakistan, extending to waters beyond territorial limits. It establishes prohibitions on unlicensed fishing, the use of explosives or poisons, and sets rules for closed seasons and prohibited areas.

name: The Capital Development Authority (Abatement of Arbitration Proceedings) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Capital Development Authority (Abatement of Arbitration Proceedings) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the annulment of certain references to arbitration and the abatement of specific arbitration proceedings involving the Capital Development Authority. It declares that provisions in agreements relating to arbitration shall be abrogated and all pending arbitration proceedings or awards under such agreements shall stand annulled.

name: The Abandoned Properties (Taking Over and Management) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Abandoned Properties (Taking Over and Management) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the taking over and management of certain abandoned properties belonging to specified persons who left East Pakistan after December 16, 1971. It vests such properties in the Federal Government and establishes a Board of Trustees and an Administrator to control and manage them.

name: The Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides special provisions for the suppression of acts of sabotage, subversion, and terrorism. It establishes Special Courts with specific jurisdiction to try scheduled offences and outlines their powers, procedures, and appeal mechanisms.

name: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975

metadata.title: Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act repeals several existing laws and regulations concerning evacuee property and the rehabilitation of displaced persons. It also transfers pending proceedings to provincial authorities and outlines the process for transferring available urban and rural properties to the Provincial Government.

name: The Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 1975

metadata.title: Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and disposal of evacuee properties attached to charitable, religious, or educational trusts or institutions. It establishes the Evacuee Trust Property Board as a body corporate responsible for supervising, maintaining, and disposing of such properties in accordance with the Act's provisions.

name: The President's Pension Act, 1974

metadata.title: The President's Pension Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Governor-General's Pension Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a monthly pension and gratuity to persons who have held the office of President for not less than two years without removal for misconduct. It also grants specific facilities such as exemption from arms ordinances, diplomatic passports, and access to government guest houses.

name: The Federal Investigation Agency Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Federal Investigation Agency Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of a Federal Investigation Agency to investigate specific offences connected with matters concerning the Federal Government. It defines the agency's structure, including a Director-General appointed by the Federal Government, and outlines the powers of its members regarding search, arrest, and seizure of property throughout Pakistan.

name: The Associated Cement (Vesting) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Associated Cement (Vesting) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the vesting of the Associated Cement undertakings in the State Cement Corporation of Pakistan Limited. It transfers all associated rights, properties, liabilities, and powers from the Federal Government to the Corporation while ensuring employee terms remain favorable.

name: The Settlement of Disputes of Immovable Property (Chitral) Regulation, 1974

metadata.title: Regulation to provide for the settlement of disputes in regard to immovable property in the former State of Chitral
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the settlement of disputes regarding immovable property in the former State of Chitral during a state of emergency. It empowers the Federal Government to suspend orders, restricts property transfers for twelve months, bars court jurisdiction over its actions, and outlines punishments for obstruction.

name: The Distribution of Property (Chitral) Regulation, 1974

metadata.title: Distribution of Property (Chitral) Regulation, 1974
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the distribution of properties in the former State of Chitral under emergency powers. It establishes rules regarding the suspension of orders, restrictions on property transfers, and penalties for obstructing implementation.

name: The Abolition of Jagirs and Intermediary Interests Regulation, 1974

metadata.title: The Abolition of Jagirs and Intermediary Interests Regulation, 1974
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the abolition of jagirs and certain intermediary interests in the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas. It declares that all such interests existing immediately before its commencement shall be abolished and revert to the Provincial Government without compensation.

name: The Associated Cement (Vesting) Ordinance, 1974

metadata.title: The Associated Cement (Vesting) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the vesting of Associated Cement undertakings in the State Cement Corporation of Pakistan Limited. It transfers all associated rights, properties, assets, liabilities, and legal proceedings from the Federal Government to the Corporation while ensuring employees' terms are not less favorable than before.

name: The Evacuee Trust Property (Management and Disposal) Ordinance, 1974

metadata.title: The Evacuee Trust Property (Management and Disposal) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the management and disposal of evacuee property attached to charitable, religious, or educational trusts or institutions. It establishes the Evacuee Trust Property Board as a body corporate responsible for supervising, maintaining, and disposing of such properties in accordance with the provisions of the Act.

name: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Ordinance, 1974

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons (Repeal) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.repeals: Registration of Claims Displaced Persons Act, 1966; Pakistan Rehabilitation Act, 1958 (XIII of 1958); Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Properties) Act, 1947 (XI of 1947); The East Pakistan (Evacuee Property and Rehabilitation) Act, 1948; Displaced Persons (Land Settlement) Act, 1958 (XLVII of 1958); Survey of Claims Evacuee Property Regulation, 1942; Recovery of Price of Evacuee Property and Public Lives Regulation, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals several existing Acts and Regulations related to evacuee property and the rehabilitation of displaced persons. It also provides for the transfer of such properties to Provincial Governments and outlines procedures for their disposal.

name: The Transfer of Property Ordinance (Repeal) Act, 1974

metadata.title: Transfer of Property Ordinance (Repeal) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: Transfer of Property Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the National Assembly of Pakistan to repeal the Transfer of Property Ordinance, 1947. It received the President's assent on July 31, 1974, and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Finance Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1974. It primarily amends the Income-tax Act, 1922 to update definitions, tax rates, and provisions regarding Appellate Assistant Commissioners.

name: The People's Open University Act, 1974

metadata.title: The People's Open University Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the People's Open University at Islamabad as a specialized educational institution. It provides for the university's powers to offer educational facilities, conduct examinations, award degrees, and engage in research.

name: The Sukkur Barrage (Validation of Orders) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Sukkur Barrage (Validation of Orders) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain orders passed by the Sukkur Barrage Authorities regarding land grants to non-Muslims who migrated to India or grants made to other persons. It declares these orders valid despite any conflicting provisions in previous rehabilitation acts or court decrees.

name: The Delimitation of constituencies Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Delimitation of Constituencies Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the delimitation of constituencies for elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies in Pakistan. It establishes the Election Commission's powers, procedures, and authority to allocate seats based on population data from the last preceding census.

name: The Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Court) Ordinance, 1974

metadata.title: suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Court) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides special provisions to suppress acts of sabotage, subversion, and terrorism. It establishes mechanisms for the speedy trial of offences committed in furtherance of or in connection with such acts.

name: The Provincial Service Tribunals (Extension of Provisions of the Constitution) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Provincial Service Tribunals (Extension of Provisions of the Constitution) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of clause (2) of Article 212 of the Constitution to Service Tribunals established under Acts of the Provincial Assemblies of the North-West Frontier Province, Punjab, and Sind. It responds to requests from these Provincial Assemblies for this specific extension of constitutional rights.

name: The West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Transfer of Projects and Companies) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Transfer of Projects and Companies) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the transfer of certain projects and companies from the West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation to specified corporations. It defines key terms such as 'corporation', 'managed company', and 'project' and establishes that these transfers take effect from August 13, 1973.

name: The Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974

metadata.title: Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: Economic Reforms (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the salaries and allowances of members of Parliament in Pakistan. It also provides for certain privileges belonging to the Leaders of the House and the Leaders of the Opposition in both Houses of Parliament.

name: The Centres of Excellence Act, 1974

metadata.title: Centres of Excellence Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act establishes centres of excellence in universities to conduct high-level teaching and research. It provides for the creation of a Board of Governors, appoints a Director, and outlines the functions and management structure of these centres.

name: The University Grants Commission Act, 1974

metadata.title: University Grants Commission Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University Grants Commission to oversee educational planning and ensure coordination between universities in Pakistan. It defines the Commission's structure, membership composition, functions regarding financial grants, and standards for teaching and research.

name: The Electoral Rolls Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Electoral Rolls Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preparation and revision of electoral rolls for elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies. It defines key terms such as 'Commissioner', 'electoral area', and 'Registration Officer', and outlines the criteria for voter enrollment, including age and residency requirements.

name: The Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Ordinance, 1974

metadata.title: Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law regarding salaries and allowances for members of Parliament in Pakistan. It also establishes certain privileges for the Leaders of the House and the Leaders of the Opposition in both Houses of Parliament.

name: The Passports Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Passports Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the departure from and entry into Pakistan, as well as visits to foreign countries by Pakistani citizens. It establishes requirements for possessing a valid passport, defines offenses related to forgery or misuse of travel documents, and prescribes penalties for contraventions.

name: The Banks (Nationalization) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Banks (Nationalization) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the nationalization of banking business in Pakistan by transferring ownership, management, and control of all banks to the Federal Government. It establishes an exclusive right for the Federal Government to establish banks and outlines provisions for compensating former shareholders with government bonds.

name: The Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Regulation and Control) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Regulation and Control) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the operation and future development of the maritime shipping industry in Pakistan to maintain essential services and promote foreign trade. It empowers the Federal Government to take over the management or acquire shares/business of establishments deemed necessary for public interest, while excluding certain government-owned institutions and foreign investors from such acquisition.

name: The Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Act,1974

metadata.title: The Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and development of marketing facilities in petroleum products within Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to take over the management of marketing companies, acquire their shares, and appoint Managing Directors under federal control.

name: The West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Transfer of Projects and Companies) Ordinance, 1974

metadata.title: West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Transfer of Projects and Companies) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of certain projects and companies from the West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation to specified corporations. It defines key terms such as 'corporation', 'managed company', and 'project' within the context of this transfer.

name: The Banks (Transfer of Assets and Liabilities) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Banks (Transfer of Assets and Liabilities) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the transfer of certain assets and liabilities from the Eastern Mercantile Bank Limited and the Eastern Banking Corporation Limited to the National Bank of Pakistan. It defines the scope of the transfer, outlines the vesting of undertakings, and establishes procedures for contracts, pending proceedings, valuation, and delivery of property.

name: The Companies (Appointment of Legal Advisers) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Companies (Appointment of Legal Advisers) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Legal Advisers to companies in Pakistan. It mandates that every company must appoint at least one Legal Adviser, who must be an advocate or a registered firm of advocates, and specifies the minimum retainer fees and restrictions on the number of companies an individual or firm can advise.

name: The Dock Workers (Regulation of Employment) Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Dock Workers (Regulation of Employment) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the employment of dock workers to ensure efficient performance of work and speedy transit of goods through ports. It empowers the Federal Government to create schemes for worker registration, define obligations, and establish authorities like Inspectors to oversee these provisions.

name: The Prevention of Anti-National Activities Act, 1974

metadata.title: The Prevention of Anti-National Activities Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the more effective prevention of certain anti-national and treasonable activities by individuals and associations. It defines what constitutes an anti-national activity, such as inciting secession or disrupting the sovereignty of Pakistan, and establishes a mechanism for the Federal Government to declare associations as anti-national subject to review by a Tribunal.

name: The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Finance Act, 1973; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944
metadata.repeals: The Finance (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to supplementary financial proposals of the Federal Government and amends several existing laws. It introduces a flood relief surcharge on customs duties for specific goods and repeals the Finance (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1973.

name: The Private Military Organisation (Abolition and Prohibition) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Private Military Organisations (Abolition and Prohibition) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Private Military Organisations (Abolition and Prohibition) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes private organisations capable of functioning as military entities, which are prohibited under Article 256 of the Constitution. It empowers the Federal Government to declare such organisations illegal via notification and imposes penalties, including imprisonment and fines, for forming or participating in these groups.

name: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Employees' Cost of Living (Relief) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a cost of living allowance to employees in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'undertaking' while specifying the calculation rates for the allowance based on wage levels.

name: The Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1974

metadata.title: Pakistan Maritime Shipping (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the operation and future development of the maritime shipping industry in Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to take over management or acquire shares of establishments deemed necessary for public interest.

name: The Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Ordinance, 1974

metadata.title: Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the management and development of marketing facilities in petroleum products under Federal control. It empowers the Federal Government to take over the management or acquire shares of marketing companies deemed necessary for public interest.

name: The Banks (Nationalisation) Ordinance, 1974

metadata.title: The Banks (Nationalisation) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the nationalisation of banking business in Pakistan by transferring ownership, management, and control of all banks to the Federal Government. It establishes an exclusive right for the Federal Government to establish banks and outlines provisions for compensating former shareholders through government bonds.

name: The Banks (Transfer of Assets and Liabilities) Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: The Banks (Transfer of Assets and Liabilities) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of certain assets and liabilities from the Eastern Mercantile Bank Limited and the Eastern Banking Corporation Limited to the National Bank of Pakistan. It defines the scope of the transferred undertaking, including all property, rights, and obligations, while ensuring that existing contracts and legal proceedings continue against or in favor of the National Bank of Pakistan.

name: The Prevention of Anti-National Activities Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: The Prevention of Anti-National Activities Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the more effective prevention of certain anti-national and treasonable activities by individuals and associations. It defines specific acts that constitute anti-national activities, such as inciting secession or disrupting Pakistan's sovereignty, and establishes a process for the Federal Government to declare associations as anti-national.

name: The Dock Workers (Regulation of Employment) Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: Dock Workers (Regulation of Employment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of dock worker employment to ensure efficient performance of work and speedy transit of goods. It empowers the Federal Government to make schemes for registering dock workers, defining their obligations, regulating recruitment, and establishing minimum pay and safety measures.

name: The Private Military Organisations (Abolition and Prohibtion) Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: The Private Military Organisations (Abolition and Prohibition) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes private organisations capable of functioning as military organisations and declares them illegal under Article 256 of the Constitution. It imposes penalties, including imprisonment up to five years and a fine, on anyone who forms, organizes, trains, equips, or participates in such prohibited organizations.

name: The Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1973

metadata.title: The Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1973
metadata.summary: These rules outline the methods for appointing civil servants to various posts within the Federal Government of Pakistan. They define key terms such as 'appointing authority' and 'Selection Board', and establish the composition and functions of Departmental Promotion and Selection Committees.

name: The Civil Servants Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Civil Servants Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Service Tribunals Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment of persons to, and the terms and conditions of service for, persons in the service of Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'civil servant' and 'permanent post', establishes that civil servants hold office during the pleasure of the President, and outlines procedures for initial appointments and probation periods.

name: The Service Tribunals Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Service Tribunals Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Service Tribunals to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters relating to the terms and conditions of service for civil servants. It defines the composition, appointment, and powers of these tribunals, including their authority to hear appeals against departmental orders regarding disciplinary actions or fitness for posts.

name: The High Treason (Punishment) Act, 1973

metadata.title: High Treason (Punishment) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the punishment of persons found guilty of acts involving the abrogation or subversion of a Constitution or high treason. It extends to the whole of Pakistan and comes into force immediately.

name: The Employees, Cost of Living (Relief) Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: The Employees Cost of Living (Relief) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the payment of a cost of living allowance to employees in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'undertaking' to establish the scope of the relief measures.

name: The Finance (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: Finance (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.amends: Tariff Act, 1934; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Finance Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to supplementary financial proposals of the Federal Government and amends specific existing laws. It introduces a flood relief surcharge on customs duty for specified goods and updates schedules in the Tariff Act, Central Excises and Salt Act, and Finance Act.

name: The Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil Industry (Control and Development) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil Industry (Control and Development) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the operation and future development of the hydrogenated vegetable oil industry in Pakistan. It declares that the industry shall be carried on and owned by the Federal or Provincial Government to the exclusion of other persons, except foreign investors.

name: The Removal Of Accused Persons Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Removal of Accused Persons Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Removal of Accused Persons Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the removal of accused persons from one Province to another within Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to issue orders transferring individuals held in custody between provinces, overriding other existing laws.

name: The Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil Industry (Control and Development ) Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: The Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil Industry (Control and Development) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the operation and future development of the hydrogenated vegetable oil industry in Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to take over management or acquire shares of establishments deemed necessary for public interest, while safeguarding small investors.

name: The Removal of Accused Persons Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: The Removal of Accused Persons Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the removal of accused persons from one Province to another within Pakistan. It empowers the Federal Government to issue orders transferring any accused person held in custody in one province to be held in custody in another province, overriding other laws on the matter.

name: S.R.O. 1205(I)/73 — Direction Regarding Maintenance of Liquid Assets by Banking Companies

metadata.title: Notification No. S.R.O. 1205(1)/73
metadata.summary: This notification directs banking companies to maintain a minimum cash reserve of thirty-five percent of their total time and demand liabilities in Pakistan. It sets this requirement effective August 16, 1973, superseding a previous notification from June 6, 1972.

name: The Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Federal Public Service Commission and outlines its composition, term of office for members, and primary functions regarding recruitment and advising on service conditions. It was promulgated by the President under Article 89 of the Constitution due to the National Assembly not being in session.

name: The Service Tribunals Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: The Service Tribunals Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Service Tribunals to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters relating to the terms and conditions of service for civil servants. It defines the composition of these tribunals, outlines the process for filing appeals against departmental orders, and grants the tribunals powers similar to civil courts.

name: The Civil Servants Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: The Civil Servants Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the appointment of persons to and the terms and conditions of service for persons in the service of Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'civil servant', 'ad hoc appointment', and 'permanent post', and establishes rules regarding tenure, initial appointments on probation, promotion, and confirmation.

name: RULES OF BUSINESS,1973 (As Amended up to 2nd June, 2025)

metadata.title: Rules of Business, 1973
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Federal Government under Articles 90 and 99 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to regulate business procedures. They cover general administration, consultation among divisions, cabinet operations, legislative processes, relations with parliament, provincial interactions, and emergency provisions.

name: The National Guards Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Funds Vesting in the President (Transfer) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the administration of certain funds that vest in the President. It stipulates that these funds, along with their income and profits, shall vest in the Federal Government and be utilized for their original purposes or similar ones.

name: The Funds Vesting in the President (Transfer) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Funds Vesting in the President (Transfer) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the administration of certain funds that vest in the President. It transfers specified funds, along with their income and profits, to the Federal Government for utilization according to their original purpose or similar ones.

name: The Pakistan National Council of the Arts Act, 1973

metadata.title: Pakistan National Council of the Arts Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan National Council of the Arts to promote and develop the arts through patronage and systematic planning. It defines the Council as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its composition, including members from various ministries, elected representatives, and eminent persons in the field of art.

name: The Newspaper Employees (Conditions of Service) Act, 1973

metadata.title: Newspaper Employees (Conditions of Service) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and reenacts the Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960 with certain amendments. It establishes conditions for newspaper employees regarding appointment orders, termination notice periods, provident fund contributions, working hours, and leave entitlements.

name: The Members of the Senate (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1973

metadata.title: Members of the Senate (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1973
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salary, allowances, and privileges for members of the Senate of Pakistan. It stipulates that these benefits shall be the same as those admissible to members of the National Assembly, with the Federal Government retaining the power to grant additional privileges.

name: The Chairman and Deputy Chairman of Senate (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1973

metadata.title: The Chairman and Deputy Chairman of Senate (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1973
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salaries, allowances, and privileges for the Chairman and Deputy Chairman of the Senate. It stipulates that these officials receive the same benefits as the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly, respectively, while prohibiting them from drawing additional salary for their Senate membership.

name: The National Registration Act, 1973

metadata.title: The National Registration Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of citizens in Pakistan and the issuance of identity cards to them. It establishes a hierarchy of Registration Officers, defines key terms, and outlines procedures for applying for registration and obtaining identity cards. The legislation also specifies requirements for producing identity cards for travel and elections, along with penalties for disclosing information acquired during employment under the Act.

name: The Publication of the Holy Quran (Elimination of Printing Errors) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Publication of the Holy Quran (Elimination of Printing Errors) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act ensures the publication of the text of the Holy Quran free from printing errors and regulates matters connected therewith. It establishes a Committee of Ulema to authenticate a standard copy and mandates specific registration, printing, and quality control procedures for publishers.

name: The Finance Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1973. It also amends specific sections of the Income-tax Act, 1922 regarding tax recovery officers, valuation procedures, and penalties.

name: The National Development Volunteer Programme Act, 1973

metadata.title: The National Development Volunteer Programme Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for promoting, developing, and regulating systematic apprenticeship programmes for educated persons to help them secure gainful employment. It establishes a National Development Volunteer Programme with a Director-General to register educated persons, manage job opportunities, provide training, and advise on economic adjustments.

name: The Assistant Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Assistant Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain orders passed by Assistant Settlement Commissioners that were previously declared or rendered invalid. It deems these orders to have been validly made despite the lack of delegated powers, effective from March 26, 1958.

name: The Port Qasim Authority Act, 1973

metadata.title: Port Qasim Authority Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: Loans for Agricultural Purposes Ordinance, 1973 (IV of 1973)
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Port Qasim Authority to manage, plan, and develop the Muhammad Bin Qasim Port at Phitti Creek. It defines the powers of the Authority as a body corporate and outlines the composition and management structure involving a Board.

name: The Loans for Agricultural Purposes Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Loans for Agricultural Purposes Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for credit facilities for persons engaged in agriculture. It establishes a system where banks can grant loans to land-owners based on pass books authenticated by Revenue Officers, treating these books as title deeds for the purpose of securing agricultural loans.

name: The Chemical Fertilizers (Development Surcharge) Act, 1973

metadata.title: Chemical Fertilizers (Development Surcharge) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy and collection of a development surcharge on chemical fertilizers in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'differential margin' and 'ex-factory price', establishes the obligation for companies and stockists to pay the surcharge, and grants the Federal Government powers to set maximum sale prices and grant exemptions.

name: The Federal Security Force Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Federal Security Force Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and regulation of the Federal Security Force to assist civil administration and the Police Force in maintaining law and order. It defines key terms, outlines the functions of the force, and establishes provisions for the appointment of officers and subordinate staff.

name: The National Development Volunteer Programme Ordinance,1973

metadata.title: National Development Volunteer Programme Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the promotion, development, and regulation of systematic apprenticeship programmes to equip educated persons for gainful employment. It establishes a Director-General and registration centres to manage job opportunities, training, and counselling for unemployed educated individuals within government and industrial establishments.

name: The Federal Security Force Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: The Federal Security Force Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution and regulation of the Federal Security Force to assist civil administration and police in maintaining law and order. It outlines the force's functions, including handling dangerous criminals, conducting road patrols, and performing other duties as notified by the Federal Government.

name: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973

metadata.title: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This document is the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, enacted by the National Assembly and authenticated by the President on April 12, 1973. It establishes the fundamental rights, principles of policy, and structure of the federation including provisions for the President, Parliament, and legislative procedures.

name: The Chemical Fertilizers (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: The Chemical Fertilizers (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of a development surcharge on chemical fertilizers in Pakistan. It establishes definitions for terms like 'differential margin' and 'ex-factory price', mandates payment by manufacturers and stockists, and grants the Federal Government power to exempt companies or authorize refunds.

name: The Loans for Agricultural Purposes Ordinance, 1973

metadata.title: Loans for Agricultural Purposes Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for credit facilities available to persons engaged in agriculture. It establishes a mechanism where banks can accept pass books authenticated by Revenue Officers as title deeds for granting loans secured against agricultural land.

name: The Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the law relating to legal practitioners and bar councils with certain modifications. It establishes the constitution, incorporation, and terms of the Pakistan Bar Council and Provincial Bar Councils.

name: The Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation Act, 1973

metadata.title: Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition of the Board, the qualifications for Directors, and outlines the Corporation's functions to provide broadcasting services for information, education, and entertainment.

name: The Pay-As-You-Earn Scheme Act, 1973

metadata.title: Pay-As-You-Earn Scheme Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: Pay-As-You-Earn Scheme Ordinance, 1972 (LIX of 1972)
metadata.summary: This Act introduces a scheme for importing machinery and equipment on credit to establish specific industrial units and enterprises. It requires that the costs of imported machinery be met from the export earnings of the respective units, with provisions for penalties if foreign exchange is not repatriated or earnings are insufficient.

name: The Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research Act, 1973

metadata.title: Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research to promote and guide scientific and technological research for industrial development in Pakistan. It defines the Council's composition, functions, and the terms of office for its members while providing for the establishment of research institutes.

name: The University of Islamabad Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to certain Tribal Areas) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to Tribal Areas) Order, 1970 (P. O. No. 28 of 1970)
metadata.summary: This Act extends the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and the Peshawar High Court to specific Tribal Areas including Chitral, Dir, Kalam, Swat, and Malakand Protected Area. It grants these courts the same jurisdiction in these areas as they possess in other parts of the North-West Frontier Province.

name: The Supreme Court and High Court (Extension Of Jurisdiction to certain Tribal Areas) Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to certain Tribal Areas) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Supreme Court and High Court (Extension of Jurisdiction to Tribal Areas) Order, 1970 (P. O. No. 28 of 1970)
metadata.summary: This Act extends the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and the Peshawar High Court to specific Tribal Areas including Chitral, Dir, Kalam, Swat, and Malakand Protected Area. It grants these courts the same jurisdiction in these areas as they possess in other parts of the North-West Frontier Province.

name: The Pakistan Nursing Council Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Economic Reforms Order (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: Economic Reforms Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Economic Reforms Order of 1972 by adding specific provisions regarding the establishment's new name and effective date. It also repeals a previous amendment ordinance from 1972.

name: The Short Titles Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Short Titles Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Short Titles Ordinance, 1972 (LXV of 1972)
metadata.summary: This Act assigns short titles to various Martial Law Regulations and Orders specified in the First and Seventh Schedules of the Interim Constitution. It also repeals the Short Titles Ordinance, 1972.

name: The Pakistan Coast Guards Act, 1973

metadata.title: The Pakistan Coast Guards Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Payment of Wages Ordinance, 1972 (XIX of 1972)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and regulation of the Pakistan Coast Guards. It also establishes special measures to check smuggling across the Arabian Sea frontiers and deal with threats to national defense in coastal areas.

name: The National Development Finance Corporation Act, 1973

metadata.title: National Development Finance Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: Agricultural Development Bank (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Development Finance Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the corporation's authorized and paid-up share capital, outlines the composition and appointment of its Board of Directors, and sets forth the qualifications for directors.

name: The Pakistan Science Foundation Act, 1973

metadata.title: Pakistan Science Foundation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Science Foundation as a body corporate to promote and finance scientific activities relevant to the country's socio-economic needs. The Foundation functions as a financing agency for research, science centers, and the exchange of scientific knowledge with other countries.

name: The Finance (Third Supplementary) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Finance (Third Supplementary) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes supplementary provisions to give effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government. It also amends certain laws, specifically omitting clauses in the Income-tax Act, 1922, and sets deadlines for depositing sums into the State Bank of Pakistan.

name: The Pay-As-You-Earn Scheme Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Pay-As-You-Earn Scheme Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Pay-As-You-Earn Scheme Act, 1973 (31 of 1973)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance introduces a scheme for importing machinery and equipment on credit to establish specific industrial units and enterprises. It requires that the costs of imported machinery and related foreign exchange charges be met from the export earnings of the benefiting industrial unit or enterprise.

name: The National Development Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The National Development Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the National Development Finance Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the corporation's share capital, the composition and powers of its Board of Directors, and defines its eligible enterprises and borrowing capabilities.

name: The Tolls (Army and Air Force) Act (Application to the Centrally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Tolls (Army and Air Force) Act (Application to the Centrally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1972
metadata.amends: The Tolls (Army and Air Force) Act, 1901
