metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the provisions of the Tolls (Army and Air Force) Act, 1901 to the Centrally Administered Tribal Areas. It was promulgated by the President under clause (5) of Article 261 of the Interim Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

name: The Finance (Second Supplementary) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Finance (Second Supplementary) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes supplementary provisions to give effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government. It also amends specific sections of the Income-tax Act, 1922, and the Finance Ordinance, 1972.

name: The Peoples Finance Corporation Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Peoples' Finance Corporation Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of a body corporate called the Peoples' Finance Corporation. It outlines the Corporation's powers, share capital structure, and governance through a Board of Directors.

name: The University of Islamabad Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The University of Islamabad Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to reconstitute and reorganize the University of Islamabad for improved administration. It establishes the university's structure, including its officers, authorities like the Senate and Syndicate, and provisions for statutes, regulations, and rules.

name: The Discontinuance of Medical Reimbursement Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Discontinuance of Medical Reimbursement Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Discontinuance of Medical Reimbursement Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act discontinues the reimbursement of medical expenses incurred by government servants and employees of other bodies in Pakistan. It applies to all federal, provincial, and public corporation employees, prohibiting them from claiming reimbursement for purchased medicines while allowing access to medicines prescribed by authorized attendants within budget limits.

name: The Drugs (Generic Names) Act, 1972

metadata.title: Drugs (Generic Names) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the National Formulary of Pakistan and establishes the adoption of generic names for drugs. It creates a National Formulary Committee to prepare this list and sets prohibitions on using brand or proprietary names after specific dates.

name: The Foreign Exchange (Prevention of Payments) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange (Prevention of payments) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Foreign Exchange (Prevention of Payments) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Federal Government to prohibit certain payments related to foreign exchange repatriation. It empowers the State Bank of Pakistan and authorized dealers to manage deposits and claims arising from such repatriations while providing legal immunity for actions taken in good faith under the Act.

name: The Extradition Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Extradition Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the extradition of fugitive offenders in Pakistan. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'extradition offence' and 'treaty State', outlines procedures for requisitioning surrender, and provides powers to the Federal Government regarding non-treaty states.

name: The National Book Foundation Act, 1972

metadata.title: The National Book Foundation Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The National Book Foundation Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Book Foundation to make books available at moderate prices. It defines the foundation's constitution, functions, and governance structure while repealing a previous ordinance.

name: The National Sport Trust Act, 1972

metadata.title: The National Sports Trust Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The National Sports Trust Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Sports Trust to promote sports activities and matters ancillary thereto. It defines the composition of the Trust, outlines its functions such as receiving grants and maintaining stadia, and empowers the Trust to make rules for carrying out the Act's provisions.

name: The Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: Ordinance XXXVI of 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for certain matters relating to the development of industries under Federal control in Pakistan. It establishes a Board of Industrial Management with specific functions to ensure efficient management of establishments and defines the powers of the Federal Government regarding this board.

name: The Companies (Appointment of Trustees) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Companies (Appointment of Trustees) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management of affairs of certain companies where a trustee is appointed by the Federal Government. It vests the company's assets and liabilities in the trustee and outlines the powers, functions, and restrictions regarding such appointments.

name: The Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The War Risks Insurance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the transfer of certain evacuee land to its occupants in Katchi Abadi areas. It cancels previous allotments and transfers, grants proprietary rights to occupants who did not own other property, and establishes a scheme for resuming vacant possession of such lands.

name: The Civil Commotion Compensation Fund (Repeal) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Civil Commotion Compensation Fund (Repeal) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: Civil Commotion Compensation Fund Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Civil Commotion Compensation Fund Ordinance, 1971. It mandates that insurers pay outstanding surcharges and amounts into the existing Fund, after which all monies in the Fund are credited to the Federal Consolidated Fund.

name: The Diplomatic and Consular Privileges Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Diplomatic and Consular Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: Diplomatic and Consular Privileges Ordinance, XV of 1972
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, 1961, and the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations, 1963. It grants force of law to the provisions of these conventions within Pakistan while establishing specific rules regarding privileges, immunities, and their restrictions.

name: The Settlement Commissioners (validation of Orders) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain orders passed by Settlement Commissioners that were previously declared or rendered invalid. It deems these specific orders to have been validly made and effective from March 26, 1958, notwithstanding any conflicting court decrees or other authorities.

name: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1965; The Province of West Pakistan (Dissolution) Order, 1970; The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the dissolution of the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation and transfers its business, projects, and properties to the Provinces. It also outlines provisions for the succession of rights, liabilities, and the transfer of employees following the dissolution.

name: The Civil Commotion Compensation Fund (Repeal) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain orders passed by Settlement Commissioners that were previously declared invalid. It applies to the whole of Pakistan and is deemed to have taken effect from March 26, 1958.

name: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Settlement Commissioners (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain orders passed by Settlement Commissioners that were previously declared or rendered invalid. It deems these specific orders to have been validly made and effective from March 26, 1958, notwithstanding any conflicting decrees or the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958.

name: The Foreign Exchange (Prevention of Payments) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange (Prevention of Payments) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Foreign Exchange (Prevention of Payments) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance enables the Federal Government to prohibit certain payments related to foreign exchange repatriation. It outlines procedures for depositing repatriated amounts with the State Bank and handling claims against persons who have repatriated funds, while also granting legal immunity to government bodies acting in good faith under this law.

name: The National Press Trust (Appointment of Chairman) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The National Press Trust (Appointment of Chairman) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of the Chairman of the National Press Trust and addresses related matters. It empowers the President to appoint a person of eminence as Chairman, who serves during the pleasure of the President and receives remuneration from the Trust Fund.

name: The National Sport Trust Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The National Sports Trust Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The National Sports Trust Act, 1972 (18 of 1972)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes a Trust in Pakistan to make sports activities self-financing. It was promulgated by the President under the Interim Constitution because the National Assembly was not in session.

name: The National Book Foundation Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Pakistan Citizenship (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951. It was promulgated by the President under the Interim Constitution because the National Assembly was not in session.

name: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1965; The Province of West Pakistan (Dissolution) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the dissolution of the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation. It also outlines the transfer of the Corporation's projects, properties, and employees to the respective provinces and repeals previous laws related to the Corporation.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Finance Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government and amends certain existing laws. It was promulgated by the President under the Interim Constitution because the National Assembly was not in session.

name: The Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Transfer of Evacuee Land (Katchi Abadi) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of certain evacuee land located in Katchi Abadi areas to their occupants. It cancels previous allotments and transfers, grants proprietary rights to eligible occupants on payment of a determined price, and allows for the resumption of any remaining land not transferred.

name: The Import Policy Order, 1972

metadata.title: Import Policy Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the import of goods in Pakistan by classifying items into free and tied lists. It defines specific terms such as 'actual user' and 'indentor' and outlines restrictions on banned items, secondhand goods, and explosives.

name: The Finance (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Finance (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956; The Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950; The Customs Act, 1969; The Exchange Control Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to certain financial proposals and amends specific laws while the National Assembly is not in session. It abolishes the Bonus Voucher Scheme, voids outstanding bonus vouchers, and provides for compensation at a prescribed rate.

name: REGULATION No. 80

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 80
metadata.summary: This regulation empowers the Chief Martial Law Administrator to remove Central Government, Provincial Government, or private sector employees from service if they are engaged in activities prejudicial to Pakistan's stability or deliberately absent from duty. It mandates that employers must terminate such employment within seven days of receiving an order.

name: Interim Constitution Order

metadata.title: The Order of the President declaring suspension of Fundamental Rights
metadata.repeals: Order No. F. 24 (1)/72-Pub., dated the 21st April, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order declares that the right to move any court, including the Supreme Court, for the enforcement of specific Fundamental Rights is suspended. The suspension applies during the period the Proclamation of Emergency issued on November 23, 1971, remains in force.

name: The Land Reforms (Limits on Individual Holdings) Order, 1972

metadata.title: Land Reforms (Limits on Individual Holdings) Order, 1972
metadata.amends: Land Reforms Regulation (Martial Law Regulation No. 115 of 1972)
metadata.summary: This Order reduces the maximum area of land permitted to be owned or possessed by any individual under the Land Reforms Regulation. It establishes new limits based on produce index units and requires declarations from persons who held land exceeding twelve thousand units between March 1, 1967, and December 20, 1971.

name: REGULATION No. 128

metadata.title: Regulation No. 128
metadata.summary: This regulation empowers the President to make an Order reducing the area of land permitted to be possessed or owned under paragraph 8. The reduced area must not fall below specific thresholds regarding produce index units, irrigated land, or unirrigated land.

name: The Drugs (Generic Names) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Drugs (Generic Names) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Formulary of Pakistan and mandates the adoption of generic names for drugs. It creates a National Formulary Committee to prepare and review the list of approved drugs and prohibits the manufacture, sale, or prescription of drugs not included in this formulary.

name: The Discontinuance of Medical Reimbursement Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: Discontinuance of Medical Reimbursement Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance discontinues the reimbursement of medical expenses incurred by Government servants and employees of other bodies. It applies to all employees of Central and Provincial Governments as well as those in public corporations and statutory bodies, overriding any existing laws or contracts regarding such reimbursements.

name: The Interim Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1972

metadata.title: The Interim Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This document outlines the structure of the Interim Constitution for the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, covering fundamental rights, principles of policy, and federal/provincial governance. It details the roles of the President, Vice-President, Ministers, and the National Assembly, including legislative procedures and financial matters.

name: ORDER

metadata.title: Proclamation of Emergency
metadata.summary: This Order declares that the right to move any court for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights under Article 9 of the Constitution shall remain suspended. The suspension applies for the duration of the Proclamation of Emergency issued on November 23, 1971.

name: The Provincial Assemblies (Summons and Powers) (Repeal) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Provincial Assemblies (Summons and Powers) (Repeal) Order, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Assemblies (Summons and Powers) Repeal Order, 1972 (P.O. No. 12 of 1972)
metadata.summary: This Order, made by the President and Chief Martial Law Administrator on April 20, 1972, repeals the Provincial Assemblies (Summons and Powers) Repeal Order, 1972 (P.O. No. 12 of 1972). It further stipulates that any actions taken under the repealed order shall abate and have no legal effect.

name: The West Pakistan Rangers (Administration and Control) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Rangers (Administration and Control) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the administration and control of the West Pakistan Rangers. It transfers all powers regarding the Rangers from the Provincial Government to the Central Government and redefines references to provincial governors as references to the Central Government.

name: The Standing Power Rates Advisory Board Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Standing Power Rates Advisory Board Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a Standing Power Rates Advisory Board common to the provinces of Baluchistan, North-West Frontier, Punjab, Sind, and Centrally Administered Areas. It defines the board's composition, including government officials and nominated representatives from various ministries and provinces, and outlines its functions regarding power rates.

name: REGULATION No. 127

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 127
metadata.summary: This regulation amends Martial Law Regulation No. 59 by inserting a new paragraph designated as 1-A. The amendment extends the application of paragraph 1 to individuals who were at any time in the service of Pakistan or serving in any corporation or institution set up by law.

name: The Industrial Sanctions and Licenses (Cancellation) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Industrial Sanctions and Licenses (Cancellation) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the cancellation of industrial sanctions or licenses granted for projects or expansions not deemed to be in the public interest. It defines key terms such as 'license', 'project', and 'sanction' and stipulates that no legal proceedings shall lie against the government for actions taken in good faith under this Order.

name: The Martial Law (Pending Proceedings) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Martial Law (Pending Proceedings) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the disposal of cases pending before Martial Law Authorities immediately after the appointed day. It establishes procedures for transferring cases to criminal courts, handling death sentences and reviews by the President or Governors, and executing sentences under ordinary law.

name: REGULATION No. 126

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 126
metadata.summary: This document amends Martial Law Regulation No. 115 by adding a new sub-paragraph (4) to paragraph 1. The amendment includes specific text regarding the West Frontier Province.

name: REGULATION No. 125

metadata.title: Regulation No. 125
metadata.summary: This Regulation empowers the Government to manage establishments under the Economic Reforms Order, 1972, by appointing Managing Directors and regulating financial obligations. It outlines procedures for recovering debts from previous management, limits shareholder challenges to government actions, and grants broad immunity to government orders while prescribing penalties for contravention.

name: The Rulers of Acceding States (Abolition of Privy Purses and Privileges) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Rulers of Acceding States (Abolition of Privy Purses and Privileges) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order abolishes the privy purses and other privileges admissible to the Rulers of Acceding States. It provides for maintenance allowances in lieu of these abolished payments, subject to conditions regarding allegiance to Pakistan.

name: The Law Reforms Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Law Reforms (Commencement, Amendment of certain laws) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Penal Code to replace the term 'transportation' with 'imprisonment' in various sections. It also omits specific sections and adds new clauses regarding sentencing terms.

name: REGULATION No. 124

metadata.title: Regulation No. 124 of 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation empowers the Central Government to revoke sales or transfers of property made by corporations established under specific laws after March 25, 1969. It establishes a committee to determine compensation for affected persons based on costs, improvements, and income derived from the property.

name: The Worker's Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: Workers' Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the education of workers' children and related matters. It mandates that specific employers provide free education up to matriculation level for one child per worker employed in their establishment.

name: The Employees' Old Age Pension Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Employees' Old Age Pension Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for a scheme of old age pension and matters ancillary thereto. It empowers the Provincial Government to institute the scheme, define eligibility criteria, establish financing measures, and make necessary regulations.

name: The Settlement of Immovable Property Disputes (Dir and Swat) Regulation

metadata.title: Settlement of Immovable Property Disputes (Dir and Swat) Regulation
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes a framework for deciding disputes regarding ownership or rights in immovable property within the former States of Dir and Swat. It empowers the Provincial Government to make final decisions based on Commission recommendations, prohibits courts from entertaining related proceedings, and outlines penalties for obstructing enforcement.

name: The Devolution and Distribution of Property (Dir and Swat) Regulation

metadata.title: Devolution and Distribution of Property (Dir and Swat) Regulation
metadata.repeals: Acceding State (Property) Order, 1961
metadata.summary: This Regulation determines the classification of property in the former States of Dir and Swat as either state or private property belonging to the ex-Rulers. It establishes the respective shares of heirs in the private property of the late Nawab Sir Shehjenan Khan and Sir Abdul Wadud Mian Gul Sahibzada, overriding previous laws and orders.

name: The Centrally Administered Tribal Areas (Employees’ Status) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Centrally Administered Tribal Areas (Employees' Status) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order defines the status of employees serving in the Centrally Administered Tribal Areas as of July 1, 1970. It designates these employees as servants of the Provincial Government on deputation to the Central Government, subject to the administrative control and terms of service of the Provincial Government.

name: REGULATION No. 121

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 121
metadata.summary: This regulation amends Martial Law Regulation No. 115 issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator. It modifies specific paragraphs regarding land ownership declarations and numerical limits applicable during a defined period in 1967 to 1971.

name: REGULATION No. 120

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 120
metadata.summary: This regulation amends Martial Law Regulation No. 8&5 issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator. The amendments modify clauses regarding club membership duration, enrollment restrictions, and the transfer of powers to the Governor of Sind if a specific post ceases to exist.

name: REGULATION No. 119

metadata.title: Regulation No. 119
metadata.summary: This Regulation empowers the Central Government to revoke the sale of enemy property sold by a Custodian after September 6, 1965. It establishes a Committee to determine compensation for persons who owned the property immediately before such revocation and outlines procedures for managing the property and continuing legal suits.

name: REGULATION No. 118

metadata.title: Regulation No. 118
metadata.summary: This Regulation governs privately-managed colleges and schools in Pakistan, prohibiting their closure or alienation of property after March 15, 1972. It mandates that such institutions and their attached properties shall vest in the Central or Provincial Government starting September 1, 1972, while also regulating employment terms and ensuring teachers receive government-equivalent pay scales.

name: The Provincial Assemblies (Summons and Powers) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Provincial Assemblies (Summons and Powers) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order summons the Provincial Assemblies to meet on April 21, 1972. It grants these assemblies the powers and functions of a Provincial Assembly under the Legal Framework Order, 1970.

name: The National Assembly (Short Session) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The National Assembly (Short Session) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order summons the National Assembly to meet on April 14, 1972, for a short session. It limits the Assembly's business to voting on confidence in the President, the continuance of Martial Law, the interim Constitution, and the appointment of a constitutional drafting committee.

name: The Life Insurance (Nationalisation) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Life Insurance (Nationalisation) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the nationalisation of life insurance business in Pakistan by vesting its management in the Central Government. It establishes a system where trustees are appointed to manage insurers' affairs and take possession of relevant assets, acting under the direction of the government.

name: The Land Reforms (Baluchistan Fat Feeder Canal) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: Land Reforms (Baluchistan Pat Feeder Canal) Regulation
metadata.summary: This Regulation addresses protracted litigation regarding State land in Baluchistan within the command of the Pat Feeder Canal. It declares specific lands as State land, resumes them from previous occupants, and establishes a priority order for granting these lands to defense families, former tenants, and other eligible persons.

name: REGULATION No. 116

metadata.title: Removal from Service (Review Petition) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation allows persons dismissed or removed from service under Martial Law Regulation No. 114 to submit a review petition to the Chief Martial Law Administrator. It specifies filing deadlines based on whether the order was made before or after March 12, 1972, and whether the person was serving abroad.

name: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Reforms) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order was made by the President of Pakistan to improve the constitution and working of co-operative societies. It prohibits individuals from being members of apex or central banks and mandates the cessation of existing individual memberships, with provisions for refunding share prices.

name: The Land Reforms Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Regulation, 1972
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Land Reforms Regulation (Regulation 64 of 1959)
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes Land Commissions for each province to oversee land reforms and improve the economic well-being of the peasantry. It defines key terms such as 'economic holding' and 'subsistence holding' based on specific acreage limits for different provinces, while repealing the previous West Pakistan Land Reforms Regulation.

name: The removal from service (special provisions) regulation, 1972

metadata.title: Removal from Service (Special Provisions) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides special provisions for the dismissal, removal, reduction in rank, or premature retirement of persons in government or corporation service. It applies notwithstanding any existing laws, including the Provisional Constitution Order and Martial Law Regulations.

name: The Members of the Assemblies (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1972

metadata.title: Members of the Assemblies (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1972
metadata.amends: Members of the National Assembly (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order grants salary, allowances, and privileges to members of the National and Provincial Assemblies elected after December 20, 1971. It establishes specific salary caps for individuals holding dual offices or positions of profit in the service of Pakistan.

name: REGULATION No. 113

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 113
metadata.summary: This document amends Martial Law Regulation No. 81 by adding specific wording to paragraph 2, clause (b). The amendment requires the addition of the phrase 'issued before the coming into force of this Regulation' after the word 'denominations'. It was issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator on February 28, 1972.

name: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Removal of Disqualification) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Removal of Disqualification) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order removes the disqualification of persons holding specific high offices in Pakistan from being elected as members of the National or Provincial Assemblies. It applies to holders of offices such as President, Vice-President, Governor, and various advisory roles, effective from December 20, 1971.

name: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation (Dissolution) Order, 1972

metadata.title: West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation (Dissolution) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the dissolution of the West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation and the transfer of its business, projects, properties, officers, and employees to the new Provinces, the Central Government, or other authorities. It defines key terms related to the corporation and outlines the President's powers to manage affairs until specific orders are issued.

name: The Companies (Shifting of Registered Office) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Companies (Shifting of Registered Office) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides an additional procedure for shifting the registered office of a company from one Province to another in Pakistan. It outlines the application process, publication requirements in the official Gazette, and the submission of company documents to the Registrar upon such a shift.

name: REGULATION No. 97

metadata.title: Regulation No. 97
metadata.summary: This regulation declares the funds of the Pakistan Muslim League and the All Pakistan Awami League forfeited to the Central Government. These funds, held in banks under the names of the parties or their agents, are transferred to the Central Consolidated Fund for utilization as permitted by law.

name: Trial Of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman( Regulation), 1972

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 84
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes the framework for a Special Military Court to try Sheikh Mujibur Rahman. It details the composition of the court, including the president, members, prosecutors, and defence arrangements, while also outlining strict procedures regarding evidence, adjournments, and the prohibition on publishing trial proceedings.

name: REGULATION No. 83

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This regulation amends the Punjab Land Revenue Regulation by substituting specific phrases regarding engagement status in its paragraphs. It changes 'is engaged' to 'is or has been engaged' and makes similar modifications in sub-paragraphs.

name: ORDER No. 11

metadata.title: Regulation No. 97
metadata.summary: This regulation declares the funds of the Pakistan Muslim League and the All Pakistan Awami League forfeited to the Central Government. These funds are transferred to the Central Consolidated Fund and may be utilized for any purpose allowed for other moneys in that fund.

name: The Advisers (Appointment) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Advisers (Appointment) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the appointment of Advisers to the President and the Governor of a Province in Pakistan. It outlines their tenure, remuneration, privileges, and functions assigned by the respective office holders.

name: Presidential Order No. 33

metadata.title: Order No. 33
metadata.summary: This order authorizes Mr. Abdul Jabbar Khan to perform the functions of the Managing Director of the Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan during the absence of Mr. Z. A. Haq, who is under detention. The order remains in effect despite any provisions in the Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1961, and cannot be challenged in any court.

name: The State Arrangements Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The State Arrangements Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This regulation provides for the uninterrupted performance of the President's and Chief Martial Law Administrator's functions in their absence. It designates the Vice-President to act as President and restricts the acting President from removing Governors, Cabinet members, or military commanders.

name: The Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goads (Repeal) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods (Repeal) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to repeal the Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods Ordinance, 1971. It came into force immediately upon its publication.

name: The Presidential Cabinet Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Presidential Cabinet Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Council of Ministers (Cabinet) to aid and advise the President in exercising his functions. It defines the composition of the Cabinet, presiding arrangements, allocation of ministries, and the oath of office required for appointed ministers.

name: REGULATION No. 109

metadata.title: The Martial Law Regulations, 1972
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Order No. 3
metadata.summary: These regulations amend existing martial law provisions regarding the disposal of petitions from military courts and insert a new sub-paragraph concerning transportation for life. Additionally, Martial Law Order No. 3 is repealed by these instruments.

name: REGULATION No. 108

metadata.title: The Martial Law Regulations, 1972
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Order No. 3
metadata.summary: These regulations amend existing martial law provisions regarding the disposal of petitions from military courts and insert a new sub-paragraph concerning transportation for life. Additionally, Martial Law Order No. 3 is repealed by these instruments.

name: The Companies (Managing Agency and Election of Directors) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Companies (Managing Agency and Election of Directors) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order provides provisions for the removal of managing agents and the election of directors to protect minority members' interests. It establishes rules regarding the appointment of Chief Executives, termination of certain agency agreements, compensation limitations, restrictions on future managing agent appointments, and minimum director requirements for private and public companies.

name: Order No. 31

metadata.title: Order No. 31
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Regulation No. 84 as amended by Martial Law Regulation No. 92
metadata.summary: This order appoints Mr. Yunus Said as Chairman of the National Press Trust effective December 21, 1971. It grants legal immunity to the Chief Martial Law Administrator and others for actions taken under the repealed regulation.

name: REGULATION No. 107

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 106
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Regulation No. 84 as amended by Martial Law Regulation No. 92
metadata.summary: This regulation repeals Martial Law Regulation No. 84 (as amended) and annuls all proceedings, findings, sentences, or orders passed under that repealed regulation. It grants legal immunity to individuals and the government for actions taken in good faith under the said regulation.

name: REGULATION No. 106

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 106
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Regulation No. 84 as amended by Martial Law Regulation No. 92
metadata.summary: This regulation repeals Martial Law Regulation No. 84 (as amended) and annuls all proceedings, findings, sentences, or orders passed under it by the Special Military Court. It also grants immunity from legal suits or prosecutions for any actions taken in good faith under the repealed regulation, including protection against claims of damage caused to the Government.

name: The Foreign Assets (Declaration) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Foreign Assets (Declaration) Regulation, 1972
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Regulation No. 35
metadata.summary: This regulation requires citizens of Pakistan to declare movable and immovable property held abroad on or before January 15, 1972. It mandates the repatriation of declared assets by February 15, 1972, offers a 45% bonus on foreign exchange repatriated, and exempts such amounts from tax.

name: The Foreign Exchange Repatiation Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: Foreign Exchange Regulation, 1972
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Regulation No. 34
metadata.summary: This regulation mandates the declaration and repatriation of foreign exchange held in Pakistan by January 15, 1972, with a 45% bonus for compliance. It provides legal protections for declarants regarding the source of funds and confidentiality of declarations while imposing severe penalties for non-compliance.

name: The Delegation of Powers (Revocation) Order, 1971

metadata.title: The Delegation of Powers (Revocation) Order, 1971
metadata.summary: This Order was made by the President to revoke all rules, orders, and notifications under which officers or authorities were authorized to exercise Central Government powers. It states that these instruments shall cease to have effect immediately upon its commencement.

name: The Presidential Cabinet Order, 1971

metadata.title: The Presidential Cabinet Order, 1971
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a Cabinet of Ministers composed of persons elected to the National Assembly or Provincial Assemblies under the Legal Framework Order, 1970. It defines the composition, appointment procedures, duties, and tenure of the Prime Minister, Vice Prime Minister, and other Ministers, while also outlining the oath of office required for these officials.

name: The Economic Reforms Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Economic Reforms Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order was issued by the President of Pakistan to ensure that benefits of economic development are not exploited by the privileged few and to safeguard the interests of small investors. It empowers the Central Government to appoint a Managing Director for specific establishments, vesting administrative control in them while ceasing previous powers held by boards or agents.

name: The Workers’ Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Workers' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Workers' Welfare Fund to provide residential accommodation and other facilities for workers. It defines the fund's composition, including initial government contributions and payments from industrial establishments based on their total income.

name: The Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the detention and seizure of enemy ships, aircraft, and goods in transit by any means within Pakistan. It declares that no such vessels or goods shall be allowed to depart from Pakistan and establishes procedures for adjudication by Prize Courts.

name: The War Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: War Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the insurance of certain goods and property in Pakistan against war risks. It establishes compulsory insurance schemes for factories, buildings, ships, and goods, including those in transit.

name: The Compulsory Service in the Armed Forces Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Compulsory Service in the Armed Forces Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the compulsory service of essential persons and ex-servicemen in the Armed Forces of Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'Armed Forces', 'essential person', and 'ex-serviceman', and outlines the procedures for issuing call-up notices by the Manpower Board or Service Headquarters.

name: The Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides special measures to ensure the security, public safety, and interest of Pakistan during an emergency. It establishes the framework for making rules, enhancing penalties, constituting special tribunals, and acquiring property necessary for national defense.

name: The Quaid-i-Azam's Mazar (Protection and Maintenance) Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Quaid-i-Azam's Mazar (Protection and Maintenance) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection and maintenance of the Quaid-i-Azam's Mazar in Karachi. It declares the site a national historical monument, vests it in the Central Government, and establishes rules prohibiting political activities, weapons, and acts derogatory to its sanctity.

name: The Compulsory Service (Armed Forces) Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Compulsory Service (Armed Forces) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the compulsory service of essential persons in the Armed Forces of Pakistan. It defines eligible individuals, outlines the procedure for call-up notices and exemptions, and establishes the legal framework for their commissioning and service terms.

name: The Civil Commotion Compensation Fund Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Civil Commotion Compensation Fund Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Civil Commotion Compensation Fund to provide financial relief for losses suffered during civil commotion. It mandates insurance companies to collect a surcharge on specific policies and contribute net premium receipts to the fund, which is administered by the Central Government.

name: The Finance (Supplementary Provisions) Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Finance (Supplementary Provisions) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This ordinance makes supplementary provisions regarding the financial proposals of the Central Government. It amends specific sections of the Income-tax Act, 1922 and the Finance Ordinance, 1970 to adjust tax rates and procedures.

name: The Railway Surcharge (Pakistan Western Railway) Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Railway Surcharge (Pakistan Western Railway) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance levies a specific tax known as the railway surcharge on fares and freights for the Pakistan Western Railway. The proceeds collected from this surcharge are to be distributed among the provinces of Baluchistan, North-West Frontier, Punjab, and Sind.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Finance Ordinance, 1971
metadata.amends: The Tariff Act, 1934; The Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government and amends specific existing laws. It includes amendments to the Tariff Act, 1934, the Excises and Salt Act, 1944, and the Income-tax Act, 1922.

name: The Pakistan Railways (Budgetary Arrangements and Investments) Order, 1971

metadata.title: The Pakistan Western Railway (Budgetary Arrangements and Investments) Order, 1971
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the budgetary arrangements and investment framework for the Pakistan Western Railway following the dissolution of West Pakistan. It outlines procedures for preparing annual budget statements, authenticating expenditure schedules, and managing funds between the President, new provinces, and the Central Government.

name: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Financing) Order, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Financing) Order, 1971
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the financing of the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority following the dissolution of the province. It establishes rules for grants-in-aid, loan repayments, and the distribution of funds between the Central Government and new provinces effective July 1, 1970.

name: The West Pakistan Statutory Corporations (Financing) Order, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Statutory Corporations (Financing) Order, 1971
metadata.amends: The Province of West Pakistan (Dissolution) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the financing of statutory corporations in West Pakistan following its dissolution. It establishes rules for allocating moneys, liabilities, and net losses among new provinces, as well as procedures for grants-in-aid and loan repayments to the Central Government.

name: The Withdrawal of Currency Notes (High Denominations) Regulation, 1971

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 81
metadata.summary: This regulation withdraws high denomination Pakistan currency notes (500 and 100 rupees) from circulation due to illegal removal from treasuries. It mandates the surrender of these specific notes by holders to government officials or banks by specified dates in June 1971.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 23

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 23
metadata.summary: This document is an amendment to Martial Law Order No. 22 issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator of Pakistan. It adds a new paragraph deeming the order effective from March 25, 1971.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 22

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 22
metadata.summary: This order empowers the Central or Provincial Government to require government servants to serve anywhere in or outside Pakistan, overriding existing laws regarding their terms of service. It also authorizes the Central Government to make rules regulating the conditions of service for personnel directed under this order.

name: The Local Government Institutions (Dissolution) Order, 1971

metadata.title: Local Government Institutions (Dissolution) Order
metadata.summary: This Order empowers Provincial Governments to dissolve local councils or Municipal Committees if deemed necessary in the public interest. It outlines procedures for appointing replacements, handling financial accounts for the 1970-71 fiscal year, and confirms that such actions cannot be challenged in any court.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 20

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 20
metadata.summary: This order re-constitutes Martial Law Order No. 16, deeming it effective from May 12, 1969. It grants Special Military Courts the authority to order that part of a fine imposed be applied as compensation for loss or injury caused by an offence when substantial civil recovery is possible.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 79

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 79
metadata.summary: This regulation amends Martial Law Regulation No. 74 by substituting the names of various Major Generals and Lieutenant Generals in different zones. It also omits paragraph (b) of the original regulation.

name: The Newsprint Control Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Newsprint Control Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of the keeping, storage, distribution, disposal, acquisition, and use of newsprint in Pakistan. It establishes definitions for newspapers and newsprint, sets maximum prices for newsprint, and restricts sales to approved dealers or persons with specific requirements.

name: The Price Equalization Surcharge (Validation) Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Price Equalization Surcharge (Validation) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the price equalization surcharge levied on copper rods imported during a specific shipping period in 1968-1969. It deems the surcharge to have been validly collected as if certain notifications had never been issued, thereby restoring the legal status of the goods under the Import of Goods (Price Equalization Surcharge) Act, 1967.

name: The Asian Development Bank Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Asian Development Bank (Implementation and Operation) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance implements the international agreement for the establishment and operation of the Asian Development Bank. It outlines Pakistan's obligations as a member of the Bank and matters connected therewith.

name: CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ORDER No. 19a

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 19
metadata.summary: This order authorizes a Martial Law Administrator to appoint persons to exercise police and magistrate powers, including arrest and investigation. It grants immunity from legal challenge for actions taken under this order by any court.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 77

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 77
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Regulation No. 51
metadata.summary: This regulation prohibits the printing or publication of matter that prejudices Pakistan's integrity, criticizes martial law, creates public alarm, or incites hatred against political parties and communities. It also repeals specific previous regulations and mandates scrutiny by provincial authorities for matters likely to cause agitation on political issues.

name: CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ORDER No. 18

metadata.title: Order No. 18
metadata.summary: This Order declares the Awami League to be an unlawful political party in Pakistan and prohibits any person from being a member or calling themselves a member of the party. It further bans operating the party's accounts, spending funds, or making transactions related to the frozen assets of the Awami League.

name: The Dissolution of West Pakistan Province (Rights, Properties, Assets and Liabilities) Order, 1971

metadata.title: The Dissolution of West Pakistan Province (Rights, Properties, Assets and Liabilities) Order, 1971
metadata.summary: This Order outlines the apportionment and adjustment of rights, properties, assets, and liabilities of the Government of West Pakistan following its dissolution. It establishes a Committee to regulate procedures and make recommendations for distributing these assets among the new provinces and the Central Government.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 75

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 75
metadata.summary: This document is a Martial Law Regulation issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator of Pakistan. It amends paragraph (1), sub-paragraph (4) of Martial Law Regulation No. 1 to substitute Lt. General Tikka Khan as the commander for Zone B.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 74

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 73
metadata.summary: This regulation appoints Lieutenant Generals as Deputy Administrators of Martial Law for specific zones in Pakistan. It grants them the authority to exercise powers previously assigned to the Governor of East Pakistan under existing laws.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 73

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation
metadata.summary: This document appoints specific military officers as Chief Martial Law Administrators and Deputy Administrators for different zones of Pakistan. It was issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator, General A.M. Yahya Khan, on March 1st, 1971.

name: The Commander-in-Chief (Delegation of Powers) Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Ordinance on Delegation of Powers of the Commander-in-Chief of the Pakistan Army
metadata.repeals: The Deputy Commander-in-Chief (Powers) Ordinance, 1942
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the delegation of powers from the Commander-in-Chief of the Pakistan Army to the Chief of Staff. It authorizes the Chief of Staff to exercise these powers when the Commander-in-Chief is absent or holds the office of President, and validates any prior actions taken by the Chief of Staff since March 25, 1969.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 72

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 72
metadata.summary: This document amends Martial Law Regulation No. 58 by modifying paragraph 7. Specifically, it inserts a clause regarding the Chief Martial Law Administrator's direction and omits a time limit related to suspension or dismissal from service.

name: CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ORDER No. 17

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 17
metadata.summary: This order directs persons who received funds or drew money from bank accounts on behalf of the Pakistan Muslim League to deposit unaccounted sums within fifteen days. It also authorizes officials to require statements of accounts for any such funds received or drawn after March 26, 1969.

name: The Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971

metadata.title: The Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the import, manufacture, formulation, sale, distribution, and use of pesticides in Pakistan. It establishes a registration system requiring persons to apply to the Central Government before importing or selling any brand of pesticide.

name: CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ORDER No. 20

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 20
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order requires a specific person to render themselves for trial by Summary Military Court No. 5 Sector 1 Zone C Rawalpindi under sections 420, 328, 392, 342, and 386 of the PPC. The individual is ordered to appear or face being charged under MLR-40 and tried in absentia for contravention of the said regulation.

name: CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ORDER No. 19

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 19
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order directs Mohammad Aslam Khan to surrender himself to a Special Military Court by January 31, 1971. The order warns that failure to comply will result in the individual being charged under MLR-40 and tried in absentia.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 78

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 78
metadata.summary: This regulation empowers the Chief Martial Law Administrator and authorized officials to issue orders restricting the movements of suspected persons. It allows for directives requiring individuals to leave Pakistan, prohibiting their return, detaining them, or regulating their conduct regarding communication and news dissemination.

name: CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ORDER No. 16

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 16
metadata.summary: This order directs specific individuals to surrender themselves to Special Military Court No. 2 or Martial Law Headquarters by January 21, 1971. Failure to comply will result in being charged under MLR-40 and tried in absentia for contravention of the regulation.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 71

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 71
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes price controls for motor cars in Pakistan, prohibiting sales above prices fixed by the Controller General of Prices and Supplies. It mandates specific reporting requirements for dealers, importers, and producers regarding inventory, costs, and production details to the Controller General.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 9

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 9
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order requires Abdul Hameed alias Khameed to surrender to Special Military Court No. 2 at Rawalpindi by 1000 hours on November 12, 1970. The order is issued under the authority of MLR-4G for his trial regarding a case under Section 302/34 PPC read with MLR-2.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 8

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 8
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order directs Raja Khalid Zaman to surrender himself to Special Military Court No. 2 at Rawalpindi by 1000 hours on November 14, 1970. The order is issued under the powers of MLR-40 for his trial regarding a case under CMLR-16(a). Failure to comply will result in being charged and tried in absentia.

name: The Pakistan National Service Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: The Pakistan National Service Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance introduces compulsory national service for male citizens of Pakistan aged between eighteen and twenty who possess specific educational qualifications. It defines key terms such as 'national service', 'essential service', and 'employer', while also outlining exemptions for members of the Defence Services, police forces, and students in essential fields like medicine or engineering.

name: The Sugar Export Subsidy Fund Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: The Sugar Export Subsidy Fund Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Sugar Export Subsidy Fund to promote the export of sugar from Pakistan. It levies specific sales tax and excise duties on sugar-cane and produced sugar, with proceeds credited to the fund after collection costs are deducted. The Central Government is authorized to apply these funds for subsidizing exports and may require registration of export contracts.

name: The Centrally Administered Tribal Areas Development Corporation Regulation, 1970

metadata.title: The Centrally Administered Tribal Areas Development Corporation Regulation, 1970
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes the Centrally Administered Tribal Areas Development Corporation to promote economic development in the specified regions. It defines the Corporation's constitution, powers, and the functions of its Board of Directors regarding budget approval and project execution.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION NO. 70

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 70
metadata.summary: This regulation empowers the Custodian of Enemy Property to seize and manage assets belonging to enemies, enemy firms, or enemy subjects. It outlines procedures for taking possession of property, selling it via auction, and attaching assets to cover debts due to the custodian.

name: REGULATION No. 69

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 69
metadata.summary: This regulation amends Martial Law Regulation No. 42 by adding an explanation to define the scope of 'Criminal Court'. The amendment clarifies that this term includes various tribunals and special judges constituted under specific ordinances and acts from 1958, 1963, 1965, and 1968. It also validates any powers exercised prior to the regulation's commencement in relation to these specified courts.

name: CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR, ORDER No. 16

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 16
metadata.summary: This order empowers Special Military Courts to order the recovery of fines imposed under Martial Law or other laws for the purpose of paying compensation. The compensation is intended for any person who suffered loss or injury due to the offence, provided substantial compensation is recoverable in a Civil Court.

name: The Associated Cement (Vesting) Order, 1970

metadata.title: The Associated Cement (Esting) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the legal framework for the Associated Cement undertaking following the dissolution of West Pakistan. It deems the Government of West Pakistan's actions as those of the President for the new provinces and sets up an Advisory Board to manage the cement affairs.

name: REGULATION No. 68

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation
metadata.summary: This regulation defines terms related to government land allotted for military or civil gallantry awardees and establishes procedures for recovering possession from unauthorized occupants. It empowers authorized officers to evict lessees or licensees upon lease expiration or termination, subject to specific notice periods and judicial review mechanisms involving Martial Law Tribunals.

name: REGULATION No. 67

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 67
metadata.summary: This regulation amends Martial Law Regulation No. 60 by modifying the conditions under which a person convicted of an offence is eligible for release. Specifically, it substitutes new text in paragraph 10 regarding sentences involving transportation or imprisonment of at least two years.

name: The National Assembly (Elections) Federally Administered Tribal Areas Regulation, 1970

metadata.title: The National Assembly (Elections) (Centrally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1970
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the conduct of elections to the National Assembly from the Centrally Administered Tribal Areas. It was made by the President under powers granted by clause (2) of Article 6 of the Legal Framework Order, 1970.

name: CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR, ORDER No. 15

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 15
metadata.summary: This order establishes a committee to investigate the affairs and funds of the Convention Muslim League. The committee is tasked with determining if funds were misused, spent improperly, or lost due to negligence by office bearers. It grants the committee powers similar to those under the Code of Civil Procedure for summoning witnesses, seizing documents, and receiving evidence.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 2

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 2
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order requires two specific individuals to surrender themselves to the Headquarters of ML Sector I, Zone C, Rawalpindi by 1000 hours on August 24, 1970. The order mandates that if they fail to comply with this deadline, they will be charged under MLR-40 and tried in absentia for contravention of the regulation.

name: The Supreme Judicial Council Composition Order, 1970

metadata.title: The Supreme Judicial Council (Composition) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order defines the composition of the Supreme Judicial Council, including the Chief Justice and senior judges. It also establishes procedures for replacing council members who are absent or unable to act.

name: The Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Centrally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 1970

metadata.title: The Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Centrally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 1970
metadata.repeals: The Electoral College of Pakistan (Representation of Tribal Areas) Order, 1964; The Representation of the People (Tribal Areas) Order, 1965
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the preparation of electoral rolls for the Centrally Administered Tribal Areas to facilitate the election of members to the National Assembly. It mandates Political Agents and Deputy Commissioners to create these rolls, defining eligibility based on age and guardianship, and establishes procedures for public inspection and amendments.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 1

metadata.title: PUBLIC NOTICE No. 64 (70)/Imp.-R.
metadata.summary: This public notice extends the deadline for processing OSB Notices under AID Loan No. 391-H-148 to August 15, 1970, for eligible importers who missed the June 15 cutoff. It explicitly states that no revisions will be allowed for notices already processed and that no further extensions or requests regarding this matter will be entertained.

name: REGULATION No. 66

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 66
metadata.summary: This document amends Martial Law Regulation No. 1 by adding a new paragraph regarding the appointment of an acting Administrator when the Chief Martial Law Administrator or Zone Administrator is absent or unable to perform duties. It subsequently appoints Major General Khadim Hussain Raja as the acting Martial Law Administrator for Zone 'B' effective July 15, 1970, due to the absence of Lt. General Sahibzada Mohammad Yaqub Khan.

name: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: Ordinance No. XIII of 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conduct of elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies, along with related matters. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'Assembly', 'Commission', and 'constituency' within the context of the Legal Framework Order, 1970.

name: REGULATION No. 65

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 65
metadata.summary: This regulation allows persons under martial law to sell, transfer, or dispose of their properties and assets without obtaining specific permissions previously required under Martial Law Regulations No. 43 and 58. It explicitly excludes individuals dismissed under Regulation No. 58 from this permission and defines the scope of 'person' to include those subject to related regulations and the Improper Acquisition of Property Ordinance, 1969.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 22

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 22
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order directs three specific individuals to surrender themselves to the Sub-Martial Law Administrator in Sector-2, Rawalpindi by July 25, 1970. The order mandates that if these persons fail to comply with the surrender deadline, they will be charged under Martial Law Regulation No. 40 and tried in absentia for contravention of said regulation.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 22

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 22
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order directs three specific individuals to surrender themselves to the Sub-Martial Law Administrator in Sector-2, Rawalpindi by July 25, 1970. The order mandates that if these persons fail to comply with the surrender deadline, they will be charged under Martial Law Regulation No. 40 and tried in absentia for contravention of said regulation.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: The Finance Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The Tariff Act, 1934; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government and amends specific existing laws. It primarily targets the Tariff Act, 1934, and the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944 to update definitions, levy duties on services, and introduce regulatory duties.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (Oath of Chief Justice of Sind and Baluchistan High Court) Order, 1970

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (Oath of Chief Justice of Sind and Baluchistan High Court) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order specifies that the oath of office for the Chief Justice of the Sind and Baluchistan High Court shall be administered by the Governor of the Province of Sind. It was issued by the President on June 19, 1970, to resolve difficulties regarding this specific judicial appointment.

name: The West Pakistan Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Private Colleges Management and Control Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control and management of private colleges in West Pakistan. It establishes a Governing Body for each college consisting of members nominated by various authorities, elected teachers, and representatives of students and benefactors.

name: REGULATION No. 64

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 64 (Constitution of New Zones)
metadata.summary: This regulation reconstitutes Martial Law Regulation No. 1 to divide Pakistan into new administrative zones (B through F) under the Chief Martial Law Administrator. It establishes Deputy Chief Martial Law Administrators, appoints military officers as Zone Administrators, and clarifies the continuation of existing military courts and orders from Zone A within the new zone structure.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 21

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 91
metadata.summary: This order directs specific individuals to surrender themselves to the authorities. Failure to comply by the prescribed date and time will result in being charged under MLR-40 and tried in absentia.

name: The High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1970

metadata.title: The High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the leave, pension, and privileges applicable to judges of High Courts in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'actual service' and 'service for pension', establishes rules for calculating leave accounts, and sets limits on the total amount of leave a judge can avail during their tenure.

name: The West Pakistan (Dissolution) (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Dissolution) (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order was made by the President on June 15, 1970, to address difficulties arising from the dissolution of West Pakistan. It provides for entering into agreements on behalf of a new province before it officially comes into being and mandates the oath of office for appointed Governors.

name: The High Courts (Establishment) Order, 1970

metadata.title: The High Courts (Establishment) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order establishes new High Courts for the provinces of Sind and Baluchistan following the dissolution of West Pakistan. It defines the jurisdiction, powers, and seal requirements for these new courts while appointing initial judges and ensuring continuity of service benefits.

name: The Election to Assemblies (Qualifications) (Supplementary Provisions) Order, 1970

metadata.title: The Elections to Assemblies (Qualifications) (Supplementary Provisions) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order makes supplementary provisions regarding the qualifications for being and being elected as a member of the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies. It specifically addresses eligibility requirements notwithstanding certain clauses in the Legal Framework Order, 1970.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 19

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 19
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Order No. 18
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order requires two specific individuals to surrender themselves by a designated deadline. Failure to comply will result in the individuals being tried in absentia under the relevant martial law regulations.

name: The Delimitation of Constituencies Order, 1970

metadata.title: The Delimitation of Constituencies Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the delimitation of constituencies for elections to the National and Provincial Assemblies under the Legal Framework Order, 1970. It establishes a Delimitation Commission consisting of the Chief Election Commissioner and two High Court Judges to divide provinces into territorial constituencies based on population data from the 1961 Census.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 18

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 18
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order directs two specific individuals to surrender themselves to the Headquarters of the Sub Martial Law Administrator in Rawalpindi by a specified deadline. Failure to comply will result in being charged under relevant regulations and tried in absentia for contravention.

name: The Legal Framework Order, 1970

metadata.title: The Legal Framework Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the framework for constituting a National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies in Pakistan following general elections. It defines the composition of these assemblies, including specific seats reserved for women, and outlines the principles for electing members based on adult franchise.

name: The Province of West Pakistan (Dissolution) Order, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Dissolution) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order dissolves the Province of West Pakistan and establishes four new Provinces: Baluchistan, North-West Frontier Province, Punjab, and Sind. It also constitutes the Islamabad Capital Territory and Centrally Administered Tribal Areas as separate entities under the President's administration.

name: The Central Law Officers Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: The Central Law Officers Ordinance, 1970
metadata.repeals: The Central Law Officers Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of Central Law Officers, including Additional Attorney-General, Deputy Attorney-General, and Standing Counsel. It grants these officers the right of audience in all courts in Pakistan and sets out their qualifications and terms of service.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 16

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 15
metadata.summary: This document orders specific individuals accused under Martial Law Regulations to surrender themselves before a Special Military Court or police station by March 31, 1970. Failure to comply will result in charges under MLR-40 and a trial in absentia for contravention of the regulations.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 15

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 15
metadata.summary: This document orders specific individuals accused under Martial Law Regulations to surrender themselves before a Special Military Court or police station by March 31, 1970. Failure to comply will result in charges under MLR-40 and a trial in absentia for contravention of the regulations.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 7

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 7
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order directs two specific individuals to surrender themselves to Summary Military Court No. 7 in Rawalpindi by November 10, 1970. The order warns that failure to comply will result in the individuals being charged under MLR-4 and tried in absentia for contravening martial law regulations.

name: The Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices (Control and Prevention) Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: The Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for regulating monopolies and restrictive trade practices in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'agreement', 'individual', and 'undertaking' to facilitate enforcement of market competition rules.

name: REGULATION No. 63

metadata.title: The Kohistan (Liquidation) Regulation, 1970
metadata.summary: This Regulation dissolves the Board of Directors of Kohistan Limited and vests all its properties, funds, and liabilities in an appointed Administrator. The Administrator is placed under the control of the Government of West Pakistan to manage the company's affairs, collect dues, and eventually dissolve the company upon completion of proceedings.

name: REGULATION No. 62

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 62
metadata.summary: This regulation amends Martial Law Regulation No. 37 to expand the definition of 'security' within its provisions. The amendment specifically includes various financial instruments like stocks, debentures, and government securities as defined by the Securities Act, 1920.

name: The Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: The Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Equity Participation Fund as a body corporate with its head office in Dacca. It defines key terms such as 'Bank', 'Board', and various types of equity securities, while outlining the fund's share capital contributions from the Government of Pakistan, East Pakistan, West Pakistan, the State Bank of Pakistan, and institutional investors.

name: NA- The National Assembly (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1970

metadata.title: Members of the National Assembly (Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 1971
metadata.amends: Members of the National Assembly (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Members of the National Assembly (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1970. It substitutes specific articles in the said Order and omits certain paragraphs from its Schedule regarding allowances.

name: The Legal Frame Work Order, 1970

metadata.title: The Legal Framework Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the constitution of a National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies to make provisions regarding the Constitution of Pakistan. It establishes the composition, election principles, and qualifications for members, including specific seats reserved for women.

name: No. BCD 2/69 — Amendments to Forms of Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account under the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: Notification No. BCD 2/69
metadata.summary: This notification directs amendments to Form 'A' (Balance Sheet) and Form 'B' (Profit and Loss Account) found in the Second Schedule of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962. The State Bank of Pakistan issued these changes after a three-month notice period following Notification No. BCD 1/69.

name: The Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the formation of trade unions, the regulation of relations between employers and workmen, and the avoidance and settlement of industrial disputes. It applies to the whole of Pakistan but excludes persons employed in police, defence services, and specific government administrations.

name: The Defence Services (Inquiry) (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: Defence Services (Inquiry) (Special Provisions) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a uniform procedure for inquiring into the conduct of Defence Service members serving outside their primary organization or unit. It provides for the convening, composition, and functioning of boards of inquiry to handle such investigations.

name: The Securities and Exchange Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: Securities and Exchange Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection of investors and the regulation of markets and dealings in securities. It establishes requirements for the registration and operation of Stock Exchanges within Pakistan.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.amends: Post Office Act, 1898; Tariff Act, 1934; Customs Act, 1969; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government and amends several existing laws. It specifically updates the Post Office Act, Tariff Act, Customs Act, and Central Excises and Salt Act with new schedules, sections, and provisions regarding duties and retail prices.

name: The British Statutes (Application to Pakistan) Repeal Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: The British Statutes (Application to Pakistan) Repeal Ordinance, 1969
metadata.repeals: British Statutes (various Acts of the Parliament of the United Kingdom)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals certain Acts of the Parliament of the United Kingdom that operate as part of the law of Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President under the Provisional Constitution Order to remove these specific British statutes from Pakistani legal application.

name: The Improper Acquisition of Property (Special Committee) Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: The Improper Acquisition of Property (Special Committee) Ordinance, 1969
