metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Special Committee to inquire into the improper acquisition of property by specific government officials and employees of corporations. It empowers the Central Government to set up this committee, which includes a judicial member and a senior Defence Services officer, to investigate unlawful acquisitions involving bribery or corruption.

name: The Customs Act, 1969

metadata.title: The Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the levy and collection of customs duties in Pakistan. It provides for allied matters concerning customs operations, including definitions, officer appointments, and powers.

name: The War Risks Insurance Continuance Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: War Risks Insurance Continuance Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of the War Risks Insurance Fund established under the War Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1965. It ensures that all liabilities incurred before its commencement and related provisions continue in force despite the cessation of the original Ordinance.

name: The Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of certain emergency powers regarding land that was requisitioned under the Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1965, after that Ordinance ceases to have effect. It defines terms such as 'appropriate Government' and 'requisitioned land', outlines procedures for releasing land from requisition, and grants the government power to acquire requisitioned land in specific circumstances.

name: The Enemy Property (Continuance of Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: The Enemy Property (Continuance of Emergency Provisions) Ordinance, 1969
metadata.repeals: Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of specific provisions from the Defence of Pakistan Rules regarding trading with enemies and controlling enemy firms. It ensures these rules remain in force after the Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1965 ceases to have effect, while also protecting actions taken under these continued provisions from legal challenge.

name: The Central Employees Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Act, 1969

metadata.title: Central Employees Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a benevolent fund for the common benefit of employees of the Central Government and certain autonomous bodies. It also provides for group insurance schemes for these employees and their families.

name: The Second Capital of the Republic ( Determination of Area) Act, 1969

metadata.title: The Second Capital of the Republic at Dacca (Determination of Area) Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act determines the specific area of the Second Capital of the Republic located at Dacca in East Pakistan. It defines the boundaries of this area, which measures approximately 623 acres within the district of Dacca, based on landmarks such as the Dacca Airport and various roads.

name: The Antiquities Act, 1968

metadata.title: The Antiquities Act, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the preservation and protection of antiquities in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'antiquity', 'dealer', and 'immovable antiquity' while establishing an Advisory Committee to assist the Central Government.

name: The Companies Profits (Workers Participation) Act, 1968

metadata.title: The Companies Profits (Workers Participation) Act, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a framework for worker participation in the profits of companies within Pakistan. It mandates the creation of Workers Participation Funds and defines the composition and management responsibilities of the Boards overseeing these funds.

name: The Finance Act, 1968

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1968
metadata.amends: The Post Office Act, 1898; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1965; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government and amends several existing laws. It specifically updates the Post Office Act, Tariff Act, Finance (Supplementary) Act, and Central Excises and Salt Act with new schedules, sections, and provisions regarding duties and penalties.

name: The Privy Purses (Charged Expenditure) Act, 1968

metadata.title: The Privy Purses (Charged Expenditure) Act, 1968
metadata.summary: This Act declares that the expenditure relating to privy purses payable to Rulers of certain former States is a charge on the Central Consolidated Fund. It mandates that such sums be paid out of this fund and are deemed to have always been so charged.

name: The Carriage by Air (Supplementary Convention) Act, 1968

metadata.title: Carriage by Air (Supplementary Convention) Act, 1968
metadata.amends: Carriage by Air Act, 1934; Carriage by Air (International Convention) Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Convention Supplementary to the Warsaw Convention regarding international air carriage performed by a person other than the contracting carrier. It provides for matters connected with this implementation and establishes that the rules in the Schedule have the force of law in relation to applicable air carriage.

name: The Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968

metadata.title: The Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Tobacco Board to promote the cultivation, manufacture, and export of tobacco products. It defines the board's composition, member terms, and functions including regulating exports and assisting in research.

name: NA- The Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1968

metadata.title: The Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 1976
metadata.amends: The Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1968
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1968 to update terminology from 'allowances' to 'salary' and adjust leave calculation limits. It introduces provisions for special disability leave and modifies rules regarding leave salary rates and foreign exchange entitlements.

name: NA- The West Pakistan Industrial and Commercial Employement (Standing Orders) Ordinance , 1968

metadata.title: Labour Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.amends: certain laws relating to industrial relations and welfare of workers
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends various laws concerning industrial relations and the welfare of workers in Pakistan. It comes into force immediately, with specific provisions regarding amendments to the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969, taking effect on dates specified by the Federal Government.

name: The Listed Posts (Substantive Appointments) Act, 1967

metadata.title: The Listed Posts (Substantive Appointments) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act vests the power to make substantive appointments to certain provincial posts in the President of Pakistan. It applies specifically to persons who are not members of the Civil Service of Pakistan but hold posts borne on that service's cadre.

name: The Islamabad (Preservation of Landscape) Rules, 1967

metadata.title: The Islamabad (Preservation of Landscape) Rules, 1967
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under section 15 of the Islamabad (Preservation of Landscape) Ordinance, 1966. They establish procedures for applying permission to perform acts that affect the landscape, such as digging, grazing, or cutting trees within the Islamabad Capital Territory.

name: The University of Islamabad Act, 1967

metadata.title: The University of Islamabad Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the powers and functions of the University, including providing instruction, conducting research, conferring degrees, and managing institutes.

name: The Pharmacy Act, 1967

metadata.title: The Pharmacy Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Pharmacy Councils to regulate the practice of pharmacy in Pakistan. It provides for the creation of a Central Pharmacy Council and Provincial Pharmacy Councils with defined compositions and powers.

name: The Excise duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967

metadata.title: The Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act imposes an excise duty on specific minerals dispatched from mines to finance measures for the welfare of labour in the mining industry. The proceeds are collected and credited to a dedicated fund split into housing and general welfare accounts, which can be used for grants-in-aid to mine owners for dispensary services and other health initiatives.

name: The Weights and Measures (Metric System) Act, 1967

metadata.title: The Weights and Measures (Metric System) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act establishes standards of weights and measures based on the metric system for Pakistan. It defines various units such as the kilogram, metre, and ampere, and sets primary units for mass, length, area, electric current, and luminous intensity.

name: The Copyright Rules, 1967

metadata.title: The Copyright-Rules, 1967
metadata.summary: These rules amend the Karachi Port Trust General Bye-laws regarding the registration of copyright. They establish specific procedures for applications, including the requirement to submit forms in triplicate and provide copies of works.

name: The Import of Goods (Price Equalization Surcharge) Act, 1967

metadata.title: The Import of Goods (Price Equalization Surcharge) Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act levies an additional duty known as the price equalization surcharge on certain imported goods to balance price differences based on landed costs. It defines terms such as 'landed cost' and 'shipping period,' outlines procedures for collecting the surcharge, and validates previous charges collected under a specific Ministry of Commerce notification.

name: The Natural Gas (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1967

metadata.title: The Natural Gas (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1967
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of a development surcharge on natural gas sold by specified companies. It defines key terms such as 'development surcharge', 'differential margin', and 'natural gas', and establishes rules regarding payment timelines, interest on late payments, and maximum sale prices.

name: The Dormant Funds (Administration) Act, 1966

metadata.title: Dormant Funds (Administration) Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the administration of certain dormant funds raised by public subscriptions and donations. It vests these funds, along with accrued interest, in the President for utilization in relief purposes or causes related to their original intent.

name: The Medical Diplomas (Repeal) Act, 1966

metadata.title: The Medical Diplomas (Repeal) Act, 1966
metadata.repeals: The Medical Diplomas Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Medical Diplomas Act of 1939. It was enacted by the National Assembly of Pakistan and received presidential assent on December 17, 1966.

name: The Cantonments Pure Food Act, 1966

metadata.title: The Food Adulteration Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act defines key terms related to food products such as milk, ghee, and margarine to establish standards for purity and quality. It prohibits the mixing, coloring, or powdering of food with injurious ingredients and bans the sale of adulterated or misbranded articles.

name: The Cost and Industrial Accountants Act, 1966

metadata.title: The Cost and Industrial Accountants Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the profession of cost and industrial accountants in Pakistan. It establishes the Pakistan Institute of Industrial Accountants as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines the criteria for membership registration.

name: The Members of the National Assembly (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1966

metadata.title: Members of the National Assembly (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries and allowances of the Members of the National Assembly of Pakistan. It establishes specific rates for monthly salary, daily allowance, conveyance allowance, and travelling allowances based on mode of transport.

name: The Ex-Government Servants (Employment with Foreign Governments) (Prohibition) Act, 1966

metadata.title: The Ex-Government Servants (Employment with Foreign Governments) Prohibition Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits ex-Government servants from seeking or taking up employment with a foreign Government or foreign agency without prior written permission. It defines key terms such as 'ex-Government servant', 'foreign agency', and 'foreign Government' to clarify the scope of the prohibition.

name: The Finance Act, 1966

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1966
metadata.amends: The Post Office Act, 1898; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Income Tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government by amending several existing laws. It specifically updates inland postage rates, modifies provisions in the Tariff and Central Excises Acts regarding production capacity duties, and alters sections within the Income Tax Act concerning agricultural income and refundable surcharges.

name: The Carriage by Air (International Convention) Act, 1966

metadata.title: The Carriage by Air (International Convention) Act, 1966
metadata.repeals: The Carriage by Air Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the Warsaw Convention concerning international carriage by air as amended at The Hague in 1953. It applies the convention's rules to international flights and provides mechanisms for applying these rules to non-international carriage with specific exceptions. Additionally, it repeals the Carriage by Air Act of 1934 to the extent that the new provisions apply.

name: The Deputy Speakers (Remuneration and Privileges) Act, 1966

metadata.title: Deputy Speakers (Remuneration and Privileges) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the remuneration and privileges of the Deputy Speakers of the National Assembly of Pakistan. It establishes specific salary rates, allowances for equipment and travel, as well as provisions regarding official residences and official cars.

name: The Investment Corporation of Pakistan Ordinance, 1966

metadata.title: Investment Corporation of Pakistan Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Investment Corporation of Pakistan to encourage investment and develop the capital market. It defines key terms, incorporates the Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession, and outlines its authorized share capital.

name: S.R.O. 8(R)/66 — Declaration of Bonds of the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany as Approved Securities

metadata.title: The Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This order declares German government bonds denominated in Deutsche Marks as approved securities. It is issued under the powers of section 5(a) of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962.

name: The Islamabad (Preservation of Landscape) Ordinance, 1966

metadata.title: Islamabad (Preservation of Landscape) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President to provide for the preservation of landscape in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes prohibitions on removing or damaging natural features, defines penalties for contravention, and grants specific powers to the Authority and police officers to enforce these provisions.

name: The Central Government Lands and Buildings (Recovery of Possession) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Ordinance on Eviction of Unauthorized Occupants from Central Government Lands and Buildings
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides the legal framework for the eviction of unauthorized occupants from land or buildings vested in, possessed by, or under the management and control of the Central Government. It defines key terms such as 'building', 'land', 'lessee', 'licensee', and 'unauthorized occupant' to clarify their scope under this legislation.

name: The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1965

metadata.title: The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the supplementary financial proposals of the Central Government for the year ending June 13, 1966. It levies a twenty-five per cent defence surcharge on customs duty, excise duty, and sales tax on specified goods to raise revenue for defence expenditure.

name: No. NG-10(75)/64 — Appointment of Mr. S. B. Awan as Chief Gas Controlling Officer

metadata.title: The Natural Gas (Control of Production and Distribution) Order, 1965
metadata.summary: This order appoints Mr. S. B. Awan as the Chief Gas Controlling Officer for the Natural Gas (Control of Production and Distribution) Order, 1965. The appointment is effective from November 6, 1965, replacing Mr. A. K. M. Musa.

name: S.R.O. 310(R)|65 — Declaration of Foreign Securities as Approved Securities

metadata.title: O. 310 (R)|65
metadata.summary: This order declares Dollar Securities of the Federal Government of the United States and bonds of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development as approved securities. This declaration is made under the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962, specifically for the purpose of section 13.

name: The Civil Services (Qualification for Appointment as High Court Judge) Act, 1965

metadata.title: The Civil Services (Qualification for Appointment as High Court Judge) Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes that the Civil Service of Pakistan shall be considered a civil service for specific purposes under Article 92(2)(b) of the Constitution. It was enacted to ensure uniformity in national interest regarding this classification.

name: The Limitation (Emergency and War Conditions) Act, 1965

metadata.title: The Limitation (Emergency and War Conditions) Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act extends the period of limitation for suits, appeals, applications, and other proceedings in cases involving war or armed hostilities. It specifically addresses situations where persons are displaced from affected areas or detained in enemy territory due to circumstances attributable to war.

name: The West Pakistan Weights and Measures Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Weights and Measures Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law regulating the use of weights and measures in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes standards, licensing requirements for manufacturers, verification procedures, and penalties for fraudulent practices or unauthorized use of instruments.

name: The West Pakistan Statutory Bodies (Appointment and Removal of Legal Advisors) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Statutory Bodies (Appointment and Removal of Legal Advisers) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958; The West Pakistan (University of Sind) Ordinance, 1961; The West Pakistan (University of the Punjab) Ordinance, 1961; The West Pakistan (University of Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961; The West Pakistan University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for government control and supervision over the appointment, engagement, and removal of legal advisers and legal practitioners by statutory bodies in West Pakistan. It mandates that no statutory body can appoint legal advisers or engage legal practitioners without prior government approval and establishes specific procedures for their removal.

name: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation to promote small and cottage industries within the province. It defines the corporation's constitution, including its Board of Directors, management structure, and financial powers such as granting loans and managing funds.

name: The West Pakistan Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: Sind XXII of 1948; West Punjab Qaumi Razakars Act, 1949; North-West Frontier Qaumi Razakars Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to Qaumi Razakars in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes their constitution, duties, powers, and disciplinary measures while granting them specific legal protections.

name: The Control of Employment Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Control of Employment Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the collection of information regarding employment in industrial undertakings and the availability of persons for such work. It also establishes mechanisms for the control and distribution of employment, as well as matters connected therewith.

name: S.R.O. 202(R)|65 — Stay of Actions and Proceedings Against Indian Banks Operating in Pakistan

metadata.title: S.R.O. 202(I)/65
metadata.summary: This order stays the commencement or continuance of all actions and proceedings against Indian banks operating in Pakistan for a period of two months. It was issued by the Central Government under the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962, upon an application made by the State Bank of Pakistan.

name: The Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control of persons exiting Pakistan during a state of emergency. It empowers the Central Government to issue orders requiring written permits for departure and allows police officers to prevent departures prejudicial to public safety or defense.

name: The Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: Detention of Enemy Ships, Aircraft and Goods Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: Detention of Enemy Shipping Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the detention and seizure of enemy ships, aircraft, and goods located on ships, aircraft, or railways within Pakistan. It applies prize law to these items and authorizes the release of certain non-prohibited goods to their owners while bringing detained vessels before a Prize Court for adjudication.

name: The Electricity Control Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Electricity Control Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides the President with powers to control the production, distribution, use, and consumption of electrical energy throughout Pakistan during an emergency. It empowers the Central Government to issue orders regulating these activities, collect necessary information, and grant licenses or certificates.

name: The West Pakistan Land Utilization (Repeal) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Utilization (Repeal) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Land Utilization Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal the West Pakistan Land Utilization Ordinance, 1959. It was issued under Article 79(1) of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

name: The War Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: War Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the insurance of certain goods and property in Pakistan against war risks. It was promulgated by the President under emergency powers granted by Article 30 of the Constitution to meet immediate legislative needs arising from a Proclamation of Emergency.

name: The Civil Pioneer Force Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Civil Pioneer Force Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes a Civil Pioneer Force for service in Pakistan to secure defence, public safety, and maintain public order during an emergency. It provides for the organisation, control, discipline, duties, and officer appointments of the force.

name: The Pakistan Army (Inter-arm Transfer) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: Pakistan Army (Inter-arm Transfer) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer of personnel enrolled under the Indian Army Act, 1911 or the Pakistan Army Act, 1952 from one Corps to another during a period of emergency. It empowers the competent military authority to vary service conditions upon such transfers and mandates re-transfer to the original Corps once the emergency ends, subject to vacancy availability.

name: The Compulsory Service (Armed Forces) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: Compulsory Service (Armed Forces) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the compulsory service of essential persons and ex-servicemen in the Armed Forces of Pakistan during a state of emergency. It defines the scope of application, excluding certain categories such as active duty members and sole surviving children of fallen soldiers, and outlines procedures for call-up notices, exemptions, and applicable service laws.

name: The Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Defence of Pakistan Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides special measures to ensure the security, public safety, and defence of Pakistan during an emergency. It empowers the Central Government to make rules for maintaining public order, prosecuting war, and managing essential supplies and services.

name: The [West Pakistan] Karachi Development Authority (Abatement of Arbitration Proceedings) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: Karachi Development Authority (Abatement of Arbitration Proceedings) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the annulment of arbitration references and the abatement of proceedings involving the Karachi Development Authority. It applies to agreements where disputes were referred to arbitration but failed to achieve their intended objects, effectively voiding pending awards and court orders related to such cases.

name: The Leader of the Opposition (Privileges) Act, 1965

metadata.title: The Leader of the Opposition (Privileges) Act, 1965
metadata.repeals: The Leader of the Opposition (Allowances) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act establishes certain privileges for the Leader of the Opposition in the National Assembly, including an honorarium and entitlement to prescribed benefits. It also clarifies that holding the office of Leader of the Opposition does not disqualify a member from being elected or serving in an Assembly.

name: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar)(Validating) Act, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar) (Validating) Act, 1965
subjects: board of intermediate and secondary education
metadata.summary: This Act validates the acts, powers, functions, and duties performed by the Chairman-designate of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar, between November 2, 1960, and August 17, 1961. It deems these actions to have been properly done under the West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961.

name: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad)(Validating) Act, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad) (Validating) Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act validates the acts, powers, functions, and duties performed by the Chairman-designate of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad, between November 1, 1960, and August 16, 1961. It deems these actions to have been done under the West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad) Ordinance, 1961.

name: The Decorations Act, 1965

metadata.title: The Decorations Act, 1965
metadata.repeals: The Decorations Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the Decorations Ordinance, 1962, with certain modifications to regulate the conferment of decorations by the President. It establishes restrictions on citizens accepting foreign decorations and outlines penalties for contravention.

name: The [West Pakistan] Punjab Finance Act, 1965

metadata.title: The West-Pakistan Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties in the Province of West Pakistan. It specifically establishes a surcharge on agricultural income-tax for specific districts and introduces a new Agricultural Income-tax for other districts.

name: The Finance Act, 1965

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1965
metadata.amends: The Post Office Act, 1898; The Court Fees Act, 1870; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning on July 1, 1965. It amends various laws regarding postage rates, court fees, customs duty, excise duty, sales tax, estate duty, wealth tax, gift-tax, income-tax, and super-tax.

name: The Pakistan Mujahid Force Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Pakistan Mujahid Force Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution and discipline of the Pakistan Mujahid Force. It establishes the force's structure, personnel classes, enrolment procedures, and command hierarchy.

name: The Reservists (Reinstatement in Civil Employment) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Reservist (Reinstatement in Civil Employment) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the reinstatement in civil employment of reservists who were called up for service or training in any of the Defence Services. It mandates that employers must reinstate these reservists upon their release from service, subject to specific conditions and timelines.

name: The [West Pakistan] Motor Vehicles (Validation of Fees) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (Validation of Fees) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates fees charged, collected, or realized by the Regional Transport Authority, Karachi between May 25, 1962, and March 12, 1965. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: The Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Pakistan Naval Academy to confer Bachelor of Science degrees on Cadet-entry Officers who successfully complete their prescribed training course. It also grants the Academy the authority to award these degrees to officers who completed similar courses prior to the Ordinance's commencement, provided they were commissioned.

name: The West Pakistan Seeds and Fruit Plants Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Seeds and Fruit Plants Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the better production and distribution of high-quality seeds and fruit plants in West Pakistan. It establishes a system for registering growers, certifying seeds and plants, and regulating their sale and distribution.

name: The Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission to promote the peaceful uses of atomic energy and discharge international obligations related thereto. It provides for the composition, functions, and term of office of the Commission's members, including a Chairman, Finance member, technical members, and scientists.

name: The West Pakistan Employees’ Social Security Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance introduces a social security scheme to provide benefits to certain employees or their dependents in cases of sickness, maternity, employment, injury, or death. It establishes the legal framework for these benefits and defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'employment injury' within the context of West Pakistan.

name: The Aircraft (Removal of Danger to Safety) Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Aircraft (Removal of Danger to Safety) Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the removal of dangers to aircraft safety caused by bird-attracting sites around airfields in Pakistan. It empowers the Central Government to issue orders requiring measures to avoid bird attraction and prohibits the construction or extension of facilities like tanneries and slaughterhouses within specified areas without permission.

name: The Repealing and Amending Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: Various laws listed in the First Schedule (e.g., The Federal Court Act, 1941; The Postponement of Obligations Act, 1950)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to expressly repeal certain laws that had become spent or unnecessary and to amend other specific laws. It includes provisions for savings regarding previous operations, rights acquired, penalties incurred, and legal proceedings under the repealed laws.

name: The National Investment (Unit) Trust Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The National Investment (Unit) Trust Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for certain matters relating to the National Investment (Unit) Trust and its associated operations. It establishes the transferability of units as movable property, authorizes the issuance of bearer certificates by the Central Government, and deems the trust's units as approved securities under existing laws.

name: The [West Pakistan] Punjab Regulation and Control of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Regulation and Control of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Regulation of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the use of loudspeakers and sound amplifiers in the Province of West Pakistan to prevent public nuisance and maintain public order. It prohibits their operation in specific locations such as places of worship during prayer times, hospitals, and educational institutions, while allowing exceptions for religious prayers like Azan and Khutba. The document outlines punishments for contravention, powers of seizure by police officers, and the repeal of a previous 1964 Ordinance.

name: The West Pakistan Regulation and Control of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Regulation and Control of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Regulation of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the use of loudspeakers and sound amplifiers in the Province of West Pakistan to prevent public nuisance and maintain public order. It prohibits their operation in public places, near places of worship during prayer times, or for voicing controversial sectarian utterances likely to cause disorder.

name: The Speaker's Remuneration and Privileges Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The Speaker's Remuneration and Privileges Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The Speaker and Deputy Speaker (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the remuneration and privileges of the Speaker of the National Assembly, granting them a salary equivalent to a member of the President's Council of Ministers plus a specific sumptuary allowance. It also validates salaries and allowances drawn by the Speaker from June 11, 1962, until this Ordinance came into force.

name: The Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1965

metadata.title: The Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the law relating to legal practitioners in Pakistan. It provides for the constitution of Bar Councils at the national and provincial levels, including the Pakistan Bar Council, East Pakistan Bar Council, and West Pakistan Bar Council.

name: The Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1965

metadata.title: The Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the qualifications and provides for the registration of practitioners of Unani, Ayurvedic, and Homoeopathic systems of medicine in Pakistan. It establishes two separate Boards to oversee these systems and defines their composition and functions.

name: The [West Pakistan] Karachi Road Transport Corporation (Repeal) Ordinance, 1964

metadata.title: The Karachi Road Transport Corporation (Repeal) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.repeals: The Karachi Road Transport Corporation Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Karachi Road Transport Corporation Ordinance, 1959. It provides for the dissolution of the Corporation and the transfer of its assets, liabilities, rights, and obligations to a new Company.

name: The West Pakistan Jamia Islamic (Bahawalpur) Ordinance, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Jamia Islamia (Bahawalpur) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and re-organizes the West Pakistan Jamia Islamia, Bahawalpur to place its affairs on a formal basis. It empowers the institution to accept affiliations from Madrasas and Dar-ul-Ulooms, confer degrees, and provide training for the Auqaf Department personnel.

name: The West Pakistan Regulation of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Regulation of Loudspeakers and Sound Amplifiers Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the use and operation of loudspeakers and sound amplifiers within the Province of West Pakistan. It requires permission from the Deputy Commissioner for use in public places and sets conditions regarding volume, timing, and location restrictions to prevent annoyance or disturbance.

name: The Land Control (Capital of the Federation) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1964

metadata.title: The Land Control (Capital of the Federation) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.repeals: The Land Control (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This ordinance was promulgated to repeal the Land Control (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1948. It was issued by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 79 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary.

name: The Referendum Act, 1964

metadata.title: The Referendum Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conduct of referendums under the Constitution and related matters. It defines key terms such as 'Commission', 'elector', and 'polling day', and outlines procedures for sending questions to the Election Commission, appointing officers, and managing polling stations.

name: The Presidential Election Act, 1964

metadata.title: The Presidential Election Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conduct of elections to the office of President and related matters. It defines key terms such as candidate, elector, and election agent, and outlines the procedures for notification, nomination, and appointment of returning officers.

name: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Act, 1964

metadata.title: National and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conduct of elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies in Pakistan. It establishes rules regarding constituency delimitation, definitions of election terms, and the appointment of officers such as Returning Officers and Presiding Officers.

name: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Family Courts in West Pakistan to expedite the disposal of disputes relating to marriage and family affairs. It defines key terms, outlines the qualifications for judges, and sets out procedures for filing plaints, serving notices, and conducting pre-trial hearings.

name: The Inter-Provincial Trade Ordinance, 1964

metadata.title: The Inter-Provincial Trade Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Central Government to regulate trade and commerce between the provinces of Pakistan. It grants authority to issue orders regarding the movement, transport, and allocation of commodities, including imported goods, through licenses or permits.

name: The Finance Act, 1964

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1964
metadata.amends: The Post Office Act, 1898; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning July 1, 1964. It amends several existing laws including the Post Office Act, Tariff Act, Central Excises and Salt Act, and Income-tax Act to fix tax rates, levy regulatory duties, and adjust exemptions.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific surcharges on land revenue and agricultural income-tax for designated districts, along with new taxes on cinemas, motor vehicles, railway fares, and tolls on vessels.

name: The West Pakistan Laws (Extension to Karachi), Ordinance, 1964

metadata.title: West Pakistan Laws (Extension to Karachi) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends certain existing West Pakistan enactments to the District of Karachi. It amends specific sections and schedules of various acts to include provisions applicable in Karachi while excluding Tribal Areas.

name: The West Pakistan Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1964
metadata.summary: This Order authorizes the Governor of West Pakistan to adapt existing laws to align with the Constitution by substituting references to the Crown or Central Government with 'Government' or 'Provincial Government'. It specifies that these adapted laws shall continue in force until repealed or amended by the competent authority.

name: The West Pakistan Ghulam Muhammd Barrage Betterment Tax Ordinance, 1964

metadata.title: West Pakistan Ghulam Muhammad Barrage Betterment Tax Ordinance, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy of a betterment tax on Kabuli land irrigated by the Ghulam Muhammad Barrage Canals. It establishes rules regarding tax payment installments, interest on delayed payments, and rebates for lump-sum payments within one year.

name: The Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan Privileges Act, 1964

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan Privileges Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act defines the privileges of the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan, its Members, and Committees. It establishes immunity for Members from civil or criminal proceedings related to matters brought before the Assembly and restricts their detention or appearance in courts during specific periods surrounding Assembly sessions.

name: The Electoral College Act, 1964

metadata.title: The Electoral College Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of the Electoral College of Pakistan as required by the Constitution. It establishes rules regarding the delimitation of electoral units, the appointment of election authorities, and the preparation of electoral rolls.

name: The Kalri Lake Development (Repeal) Act 1964

metadata.title: The Kalri Lake Development (Repeal) Act, 1964
metadata.repeals: The Kalri Lake Development Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Kalri Lake Development Ordinance, 1959. It transfers all business, properties, debts, and employees of the Board to the Corporation upon its coming into force.

name: The [West Pakistan] Canal and Drainage (Extension) Act, 1964

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (Extension) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act extends the application of the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to the Divisions of Quetta and Kalat. The extension applies specifically to areas excluding Tribal Areas within those divisions.

name: The Tribal Areas (Restoration of Jurisdiction) Act, 1964

metadata.title: The Tribal Areas (Restoration of Jurisdiction) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act restores the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and the High Court of West Pakistan in relation to the Tribal Areas of the Quetta Division. It also extends limitation periods for matters concerning this restored jurisdiction.

name: The Pakistan Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) Act, 1964

metadata.title: The Pakistan Memorial Cess (West Pakistan) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act levies a cess on tickets for admission to cinema houses and race-courses in West Pakistan. The collected funds are intended to raise money for the Pakistan Memorial.

name: The West Pakistan Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Redemption and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the redemption and restitution of certain mortgages of land in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes procedures for mortgagors to apply to the Collector for an order directing the redemption of their land, including requirements for depositing due amounts.

name: The West Pakistan Firewood and Charcoal (Restriction) Act, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Firewood and Charcoal (Restriction) Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits and regulates the burning of firewood and charcoal in factories, brick-kilns, lime-kilns, and other specified places within West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'factory' and 'firewood', outlines specific exceptions for domestic use and personal kiln operations, and establishes penalties including imprisonment and fines for violations.

name: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Walver Act, 1964

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Walver Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the practice of 'Walver' in the Division of Quetta, excluding the Tribal Areas. It defines Walver as money paid or agreed to be paid to a guardian or relative upon betrothal and establishes penalties for giving, agreeing to give, or accepting such payments.

name: The Legal Practice (Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1964

metadata.title: The Legal Practice (Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1964
metadata.repeals: The Retired Judges (Legal Practice) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for disqualifications regarding legal practice in specific cases involving former judges. It applies to persons who have held office as Judges of the Supreme Court or High Courts, prohibiting them from pleading or acting in certain courts and tribunals.

name: The Election of Chairmen and Vice-Chairmen of Local Councils and Vice-Chairmen of Municipal Committees (Validating) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: West Pakistan Ordinance No. XL of 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the elections of Chairmen and Vice-Chairmen of Local Councils and Vice-Chairmen of Municipal Committees held under specific orders and ordinances. It declares these elections valid despite any irregularities regarding ballot-paper forms or serial numbers, preventing them from being challenged in court.

name: The Representation of the people (Repeal) Act, 1963

metadata.title: Representation of the People (Repeal) Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: Representation of the People Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Representation of the People Act, 1957. It was received by the President on December 23, 1963, and is published for general information.

name: The National Shipping Corporation Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The National Shipping Corporation Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Shipping Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the Corporation's functions to provide safe and efficient shipping services on international and inter-provincial routes, along with ancillary activities like ship repair and manufacturing.

name: The West Pakistan Milk Boards Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Milk Boards Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the production and marketing of milk and milk products in West Pakistan. It establishes Milk Boards as corporate bodies with perpetual succession to manage these activities across the province, excluding Tribal Areas.

name: The West Pakistan Acquisition of Property (WAPDA Office)(Second) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Acquisition of Property (WAPDA Office) (Second) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific properties in Mozang, Lahore, to construct an office for the Water and Power Development Authority. It also validates actions taken under Martial Law Orders Nos. 92 and 109 regarding these acquisitions.

name: The Capital of Republic (Declaration of Area) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: Ordinance No. VI of 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance determines the specific area of the Capital of the Republic. It defines the boundaries by describing a route starting from the Nichol Monument and following various landmarks, rivers, and roads to enclose approximately three hundred and fifty square miles.

name: The Republic (Determination of Area) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The Capital of the Republic (Determination of Area) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance determines the specific area of Islamabad as the Capital of the Republic. It defines the boundaries of the capital, which must measure approximately three hundred and fifty square miles within the district of Rawalpindi.

name: The West Pakistan Use of Loud-Speakers (Prohibition) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Use of Loud-Speakers (Prohibition) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the use of loud-speakers in public places within West Pakistan without permission from the Deputy Commissioner. It establishes penalties for contravention, allows for appeals to the Commissioner, and grants the government powers to exempt specific persons or occasions.

name: The West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Press and Publications Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to press and publication in West Pakistan. It establishes regulations for printing presses, newspaper publishers, and editors, including requirements for declarations, security deposits, and restrictions on foreign ownership.

name: No. BCD(1)14/27-63-SB — Approval of Foreign Currencies for Expression of Export and Import Bills

metadata.title: Notification No. BCD(1)14/27-63-SB
metadata.summary: This notification approves specific currencies in which export bills drawn in Pakistan and import bills drawn on or payable in Pakistan may be expressed. It lists the permitted currencies for export transactions and states that all world currencies are permitted for import transactions under Section 30 of the Banking Companies' Ordinance, 1962.

name: The Members of the National Assembly (Exemption from Preventive Detention and Personal Appearance) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: Ordinance No. IX
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides specific privileges for Members of the National Assembly of Pakistan. It grants exemption from preventive detention and requires that Members not be required to appear in Civil, Revenue, or Election Tribunals during specified periods relative to Assembly sessions.

name: The Medical Service of Pakistan Order (Repeal) Act, 1963

metadata.title: The Medical Service of Pakistan Order (Repeal) Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: The Medical Service of Pakistan Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Medical Service of Pakistan Order, 1962. It further deems that the All-Pakistan Medical Service constituted under the repealed order never existed.

name: The Censorship of Films Act, 1963

metadata.title: Censorship of Films Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the censorship of cinematograph films and the decertification of certified films on specific grounds. It establishes authorities to examine films, grants certificates for public exhibition, and outlines procedures for appeals and suspension of certification.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act continues, levies, and abolishes certain taxes and duties within the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific surcharges on land revenue in designated districts and introduces a development cess on all lands assessed to revenue.

name: The Finance Act, 1963

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1963
metadata.amends: Post Office Act, 1898; Tariff Act, 1934; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning July 1, 1963. It establishes maximum postage rates and provides provisions regarding customs, excise, sales tax, estate duty, income-tax, and super-tax.

name: The Wealth-tax Act, 1963

metadata.title: The Wealth-tax Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of wealth-tax on the net wealth of individuals, Hindu undivided families, and companies. It defines key terms such as 'assets', 'net wealth', and 'valuation date' while specifying which properties are excluded from the tax charge.

name: The Gift-tax Act, 1963

metadata.title: The Gift-tax Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of gift-tax in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as donor, donee, and taxable gifts, and establishes the charge of tax on gifts made during a specific previous year.

name: The Indecent Advertisements Prohibition Act, 1963

metadata.title: The Indecent Advertisements Prohibition Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the publication and display of indecent advertisements within Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'advertisement' and 'indecent', outlines penalties for violations including imprisonment and fines, and provides powers for confiscation of offending documents.

name: The West Pakistan Acquisition of Property (Residence of Government Officials) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Acquisition of Property (Residence of Government Officials) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition of specific property in Mauza Mian Mir, District Lahore, to be used as a residence for Government Officials. It validates actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 115 and mandates the payment of compensation to the previous occupants.

name: The West Pakistan Acquisition of Property (WAPDA House) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Acquisition of Property (WAPDA Office) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Government of West Pakistan to immediately take possession of specific property in Lahore for the Water and Power Development Authority. It mandates the assessment and payment of compensation by the Chief Settlement Commissioner and transfers the property to the Authority free from encumbrances, validating actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 129.

name: The West Pakistan Timber Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Timber Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The Martial Law Order No. 111; The West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a timber market in the revenue estates of Jia Musa and Chak Jia Musa. It also validates actions taken under previous Martial Law Order No. 111 and West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962, which were later declared invalid by the Supreme Court.

name: The West Pakistan Establishment and Improvement of Parks and Historical Places (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Establishment and Improvement of Parks and Historical Places (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of public parks and gardens in Lahore, as well as the reconstruction and renovation of places of historical interest. It also validates actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 126 regarding land acquisition and site allotment.

name: The West Pakistan Vegetable Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vegetable Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: Martial Law Order No. 121; West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of a wholesale vegetable market at Lahore. It also validates actions taken under Martial Law Order No. 121 and the West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962, which were previously questioned regarding their validity.

name: The West Pakistan Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: Martial Law Order No. 119; West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to remove and prevent traffic congestion within the Municipal limits of Gujranwala. It regulates vehicular movement, mandates the removal of specific petrol pumps, and validates actions taken under previous Martial Law Orders.

name: The West Pakistan Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Bus Stand and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to remove and prevent traffic congestion while regulating vehicular movement within the Lahore Municipal Corporation. It also validates actions taken under previous Martial Law Order No. 112 and West Pakistan Ordinance No. XXI of 1962.

name: The West Pakistan Recovery of Cost (Copies of Essential Revenue Records) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Recovery of Cost (Copies of Essential Revenue Records) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the preparation and supply of copies of essential revenue records to Union Councils in West Pakistan. It establishes a mechanism for recovering the government costs incurred in preparing these records from land revenue payers and mandates that the copies be made available for public inspection.

name: The West Pakistan (Revenue Officers and Revenue Courts of Sheikhupura) Regularisation of Proceedings Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Revenue Officers and Revenue Courts of Sheikhupura) Regularisation of Proceedings Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regularizes acts done and proceedings taken by Revenue Officers and Revenue Courts in the District of Sheikhupura between August 8, 1960, and April 23, 1962. It validates actions performed while sitting in premises or estates that were outside the official district limits at that time, preventing them from being challenged on jurisdictional grounds.

name: The Cantonments Rent Restriction Act, 1963

metadata.title: Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958 by substituting specific words in sections 175, 16B, and 30. It also contains provisions regarding the control of rents for certain buildings within cantonment areas and the eviction of tenants.

name: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the slaughter of useful animals and regulates the slaughter of other animals in the Urban Areas of West Pakistan. It establishes definitions for terms like 'animal', 'carcass', and 'slaughter', mandates veterinary examination before approval, and outlines penalties for contravention.

name: The [West Pakistan] Agror Valley Regulation (Repeal) Act, 1963

metadata.title: The Agror Valley Regulation (Repeal) Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: The Agror Valley Regulation, 1891
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Agror Valley Regulation of 1891. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: The Appellate Jurisdiction (High Courts and Supreme Court) (Repeal) Act, 1963

metadata.title: Appellate Jurisdiction (High Courts and Supreme Court) (Repeal) Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: Appellate Jurisdiction (High Courts and Supreme Court) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Appellate Jurisdiction (High Courts and Supreme Court) Ordinance, 1962. It provides for the transfer of pending appeals from the Supreme Court to the appropriate High Court and addresses the status of dismissed petitions for special leave to appeal.

name: The Diplomatic Immunities (Conferences with Commonwealth Countries) Act, 1963

metadata.title: The Diplomatic Immunities (Conferences with Commonwealth Countries) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act confers certain immunities on representatives of Commonwealth countries and their official staffs attending conferences in Pakistan. It grants them immunity from suit, legal process, and inviolability of residence and premises similar to that of an envoy, subject to specific conditions regarding citizenship.

name: The Privileges of Members of National Assembly (Exemption from Preventive Detention and Personal Appearance) Act, 1963

metadata.title: The Privileges of Members of National Assembly (Exemption from Preventive Detention and Personal Appearance) Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act provides exemptions for Members of the National Assembly from preventive detention and personal appearance in Civil, Revenue Courts, or before Election Tribunals during sessions. It specifies that these privileges apply fourteen days before and after a session and remains in force until the conclusion of the next session.

name: The West Pakistan Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the organized and planned growth of industries in West Pakistan. It restricts the establishment or enlargement of industrial undertakings without prior written permission from the Government.

name: The Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) (Validation of Transfers) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) (Validation of Transfers) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain transfers of immovable properties made by the Chief Settlement Commissioner from the compensation pool under the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958. It deems these transfers, executed between August 8, 1959, and the commencement of this Ordinance, to have been validly transferred despite any questions regarding the powers exercised at the time.

name: The Elective Bodies Disqualification (Removal and Remission) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.title: The Elective Bodies Disqualification (Removal and Remission) Ordinance, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the removal and remission of disqualifications under the Elective Bodies (Disqualification) Order, 1959. It was promulgated by the President because the National Assembly was not in session and immediate legislation was deemed necessary for national interest.

name: The West Pakistan Institute of Textile Technology Cess Act, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Institute of Textile Technology Cess Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to establish and maintain the Pakistan Institute of Textile Technology in Lyallpur. It authorizes the levying of a cess on spindles and power-looms installed in textile mills within West Pakistan, excluding Tribal Areas.

name: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions (Extension to Karachi Division) Act, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions (Extension to Karachi Division) Act, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960 to include Karachi Division. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan on December 15, 1962, and received assent from the Governor on December 31, 1962.

name: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Act, 1962
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Limitation (Custom) Act, 1920; The Punjab Custom (Power to Contest) Act, 1920; The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937; The North-West Frontier Province Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1935; The Punjab Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1948; The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application (Sind Amendment) Act, 1950; The Bahawalpur State Shariat (Muslim Personal Law) Application Act, 1951; The Khairpur State Muslim Female Inheritance (Removal of Customs) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the provisions for applying Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) in West Pakistan, excluding Tribal Areas. It terminates limited estates held by Muslim females under customary law and regulates succession, marriage, divorce, and wills where parties are Muslims.

name: The Military Court Sentences (Supplementary Provisions) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Military Court Sentences (Supplementary Provisions) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes provisions relating to sentences passed by Military Courts constituted under Martial Law Regulations. It grants the Commander-in-Chief of the Pakistan Army powers to pardon, remit, reduce, commute, or suspend sentences and to revoke orders suspending such sentences.

name: The Jute Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Jute Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to trade in jute and jute manufactures. It provides for measures to regulate and promote internal and international trade, licenses dealers and godown occupiers, collects statistics, and levies a cess on jute.

name: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance,1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1960 and the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Establishment and Actions) Validating Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the dissolution of the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation. It details the transfer of the corporation's assets, liabilities, and employees to the Industrial Development Corporation.

name: The Martial Law (Confirmation of Sentences) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Ordinance to amend the Army Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Army Act, 1952 to transfer the confirmation of death sentences and transportation for life passed by Special Military Courts to the Commander-in-Chief. It also mandates that applications for review in such cases be submitted to and disposed of by the Commander-in-Chief.

name: The Political Parties Act, 1962

metadata.title: The Political Parties Act, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the formation and regulation of political parties in Pakistan. It prohibits the formation of parties prejudicial to Islamic ideology or national security, bans foreign-aided parties, and outlines disqualifications for party membership and election.

name: The Finance Act,1962

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1962
metadata.amends: Post Office Act, 1898; Tariff Act, 1934; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Finance Ordinance, 1961; Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning July 1, 1962. It amends several existing laws including the Post Office Act, Tariff Act, Central Excises and Salt Act, Finance Ordinance, and Income-tax Act to fix tax rates and postage duties.

name: The Transfer of Railways Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Transfer of Railways Order, 1962
metadata.repeals: Railways Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order transfers railways from the Central Government to Provincial Governments in Pakistan. It establishes Provincial Railway Boards for each province and defines their composition, functions, and powers.

name: The Miani Sahib Graveyard Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Miani Sahib Graveyard Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of Martial Law Order No. 181 and promotes the functions of the Lahore Graveyard Committee regarding the Miani Sahib Graveyard. It defines specific expressions, vests property in the committee upon the expiry of martial law, and outlines penalties for contravening the order.

name: The West Pakistan Textbook Board Ordinance, 1962.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Textbook Board Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Textbook Board as a body corporate to manage the production and publication of textbooks for Classes I to XII. It also provides for the conduct of research in curricula and reading material, as well as the preparation of supplementary guides for teachers.

name: The West Pakistan Abolition of Cesses (Habubs) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: West Pakistan Abolition of Cesses (Habubs) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes all cesses known as Habubs that are leviable in cash or in kind within the Kalat Division of West Pakistan. It specifically lists various Khastas situated in Moza Mozang across different blocks where these cesses are no longer applicable.

name: The Abbottabad Joint Development Board Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Abbottabad Joint Development Board Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Abbottabad Joint Development Board to oversee and regulate building activities within Abbottabad. It defines the board's composition, powers, and responsibilities regarding master planning and local body coordination.

name: The Allopathic System (Prevention of Misuse) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Allopathic System (Prevention of Misuse) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to prevent the misuse of the allopathic system of medicine and to regulate related matters. It prohibits unregistered individuals from using titles like 'doctor', displaying unauthorized medical degrees, performing surgeries beyond minor procedures, prescribing specific drugs, or selling certain medicines without proper labeling.

name: The Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to banking companies in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'banking', 'banking company', and 'branch', while establishing that its provisions override conflicting clauses in a company's memorandum or articles.

name: The Decorations Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Decorations Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conferment of decorations for distinguished military and public service in Pakistan. It also restricts citizens and persons in Pakistani service from accepting foreign decorations without the President's approval.

name: The Appellate Jurisdiction (High Courts and Supreme Court) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Cause Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887 by substituting specific monetary limits in section 15. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan on June 5, 1962, and came into force immediately.

name: The Apprenticeship Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Apprenticeship Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the promotion, development, and regulation of systematic apprenticeship programmes within industries. It also establishes minimum standards of skill required in these trades.

name: The Appropriation (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Appropriation (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of certain sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund. It covers services and purposes for the period beginning July 1, 1961, and ending June 30, 1962.

name: The West Pakistan Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes and organizes the West Pakistan Board of Technical Education. It defines the Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its composition, membership terms, and powers to regulate technical and commercial education.

name: The West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance transfers the control of primary education from local councils to the Government of West Pakistan. It establishes District Primary Education Committees and outlines their functions, powers, and funding mechanisms. The document also defines key terms related to compulsory education, school attendance, and the administration of primary schools.

name: The Disturbed Areas (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Disturbed Areas (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The East Bengal Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Act, 1951; The Punjab Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Act, 1951; The North-West Frontier Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers special powers upon officers in respect of disturbed areas within Pakistan. It grants Magistrates and police officers the authority to use force, including lethal force, against individuals violating assembly or weapon prohibitions, while also empowering Armed Forces and Civil Armed Forces officers to arrest without warrant and search premises.

name: The Salaries and Allowances of Ministers (Repeal) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Salaries and Allowances of Ministers (Repeal) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The Salaries and Allowances of Ministers Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to repeal the Salaries and Allowances of Ministers Act, 1949. It came into force immediately upon enactment on June 5, 1962, with the repealed Act officially standing repealed on June 8, 1962.

name: The Medical Council Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Medical Council Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law regarding the registration of medical practitioners and dentists in Pakistan. It establishes a uniform minimum standard for basic and higher qualifications in medicine and dentistry while reconstituting the Medical Council.

name: The Sind Education Cess (West Pakistan Repeal) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Sind Education Cess (West Pakistan Repeal) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: Sind Muslim Education Cess Act, 1946; Sind Muslim Education Cess (Extension) Act, 1947; Sind Muslim Education Cess (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals three specific Acts relating to the Muslim Education Cess in Sindh. It also mandates that any remaining proceeds from these repealed cesses be transferred to the general revenues of West Pakistan.

name: The Tea Plantations Labour Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Tea Plantations Labour Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the welfare of labour and regulates working conditions specifically within tea plantations in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'tea plantation', 'employer', and 'worker', and establishes the powers and functions of inspectors to ensure compliance with its provisions.

name: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (West Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Industrial Development Corporation for West Pakistan to promote economic and industrial development in the region. It defines the Corporation's structure, including its share capital, management board, appointment of directors and chairman, and operational powers.

name: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (East Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Provincial Industrial Development Corporation (East Pakistan) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Industrial Development Corporation for East Pakistan to promote economic and industrial growth in the region. It defines the Corporation's structure, including its share capital, management board, appointment of directors, and operational powers.

name: The Industrial Corporations (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Industrial Corporations (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation Act, 1950; The Small Industries Corporation Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the dissolution of the Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation and the Small Industries Corporation. It authorizes the transfer of their business, projects, and properties to Provincial Corporations or other designated authorities before their official dissolution.

name: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Laws) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Laws) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: existing laws applicable in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance adapts and amends certain laws applicable in the Province of West Pakistan following the Provincial Re-organization Committee's report. It provides for the substitution of expressions and the omission of words where necessary due to changes in administrative structure.

name: The Appropriation (Railways) Supplementary Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Appropriation (Railways) Supplementary Ordinance, 1962
