metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund for Pakistan Railways. It covers the financial period starting July 1, 1961, and ending June 30, 1962, detailing various expenditures such as repairs, maintenance, and contributions to general revenues.

name: The Copyright Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Copyright Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to copyright in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as artistic works, dramatic works, and infringement while establishing the scope of protection for various types of creative content.

name: The lqbal Academy Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Iqbal Academy Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The Iqbal Academy Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Iqbal Academy Act, 1951 with certain modifications to improve administrative efficiency. It establishes the Iqbal Academy as a body corporate with defined aims, including the study of Iqbal's works, publishing, and awarding scholarships.

name: The West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of Government dues as arrears of land revenue in the Province of West Pakistan. It allows the Governor to declare specific dues recoverable under the Revenue Recoveries Act, 1890, and empowers the Government to make rules for giving effect to its provisions.

name: The West Pakistan Martial Law Orders (Continuance in Force) Ordinance, 1962.

metadata.title: West Pakistan Martial Law Orders (Continuance in Force) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: Martial Law Orders issued by the Martial Law Administrator Zone 'B'
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues certain Martial Law Orders issued by the Martial Law Administrator of Zone 'B' in West Pakistan. It amends specific clauses within those orders to update penalties for contravention, including imprisonment and fines.

name: The West Pakistan (Universities) Removal of Undesirable Government Servants Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: West Pakistan Universities Removal of Undesirable Government Servants Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the termination of services of Government servants serving in universities and other educational institutions in West Pakistan who are deemed undesirable. It authorizes the Governor to terminate such services after giving the servant a reasonable opportunity to show cause against the proposed action.

name: The Employees' Social insurance Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Employees' Social Insurance Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance introduces a scheme of social insurance to provide benefits to certain employees or their dependants in cases of sickness, maternity, employment injury, or death. It establishes the legal framework for contributions payable by employers and defines key terms such as 'employment injury', 'dependant', and 'appropriate Government'.

name: The Reserved Seats (First Elections) (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Reserved Seats (First Elections) (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Order clarifies that elections to seats reserved exclusively for women must be conducted by the Election Commission rather than by members of the Provincial Assembly. It also substitutes the word 'conduct' with 'vote at' in Article 169 of the Constitution to resolve this legal doubt.

name: The Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan College of Physicians and Surgeons as a body corporate to maintain high principles of the medical profession. It outlines the composition of the College, the functions of its Council, and provisions for post-graduate training and examinations.

name: The Political Organisations (Prohibition of Unregulated Activity) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Political Organisations (Prohibition of Unregulated Activity) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prevents unregulated associations from setting up organizational structures, collecting funds, or owning property for political purposes. It also prohibits associations from using specific names listed in the Schedule or obvious variations thereof.

name: The Military College of Engineering, Risalpur (Degree) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: Military College of Engineering, Risalpur (Degree) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance grants a charter to the Military College of Engineering, Risalpur, enabling it to award the Degree of Bachelor of Civil Engineering. It establishes the governing structure including a Commandant, an Academic Board, and defines the powers of the Controlling Authority to manage instruction, examinations, and student welfare.

name: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Establishment and Actions) Validating Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (Establishment and Actions) Validating Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regularizes the establishment of the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation. It also validates certain actions, appointments, and orders taken under the previous 1960 Ordinance between April 30, 1960, and the commencement of this law.

name: The West Pakistan Excess Appropriation (Repeal) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Excess Appropriation (Repeal) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Excess Appropriation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This ordinance was promulgated to repeal the West Pakistan Excess Appropriation Ordinance, 1960. It is deemed to have taken effect from May 25, 1960.

name: The Sports (Development and Control) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Sports (Development and Control) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the development and control of sports in Pakistan. It establishes a Board to oversee sports activities and grants the Board the power to make rules for uniformity throughout the country.

name: The West Pakistan Co-operative Development Board Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Co-operative Development Board Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Co-operative Development Board to oversee the co-operative movement in the province. The Board is constituted with a Chairman and up to ten members appointed by the Government or the Union, depending on their role. Its functions include promoting and supervising co-operative societies, managing their affairs when necessary, conducting surveys, and facilitating research within the field.

name: The West Pakistan Registration of Unrecognized Educational Institutions Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Registration of Unrecognized Educational Institutions Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration and regulation of unrecognized private educational institutions in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes a process where intending persons or existing institutions must apply to a Registering Authority, fulfilling specific conditions outlined in a Schedule, to obtain a certificate of registration.

name: CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR, PAKISTAN No. 35

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 35
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Brigadier Sardar Ali as the Martial Law Administrator for Zone C. The appointment is effective from April 13, 1962, to April 25, 1962, succeeding Major General Khawaja Wasiuddin.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (First Elections) Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (First Elections) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Order clarifies the power of the Election Commission or Chief Election Commissioner to review the rejection of a candidate's nomination by a Returning Officer. It addresses doubts arising under Article 171 of the Constitution regarding this specific procedural issue during the First Elections.

name: CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR, PAKISTAN N0. 96

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 96
metadata.summary: This document amends Martial Law Regulation No. 61 by substituting a specific list of previous regulations with the phrase 'any Martial Law Regulation' in paragraph 1(A)(1). It was issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator, Pakistan, on April 4, 1962.

name: The West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: law relating to the levy of tolls on public roads and bridges in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws regarding the imposition of tolls on public roads and bridges within West Pakistan. It establishes the government's authority to set rates, manage collection, lease toll rights, and impose penalties for non-payment.

name: The West Pakistan Validation of Naib Tehsildars and Naib Tehsildar Candidates Selection Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: West Pakistan Validation of Naib Tehsildars and Naib Tehsildar Candidates Selection Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the selection of Naib Tehsildars and Naib Tehsildar candidates made during the years 1960 and 1961. It deems these selections valid despite any existing rules, decrees, orders, or court judgments that might have otherwise affected them.

name: The Removal of Disqualification (Election) Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Removal of Disqualification (Election) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Order removes the disqualification for being elected as a member of an elective body if the person has been detained under specific security or public safety laws before October 7, 1962. It is promulgated by the President of Pakistan in exercise of powers under Articles 229 and 103 of the Constitution.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (First Elections) Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (First Elections) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Order resolves doubts regarding the application of Article 103(2)(a) of the Constitution concerning disqualification for holding an office of profit. It clarifies that full-time employees of government bodies and persons performing public functions in addition to their ordinary vocation are not automatically disqualified from being elected as members of an Assembly.

name: The National and Provincial Assemblies (First Elections) Order,1962

metadata.title: The National and Provincial Assemblies (First Elections) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the conduct of the first elections to the National and Provincial Assemblies following the enactment of the Constitution on March 1, 1962. It establishes the legal framework for holding these elections, including the appointment of registration officers, the preparation of electors' lists, and the definition of key terms related to the electoral process.

name: The Service of Pakistan (Permanent Appointment and Recruitment) Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Service of Pakistan (Permanent Appointment and Recruitment) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the permanent appointment of certain persons to the service of Pakistan, including those deriving nationality from the former Indian State of Jammu and Kashmir. It also facilitates recruitment to specific posts in the Posts and Telegraphs Department from individuals not domiciled in the respective Province.

name: The Special Police and Provincial Police (Amalgamation) Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Special Police and Provincial Police (Amalgamation) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Order amalgamates the Pakistan Special Police Establishment with the Provincial Police. It stipulates that expenses for the Special Police will be charged on the Federal Consolidated Fund and grants provincial governments power to make necessary orders regarding seniority.

name: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1962

metadata.title: The Constitution of the Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This document is a notification published by the President's Secretariat in the Gazette of Pakistan on March 1, 1962. It formally publishes the text of the Constitution of the Republic of Pakistan for general information.

name: The Port Authorities Lands and Buildings (Recovery of Possession) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Port Authorities Lands and Buildings (Recovery of Possession) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the speedy recovery of possession of lands and buildings belonging to Port Authorities from unauthorized occupants or lessees who fail to vacate. It defines key terms such as 'allotment', 'authorized officer', and 'unauthorized occupant' to facilitate legal proceedings for eviction.

name: The University of Karachi Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The University of Karachi Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance re-constitutes and re-organizes the University of Karachi to improve teaching, research, and administration. It establishes the legal framework for the University's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

name: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Karachi) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Karachi) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to reconstitute and reorganize the Karachi Board of Secondary Education. It defines key terms, establishes the composition and tenure of the Board's members, outlines procedures for resignations and removals, and sets rules for filling vacancies.

name: The West Pakistan Civil courts Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: law relating to Civil Courts in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to Civil Courts in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes the jurisdiction of District Judges and Civil Judges, defines local limits for courts, and outlines provisions regarding the appointment of judges and the handling of suits related to land.

name: The Gwadur (Application of West Pakistan Laws) Ordinance, 1962

metadata.title: The Gwadur (Application of West Pakistan Laws) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan (Gwadur) Extension of Laws Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends all West Pakistan laws applicable to the Mekran District to the territory of Gwadur, which was ceded to Pakistan in 1958. It deems these laws to have been in force in Gwadur since September 8, 1958, and repeals corresponding local laws previously in effect there.

name: NA- The Settlement of Disputes (First Elections) Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Settlement of Disputes (First Elections) (Amendment) Order, 1962
metadata.amends: The Settlement of Disputes (First Elections) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Settlement of Disputes (First Elections) Order, 1962, to establish tribunals for trying election petitions and define their composition. It also modifies provisions regarding record retention, applications to the Commission, and the transfer of pending or disposed-of petitions between provinces.

name: NA-The Election Laws Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Election Laws Amendment Order, 1962
metadata.amends: National and Provincial Assemblies (First Elections) Order, 1962; Removal of Difficulties (First Elections) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Order amends existing President's Orders relating to elections for the National and Provincial Assemblies. It specifically updates provisions regarding the return or forfeiture of election deposits, inserts references to corrupt practices in one order, adds new articles concerning delegation of powers and rule-making authority to the Election Commission, and validates certain actions taken under previous orders.

name: The Pakistan Navy Rules, 1961

metadata.title: The Pakistan Navy Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961 to regulate various aspects of naval service. They define key terms such as Administrative Authority and Drafting Authority, establish procedures for attestation and oaths, specify engagement periods, and outline conditions for dismissal.

name: The Jammu and Kashmir (Administration of Property) Rules, 1961

metadata.title: The Jammu and Kashmir (Administration of Property) Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under the Jammu and Kashmir (Administration of Property) Ordinance, 1961 to regulate the administration and management of property vested in the government. They outline the powers of the Manager regarding transactions, contracts, and the sale of property, as well as procedures for handling sale proceeds and their investment.

name: The Pakistan Standard Institution (Certification Marks) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: the Pakistan Standards Institution (Certification Marks) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the standardization and marking of goods in Pakistan. It establishes the powers and duties of the Pakistan Standards Institution regarding certification marks, licensing, and inspections to ensure conformity with established standards.

name: The Cement (Surcharge) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Cement (Surcharge) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of a surcharge on cement produced or manufactured by specific companies in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'company' and 'surcharge', mandates the payment rate, and grants powers to amend the schedule of affected companies and make rules.

name: The West Pakistan Fisheries Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Fisheries Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: law relating to fisheries in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws relating to fisheries in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'fish', 'water', and 'private water', establishes the powers of the Director of Fisheries, and sets restrictions on fishing methods and prohibited substances.

name: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration and control of voluntary social welfare agencies in Pakistan. It establishes the legal framework requiring such agencies to register with the Registration Authority, maintain audited accounts, submit annual reports, and comply with specific conditions regarding their constitution and operations.

name: The Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of trade organizations and related matters. It establishes a licensing system for registering trade organizations under the Companies Act, 1913, defining specific types of eligible organizations such as federations, chambers of commerce, and town associations.

name: The Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Conciliation Courts Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of Conciliation Courts in Pakistan to enable people to settle certain disputes through conciliation. It defines specific cases referable to these courts, outlines the composition of the courts, and establishes procedures for applications and revisions.

name: The Pakistan Naturalization Rules, 1961

metadata.title: The Pakistan Naturalization Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the forms and procedures for applications, certificates, declarations, and oaths related to naturalization under the Naturalization Act, 1926. They supersede the Indian Naturalization Rules, 1938, and establish specific fees for issuing certificates and copies of declarations.

name: The Dir (Extenshion of Laws) Regulation, 1961

metadata.title: The Dir (Extension of Laws) Regulation, 1961
metadata.number: West Pakistan Regulation No. II of 1961
metadata.summary: This regulation extends certain existing laws to the territories of the State of Dir, which was incorporated into West Pakistan in 1955. It specifies that corresponding local laws in force within Dir shall cease to have effect once the extended laws apply.

name: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: The law relating to management of waqf properties in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the laws regarding the management of waqf properties in West Pakistan. It establishes a Chief Administrator for Waqf, defines what constitutes waqf property, and outlines the powers to take over and manage such properties.

name: The Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: Wages Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of minimum rates of wages for workers employed in certain industrial undertakings and related matters. It establishes Minimum Wages Boards with specific compositions to determine these rates and defines key terms such as 'adult', 'employer', 'factory', 'industry', 'wages', 'worker', and 'juvenile worker'.

name: The Port Hajj Committees Act (Repeal) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: Port Hajj Committees Act (Repeal) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.repeals: Port Hajj Committees Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Port Hajj Committees Act, 1932. It also vests the Hajj Fund and all assets, functions, rights, liabilities, and obligations of the dissolved Port Hajj Committee of Karachi into the Central Government.

name: The West Pakistan Agricultural University Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural University Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes an Agricultural University in West Pakistan located at Lyallpur. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession, defining its structure including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council. The document outlines the University's powers to provide instruction, conduct research, confer degrees, and manage property.

name: The West Pakistan University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan University of Engineering and Technology in Lahore. It defines the university's corporate status, structure, and powers to confer degrees, institute professorships, and manage property.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 90

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 90
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Regulation defines the punishment for kidnapping minors from their lawful guardianship. It specifies that males under fourteen and females under sixteen years of age are protected, with a maximum penalty of seven years imprisonment.

name: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Agricultural Development Corporation to increase agricultural production in the region. It defines the corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its management structure, including a Board of Directors appointed by the Government.

name: The Oil and Gas Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: Oil and Gas Development Corporation Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Oil and Gas Development Corporation to manage the exploration, development, production, refining, and sale of oil and gas resources in Pakistan. It defines the corporation's structure, including a Board of Directors appointed by the Central Government, a Chairman, and a General Manager, while outlining their powers, duties, and disqualifications.

name: The West Pakistan (University of Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (University of Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance re-constitutes and re-organizes the University of Peshawar to improve its teaching, research, and administration. It establishes the University as a body corporate with perpetual succession and grants it powers to acquire property, confer degrees, and regulate its internal structure including the Syndicate and Academic Council.

name: The West Pakistan (University of the Punjab) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (University of the Punjab) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance re-constitutes and re-organizes the University of the Punjab in Lahore. It establishes the university as a corporate body with powers to provide instruction, conduct research, hold examinations, and confer degrees.

name: The West Pakistan (University of Sind) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (University of Sind) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and reorganizes the University of Sind to improve teaching and research administration. It establishes the university's structure, including a Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, while defining their powers and duties.

name: The West Pakistan General Clauses (Extension to Special Areas), Regulation, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan General Clauses (Extension to Special Areas) Regulation, 1961
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the provisions of the General Clauses Act, 1897 to the Special Areas of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan with the previous approval of the President on September 13, 1961.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 33

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 33
metadata.summary: This order appoints Major General Mian Ghulam Jilani as the Martial Law Administrator for Zone 'B' effective September 6, 1961. The appointment is made in the absence of Lieut.-General Bakhtiar Rana who is on temporary duty abroad.

name: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961
metadata.repeals: The Sind Prevention of Bribery and Corruption Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of a special agency known as the Anti-Corruption Establishment in West Pakistan. It authorizes this body to investigate specific corruption offences by public servants and to hold preliminary inquiries against them.

name: The Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the legal framework for the Pakistan Navy, covering personnel eligibility, appointment, and conditions of service. It defines various offences such as mutiny, desertion, and misconduct, along with the corresponding punishments and penalties.

name: The Scrutiny of Claims (Evacuee Property) Regulation

metadata.title: Scrutiny of Claims (Evacuee Property) Regulation
metadata.summary: This regulation reconstitutes Martial Law Regulation No. 84 regarding the scrutiny of claims for evacuee property in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'claimant' and 'Entitlement Certificate' and establishes a new scale for determining land entitlement based on previous allocations.

name: The Acceding State (Property) Order, 1961

metadata.title: The Acceding State (Property) Order, 1961
metadata.summary: This Order governs the devolution and distribution of property belonging to acceding states or their rulers. It establishes that disputes regarding such property shall be decided by an order of the Central Government rather than any court.

name: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Peshawar) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education at Peshawar as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition of the Board, including ex-officio members and nominated representatives, and outlines the powers of the Board to make Regulations and Rules.

name: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Lahore) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Lahore) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and re-organizes the Board of Secondary Education in Lahore. It establishes the Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its composition, powers, and the roles of its officers and committees.

name: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education at Hyderabad in West Pakistan. It defines the composition, tenure, and powers of the Board, including its members and jurisdiction limits.

name: Rules For The Examination Of Masters and Mates

metadata.title: Rules for the Examination of Masters and Mates
metadata.summary: These rules govern the examination process for masters and mates in Pakistan's maritime sector. They establish conditions of entry, application procedures, syllabuses, fees, and regulations regarding certificates and grades.

name: The Central Trade Union Regulations, 1961

metadata.title: The Central Trade Union Regulations, 1961
metadata.summary: These regulations were made by the Central Government under the Trade Unions Act, 1926 to govern trade union registration and recognition in Karachi Division. They establish specific forms for applications, certificates, and rule alterations, define fees for registration, and set criteria for a trade union to be considered representative for recognition purposes.

name: The Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1961
metadata.repeals: Pakistan Industrial Finance Corporation Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan to provide credit facilities to industrial concerns. It replaces the Pakistan Industrial Finance Corporation and outlines the bank's establishment, share capital structure, and government guarantees.

name: The Civilian Employees in Defence Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1961

metadata.title: Civilian Employees in Defence Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules establish the classification system for civilian employees in Defence Services who are not subject to specific military acts. They define key terms, outline the structure of service classes, and provide provisions regarding recruitment, promotion, and the application of these rules to various government servants.

name: The Pakistan Merchant Shipping (Seamen’s Employment) Rules, 1961

metadata.title: The Pakistan Merchant Shipping (Seamen's Employment) Rules, 1961
metadata.amends: The Pakistan Merchant Shipping (Seamen's Employment) Rules, 1951
metadata.summary: These rules establish Seamen's Employment Boards and define their composition and functions. They also set out the requirements for seaman registration, including physical fitness certificates and continuous discharge certificates, as well as procedures for maintaining rosters.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 32

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 32
metadata.summary: This order appoints Brigadier Sardar Ali as the Martial Law Administrator for Zone 'C' effective from July 5, 1961. It also designates Brigadier Khawaja Wasiuddin to assume duties in the same zone starting July 16, 1961.

name: The Special Areas (Restoration of Jurisdiction) Order, 1961

metadata.title: The Special Areas (Restoration of Jurisdiction) Order, 1961
metadata.summary: This Order restores the jurisdiction of the High Court of West Pakistan in relation to Special Areas as it would have existed on October 14, 1955, had certain earlier enactments not been passed. It empowers the Central Government to modify or extend this jurisdiction and includes provisions regarding limitation periods for legal matters.

name: The Road Transport Workers Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Road Transport Workers Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the hours of work and other conditions of employment for road transport workers in Pakistan. It establishes limits on daily and weekly working hours, mandates rest intervals, defines leave entitlements based on continuous employment, and sets rules regarding overtime pay and termination of services.

name: The Petroleum Products (Development Surcharge) Rules, 1961

metadata.title: The Petroleum Products (Development Surcharge) Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules determine the prescribed prices for petroleum products imported into Pakistan during a specific period. They establish formulas for calculating free-on-board values, ocean freight costs, and remuneration/profits based on Platt's daily reporting service and Abadan posted prices.

name: The Petroleum Products (Development Surcharge) Ordinance,1961

metadata.title: Petroleum Products (Development Surcharge) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy and collection of a development surcharge on petroleum products sold by companies. It establishes fixed sale prices, defines terms related to pricing margins, and outlines penalties for selling above the prescribed limits.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1961.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuation of certain taxes in the Province of West Pakistan. It imposes additional surcharges on land revenue and agricultural income-tax in specific districts and amends the Stamp Act, 1899 regarding acknowledgment of debt and receipts.

name: The Appropriation Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Appropriation Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund for the fiscal period beginning July 1, 1961, and ending June 30, 1962. It details the authorized charges for various government services, ministries, and purposes listed in the attached Schedule.

name: The Appropriation (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Appropriation (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund for government services. It covers the financial period beginning July 1, 1960, and ending June 30, 1961, detailing authorized expenditures across various ministries and departments.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: Finance Act, 1958; Tariff Act, 1934; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 1961. It amends several existing acts, including the Finance Act, 1958, Tariff Act, 1934, Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944, and Income-tax Act, 1922, to update duties, rates, and provisions for that year.

name: The West Pakistan Administration (Merger of the Federal Territory of Karachi) Order, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Administration (Merger of the Federal Territory of Karachi) Order, 1961
metadata.repeals: The Bombay District Police Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Order merges the Federal Territory of Karachi into the Province of West Pakistan. It adapts existing laws, revenues, and government assets to continue in force with necessary modifications following the merger.

name: The West Pakistan Appropriation Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Appropriation Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of certain sums out of the Provincial Consolidated Fund for the financial year 1961-62. It details specific allocations for various departments including agriculture, education, health, and irrigation.

name: The West Pakistan Supplementary Appropriation Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Supplementary Appropriation Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the further payment and appropriation of certain sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund. It covers expenses for a twelve-month period ending on June 30, 1961, including various government services and demands.

name: The Appropriation (Railways) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Appropriation (Railways) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund for Pakistan Railways. It covers the financial period starting July 1, 1961, and ending June 30, 1962.

name: The Wheat and Wheat Products (Movement Restriction) Order, 1961

metadata.title: The Wheat and Wheat Products (Movement Restriction) Order, 1961
metadata.summary: This Order restricts the export of wheat and wheat products from West Pakistan to Azad Kashmir territory. It mandates that such exports must be on Government account or accompanied by a specific permit from the Ministry of Food and Agriculture, with an exception for small quantities carried as luggage.

name: The Associated Press of Pakistan (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Associated Press of Pakistan (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Central Government to take over the Associated Press of Pakistan Limited due to its administrative and financial breakdown. Upon taking over, the company is dissolved, and all its assets, liabilities, and legal proceedings are transferred to the government to ensure a stable and efficient flow of news.

name: The Notaries Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Notaries Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for and regulates the profession of notaries in Pakistan. It establishes the power to appoint notaries, mandates the maintenance of registers, defines the functions of notaries, and outlines requirements for certificates of practice.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 87

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 87
metadata.summary: This regulation further amends Martial Law Regulation No. 61 as reconstituted and amended by Regulation No. 86. It inserts specific wording into sub-paragraph (1) of paragraph 1(A) to authorize officers designated by the Zonal Martial Law Administrator.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 86

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 61
metadata.summary: This document amends Martial Law Regulation No. 61 by inserting a new paragraph 1A. The amendment specifies that cases relating to offences under various other Martial Law Regulations shall be tried by the Supreme Commander and Chief Martial Law Administrator in Pakistan.

name: The Malaria Eradication Board Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Malaria Eradication Board Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Central Board and Provincial Boards to eradicate malaria from Pakistan and prevent its reintroduction. It defines the composition, functions, and procedures for these boards, including measures like insecticide spraying and medical examinations.

name: The permanent Transfer (Houses and Shops) Rules, 1961

metadata.title: The Permanent Transfer (Houses and Shops) Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules empower the Central Government to enable the Chief Settlement Commissioner to permanently transfer or dispose of property under the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958. They establish procedures for recording permanent transfers, defining key terms like 'final order' and 'proposed transferee', and outlining the rights of transferees to hold and alienate property.

name: The Minerals (Acquisition and Transfer) Order, 1961

metadata.title: The Minerals (Acquisition and Transfer) Order, 1961
metadata.summary: This Order vests all minerals and rights appertaining thereto in the Central Government of Pakistan. It applies to the whole of Pakistan, excluding Special Areas, and overrides any existing laws, customs, or agreements to the contrary.

name: The Pakistan Ordinance Factories Board Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: Pakistan Ordnance Factories Board Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Ordnance Factories Board and invests it with specific powers and functions previously held by the Central Government regarding ordnance factories. It outlines the Board's composition, the terms of office for its members, meeting procedures, and its primary function to manage factory affairs on commercial lines while meeting national defence needs.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 31

metadata.title: Martial Law Order
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Major General Malik Haq Nawaz as the Martial Law Administrator for Zone 'C' effective May 1, 1961. He replaces Major General Kazi Abdul Rahim Khan in this position.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 30

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 30
metadata.summary: This order appoints Lieutenant General Bakhtiar Rana as the Deputy Chief Martial Law Administrator for a specific period. The appointment is made in addition to his existing duties and occurs due to the temporary absence of General Mohammad Musa abroad.

name: The West Pakistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the improvement and expansion of certain areas in the hill tracts of the Rawalpindi and Hazara districts. It establishes a Trust known as the Rawalpindi and Hazara (Hill Tract) Improvement Trust to manage these improvements.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 85

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 1
metadata.summary: This notification amends Martial Law Regulation No. 1 with immediate effect. The amendments involve omitting specific paragraphs, renumbering others, and substituting text to include the Karachi area including Malir in Zone A.

name: The Medical Colleges (Governing Bodies) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Medical Colleges (Governing Bodies) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of Governing Bodies to administer and manage Medical Colleges in Pakistan. It outlines the composition of these bodies, including members appointed by Provincial and Central Governments, as well as provisions for committees and financial management.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 29

metadata.title: Martial Law Order
metadata.summary: This order appoints Brigadier Riaz Hussain as the Martial Law Administrator for Zone 'A' effective April 1, 1961. The appointment replaces Brigadier Muzaffar-ud-Den Mohammad Ayub Khan in this capacity.

name: The Satisfaction of Charges (Evacuee Property) Rules, 1961

metadata.title: The Satisfaction of Charges (Evacuee Property) Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules provide the procedure for applications regarding the satisfaction of charges created on acquired evacuee property. They define key terms such as 'acquired property', 'charge', and 'charge-holder', and specify the percentage rates at which total charge amounts are satisfied based on their aggregate value.

name: The Censorship of Films Rules, 1961

metadata.title: The Censorship of Films Rules, 1961
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under section 8 of the Cinematograph Act, 1918 to regulate the examination and certification of films for public exhibition. They establish the structure of the Board and its committees, define key terms, prescribe procedures for meetings and applications, and outline requirements for film records and accounts.

name: The Chartered Accountants Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Chartered Accountants Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of the profession of accountants in Pakistan. It establishes the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan and sets out provisions for the registration of members.

name: The Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to recommendations made by the Commission on Marriage and Family Laws. It establishes an Arbitration Council to handle matters regarding polygamy and regulates the registration of Muslim marriages throughout Pakistan.

name: The West Pakistan Discontinuance of Sind Road Fund Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Discontinuance of Sind Road Fund Ordinance, 1961
metadata.repeals: The Sind Road Fund Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the discontinuance of the Sind Road Fund, which was established under the Sind Road Fund Act, 1947. It also repeals the said Act and directs that any remaining balance in the fund be credited to the Provincial Consolidated Fund.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 28

metadata.title: Martial Law Orders
metadata.summary: This notification records appointments of Martial Law Administrators for Zone 'B' in Pakistan. Major General Sayad Gawas was appointed on January 25, 1961, followed by Lieut. General Bakhtiar Rana on January 30, 1961.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 27

metadata.title: Martial Law Orders
metadata.summary: This notification records appointments of Martial Law Administrators for Zone 'B' in Pakistan. Major General Sayad Gawas was appointed on January 25, 1961, followed by Lieut. General Bakhtiar Rana on January 30, 1961.

name: The Jammu and Kashmir (Administration of Property) Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Jammu and Kashmir (Administration of Property) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance vests certain immovable properties in the territory of Pakistan, which previously belonged to the State of Jammu and Kashmir, into the Central Government. It provides for the administration, leasing, and sale of these properties, as well as the management of proceeds from their sale.

name: The Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Agricultural Development Bank of Pakistan to carry out its functions as defined in the text. It defines key terms such as 'agriculture', 'agriculturist', and 'Bank', and stipulates that the Bank shall be deemed a banking company under existing banking laws.

name: The Central Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1961

metadata.title: The Central Laws (Adaptation) Order, 1961
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the adaptation of Central laws and Ordinances in force immediately before the Proclamation. It amends the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1958, to ensure necessary adjustments are made to existing legislation.

name: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: law relating to gambling in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws relating to gambling in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'common gaming-house' and 'gaming', while establishing penalties for operating or frequenting such establishments.

name: The West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Suppression of Prostitution Ordinance, 1961
metadata.amends: the law relating to the suppression of prostitution in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws regarding the suppression of prostitution in West Pakistan. It defines specific terms such as brothel, place of public amusement, and prostitution, while establishing punishments for keeping brothels, soliciting, and living off the earnings of prostitution.

name: The Scrutiny of Claims (Evacuee Property) Regulation

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Regulation amends the Registration of Claims (Displaced Persons) Act, 1956 to facilitate the verification and re-verification of claims for evacuee property. It establishes procedures for cancelling original claims if statements are not submitted and defines specific terms related to allotment and settlement commissioners.

name: The Eye Surgery (Restriction) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Eye Surgery (Restriction) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prevents unregistered persons from performing surgical operations on the eye in Pakistan. It defines specific terms such as 'complete blindness', 'partial blindness', and 'eye surgery' to establish legal boundaries for medical practice.

name: The Working Journalists (Miscellaneous) Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Working Journalists (Miscellaneous) Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules establish the constitution and management of a Provident Fund for working journalists under the Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960. They define key terms such as 'family' and 'subscriber', and outline the structure of the Board of Trustees responsible for administering the fund.

name: The West Pakistan District (Reconstitution) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan District (Reconstitution) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the alteration of district limits and the constitution of new districts within West Pakistan. It grants the Government power to alter district boundaries by notification and specifies how existing laws apply to added areas or newly constituted districts.

name: The West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to amend and consolidate laws regarding the detention and control of persons prejudicial to public order. It empowers the Government of West Pakistan to direct arrests and detentions without trial under specific conditions, establishes a Board for reviewing long-term detentions, and defines key legal expressions used within the document.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 83

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 83
metadata.amends: Martial Law Regulations Nos. 21, 23 and 26; reconstitutes Martial Law Regulation No. 25
metadata.summary: This notification amends Martial Law Regulations Nos. 21, 23, and 26 by substituting specific figures related to punishment terms. It also reconstitutes Martial Law Regulation No. 25 to address hoarding of public necessities, stock declaration requirements, and sales obligations for retailers.

name: The West Pakistan Administration Order, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Administration Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the administrative divisions within the Province of West Pakistan. It lists specific districts and special areas included in each division, such as Peshawar, Dera Ismail Khan, and Rawalpindi.

name: The Karachi Divisional Council (Conduct of Business) Model Regulations, 1960

metadata.title: The Karachi Divisional Council (Conduct of Business) Model Regulations
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the conduct of business for meetings of the Divisional Council in the Federal Territory of Karachi. They specify the types of meetings, notice periods, agenda preparation, and quorum requirements.

name: The Karachi District Council (Conduct of Meetings) Model Regulations, 1960

metadata.title: Karachi District Council (Conduct of Meetings) Model Regulations, 1960
metadata.summary: These regulations prescribe the model rules for conducting meetings of the Karachi District Council. They cover procedures for convening ordinary, special, and emergent meetings, including notice periods and quorum requirements.

name: The Karachi Tehsil Council (Conduct of Business) Model Regulations, 1960

metadata.title: The Karachi Town Council (Conduct of Business) Model Regulations, 1960
metadata.summary: These regulations prescribe the model rules for the conduct of business, meetings, and functions of Town Councils in Karachi. They define procedures for ordinary, special, and emergent meetings, including notice periods, quorum requirements, and agenda preparation.

name: The Karachi Union Councils (Conduct of Meetings) Model Regulations, 1960

metadata.title: Karachi Union Councils (Conduct of Meetings) Model Regulations, 1960
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the conduct of meetings for Union Councils in the Federal Territory of Karachi. They define the types of meetings, specify matters that must be considered at special versus ordinary meetings, and outline procedures for authentication and reporting decisions to the Controlling Authority.

name: The Karachi Local Councils (Conduct of Business) Rules, 1960

metadata.title: Karachi Local Councils (Conduct of Meetings) Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules delegate executive powers to local councils in the Federal Territory of Karachi, covering administration, staff management, and financial duties. They also establish procedures for convening meetings, reporting decisions, and authenticating council acts.

name: The Karachi Union Councils Account Rules, 1960

metadata.title: Karachi Union Councils Account Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under the Basic Democracies Order, 1959 to regulate the accounts of Union Councils in the Federal Territory of Karachi. They establish procedures for preparing annual budgets, defining key terms like 'employee' and 'contract', and outlining requirements for estimating receipts and expenditures.

name: The Karachi Union Councils (Secretary) Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Karachi Tahsil Councils (Appointment of Official Members) Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the appointment procedure for official members of Tahsil Councils in the Federal Territory of Karachi. The appointments require the previous approval of the Administrator of Karachi and are made by the Governor.

name: The Karachi Tehsil Councils (Appointment of Official Members) Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Karachi Tahsil Councils (Appointment of Official Members) Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the appointment of official members for Tahsil Councils in the Federal Territory of Karachi. The appointments require the previous approval of the Administrator of Karachi and are made by the Governor.

name: Amendments in the Displaced Persons (Fees for Compensation) Rules, 1959

metadata.title: The Displaced Persons (Fees for Compensation) Rules, 1959
metadata.amends: The Displaced Persons (Fees for Compensation) Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Displaced Persons (Fees for Compensation) Rules, 1959 by adding a new definition for 'Board' and introducing a fee structure for property transfers. Specifically, it mandates a ten percent fee on the value of transferred property to be paid to the Board for services rendered.

name: The Public Investments (Financial Safeguards) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: Public Investments (Financial Safeguards) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides financial safeguards for certain investments made out of public revenues. It empowers the appropriate Government to prescribe financial procedures, give directions, and scrutinize transactions of corporations established with federal or provincial aid.

name: The Pakistan Girl Guides Association Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: Pakistan Girl Guides Association Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance incorporates the Pakistan Girl Guides Association as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the association exclusive rights to use specific titles, uniforms, and badges while establishing rules for property acquisition and legal standing.

name: The Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Probation of Offenders Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the release on probation of offenders in certain cases and addresses matters incidental thereto. It empowers courts to make probation orders or conditional discharges instead of imposing immediate sentences, considering factors such as the offender's character and the nature of the offence.

name: The [West Pakistan] Dir (Advisory Council) Regulation, 1960

metadata.title: The Dir (Advisory Council) Regulation, 1960
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes a Council of Advisors to aid and advise the Ruler of Dir in exercising his functions following the incorporation of the State of Dir into West Pakistan. It outlines the constitution of the council, the appointment of a Chief Advisor, and grants the Provincial Government the power to make rules for its implementation.

name: The University Degrees (Duration of Courses) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: University Degrees (Duration of Courses) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the duration of courses for specific degrees at universities in Pakistan, setting the period to three years starting from the 1960-61 academic session. It mandates that university examinations for these degrees be held at the end of each of the three years and requires universities to amend their statutes accordingly.

name: The Karachi Municipal Committee (General) Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Karachi Municipal Committee (General) Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960 to regulate the Karachi Municipal Committee. They establish procedures for declarations of urban areas, assumption of office, oaths of office, and the election of a Vice-Chairman.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 26

metadata.title: CMLA Order No. 26
metadata.summary: This order amends CMLA Order No. 21 with effect from September 24, 1960. It deletes the entry relating to the Administrator of Karachi under the board membership and substitutes 'Martial Law Administrator, Zone A' with 'Administrator, Karachi' in specific paragraphs.

name: The Coal Mines (Fixation of Rates of Wages) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Coal Mines (Fixation of Rates of Wages) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the fixation of minimum wage rates for labor employed in coal mines and addresses related matters. It defines key terms such as 'coal mine', 'owner', and 'wages' within the context of this legislation.

name: The West Pakistan (University of Sind) Ordinance, 1961.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (University of Sind) Ordinance, 1961
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and reorganizes the University of Sind to improve teaching, research, and administration. It establishes the university's corporate body, including a Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and defines its powers regarding instruction, examinations, degrees, and property management.

name: The Expenditure (Authentications) Order, 1960

metadata.title: The Expenditure (Authentications) Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the President to authenticate further expenditure from federal revenues for financial years prior to April 1958. It extends similar powers to Governors regarding provincial revenues and applies immediately upon promulgation.

name: The Gwadur (Application of Central Laws) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Gwadur (Application of Central Laws) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance applies all Central laws in force in the Mekran District to the territory of Gwadur, which was ceded to Pakistan on September 8, 1958. It ensures that these laws extend to Gwadur while preserving rights and liabilities accrued under previous local laws prior to the Ordinance's commencement.

name: The Cooperative Societies (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the repayment of unsecured or insufficiently secured loans taken from Cooperative Banks and other Cooperative Societies. It mandates specific timelines for repaying such loans and securing them with appropriate property, while establishing the Registrar's powers to determine liability and conduct inquiries.

name: The Tea (Registration of Dealers) Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Tea (Registration of Dealers) Rules, 1960
metadata.repeals: Notification No. S. R. O. 890 (K), dated the 27th July, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for registering dealers in tea under the Tea (Control of Prices, Distribution and Movement) Ordinance, 1960. They specify application forms, registration fees based on dealer type, and requirements for maintaining registers and issuing certificates.

name: The Seat of Government Order, 1960

metadata.title: The Seat of Government Order, 1960
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan (Establishment of the Federal Capital) Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order designates Rawalpindi as the principal seat of Government of Pakistan and establishes Karachi as the Federal Territory. It vests executive functions in the Federal Territory with an appointed Agent while repealing previous orders regarding the federal capital.

name: The Pakistan Mining Concession Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Pakistan Mining Concession Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules supersede the Pakistan Mining Concession Rules, 1949, and establish the framework for granting prospecting licences and mining leases in Pakistan. They define key terms such as 'Collector' and 'lessee', outline application procedures including required fees, and specify that existing licences granted under previous rules shall continue to be treated as valid under these new provisions.

name: The Civil Aviation Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: Civil Aviation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control of aircraft manufacture, possession, use, operation, sale, import, and export in Pakistan. It also regulates air transport services and oversees the control and development of aerodromes.

name: The Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Act Declaration Order, 1960

metadata.title: The Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Act Declaration Order, 1960
metadata.amends: The Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Order declares that actions taken under the Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Act, 1949 are valid despite the lack of Governor-General assent. It further states that no legal proceedings shall lie against any person acting in good faith under the said Act.

name: The West Pakistan Money-Lenders Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Money-lenders Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to money-lenders, their registration, and the regulation of their accounts in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes provisions for licensing, account keeping, interest computation, and penalties for various offenses related to money-lending activities.

name: The Karachi Municipal Committee Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Karachi Municipal Committee Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for elections to the Municipal Committee of Karachi under the Basic Democracies Order, 1959. They define key terms, outline the appointment of presiding officers, and detail the procedures for proposing candidates, conducting polls by ballot, and declaring results.

name: The Judiciary (Karachi and West Pakistan) Order, 1960

metadata.title: The Judiciary (Karachi and West Pakistan) Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the membership of the Provincial Judicial Service for West Pakistan and transfers personnel serving in the Court of the District and Sessions Judge at Karachi. It also outlines provisions regarding appointments, administrative expenses charged to the Federal Consolidated Fund, and the transfer of judges from East Pakistan to West Pakistan.

name: The Tea (Control of Prices, Distribution and Movement) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Tea (Control of Prices, Distribution and Movement) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides special measures for the control of prices, distribution, and movement of tea within Pakistan. It establishes a registration system for dealers, bans speculative forward transactions, and restricts stock holdings to approved dealers.

name: The Natural Gas Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Natural Gas Rules, 1960
metadata.amends: The Regulation of Mines and Oilfields and Mineral Development (Federal Control) Act, 1948
metadata.repeals: Ministry of Works, Irrigation and Power Notification No. P-8(70)|58, dated 7th July 1958
metadata.summary: These rules govern the transmission, distribution, and uses of natural gas in Pakistan. They define key terms related to gas supply areas, authorities, and infrastructure, and establish the framework for obtaining licenses for gas transmission and distribution.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance and enhancement of certain taxes in West Pakistan. It establishes surcharges on land revenue and agricultural income-tax, increases stamp duties, and levies new taxes on cinemas, specific professions, and motor vehicles.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Finance Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: Finance Act, 1958; Post Office (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959; Tariff Act, 1934; Protective Duties Act, 1950; Central Excise and Salt Act, 1944; Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 1960. It continues certain duties and taxes from previous ordinances while amending several existing acts regarding customs, excise, income tax, and protective duties.

name: The Appropriation (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Appropriation (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund to cover government charges for the period starting July 1, 1959, and ending June 30, 1960. It details the authorized amounts for various ministries, departments, and capital outlays, totaling approximately forty-seven crores rupees.

name: The Appropriation Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Appropriation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund for the fiscal period beginning July 1, 1960, and ending June 30, 1961. It details the authorized charges for various government services, ministries, and purposes listed in the attached Schedule.

name: The Local Councils (Federal Capital) Assumption of Office and Election of Chairman Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Local Councils (Federal Capital) Assumption of Office and Election of Chairman Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules govern the assumption of office and election of chairmen for local councils in the Federal Capital. They define key terms, outline procedures for notifying member changes, convening meetings, administering oaths, and conducting elections or polls for the chairman position.

name: The Capital Development Authority Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Capital Development Authority Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Capital Development Authority to manage arrangements for the planning and development of Islamabad. It defines key terms such as 'Authority', 'Board', and 'Capital Site', and outlines the constitution and management structure of the new body.

name: The Pakistan Capital Regulation, 1960

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 82
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Regulation establishes restrictions on building construction, land conversion, and tree cutting within the Capital Site and surrounding areas. It empowers a Commission to issue directions regarding these activities and outlines procedures for appeals against local authority orders.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 81

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 81
metadata.summary: This regulation withdraws high denomination Pakistan currency notes (500 and 100 rupees) from circulation due to illegal removal from treasuries. It mandates the surrender of these specific notes by holders to government officials or banks by specified dates in June 1971.

name: The Rulers (Recognition of Successors) Order, 1960

metadata.title: The Rulers (Recognition of Successors) Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This Order clarifies the legal definition of a Ruler in states acceding to Pakistan by referencing successors recognized by the President. It applies to recognition granted after August 14, 1947, and existing as of March 22, 1956, amending the interpretation of the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1958.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 80

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 80
metadata.summary: This regulation reconstitutes Martial Law Regulation No. 29 to address strikes and lock-outs prohibited under the Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1959. It mandates that such industrial actions shall be punishable under this specific regulation with a maximum penalty of two years.

name: The Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.repeals: certain Central Acts and Ordinances specified in the First Schedule; certain laws in force in Acceding States before their incorporation into West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to reform the Central Statute-book by repealing obsolete Acts and Ordinances. It also extends certain Central laws to parts of West Pakistan that were formerly separate provinces or acceding states, while ensuring no retrospective creation of offences.

name: The Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: Industrial and Commercial Employment (Standing Orders) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.repeals: Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946 with certain amendments. It regulates conditions of employment for workmen in industrial and commercial establishments employing fifty or more workers.

name: The International Development Association Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: International Development Association Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for Pakistan's participation in the International Development Association to give effect to an international agreement approved on January 26, 1960. It establishes financial provisions requiring payments from the Federal Consolidated Fund and designates the State Bank of Pakistan as the depository for currency holdings. The document also grants specific immunities, privileges, and legal status to the Association and its assets within Pakistan.

name: The West Pakistan Medical Practitioners’ Registration and Medical Council Ordinance, 1960.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Medical Practitioners' Registration and Medical Council Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law regarding the registration of medical practitioners and the constitution of a Medical Council in West Pakistan. It establishes the Medical Council as a corporate body with specific membership requirements, including nominated and elected members from registered practitioners and graduates.

name: The Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel Order, 1960

metadata.title: The Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the appointment of a Deputy Attorney-General and one or more Standing Counsel by the President. It defines their tenure, remuneration, eligibility requirements regarding judicial service, and grants them rights of audience in courts across Pakistan.

name: The Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel Rules, 1960

metadata.title: Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This order establishes the financial allowances and duties for the Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel in Pakistan. It outlines their right of audience, specific monthly retainers, restrictions on defending criminal cases or advising against the Central Government, and provisions for acting during absences.

name: The West Pakistan Excess Appropriation Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Excess Appropriation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the further payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund. It covers excess charges incurred for the service of the Punjab, Sind, and North-West Frontier provinces for financial years ranging from 1948-49 to 1954-55.

name: The Working Journalists (Wage Board) Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Working Journalists (Wage Board) Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Working Journalists Wage Board under the Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960. They define the Board's procedures regarding meetings, witness summonses, expense allowances, and the fixation of wage rates for various descriptions of working journalists.

name: The West Pakistan Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to amend and consolidate laws regarding the relief of indebtedness in West Pakistan. It defines specific categories of debtors, such as agricultural workers and artisans with limited assets, and restricts the recovery of debts to twice the actual amount advanced. The document also provides protections against arrest, attachment of essential housing, and sale of livestock necessary for agriculture.

name: The Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Working Journalists (Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the conditions of service for working journalists and other persons employed in newspaper establishments across Pakistan. It establishes definitions for key terms, mandates the creation of a Provident Fund administered by a Board of Trustees, and outlines rules regarding notice periods for terminating services.

name: The Press and Publications Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Press and Publications Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: law relating to press and publications
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws relating to press and publications in Pakistan. It establishes requirements for printing particulars, declarations by keepers of printing presses, and regulations regarding the publication of newspapers.

name: The West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Benevolent Fund to provide relief for Government servants and their families in West Pakistan. The fund is divided into two parts for gazetted and non-gazetted servants, with contributions deducted from salaries and utilized for financial assistance to deceased families, invalided servants, and exceptional cases.

name: The West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation to promote small-scale industries in handicrafts and consumer goods. It defines the corporation's constitution, capital structure with government majority shareholding, and the powers of its Board of Directors.

name: The Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to municipal administration in Pakistan. It establishes definitions for terms used within the Act, such as 'Municipal Committee', 'by-laws', and 'dwelling house', and outlines the extent of its application across the country.

name: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Intuitions Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Boards of Governors to manage and control government educational and training institutions in West Pakistan. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of these boards, including their authority over property, staff recruitment, and budget formulation.

name: The West Pakistan Special Tribunal Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Special Tribunal Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Special Tribunal in West Pakistan to try specific offences alleged to have been committed by Murad Mangrio and other outlaws. It outlines the composition of the tribunal, its powers regarding witnesses and trials, sentencing authority, and appeal procedures, while explicitly stating that its provisions override any inconsistent sections in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.

name: The West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: law relating to the preparation and sale of foods in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the laws regarding the preparation and sale of food in West Pakistan. It defines key terms related to food products and establishes general provisions prohibiting false warranties and the mixing or coloring of food.

name: The West Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: Pakistan Consolidation of Holdings Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the consolidation of holdings in estates and subdivisions to reduce the number of plots. It defines key terms such as 'holding', 'estate', and 'land-revenue' while establishing the roles of the Board of Revenue, Collector, and Consolidation Officer.

name: The Industrial Disputes (Central) Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Industrial Disputes (Central) Rules, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure and duties of conciliation officers and industrial courts under the Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1959.
