They cover matters such as conciliation proceedings, court sittings, evidence administration, and the disposal of business before the court.

name: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal framework for raising funds through a specific cess to support the repair, maintenance, and endowment of historically significant mosques in West Pakistan. It creates a dedicated fund under government control to manage these financial resources and outlines the procedures for collecting the tax from land revenue and urban immovable property taxes.

name: The Medical Qualifications (Information) Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Medical Qualifications (Information) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance mandates that specific medical and health personnel residing in Pakistan must furnish certain information to the Director-General of Health. The required data includes personal details, educational qualifications, professional history, and nationality for various categories of healthcare workers.

name: Amendments in the Registration of Claims (Displaced Persons) Rules, 1955

metadata.title: The Registration of Claims (Displaced Persons) Rules, 1955
metadata.amends: The Registration of Claims (Displaced Persons) Rules, 1955
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Registration of Claims (Displaced Persons) Rules, 1955 by adding a specific provision to Rule 3. The amendment allows applications made within February 15, 1960, for persons who applied under other schedules or laws not applicable to their claims.

name: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits smoking in cinema houses within the Province of West Pakistan. It defines specific terms such as 'cinema house' and outlines penalties, including fines up to one hundred rupees and arrest without warrant, for individuals who smoke during a performance or exhibition.

name: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in the Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits smoking in cinema houses within the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes penalties including fines and arrest without warrant for individuals who smoke during performances or exhibitions, while also empowering management to post notices regarding these restrictions.

name: The Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation to provide financial assistance for refugee rehabilitation. It defines the corporation's structure, share capital managed by the Central Government, and its management board.

name: The Government Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 1960

metadata.title: The Pakistan Civil Services (Discipline) Rules, 1958
metadata.summary: These Rules define terms such as authority, misconduct, and penalty within the context of Pakistan's civil services. They establish grounds for imposing penalties like censure, removal, or dismissal for inefficiency, misconduct, corruption, or subversion.

name: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance,1960

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws relating to the prohibition of opium smoking in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'opium' and 'place', establishes prohibitions on manufacturing, possessing, or smoking opium, and outlines various penalties for offenses including failing to give notice of suspected use.

name: LIEUT-GENERAL BAKHTIAR RANA, SQA, MC, MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR, ZONE B’.

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 54
metadata.summary: This order appoints Major-General Garfraz Khan as Sub-Administrator of Martial Law for Sector No. 2, Zone 'B'. The appointment takes effect from January 12, 1960, replacing Brigadier Hissam Mahmud-el-Effendi who relinquished charge on the same date.

name: The Presidential (Election and Constitution) Order, 1960

metadata.title: The Presidential (Election and Constitution) Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the election of the President and the making of a Constitution by the people of Pakistan. It establishes a process where local council members vote on their confidence in the President to determine his authority and eligibility for office during the transitional period.

name: The Distribution of Revenues (Ascertainment and Certification of Net Proceeds) Order, 1960

metadata.title: The Distribution of Revenues (Ascertainment and Certification of Net Proceeds) Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the procedure for ascertaining and certifying the net proceeds of taxes or duties leviable in specific areas. The certificate issued by the Comptroller and Auditor-General regarding these proceeds is declared to be final for the purposes of the Distribution of Revenues Order, 1953.

name: NA- The Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel order, 1960

metadata.title: The Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.amends: The Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel Order, 1960. It inserts specific wording regarding provincial representation in Article 2 and substitutes terms in Article 4 to reflect changes in office titles.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 3
metadata.summary: This regulation amends Martial Law Regulation No. 3 by adding an explanation regarding punishments under martial law. It specifies that courts may impose imprisonment or additional imprisonment in default of fine payment, and deems the fine liability discharged after such imprisonment is undergone.

name: The West Pakistan Rice (Restrictions on Cultivation) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Rice (Restrictions on Cultivation) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the cultivation of rice in the Province of West Pakistan to check water logging, salinity, and seepage. It empowers the Board of Revenue to impose restrictions on rice cultivation and establishes penalties for contravention.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 55-A

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 55-A
metadata.summary: This regulation amends Martial Law Regulation No. 55 to prohibit the organization, convening, or attendance of political meetings and processions. It includes a proviso allowing meetings related to elections for Basic Democracies under specific restrictions.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 22

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 22
metadata.summary: This order appoints Brigadier Muzaffar-ud-Din as the Martial Law Administrator for Zone 'A'. The appointment takes effect from December 1, 1959, replacing Brigadier S. M. Aslam.

name: The Power Alcohol Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Power Alcohol Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for matters connected with the development of the power alcohol industry under Federal control in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as power alcohol and petrol, restricts production to specific substances like molasses, and empowers the Central Government to make rules regarding licensing, pricing, testing, and excise duties.

name: The Basic Democracies (Federal Capital) Election Rules, 1959

metadata.title: The Basic Democracies (Federal Capital) Election Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Central Government under Article 89 of the Basic Democracies Order, 1959 to regulate elections in the Federal Capital. They establish preliminary provisions, define key terms such as 'Returning Officer' and 'Polling Station', and outline the organization and conduct of elections.

name: PNA- Amendments in the Fundamental Rules

metadata.title: The Fundamental Rules (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This notification directs the President to make further amendments to the Fundamental Rules. Specifically, it renumbers an existing item regarding Record Sorters and adds a new item for the Selection Grade of Stenographers in the Central Secretariat.

name: The Displaced Persons (Scale of Compensation) Rules, 1959

metadata.title: The Displaced Persons (Scale of Compensation) Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the scale of compensation payable to claimants from a designated compensation pool. It specifies percentage rates for verified claims up to a maximum total compensation of three lakhs rupees.

name: The CANTONMENTS (FEDERAL AREA) ELECTORAL RULES, 1959

metadata.title: The Cantonments (Federal Area) Electoral Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules govern elections to Union Committees in the Cantonments of Karachi, Malir, Drigh Road, and Manora. They apply mutatis mutandis the election rules framed for the Federal Area other than Cantonments under the Basic Democracies Order, 1959.

name: The CANTONMENTS (PROVINCES) ELECTORAL RULES, 1959

metadata.title: The Cantonments (Provinces) Electoral Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for holding elections to Union Committees in Cantonments located in West and East Pakistan. They authorize the respective provincial governments to conduct these elections under specific articles of the Basic Democracies Order, 1959, applying existing electoral rules mutatis mutandis.

name: The West Pakistan Wild Life Protection Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Wild Life Protection Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the protection of wild life in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes a framework for issuing licences, permits, and special permits required for dealing with, capturing, or possessing specific wild birds and animals.

name: The West Pakistan Determination of Land Revenue and Water Rate Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Determination of Land Revenue and Water Rate Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the separation of land revenue from water rate in areas where a composite charge is imposed. It also establishes provisions for the re-assessment of these rates and empowers the Government to issue notifications and make rules to carry out its purposes.

name: The Basic Democracies Order, 1959

metadata.title: The Basic Democracies Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the framework for Basic Democracies and local self-government in Pakistan. It provides for the constitution, composition, functions, and administration of various local councils including Union, District, and Divisional Councils.

name: The Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Industrial Disputes Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 with certain amendments. It provides for the investigation and settlement of industrial disputes and matters connected therewith throughout Pakistan.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 21

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 24
metadata.summary: This order establishes a Board to manage the property and affairs of an Anjuman under the supervision of the Martial Law Administrator of Zone 'A'. The Board is tasked with securing the organization's purposes, managing its assets, and framing bye-laws pending new regulations. It mandates the surrender of all Anjuman property to the Board and prohibits any obstruction of its functions, with penalties for non-compliance under Martial Law Regulation No. 16.

name: The North-West Frontier Province Sugarcane (Additional Land Revenue)(West Pakistan Repeal) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province Sugar-cane (Additional Land Revenue) (West Pakistan Repeal) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Sugar-cane (Additional Land Revenue) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to repeal the North-West Frontier Province Sugar-cane (Additional Land Revenue) Act, 1948. The repeal is deemed to have taken effect on October 11, 1955.

name: The West Pakistan Nursing Services Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Nursing Services Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the registration and training of nurses, health visitors, midwives, and dais in West Pakistan. It establishes the Nursing Services Council and outlines the constitution, appointment of office-bearers, and powers of the Council.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 75

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 75
metadata.summary: This document is a Martial Law Regulation issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator of Pakistan. It amends paragraph (1), sub-paragraph (4), clause (a) of Martial Law Regulation No. 1 to designate Lt. General Tikka Khan as the commander for Zone B.

name: PNA- Amendments in Pakistan Post Office Rules, 1955

metadata.title: Pakistan Post Office Rules, 1955
metadata.summary: This notification directs amendments to the Pakistan Post Office Rules, 1955, specifically updating postage rates for various categories of mail. It establishes new charges for letters, postcards, registered newspapers, books, and other printed materials sent to different parts of the world.

name: The Elective Bodies (Disqualification) ) Rules, 1959

metadata.title: The Elective Bodies (Disqualification) Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules amend the Elective Bodies (Disqualification) Rules, 1939, to establish procedures for a Tribunal regarding misconduct by respondents. The document outlines the Tribunal's powers, including holding proceedings at specified places, appointing assistants, and managing evidence without recording formal charges.

name: The Submission of Appropriation Accounts and Audit Reports (Pre-West Pakistan) Order, 1959

metadata.title: The Submission of Appropriation Accounts and Audit Reports (Pre-West Pakistan) Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order directs the Comptroller and Auditor-General not to submit Appropriation Accounts and Audit Reports for a specific period in the then-provinces of Punjab, North-West Frontier, and Sind. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan on September 19, 1959.

name: The Pakistan Military Academy (Degrees and Certificates) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Pakistan Military Academy (Degrees and Certificates) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the Pakistan Military Academy at Kakul to confer degrees and grant certificates. It defines the specific academic courses eligible for degree awards (Arts and Science) and certificate awards (Intermediate in Arts and Science).

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 74

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 73
metadata.summary: This regulation appoints Lieutenant Generals as Deputy Administrators of Martial Law for specific zones in Pakistan. It grants them the authority to exercise powers previously assigned to the Governor of East Pakistan under existing laws.

name: The Punjab Land Preservation (West Pakistan Extension to Dera Ghazi Khan Excluded Area) Regulation, 1959

metadata.title: The Punjab Land Preservation (West Pakistan Extension to Dera Ghazi Khan Excluded Area) Regulation, 1959
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the provisions of the Punjab Land Preservation Act, 1900 to the Dera Ghazi Khan Excluded Area in West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on September 12, 1959, pursuant to a Presidential Proclamation from October 7, 1958.

name: The Claims for Maintenance (Recovery Abroad) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Claims for Maintenance (Recovery Abroad) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the United Nations Convention on the Recovery Abroad of Maintenance in Pakistan. It grants the provisions of the Convention the force of law and empowers the Central Government to make rules and amend the Schedule as necessary.

name: The West Pakistan Contempt of Courts (Repeal) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: West Pakistan Contempt of Courts (Repeal) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Contempt of Courts Act, 1938; Khairpur State Contempt of Courts Act, 1950; Contempt of Courts (Sind Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal three specific enactments regarding contempt of courts. It came into force on a date appointed by government notification.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 20

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 20
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Brigadier S. M. Aslam as the Martial Law Administrator for Zone 'A'. The appointment takes effect from September 1, 1959, replacing Major General Malik Haq Nawaz.

name: The Rawalpindi (Requisition of Property) Rules, 1959

metadata.title: The Rawalpindi (Requisition of Property) Rules, 1959
metadata.repeals: Ministry of Works, Irrigation and Power Notification No. W. 32(20)/59
metadata.summary: These rules specify areas within Rawalpindi for property requisition under Martial Law Regulation No. 71 and supersede a previous notification from August 18, 1959. They establish the framework for calculating compensation based on rent, handling building repairs, and apportioning costs among interested parties.

name: The Railway Board Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: Railway Board Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of a Railway Board to administer railways in Pakistan. It invests the Board with specific powers and functions previously held by the Central Government under the Railways Act, 1890.

name: The Pensions and Provident Funds (Payment in Rupees) Order, 1959

metadata.title: The Pensions and Provident Funds (Payment in Rupees) Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order mandates that pension and provident fund dues for specific government officials domiciled in Pakistan must be paid only in Pakistani rupees. It establishes an exchange rate of one shilling and six pence to the rupee for conversions, unless a different rate is specified in the terms of service.

name: The Displaced Persons (Land Settlement) Rules, 1959

metadata.title: The Displaced Persons (Land Settlement) Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Displaced Persons (Land Settlement) Act, 1958 to regulate procedures for ejectment and compensation pools. They also establish conditions for permanent land settlements, including requirements regarding mortgages and protection of non-evacuee rights.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 73

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 73
metadata.summary: This regulation appoints specific Lieutenant Generals as Chief Martial Law Administrators for Zones C, D, E, and F. It also designates Major Generals as Deputy Administrators of Martial Law for the respective zones.

name: The Tea Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Tea Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to expand tea exports and establish bodies for new or rehabilitated tea gardens. It also authorizes the levying of a cess on tea produced in Pakistan.

name: The Elective Bodies (Disqualification) Order, 1959

metadata.title: The Elective Bodies (Disqualification) Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order establishes Tribunals in West Pakistan and East Pakistan to inquire into cases of misconduct by persons holding office or membership in elective bodies. It defines specific grounds for disqualification, including corruption, bribery, and activities contributing to political instability, and sets the duration of these disqualifications.

name: The Rawalpindi (Requisition of Property) Regulation, 1959

metadata.title: The Rawalpindi (Requisition of Property) Regulation, 1959
metadata.summary: This Regulation empowers the Central Government to requisition buildings within the municipal limits of Rawalpindi during martial law. It establishes restrictions on leasing properties in specified areas and outlines the process for determining compensation for owners whose buildings are requisitioned.

name: The [West Pakistan] Excise Regulation (Extension) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Excise Regulation (Extension) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Excise Regulation of 1915 to the districts of Kalat, Kharan, Lasbela, and Mekran. It was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan on August 3, 1959, pursuant to a Presidential Proclamation from October 7, 1958.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 72

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 72
metadata.summary: This document amends Martial Law Regulation No. 58 by modifying paragraph 7, sub-paragraph (a). The amendment inserts specific conditions regarding the Chief Martial Law Administrator's direction and omits a time limit related to suspension or dismissal from service.

name: The Pakistan Boy Scouts Association Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: Pakistan Boy Scouts Association Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance incorporates the Pakistan Boy Scouts Association as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Association exclusive rights to use specific titles, emblems, uniforms, and badges, while establishing rules for its constitution and functions.

name: The Public Conduct (Public Statutory Corporations) (Scrutiny) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Public Conduct (Public Statutory Corporations) (Scrutiny) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for specific penalties regarding persons holding employment or office in public statutory corporations. It ensures that individuals whose conduct has been scrutinized by a committee cannot be suspended, dismissed, or retired due to corruption, misconduct, inefficiency, or reputation of being corrupt.

name: The Police (West Pakistan and the Federal Capital) Order, 1959

metadata.title: The Police (West Pakistan and the Federal Capital) Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the appropriate Government to direct members of the West Pakistan Police and Karachi Police (not below Assistant Sub-Inspector) to serve in any place within West Pakistan or the Federal Capital. It defines 'appropriate Government' as the Central Government for Karachi Police and the Government of West Pakistan for West Pakistan Police.

name: The West Pakistan Discontinuance of Sind Mosque and Hostels Fund Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Discontinuance of Sind Mosque and Hostels Fund Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Sind Mosque and Hostels Fund Cess Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the discontinuance of the Sind Mosque and Hostels Fund, which was established under the Sind Mosque and Hostels Fund Cess Act, 1951. It also repeals the aforementioned 1951 Act and directs that any remaining balance in the fund be utilized for repairing and maintaining historically significant mosques in the former Province of Sind.

name: The West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to restrict the number of goats in the Province of West Pakistan for public interest. It grants the Government powers to regulate grazing, movement, and slaughter of goats through notifications and rules, while establishing penalties for contravention.

name: The Rules Under Martial Law Regulation No. 42

metadata.title: Rules Under Martial Law Regulation No. 42
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under Martial Law Regulation No. 42 to regulate controlled articles in Pakistan. They define key terms such as 'controlled article', 'dealer', and 'producer', and grant powers to search, inspect, and seize goods to ensure compliance with the regulation.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuation and enhancement of certain taxes in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes surcharges on land revenue and agricultural income-tax, increases stamp duties, and levies new taxes on cinemas, betting, and specific professions.

name: The Appropriation Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Appropriation Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund for the fiscal period beginning July 1, 1959, and ending June 30, 1960. It details the authorized amounts for various government services, departments, and capital outlays across multiple ministries.

name: The Appropriation (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Appropriation (Supplementary) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund. It covers expenses for services and purposes ranging from April 1, 1958, to June 30, 1959.

name: The Finance (No. 2) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: Finance (No. 2) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 1959. It contains provisions relating to various taxes including customs, excise, income-tax, super-tax, sales tax, and betting tax.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 19

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 19
metadata.summary: This order provides instructions for the custody and disposal of property in cases pending trial under martial law. It outlines procedures for sending orders to magistrates, handling unclaimed property after six months, and allows courts to deliver property to claimants who execute a bond.

name: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the control of disorderly persons commonly known as goondas in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes Tribunals consisting of District Magistrates or empowered Magistrates to conduct inquiries, issue summonses or warrants, and declare individuals as goondas based on specific practices and allegations.

name: The West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Survey and Rectangulation of Lands Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the survey and rectangulation of lands in the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers the Board of Revenue to direct these operations while ensuring that land holdings are not reduced as much as possible, outlines the assessment and recovery of costs from affected persons, and grants legal immunity to public servants acting in good faith under its provisions.

name: PNA- Amenmdnets in the Post Office Annuities Rules, 1957

metadata.title: Post Office Annuities Rules, 1957
metadata.summary: This notification directs the Central Government to make further amendments to the Post Office Annuities Rules, 1957. The changes include substituting specific tables, adding provisions regarding payments to minor annuitants, updating interest rates, and introducing a new rule for transferring annuities upon the death of the annuitant.

name: The West Pakistan Highways Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Highways Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to highways in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes Highway Authorities, defines their powers regarding construction and maintenance, regulates traffic and vehicles, and outlines procedures for penalties and land acquisition.

name: The State Arrangements Order, 1959

metadata.title: The State Arrangements Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the discharge of the duties of the office of President in cases of vacancy, absence, or incapacity. It establishes a Succession Council composed of Ministers, Governors, and Military Commanders to exercise presidential functions until a new President is elected or the incumbent resumes duty.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 18

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 18
metadata.repeals: CMLA Order No. 11-A
metadata.summary: This order appoints the Commanders in Chief of the Pakistan Army, Navy, and Air Force as Deputy Chief Martial Law Administrators. It partially modifies CMLA Order No. 11 and cancels CMLA Order No. 11-A.

name: The Public Offices (Disqualification) Rules, 1959

metadata.title: The Public Offices (Disqualification) Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These Rules establish the framework for making referring orders regarding misconduct by public office holders under the Public Offices (Disqualification) Order, 1959. They outline the requirements for applications, including affidavits and evidence lists, and define the powers and procedures of the Tribunal conducting the enquiry.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 17

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 17
metadata.repeals: Anti-Hoarding (Foodgrains) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This document is a Martial Law Order issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator, General Mohammad Ayub Khan. It officially repeals the Anti-Hoarding (Foodgrains) Order, 1958, which was originally promulgated on October 11, 1958.

name: The West Pakistan Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Pests Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to the eradication of agricultural pests in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'agricultural pest' and 'infested crop', grants the Government powers to prohibit cultivation methods or transport of infested crops, and establishes the role of Inspectors to enforce preventive measures.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 70

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 70
metadata.summary: This regulation empowers the Custodian of Enemy Property to seize and manage assets belonging to enemies, enemy firms, or enemy subjects. It outlines procedures for taking possession of property, selling it via auction, and attaching assets to cover debts due to the custodian.

name: The Pensionary Options Order, 1959

metadata.title: The Pensionary Options Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order is made by the President of Pakistan in pursuance of the Proclamation of October 7, 1958. It clarifies references to pension regarding High Court Judges and addresses situations where judges chose positions before this Order came into force.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 68

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation
metadata.summary: This notification empowers Martial Law Authorities to declare individuals who fail to report for investigation or intentionally stay abroad as absconders. It further directs these authorities to order such persons to appear within a specified period and allows for trials in absentia regarding offences under this regulation.

name: The Frontier Corps Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Frontier Corps Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: law relating to the regulation of the Frontier Corps Units operating in West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law regarding the regulation of Frontier Corps Units operating in West Pakistan. It defines key terms, establishes the powers to maintain the corps, outlines its constitution, and details the appointment and authority of superior officers.

name: The West Pakistan Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the registration of companies in West Pakistan that carry on business for certain undesirable purposes. It also provides legal mechanisms for the winding up and dissolution of such companies once they are identified.

name: The Karachi Road Transport Corporation Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: Karachi Road Transport Corporation Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Karachi Road Transport Corporation to operate road transport services in the Federal Capital. It defines the corporation's legal status, authorized share capital, and the composition and terms of its Board of Directors.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 64-A

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Land Reforms Regulation (Martial Law Regulation No. 64)
metadata.summary: This notification amends the West Pakistan Land Reforms Regulation (Martial Law Regulation No. 64) by substituting specific definitions and adding new provisos regarding economic and subsistence holdings. It also modifies thresholds for irrigated land areas and adds provisions concerning jointly owned evacuee holdings and land required for building purposes.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 69

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This notification amends Martial Law Regulation No. 42 by modifying paragraph 5 regarding stock fixation and altering paragraphs 10 and 11 concerning stock registers and transaction records. The amendments were issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator of Pakistan on April 8, 1959.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 67

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This notification requires factory occupiers to submit detailed information regarding their establishments, production capacity, and material consumption by May 1, 1959. The regulation mandates the submission of specific forms to designated survey officers in Karachi, Lahore, and Dhaka for factories falling under the Factories Act, 1934.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 16

metadata.title: Martial Law Orders
metadata.repeals: CMLA Order No. 6, dated 11th October 1958
metadata.summary: This order specifies that the jail classification for prisoners convicted under Martial Law Regulations is determined solely by the convicting court or confirming authority. It also cancels CMLA Order No. 6 dated October 11, 1958.

name: The West Pakistan Usurious Loans Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Usurious Loans Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to usurious loans in the Province of West Pakistan. It empowers courts to re-open unfair transactions, relieve debtors of excessive interest liability, and revise securities where interest exceeds reasonable limits or bank rates.

name: The Unani, Ayurvedic and Homeopathic Practitioners (Repeal) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners (Repeal) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan to repeal the Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1957. It came into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Appropriation (Transitional Provisions) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Appropriation (Transitional Provisions) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund. It covers the service period beginning April 1, 1959, and ending June 30, 1959.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Finance Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The Finance Act, 1958; The Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the financial proposals of the Central Government for the period beginning April 1, 1959. It continues certain duties and taxes from the Finance Act, 1958, and amends the Income-tax Act, 1922 to adjust rates and definitions for the new fiscal year.

name: The Control of Shipping Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Control of Shipping Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Control of Shipping Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the provisions of the Control of Shipping Act, 1947 with certain amendments to provide for more effective control of shipping. It establishes a licensing system for ships registered in Pakistan or owned/chartered by citizens/companies to take to sea or engage in coasting trade, while defining terms such as 'owner', 'ship', and 'Shipping Authority'.

name: The West Pakistan Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Juvenile Smoking Act, 1918; The Punjab Juvenile Smoking Act applicable to the former state of Baluchistan; The North-West Frontier Province Juvenile Smoking Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the prevention of tobacco smoking by juveniles in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'juvenile' and 'public place', establishes fines for selling tobacco to minors, and authorizes the seizure of tobacco found with smoking juveniles.

name: The West Pakistan Hindu Women's Rights to Agricultural Land Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Hindu Women's Rights to Agricultural Land Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The North-West Frontier Province Hindu Women's Rights to Property (Extension to Agricultural Land) Act, 1942; The Hindu Women's Rights to Property (Extension to Agricultural Land) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the Hindu Law governing women's rights to agricultural land in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes specific inheritance shares for widows when a Hindu dies intestate regarding agricultural land and defines the nature of the interest devolving on them.

name: The Public Offices (Disqualification) Order, 1959

metadata.title: The Public Offices (Disqualification) Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a Tribunal to investigate misconduct in public offices held on or after August 15, 1947. It defines misconduct broadly to include bribery, corruption, and abuse of official power, and stipulates that persons found guilty shall be disqualified from holding public office.

name: The West Pakistan Agricultural Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Bank (Recovery of Dues) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides facilities to the Agricultural Bank for recovering its dues. It empowers agriculturists and co-operative societies to pledge or mortgage property to secure loans from the Bank.

name: The Legislative Powers Order, 1959

metadata.title: The Legislative Powers Order, 1959
metadata.summary: This Order grants the President of Pakistan exclusive power to make laws regarding matters listed in the Schedule. It came into force immediately after the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order took effect.

name: The Census Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Census Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the periodic taking of a census in Pakistan and the collection of specific information regarding its population. It establishes the roles of Census Officers, outlines procedures for data collection assistance, and defines legal obligations for individuals to cooperate with the census process.

name: The West Pakistan Land Reforms Regulation

metadata.title: West Pakistan Land Reforms Regulation
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes the West Pakistan Land Commission and defines its powers to implement land reform measures across West Pakistan. It provides specific definitions for terms such as 'economic holding', 'subsistence holding', and 'jagir' while setting different standards for Quetta and Kalat Divisions.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 65

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This document contains Martial Law Regulations issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator of Pakistan on February 28, 1959. It mandates that individuals reporting offenses such as bribery, smuggling, or hoarding must inform the nearest police station and outlines penalties for those who fail to do so.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 54

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This notification amends Martial Law Regulation No. 54 dated December 4, 1958. The amendment changes the specified days in paragraphs (a) and (b) of the original regulation to alter the schedule for martial law administration.

name: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance restricts the increase of rent for certain premises within urban areas in West Pakistan and limits the eviction of tenants. It defines terms such as 'building', 'rented land', and 'urban area' to clarify its scope, which excludes evacuee properties and tribal areas.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION no. 41

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 41
metadata.summary: This regulation reconstitutes Martial Law Regulation No. 41 to restrict the sale, purchase, or dealing in import permits and licences outside of the Export Bonus Scheme. It prohibits using imported goods for purposes other than those specified in the licence without written permission from the Central Government.

name: The West Pakistan Sind Acts (Extension to Khairpur District) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The Sind Acts (Extension to Khairpur District) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: The Khairpur State Savings Act of 1947; The Notice to Police of Suspicious Characters Act, 1898; The Khairpur Tonga Act, 1905; The Khairpur Bullock Cart Act, 1929; The Khairpur State Irrigation Act, 1923; The Khairpur State Courts Act, 1941; The Khairpur State Primary Education Act, 1945; The Khairpur State Municipal Act, 1947; The Khairpur State Small Towns Act, 1947; The Hurs Control Act, 1947; The Khairpur Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1953; The Khairpur Essential Articles (Control of Price Movement and Anti-hoarding) Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends specific Sind Acts and associated rules to the Khairpur district. It simultaneously repeals corresponding local Khairpur Acts, including those related to municipal administration, education, and public order.

name: The Displaced Persons (Application for Compensation) Rules, 1959

metadata.title: The Displaced Persons (Application for Compensation) Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for claimants to submit applications for compensation books under the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958. They define key terms such as 'Act', 'Form', and 'Authority', and outline requirements for submitting claims, retaining property, and maintaining records of compensation entries.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 61

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This notification reconstitutes Martial Law Regulation No. 61 (as amended by No. 63) regarding the trial of offences under martial law in Pakistan. It establishes procedures for trials by magistrates and special military courts, bars appeals from their sentences, outlines revision processes, and specifies confirmation requirements for death sentences.

name: The Recruitment Rules for Civilian Gazetted Posts (Class I and Class II), in the Pakistan Army, 1959

metadata.title: Recruitment Rules for Civilian Gazetted Posts (Class I and Class II), in the Pakistan Army
metadata.summary: This document publishes recruitment rules for civilian gazetted posts in the Pakistan Army, covering Class I and Class II. It establishes methods for recruitment through direct appointment and promotion, defines the composition of relevant boards and committees, and outlines application procedures including fees.

name: The West Pakistan Land Dispositions (Saving of Shamilat) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: West Pakistan Land Dispositions (Saving of Shamilat) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.repeals: Punjab Land Dispositions (Saving Shamilat) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for a uniform preamble regarding the definition and treatment of 'Shamilat' land in West Pakistan. It stipulates that general words in land dispositions do not include Shamilat unless specifically mentioned, while preserving prior court decisions.

name: The Government Servants (Discipline and Efficiency) Rules, 1959

metadata.title: The Government Servants (Discipline and Efficiency) Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules apply to all government servants who are members of an All-Pakistan Service or serving in connection with the affairs of the Federation. They establish procedures for removing or compulsorily retiring officials engaged in subversive activities, corruption, misconduct, or inefficiency.

name: The Public Conduct (Scrutiny) Rules, 1959

metadata.title: Public Conduct (Scrutiny) Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for a Committee to investigate allegations of corruption, inefficiency, or unbecoming conduct against government servants. The document outlines the process for summoning explanations, recording findings, and submitting recommendations for punishment to the appointing authority.

name: The Public Conduct (Scrutiny) Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: Public Conduct (Scrutiny) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the constitution, powers, and procedure for Committees appointed to scrutinize the conduct of specific persons. It grants these Committees powers equivalent to a civil court, including the ability to summon witnesses, seize documents, and order police investigations.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 52

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This regulation re-constitutes Martial Law Regulation No. 52 to restrict the sale of specific medicines for oral and parenteral use without a prescription from registered medical practitioners, veterinarians, or dentists. It lists prohibited drugs including antibiotics, hormones, and insulin, while exempting sales to approved institutions or small quantities.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 63

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This regulation prescribes punishment for public servants who obtain valuable things or pecuniary advantages through corrupt or illegal means. It establishes that possession of disproportionate property without a satisfactory account creates a presumption of corruption.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 62

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This regulation prescribes severe penalties for public servants who obtain valuable things or pecuniary advantages through corrupt or illegal means. It establishes that possession of disproportionate property without a satisfactory account allows courts to presume the property was acquired via corruption.

name: The Registration of Private Schools (Federal Capital) Rules, 1959

metadata.title: The Registration of Private Schools (Federal Capital) Rules, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedures for registering private schools in the Federal Capital of Pakistan. They establish specific registration fees, required application forms, and conditions that registered schools must follow regarding inspection, working hours, and approved textbooks.

name: NA- The West Pakistan Wagf Properties Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties (Amendment) Ordinance, 1960
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1959, to update terminology from 'Administrator' to 'Chief Administrator' and expand administrative powers. It introduces new sections regarding the recovery of unpaid rent as land-revenue arrears and grants the Chief Administrator authority to issue binding instructions for the management of waqf properties.

name: The Displaced Persons (Land Settlement) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Displaced Persons (Land Settlement) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the settlement of displaced persons on land and compensation for losses suffered due to expropriation by the Government of India. It defines key terms such as 'displaced person', 'land', and various authorities involved in the rehabilitation process.

name: The Medical Practitioners (National Service) (Repeal) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Medical Practitioners (National Service) (Repeal) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Medical Practitioners (National Service) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Medical Practitioners (National Service) Act, 1950. It was enacted to expedite the removal of the previous legislation.

name: The Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) (Repeal) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) (Repeal) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) Ordinance, 1949 and The Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) Ordinance, 1949 and the Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1958. It was enacted on September 19, 1958, and came into force immediately.

name: The Electoral Disqualification (Declaration) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Electoral Disqualification (Declaration) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act declares that the holders of the offices of Public Prosecutor and Government Pleader are not subject to specific disqualifications under the Fourth Schedule to the Constitution. It was enacted on September 19, 1958, and received assent from the President.

name: The Sind Legislative Assembly (Abatement of Election Petitions) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Sind Legislative Assembly (Abatement of Election Petitions) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act abates all pending election petitions presented under the Sind Legislative Assembly Electoral (Elections and Election Petitions) Rules, 1952. The legislation was enacted because the Sind Legislative Assembly ceased to exist upon the commencement of the Establishment of West Pakistan Act, 1955, rendering further proceedings on these petitions infructuous.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 61

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This regulation outlines the procedures for trying offences under Martial Law Regulations by Magistrates and Military Courts. It establishes specific bars on appeals from sentences imposed in these cases and details the process for applying for revisions to those sentences.

name: The Control of Orphanages (Federal Capital) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: Control of Orphanages (Federal Capital) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the maintenance and control of orphanages located in the Federal Capital. It establishes a licensing system managed by the District Magistrate, mandates medical examinations for admitted children, and outlines regulations regarding admission, discharge, and inspection procedures.

name: The West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the employment of women in factories within the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes rights for female workers regarding maternity benefits, including paid leave and specific conditions for claiming such benefits.

name: The Prevention of Corruption Act (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption Act (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur Prevention of Corruption Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 to the whole of West Pakistan. It also repeals the Bahawalpur Prevention of Corruption Act, 1950.

name: The Prevention of Corruption Act ( West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption Act (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur Prevention of Corruption Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 to the entire Province of West Pakistan. It also amends references within that Act regarding specific districts by pointing to local codes like Tazirat-e-Qalat and Zabata-e-Faujdari Qalat.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 11

metadata.title: Notification No. 1233/58
metadata.summary: This notification appoints General Mohammad Musa, Vice Admiral H. M. Siddiq Choudhri, and Air Vice Marshal M. Asghar Khan as Deputy Chief Martial Law Administrators. Additionally, it appoints Mr. Aziz Ahmad to the same position with effect from October 1958.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 14

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 14
metadata.summary: This order mandates the restoration of abducted or kidnapped women and children to their respective guardians by January 15, 1959. It applies specifically to cases falling under Sections 366 and 363 of the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 42

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This regulation reconstitutes Martial Law Regulation No. 42 to establish Central Government control over the prices of imported goods, domestically manufactured goods, and selected food-grains. It mandates that dealers maintain stock registers, display price lists, and issue cash memos for transactions involving specific categories of goods.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 42

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 42
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Regulation empowers the Central Government to control prices of imported goods, domestically manufactured items, and selected food grains. It establishes specific maximum retail price margins for different categories of goods and defines offenses related to hoarding and black marketing.

name: The West Pakistan Restrictions on Slaughter of Useful Animals (Repeal) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Restrictions on Slaughter of Useful Animals (Repeal) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Conservation (Restrictions on Slaughter) of Useful Animals Act, 1948; The Behawalpur State Conservation (Restriction on Sale and Export) of Cattle Act, 1948; The Sui Cattle (Restriction of Slaughter) Act, 1948; The Punjab Conservation of Cattle (Meat) Act, 1948; The Kharar State Cattle (Restriction of Slaughter) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal existing laws regarding livestock conservation and slaughter restrictions in the province. It was issued under Martial Law Regulation No. 54 and extends to the whole of West Pakistan, excluding the Federal Capital and Special Areas.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 50-60

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This document contains a series of regulations issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator to enforce strict control over public life, including restrictions on literature, medicine sales, and loudspeakers. It also establishes meatless days, bans on political meetings, and penalties for violating currency laws or engaging in strikes.

name: The Registration of Private Schools (Federal Capital) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: Registration of Private Schools (Federal Capital) Ordinance
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration of certain private schools located in the Federal Capital. It establishes the Director of Education, Karachi as the authority responsible for granting certificates and registering these schools after necessary enquiries.

name: The Martial Law (Recovery of Unauthorised Evacuee Property) Regulation

metadata.title: The Martial Law (Recovery of Unauthorised Evacuee Property) Regulation
metadata.summary: This regulation provides for the recovery of unauthorised evacuee property and requires individuals who disposed of such property or made false claims to submit written declarations by December 31, 1958. It stipulates that no penalties shall be imposed for circumstances arising from these disclosures if made within the specified timeframe.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 49

metadata.title: The Martial Law (Recovery of authorised Evacuee Property) Regulation
metadata.summary: This regulation provides for the recovery of property belonging to authorized evacuees under martial law. It allows displaced persons and witnesses to correct false claims or statements regarding property possession before a specified deadline without facing penalties.

name: The West Pakistan Vaccination Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vaccination Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to vaccination in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes duties for local authorities, parents, and guardians regarding the vaccination of unprotected children against smallpox.

name: The Courts (Additional Judges) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Courts (Additional Judges) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the President to appoint additional judges to the Supreme Court or High Courts when there is a temporary increase in business or arrears of work. The appointed judges serve for a specified period not exceeding two years.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 48

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This regulation amends the Income-tax (Correction of Returns) Regulation, 1958 to change specific dates and add new provisions regarding the filing of returns. It allows persons who have never filed a return or been assessed to file one by December 31, 1958, and modifies rules for calculating excess income and tax due.

name: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Act (Repeal) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Act (Repeal) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to repeal the West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Act, 1958. It was issued in pursuance of a Presidential Proclamation dated October 7, 1958.

name: The West Pakistan Local Authority Laws Amending Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Local Authority Laws Amending Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: laws relating to local authorities (specifically the Punjab District Boards Act, 1863; The Punjab Municipal Act, 1911; The Punjab Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1941; The Punjab Penchayat Act; and The City of Lahore Corporation Act)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several existing laws relating to local authorities in West Pakistan. The primary purpose is to substitute the term 'Provincial Government' with 'Commissioner' and to make consequential grammatical adjustments throughout these acts.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 47

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This regulation mandates industrial undertakings in West Pakistan to declare their stocks of imported raw materials and spare parts to specific sponsoring authorities. The declaration must be submitted within 15 days of the regulation's date, with penalties including up to five years of rigorous imprisonment for non-compliance or providing false information.

name: The West Pakistan (Khairpur State People's Welfare Trust Act) Repeal Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Khairpur State People's Welfare Trust Act) Repeal Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Khairpur State People's Welfare Trust Act, Repeal of 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Khairpur State People's Welfare Trust Act, Repeal of 1955. It immediately vests all property and assets previously held by the trust in the Government of West Pakistan and transfers all associated rights and obligations to the government.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 46

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This notification establishes regulations under Martial Law in Pakistan. It specifically addresses penalties for making false declarations regarding the kind, quality, quantity, or value of imported or exported goods.

name: The West Pakistan Municipal Authorities (Supersession) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Municipal Authorities (Supersession) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the immediate supersession of municipal authorities in West Pakistan following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly and abrogation of the Constitution. It defines specific municipal bodies covered by the law and stipulates that their powers and duties shall be exercised by persons appointed by the Commissioner of the concerned Division.

name: The West Pakistan Discontinuance of (Sind) Land Revenue Equalization Fund Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Discontinuance of (Sind) Land Revenue Equalization Fund Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Sind Land Revenue Equalization Fund Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the discontinuance of the Land Revenue Equalization Fund established under the Sind Land Revenue Equalization Fund Act, 1947. It declares that maintaining a separate fund is no longer necessary after the establishment of West Pakistan and repeals the original 1947 Act as amended in 1955.

name: Income Tax (Correction of Returns) Regulations, 1958

metadata.title: Income Tax (Correction of Returns) Regulation, 1958
metadata.repeals: All instructions, orders and regulations issued by any Martial Law authority inconsistent with the provisions of this Regulation
metadata.summary: This regulation allows individuals to file revised income tax returns or asset statements for the assessment year 1954-55 and subsequent years if they believe their original filings were incorrect. It establishes specific compounding rates for taxes due on 'excess income' based on the timing of payment and repeals any inconsistent Martial Law authority instructions.

name: Foreign Exchange (Surrender and Declarations) Regulation, 1958

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange (Surrender and Declarations) Regulation, 1958
metadata.summary: This regulation outlines the procedures for persons in Pakistan to surrender or declare holdings of foreign exchange that are not lawful. It specifies deadlines for compliance based on whether individuals were inside or outside the country as of November 3, 1958, and details how certificates can be obtained from authorized dealers.

name: Income Tax (False Declarations) Regulation, 1958

metadata.title: Income Tax (False Declarations) Regulation, 1958
metadata.repeals: All instructions, orders or regulations issued by any Martial Law authority inconsistent with the provisions of this Regulation
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes penalties for making false statements, omitting required information or documents, failing to pay taxes on time, and divesting assets to avoid tax liability under specific Pakistani tax acts. It mandates that complaints regarding offenses must be made in writing by the Central Board of Revenue or an authorized authority. Additionally, it repeals any inconsistent instructions issued by Martial Law authorities.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 43

metadata.title: Income Tax (Correction of Returns) Regulations, 1958
metadata.repeals: All instructions and regulations issued by any authority inconsistent with the provisions of this Regulation
metadata.summary: This regulation allows persons who filed incorrect income tax returns for the assessment year 1954-55 or subsequent years to file revised returns by December 15, 1958, without facing legal action. It establishes specific rules for taxing 'excess income' separately and outlines compounding rates for tax dues based on the timing of payment.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 41

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This notification prohibits the sale and purchase of import licences and permits. It also bans the sale of imported raw materials and other goods by industrial consumers and actual users, with specific exceptions for traders selling goods after authorized import.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 11

metadata.title: Notification No. 1041/58
metadata.summary: This notification appoints General Mohammad Musa, Vice Admiral H. M. Siddiq Choudri, and Air Vice Marshal M. Asghar Khan as Deputy Chief Martial Law Administrators. It also states that Mr. Aziz Ahmad relinquishes his appointment with immediate effect.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 11

metadata.title: Notification No. 1041/58
metadata.summary: This notification appoints General Mohammad Musa, Vice Admiral H. M. Siddiq Choudri, and Air Vice Marshal M. Asghar Khan as Deputy Chief Martial Law Administrators. It also states that Mr. Aziz Ahmad relinquishes his appointment with immediate effect.

name: The Government (Presidential Cabinet) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Government (Presidential Cabinet) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the framework for the Presidential Cabinet in Pakistan following the Proclamation of October 7, 1958. It authorizes the President to appoint Ministers who hold office at his pleasure and explicitly states that there shall be no Prime Minister.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 10

metadata.title: Martial Law Orders
metadata.summary: This notification outlines proceedings for cases tried under Martial Law Orders and Regulations by Criminal Courts. The document specifies that these proceedings occur after confirmation by the Administrators.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 10

metadata.title: Martial Law Orders
metadata.summary: This notification outlines the procedure for forwarding proceedings of cases tried under Martial Law Orders and Regulations by Criminal Courts to the Judge Advocate General in Rawalpindi after confirmation by Administrators. It was issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator, Pakistan, on October 22, 1958.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 40

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This document amends Martial Law Regulation No. 27 by adding specific wording regarding the possession of smuggled goods. The addition applies retroactively to the date of issue of the original regulation.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 37-39

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This document contains regulations issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator of Pakistan to define offenses against the Armed Forces and government officials. It specifies punishments for acts such as bringing hatred against the military, causing disaffection, impersonating officers, and theft of government arms.

name: PROCLAMATION OF MARTIAL LAW

metadata.title: Proclamation of Martial Law
metadata.summary: This notification declares the exercise of jurisdiction within Pakistan's international boundaries under Martial Law. It authorizes the publication of specific Regulations and Orders, establishes penalties for contraventions, and allows for the appointment of special courts to try offenses.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No.30-34

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This document outlines regulations issued by the Chief Martial Law Administrator regarding offenses such as bribery, nepotism, and misuse of state facilities. It also includes specific provisions prohibiting whipping for individuals under 18 years of age and penalizing the spread of news calculated to dismember Pakistan.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 1-29

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This document establishes Martial Law Regulations for Pakistan effective October 15, 1958. It defines administrative zones, appoints military administrators, and sets up Special Military Courts and Summary Military Courts to try offenses under ordinary law or martial law regulations.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 35

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This document outlines regulations for proceedings in special military courts under martial law in Pakistan. It defines the powers of criminal courts regarding punishments, procedures for summons cases, jurisdiction limits for magistrates, and requirements for confirming death sentences by the Chief Administrator.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS NO. 1-9

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This document outlines the Martial Law Regulations issued by the Chief Administrator, Martial Law, Pakistan. It details specific powers for Special Military Courts regarding proceedings, punishments, and procedures under ordinary law.

name: The West Pakistan Vagrancy Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Vagrancy Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: law relating to vagrancy in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws relating to vagrancy in West Pakistan. It establishes welfare homes for the custody, detention, training, and rehabilitation of vagrants, while defining specific categories of vagrants and procedures for their medical examination and separation.

name: The Punjab Village Panchayat (West Pakistan Extension and Amendment) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayat (West Pakistan Extension and Amendment) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to panchayats in the Province of West Pakistan. It extends the Punjab Village Panchayat Act, 1939 to the whole province (except the Federal Capital and former NWFP) while repealing specific sections and modifying others.

name: The West Pakistan Border Police Force Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Border Police Force Act, 1958
metadata.number: West Pakistan Act No. I of 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the Border Police Force in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes the Force, defines its functions including border defense and intelligence collection, and outlines the appointment and control structure under the Government.

name: The Gwadur (Government and Administration) (Application of Laws) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Gwadur (Government and Administration) (Application of Laws) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order applies existing Pakistani laws to the territory of Gwadur, which was ceded to Pakistan on September 8, 1958. It serves as an interim measure under Article 2 of the Constitution until Parliament enacts specific legislation for the region's government and administration.

name: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of the West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission. It outlines the powers of the Government to set up the commission, define its composition, and establish its duties regarding election matters such as constituency delimitation and voter registration.

name: The West Pakistan Regulation of Mines and Mineral Development Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Regulation of Mines and Mineral Development Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of mines and mineral development in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes rules for prospecting licenses, mining leases, royalty payments, and procedures for government acquisition of mining properties with compensation.

name: The West Pakistan (Crescent Textile Mills Firing)(Public Inquiry) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Crescent Textile Mills Firing) (Public Inquiry) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Court of Inquiry to investigate the circumstances surrounding the police firing on workers at the Crescent Textile Mills in Lyallpur on June 20, 1958. The document outlines the court's composition, duties, powers regarding witness examination and evidence collection, and procedures for reporting findings to the Provincial Government.

name: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Power) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act confers powers on officers conducting departmental inquiries against government servants in West Pakistan to compel witness attendance and document production. These powers are equivalent to those exercisable by a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.

name: The West Pakistan Regulation of Mines and Mineral Development Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Regulation of Mines and Mineral Development Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of mines and mineral development in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes rules for prospecting licenses, mining leases, royalty payments, and procedures for compulsory acquisition of mining properties with compensation.

name: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of supply, distribution, and trade in certain essential articles within West Pakistan. It grants the Government powers to control production, storage, movement, and consumption of these articles through orders, licenses, and permits.

name: The Agricultural Census Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Agricultural Census Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the taking of an agricultural census in Pakistan to comply with United Nations decisions. It establishes a Census Commissioner and other officers to supervise data collection on matters such as land tenure, crop acreage, livestock, and employment.

name: The Public Order (Political Uniforms) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The Public Order (Political Uniforms) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the wearing of uniforms for political purposes and prevents private persons from maintaining associations with a military or semi-military character. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan under Article 69 because the National Assembly was not in session.

name: The Gwadur (Government and Administration) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Gwadur (Government and Administration) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order notifies that the port and territory of Gwadur on the coast of Mekran have been ceded to Pakistan and form part of the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes the government and administration of Gwadur under Article 104 of the Constitution as a Special Area, while allowing existing laws to continue in force with necessary adaptations.

name: The Karachi Foodstuffs Distribution Control Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Karachi Foodstuffs Distribution Control Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order establishes controls for the equitable distribution of foodstuffs within the Federal Capital at fair prices. It defines key terms such as 'dealer', 'producer', and specific categories like 'provisioned' and 'rationed' commodities, while granting the Director powers to fix maximum prices and regulate sales.

name: The Edible Oilseeds and Edible Oils (Futures and Options Prohibition) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Edible Oilseeds and Edible Oils (Futures and Options Prohibition) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order prohibits transactions in futures and options regarding edible oilseeds and oils within the Federal Capital. It declares such transactions detrimental to public interest and renders any outstanding options void upon its commencement.

name: The Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This ordinance repeals the Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) Ordinance, 1949. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan on August 14, 1958, as Parliament was not in session.

name: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of supply, distribution, and trade in certain essential articles within West Pakistan. It grants the Government powers to control production, storage, movement, and consumption of these items to ensure equitable availability.

name: The Members of National Assembly (Salaries and Allowances) Rules, 1958

metadata.title: The Members of National Assembly (Salaries and Allowances) Rules, 1958
metadata.summary: These rules were framed under the Members of National Assembly (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1956, to regulate the salaries, allowances, and facilities for members of the National Assembly. The document details provisions regarding travelling allowances, daily allowances for partial days, housing rent calculations, telephone usage charges, and medical facilities.

name: The Public Order (Meetings) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The Public Order Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the preservation of public order during public meetings and prevents disturbances at such gatherings. It defines terms like 'public meeting' and 'public place', prohibits disorderly conduct, carrying offensive weapons, and using threatening behavior, and prescribes penalties including imprisonment and whipping.

name: PROCLAMATION

metadata.title: Proclamation
metadata.summary: This Proclamation declares that the Government of East Pakistan cannot be carried on in accordance with the Constitution. It suspends specific articles and clauses related to the Governor, Legislature, and elections for that Province while substituting references to the President and Parliament.

name: The West Pakistan Border Police Force Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Border Police Force Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the Border Police Force in the Province of West Pakistan. It establishes the force, defines its functions such as border defense and intelligence collection, and outlines the appointment and control structure under the Government.

name: The Passengers Baggage (Imports) Rules, 1958

metadata.title: The Passengers Baggage (Imports) Rules, 1958
metadata.repeals: Central Board of Revenue Notification No. 45-Cus., dated the 14th September 1929
metadata.summary: These rules define the goods that passengers arriving from foreign countries (excluding India, Portuguese Possessions in India, and Ceylon) may import free of duty. They specify allowances for personal use items such as clothing, jewelry, cameras, and specific quantities of foodstuffs or spirits.

name: The Representation of the People (Conduct of Elections and Election Petitions) Rules, 1958

metadata.title: The Representation of the People (Conduct of Elections and Election Petitions) Rules, 1958
