metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under section 122 of the Representation of the People Act, 1957 to regulate the conduct of elections and election petitions. They establish administrative arrangements for polling stations, procedures for nomination and withdrawal of candidates, and requirements for publishing notices in the Gazette.

name: The Criminal Law (Armed Forces) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Armed Forces) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance supplements the criminal law by providing for the punishment of acts adversely affecting the Armed Forces. It establishes specific offenses related to bringing hatred against the forces, causing disaffection, promoting enmity, or seducing members from their duty, and imposes restrictions on bail and public hearings.

name: The Federal Capital (Control of Rice) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Federal Capital (Control of Rice) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the disposal of rice in the Federal Capital through the Director of Civil Supplies, Karachi. It mandates that stockholders sell rice only to the Director and requires immediate reporting of stock details upon the Order's issuance.

name: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Departmental Inquiries (Powers) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers powers on officers conducting departmental inquiries against government servants in West Pakistan. It allows these officers to compel the attendance of witnesses and the production of documents with the same authority as a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.

name: The West Pakistan Abolition Of Estate Duty (Agricultural Lands) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Abolition of Estate Duty (Agricultural Lands) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Estate Duty Act, 1950 to abolish estate duty on agricultural lands within West Pakistan. It achieves this by inserting specific words into section 2 of the said Act to exclude agricultural land from duty levies.

name: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law regarding the regulation of retail sales of manufactured tobacco in urban areas within West Pakistan to protect public health. It establishes requirements for dealer's licenses, defines key terms such as 'manufactured tobacco' and 'urban area', and outlines penalties for unauthorized dealing or breach of license conditions.

name: The West Pakistan Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897; Khairpur State Epidemic Diseases Act, 1941; Epidemic Diseases (Punjab Amendment) Act 1944
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government of West Pakistan to take special measures and prescribe temporary regulations when an outbreak of dangerous epidemic diseases is present or threatened. It outlines specific powers for inspecting travelers, segregating suspected cases, and delegating authority to Deputy Commissioners, while also providing legal protection for officials acting in good faith.

name: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of calamities such as floods, famines, and epidemics in West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to declare areas affected by these disasters and appoints a Relief Commissioner with extensive powers to manage relief operations.

name: The West Pakistan Power and Development Authority Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority as a body corporate to manage water and power resources. It provides for the unified and coordinated development of these resources across West Pakistan, covering irrigation, drainage, and electricity generation.

name: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of certain powers regarding requisitioned land in West Pakistan after the expiration of previous ordinances and acts. It defines key terms such as 'Government' and 'Requisitioned land', and outlines procedures for releasing land from requisition, including inquiries, written orders, and public notices.

name: The West Pakistan Control of Orphanages Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Control of Orphanages Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the maintenance and control of orphanages in West Pakistan. It establishes a licensing system managed by District Magistrates, mandates medical examinations for orphans, and requires regular financial reporting.

name: The West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation to promote mineral development within the Province of West Pakistan. It defines the Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession, sets its authorized capital at five crores of rupees subscribed by the Government, and outlines the structure and powers of its Board of Directors.

name: The West Pakistan Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act,1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation and maintenance of graveyards in West Pakistan, specifically targeting the Mian Sahib Graveyard in Lahore initially. It establishes committees to investigate encroachments and appoints tribunals to adjudicate claims regarding land titles within graveyard limits.

name: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws relating to the imposition of tax on motor vehicles in West Pakistan. It establishes definitions for terms such as 'motor vehicle', 'tax', and 'licensing officer', and outlines the obligations for vehicle owners to declare their vehicles and pay quarterly tax installments.

name: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance of certain essential services in West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to issue orders restricting the movement of persons engaged in essential services and regulates their wages and conditions.

name: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of powers to control the supply, distribution, and movement of foodstuffs in West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to regulate trade, set prices, issue licenses, and impose penalties for contraventions.

name: The West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1884; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1951; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1955; Agriculturists' Loans (Sind Amendment) Act, 1941; Khairpur State Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1952; West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the advancement and recovery of taccavi loans for agricultural purposes in the Province of West Pakistan. It repeals several previous enactments regarding agriculturists' loans, including acts from 1884, 1951, 1955, 1941, and 1952, as well as a specific ordinance from 1958.

name: The High Court Judges (Daily Allowances) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The High Court Judges (Daily Allowances) Order, 1958
metadata.amends: The Government of India (High Court Judges) Order, 1937
metadata.repeals: The Government of India (High Court Judges) Order, 1937
metadata.summary: This Order determines the daily allowances for Judges of High Courts in Pakistan to reimburse travel expenses incurred on duty. It repeals paragraph 25 of the Government of India (High Court Judges) Order, 1937, regarding these specific allowances.

name: The Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of compensation to certain displaced persons who suffered losses due to the expropriation of their property rights in India or occupied areas. It also establishes provisions for the rehabilitation of other displaced persons and covers matters incidental to these primary objectives.

name: The Appropriation (Supplementary) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Appropriation (Supplementary) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the payment and appropriation of further sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund for the financial year 1957-58. It specifies the total amount authorized and details the services and purposes for which these funds are to be applied in a schedule.

name: The Finance Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1958
metadata.amends: The Tariff Act, 1934; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the fiscal year beginning April 1, 1958. It establishes duties on salt and postage, alters customs and excise rates on various articles, and continues specific taxes like business profits tax.

name: The Appropriation Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Appropriation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the payment and appropriation of specific sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund for the financial year 1958-59. It details the aggregate amount available to defray charges for various government services and purposes listed in the Schedule.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (Adaptation) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (Adaptation) Order, 1958
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order exercises the President's powers to adapt laws and the Constitution to remove difficulties arising from the new constitutional framework. It specifically amends Article 224 of the Constitution by substituting 'two years' with 'three years' for the exercise of adaptation powers and appoints judges to the Supreme Court.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (Adaptation) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (Adaptation) Order, 1958
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order adapts Article 224 of the Constitution to extend a specific time period from two years to three years for the purpose of bringing laws into accord with the Constitution. It was promulgated by the President to facilitate the drawing up of the first Statute Book after the Constitution and to address difficulties arising before the National Assembly could pass necessary legislation.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (Chairman of the Federal Public Service Commission) (Resignation) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The President's Order No. 2 of 1958
metadata.summary: This order addresses difficulties regarding the appointment and resignation of the first Chairman of the Federal Public Service Commission. It directs that the provisions of Article 186 of the Constitution be modified to exempt this specific Chairman from restrictions on further employment after ceasing office.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (Resignation of Judges) Order, 1958

metadata.title: Removal of Difficulties (Resignation of Judges) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order modifies clause (3) of Article 166 of the Constitution to exempt judges who resign between February 18 and March 23, 1958, from restrictions on pleading before their former courts. It allows such judges to continue acting or pleading despite previous undertakings to the contrary.

name: The Foodstuffs (Regulation of Consumption) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Foodstuffs (Regulation of Consumption) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the consumption of certain foodstuffs, specifically wheat, rice, and their products, by restricting the number of persons served at private functions in the Federal Capital. It grants enforcement officers powers to enter premises, search for contraband, and seize foodstuffs involved in violations, while also outlining penalties including imprisonment, fines, and forfeiture of stock.

name: The Undesirable Companies Act, 1958

metadata.title: The Undesirable Companies Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the registration of companies carrying on business for certain undesirable purposes and mandates the winding up and dissolution of such entities. It defines specified purposes, including lotteries or schemes promising money without other rights, and restricts associations operating across provinces or in the Federal Capital for these purposes.

name: NA- The Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1958

metadata.title: The Laws (Continuance in Force) (Amendment) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1958 to address the suspension and pay of Supreme Court judges. It grants the President the power to suspend a judge whose conduct is referred to the Chief Justice for report and stipulates that suspended judges do not receive half pay unless later found guilty of misbehaviour.

name: The Licences and Permits Fees Order, 1957

metadata.title: The Licences and Permits Fees Order, 1957
metadata.summary: This Order establishes fees for licences and permits issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950. It specifies fee amounts based on the value of the licence or permit and outlines exemptions for government departments, local authorities, educational institutions, hospitals, corporations, and specific export schemes.

name: PNA-Amendments in Central Excise Rules, 1944

metadata.title: Central Excise Rules, 1944
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Central Excise Rules, 1944, to facilitate the removal of excisable goods from factories to private bonded warehouses without immediate payment of duty. It introduces new clauses regarding applications for removal, security requirements, and updates various forms related to warehousing procedures.

name: Amendments in Custom House Agents (Licensing) Rules, 1957

metadata.title: Custom House Agents (Licensing) Rules, 1957
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Custom House Agents (Licensing) Rules, 1957 by updating Rule 4 to require applicants to have knowledge of English and Urdu or Bengali. It also modifies Rule 7 to include duties regarding information accuracy and client entitlements, while adding provisions for license revocation based on misconduct.

name: The Prevention of Smuggling (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The Smuggling (Prevention) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers commissioned officers of the Armed Forces to exercise specific powers to prevent smuggling of essential commodities like wheat, rice, and jute. It grants these officers authority to arrest suspects without a warrant and to enter premises for searches related to smuggling offenses.

name: The West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation to promote mineral development in the region. It defines the corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession, sets its authorized capital at one crore rupees subscribed by the Government, and outlines the structure and powers of its Board of Directors.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (Offices of Profit) Order, 1957

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (Offices of Profit) Order, 1957
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order was issued by the President of Pakistan to address difficulties regarding the interpretation of the Constitution, specifically concerning offices of profit. It modifies paragraph 4 of the Fourth Schedule to the Constitution by adding a proviso that allows an Act of Parliament to declare holders of certain offices are not subject to disqualification until March 22, 1963.

name: The West Pakistan Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release (Extension) Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Ordinance, 1957
metadata.amends: The Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Act, 1926 to the entire Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly Speaker and Deputy Speaker's Salaries Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly Speaker and Deputy Speaker's Salaries Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the salaries and allowances of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan. It also grants them the right to use a government-provided house or receive a house-rent allowance if no such house is provided.

name: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides facilities to the Agricultural Development Finance Corporation for recovering its dues. It empowers the Corporation to pledge, mortgage, or assign property to secure loans and authorizes it to recover dues by disposing of such pledged or mortgaged property.

name: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers the Government of West Pakistan to regulate and prohibit the keeping, storage, movement, transport, supply, distribution, disposal, acquisition, use, or consumption of foodstuffs. It aims to ensure equitable distribution and availability of food at fair prices by allowing the government to issue orders regarding licenses, price controls, and prohibitions on trade.

name: The Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: Undesirable Companies Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the registration of companies carrying on business for certain undesirable purposes and provides for the winding up and dissolution of such entities. It defines 'specified purpose' and 'undesirable company' while establishing penalties for officers or agents who continue to operate these businesses after the Ordinance comes into force.

name: The Review, Appeal and Revision Order, 1957

metadata.title: The Review, Appeal and Revision Order, 1957
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the procedures for review, appeal, and revision regarding orders passed by licensing authorities under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950. It defines specific terms such as 'licensing authority' and outlines timelines and fees required for filing appeals or applications for revision with the Ministry of Commerce.

name: The Communication and Transport Services Maintenance Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The Communication and Transport Services Maintenance Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the maintenance of essential communication and transport services in Pakistan, including postal, telegraph, telephone, railway, and port services. It empowers the Central Government to prohibit strikes in these sectors if deemed necessary for public interest and imposes penalties on individuals who participate in or instigate illegal strikes.

name: The West Pakistan Continuance of Supplementary Taxes Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Continuation of Supplementary Taxes Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of certain taxes imposed under the Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1950. It establishes specific surcharges on land revenue and additional taxes on entertainments, cinemas, and betting in designated districts of West Pakistan.

name: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the maintenance of certain essential services in West Pakistan when the Provincial Assembly is not in session. It empowers the Government to direct persons engaged in these services to remain in their areas and regulates their wages and conditions of service.

name: The West Pakistan Appropriation Act, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Appropriation Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the payment and appropriation of certain sums out of the Provincial Consolidated Fund for the financial year 1957-58. It details specific allocations for various services, purposes, and capital outlays voted by the Provincial Assembly.

name: The Representation of the Peoples Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Conduct of Elections Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conduct of elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies, including administrative arrangements, nomination processes, and polling procedures. It also outlines offences related to elections, disqualifications for candidates, and the trial of election petitions.

name: The Cotton Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Cotton Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: The Jute Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to promote international trade in cotton within Pakistan. It establishes a Cotton Board with powers to regulate dealings in cotton and directs the Central Government to constitute this board. The legislation also grants the Central Government authority to requisition pressing factories for export purposes and to call for information regarding contract fulfilment.

name: The Jute Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Jute Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides for measures to regulate and promote international trade in jute within Pakistan. It establishes a Jute Board with specific functions, sets rules for price fixation and contract registration, and grants the Central Government powers to inspect records and direct exporters.

name: Amendments in the Valuation (Exports) Rules, 1957

metadata.title: The Valuation (Exports) Rules, 1957 and The Valuation (Imports) Rules, 1957
metadata.amends: The Valuation (Exports) Rules, 1957 and The Valuation (Imports) Rules, 1957
metadata.summary: This notification directs amendments to be made in the Valuation (Exports) Rules, 1957 and the Valuation (Imports) Rules, 1957. The changes involve substituting specific text within Forms VBF 9-A, VBF 9-B, and VBF 6-B found in the schedules of these rules.

name: The West Pakistan (Adaptation and Repeal of Laws) Act, 1957

metadata.title: THE WEST PAKISTAN (ADAPTATION AND REPEAL OF LAWS) ACT, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act adapts and repeals certain laws applicable to the Province of West Pakistan. It came into force on October 14, 1957, following the assent received by the Governor on July 18, 1957.

name: The West Pakistan Development Fund Cess Act, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Development Fund Cess Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the raising of funds to support the development of West Pakistan. It establishes a cess levied on land revenue and occupier's rates across specified districts in the province.

name: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act restricts the increase of rent for certain premises located within urban areas in West Pakistan and regulates the eviction of tenants. It empowers a designated Controller to fix fair rents based on specific factors such as previous rental values, construction costs, and local circumstances.

name: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1946; Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1947; Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of certain powers in relation to requisitioned land in West Pakistan. It declares that upon the repeal of previous ordinances and acts, requisitioned lands shall continue to be subject to requisition unless released by a published notice.

name: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of a duty on admission to entertainments in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'entertainment', 'payment for admission', and 'proprietor' to establish the scope of the duty.

name: The Cotton Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The Cotton Ordinance, 1957
metadata.repeals: The Jute Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Cotton Board to supervise cotton dealings and promote international trade in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'cotton', 'factory selection contract', and 'pressing factory' for the purposes of the law. Additionally, it grants the Central Government powers to requisition pressing factories or places for storing cotton and to buy cotton elsewhere if an exporter defaults on a contract.

name: The Jute Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The Jute Ordinance, 1957
metadata.repeals: The Jute Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the provisions of the Jute Act, 1957 to regulate and promote international trade in jute. It establishes a Board to execute government policy, supervise dealings, and assist with transport arrangements for exporting jute.

name: The Electoral Rolls (Preparation) Rules, 1957

metadata.title: The Electoral Rolls (Preparation) Rules, 1957
metadata.summary: These Rules provide for the preparation of electoral rolls for every constituency in Pakistan. They define key terms such as the Election Commission, Regional Election Commissioner, and Registration Officer, and mandate that separate rolls be prepared for men and women.

name: The Diplomatic Immunities (Commonwealth Countries Representatives) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Diplomatic Immunities (Commonwealth Countries Representatives) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act declares and confers certain immunities on representatives in Pakistan of Commonwealth Countries and on certain other persons. It defines key terms such as chief representative, envoy, and staff, and establishes the scope of immunity from suit, legal process, and inviolability for official premises and archives.

name: The Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorised Use) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Pakistan Names and Emblems (Prevention of Unauthorised Use) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act prevents the unauthorised use of specific names and emblems in trade marks, designs, patents, or business contexts. It defines key terms such as 'emblem', 'name', and 'competent authority' and prohibits their use without written permission from the Central Government.

name: The Agricultural Bank Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Agricultural Bank Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Agricultural Bank of Pakistan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the bank's objects, which include providing credit and warehousing facilities to agriculturists and co-operative societies for agricultural development.

name: The Leader of the Opposition (Allowances) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Leader of the Opposition (Allowances) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides allowances and privileges to the Leader of the Opposition in the Punjab Assembly. It grants entitlements for so long as the individual holds the position, including a fifteen-day period thereafter, with no personal financial charge for maintaining their residence.

name: The Electoral Rolls Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Electoral Rolls Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the delimitation of constituencies and the preparation of electoral rolls for elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies. It also establishes the qualifications of voters and matters connected therewith.

name: The West Pakistan Provincial Legislature (Delegation of Powers) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Electorate (Amendment) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Electorate Act, 1956 to specify that elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies shall be held on the basis of a joint electorate. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: The Drugs and Medicines (Indemnity) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Drugs and Medicines (Indemnity) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act indemnifies Government servants and other persons for acts done in pursuance of a specific order regarding drugs and medicines. It was enacted to validate an order that previously lacked legal validity when added to the Essential Commodities Distribution Order.

name: The Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the qualifications and registration of practitioners of Unani, Ayurvedic, and Homoeopathic systems of medicine in Pakistan. It establishes two separate Boards to oversee these systems and provides for their constitution, functions, and the maintenance of registers for practitioners.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (National Economic Council) Order, 1957

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (National Economic Council) Order, 1957
metadata.summary: This Order was issued by the President of Pakistan to address a difficulty arising from the absence of Ministers in the Provincial Government of West Pakistan. It adapts provisions regarding the constitution of the National Economic Council under Article 234 of the Constitution to ensure its proper formation during this period.

name: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of powers to control the supply, distribution, and trade in foodstuffs in West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to regulate storage, transport, pricing, and commerce regarding items like wheat, rice, and sugar through notified orders.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (Authentication of Schedule of Authorised Expenditure) Order, 1957

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (Authentication of Schedule of Authorised Expenditure) Order, 1957
metadata.summary: This Order was issued by the President of Pakistan to modify Article 230 of the Constitution regarding the authentication of expenditure schedules in West Pakistan. It grants the Governor additional power to authenticate a schedule of authorised expenditure even when a Proclamation under Article 193 is in force, addressing specific difficulties arising within the province.

name: The Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the administration of evacuee property in Pakistan and addresses incidental matters related to the partition. It defines key terms such as 'evacuee', 'evacuee property', and 'displaced person' to establish the legal framework for managing properties left behind or acquired illegally after March 1, 1947.

name: The Evacuee Property (Multiple Allotments) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property (Multiple Allotments) Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: Evacuee Property (Multiple Allotments) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the investigation and disposal of certain cases regarding the multiple allotment of evacuee property. It defines 'multiple allotment' as obtaining more than one piece of such property for residence or business, with specific exceptions for agricultural land under approved rehabilitation schemes.

name: The Jute Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Jute Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures for the regulation and promotion of international trade in jute within Pakistan. It establishes a Jute Board to execute government policy, supervise dealings, assist with transport, and recommend measures regarding quality standards and export facilities.

name: The Cotton Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Cotton Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: The Jute Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to promote international trade in cotton within Pakistan. It establishes a Board with powers to regulate dealings in cotton, including handling, transport, and storage, and authorizes the Central Government to direct the Board to buy or sell cotton as necessary.

name: The Essential Supplies Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Essential Supplies Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the price control and regulation of trade and commerce between Pakistani provinces and between a province and the Federal Capital regarding specific commodities. It empowers the Central Government to make orders controlling prices, prohibiting withholding of sales, and requiring stock transfers or record maintenance.

name: The Appropriation Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Appropriation Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the payment and appropriation of certain sums from the Federal Consolidated Fund for the financial year 1957-58. It specifies the purposes for which these funds are to be applied, including services for various ministries such as Agriculture, Commerce, and Cabinet.

name: The Finance Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the fiscal year beginning April 1, 1957. It amends previous legislation to fix duties on salt and motor spirit, alter postage rates, and continue various taxes including business profits tax.

name: The West Pakistan Board of Revenue Act, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Board of Revenue Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Board of Revenue for West Pakistan to oversee land administration and revenue collection. It designates the Board as the highest appellate and revisional authority in revenue cases within the province.

name: The West Pakistan Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and other privileges applicable to Ministers in the Government of West Pakistan. It specifies that ministers shall receive salaries and allowances admissible immediately before March 23, 1956, along with provisions for housing or house-rent allowances and daily travelling allowances.

name: The West Pakistan Jhelum District Board Elections (Cancellation of Nominations) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Jhelum District Board Elections (Cancellation of Nominations) Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Jhelum Districts Board Elections (Cancellation of Nominations) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act cancels the nominations of candidates declared on October 26, 1954, for election as members of the Jhelum District Board. It also extinguishes rights accrued from these cancelled nominations and bars legal suits against the government regarding losses caused by this cancellation.

name: The West Pakistan Deputy Ministers (Salaries and Allowances) Act , 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Deputy Ministers (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Deputy Ministers (Salaries and Allowances) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries and allowances of Deputy Ministers of the Government of West Pakistan. It establishes a fixed salary, housing provisions, and various other allowances and privileges for these officials.

name: The [West Pakistan] Pakistan Red Cross Society (Sind Provincial Branch) (Validating) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The Pakistan Red Cross Society (Sind Provincial Branch) (Validating) Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan Red Cross Society (Sind Provincial Branch) (Validating) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act regularizes the appointment of the Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Sind Provincial Branch of the Pakistan Red Cross Society. It also validates all actions, orders, and decisions taken by that Chairman during his tenure as if they were properly authorized under the relevant laws.

name: The West Pakistan High Court (Special Jurisdiction) Act, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan High Court (Special Jurisdiction) Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Enactments) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the disposal of specific death sentence cases pending with the Rulers of the Bahawalpur and Khairpur States before October 14, 1955. It also amends the Khairpur State Courts Act, 1941, to facilitate the re-hearing and confirmation or modification of these orders by the High Court of West Pakistan.

name: The Supreme Court Rules, 1956

metadata.title: The Supreme Court Rules, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Federal Court Rules, 1950
metadata.summary: This document establishes the Supreme Court Rules, 1956, made by the Supreme Court of Pakistan with the approval of the President. It interprets key terms, defines the roles of court officers like the Registrar, and sets procedures for hearings during vacations.

name: The West Pakistan Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of Ministers of the Government of West Pakistan. It stipulates that these benefits shall be those admissible immediately before March 23, 1956, with provisions for daily travelling allowances during public tours.

name: The High Courts (Bengal) (Adaptation) Order, 1957

metadata.title: The High Courts (Bengal) (Adaptation) Order, 1957
metadata.summary: This Order adapts the High Courts (Bengal) Order, 1947 to align its provisions with the Constitution of Pakistan. It amends specific articles to replace references to 'East Bengal' with 'East Pakistan' and updates the court's seal description.

name: The West Pakistan Development Fund Cess Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Development Fund Cess Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the raising of funds to support the development of West Pakistan Province. It levies a specific cess on land revenue and occupier's rates across various districts, with provisions for assessment, collection, and recovery similar to existing land revenue laws.

name: The Pakistan Cantonment Property Rules, 1957

metadata.title: The Pakistan Cantonment Property Rules, 1957
metadata.repeals: Army Department Notification No. 936, dated the 26th June, 1925
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the maintenance of registers for immovable and movable property vested in Cantonment Boards. They outline procedures for the purchase, lease, acquisition, and transfer of land required for cantonment administration, as well as conditions for resumption by the Government.

name: The University of Karachi (Amendment) Order, 1956

metadata.title: President's Order No. 19 of 1956
metadata.summary: This Order establishes an Enquiry Committee appointed by the Chancellor of the University of Karachi to investigate university affairs and improve academic standards. It amends the University of Karachi Act, 1950, to define the committee's procedure, mandate report submission timelines, and expand the Chancellor's powers to pass binding orders for the university's interests.

name: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the laws relating to the imposition of tax on motor vehicles in West Pakistan. It establishes the authority for levying quarterly taxes, defining key terms such as 'motor vehicle' and 'licensing officer', and outlines the obligations for vehicle owners regarding declarations and tax payments.

name: The Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Order, 1956

metadata.title: The Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the continuance of emergency powers regarding requisitioned land in the Federal Capital after the expiration of previous acts and ordinances. It outlines the Central Government's authority to use, deal with, or release such lands, including procedures for acquiring them and delivering possession.

name: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the removal of certain disqualifications regarding membership in the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan. It specifically addresses disqualifications arising from holding offices of profit listed in the Schedule to the Act.

name: The Pakistan Rehabilitation Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Pakistan Rehabilitation Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Tariff (Amendment) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the rehabilitation of persons displaced by the partition of India and Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'evacuee', 'evacuee property', and 'Custodian' to establish legal frameworks for managing assets transferred or held in relation to the partition.

name: The National Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the extension of time granted for doing certain acts related to patents and designs. It addresses scenarios where applications, patents, or registrations have ceased, expired, become void, been treated as abandoned, or refused due to missing deadlines.

name: The Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1956. Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the extension of time limits under the Patents and Designs Act, 1911. It allows applications, patents, registrations, or proceedings to be completed even if the original deadline has passed or expired.

name: The East Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Removal of Disqualification) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The East Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the removal of certain disqualifications regarding membership in the Provincial Assembly of East Pakistan. It specifically addresses individuals holding offices of profit listed in the Schedule, allowing them to be qualified for membership despite such holdings.

name: The Recruitment Rules for Civilian Gazetted Posts Class I and Class II in the Pakistan Navy

metadata.title: Recruitment Rules for Civilian Gazetted Posts Class I and Class II in the Pakistan Navy
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for recruiting to civilian gazetted Class I and Class II posts in the Pakistan Navy under the Ministry of Defence. They cover methods of recruitment including direct appointment, promotion, and transfer, as well as provisions regarding probation periods and the composition of the Civilian Recruitment Board.

name: The Karachi Rent Restriction Act (Amendment) Order, 1956

metadata.title: The Karachi Rent Restriction Act (Amendment) Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Karachi Rent Restriction Act, 1953 by substituting references to subsections in section 15. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan on November 28, 1956, and came into force immediately.

name: The Evacuee Property (Multiple and Irregular Allotments) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Evacuee Property (Multiple and Irregular Allotments) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President of Pakistan under emergency powers to address irregularities in the allocation of evacuee property. It defines multiple and irregular allotments and empowers High Court Judges to investigate such cases, reopen them, and pass final orders without judicial review.

name: The Cotton Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: Cotton Ordinance, 1956
metadata.repeals: Jute Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to promote international trade in cotton within Pakistan. It establishes a Cotton Board with the power to supervise and regulate dealings in cotton, including handling, transport, and storage. The document also defines key terms such as 'cotton', 'factory', and 'contract', while repealing the Jute Ordinance, 1956.

name: The Jute Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Jute Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Jute Board to promote international trade in jute and assist the Central Government with exports. It grants the Central Government powers to fix minimum prices for buying and selling jute, call for information, and seize documents related to contraventions.

name: The Essential Supplies Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Ordinance on Price Control and Trade and Commerce between the Provinces
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for price control and regulates trade and commerce between the Provinces and between a Province and the Federal Capital regarding certain essential commodities. It empowers the Central Government to make orders regulating the movement, distribution, and sale of these commodities, as well as controlling prices and issuing necessary licenses.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (Adaptation) Order, 1956

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (Adaptation) Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order adapts laws continued in force under Article 224 of the Constitution to ensure consistency with constitutional provisions. It empowers courts and tribunals to construe such laws with necessary adaptations even if no specific Presidential Order has been issued yet.

name: The Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the transfer of certain deposits belonging to evacuees to India and the reception of similar deposits belonging to refugees in Pakistan. It establishes the office of the Custodian of Deposits and outlines the duties of the Custodian and Assistant Custodians under the general superintendence of the Central Government.

name: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the maintenance of certain essential services in West Pakistan. It empowers the Government to issue orders restricting movement and regulating wages or conditions of service for designated essential employees.

name: The Rice (Movement Restriction) Order, 1956

metadata.title: The Rice (Movement Restriction) Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order restricts the transport of rice from West Pakistan to East Pakistan, allowing only Basmati rice or rice on Government account. It was issued under the Control of Essential Commodities Ordinance, 1956, superseding a previous notification.

name: The Electorate Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Electorate Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the principle of electorate in elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies. It mandates that elections in East Pakistan be held on the principle of joint electorate, while all other constituencies are to be held on the principle of separate electorate.

name: The Pakistan Red Cross Society (Sind Provincial Branch) (Validation) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Pakistan Red Cross Society (Sind Provincial Branch) Validating Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to regularize the appointment of the Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Sind Provincial Branch of the Pakistan Red Cross Society. It also validates all actions, orders, and decisions taken by that Chairman during his tenure under the relevant Act and Rules.

name: The West Pakistan Deputy Ministers (Salaries and Allowances) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Deputy Ministers (Salaries and Allowances) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the salaries and allowances of Deputy Ministers of the Government of West Pakistan. It establishes a specific monthly salary, housing benefits, and various travel-related allowances for these officials.

name: The Essential Services Maintenance (Adaptation) Order, 1956

metadata.title: Essential Services Maintenance (Adaptation) Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order adapts and modifies the Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1952, following the cessation of the Proclamation of Emergency. It directs specific amendments to replace references to provincial governments with the Central Government and adjusts the scope of essential services maintenance to the Federal Capital.

name: The Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan Rehabilitation Ordinance, 1948 (XIX of 1948)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1949. It was promulgated by the President under emergency powers because the National Assembly was not in session.

name: The Pakistan Rehabilitation Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Pakistan Rehabilitation Ordinance, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan Rehabilitation Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Pakistan Rehabilitation Ordinance, 1948. It defines key terms such as 'evacuee' and 'evacuee property' to manage the restoration of social and economic life for displaced persons following the partition.

name: The Cotton Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Cotton Ordinance, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Cotton Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Cotton Act, 1951 to regulate dealings in cotton across Pakistan. It empowers the Central Government to fix prices, establish a Cotton Board, requisition factories for ginning and storage, and regulate related charges.

name: The Jute Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Jute Ordinance, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Jute Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Jute Ordinance, 1949 to continue measures safeguarding international trade in jute. It empowers the Central Government to fix minimum prices for jute, appoint agents and brokers, establish a Jute Board, and enforce compliance through information gathering and search warrants.

name: The Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Ordinance, 1956
metadata.repeals: Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Act, 1954. It was promulgated by the President under emergency provisions because the National Assembly was not in session.

name: The Hoarding and Black Market Order, 1956

metadata.title: The Hoarding and Black Market Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act defines offenses related to hoarding and dealing in the black market, including selling rationed goods or trading at prices above legal limits. It establishes punishments for individuals found guilty of these specific economic crimes.

name: The Stamp Act (Amendment) Order, 1956

metadata.title: The Stamp Act (Amendment) Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Stamp Act, 1899 specifically for its application to the Federal Capital. It substitutes the figure '160' for '81' in the Exemption under Article 12 of Schedule I to the Act.

name: The West Pakistan Jhelum District Board Elections (Cancellation of Nominations) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Jhelum District Board Elections (Cancellation of Nominations) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance cancels the nominations of candidates declared on October 26, 1954, for election as members of the Jhelum District Board. It declares that any rights acquired based on these cancelled nominations are extinguished and prevents legal proceedings against the Provincial Government regarding losses caused by this cancellation.

name: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan under Article 102 of the Constitution to restrict rent increases and regulate tenant evictions in specific urban areas. It defines key terms such as 'building', 'tenant', and 'Controller' and establishes the powers of the Provincial Government to exempt certain properties from its provisions.

name: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Continuance of Control) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Continuance of Control) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of powers to control the production, supply, and distribution of foodstuffs within West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor under Article 102 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: The West Pakistan High Court (Special Jurisdiction) Second Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan High Court (Special Jurisdiction) Second Ordinance, 1956
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan High Court (Special Jurisdiction) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the disposal of certain cases pending with the Rulers of the Bahawalpur and Khairpur States regarding death sentences immediately before October 14, 1955. It authorizes the High Court of West Pakistan to re-hear these specific cases and confirms, sets aside, or modifies previous orders.

name: The West Pakistan Assembly (Offices) Second Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Assembly (Offices) Second Ordinance, 1956
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Assembly (Offices) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of a Serjeant-at-Arms and Deputy Serjeant-at-Arms to attend on the Speaker of the West Pakistan Assembly. It grants the Speaker powers to maintain order within the Assembly building, including directing the removal or exclusion of persons who infringe rules or behave disorderly.

name: The Removal of Difficulties Casual Vacancies) (National Assembly) Order, 1956

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (National Assembly) Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order was issued by the President of Pakistan to resolve doubts regarding the intent of Article 223 of the Constitution concerning casual vacancies in the National Assembly. It directs that specific provisions of the Constitution shall have effect during a specified period with necessary adaptations to address these difficulties.

name: The West Pakistan Board of Revenue Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Board of Revenue Ordinance, 1956
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Board of Revenue Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Board of Revenue for West Pakistan to oversee revenue administration and land collection. It grants the Board appellate and revisional jurisdiction over revenue cases while subjecting it to Government control.

name: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief ) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the maintenance and restoration of order in areas affected by calamities such as floods, famine, or fire. It also establishes measures for the prevention, control, and relief against these disasters, including the appointment of a Relief Commissioner with specific emergency powers.

name: The Karachi Joint Water Board (Chairman and Members Term of Office) Rules, 1956

metadata.title: The Karachi Joint Water Board (Chairman and Members' Term of Office) Rules, 1956
metadata.summary: These rules define the terms of office for the Chairman and members of the Karachi Joint Water Board. They also specify the circumstances under which a member may be removed from their position by the Central Government.

name: The West Pakistan High Court (Special Jurisdiction) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan High Court (Special Jurisdiction) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the disposal of death penalty cases pending with the Rulers of Bahawalpur and Khairpur States in their Judicial Committees as of October 14, 1955. It transfers these specific cases to the High Court of West Pakistan for re-hearing and confirms its power to amend the Khairpur State Courts Act, 1941.

name: The West Pakistan Assembly (Offices) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the role and powers of the Serjeant-at-Arms within the West Pakistan Assembly building. It grants the Speaker authority to direct the removal of persons who disorderly conduct or violate assembly rules, while providing immunity for officers acting under their duties.

name: The Removal of Difficulties (Offices of Profit) Order, 1956

metadata.title: The Removal of Difficulties (Offices of Profit) Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Constitution to provide exemptions from disqualification for holding offices of profit in the service of Pakistan. It adds a proviso allowing Parliament to declare that holders of specific acts shall not be subject to such disqualification.

name: The West Pakistan Legislative Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Legislative Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the allowances of members of the West Pakistan Legislative Assembly, including compensatory and daily allowances. It also empowers the Provincial Government to make rules regarding travelling allowances, claim procedures, and other related matters.

name: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of powers to control the production, supply, distribution, and trade in foodstuffs within West Pakistan. It was promulgated because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: The West Pakistan Conservation (Restriction on Slaughter) of Useful Animals Act, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Conservation (Restriction on Slaughter) of Useful Animals Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conservation of useful animals by restricting their slaughter. It defines specific criteria for what constitutes a 'useful animal' based on age and purpose, such as breeding or draught work.

name: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the temporary requisitioning of immovable property by the Provincial Government of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'ordinary repairs' and outlines the procedures for issuing requisition orders, serving notices to occupants, and releasing buildings back to their owners.

name: The West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act is enacted to facilitate the interpretation of West Pakistan Acts and to shorten the language used therein. It provides specific definitions for terms such as 'Acceding State', 'British India', and 'Central Government' applicable to laws in force in West Pakistan.

name: The [West Pakistan] Sind District Police (Repeal) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Sind District Police (Repeal) Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: Sind District Police Act, 1890; Bombay District Police Act, 1890 (Repeal) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Sind District Police Act, 1890. It also repeals the Bombay District Police Act, 1890 (Repeal) Ordinance, 1955.

name: The West Pakistan (Sind Ordinance Repeal) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Sind Ordinance Repeal) Act, 1956
metadata.amends: The Sind Laws (Adaptation, Revision, Repeal and Declaration) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.repeals: The Sind Laws (Adaptation, Revision, Repeal and Declaration) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Sind Laws (Adaptation, Revision, Repeal and Declaration) Ordinance, 1955, with effect from October 14, 1955. It validates all repeals, omissions, additions, and modifications made under the repealed Ordinance as if they were made under this Act.

name: The Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1954; The Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Amendment Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the extension of time limits established under the Patents and Designs Act, 1911 for performing specific acts. It empowers the Controller of Patents and Designs to grant these extensions even if the original time has expired or the application has ceased.

name: The West Pakistan Essential Supplies Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: West Pakistan Essential Supplies Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to continue powers for regulating the supply, production, treatment, and distribution of certain essential commodities. It applies to the whole of West Pakistan (excluding specific areas) and provides the government with extensive authority to control prices, manage stock, issue licenses, and take necessary actions during times when the Provincial Assembly is not in session.

name: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance removes specific disqualifications for membership in the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan related to holding offices of profit. It declares that certain listed offices, including various military reserves and local positions, shall not disqualify a person from being elected or serving as a member of the Assembly.

name: The East Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The East Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance removes specific disqualifications for membership in the Provincial Assembly of East Pakistan related to holding offices of profit. It declares that certain military and paramilitary reserve positions do not disqualify individuals from being elected or serving as members of the Assembly.

name: The National Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The National Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance removes certain disqualifications for membership of the National Assembly arising from holding specific offices of profit. It declares that holders of listed military reserve positions and other specified offices shall not be disqualified if they hold them for a period not exceeding three months from the date of promulgation.

name: The Control of Essential Commodities Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Control of Essential Commodities Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for price control and regulates trade and commerce between the Provinces and between a Province and the Federal Capital regarding essential commodities. It empowers the Central Government to make orders regulating the movement, transport, sale, and pricing of these commodities, including provisions for licensing and penalties for contravention.

name: The Control of Essential Commodities Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Control of Essential Commodities Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a framework for price control and regulates trade and commerce in essential commodities between Pakistani provinces and the Federal Capital. It empowers the Central Government to issue orders regarding the movement, transport, sale, and pricing of these commodities, including provisions for licensing and information collection.

name: The State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956

metadata.title: The State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the State Bank of Pakistan as a body corporate to regulate the country's monetary and credit system. It outlines the bank's incorporation, share capital structure, and powers to manage currency while ensuring monetary stability.

name: The Finance (1955-56) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Finance (1955-56) Act, 1956
metadata.amends: Post Office Act, 1898; Tariff Act, 1934; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the fiscal year beginning April 1, 1955. It establishes specific duties on salt and postage rates, continues certain customs and excise duties with modifications, and amends existing schedules related to tariffs and income tax.

name: The Small Industries Corporation Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Small Industries Corporation Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Small Industries Corporation to promote the development of small industries in Pakistan. It defines the Corporation's structure, share capital, management by a Board of Directors, and the guarantee provided by the Central Government for shares and dividends.

name: The International Finance Corporation Act, 1956

metadata.title: The International Finance Corporation Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to an international agreement for the establishment and operation of the International Finance Corporation (IFC) and facilitates Pakistan's participation in it. It grants the IFC full juridical personality, specific immunities from seizure and legal process, and privileges regarding its assets and communications within Pakistan.

name: The Criminal Tribes (Repeal) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Criminal Tribes (Repeal) Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Criminal Tribes Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Criminal Tribes Act, 1924. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation to facilitate the acquisition of Orient Airways Limited and develop air-transport services. It defines the Corporation's functions, powers, and administrative structure, including the composition and terms of its Board of Directors.

name: The Members of National Assembly (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Members of National Assembly (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries and allowances of Members of the National Assembly. It defines terms such as 'Member', 'Committee', and 'period of residence on duty' to determine entitlements.

name: The United Nations (Declaration of Death of Missing Persons) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The United Nations (Declaration of Death of Missing Persons) Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: The United Nations (Declaration of Death of Missing Persons) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the United Nations Convention on the Declaration of Death of Missing Persons within Pakistan. It establishes that the provisions of the Convention, adopted in 1950, shall have the force of law and allows the Central Government to amend the schedule or declare death for persons disappeared after 1945 under similar circumstances.

name: The Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Commissions of Inquiry by the Central Government to investigate matters of public importance. It vests these commissions with specific powers similar to a civil court, including summoning witnesses, examining evidence, and seizing documents.

name: The Registration of Claims (Displaced Persons) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Registration of Claims (Displaced Persons) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and verification of claims made by displaced persons regarding their property in India and areas occupied by India. It defines key terms such as 'displaced person', 'property', and 'claim', and establishes the roles of Claims Commissioners, Registering Officers, and Claims Officers to handle these cases.

name: The Finance Act, 1956

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1956
metadata.amends: Post Office Act, 1898; Tariff Act, 1934; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the fiscal year beginning April 1, 1956. It establishes specific duties on salt and postage rates, continues certain customs and excise duties with modifications, and amends existing tax laws including the Income-tax Act.

name: The West Pakistan Special Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1956

metadata.title: Pakistan Special Areas (Application of Punjab Land Revenue Act) Regulation, 1956
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies certain provisions of the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887 to the Special Areas of West Pakistan. It declares that all mines of metal, natural gas, oil, lime, Crown earth, and gold washings are deemed to be property of the Crown.

name: The West Pakistan Excluded Areas (Application of Laws)Regulation, 1956

metadata.title: West Pakistan Excluded Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1956
metadata.summary: This Regulation amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887 as it applies to the Excluded Areas of West Pakistan. It was made by the Governor of West Pakistan with the assent of the Governor-General and published on March 22, 1956.

name: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Laws) Order, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Laws) Order, 1956
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Laws) Repeal Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order adapts existing laws to the territories included in the Province of West Pakistan as per the Establishment of West Pakistan Act, 1955. It also repeals specific laws listed in Schedule II and revokes the previous Repeal Order of 1955.

name: The Pakistan Navy (Discipline) (Declaration) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The Pakistan Navy (Discipline) (Declaration) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance makes certain declarations relating to the Pakistan Navy (Discipline) Act, 1934 during an emergency. It clarifies that references to ships in commission include shore establishments and ensures judgments regarding personnel from these establishments are not questioned on that ground.

name: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1956

metadata.title: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This document establishes the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, passed by the Constituent Assembly on February 29, 1956, and assented to by the Governor-General on March 2, 1956. It outlines the structure of the state, including fundamental rights, directive principles, and the organization of federal and provincial governments.

name: The United Nations (Declaration of Death of Missing Persons) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The United Nations (Declaration of Death of Missing Persons) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the United Nations Convention on the Declaration of Death of Missing Persons in Pakistan. It empowers the Central Government to declare death for persons who disappeared under circumstances similar to those defined in the Convention, particularly regarding war or persecution between 1939 and 1945.

name: The West Pakistan Interim Legislative Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Interim Legislative Assembly (Removal of Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance removes specific disqualifications for individuals seeking election to the Interim Legislative Assembly of West Pakistan. It applies to persons holding certain public offices, including Lambardar/Inamdar, officers in the Pakistan Army or its reserves, and members of the Pakistan National Guards.

name: NA-The Federal Capital (Essential Supplies) Order, 1956

metadata.title: Federal Capital (Essential Supplies) (Amendment) Order, 1958
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Federal Capital (Essential Supplies) Order, 1956. It inserts a new sub-clause to control prices at which essential commodities may be bought or sold.

name: NA-The Karachi Courts Order, 1956

metadata.title: The Karachi Courts (Amendment) Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Karachi Courts Order, 1956 to align references with the High Court of West Pakistan and the Federal Capital. It substitutes specific terms regarding court benches and clarifies jurisdictional powers for revision cases.

name: The Capital of the Federation Order, 1959

metadata.title: The Capital of the Federation Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order designates Karachi as the Capital of the Federation. It transfers executive authority in relation to the capital from the Governor-General to the President.

name: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Laws) Order, 1955

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Laws) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the Governor of West Pakistan to make repeals, omissions, additions, and adaptations of existing laws applying to territories included in the Province of West Pakistan. It provides for the substitution of references to former provinces and authorities with those relevant to the newly established Province of West Pakistan as of the appointed day.

name: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Courts Acts) Order, 1955

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Adaptation of Courts Acts) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order adapts existing court laws to the newly constituted Province of West Pakistan. It establishes that references to various pre-existing High Courts and judicial officers shall be deemed as references to the High Court of West Pakistan. Additionally, it specifies adaptations for specific acts regarding appeals and jurisdiction within the province.

name: The Bombay District Police Act, 1890 (Repeal) Ordinance,1955

metadata.title: THE BOMBAY DISTRICT POLICE ACT, 1890 (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1955
metadata.number: West Pakistan Ordinance No. VIII of 1955
metadata.repeals: The Bombay District Police Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the application of the Bombay District Police Act, 1890 to specific districts within the Province of West Pakistan. It ensures that all actions, obligations, and proceedings commenced under the repealed Act continue validly unless inconsistent with the Police Act, 1861.

name: The West Pakistan (Board of Revenue) Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Board of Revenue) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Board of Revenue for the Province of West Pakistan and vests general superintendence and control over all Revenue Officers and Courts in the Board. It defines the Board's powers as the controlling authority for land administration and revenue collection, as well as the final appellate tribunal.

name: The High Court of West Pakistan (Establishment) Order, 1955

metadata.title: The High Court of West Pakistan (Establishment) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the High Court for the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'Chief Justice' and outlines the transfer of jurisdiction from various courts to the newly established High Court.

name: The West Pakistan (Rights, Property, Liabilities and Obligations) Order, 1955

metadata.title: Transfer of Assets and Obligations Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order declares that property and assets vested in the Chief Commissioner's Province of Baluchistan, Tribal Areas, Punjab, and North-West Frontier shall vest in Her Majesty for the government of West Pakistan. It further transfers all associated rights, liabilities, and obligations to the Province of West Pakistan as from the appointed day.

name: The West Pakistan (Functions of Government) (Authorizing) Order, 1955

metadata.title: West Pakistan (Functions of Government) (Authorizing) Order
metadata.summary: This Order authorizes the Governor of West Pakistan to exercise all functions of government in that territory. It was issued by the Governor-General on October 6, 1955, under the powers granted by the Establishment of West Pakistan Act, 1955.

name: The Validation of Laws Act, 1955

metadata.title: Validation of Laws Act, 1955
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain laws declared invalid and relates to the Constituent Assembly of Pakistan. It provides immunity from legal proceedings against the government for actions taken between August 14, 1947, and October 24, 1954.

name: The Establishment of West Pakistan Act, 1955

metadata.title: The Establishment of West Pakistan Act, 1955
