metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Province of West Pakistan and defines its territorial boundaries. It outlines the executive authority of the province, the powers of the Governor regarding special areas, and provisions concerning taxes and assets in the Federal Capital.

name: The Karachi Courts Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: The Karachi Courts Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to courts in Karachi. It applies the Sind Courts Act, 1926 to the Capital of the Federation with specific amendments regarding the appointment and jurisdiction of District Judges, Additional District Judges, and Subordinate Judges.

name: The Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: Pakistan Commissions of Inquiry Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the appointment of Commissions of Inquiry to investigate matters of public importance. It vests these commissions with specific powers similar to a civil court, including summoning witnesses, examining evidence, and seizing documents.

name: The Pakistan Military Lands and Cantonments Service (Class I) Recruitment Rules, 1955

metadata.title: The Pakistan Military Lands and Cantonments Service (Class I) Recruitment Rules, 1955
metadata.summary: These rules establish the recruitment methods for the Pakistan Military Lands and Cantonments Service (Class I), specifying that 80% of junior scale vacancies are filled via competitive examination while the remainder are filled by promotion. The document also outlines eligibility requirements, including age limits, citizenship status, and specific concessions for certain groups.

name: The State Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: The State Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment, incorporation, and management of the State Bank of Pakistan. It defines key terms related to the bank's operations, including its share capital, governance structure, and shareholder eligibility.

name: The North-West Frontier Province (Enlargement of the Area and Alteration of Boundary) Order, 1955

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province (Enlargement of the Area and Alteration of Boundary) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order enlarges the area of the North-West Frontier Province by merging specific added areas located beyond the boundaries of Mardan and Hazara districts. It alters the existing boundaries of the province to conform to these new additions and assigns the added areas to the Hazara District for administrative purposes.

name: The Art Silk Cloth (Control) Order, 1955

metadata.title: The Art. Silk Cloth (Control) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order declares artificial silk cloth as an essential commodity under the Essential Supplies (Continuance of Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1955. It establishes a regulatory framework for manufacturers, importers, and dealers regarding price limits, stock quantities, mandatory markings, and information submission to the Textile Commissioner.

name: The Constituent Assembly Order, 1955

metadata.title: The Constituent Assembly Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a new Constituent Assembly for Pakistan following the dissolution of the previous one. It outlines the procedures for summoning, proroguing, and dissolving the Assembly, defines its composition based on provincial representation, sets qualifications and disqualifications for members, and mandates an oath of allegiance.

name: The Artificial Silk (Yarn Control) Order, 1955

metadata.title: The Artificial Silk (Yarn Control) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a regulatory framework for the import and sale of artificial silk yarn in Pakistan. It empowers the Textile Commissioner to fix maximum prices, issue licenses for trade, and direct importers and dealers on distribution and record-keeping requirements.

name: The Constituent Convention (Postponement of Election) Order, 1955

metadata.title: The Constituent Convention (Postponement of Election) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order postpones the dates for receiving nominations, holding polls, and withdrawing candidatures originally set in the Constituent Convention Order, 1955. The new dates will be appointed by the Governor-General after receiving a report from the Federal Court regarding a reference under section 213 of the Government of India Act, 1935.

name: The Small Industries Corporation Rules, 1955

metadata.title: The Small Industries Corporation Rules, 1955
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1955 to establish the framework for the Corporation's operations. They define terms, mandate meetings of the Executive Committee, outline industrial research schemes, and provide for the appointment of a Financial Adviser.

name: PROCLAMATION of 1955

metadata.title: The Emergency Powers Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance declares that the Governor-General assumes necessary powers to validate and enforce laws needed to prevent a breakdown in the constitutional and administrative machinery of Pakistan. It specifically validates certain Acts passed by the Constituent Assembly which lacked the required assent from the Governor-General, deeming them valid and enforceable from their original dates.

name: The Questioned Provincial Acts Confirmation Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: The Questioned Provincial Acts Confirmation Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confirms the validity of Acts passed by Provincial Legislatures after March 14, 1954. It prevents courts from questioning these laws on the ground that they lacked the Governor-General's assent.

name: The Invalid Provincial Acts Confirmation Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: The Invalid Provincial Acts Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain Acts purportedly enacted by the Governors of East Bengal, the Punjab, and Sind during a constitutional breakdown. It declares these laws to be part of the law of Pakistan from specified dates, subject to reports from the Federal Court.

name: The Constituent Convention Order, 1955

metadata.title: Constituent Convention Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Constituent Convention of Pakistan and defines its short title, commencement, and key definitions. It outlines the powers, composition, election procedures, qualifications, and privileges of the Convention's members.

name: The Merchant Shipping (Life-Saving Appliances) Rules, 1955

metadata.title: The Merchant Shipping (Life-Saving Appliances) Rules, 1955
metadata.repeals: Government of India Department of Commerce Notification No. 46-M. I. (12) |33 dated the 5th January 1935
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the requirements for life-saving appliances on various types of merchant vessels operating in Pakistani waters. They define specific terms related to ship types, voyage classifications, and equipment standards under the Merchant Shipping Act, 1923.

name: The Merchant Shipping (Radio) Rules, 1955

metadata.title: Merchant Shipping (Radio) Rules, 1955
metadata.repeals: Notification No. %1-M.1(2)|30 dated the 10th March 1934
metadata.summary: These rules define terms related to radio installations and operators for sea-going steamers registered in Pakistan or visiting Pakistani ports. They classify ships into four categories based on passenger capacity, tonnage, and voyage duration to determine compliance requirements.

name: The West Pakistan (Appointments) Order, 1955

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Appointments) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the appointment of persons to exercise certain government functions in West Pakistan before a specified day. It is issued under section 46 of the Government of India Act, 1935 and comes into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Newsprint Control Order, 1955

metadata.title: The Newsprint Control Order, 1955
metadata.repeals: The Newsprint Control Order (No. 3), 1953
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the use of newsprint for printing and publishing newspapers, books, pamphlets, and posters in Pakistan. It defines specific standards for newsprint and establishes requirements for prior government permission before using newsprint for new publications or non-newspaper items. The Order also grants the Central Government powers to require information, inspect records, and seize contraband newsprint.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: The Finance Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to give effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the fiscal year beginning April 1, 1955. It addresses various fiscal measures including fixing salt duties, altering excise and customs rates, and continuing specific taxes under emergency provisions.

name: The Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: The Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of certain emergency powers related to requisitioned land in Pakistan. It ensures that specific orders made under previous legislation remain in force immediately before their commencement, even if they were not fully operational at that time.

name: The Essential Supplies (Continuance of Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: The Essential Supplies (Continuance of Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance of powers to control the production, treatment, storage, movement, supply, and trade of certain essential commodities during an emergency. It defines specific classes of commodities such as foodstuffs, textiles, petroleum, and steel that fall under these controls.

name: The Merchant Shipping (Safety Convention Certificates) Rules, 1955

metadata.title: The Merchant Shipping (Safety Convention Certificates) Rules, 1955
metadata.repeals: Department of Commerce Notification No. M. M. I. (11)|33, dated the 29th December, 1934
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the specific forms and requirements for various safety certificates under the Merchant Shipping Act, 1923. They supersede previous rules published by the Government of India in 1934 and come into force on May 1, 1955.

name: The West Pakistan (Establishment) Order, 1955

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Establishment) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Province of West Pakistan by combining specific areas from existing provinces and states. It authorizes the Council for Administration to take necessary steps for the province's constitution and issues directions to relevant governments and officers.

name: The Emergency Powers Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: An Ordinance to validate certain laws and to provide for certain emergency powers
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates laws enacted by the Constituent Assembly despite its unconstitutional status following a breakdown in constitutional machinery. It provides emergency powers to the Governor-General under section 102 of the Government of India Act, 1935, ensuring that such laws and orders are deemed to have legal force from their original dates.

name: The Pakistan Cantonments Account Code, 1955

metadata.title: The Pakistan Cantonments Account Code, 1955
metadata.repeals: Government of India, Army Department Notification No. 1474, dated the 7th November 1924
metadata.summary: These rules establish the financial and accounts procedures for transactions related to the Cantonment Fund in Pakistan. They define key terms such as 'Accountant-General', 'Contractor', and 'Cantonment Board' to ensure financial regularity and proper maintenance of accounts.

name: The Power Kerosene Distribution Order, 1955

metadata.title: The Power Kerosene Distribution Order, 1955
metadata.repeals: Notification No. PC-18(1)|53
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the use, sale, and supply of power kerosene in Pakistan. It establishes licensing requirements for specific machinery and vehicles designed to operate on power kerosene.

name: The Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: Small Industries Corporation Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Corporation to promote the development of small industries in Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor-General under emergency powers derived from the Government of India Act, 1935.

name: The Essential Commodities (Declaration) Order, 1955

metadata.title: Essential Commodities (Declaration) Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Order declares cement to be an essential commodity under the authority of the Governor-General. It comes into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Pakistan Army Act Rules, 1954

metadata.title: The Pakistan Army Act Rules, 1954
metadata.summary: These rules provide the short title and preliminary definitions for regulations concerning the Pakistan Army Act, 1954. They establish procedures for enrolment officers, forms of oath and affirmation, and the exercise of powers by military office holders.

name: The Agricultural Development Finance Corporation Rules, 1954

metadata.title: Agricultural Development Finance Corporation Rules, 1954
metadata.summary: These rules define the short title and definitions for the Agricultural Development Finance Corporation. They establish procedures for Board meetings, director resignations, disqualification notifications, and interest rates on loans.

name: The Registration of Claims (Displaced Persons) Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: The Ordinance II of 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration and verification of claims made by displaced persons regarding their property in India and areas occupied by India. It was promulgated by the Governor General under the powers conferred by section 42 of the Government of India Act, 1935.

name: Draft - The Merchant Shipping (Grain-Cargoes) Rules, 1955

metadata.title: The Merchant Shipping (Grain-Cargoes) Rules, 1955
metadata.summary: This document publishes a draft of the Merchant Shipping (Grain-Cargoes) Rules, 1955, for public consideration. The rules specify technical requirements for ships loading grain in Pakistani ports or entering them after being loaded elsewhere, including definitions for grain types and standards for shifting boards and uprights.

name: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Ordinance, 1955

metadata.title: An Ordinance to establish the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation as a body corporate to facilitate air transport services. It grants the Corporation powers to operate flights, train personnel, acquire property, and manage the undertaking of Orient Airways Limited.

name: The Pakistan (Establishment of Council for the Administration of West Pakistan) Order, 1954

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Establishment of Council for the Administration of West Pakistan) Order, 1954
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a Council for the administration of West Pakistan as a single administrative unit. The Council is tasked with investigating and making recommendations regarding the formation of a common secretariat, integrating provincial cadres, and coordinating administrative policy.

name: The Merchant Shipping (Pilot Ladders) Rules, 1955

metadata.title: The Merchant Shipping (Pilot Ladders) Rules, 1955
metadata.summary: This document publishes a draft of the Merchant Shipping (Pilot Ladders) Rules, 1955, proposed under the powers of section 216A of the Merchant Shipping Act, 1923. The rules specify requirements for pilot ladders on various classes of ships, including construction standards, lighting, and exemptions, with a penalty of up to two hundred rupees for breaches.

name: The Merchant Shipping (Fire Appliances) Rules, 1955

metadata.title: The Merchant Shipping (Wire Appliances) Rules, 1955
metadata.summary: This document outlines the Merchant Shipping (Wire Appliances) Rules, 1955, published in the Gazette of Pakistan. It provides a detailed index and classification for various types of ships, including passenger steamers, cargo steamers, fishing vessels, and sailing ships, regarding fire safety measures and wire appliance regulations.

name: The Merchant Shipping (Musters) Rules, 1955

metadata.title: The Merchant Shipping (Musters) Rules, 1955
metadata.amends: The Indian Merchant Shipping (Life-Saving Appliances) Rules, 1934
metadata.summary: These rules establish requirements for musters and drills on sea-going ships registered in Pakistan, including the preparation of muster lists and assignment of emergency duties. They specify training intervals for crew members based on ship class and mandate emergency signals and passenger assembly procedures.

name: The Power Alcohol Ordinance, 1954

metadata.title: The Power Alcohol Ordinance, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for matters connected with the development of the power alcohol industry under Federal control. It regulates the manufacture, disposal, and mixing of power alcohol with petrol, specifying limits on the proportion of power alcohol allowed in motor vehicle fuel.

name: Amendment in Pakistan Mining Concessions Rules, 1949

metadata.title: Pakistan Mining Concessions Rules, 1949
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Pakistan Mining Concessions Rules, 1949 by adding a new Rule 81. The amendment prescribes penalties for unauthorized prospecting of specified minerals outside granted areas or without a valid licence.

name: The Baluchistan Laws Regulation (Second Amendment) Regulation, 1954

metadata.title: Baluchistan Laws Regulation (Second Amendment) Regulation, 1954
metadata.summary: This Regulation amends the Baluchistan Laws Regulation, 1913 by adding an item to Schedule I relating to the Merchandise Marks Act, 1889. It was promulgated by the Governor-General of Pakistan on July 28, 1954, and came into force immediately.

name: The Finance Act, 1954

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1954
metadata.amends: The Post Office Act, 1898; The Finance Act, 1942; The Finance Act, 1943; The Finance Act, 1953; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning April 1, 1954. It establishes duties on salt, alters excise and customs duties, fixes income-tax rates, and continues taxes related to refugee rehabilitation.

name: The Pakistan Cantonment Servants Rules, 1954

metadata.title: The Pakistan Cantonment Servants Rules, 1954
metadata.summary: These rules govern the service, pay, and transfer of Cantonment servants in Pakistan under the authority of the Cantonments Act, 1924. They apply to all persons previously covered by the Cantonment Fund Servants Rules, 1937, and establish procedures for recruitment, promotion, and the determination of pay scales.

name: The Cotton Cloth (Control) Order, 1954

metadata.title: The Cotton Cloth (Control) Order, 1954
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a framework for the equitable distribution and availability of cotton cloth at fair prices in Pakistan. It empowers the Textile Commissioner to prescribe maximum prices, marking requirements, and licensing conditions for manufacturers, importers, and dealers.

name: The Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Ordinance, 1954

metadata.title: Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Ordinance, 1954
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the transfer to India of certain deposits belonging to evacuees and the reception in Pakistan of similar deposits belonging to refugees. It was promulgated by the Governor-General under emergency powers granted by the Government of India Act, 1935, to handle matters connected with these transfers.

name: The Martial Law (Indemnity) (Submission of Applications) Rules, 1953

metadata.title: The Martial Law (Indemnity) (Submission of Applications) Rules, 1953
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the form and procedure for submitting applications under the Martial Law (Indemnity) Act, 1953. They specify that applications must be in writing, signed by the applicant, and detail facilities for submission whether the applicant is in jail or not.

name: The Distribution of Revenues Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Distribution of Revenues Order, 1953
metadata.repeals: Government of India (Distribution of Revenues) Order, 1936; Government of Pakistan (Distribution of Revenue) Order, 1949
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the distribution of net proceeds from taxes on income and jute export duties between the Federation, Chief Commissioners' Provinces, and other States. It establishes a convention to prevent provinces from imposing taxes that encroach upon central customs and excise fields.

name: The Essential Commodities Distribution Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Essential Commodities Distribution Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Controller General of Prices and Supplies to regulate the distribution of scheduled articles. It defines key terms such as dealer, producer, and scheduled article, and empowers the Controller General to fix maximum prices and issue instructions regarding the sale of imported goods.

name: The Baluchistan Imports and Exports (Control) Regulation, 1953

metadata.title: Regulation VII of 1953
metadata.summary: This Regulation continues powers to prohibit or control imports and exports for a limited period. It was promulgated by the Governor General under the Government of India Act, 1935.

name: The Karachi Municipal Elections (Special Re-polling) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Karachi Municipal Elections (Special Re-polling) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order provides for special re-polling in specific wards of the City of Karachi Municipality. It validates nominations and actions taken under a previous notification regarding these wards and grants legal immunity to government officials acting in good faith.

name: The Artificial Silk (Yarn Control) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Artificial Silk (Yarn Control) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order establishes maximum prices for artificial silk yarn and regulates its import, sale, and distribution in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'dealer', 'consumer', and 'importer', and mandates licensing requirements for trading activities.

name: The Pakistan Junior Cadet Corps Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Pakistan Junior Cadet Corps Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and maintenance of a Junior Cadet Corps in Pakistan. It defines terms such as 'cadet' and 'Commander-in-Chief', establishes the structure of companies and battalions, and outlines the process for enrolling students and appointing officers.

name: The Martial Law (Indemnity) Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Martial Law (Indemnity) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act indemnifies servants of the Crown and other persons for acts done during the martial law period in Lahore to maintain order or carry out regulations. It declares that no legal proceedings shall lie against them unless specific conditions regarding good faith are not met, and it validates sentences passed by courts operating under martial law.

name: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and accounting of charitable fund collections to prevent fraud. It defines terms such as private funds, charitable funds, promoters, and collectors, while establishing requirements for declarations and sanctions before collecting donations.

name: The Karachi Essential Articles (Price Control and Anti-Hoarding) Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Karachi Essential Articles (Price Control and Anti-Hoarding) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the possession, distribution, sale, and prices of certain essential articles in the Capital of the Federation. It empowers the Chief Commissioner to fix maximum prices, require price markings on goods, limit stock quantities, and issue trading licenses.

name: The Chitral State (North-West Frontier Corps Law) (Extension) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Chitral State (North-West Frontier Corps Law) (Extension) Order, 1953
metadata.repeals: Chitral State Scouts Law, 1945
metadata.summary: This Order extends the Chitral State Scouts Law to include specific units like the Khyber Rifles and Thal Scouts. It amends section 7 of the original law by substituting references to various tribal areas and replacing 'Chitral' with 'North-West Frontier Province'. The Order also repeals the corresponding Chitral State Scouts Law, 1945.

name: The Power Kerosene (Motor Vehicles) (Prohibition) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Power Kerosene (Motor Vehicles) (Prohibition) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order prohibits the use of power kerosene in motor vehicles for supplying motive power. It defines key terms such as 'motor vehicle' and 'power kerosene' and establishes licensing authorities to regulate the sale and supply of this fuel.

name: The Railways (Transport of Goods) (Continuance) Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Railways (Transport of Goods) (Continuance) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act continues the Railways (Transport of Goods) Act, 1947 for a limited period. It also substitutes the word 'ten' for 'seven' in section 1(3) of the continued Act.

name: The Karachi Municipal Corporation (Revision of pay of ‘A’ Schedule Staff) Rules, 1953

metadata.title: The Karachi Municipal Corporation (Revision of pay of 'A' Schedule Staff) Rules, 1953
metadata.summary: These rules revise the pay scales for 'A' Schedule Staff of the Karachi Municipal Corporation. They establish prescribed scales effective from March 1, 1953, and provide mechanisms for officers to elect existing scales or move to new ones based on completed years of service.

name: The Baluchistan States Union (Federal Laws) (Second Extension) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Baluchistan States Union (Federal Laws) (Second Extension) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order extends various federal laws and ordinances to the Baluchistan States Union, effective from April 1, 1953. It includes specific provisions for interpreting references to acceding states and British subjects within the context of the union.

name: The Khairpur (Federal Laws) (Second Extension) Order, 1953

metadata.title: Khairpur (Federal Laws) (Second Extension) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order extends various Federal Acts and Ordinances to the State of Khairpur following its accession to Pakistan. It specifies commencement dates for different tax acts and includes amendments to specific legislation applicable within the state.

name: The Essential Commodities (Declaration No. 2) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Essential Commodities (Declaration No. 2) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order declares specific commodities listed in the Schedule as essential commodities under Pakistani law. The declared items include timber, sanitary and water supply fittings, and infant and patient foods.

name: The Territorial Constituencies (East Bengal) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Territorial Constituencies (East Bengal) Order, 1953
metadata.amends: The Government of India (Provincial Legislative) Order, 1936
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a scheme for the delimitation of territorial constituencies in the Province of East Bengal for the first elections based on adult franchise. It amends and omits specific paragraphs and schedules from the Government of India (Provincial Legislative) Order, 1936, while substituting new provisions regarding constituency extents and seats.

name: The Civil Services (Prevention of Corruption) Rules, 1953

metadata.title: Civil Services (Prevention of Corruption) Rules, 1953
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Governor-General in exercise of powers under Section 241 of the Government of India Act, 1935. They apply to persons serving in connection with the affairs of Pakistan whose conditions of service are subject to the rule-making control of the Governor-General.

name: The Karachi Electricity Rates Order,1953

metadata.title: The Karachi Electricity Rates Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This order establishes new electricity rates for the Karachi Electric Supply Corporation Ltd. effective June 1, 1953. It specifies surcharges on existing rates for various categories of power consumption, including industrial loads over 50 HP and specific schedules for hotels, cinemas, and salt works.

name: The Foodgrains (Futures and Options Prohibition) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Foodgrains (Futures and Options Prohibition) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order prohibits the entering into of futures and options agreements regarding foodgrains in Pakistan. It defines specific terms related to foodgrains, margins, and options, and outlines penalties for violating these prohibitions or using premises for such illegal activities.

name: The Rawalpindi Conspiracy (Special Leave) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Rawalpindi Conspiracy (Special Leave) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order grants full salary leave to three specific judges of the Federal Court and High Courts. The leave periods range from 72 days to eight months, with specific start dates in January and February 1953.

name: The Essential Commodities (Control of Distribution) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Essential Commodities (Control of Distribution) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Controller General of Prices and Supplies to regulate the distribution of scheduled articles in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as dealers, importers, producers, and scheduled articles, while granting the Controller General powers to approve dealers, fix maximum prices, and require information on imports and production.

name: The North-West Frontier Province (Increase of Area and Alteration of Boundary) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province (Increase of Area and Alteration of Boundary) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This order merges an area lying on the border of the Mardan District into the North-West Frontier Province following a unanimous request by its inhabitants. It alters the existing boundaries of the province and designates the added area as part of the Mardan District for administrative purposes.

name: Amendments in the Pakistan Post Office Savings Certificates Rules

metadata.title: Pakistan Post Office Savings Certificates Rules
metadata.amends: Pakistan Post Office Savings Certificates Rules
metadata.summary: This notification directs the Central Government to make further amendments to the Pakistan Post Office Savings Certificates Rules. Specifically, it substitutes higher monetary limits in Rule 18 regarding savings certificate denominations and purchase restrictions.

name: The Pakistan Insurance Corporation Rules, 1953

metadata.title: The Pakistan Insurance Corporation Rules, 1953
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under the Pakistan Insurance Corporation Act, 1952. They establish requirements for insurers operating in Pakistan regarding information submission, compulsory reinsurance with the Corporation, account verification, and the recovery of unpaid premiums.

name: The Essential Commodities (Declaration) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Essential Commodities (Declaration) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order declares specific commodities listed in the Schedule as essential commodities. The declared items include mechanically propelled vehicles, drugs and medicines, chemicals, electrical goods, medical instruments, glassware, artificial silk yarn, cycles, and matches.

name: The Cotton Textiles (Yarn Control) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Cotton Textiles (Yarn Control) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order establishes price controls and licensing requirements for the manufacture, import, and sale of cotton yarn in Pakistan. It empowers the Textile Commissioner to fix maximum prices, specify markings, and issue directions regarding production quantities and stock limits.

name: The Khairpur (Federal Laws) (Extension) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Khairpur (Federal Laws) (Extension) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order extends various Federal enactments, rules, and notifications to the Khairpur State in pursuance of the Supplementary Instrument of Accession. It includes specific provisions for interpreting references to states, subjects, provinces, and governments within the extended laws.

name: The Baluchistan States Union (Federal Laws) (Extension) Order, 1953

metadata.title: Baluchistan States Union (Federal Laws) (Extension) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order extends various federal enactments and rules to the Baluchistan States Union, effective from April 15, 1953. It includes specific provisions for interpreting references to states, subjects, and provinces within the context of this extension.

name: The Cotton Cloth and Yarn (Forward Contracts Prohibition) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Cotton Cloth and Yarn (Forward Contracts Prohibition) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order prohibits persons from entering into forward contracts for the sale or purchase of cotton cloth or yarn. It was issued by the Central Government under the Essential Supplies (Temporary Powers) Act, 1946 to ensure equitable distribution and availability of essential supplies at fair prices.

name: The Newsprint Control Order (No. 3) 1953

metadata.title: The Newsprint Control Order (No. 3), 1953
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the purchase, acquisition, and use of newsprint within Pakistan. It establishes a permit system for newspaper proprietors to acquire newsprint and restricts non-proprietors from buying it without specific authorization.

name: PNA-Amendments in the Central (Gazetted) Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 1951

metadata.title: Central (Gazetted) Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 1951
metadata.amends: Central (Gazetted) Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 1951
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Central (Gazetted) Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 1951, to update pay scales and service classifications for various government posts. The amendments cover departments including Forests, Cabinet Secretariat, Communications, Defence, and Agriculture, with changes deemed effective from January 1, 1949.

name: Extension of Section 11 of the Pakistan Rehabilitation Ordinance, 1948 to the Province of Punjab

metadata.title: Notification
metadata.summary: This notification orders that section 11 of the Pakistan Rehabilitation Ordinance, 1948 shall come into force in the Province of the Punjab. It was issued by the Ministry of Refugees and Rehabilitation on December 23, 1952.

name: Amendments in the Central (Gazetted) Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 1951

metadata.title: Central (Gazetted) Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 1951
metadata.amends: Central (Gazetted) Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 1951
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Central (Gazetted) Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 1951 to update salary scales and pay grades for various officers. It specifically addresses revisions within the Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Interior, and Information and Broadcasting Division.

name: The Prevention of Smuggling Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Prevention of Smuggling Act, 1952
metadata.repeals: The Sind Electricity Control Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to prevent the smuggling of certain commodities across Pakistan. It establishes restrictions on possession and movement of these goods, outlines penalties including imprisonment and fines, and grants specific powers to magistrates for sentencing.

name: The Passport (Offences) Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Passport (Offences) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act introduces legislation to prevent specific offences related to passports and other travel documents. It defines penalties for actions such as making false statements, forging passports, trafficking in passports, and wrongful possession of passports.

name: The Pakistan (Control of Entry) Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Control of Entry) Act, 1959
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of Indian citizens entering Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'enter', 'passport', 'visa', 'permit', 'Indian citizen', and 'Pakistan citizen'.

name: The Pakistan Nursing Council Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Pakistan Nursing Council Act, 1952
metadata.repeals: The Prevention of Smuggling Ordinance, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Central Nursing Council to ensure uniform training standards for nurses, midwives, and health visitors across Pakistan. It defines the composition of the Council, outlines procedures for elections and nominations, and sets rules regarding meetings, quorums, and vacancies.

name: The Pending Proceedings (Indian Courts) Act, 1952

metadata.title: The (Indian Courts) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides an alternative remedy regarding decrees and orders secured against India. It enacts provisions to regulate legal proceedings in this specific context.

name: The Karachi Electricity Control Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Karachi Electricity Supply Act, 1952
metadata.repeals: Sind Electricity Control Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act provides powers to the Central Government to control the production, distribution, and consumption of electrical energy in the Federal Capital. It establishes regulations regarding supply rates, licensing requirements, and penalties for contravening government orders.

name: The Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1952

metadata.title: An Act to provide for the maintenance of certain essential services
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance of certain essential services during a continuing state of emergency declared under the Government of India Act, 1935. It empowers the government to issue orders restricting the movement of employees in essential services and regulates their wages and conditions.

name: The Royal Pakistan Air Force (Extension of Service) Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Air Force Validation of Discharges Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain discharges of airmen from the Royal Pakistan Air Force that were ordered between August 15, 1947, and the date of this Act's commencement. It declares these orders lawful and valid despite being made in purported exercise of powers conferred on the Commander-in-Chief.

name: The Air Force Validation of Discharges Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Air Force Validation of Discharges Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain discharges of airmen from the Royal Pakistan Air Force that were ordered between August 15, 1947, and the date this Act came into force. It declares these orders lawful and valid despite being made in purported exercise of powers conferred on the Commander-in-Chief, and provides indemnity against legal proceedings regarding their validity.

name: The Opium (Extension to the North-West Frontier Province) Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Opium (Extension to the North-West Frontier Province) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Opium Act, 1857 to the North-West Frontier Province. It was enacted by the Governor-General and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Registration (Importers and Exporters) Order, 1952

metadata.title: The Registration (Importers and Exporters) Order, 1952
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the registration requirements for importers and exporters in Pakistan under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950. It defines key terms such as 'branch', 'Chief Controller', and 'family' to regulate foreign trade activities.

name: The Bahawalpur (Federal Laws) (Extension) Order, 1952

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur (Federal Laws) (Extension) Order, 1952
metadata.summary: This Order extends various Federal Acts and Ordinances to the State of Bahawalpur in pursuance of the Second Supplementary Instrument of Accession. It specifies that any corresponding laws existing in Bahawalpur prior to this Order's commencement shall cease to have effect.

name: The Pakistan (Control of Entry) Ordinance, 1952

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Control Entry) Ordinance, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to make better provision for controlling the entry of Indian citizens into Pakistan during an emergency. It establishes requirements for passports, visas, and specific travel documents, while also defining offenses related to false statements and unauthorized entry.

name: The Pending Proceedings (Indian Courts) Ordinance, 1952

metadata.title: The Pending Proceedings (Indian Courts) Ordinance, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance renders ineffective certain decrees and orders passed by courts in India against a Government in Pakistan. It also provides an alternative remedy for persons who have secured such decrees or orders.

name: The Royal Pakistan Air Force (Extension of Service) Ordinance, 1952

metadata.title: The Royal Pakistan Air Force (Extension of Service) Ordinance, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor-General to provide for the retention in service of certain persons enrolled in the Royal Pakistan Air Force during an emergency. It allows personnel whose original term of service has expired to continue serving until discharged or until a maximum extension period of six years is reached.

name: The Prevention of Smuggling Ordinance, 1952

metadata.title: The Prevention of Smuggling Ordinance, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to provide immediate measures for preventing the smuggling of certain commodities due to an emergency. It defines key terms, outlines offenses regarding possession or movement of notified goods, and prescribes penalties including imprisonment and fines.

name: The Pakistan (Audit and Accounts) Order, 1952

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Audit and Accounts) Order, 1952
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the conditions of service for the Auditor-General of Pakistan and defines their powers regarding federal and provincial accounts. It establishes rules for resignation, retirement age, leave grants, and the duration of office for the Auditor-General.

name: The Zhob Militia (Application to Mekran, Pishin and Chagai) Order, 1952

metadata.title: The Zhob Militia (Application to Mekran, Pishin and Chagai) Order, 1952
metadata.summary: This Order declares that the territories of Mekran, Pishin, and Chagai are subject to the jurisdiction of the Governor-General under the Extra-Provincial Jurisdiction Order, 1949. It extends the provisions of the Zhob Militia Law to apply to the Mekran Militia, Pishin Scouts, and Chagai Militia as if they were the Zhob Militia.

name: The Allowances and Privileges (Governors) Order, 1952

metadata.title: The Allowances and Privileges (Governors) Order, 1952
metadata.summary: This Order determines the allowances and customs privileges for Governors of Provinces in Pakistan. It specifies payments for appointment, retirement, official residences, transport, and other benefits, while also defining terms related to acting governors.

name: The Pakistan Army Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Pakistan Army Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the Pakistan Army. It defines who is subject to the Act, including officers, junior commissioned officers, warrant officers, and persons in active service or followers of the army.

name: The Pakistan Insurance Corporation Act, 1952

metadata.title: Pakistan Insurance Corporation Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Insurance Corporation to develop insurance business within Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'Corporation', 'Board', and 'insurance company' and outlines provisions regarding share registration and guarantees.

name: NA- The Sind Rent Restriction Act, 1947

metadata.title: The Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Amendment Act, 1948
metadata.amends: Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1942
metadata.repeals: Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Amendment Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1942. It substitutes specific subsections regarding the duration of force and inserts references to the separation of India and Pakistan into Dominions.

name: The Pakistan Military Nursing Service Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Pakistan Military Nursing Service Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes a force designated as the Pakistan Military Nursing Service to be part of the Armed Forces of Pakistan. It provides for the discipline, appointment, and regulation of members of this service.

name: The Security of Pakistan Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Security of Pakistan Act, 1959
metadata.summary: This Act provides powers to the Central Government to make orders for the maintenance of supplies, services, and public order within Pakistan. It allows for restrictions on an individual's movement, residence, employment, and possession of articles, as well as their detention.

name: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Karachi Control of Disorderly Persons Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better control of disorderly persons in the Capital of the Federation. It establishes a Tribunal with specific powers to conduct enquiries, accept evidence under relaxed conditions, and declare individuals as disorderly or dangerous disorderly persons.

name: The Civil Defence Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Civil Defence Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides powers to secure the civil defence of the Federation of Pakistan. It empowers the Central Government to make rules regarding Air Raid Precautions Services, evacuation measures, fire prevention, and the protection of public utilities and buildings.

name: The Land Control (Capital of the Federation) Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Land Control Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of land and buildings within the Capital of the Federation, specifically Karachi. It defines key terms such as 'Administrator', 'Authorised Officer', and 'controlled area', and outlines procedures for eviction and the publication of notifications regarding controlled lands.

name: Finance Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1952
metadata.amends: The Post Office Act, 1898; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Stamp Act, 1899; The Court Fees Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning April 1, 1952. It fixes duties on salt and postage, alters customs and excise duties on specific articles, and continues various taxes including business profits tax and sales tax.

name: The Bahawalpur (Extension of Laws) Order, 1952

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur (Extension of Laws) Order, 1952
metadata.amends: The Income-tax Act, 1922; the Business Profits Tax Act, 1947; the Estate Duty Act, 1950; the Pakistan General Sales Tax Act, 1948; the Sales Tax Act, 1951; the Revenue Recovery Act, 1890; the Transfer of Property (Pakistan) Ordinance, 1947; the Central Excise and Salt Act, 1944; the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930; and the Stamp Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Order extends various Acts and Ordinances from the Provinces of Pakistan to the State of Bahawalpur. It also incorporates specific amendments into these extended laws as they apply within the state.

name: The Central Excises (Distribution of Revenue) Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Central Excises and Sales Tax Act, 1946
metadata.amends: The Central Excises and Sales Tax Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Central Excises and Sales Tax Act, 1946 by adding new entries to the Seventh Schedule regarding taxes on the sale of goods. It also provides for the continued operation of specific Provincial Legislature Acts with necessary adaptations.

name: The Pakistan Public Safety Ordinance, 1952

metadata.title: The Ordinance to provide for special measures for the maintenance of public safety
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides special measures for the maintenance of public safety in Pakistan. It grants the Central Government authority to issue orders regarding detention, movement restrictions, and reporting requirements for specific individuals.

name: The North-West Frontier Province (Enlargement of the Area and Alteration of Boundary) Order, 1952

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province (Enlargement of the Area and Alteration of Boundary) Order, 1952
metadata.summary: This Order enlarges the area of the North-West Frontier Province by merging an added region beyond the western border of the Hazara District. It alters the provincial boundaries and stipulates that the new area shall form part of the province for administrative purposes, with revenues and expenditures integrated accordingly.

name: The Pakistan Citizenship Rules, 1952

metadata.title: The Pakistan Citizenship Rules, 1952
metadata.summary: These rules were framed by the Federal Government under section 23 of the Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951. They prescribe the procedures for granting citizenship certificates to persons claiming rights under various clauses of the Act.

name: The Land Control (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1952

metadata.title: The Land Control (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of unauthorised occupation of lands and unauthorised building within the Capital of the Federation. It also establishes mechanisms for eviction from such lands and buildings, including the declaration of controlled areas and the requirement for written permission before erecting structures.

name: The Karachi Foodgrains (Sale and Possession) Control Order, 1952

metadata.title: The Karachi Foodgrains (Sale and Possession) Control Order, 1952
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the purchase, sale, and storage of foodgrains in Karachi by establishing licensing requirements and possession limits. It defines various categories of sellers, including wholesale dealers, retail dealers, hawkers, and establishments, while specifying normal quantities allowed for each.

name: The Army Validation of Proceedings Ordinance, 1952

metadata.title: Army Validation of Proceedings Ordinance, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates acts and proceedings taken by persons appointed to exercise the powers of the Commander-in-Chief of the Pakistan Army during his absence from duty between October 10, 1951, and December 10, 1951. It declares these actions lawful under the Indian Army Act, 1911, and provides immunity from legal proceedings regarding their validity.

name: The Allowances and Privileges (Governor-General’s) Order, 1951

metadata.title: The Allowances and Privileges (Governor-General's) Order, 1951
metadata.summary: This Order determines the allowances and customs privileges for the Governor-General of Pakistan. It applies to both the acting Governor-General and the official residence, specifying various expenses related to furnishings, maintenance, and official duties.

name: Proclamation by the Governor-General Assuming the Legislative Powers of the Government of Sind

metadata.title: The Proclamation dated the 29th December 1951
metadata.summary: This Proclamation directs the Governor of Sind to assume all powers vested in the Provincial Legislature on behalf of the Governor-General. It suspends specific sections of the Government of India Act, 1935, and establishes rules for legislative preparation, financial expenditure, and legal references within the Province.

name: The Boiler Regulation, 1951

metadata.title: The Boiler Regulations, 1951
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the standard conditions for material, design, and construction required for boiler registration under the Boilers Act, 1923. They mandate supervision by an Inspecting Officer during construction and require specific certificates from recognized authorities for imported boilers.

name: The Karachi Indecent Advertisement Prohibition Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Karachi Indecent Advertisement Prohibition Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the publication and display of indecent advertisements within the Capital of the Federation. It outlines punishments for contravention, grants powers to seize offending materials, and specifies exemptions for public health authorities and medical professions.

name: The Karachi Foodgrains Control Order, 1951

metadata.title: The Karachi Foodgrains Control Order, 1951
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the purchase, sale, and storage for sale of foodgrains in Karachi. It defines terms such as 'foodgrains', 'wholesale dealer', and 'retail dealer', and establishes licensing requirements for those engaging in these activities.

name: The Civil Defence Ordinance, 1951

metadata.title: The Civil Defence Ordinance, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides the Governor-General with powers to secure civil defence for the Federation of Pakistan during an emergency. It authorizes the Central Government to make rules regarding Air Raid Precautions Services, evacuation measures, fire prevention, and the protection of public utilities and private property.

name: The Provincial Franchise (Absent Official Persons) Order, 1951

metadata.title: The Provincial Franchise (Absent Official Persons) Order, 1951
metadata.summary: This Order provides the legal framework for absent voters, including government officials and defence personnel, to cast their votes in elections. It details specific procedures for sealing, transmitting, and acknowledging these votes via registered post to the Central Returning Officer.

name: The Railway Air Raid Precautions Services Rules, 1951

metadata.title: Railway Air Raid Precautions Services Rules, 1951
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for Railway Air Raid Precautions Services under the authority of the Civil Defence (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1951. They define key terms, outline the structure of various sub-services such as Wardens and Rescue, and set out procedures for appointing and releasing members of the service.

name: The Territorial Constituencies (North-West Frontier Province) Order, 1951

metadata.title: The Territorial Constituencies (North-West Frontier Province) Order, 1951
metadata.amends: The Government of India (Provincial Legislative Assemblies) Order, 1936
metadata.summary: This Order delimits the territorial constituencies in the North-West Frontier Province for the first elections based on adult franchise. It amends the Government of India (Provincial Legislative Assemblies) Order, 1936 by inserting provisions regarding women's reserved seats and omitting specific paragraphs.

name: The Federal Court Rules, 1951

metadata.title: Amendment to the Federal Court Rules, 1950
metadata.summary: This notification publishes an amendment to the Federal Court Rules, 1950, made by the Federal Court with the approval of the Governor-General. The specific change substitutes the word 'ninety' with 'thirty' in Order XLIV, rule 1 of the rules.

name: The Sales Tax Rules, 1951

metadata.title: The Sales Tax Rules, 1951
metadata.summary: These rules provide the procedural framework for obtaining and renewing sales tax licenses under the Sales Tax Act, 1951. They define key terms such as 'place of business' and 'treasury', outline application requirements including fees and forms, and establish conditions for license discontinuance and changes in business ownership.

name: The Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act, 1951
metadata.repeals: The Acts and Ordinances specified in the First Schedule; The Acts and Ordinances specified in the Second Schedule to the extent mentioned therein
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and revises the text of Central Acts and Ordinances of Pakistan enacted since August 14, 1947. It wholly repeals certain acts listed in the First Schedule, partially repeals others in the Second Schedule, amends specific acts in the Third and Fourth Schedules, and declares that laws from British India no longer form part of Pakistani law.

name: The Embodiment (Pakistan National Guard) (Validation) Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Post Office (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Post Office Act, 1898 to insert specific words regarding treasonable content into its sections. It also substitutes references to section 124A of the Indian Penal Code with corresponding sections of the Pakistan Penal Code.

name: The Salaries and Allowances of Ministers of State Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Court-fees (Amendment) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Court-fees Act, 1870. It extends to the Capital of the Federation and comes into force immediately.

name: The Opium (Extension to the Punjab) Act, 1951

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province Disturbed Areas (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1947
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Disturbed Areas (Special Powers) Ordinance of the Armed Forces, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance empowers officers of the Pakistan Army and Royal Pakistan Air Force to exercise special powers in areas declared as disturbed. These powers include arresting persons for cognizable offences, entering premises without a warrant, and recovering stolen property or unlawfully kept arms.

name: The North-West Frontier Province Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Act, 1951

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Province Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Act, 1951
metadata.repeals: North-West Frontier Province Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act extends special powers to officers of the Pakistan Army and Royal Pakistan Air Force in declared disturbed areas. It allows these officers to exercise police powers, make arrests without warrants, and conduct searches for stolen property or unlawful arms.

name: The Punjab Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Punjab Disturbed Areas Act, 1951
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Act, 1947; The West Punjab Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of the Armed Forces and Validation of Certain Acts) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act extends to the whole of Punjab and confers special powers upon officers of the Pakistan Army or Royal Air Force in declared disturbed areas. It allows these officers to arrest persons committing cognizable offences, enter premises without a warrant for search, and recover stolen property or unlawfully kept arms. The legislation deems itself effective from August 15, 1947, while repealing previous ordinances related to special powers of armed forces in Punjab.

name: The Rawalpindi Conspiracy (Special Tribunal) Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Rawalpindi Conspiracy (Special Tribunal) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Special Tribunal composed of three judges to try the Rawalpindi Conspiracy Case and related matters. It outlines the tribunal's powers, procedures, and restrictions, such as prohibiting bail for accused persons and requiring trials without a jury.

name: The Cotton Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Cotton Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to safeguard international trade in cotton within Pakistan. It establishes a Cotton Board to regulate the ginning, pressing, and storage of cotton, while also empowering the Central Government to fix minimum prices and requisition factories for specific purposes.

name: The Delimitation of Constituencies (Adult Franchise) Act, 1951

metadata.title: Delimitation of Territorial Constituencies Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the delimitation of territorial constituencies for the Legislative Assemblies of the Provinces following amendments to the Government of India Act, 1935. It establishes a Committee appointed by the Central Government to prepare schemes for constituency boundaries based on adult suffrage.

name: The Iqbal Academy Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Iqbal Academy Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the Iqbal Academy as a body corporate with perpetual succession to promote the works and teachings of Allama Iqbal. It establishes the structure of the Academy, including its Council, membership categories, powers such as establishing branches and awarding scholarships, and sources of funding.

name: The Sales Tax Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Sales Tax Act, 1951
metadata.amends: The law relating to the levy of a tax on the sale or consumption of goods
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws regarding the levy of taxes on the sale or consumption of goods. It defines key terms such as 'goods', 'assessee', and various commissioners, while establishing its application across all provinces and the capital of the Federation.

name: The Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the acquisition of citizenship in Pakistan through birth, descent, migration, or naturalization. It defines key terms such as 'alien' and establishes conditions under which a person is considered a citizen by virtue of their birth or parentage.

name: The Fruit Products Control Order, 1951

metadata.title: The Fruit Products Control Order, 1951
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the manufacture and sale of fruit products across all provinces and the capital of Pakistan. It establishes two Advisory Committees for East and West Pakistan to oversee licensing applications and appeals regarding refusals.

name: The Finance Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1951
metadata.amends: The Indian Finance Act, 1942; The Post Office Act, 1898; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning April 1, 1951. It establishes duties on salt and postage, alters customs and excise rates, and provides provisions regarding income-tax, super-tax, estate duty, and sales tax.

name: The Pakistan Rehabilitation Rule, 1951

metadata.title: The Pakistan Rehabilitation Ordinance, 1951 Rules
metadata.summary: These rules provide the administrative and executive procedures for the Pakistan Rehabilitation Ordinance, 1951. They define terms related to the Rehabilitation Commission and outline processes for summary ejectment of unauthorized persons from allotted property.

name: The Import and Export Licences Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1950 Rules, 1951

metadata.title: Import and Export Licences Rules, 1951
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under section 20 of the Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1950. They establish procedures for calculating tax on import and export licences based on their declared values and mandate that such taxes be recovered as arrears of land revenue.

name: The Pakistan Industrial Finance Corporation Rules, 1950

metadata.title: The Pakistan Industrial Finance Corporation Rules, 1950
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under the Pakistan Industrial Finance Corporation Act 1949. They establish procedures for the Corporation to submit semi-annual returns on loans and investments, as well as powers for the government to request information regarding applications.

name: NA - The Baluchistan (Rehabilitation) Rules, 1951

metadata.title: 10-A, Fees
metadata.summary: This notification prescribes the court-fee stamps required for various applications regarding land allotment and factory registrations in Balochistan. It specifies different fee amounts based on the type of industry, whether the factory is registered or unregistered, and the nature of the land applied for.

name: Amendments in the Census of Manufacturing Industries Rules, 1945

metadata.title: The Census of Manufactures Rules
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Census of Manufactures Rules, 1942, by adding new entries to the schedules listing various industries. It also substitutes specific text in Rule 3 regarding seasonal industries and updates the list of industries subject to statistical reporting.

name: Amendment in Auditor's Certifcates Rules, 1932

metadata.title: Auditors' Certificates Rules, 1932
metadata.summary: This document amends the Auditors' Certificates Rules, 1932 by adding a new rule regarding conditions for registered accountants not permanently residing in Pakistan. It also modifies Rule 14 to include clauses addressing compliance with these new government-imposed conditions.

name: The Cotton Ordinance, 1950

metadata.title: The Cotton Ordinance, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides emergency measures to safeguard international trade in cotton within Pakistan. It establishes a Cotton Board, fixes minimum prices for cotton transactions, and grants the Central Government powers to requisition factories and regulate related charges.

name: The Indian Army ( Application of Provisions) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Indian Army (Application of Provisions) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act applies the provisions of the Indian Army Act, 1911, to certain officers of the Pakistan Army who held His Majesty's Commissions in the Land Forces. It deems these officers as Indian Commissioned Officers for the purposes of that Act while preserving their existing service conditions regarding remuneration, leave, pension, and gratuity.

name: The Railways (Transport of Goods) (Continuance) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Railways (Transport of Goods) (Continuance) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act continues the Railways (Transport of Goods) Act, 1947 for a limited period. It substitutes the word 'seven' for 'four' in section 1(5) of the continued Act and specifies that it comes into force on March 25, 1951.

name: The Medical Practitioners (National Service) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Medical Practitioners (National Service) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for national service by medical practitioners to address shortages in certain services and safeguard national health. It defines the liability of registered medical practitioners or degree holders under thirty-two years of age who are nationals of Pakistan to be called up for this service.

name: The East Bengal (Smuggling of Foodgrains) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The East Bengal (Smuggling of Foodgrains) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions to prevent the smuggling of foodgrains within East Bengal. It defines key terms such as 'foodgrains', 'smuggling', and 'fair price', and grants authorized officers powers to inspect premises, seize contraband, and confiscate goods involved in violations.

name: The Chalna Anchorage Rules, 1950

metadata.title: The Chalna Anchorage Rules
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Ports Act, 1908 to regulate the Chalna Anchorage. They define specific terms related to vessels and establish procedures for entering or leaving the anchorage, including reporting requirements for masters of vessels.

name: The Sea Salt Control Order, 1950

metadata.title: The Sea Salt Control Order, 1950
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the manufacture, sale, stocking, and distribution of sea salt in Pakistan. It establishes the powers of a Controller to fix prices, authorize dealers, and issue transport permits for sea salt.

name: The Finance (Supplementary Taxes) Rules, 1950

metadata.title: The Finance (Supplementary Taxes) Rules, 1950
metadata.summary: These rules establish supplementary taxes imposed under the Finance Act, 1950. They outline procedures for assessing additional income-tax, sales tax on dealers, and taxes on air passages and professions.

name: The Karachi Hotels and Lodging Houses (Control) Rules, 1950

metadata.title: Karachi Hotels and Lodging Houses (Control) Rules, 1950
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under the Karachi Hotels and Lodging Houses (Control) Act, 1950 to establish administrative procedures for hotel control. The document outlines the appointment of controllers, the composition and meeting requirements of advisory committees, registration fees, and the specific forms required for application and certification.

name: The Chalna Anchorage Rules, 1950

metadata.title: Chalna Anchorage Rules
metadata.summary: These rules define the Chalna Anchorage and the navigable portion of the river Pussur as a major port under the Ports Act, 1908. The document establishes definitions for key terms such as vessel, master, and steam vessel, and sets preliminary provisions for entering or leaving the anchorage.

name: The Baluchistan Opium Smoking Regulation, 1950

metadata.title: Baluchistan Opium Smoking Regulation 1950
metadata.summary: This Regulation prohibits the smoking of opium in Baluchistan. It was promulgated by the Governor-General under the Government of India Act, 1935, and came into force on September 29, 1950.

name: The Vagrancy (Capital of the Federation) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Vagrancy Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for dealing with vagrancy in the Capital of the Federation. It defines terms such as 'vagrant', 'child', and 'Poor House', and establishes the powers of Special Magistrates to inquire into cases, declare individuals as vagrants, and order their detention or placement in a Poor House.

name: The Pakistan Inscribed Notes and India Coin Withdrawal Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Pakistan Inscribed Notes and India Coin Withdrawal Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the accelerated withdrawal of Pakistan inscribed notes and India coins from circulation. It declares that these specific notes and coins shall cease to be legal tender on dates appointed by the Central Government via notification.

name: The Karachi Cattle Slaughter Control Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Karachi Cattle Slaughter Control Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the slaughter of useful cattle and regulates the slaughter of other cattle within the Capital of the Federation. It defines terms such as 'useful cattle' and establishes procedures for examination, approval, and seizure of animals slaughtered in contravention of the law.

name: The Karachi Hotels and Lodging-houses (Control) Act, 1950

metadata.title: Karachi Hotels and Lodging-houses (Control) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides special measures for the control of rates chargeable in hotels and lodging-houses located in Karachi. It also establishes provisions for the reservation of accommodation therein and covers various ancillary matters related to these establishments.

name: The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act serves as a supplementary finance measure for the Federation of Pakistan. It contains amendments to the Finance Act, 1950, specifically altering sections related to duties and expenditure on refugee rehabilitation.

name: The Pakistan National Guard Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Pakistan National Guard Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution and discipline of a National Guard for Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'district', 'enrolled', and 'officer', and establishes classes of officers within the guard.

name: The Protective Duties Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Protective Duties Act, 1950
metadata.repeals: The Protective Duties Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Central Government to immediately impose protective customs duties on imported goods produced or manufactured in Pakistan. It stipulates that these duties are leviable under the Customs Act, 1934, and provides for the introduction of a bill to continue such duties after the initial notification period expires.

name: The University of Karachi Act, 1950

metadata.title: The University of Karachi Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and incorporates a University at Karachi. It defines key terms such as college, hall, principal, and registered graduate, and grants the University powers to regulate admission, conduct research, and manage academic affairs.

name: The Cotton Contracts (Extension of Time) Ordinance, 1950

metadata.title: The Cotton Contracts (Extension of Time) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the delivery period for specific factory selection contracts involving cotton that were due in September or October 1950. It applies to all provinces and the capital of the Federation, setting a new deadline of November 15, 1950, for deliveries not yet made.

name: The Pakistan Territorial Force Act, 1950

metadata.title: Pakistan Territorial Force Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the Pakistan Territorial Force and provides for its administration and discipline. It defines terms such as 'officer' and outlines the process for enrolment, discharge, and liability of persons serving in the force.

name: The Refugees (Registration of Land Claims) (Baluchistan) Regulation, 1950

metadata.title: The Refugees (Registration of Land Claims) (Baluchistan) Regulation, 1950
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the registration of land claims by persons who were forced to abandon their land in specific territories of India due to disturbances following the partition. It defines key terms such as 'refugee', 'land', and 'Registering Officer' and establishes the procedure for submitting applications supported by affidavits.

name: The Leased Areas (Laws) Order, 1950

metadata.title: The Leased Areas (Laws) Order, 1950
metadata.summary: This Order extends the laws of Baluchistan to the Leased Areas, which include Quetta District, Nushki Tahsil, Bolan District, and Nasirabad Sub-Division. It deems these laws to have come into force on August 15, 1947, and provides for their application with necessary modifications in courts.

name: The working of the Karachi Police Prosecuting Agency Rules, 1950

metadata.title: Rules for the working of the Karachi Police Prosecuting Agency
metadata.summary: This notification establishes rules for the preparation, scrutiny, and submission of charge sheets by the Karachi Police Prosecuting Agency. It outlines specific procedures for collecting witnesses, recording evidence, and managing court appearances to ensure efficient disposal of police cases.

name: The Administration of Evacuee Property Rules, 1950

metadata.title: The Administration of Evacuee Property Rules, 1950
metadata.amends: The Administration of Evacuee Property Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under the Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1949 to regulate the administration of evacuee property. They supersede previous notifications and establish procedures for taking possession of property, appointing managers, allocating work, and furnishing security.

name: The Flour Mills Control Order, 1950

metadata.title: The Flour Mills Control Order, 1950
metadata.summary: This Order establishes government control over flour mills and wheat product production in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'Controller', 'Dealer', and 'Producer', and mandates compliance with specific directions regarding the cleaning, milling, and distribution of wheat.

name: The Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Rules, 1950

metadata.title: The Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Rules, 1950
metadata.summary: These Rules were made by the Central Government under section 7 of the Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Act, 1949. They establish procedures for referring authorities to make orders regarding misconduct in public or representative offices, including requirements for applications, deposits, and the conduct of inquiries by Courts or Tribunals.

name: The Baluchistan (Rehabilitation) Regulation, 1950

metadata.title: The Baluchistan (Rehabilitation) Regulation, 1950
metadata.repeals: The Evacuees Property) Regulation, 1948 (1 of 1948)
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the restoration and maintenance of social and economic life in Baluchistan. It also establishes provisions for the orderly settlement of persons who have taken refuge in the region.

name: The Karachi Improvement Trust Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Karachi Improvement Trust Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development and expansion of the Capital of the Federation (Karachi) and certain nearby areas. It establishes a Board of Trustees with special powers to execute improvement schemes, acquire land, demolish or construct buildings, and rehouse displaced persons.

name: The Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation Act, 1950

metadata.title: Development of Industries (Federal Control) Amendment Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1949 to grant the Central Government power to regulate the setting up of new or existing industrial undertakings. It inserts a new section allowing the government to plan and regulate industries in accordance with previous declarations.

name: The Salaries and Allowances of Deputy Ministers Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Salaries and Allowances of Deputy Ministers Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries and allowances of Deputy Ministers of the Governor-General of Pakistan. It also defines terms such as 'Deputy Minister', 'residence', and 'prescribed' within the context of this legislation.

name: The Trade Marks (Invalidation and Summary Registration) Act, 1950

metadata.title: Pakistan Public Safety (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Pakistan Public Safety Ordinance, 1949 to apply the General Clauses Act upon its expiry. It also adds new sections regarding the delegation of powers to the Administrator of Karachi and the power to make rules.

name: The Railways (Transport of Goods) (Revival and Continuance) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Railways (Transport of Goods) (Revival and Continuance) Act
metadata.summary: This Act revives and continues the Railways (Transport of Goods) Act, 1947 for a limited period. It substitutes the word 'four' for 'three' in section 1(3) of the revived Act.

name: The Pakistan (Army and Air Force) Reserves Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Army and Air Force) Reserves Act, 1950
metadata.repeals: The Indian Reserve Forces Act, 1888
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the government and discipline of the Pakistan Army and Air Force Reserves. It defines the categories of reservists, outlines their service obligations, and empowers the Central Government to make rules regarding pay, allowances, and training.

name: The International Monetary Fund and Bank Act, 1950
