metadata.title: The International Monetary Fund and Bank Act, 1950
subjects: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development
metadata.summary: This Act implements the agreements drawn up at the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference held at Bretton Woods in July 1944 regarding the International Monetary Fund and the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development. It establishes provisions for payments by the Central Government to these international bodies, designates the State Bank of Pakistan as the depository for currency holdings, and mandates information furnishing requirements.

name: The Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act continues for a limited period the powers of the Central Government to prohibit, restrict, or control imports into and exports from Pakistan. It establishes the legal framework for issuing licences, defining key terms like 'import' and 'export', and outlines penalties for contravening orders made under the legislation.

name: The Pakistan (Punjab Boundary) Order, 1950

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Punjab Boundary) Order, 1950
metadata.summary: This Order merges the Baluch area of Dera Ghazi Khan District into the Province of Punjab based on a unanimous petition by local inhabitants. It extends the provincial boundary to include this area and assigns its administrative expenditure to the province's revenues.

name: The Federal Court Rules, 1950

metadata.title: The Federal Court Rules, 1950
metadata.repeals: The Rules of the Federal Court of India made applicable to the Federal Court of Pakistan by virtue of the Federal Court of Pakistan Order, 1948
metadata.summary: These Rules establish the procedural framework for the Federal Court of Pakistan, defining terms, office hours, and term schedules. They also specify the roles of officers like the Registrar and outline the court's sitting arrangements in Karachi and other places.

name: The Pakistan Currency Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Pakistan Currency Act, 1950
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan Currency Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the issue and circulation of Government of Pakistan one-rupee notes. It defines these notes as legal tender in Pakistan and specifies that they are not considered currency notes under the 1947 Monetary System Order.

name: The Postponement of Obligations Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Postponement of Obligations Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act relieves against the consequences of declaring specific days in September 1949 as public holidays under the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881. It deems certain debts and instruments due on those holidays to be payable on a later date and excludes the holiday period from computing payment deadlines.

name: The Finance Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1950
metadata.amends: The Post Office Act, 1898; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Income-tax Act, 1922; The Business Profits Tax Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning April 1, 1950. It fixes scales for various duties including estate duty, salt duty, and customs/excise on specific articles while also setting rates for income tax, super-tax, and sales tax.

name: The Imports and Exports (Control) Ordinance, 1950

metadata.title: The Imports and Exports (Control) Ordinance, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the life of emergency powers to control imports and exports into and out of Pakistan. It amends Section 1 of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1947, by substituting a new end date for these powers until April 30, 1950.

name: The Pakistan Tea Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Pakistan Tea Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the cultivation and export of tea in Pakistan while promoting the interests of the tea industry through research and marketing improvements. It establishes the Pakistan Tea Board to oversee these activities and levies a cess on produced tea to finance related objectives.

name: The Karachi Secondary Education Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Karachi Secondary Education Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation, organization, development, and control of secondary education in the Capital of the Federation. It establishes the Karachi Board of Secondary Education as a corporate body with defined composition, powers, and procedures.

name: The Royal Pakistan Navy (Extension of Service) Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Royal Pakistan Navy (Extension of Service) Act, 1950
metadata.repeals: The Royal Pakistan Navy (Extension of Service) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the retention in service of certain persons enrolled in the Royal Pakistan Navy whose engagement terms have expired. It allows these personnel to continue serving until discharged by the Officer Commanding, with an extension period not exceeding five years.

name: The Census Act, 1949

metadata.title: The Census Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for certain matters in connection with the taking of a census of Pakistan during the year 1951. It establishes the roles of the Census Commissioner, Superintendents, and Officers, defines who must assist in the census, and outlines the legal duties and penalties for refusing to perform census-related tasks.

name: The Continuance of Legal Proceedings Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Continuance of Legal Proceedings Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of certain legal proceedings by or against the Secretary of State regarding rights pending immediately before August 15, 1947. It extends to all provinces of Pakistan and the capital, specifying how these proceedings are continued against the Dominion or specific provinces.

name: The Estate Duty Act, 1950

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 by omitting specific subsections and words related to official duty and habitual misconduct. It was enacted by the Punjab legislature and received assent on January 23, 1950.

name: The Merchant Shipping (National Colours) Act, 1949

metadata.title: The Merchant Shipping (National Colours) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the national colours to be worn by ships registered in Pakistan or owned by persons domiciled there. It empowers the Central Government to declare proper national colours and imposes penalties for hoisting other colours.

name: The Criminal Law (Extinction of Discriminatory Privileges) Act, 1949

metadata.title: The Criminal Law (Extinction of Discriminatory Privileges) Act, 1949
metadata.amends: The Penal Code, 1860; The Criminal Procedure Code, 1898; The Indian Penal Code, 1860; The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.repeals: The Penal Servitude Act, 1855; The European Vagrancy Act, 1874
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the extinction of certain discriminatory privileges existing in the criminal law. It amends several key statutes, including the Penal Code and the Criminal Procedure Code, to remove references to European or American status and penal servitude distinctions.

name: The Federal Court (Enlargement of Jurisdiction) Act, 1949

metadata.title: The Indian Independence (Amendment) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This document is an Act to further amend the Indian Independence Act, 1947. It substitutes the expression 'the Punjab' for 'West Punjab' wherever it occurs in the parent Act.

name: The Baluchistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Regulation, 1950

metadata.title: The Baluchistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Regulation, 1950
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the administration of evacuee property in Baluchistan. It defines key terms such as 'evacuee', 'evacuee property', and 'Custodian', and establishes the appointment of Custodians to take possession of such properties.

name: NA- The Punjab Preventive Detention Law Act, 1949

metadata.title: West Pakistan Preventive Detention Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.amends: West Punjab Public Safety Act, 1949; Sind Public Order and Detention Act, Amendment, 1952
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends laws relating to preventive detention in force in West Pakistan. It establishes procedures for communicating grounds of detention, constituting advisory boards, and reviewing the sufficiency of cause for detention orders exceeding three months.

name: The Pakistan Navy (Court Martial ) Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: The Pakistan Navy (Court Martial) Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides that substantive and acting commanders may sit as presidents of naval courts-martial during an emergency. It amends the Pakistan Navy (Discipline) Act, 1934 to specify the rank requirements for court-martial members when trying personnel below or at the rank of commander.

name: The National Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: The National Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to constitute the National Bank of Pakistan in response to an emergency requiring extended banking facilities and agricultural credit. It establishes the bank as a body corporate with perpetual succession, defines its authorized share capital, and outlines regulations regarding shareholder registration and rights.

name: PROCLAMATION 3

metadata.title: The Proclamation dated the 4th November, 1949
metadata.amends: The Proclamation issued in the Cabinet Secretariat Notification No. 18(1)-Cord|49, dated the 25th January, 1949, as amended by that Secretariat Notifications No. 18(1)-Cord|49, dated the 20th April, 1949 and No. 18(1)-Cord|49, dated the 20th April, 1949
metadata.summary: This order amends a previous Proclamation issued by the Governor-General on January 25, 1949. The amendment adds a new paragraph to suspend specific Chapters regarding Advisers with the Governor's pleasure.

name: The Jute Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: The Jute Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to safeguard international trade in jute by establishing a minimum price for purchase and sale. It grants the Central Government powers to regulate baling charges, requisition facilities, call for information, and impose penalties for contraventions.

name: The Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Administration of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the administration of evacuee property in Pakistan and addresses certain incidental matters arising from the partition. It defines key terms such as 'evacuee', 'evacuee property', and 'refugee' to establish the legal framework for managing assets left behind by persons who fled India.

name: The Pakistan Public Safety Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: Pakistan Public Safety Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides special measures to ensure public safety and maintain public order during an emergency. It empowers the Central Government to issue orders restricting individuals' movements, requiring detention, or imposing specific conditions on their conduct.

name: The Regulation of Mines and Oilfields and Mineral Development (Federal Control) Act, 1948

metadata.title: PAKISTAN MINING CONCESSIONS RULES, 1949
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for granting certificates of approval, prospecting licences, and mining leases in Pakistan. They define key terms such as 'Government', 'Collector', and 'Lessee', and specify the application procedures and fees required for obtaining mineral concessions.

name: The Karachi Joint Water Board Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: The Karachi Joint Water Board Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Karachi Joint Water Board and defines its constitution, membership, and operational scope. It applies to the Capital of the Federation and the Province of Sind, coming into force immediately upon publication.

name: THE PAKISTAN PETROLEUM (PRODUCTION ) RULES, 1949

metadata.title: PAKISTAN PETROLEUM (PRODUCTION) RULES, 1949
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for obtaining oil exploration licences, oil prospecting licences, and oil mining leases in Pakistan. They define key terms related to petroleum production and outline the specific requirements, fees, and documentation needed to apply for these rights.

name: The Pakistan Petroleum (Production) Rules, 1949

metadata.title: The Pakistan Petroleum (Production) Rules, 1949
metadata.summary: These Rules prescribe the procedures for obtaining oil exploration licences, oil prospecting licences, and oil mining leases in Pakistan. They define key terms such as crude oil and petroleum, outline application requirements, and establish working obligations and financial terms like rent and royalty.

name: The Refugees (Registration of Land Claims) (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: The Refugees (Registration of Land Claims) (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration of land claims belonging to persons who took refuge in the Capital of the Federation. It was promulgated by the Governor-General under emergency powers due to disturbances arising from the setting up of the Dominions of Pakistan and India.

name: THE ORDER OF THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL UNDER SECTION 6 OF THE GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1948

metadata.title: Order of the Governor-General under Section 6 of the Government of India (Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This notification publishes an Order by the Governor-General modifying the Sind Sales Tax Act, 1947. The modifications include inserting new provisos regarding tax liability for registered persons, omitting specific sections, extending time limits for certain provisions, and altering penalties and appeal procedures.

name: The Pakistan (Dealings in Immovable Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Dealings in Immovable Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits all dealings relating to immovable evacuee property in Pakistan due to an emergency situation. It defines key terms such as 'immovable evacuee property', 'registering officer', and 'Custodian' by referencing existing laws from 1948, and declares any agreements or deeds executed in violation of these provisions as null and void.

name: The Sind Textile Board Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: The Sind Textile Board Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance incorporates and regulates the Sind Textile Board to improve the procurement and wholesale distribution of cloth in the Province of Sind. It establishes a trading corporation with specific governance structures, including an Executive Committee and a Board of up to seventy members.

name: The Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Rules, 1949

metadata.title: The Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Rules, 1949
metadata.summary: These Rules were made under the Public and Representative Offices (Disqualification) Act, 1949 to regulate the procedures for moving Federal Courts or High Courts regarding disqualifications. They outline requirements for applications, preliminary enquiries, hearing procedures, and the powers of tribunals established under the said Act.

name: The Forces (Service by Foreigners) Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: The Forces (Service by Foreigners) Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the service of foreigners in His Majesty's Pakistan Forces during an emergency. It grants the Governor-General the power to issue commissions or authorize the enrolment of foreigners into these forces.

name: The Protection of Evacuee Property (North-West Frontier Province) Rules, 1949

metadata.title: The Protection of Evacuee Property (North-West Frontier Province) Rules
metadata.summary: These Rules were made by the Central Government under section 25 of the Pakistan (Protection of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, XVIII of 1948. They define the powers and duties of Custodians and Assistant Custodians regarding the administration of evacuee property in the North-West Frontier Province.

name: The Import and Export Licences (Conditions of Issue) Order, 1949

metadata.title: Import and Export Licences (Conditions of Issue) Order, 1949
metadata.amends: Import and Export Licences (Conditions of Issue) Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order establishes conditions for the issue of import and export licences under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1947. It mandates that licences issued must be non-transferable without specific permission from the licensing authority.

name: The Pakistan (White Oil Control) Order, 1949

metadata.title: The Pakistan (White Oil Control) Order, 1949
metadata.summary: This Order establishes a framework for the control of White Oil within Pakistan, defining terms such as 'White Oil', 'Controller', 'stockholder', and 'importer'. It empowers the Central Government to appoint a Controller who can regulate imports, inspect records, and seize oil in cases of contravention.

name: The Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) Ordinance, 1949

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Recovery of Abducted Persons) Ordinance, 1949
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery and restoration of abducted persons in pursuance of an agreement between the Governments of Pakistan and India. It establishes camps for the temporary detention of these individuals pending their return to relatives and outlines the powers of police officers to locate and recover them.

name: PROCLAMATION 2

metadata.title: The Proclamation issued in the Cabinet Secretariat Notification No. 18(1)-Cord/49
metadata.amends: The Proclamation issued in the Cabinet Secretariat Notification No. 18(1)-Cord/49 dated the 25th January 1949
metadata.summary: This notification publishes a Proclamation by the Governor-General dated April 25, 1949. It amends a previous Cabinet Secretariat Notification regarding specific sections of the Government of India Act, 1935.

name: The Special Leave Rules applicable to the Governor and Deputy Governors (State Bank of Pakistan), 1949

metadata.title: Special Leave Rules applicable to the Governor and Deputy Governors (State Bank of Pakistan), 1949
metadata.summary: These rules grant leave with pay and without pay to the Governor and Deputy Governors of the State Bank of Pakistan. They specify conditions regarding leave duration, salary entitlements during leave, and residence allowances.

name: The Protection of Evacuee Property (Sind and Federal Capital) Rules

metadata.title: The Protection of Evacuee Property (Sind and Federal Capital) Rules
metadata.summary: These Rules were made by the Central Government under section 25 of the Pakistan (Protection of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, XVIII of 1948. They extend to Sind and the Capital of the Federation and come into force immediately.

name: PROCLAMATION 1

metadata.title: Proclamation dated the 5th April, 1949
metadata.amends: Proclamation issued in Governor-General's Notification No. 18(1)-Cord/49, dated 25th January 1949
metadata.summary: This notification publishes a Proclamation by the Governor-General dated April 5, 1949. It directs that specific provisions of an Act be suspended with effect from January 25, 1949, including sections related to Ministers, the Speaker, and the laying of reports before the Provincial Legislature.

name: THE PAKISTAN PROVISIONAL CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1949

metadata.title: The Pakistan Provisional Constitution (Amendment) Order, 1949
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Government of India Act, 1935 to incorporate areas with Federation consent and adjust executive authority provisions. It substitutes 'Baluchistan' for 'British Baluchistan', inserts new sections regarding areas included in the Federation, modifies salary schedules for the Governor-General and Governors, and updates railway entries in the Schedules.

name: The Extra-Provincial Jurisdiction Order, 1949

metadata.title: The Extra-Provincial Jurisdiction Order, 1949
metadata.summary: This Order defines the Governor-General's authority to exercise jurisdiction in territories outside the Provinces and Capital of Pakistan. It establishes that acts done under this jurisdiction are valid according to local laws and outlines procedures for determining the extent of such jurisdiction in civil or criminal proceedings.

name: The Adaptation of Central Acts and Ordinances Order, 1949

metadata.title: The Adaptation of Central Acts and Ordinances Order, 1949
metadata.amends: Pakistan (Adaptation of Existing Pakistan Laws) Order, 1947
metadata.summary: This Order adapts Central Acts and Ordinances from British India to continue as law in Pakistan with necessary modifications. It specifically addresses the substitution of 'all the Provinces' or 'the Provinces' with 'all the Provinces and the Capital of the Federation' and provides exceptions for certain revenue and tax acts.

name: THE STATE BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1949

metadata.title: The State Bank of Pakistan (Amendment) Order, 1949
metadata.amends: The State Bank of Pakistan Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order amends the State Bank of Pakistan Order, 1948 to update definitions and provisions regarding provincial cooperative banks. It also modifies clauses related to the appointment of directors, leave for governors, removal from office, and shareholding requirements for board members.

name: The Government of Pakistan (Distribution of Revenue) Order, 1949

metadata.title: Government of Pakistan (Distribution of Revenue) Order, 1949
metadata.amends: Government of India (Distribution of Revenue) Order, 1936
metadata.summary: This Order specifies the proportion of net proceeds from export duties on jute or jute products to be assigned to Provinces or Federated States where jute is grown. It establishes that this share shall be sixty-two and one-half percent or rupees three and one-half crores, whichever is less.

name: The Cantonments Electoral (Amendment) Rules 1945

metadata.title: Amendments to the Defence Rules
metadata.summary: This notification amends Rule 5 of the Defence Rules by substituting specific monetary values and time periods. The amendments replace 'five Rupees' with 'two rupees and eight annas', adjust year calculations to six months, and update related explanatory text.

name: The Salaries and Allowances of Ministers Act, 1949

metadata.title: The Control of Shipping (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Control of Shipping Act, 1947 by substituting a specific sub-section regarding its commencement and duration. It was enacted as Act No. XIV of 1949.

name: The Pakistan Finance Act, 1949

metadata.title: The Pakistan Finance Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning on April 1, 1949. It establishes duties on salt, modifies postage rates under the Indian Post Office Act, and continues additional customs duties with specific modifications.

name: The Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1949

metadata.title: Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act provides for matters connected with the development of industries under Federal control in Pakistan. It declares such development expedient in the public interest and empowers the Central Government to make rules, subject to prior publication.

name: The Pakistan Industrial Finance Corporation Act, 1949

metadata.title: The Pakistan Industrial Finance Corporation Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Industrial Finance Corporation to facilitate medium and long-term credit for industrial concerns in Pakistan. It defines the corporation's legal status, authorized share capital structure, and subscription rules involving the Central Government and public entities.

name: The Pakistan High Courts (Bengal) Order, 1949

metadata.title: The Pakistan High Courts (Bengal) Order, 1949
metadata.summary: This Order was made by the Governor-General of Pakistan to establish the jurisdiction and authority of High Courts in Bengal. It declares that judgments from the High Court of Calcutta regarding legislative or executive rights are void if they affect the Central or Provincial Governments of Pakistan.

name: The States Forces Discipline Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The States Forces Discipline Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the discipline and command of State Forces acting with or attached to His Majesty's Pakistan Land Forces. It stipulates that when such forces are acting with Pakistan forces, the provisions of the Indian Army Act, 1915 apply to them.

name: The Motor Spirit Rationing Order, 1948

metadata.title: The Motor Spirit Rationing Order, 1948
metadata.repeals: The Motor Spirit Rationing Order, 1941
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the supply of motor spirit across all provinces of Pakistan by establishing a rationing system based on specific coupons. It repeals the previous Motor Spirit Rationing Order of 1941 while ensuring that ongoing appointments and proceedings under the old order continue under this new framework.

name: The Hoarding and Black Market Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Hoarding and Black Market Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides special provisions to check hoarding and dealing in the black market within Pakistan. It defines specific offenses related to the unauthorized sale, storage, or production of rationed goods and prescribes imprisonment and fines for those found guilty.

name: The Banking Companies (Control) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Banking Companies Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control of banking companies by the State Bank of Pakistan. It grants the Central Legislature power to make laws regarding banking and defines specific terms such as 'banking company' and 'secured loan'. The document also outlines restrictions on loans, including prohibitions on lending against own shares or to directors.

name: The Regulation of Mines and Oil fields and Mineral Development (Federal Control) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Mines and Oil-fields and Mineral Development Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for matters connected with the regulation of mines, oil-fields, and mineral development under Federal Control. It extends to all Provinces of Pakistan and empowers the Central Government to make rules regarding these matters.

name: The Diplomatic and Consular Officers (Oaths and Fees) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Diplomatic and Consular Officers (Oaths and Fees) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the administration of oaths and affirmations by diplomatic and consular officers in foreign countries. It also prescribes the fees leviable for certain official duties performed by these officers and establishes penalties for taking excessive fees or forging seals.

name: The Land Control (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The Land Control (Capital of the Federation) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor-General to control the transfer and market value of lands within the Capital of the Federation due to an emergency. It defines the specific geographical boundaries of the area subject to these controls and interprets key terms like 'transfer' based on existing property laws.

name: The Pakistan [Indian Independence (Legal Proceedings)] Order, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan [Indian Independence (Legal Proceedings)] Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This notification promulgates an Order made by the Governor-General of Pakistan on November 13, 1948. The document amends the Indian Independence (Legal Proceedings) Order, 1947, to address legal proceedings following the partition and independence of India.

name: The Riot and Civil Commotion Risks Insurance (Repealing) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The Riot and Civil Commotion Risks Insurance (Repealing) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.repeals: Riot and Civil Commotion Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This ordinance was promulgated by the Governor-General to repeal specific provisions of the Riot and Civil Commotion Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1947. It was issued under emergency powers granted by section 42 of the Government of India Act, 1935, and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Bombay Public Conveyance (Amendment) Order, 1948

metadata.title: The Bombay Public Conveyance (Amendment) Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order amends clause (b) of Section 2 of the Bombay Public Conveyance Act, 1920 to define 'Public Conveyance' as wheeled vehicles drawn or propelled by man or animal used for hire. It extends to the Capital of the Federation and comes into force immediately.

name: The Pakistan (Economic Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Economic Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the restoration and maintenance of Pakistan's economic life following disturbances arising from the partition. It establishes a framework for the orderly settlement of refugees and the management of evacuee property through appointed Rehabilitation Authorities.

name: The Pakistan (Protection of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: Pakistan (Protection of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection and care of the property of evacuees from Pakistan following the partition. It establishes the role of Custodians appointed by the Central Government to manage such property and defines key terms including 'evacuee property' and 'refugee'. The legislation overrides any inconsistent provisions in other enactments.

name: The Baluchistan Disturbed Areas Special Powers of Armed Forces (Amendment) Regulation, 1948

metadata.title: The Baluchistan Disturbed Areas Special Powers of Armed Forces (Amendment) Regulation, 1948
metadata.amends: The Baluchistan Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Regulation, 1947
metadata.summary: This Regulation amends the Baluchistan Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Regulation, 1947. It specifically inserts a reference to the Zhob Militia, Pishin Scouts, and Mekran and Chagai Levy Corps into section 2 of the amended regulation.

name: The Pakistan (Control of Entry) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The Control of Entry into Pakistan Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the entry of persons into Pakistan from India, requiring valid permits for those domiciled in either country and passports for others. It establishes penalties for contravention, grants arrest powers to police and customs officers, and provides for the making of rules by the Central Government.

name: The Pakistan (Adaptation of Existing Pakistan Laws) (State Bank of Pakistan) Order, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Adaptation of Existing Pakistan Laws) (State Bank of Pakistan) Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order adapts existing Pakistani laws to replace references to the Reserve Bank of India with those of the State Bank of Pakistan following the transition of central banking functions. It stipulates that from July 1, 1948, all existing laws shall be subject to the provisions directed in this Order until repealed or amended by a competent authority.

name: The Pakistan (Adaptation of Indian Tariff Act) Order, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Adaptation of Indian Tariff Act) Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order adapts the Indian Tariff Act, 1934 for application to the Dominion of Pakistan as of April 1, 1948. It specifies particular adaptations to the First Schedule of the Act and substitutes the word 'Revenue' for 'Protective' in certain columns.

name: The Pakistan (Establishment of the Federal Capital), Order, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Establishment of the Federal Capital) Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order establishes Karachi as the Federal Capital of Pakistan based on a resolution by the Constituent Assembly. It demarcates the area of Karachi from the Province of Sind, vests executive and administrative authority in the Government of Pakistan, and provides for the apportionment of assets and liabilities between the central government and the province.

name: The West Punjab Special Tribunal (Abolition) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The West Punjab Special Tribunal (Abolition) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the West Punjab Special Tribunal with immediate effect. It transfers cases from the abolished tribunal to the District Magistrate of Lahore or another designated magistrate, preserving all prior evidence and proceedings.

name: The Arbitral Tribunal (Dissolution) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Arbitral Tribunal (Dissolution) Act, 1948
metadata.repeals: The Arbitral Tribunal Order, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Arbitral Tribunal Order, 1947, and dissolves the Arbitral Tribunal established under that order. It clarifies that these actions do not affect the validity or binding nature of any awards previously made by the Tribunal.

name: The Pakistan Armed Forces (Recruitment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1948

metadata.title: Pakistan Armed Forces (Recruitment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of recruitment and conditions of service within the Pakistan Armed Forces. It empowers the Central Government to frame rules regarding recruitment, pay, leave, pensions, and general rights for the Army, Navy, and Air Force.

name: The Pakistan Federal Legislature (Deputy President's Salary) Act, 1948

metadata.title: Pakistan Federal Legislature (Deputy President's Salary) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the salary for the Deputy President of the Federal Legislature at a rate of two thousand rupees per mensem. It is deemed to have come into force on February 23, 1948.

name: The United Nations (Privileges and Immunities) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The United Nations (Privileges and Immunities) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the Convention on the Privileges and Immunities of the United Nations within Pakistan. It grants similar privileges and immunities to other international organizations and their representatives, enabling them to enjoy rights comparable to those of the UN.

name: The Protection of Ports (Special Measures) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Protection of Ports (Special Measures) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides special measures to ensure the protection of ports in Pakistan. It empowers the Central Government to declare protected areas around major ports and make rules regarding the entry, removal, and conduct of persons within those areas.

name: The United Nations (Security Council) Act, 1948

metadata.title: The United Nations (Security Council) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Central Government to apply measures under Article 41 of the United Nations Charter without using armed force. It authorizes the government to make necessary provisions via orders published in the official Gazette, including those with extra-territorial operation, and allows for the punishment of persons offending against such orders.

name: The State Bank of Pakistan Order, 1948

metadata.title: The State Bank of Pakistan Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the State Bank of Pakistan as a body corporate to take over currency management from the Reserve Bank of India. It defines the bank's capital structure, shareholding limits, and operational scope within Pakistan.

name: The Pakistan Constituent Assembly (Legislature) Rules, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan Constituent Assembly (Legislature) Rules
metadata.summary: This document publishes the rules of procedure and standing orders for the Legislative Assembly of Pakistan, adapted from the Government of India Act, 1935. It defines key terms such as 'Assembly', 'Member', and 'President' and outlines procedures for elections, declarations of allegiance, and the delegation of powers.

name: The Pakistan Constituent Assembly (Legislature) Standing Orders

metadata.title: Pakistan Constituent Assembly (Legislature) Standing Orders
metadata.summary: This document establishes the Standing Orders for the Pakistan Constituent Assembly functioning as the Federal Legislature. It defines key terms, appoints a Leader of the House, and sets rules regarding the precedence of non-official Bills and Resolutions during sessions.

name: The Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Refugees Rehabilitation Finance Corporation to provide financial aid for refugee rehabilitation. The corporation is authorized to issue loans to various groups, including shopkeepers and artisans, and to take over abandoned factories or businesses.

name: The Pakistan (Miscellaneous Transitional Provisions) Order, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Miscellaneous Transitional Provisions) Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the endorsement of certificates and licences granted by the Dominion of India during the transitional period. It stipulates that such documents may be endorsed by provincial governments or authorized authorities to have effect in Pakistan.

name: The Pakistan General Sales Tax Rules, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan General Sales Tax Rules, 1948
metadata.summary: These rules define the Pakistan General Sales Tax Rules, 1948, and establish their effective date as April 1, 1948. The document provides definitions for various officials and terms, outlines how to calculate a dealer's gross turnover, and specifies deductions allowed from that turnover.

name: The Iron and Steel (Scrap Control) Order, 1948

metadata.title: Iron and Steel (Scrap Control) Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the acquisition and disposal of iron and steel scrap within Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'controlled source', 'controller', and 'scrap' to establish a framework for managing these materials.

name: The Pakistan Currency Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: Pakistan Currency Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the issue and circulation of Government of Pakistan One Rupee Notes. It defines these notes as legal tender in all territories of Pakistan and establishes their status within the monetary system.

name: The Iron and Steel (Control of Production, Distribution and Imports) Order, 1948

metadata.title: Iron and Steel (Control of Production, Distribution and Imports) Order, 1948
metadata.amends: Iron & Steel (Control of Production and Distribution) Order, 1941
metadata.summary: This Order regulates the production, distribution, and import of iron and steel in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'producer', 'importer', and 'stockholder' and establishes rules for acquiring and disposing of these materials under the authority of a Controller.

name: The Pakistan General Sales Tax Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan General Sales Tax Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a general sales tax on the sale of goods in the provinces of Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'dealer', 'goods', and 'sale' to establish the scope and mechanics of the tax.

name: The Pakistan (Exchange of Prisoners) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Exchange of Prisoners) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to immediately implement an agreement between the Dominion of Pakistan and the Dominion of India regarding the exchange of certain classes of prisoners. It outlines the procedures for transferring prisoners, including the issuance of warrants, the cessation of jurisdiction over transferred individuals in Pakistan, and the repatriation process.

name: The Constituent Assembly (Legislature) Members Allowances Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Constituent Assembly (Legislature) Members Allowances Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for fixing the allowances of the Members of the Constituent Assembly (Legislature). It stipulates that these members shall receive traveling and daily allowances at rates applicable to other members of the assembly.

name: The Pakistan Finance Act, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan Finance Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning on April 1, 1948. It establishes duties on salt, modifies customs and excise rates, sets income-tax and super-tax levels, and adjusts postage rates under the Indian Post Office Act.

name: The West Punjab Legislative Assembly Order, 1948

metadata.title: West Punjab Legislative Assembly Order, 1948
metadata.amends: The Government of India Act, 1935, as adapted by the Pakistan (Provisional Constitution) Order, 1947
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the West Punjab Legislative Assembly and outlines the process for members transferring from Indian legislatures. It mandates that individuals resigning from their previous seats must do so within twenty days of the Order's commencement to retain membership in the new assembly.

name: The Baluchistan Economic Rehabilitation Regulation, 1948

metadata.title: Baluchistan Economic Rehabilitation Regulation, 1948
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the economic rehabilitation of Baluchistan following disturbances that caused property abandonment and business closures. It empowers a Rehabilitation Commissioner to repair economic dislocation, absorb refugees into the local economy, manage abandoned properties, and issue orders regarding leases and employment.

name: The Baluchistan Protection of Evacuees Property Regulation, 1948

metadata.title: Baluchistan Protection of Evacuees Property Regulation, 1948
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the protection and care of the property of evacuees from Baluchistan. It establishes the authority of the Chief Commissioner to appoint custodians and defines terms such as 'evacuee', 'property', and 'rehabilitation authority'.

name: The Pakistan Drugs Act Adaptation Order, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan Drugs Act Adaptation Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order adapts the provisions of the Indian Drugs Act, 1940 for application in Pakistan. It establishes the composition of the Board and amends specific sections regarding magistrates and other administrative details.

name: The Federal Court of Pakistan Order, 1948

metadata.title: The Federal Court of Pakistan Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Federal Court of Pakistan as of August 15, 1947. It defines the court's composition based on the Government of India Act, 1938, and stipulates that existing rules remain in force until new ones are made.

name: The West Punjab Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces and Validation of Certain Acts) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: the West Punjab Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces and Validation of Certain Acts) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.repeals: the Punjab Disturbed Areas Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers special powers upon officers of the Armed Forces in certain disturbed areas of West Punjab. It also validates powers exercised by such officers after the termination of the Punjab Disturbed Areas Act, 1947.

name: The Essential Personnel (Registration) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The Essential Personnel (Registration) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the compulsory registration of essential personnel at Employment Exchanges established by the Government of Pakistan. It defines essential personnel, outlines the liability to register, specifies procedures for obtaining registration certificates, and establishes penalties for failing to register without sufficient cause.

name: The Cantonments (Requisitioning of Immoveable Property) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The Cantonment (Immoveable Property) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the requisition of immovable property within cantonments and establishes the procedures for delivering possession to authorized persons. It outlines the principles and methods for determining compensation payable when such property is requisitioned, including agreements or government-fixed amounts under specific rules.

name: The India Military Personnel Amnesty Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: India Military Personnel Amnesty Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance implements an agreement between the Dominions of Pakistan and India to grant a general amnesty to specific military personnel. It applies to acts committed between August 15, 1947, and December 22, 1947, regarding internal defence or refugee protection duties.

name: The Salt Duty (Pakistan) Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: The Salt Duty (Pakistan) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.amends: The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Ordinance imposes a duty on salt manufactured in or imported into the Provinces of Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor-General under emergency powers to regulate salt taxation rates.

name: NA- The Pakistan (Provisional Constitution) Order, 1948

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Provisional Constitution) (Amendment) Order, 1948
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Pakistan (Provisional Constitution) Order, 1947, specifically regarding the office of the Deputy President and related sections in the Schedule. It outlines procedures for resignation, removal, vacancy filling, and salary determination for the Deputy President.

name: NA- The Baluchistan Public Safety Regulation, 1947

metadata.title: The Baluchistan Public Safety (Amendment) Regulation, 1949
metadata.summary: This Regulation amends the Baluchistan Public Safety Regulation, 1947. It specifically substitutes a provision regarding the Chief Commissioner's power to order detention and extend such periods.

name: NA-The Capital Issues (Continuance of Control) Act, 1947

metadata.title: Capital Issues Continuance of Control (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Capital Issues (Continuance of Control) Act, 1947. It substitutes the figure '1952' for '1950' in sub-section (3) of Section 1 of the amended Act.

name: The Indian Independence Act, 1947

metadata.title: Indian Independence Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act establishes two independent Dominions in India known as India and Pakistan, effective from August 15, 1947. It substitutes provisions for the Government of India Act, 1935, regarding territories outside these new Dominions and addresses consequential matters related to their formation.

name: NA- The Railways (Transport of Goods) Act, 1947

metadata.title: The Railways (Transport of Goods) Amendment Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Railways (Transport of Goods) Act, 1947 by substituting 'two years' for 'one year' in subsection (3) of section 1. It extends to all territories of Pakistan.

name: NA-The Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange Regulation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947 due to an emergency situation. It extends to all territories of Pakistan and comes into force immediately upon the enforcement of the original Act.

name: NA- The Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947

metadata.title: The Prevention of Corruption (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 by omitting specific subsections and words related to official duty and habitual conduct. It was enacted by the Punjab legislature and received assent on January 23, 1950.

name: NA-The Coal Mines Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1947

metadata.title: The Coal Mines Labour Welfare Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.amends: The Coal Mines Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Coal Mines Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1947 to allow funds to be deposited into government treasuries in addition to the State Bank of Pakistan. It specifically inserts new wording into sections 4 and 10 of the said Act regarding these deposit options.

name: NA- The Industrial Disputes Act, 1947

metadata.title: Industrial Disputes (Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 to include specific undertakings and services related to defence, naval dock-yards, and port operations within its scope. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

name: NA- The Control of Shipping Act, 1947

metadata.title: The Control of Shipping (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Control of Shipping Act, 1947 by substituting a specific sub-section regarding its commencement and duration. It was enacted as Act No. XIV of 1949.

name: NA-The Central Nursing Council Ordinance, 1947

metadata.title: The Central Nursing Council Ordinance (Amendment) Act, 1949
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Central Nursing Council Ordinance, 1947. It adds a proviso to section 3 allowing the Central Government to nominate members to fill vacancies if the relevant bodies fail to elect their representatives within the prescribed period.

name: NA-The Sind Electricity Control Act, 1947

metadata.title: The Diplomatic and Consular Officers (Oaths and Fees) Amendment Act, 1949
metadata.amends: The Diplomatic and Consular Officers (Oaths and Fees) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Diplomatic and Consular Officers (Oaths and Fees) Act, 1948. It inserts the word 'counselor' into section 2 of the amended Act and deems the changes effective from August 15, 1947.

name: NA- The Business Profits Tax Act, 1947

metadata.title: Business Profits Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was enacted to remove certain defects in the Business Profits Tax Act, 1947. It amends specific sections and schedules of the original Act to adapt provisions for Pakistan following independence.

name: NA- The Quetta Municipal Law, 1946

metadata.title: The Quetta Municipal Law (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Quetta Municipal Law of 1946 to require committee members to take an oath or affirmation of allegiance to the Constitution of Pakistan. It also substitutes the word 'Pakistan' for 'India' wherever it appears in the said law.

name: The Foreigners Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Foreigners Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act confers powers upon the Central Government regarding the entry, presence, and departure of foreigners into British India. It establishes definitions for 'foreigner' and provides authority to make orders prohibiting or regulating these movements, including conditions on residence and conduct.

name: The Hindu Marriage Disabilities Removal Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Hindu Marriage Disabilities Removal Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act removes certain disabilities and doubts under Hindu Law regarding marriages between Hindus. It declares that a marriage is not invalid solely because the parties belong to the same gotra, pravara, or different subdivisions of the same caste.

name: The Banking Companies (Restriction of Branches) Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Banking Companies (Restriction of Branches) Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act restricts the indiscriminate opening and removal of branches by banking companies. It empowers the Reserve Bank to inspect bank records and consider financial conditions before granting permission for new branches, while also establishing penalties for contraventions.

name: The Special Tribunals (Supplementary Provisions) Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Special Tribunals (Supplementary Provisions) Act, 1946
metadata.repeals: The Special Tribunals (Supplementary Provisions) Ordinance, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the treatment of sentences and orders passed by Special Tribunals constituted under the Criminal Law Amendment Ordinance, 1943, once those tribunals cease to function. It deems such sentences as having been passed by the Court of Session within the relevant jurisdiction for the purposes of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.

name: The Delhi Special Police Establishment Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Delhi Special Police Establishment Act, 1946
metadata.repeals: The Delhi Special Police Establishment Ordinance, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes a special police force for the Chief Commissioner's Province of Delhi to investigate offences connected with Central Government departments. It grants members of this force specific powers, duties, and privileges throughout the province and extends their jurisdiction to other areas in British India under certain conditions.

name: The Essential Supplies (Temporary Powers) Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Essential Supplies (Temporary Powers) Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of powers to control the production, supply, and distribution of essential commodities during a limited period. It covers items such as foodstuffs, textiles, paper, petroleum, spare parts, coal, iron, steel, and mica. The legislation empowers authorities to regulate trade and commerce in these goods through notified orders.

name: The Mica Mines Labour Welfare fund Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Mica Mines Labour Welfare Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Mica Mines Labour Welfare Fund to promote the welfare of labour employed in the mica mining industry. It provides for the levying and collection of a customs duty on exported mica, with proceeds directed towards improving public health, sanitation, education, housing, and living standards.

name: The Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act requires employers in industrial establishments to formally define and make known the conditions of employment for workmen. It establishes a process where employers must submit draft standing orders to a Certifying Officer for certification, ensuring these rules cover applicable matters and conform to the Act's provisions.

name: The Hindu Married Women's Right to Separate Residence and Maintenance Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Hindu Married Women's Right to Separate Residence and Maintenance Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act grants Hindu married women the right to claim separate residence and maintenance from their husbands under specific circumstances. It outlines grounds such as the husband's loathsome disease, cruelty, desertion, bigamy, conversion to another religion, or keeping a concubine, while also setting conditions where this right is denied.

name: The Merchant Seamen (Litigation) Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Merchant Seamen (Litigation) Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act provides special protection for serving merchant seamen involved in civil and revenue litigation. It establishes procedures for courts to suspend or postpone proceedings if a seaman is unable to appear, and grants powers to set aside decrees passed against serving seamen.

name: The Protective Duties Continuation Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Protective Duties Continuation Act, 1946
metadata.amends: The Indian Tariff Act, 1934; The Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act extends the duration of protective duties in the First Schedule to the Indian Tariff Act, 1934, from 1946 to 1947. It also amends the Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1932, by substituting the year 1947 for 1946 in its preamble and section 3.

name: The Railway Companies (Subtitution of Parties in Civil Proceedings) Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Railway Companies (Substitution of Governor-General in Council in Civil Proceedings) Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act substitutes the Governor-General in Council for specific railway companies in certain civil proceedings pending at its commencement. It applies to cases founded on rights or liabilities assumed by the Central Government with these companies, effectively discharging the companies from liability and allowing proceedings to continue against the Governor-General.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Indian Finance Act, 1946
metadata.amends: The Indian Finance Act, 1945; The Indian Tariff Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Finance Act, 1945, and the Indian Tariff Act, 1934 to fix salt duties, adjust inland postage rates, and continue specific additional customs duties. It also alters various customs duties on items such as wines, betelnuts, raw cotton, silver, gold, kerosene, and mineral oils.

name: NA-The Banking Companies (Inspection) Ordinance, 1946

metadata.title: The Companies (Inspection) Ordinance, 1946 (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Banking Companies (Inspection) Ordinance, 1946 to empower the State Bank of Pakistan to inspect banking companies and their books. It outlines the duties of directors to produce information during inspections and establishes penalties for refusal or failure to comply with inspection requirements.

name: NA-The British Baluchistan Rent Control Regulation, 1945

metadata.title: Regulation V of 1954
metadata.summary: This regulation amends the British Baluchistan Rent Control Regulation of 1945. It came into force immediately upon notification.

name: The Public Debt (Central Government) Act, 1944

metadata.title: The Government Securities Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the transfer and holding of Government securities in Pakistan. It specifies that transfers must follow prescribed forms and states that a person transferring a security is not liable for the principal or interest due on it.

name: The Protective Duties Continuation Act, 1944

metadata.title: The Factories (Amendment) Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Factories Act, 1934 by updating specific sections regarding worker protections and working conditions. It includes temporary amendments to adjust working hours from 7:30 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. until the termination of hostilities.

name: NA- The Coconut Committee Act, 1944

metadata.title: The Coconut Committee (Amendment) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Coconut Committee Act, 1944 to replace references to 'India' with 'Pakistan' and change the fund description from 'creation of a fund' to 'financing a Committee'. It also omits specific sections and clauses related to the old committee structure and substitutes new provisions regarding the Pakistan Food and Agriculture Committee.

name: The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944

metadata.title: The Central Excise and Salt Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to central duties of excise and salt in British India. It establishes the framework for levying duties on excisable goods and salt, defines key terms such as 'manufacture' and 'sale', and grants the Central Government powers to set tariff values.

name: NA- The Restriction and Detention Ordinance, 1944

metadata.title: The Restriction on Detention (Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Restriction on Detention Ordinance, 1944 by substituting specific legal definitions regarding citizenship status. It was enacted to update the laws governing detention restrictions in force at the time.

name: The War Injuries (Compensation Insurance) Act, 1943

metadata.title: The War Injuries (Compensation Insurance) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a liability on employers to pay compensation to workmen sustaining war injuries. It also provides for the insurance of employers against such liability.

name: The Excess Profits Tax Ordinance, 1943

metadata.title: The Excess Profits Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Excess Profits Tax Act, 1940 by inserting a new section 14A. The new provision grants the Excess Profits Officer the power to make provisional assessments in a summary manner before proceeding with regular assessments.

name: The Reserve Bank of India (Limitation of Dividend) Ordinance,1943

metadata.title: Reserve Bank of India (Limitation of Dividend) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance limits the aggregate dividend payable to shareholders of the Reserve Bank of India. It overrides specific provisions in the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 regarding cumulative and additional dividends.

name: The Special Criminal Courts (Repeal) Ordinance, 1943

metadata.title: The Special Courts (Emergency Powers) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes special courts with emergency powers to try specific cases. It outlines the jurisdiction of these courts, the rights of appeal for sentences passed, and provisions for transferring pending cases to regular magistrates upon the Ordinance's commencement.

name: The Delhi Muslim Wakfs Act, 1943

metadata.title: The Delhi Muslim Wakfs Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better administration of Muslim Wakfs in the Province of Delhi. It establishes the constitution, powers, and duties of the Majlis responsible for managing these wakfs.

name: The Essential Services (Telephone Employees) Ordinance, 1943

metadata.title: Essential Services (Telephone Employees) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This ordinance was promulgated to secure the continuance in employment of certain persons working in telephonic communications during an emergency. It applies these provisions to employees of specific telephone companies who were engaged under the Crown immediately before April 1, 1943.

name: The Reserve Bank of India (Governor’s Powers and Functions) Ordinance, 1943

metadata.title: The Reserve Bank of India (Governor's Powers and Functions) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to temporarily provide for the exercise of powers and functions vested in the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India during an emergency. It authorizes Chintaman Dwarkanath Deshmukh, Deputy Governor, or any person officiating for him to exercise these powers until a new Governor is appointed.

name: NA- X of 1942

metadata.title: Civil Pioneer Force (Amendment) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Civil Pioneer Force Ordinance, 1942 to correct an error occurring in that law. It substitutes a reference to the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 for the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 within section 17 of the original ordinance.

name: The Standard Time (Interpretation of References) Ordinance, 1943

metadata.title: The Indian Standard Time (Interpretation of References) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the interpretation of references to Indian Standard Time in enactments that were in force in British India. It stipulates that such references must be interpreted based on orders from the Central Government fixing Indian Standard Time, rather than a fixed interval of five and one-half hours.

name: The Income-tax Proceedings Validity Ordinance, 1943

metadata.title: Income-tax Proceedings Validity Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to establish the validity of certain appointments as Income-tax Officers and proceedings taken by Assistant Income-tax Officers under the Indian Income-tax Act, 1922. It deems persons designated as Assistant Income-tax Officers who performed functions of an Income-tax Officer to have been validly appointed for all purposes.

name: The Enemy Agents Ordinance, 1943

metadata.title: The Agents Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the trial and punishment of enemy agents and persons committing offenses with intent to aid the enemy during an emergency. It establishes Special Judges appointed by the Central Government to try these specific cases under a modified criminal procedure.

name: The Federal Courts (Supplemental Powers) Act, 1942

metadata.title: The Federal Court (Supplemental Powers) Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act confers supplemental powers on the Federal Court. It allows the Court to delegate judicial, quasi-judicial, and non-judicial duties to its Registrar or other officials.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act 1942

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain enactments listed in the First Schedule that are spent or unnecessary. It also amends specific enactments specified in the Second Schedule to the extent mentioned therein.

name: The Weekly Holiday's Act 1942

metadata.title: The Weekly Holidays Shops, Restaurants and Theatres Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the grant of weekly holidays to persons employed in shops, restaurants, and theatres. It defines specific terms such as 'establishment', 'shop', 'week', and outlines requirements for closing days and additional half-day holidays.

name: The Industrial Statistics Act, 1942

metadata.title: The Industrial Statistics Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the collection of specific statistics relating to industries and labour conditions across British India. It empowers Provincial Governments to direct the collection of data on matters such as factory prices, wages, living conditions, and employment status.

name: The Protective Duties Continuation Act, 1942.

metadata.title: The Protective Duties Continuation Act, 1942
metadata.amends: The Indian Tariff Act, 1934; The Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act extends the date for which certain protective duties in the First Schedule to the Indian Tariff Act, 1934, shall have effect from March 31, 1942 to March 31, 1944. It also amends the Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1932, by substituting the year 1944 for 1942 in section 3.

name: The Coffee Market Expansion Act, 1942

metadata.title: The Coffee Market Expansion Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act continues the provisions made under the Coffee Market Expansion Ordinance of 1940 to assist the coffee industry. It regulates the export and sale of coffee in British India through government-controlled measures.

name: The Multi-unit Co-operative Societies Act, 1942

metadata.title: The Multi-unit Co-operative Societies Act, 1942
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the incorporation, regulation, and winding up of co-operative societies with objects not confined to one province. It applies to such societies incorporated before or after the commencement of the Act under previous provincial laws.

name: NA- The Motor Vehicles (Drivers) Ordinance, 1942

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Motor Vehicles (Ordinance) Act, 1942 by inserting a new section 6A and modifying section 8. It establishes duties for employers regarding the reinstatement of employees and outlines compensation requirements and penalties for non-compliance.

name: NA- The Penalties (Enhancement) Ordinance, 1942

metadata.title: The Penalties (Enhancement) Amendment Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Penalties (Enhancement) Ordinance, 1942 to further increase punishments for offenses under the Explosive Substances Act, 1908. It introduces new provisions allowing for death or whipping as additional penalties and expands the scope of punishable attempts and abetments.

name: NA- The War Risks (Factories) Insurance Ordinance, 1942

metadata.title: The War Risks (Factories) Insurance Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the War Risks (Factories) Insurance Ordinance, 1942 to address an emergency situation. It introduces specific procedural changes regarding appeals and modifies clauses related to insurable property, liability sharing, and payment postponement during hostilities.

name: NA- The Special Criminal Courts Ordinance, 1942

metadata.title: Criminal Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Special Criminal Courts Ordinance, 1942 to facilitate the transfer of cases and appeals between different areas and districts. It grants the Provincial Government authority to transfer cases involving Special Judges or Special Magistrates across different jurisdictions.

name: NA- XX of 1942

metadata.title: The Collective Fines (Amendment) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Collective Fines Ordinance, 1942 to provide immunity from legal proceedings for acts done in good faith under the law. It adds a new section stating that no suit or prosecution shall lie against any person for anything intended to be done under this ordinance.

name: The Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1942

metadata.title: The Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the extension of time limits imposed under the Indian Patents and Designs Act, 1911. It authorizes the Controller of Patents and Designs to extend these time limits where active service or circumstances arising from hostilities prevent the doing of required acts.

name: The Essential Services (Maintenance) Ordinance, 1941

metadata.title: An Ordinance of certain essential services
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the maintenance of essential services and makes provisions regarding persons engaged in such employment. It establishes rules for regulating wages, conditions of service, and penalties for offenses related to disobedience or abandonment of work during this period.

name: The Active Service Ordinance, 1941

metadata.title: Active Service Ordinance, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance declares that certain persons are deemed to be on active service for the purposes of specific military acts during an emergency. It applies to all members and followers of His Majesty's Forces in British India until hostilities terminate.

name: NA- The City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941

metadata.title: The City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941 (Amendment) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.amends: The City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the City of Lahore Corporation Act, 1941 to address issues regarding the expiry of terms for corporation members. It specifically adds a new section (395-A) detailing the consequences when a term expires without an extension and outlines procedures until new elections are held.

name: The Federal Court Act, 1941

metadata.title: The Federal Court Act, 1941
metadata.repeals: Code of Civil Procedure, V of 1908
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Federal Court to make rules for regulating the presentation of appeals lying to that Court. It also repeals specific provisions of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, that previously regulated this matter.

name: The Professions Tax Limitation Act, 1941

metadata.title: The Professions Tax Limitation Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act limits the total amount payable by any person in respect of taxes on professions, trades, callings, or employments to a maximum of fifty rupees per annum. It applies to the whole of British India and came into force on April 1, 1942.

name: The Railways (Local Authorities Taxation) Act, 1941

metadata.title: The Railways (Local Authorities' Taxation) Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the extent to which railway property vested in His Majesty for the Central Government is liable to taxation imposed by provincial authorities. It establishes that such property becomes taxable only if declared so by a notification from the Central Government and outlines the process for determining fair tax sums or revoking such liabilities.

name: The War Injuries Ordinance, 1941

metadata.title: The Ordinance, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the grant of financial relief to individuals who sustain personal injuries during the continuance of present hostilities. It defines specific terms such as 'war injury' and 'war service injury' and authorizes the Central Government to make payments, including temporary allowances and grants for artificial limbs, to injured persons or their dependents.

name: The Air Raid Precautions Services Ordinance, 1941

metadata.title: Air Raid Precautions Services Ordinance, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of Air Raid Precautions Services to protect persons and property against hostile attacks. It establishes the roles of Provincial Governments and Controllers in appointing members, defining their functions, and setting penalties for non-compliance during emergencies.

name: The Delhi Restriction of Uses of Land Act, 1941

metadata.title: The Delhi Restriction of Uses of Land Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the use of land in the Province of Delhi for purposes other than agriculture. It establishes a mechanism to declare controlled areas and imposes restrictions on erecting buildings or making excavations within those areas without permission from the Deputy Commissioner.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1941

metadata.title: The Indian Finance Act, 1941
metadata.amends: The Indian Salt Act, 1882; The Matches (Excise Duty) Act, 1934; The Mechanical Lighters (Excise Duty) Act, 1934; The Indian Tariff Act, 1934; The Indian Post Office Act, 1898; The Indian Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act amends various existing laws to vary excise duties on salt, matches, and mechanical lighters, adjust tariff rates for artificial silk yarn, fix postage rates, and determine income-tax and super-tax levies. It also continues the charge of excess profits tax while specifying new rates applicable from April 1, 1941.

name: The Berar Laws Act, 1941

metadata.title: The Berar Laws Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act extends certain Acts in force in British India to the region of Berar. It also amends specific Acts listed in the Third Schedule and removes the effect of previous applications made under the Indian (Foreign Jurisdiction) Order in Council, 1902.

name: The Insurance Deposits (Temporary Reduction) Act, 1941

metadata.title: The Insurance Deposits (Temporary Reduction) Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the temporary reduction of instalment amounts payable by insurers under Section 7 of the Insurance Act, 1938. It was enacted due to conditions arising from the present war and applies to the whole of British India.

name: NA-The North-West Frontier Corps Law, 1941

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Corps Law (Amendment) Order, 1954
metadata.summary: This Order amends the North-West Frontier Corps Law of 1941 to improve the administration of forces governed by it. Specifically, it modifies section 8 regarding the jurisdiction and trial of members of the Frontier Corps for certain offences.

name: The War Donations Donations Investments (Companies) Act, 1940

metadata.title: The War Donations Investments (Companies) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act enables companies in British India to make donations to public funds or invest in government loans to assist the prosecution of the war. It also validates such donations and investments made between September 1, 1939, and the commencement of the Act.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain enactments that are spent or have become unnecessary and amends other specified enactments. It includes provisions to ensure that the repeal does not affect existing rights, liabilities, or procedures established under the repealed laws.

name: The Indian Navy (Discipline) Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Indian Navy (Discipline) Amendment Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Indian Legislature that received the assent of the Governor General on November 30, 1940. It was promulgated to amend the Indian Navy (Discipline) Act, 1934 for certain purposes.

name: The Agricultural Produce Cess Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Toduce Cess Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a customs duty on specific articles exported from British India to provide financial support for the Imperial Council of Agricultural Research. It establishes provisions for the refund of duties, the payment of proceeds to the Council, and the creation of a reserve fund.

name: The Drugs Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Drugs Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the import, manufacture, distribution, and sale of drugs in British India. It establishes a Drugs Technical Advisory Board to advise on technical matters arising from the administration of the Act.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Indian Finance Act, 1940
metadata.amends: Indian Salt Act, 1882; Sugar (Excise Duty) Act, 1934; Motor Spirit (Duties) Act, 1917; Indian Tariff Act, 1934; Indian Post Office Act, 1898; Indian Finance (Amendment and Extending) Act, 1931; Indian Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act fixes the duty on salt manufactured in or imported into certain parts of British India. It also varies rates of excise duty on sugar and motor spirit, adjusts customs duties, sets maximum postage rates, and establishes income-tax and super-tax rates for the year beginning April 1, 1940.

name: The National Service (European British Subjects) Act, 1940

metadata.title: Act to make certain provisions relating to service by European British subjects in the Armed forces of, or in a civil capacity under, the Crown
metadata.summary: This Act establishes provisions regarding the national service liability of male European British subjects in the armed forces or serving in a civil capacity under the Crown. It defines key terms such as 'national service' and 'European British subject', sets the age limit for liability at fifty years, and outlines the procedures for calling up individuals for enquiry into their availability and fitness.

name: The Excess Profits Tax Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Excess Profits Tax Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a tax on excess profits arising from certain businesses during the hostilities. It defines key terms such as 'accounting period', 'standard profits', and 'chargeable accounting period' for the purpose of calculating this tax.

name: The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940

metadata.title: An Act to facilitate the changing of the date on which the annual accounts of the Reserve Bank of India are closed
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the changing of the date for closing the annual accounts of the Reserve Bank of India to June 30, 1940. It amends the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, to adjust references to annual reports and dividends for this specific six-month period.

name: The Trade Marks Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Trade Marks Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and more effective protection of trade marks in British India. It establishes a Register of Trade Marks to be kept at the Patent Office under the control of the Controller of Patents and Designs.

name: The Arbitration Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Arbitration Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to arbitration in British India.
