It establishes definitions for key terms like 'arbitration agreement' and 'award', outlines the authority of arbitrators, and provides procedures for appointing arbitrators when parties fail to agree.

name: The Offences on Ships and Aircraft Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Offences on Ships and Aircraft Act, 1940
metadata.amends: Indian Penal Code, 1860; Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act extends the operation of criminal law to offences committed on ships or aircraft registered in British India, regardless of location. It amends the Indian Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure to include jurisdiction over such offences.

name: The Royal Indian Navy (extension of service) Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Royal Indian Navy (Extension of Service) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the retention in service of certain persons enrolled in the Royal Indian Navy beyond their original term. It applies to those whose service would have expired during or after September 2, 1939, extending their liability for service until discharge by order or a maximum of five years.

name: The Foreigners Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Foreigners Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of restrictions on the entry, presence, and departure of foreigners in British India during the continuance of the present war. It empowers the Central Government to make orders regarding foreigner movement, detention conditions, and identity verification.

name: The Registration (Emergency Powers) Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Registration (Emergency Powers) Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of certain European British subjects residing in British India. It applies to male subjects of European descent between the ages of sixteen and fifty, excluding members of naval, military, or air forces.

name: NA- The War Risks (Goods) Insurance Ordinance, 1940

metadata.title: The War Risks (Goods) Insurance Ordinance, 1940 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the War Risks (Goods) Insurance Ordinance, 1940 to address an emergency situation. It grants the Central Government expanded powers to require information from fire insurers and inspect their premises in British India.

name: NA- The Civic Guards Ordinance, 1940

metadata.title: Civic Guards (Amendment) Ordinance, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Civic Guards Ordinance, 1940, enacted under emergency powers conferred by the Government of India Act, 1935. It adds a new section to define the operational limits for the Calcutta Presidency-town to include specific suburbs as per an 1880 notification.

name: NA- The Coffee Market Expansion Ordinance, 1940

metadata.title: An Ordinance to amend the Coffee Market Expansion Ordinance, 1940
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Coffee Market Expansion Ordinance, 1940 to update regulations regarding coffee sales, licensing, and export permissions. It also modifies provisions related to the surplus pool administration and removes specific clauses concerning storage costs and Board consultations.

name: NA-The Sind Opium Smoking Act, 1940

metadata.title: The Opium (Extension to the North-West Frontier Province) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Opium Act, 1857 to the North-West Frontier Province. It was enacted by the Governor-General and comes into force immediately.

name: The Pakistan Air Force Volunteer Reserve (Discipline) Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Indian Air Force Volunteer Reserve (Discipline) Act, 1939
metadata.repeals: The Indian Air Force Volunteer Reserve (Discipline) Ordinance, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the discipline of members of the Indian Air Force Volunteer Reserve raised in British India. It extends to the whole of British India and applies to these members wherever they may be, subjecting them to the Indian Air Force Act, 1932 during training or actual service.

name: The Defence of India Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Defence of India Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides special measures to ensure public safety, interest, and the defence of British India during a grave emergency caused by war. It establishes the Central Government's power to make rules for securing defence, maintaining public order, and prosecuting war-related offences, including provisions for the detention of persons suspected of hostile acts.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments specified in the First Schedule and repeals others listed in the Second Schedule. It includes provisions to save rights, liabilities, and procedures that existed prior to the repeal of any enactment.

name: The Medical Diplomas Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Medical Diplomas Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act ensures that British subjects holding medical diplomas granted in the United Kingdom or Burma are not excluded from practicing medicine, surgery, or midwifery in British India. It establishes specific conditions regarding notice periods and Privy Council determinations before such exclusions can take effect.

name: The Indian Census Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Indian Census Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for certain matters in connection with the taking of a census of British India during the year 1941. It establishes the appointment of a Census Commissioner, superintendents, and census officers to supervise and conduct the operations throughout the territory.

name: The Pakistan Naval Reserve Forces (Discipline) Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Indian Naval Reserve Forces (Discipline) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the discipline of members of the Indian Naval Reserve Forces raised in British India. It amends the First Schedule to the Indian Navy (Discipline) Act, 1934, and establishes rules regarding attendance for training and actual service.

name: The Sind Nurses, Midwives and Health Visitors Registration Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Sind Nurses, Midwives and Health Visitors Registration Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration and better training of nurses, midwives, health visitors, and assistant midwives in the Province of Sind. It establishes a Council to oversee these professions and defines the composition of that Council along with specific definitions for key terms used throughout the legislation.

name: The Indian Soft Coke Cess Committee (Reconstitution and Incorporation) Act, 1939

metadata.title: Indian Soft Coke Cess Committee (Reconstitution and Incorporation) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and incorporates the Committee previously constituted under the Indian Soft Coke Cess Act, 1929. It dissolves the existing committee and establishes a new body corporate with perpetual succession to manage soft coke cess matters.

name: The Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance of protection conferred on the sugar industry in British India. It amends the Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1932, by extending relevant dates and modifying tariff schedules.

name: The Coal Mines Safety (Stowing) Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Coal Mines Safety (Stowing) Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act provides further measures to ensure safety in coal mines by regulating the operation of stowing and establishing a fund for its assistance. It defines key terms such as 'stowing', 'soft coke', and 'hard coke', and sets up a Coal Mines Stowing Board to administer the fund.

name: The Registration of Foreigners Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Registration of Foreigners Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of foreigners entering, residing in, or departing from British India. It defines who constitutes a foreigner and empowers the Central Government to make rules regarding reporting presence, movement, and departure.

name: The Standards of Weight Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Standards of Weight Act, 1939
metadata.repeals: The Indian Weights and Measures Act, 1874
metadata.summary: This Act establishes uniform standards of weight throughout British India. It defines the standard grain based on an international platinum cylinder and sets specific weights for units like the tola, maund, pound, and ton.

name: The Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and clarifies provisions of Muslim law regarding suits for the dissolution of marriage by women married under that law. It also addresses doubts concerning the effect of a married Muslim woman's renunciation of Islam on her marital status.

name: The Motor Vehicles Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to motor vehicles in British India. It received the assent of the Governor General on February 16, 1939, and was promulgated for general information.

name: The Employment of Children Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Employment of Children Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the admission of children to certain industrial employments, specifically prohibiting their work in railway transport and port goods handling before age fifteen. It establishes penalties for violations, outlines prosecution procedures requiring inspector sanctions, and grants powers to appoint inspectors and make rules regarding age certificates.

name: The Employer's Liability Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Employers' Liability Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act declares that certain defences shall not be raised in suits for damages regarding injuries sustained by workmen in British India. It defines key terms such as 'workman' and 'employer' and specifies circumstances under which a suit for damages cannot fail due to the employer's negligence or the workman's adherence to rules.

name: The Sugar Industry Protection (Temporary Extension) Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Sugar Industry Protection (Temporary Extension) Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuation of protection measures for the sugar industry in British India for a period of one year. It amends the Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1932 by substituting the year 1938 with 1939 in specific sections and adjusting protective rates.

name: The Cutchi Memons Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Cutchi Memons Act, 1938
metadata.repeals: The Cutchi Memons Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act provides that all Cutchi Memons shall be governed by Muhammadan Law in matters of succession and inheritance. It came into force on November 1, 1938, and repealed the previous Cutchi Memons Act of 1920.

name: The Indian Tea Control Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Indian Tea Control (Amendment) Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tea Control Act of 1933 to implement an international agreement regarding tea exports and cultivation limits. It establishes the constitution, membership, and powers of the Indian Tea Licensing Committee for British India.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1938

metadata.title: Indian Finance Act, 1938
metadata.amends: Indian Salt Act, 1882; Indian Post Office Act, 1898; Indian Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act fixes the duty on salt manufactured in or imported by land into certain parts of British India. It also establishes maximum postage rates under the Indian Post Office Act, 1938, and sets income-tax and super-tax rates for the year beginning April 1, 1938.

name: The Manoeuvres, Field Firing and Artillery Practice Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Manoeuvres, Field Firing and Artillery Practice Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act provides facilities for military manoeuvres, field firing, and artillery practice across British India. It outlines the procedures for authorizing such activities, managing land use, and determining compensation for any damage caused to persons or property.

name: The Repealing Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Repealing Act, 1938
metadata.repeals: Various enactments specified in the Schedule (including The Official Gazette Act, 1863; The Court-fees Act, 1870; The Indian Penal Code Amendment Act, 1870; and many others listed in Part I of the Schedule)
metadata.summary: This Act expressly and specifically repeals certain enactments that are spent, unnecessary, or have ceased to be in force. It includes saving provisions to protect rights, privileges, obligations, and liabilities acquired under the repealed laws, as well as references to those laws.

name: The Insurance Act, 1938

metadata.title: The Insurance Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the business of insurance in British India. It defines key terms such as insurer, insured, policy-holder, and approved securities, while establishing regulatory frameworks for insurance companies and agents.

name: NA-The Zhob Militia Law, 1938

metadata.title: The Zhob Militia Law (Amendment) Order, 1954
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Zhob Militia Law, 1938, to alter provisions regarding offences and punishments for members of the militia. It also modifies the authority responsible for inspecting officers and establishes procedures for summary trials by Political Officers.

name: The Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937

metadata.title: The Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1937
metadata.repeals: Section 26 of the Bombay Regulation IV of 1827; Section 1367 of the Madras Courts Act, 1887; Section 3 of the Oudh Laws Act, 1876; Section 5 of the Punjab Laws Act, 1872; Section 5 of the Central Provinces Laws Act, 1875; Section 4 of the Ajmere Laws Regulation, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the dissolution of marriage by a District Judge on grounds recognized by Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) upon petition by a Muslim divorced woman. It also empowers authorities to make rules regarding fees for filing declarations and attendance at private residences, which take effect as if enacted in this Act.

name: The Federal Court Act, 1937

metadata.title: The Federal Court Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Federal Court to make rules regulating the service of processes issued by the Court. It specifically grants the power to require High Courts to serve processes related to appeals preferred to the Federal Court.

name: The Rules and Regulations Continuance Act, 1937

metadata.title: The Rules and Regulations Continuance Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuance in force of certain rules made under the Indian Electricity Act, 1910, and regulations made under the Indian Boilers Act, 1923. It deems these pre-March 1937 instruments to have been made by the authority substituted for the Governor General in Council.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1937

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1937
metadata.repeals: Various enactments specified in the Second Schedule (including The Salt Act, 1864; The Bengal Salt Act, 1873; The Land Acquisition Act, 1894; The Mines Act, 1885; The Indian Companies Act, 1913)
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing enactments and explicitly repeals other laws that are spent or have ceased to be in force. It provides specific amendments to acts such as the Indian Companies Act, Income-tax Act, and Merchant Shipping Act, while listing numerous repealed statutes in its schedules.

name: The Arya Marriage Validation Act, 1937

metadata.title: The Arya Marriage Validation Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act recognizes and removes doubts regarding the validity of inter-marriages among Arya Samajis. It declares that such marriages are valid regardless of caste differences or prior religious affiliations, overriding conflicting provisions in Hindu law.

name: The Hindu Women's Rights to Property Act, 1937

metadata.title: The Hindu Women's Short Title and Rights to Property Act, 1937
metadata.amends: Hindu Law governing Hindu Women's Rights to Property
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Hindu Law to provide better property rights for women in British India. It establishes rules for how a Hindu's separate property devolves upon his widow and lineal descendants when he dies intestate, subject to specific exceptions regarding customary succession and pre-Act deaths.

name: The Arbitration (Protocol and Convention) Act, 1937

metadata.title: The Arbitration (Protocol and Convention) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act makes further provisions respecting the law of arbitration in British India to give effect to specific protocols and conventions. It defines foreign awards, outlines procedures for filing them in court, and establishes their enforceability within British India.

name: The Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act, 1937

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act, 1937
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the grading and marking of agricultural produce across British India. It defines key terms related to quality, grade designations, and counterfeit marks, while empowering the Governor General in Council to make rules regarding these standards.

name: The Durgah Khawaja Saheb Act, 1936

metadata.title: The Durgah Khawaja Saheb Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act provides better provisions for the administration and control of the Durgah Khawaja Saheb in Ajmer. It establishes a Committee consisting of twenty-five members to manage the endowment, defining their composition, qualifications, and election processes.

name: The Red Cross Society (Allocation of Property) Act, 1936

metadata.title: The Red Cross Society (Allocation of Property) Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the creation of a fund from the property of the Indian Red Cross Society to be administered by a Burma Red Cross Society. It also terminates the existing functions of the Indian Red Cross Society within Burma.

name: The Banglore Marriages Validating Act 1936

metadata.title: The Bangalore Marriages Validating Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain marriages solemnized in the Civil and Military Station of Bangalore by Walter James McDonald Redwood. It deems these marriages between Christian subjects of His Majesty to be good and valid in law as if they had been performed under a proper license.

name: The Geneva Convention Implementing Act, 1936

metadata.title: The Geneva Convention Short title and Implementing Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act implements the Geneva Convention and establishes prohibitions on using the Red Cross emblem or the Swiss federal white cross for trade or business purposes. It outlines penalties for contravention, including fines up to fifty rupees, and requires prior sanction from the Governor General in Council for criminal court cognizance.

name: The Cochin Port Act, 1936

metadata.title: Cochin Port Act
subjects: Madras Outports Landing and Shipping Fees Act
metadata.summary: This Act makes special provision for the administration of the port of Cochin. It specifies that certain enactments shall be construed as if references to local governments were references to the Governor General in Council.

name: The the Decrees and Orders Validation Act, 1936

metadata.title: The Decrees and Orders Validation Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to remove doubts regarding the validity of certain proceedings in High Courts of Judicature in British India. It establishes that decrees and orders passed or made by these High Courts under their Letters Patent are valid, notwithstanding any contrary provisions in the Indian Independence Act, 1947.

name: The salt addition import Duty (Extending) Act, 1936

metadata.title: The Salt Additional Import Duty (Extending) Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act further extends the operation of the Salt (Additional Import Duty) Act, 1931. It was received the assent of the Governor General on April 21, 1936, and promulgated for general information.

name: The Italian Loans and Credits Prohibition Act, 1936

metadata.title: An Act to prohibit the making of certain loans and credits
metadata.repeals: The Italian Loans and Credits Prohibition Ordinance, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits persons from making loans or credits to governments or individuals in Italian territories. It also defines specific financial activities, such as giving guarantees or buying bills of exchange, as constituting prohibited loans. The legislation repeals the previous Ordinance from 1935 and allows for its own termination via a future notification.

name: The Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act, 1936

metadata.title: The Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act, 1936
metadata.amends: The Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to marriage and divorce among Parsis in British India. It establishes regulations for the solemnization of marriages, including requirements for certificates, witnesses, and fees payable to registrars.

name: The Payment of Wages Act, 1936

metadata.title: The Payment of Wages Act, 1936
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the payment of wages to certain classes of persons employed in industry, including factories and railways. It defines key terms such as 'factory', 'industrial establishment', and 'wages', while specifying who is responsible for wage payments and the timelines for such payments.

name: The Indian Coffee Cess Act, 1935

metadata.title: Indian Coffee Cess Act
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a cess on the importation of coffee by sea or land for the creation of a fund to promote Indian coffee cultivation, manufacture, and sale. It establishes a Committee constituted under Section 4 of the Act to manage monies collected from this cess.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1935

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend certain enactments and repeal others as specified in the attached schedules. It includes provisions ensuring that repeals do not affect existing rights, liabilities, or proceedings already acquired under the repealed laws.

name: The Central province Courts (Supplementary) Act 1935

metadata.title: The Sind Courts (Supplementary) Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, specifically regarding clauses related to the Chief Courts of Oudh and Sind. It substitutes references to these courts with the High Court of Judicature at Nagpur in specific sections.

name: Government of India Act, 1935

metadata.title: Government of India Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Federation of India and defines the structure of the Federal Executive and Legislature. It also outlines the provisions for Governors' Provinces, their legislatures, and administrative powers.

name: The Iron and Steel Duties Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Iron and Steel Duties Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act of 1894 to impose an excise duty of four rupees per ton on steel ingots manufactured in India. It also provides for the recovery of unpaid duties as arrears of land revenue and outlines procedures regarding penalties, warehousing, and exemptions applicable to the new duty.

name: The Navy (Discipline) Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Indian Navy (Discipline) Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act applies the provisions of the Naval Discipline Act to the naval forces raised by the Governor General in Council. It includes specific modifications and adaptations necessary for the circumstances of the Indian Navy, covering topics such as misconduct, duty during action, and penalties for mutiny.

name: The Petroleum Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Petroleum Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the import, transport, storage, production, refining, and blending of petroleum and other inflammable substances. It establishes rules for the control over these activities and provides for the licensing and regulation of dangerous petroleum.

name: The Repealing and Amedning Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1934
metadata.amends: various enactments specified in the First Schedule
metadata.repeals: enactments specified in the Second Schedule
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain existing enactments and repeals others that are spent or unnecessary. It provides for specific substitutions, omissions, and insertions within the schedules listed in the document.

name: The Factories Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Factories Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the working conditions in factories across British India, establishing definitions for terms like 'factory' and 'occupier'. It sets out provisions regarding the health, safety, welfare of workers, restrictions on child labor, and the powers of factory inspectors.

name: The Sugar Exsice Duty Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Sugar (Excise Duty) Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act imposes an excise duty on sugar produced in factories within British India and provides for the collection of that duty. It defines key terms such as 'factory', 'owner', and types of sugar like 'Khandsari' and 'palmyra sugar', while also outlining penalties for evasion and procedures for inspection.

name: The Sugar-cane Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Sugar-cane Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the price at which sugar-cane intended for use in sugar factories may be purchased to assure growers a fair price. It defines key terms such as 'controlled area', 'factory', and 'sugar', and empowers local governments to set minimum prices and issue licenses to purchasing agents.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Indian Tariff Act, VIII of 1894
metadata.amends: The Indian Tariff Act, VIII of 1894
metadata.summary: This document contains amendments to the Indian Tariff Act of 1894. It specifically addresses provisions regarding salt duty and modifications to schedules within the act.

name: The Khaddar (Name Protection) Act, 1935

metadata.title: The Khaddar (Name Protection) Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of the name 'Khaddar' and 'Khadi' when used as trade descriptions for woven materials. It applies to the whole of British India, including British Baluchistan and the Sonthal Parganas.

name: The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the Reserve Bank of India and defines its obligations regarding government business, currency issuance, and reserve management. It establishes the bank's right to issue notes, manage sterling reserves, and regulate fluctuations in rupee coin assets.

name: The Murshidabad Estate Administration Act, 1933

metadata.title: The Murshidabad Estate Administration Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of a manager to administer the Murshidabad Estate. It outlines the manager's powers regarding rents, issues, profits, and debt realization, while also defining the legal status of the estate and its properties.

name: The Wireless Telegraphy Act, 1933

metadata.title: The Wireless Telegraphy Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act regulates wireless telegraphy apparatus and authorizes the telegraph authority to issue licenses under prescribed conditions. It defines offenses related to possessing unauthorized apparatus and establishes penalties, including fines and confiscation.

name: The Safeguarding of Industries Act, 1933

metadata.title: The Safeguarding Industries Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of additional duties on imported goods to safeguard industries in British India. It extends to the whole of British India, including Aden and Perim, and remains in force until March 81st day of 1935.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1933

metadata.title: Act No. VII of 1933
metadata.amends: Indian Salt Act, 1882; Indian Tariff Act, 1894; Indian Post Office Act, 1898; Indian Income-tax Act, 1922; Indian Finance Act, 1931; Indian Finance (Supplementary and Extending) Act, 1931; Indian Paper Currency Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing laws to fix duties on salt manufactured or imported into India. It also adjusts maximum tariff rates, modifies income-tax and super-tax provisions, updates postage rates, and corrects figures in the Indian Paper Currency Act.

name: The Wheat Import Duty Extending Act, 1933

metadata.title: The Wheat (Import Duty) Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This document is an Act to extend the operation of The Wheat (Import Duty) Act, 1933. It amends section 1 of the original act by substituting specific figures.

name: The Children (Pledging of Labour) Act, 1933

metadata.title: The Children (Labour) Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits agreements to pledge the labour of children under the age of fourteen years. It defines such prohibited agreements and establishes penalties for parents, guardians, or employers who make or enforce these agreements.

name: NA- The City of Karachi Municipal Act, 1933

metadata.title: The City of Karachi Municipal (Amendment) Ordinance, 1949
metadata.amends: The City of Karachi Municipal Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the City of Karachi Municipal Act, 1933 to address an emergency situation. It grants the Provincial Government powers to alter the city's population statistics, dissolve the Corporation, and restructure ward compositions based on adult population.

name: The Tea Districts Emigrant Labour Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Emigration Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the emigration of labourers from India, establishing provisions for repatriation and the powers of criminal courts regarding this matter. It also defines restricted recruiting areas and outlines the licensing requirements for recruiters and garden-sardars.

name: The Public Suits Validation Act, 1932

metadata.title: Act No. XI of 1932
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain public suits and appeals that were dismissed solely because the required sanction of the Local Government under section 93 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, was not obtained. It applies to cases where the dismissal occurred after November 30, 1931, but before this Act commenced.

name: The Foreign Relations Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Foreign Relations Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act provides against the publication of statements likely to prejudice friendly relations between His Majesty's Government and certain foreign States. It extends to the whole of British India, including British Baluchistan and the Sonthal Parganas.

name: The Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Sugar Industry (Protection) Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act provides for amendments to be made in Schedule II of the Indian Tariff Act, 1894. It authorizes the Local Government to make rules regarding sugar-cane floating in sugar factories and establishes specific tariff headings for sugar and other food and drink items.

name: The Air Force Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Indian Air Force Act
metadata.summary: This Act defines service offences punishable by death, long imprisonment, and other penalties within the Indian Air Force. It establishes procedures for courts-martial, including powers of confirming authorities, revision of sentences, and the execution of punishments.

name: The Partnership Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Indian Partnership Act
metadata.summary: This Act defines the nature of partnership and the rights and duties of partners to one another. It also covers relations between partners and third parties, registration of firms, and the dissolution of a firm.

name: The Salt Additional Import Duty (Extending) Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Salt (Additional Import Duty) Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Salt (Additional Import Duty) Act, 1931. It specifically alters section 1 to substitute the year 1933 for 1932 and modifies sub-sections regarding the imposition of duty.

name: The Wire and Wire Nail Industry (Protection) Act, 1932

metadata.title: Act
metadata.summary: This document amends Schedule II of the Indian Tariff Act, 1894 to alter duties on iron or steel wire and wire nails. The changes are intended to foster and develop the wire nail industry in India while considering the well-being of the country.

name: The Employee and Workmen (Disputes) Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Employers and Workmen (Disputes) Repealing Act, 1932
metadata.repeals: The Employers and Workmen (Disputes) Act, 1860
metadata.summary: This Act was promulgated to repeal the Employers and Workmen (Disputes) Act, 1860. It received the assent of the Governor General on March 5, 1932.

name: The Wheat Import Duty (Extending) Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Wheat (Import Duty) Act, 1931 (Extending)
metadata.repeals: Section 3 of the Wheat (Import Duty) Act, 1931
metadata.summary: This Act extends the operation of the Wheat (Import Duty) Act, 1931. It substitutes the year 1933 with 1939 in Section 1 and repeals Section 3 of the original 1931 Act.

name: The Unlawful Association (North-West Frontier Province) Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: The Unlawful Association (North-West Frontier Province) Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides further measures against unlawful associations in the North-West Frontier Province that are considered dangerous to public peace. It empowers local authorities to notify and take possession of places used by such associations, seize associated property, and declare monies or securities forfeited to His Majesty.

name: The Unlawful Instigation (North-West Frontier Province) Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: The Unlawful Instigation (North-West Frontier Province) Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to provide against instigation for the illegal refusal to pay certain liabilities in the North-West Frontier Province. It defines notified liabilities, prescribes punishments for instigating non-payment, and establishes special procedural rules for enforcing these debts as land-revenue arrears.

name: The North-West Frontier Province Emergency Powers Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: North-West Frontier Province Emergency Powers Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor-General to maintain law and order in the North-West Frontier Province. It grants government officers powers to arrest persons without a warrant if their actions are deemed prejudicial to public safety or peace, and allows for restrictions on movement and control of essential commodities.

name: The United Provinces Emergency Powers Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: United Provinces Emergency Powers Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to prevent instigation against the illegal refusal of payment of certain liabilities. It confers special powers on the Government of the United Provinces and its officers to maintain law and order during an emergency.

name: NA- The Punjab Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Punjab Municipal (Executive Officers) (Amendment) Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur State Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1931 to extend its application to specific districts including Bahawalnagar, Bahawalpur, and Rahimyar-khan. It simultaneously repeals the Bahawalpur State Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1951 for municipalities within those districts, effectively re-enacting them under the amended Punjab Act.

name: The Bengal Emergency Powers Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: The Bengal Emergency Powers Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers special powers on the Government of Bengal and its officers to suppress the terrorist movement. It also provides for the speedier trial of offences committed in furtherance of or in connection with that movement.

name: The Indian Finance (Supplementary and Extending) Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Indian Finance (Supplementary and Extending) Act, 1931
metadata.summary: This Act supplements the Indian Finance Act, 1931, and extends its temporary provisions to the financial year beginning on April 1, 1932. It amends various schedules regarding salt duty, inland postage rates, income tax, and super-tax, while also introducing additional duties on specific goods.

name: The Kashmir State (Protection against Disorders) Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: The Kashmir State (Protection against Disorders) Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to prevent assemblies of men from proceeding from British India into the territory of His Highness the Maharaja of Jammu and Kashmir. It also aims to promote disorder-free conditions within that territory by empowering District Magistrates to disperse unlawful assemblies or prohibit future gatherings likely to cause interference with administration or public safety.

name: The Indian Press (Emergency Powers) Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Press and Registration of Books Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the keeping of printing presses and newspapers by requiring keepers to make a declaration under section 4. It empowers local governments to require security deposits from press keepers if there is a risk that the publication may incite murder or violence.

name: The Heavy Chemical Industry (Protection) Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Heavy Chemicals Industry (Protection) Act, 1931
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act, 1894 to provide protection for the heavy chemical industry in British India. It specifically adjusts duties on various chemicals like sodium sulphate and magnesium chloride to ensure effective protection for local manufacturing.

name: The Sheriff of Calcutta (Powers of Custody) Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Sheriff of Calcutta (Powers of Custody) Act, 1931
metadata.summary: This Act extends the powers of the Sheriff of Calcutta to hold persons in lawful custody. It grants retrospective effect to these powers as if they had commenced on September 1, 1925.

name: The Provisional Collection of Taxes Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Provisional Collection of Taxes Act
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the immediate imposition or increase of duties on imports and exports. It establishes rules regarding when declared provisions cease to have the force of law, including upon becoming an enactment or if a motion is passed in either House.

name: The Gold and Sterling Sales Regulation Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: The Gold and Sterling Sales Regulation Ordinance, 1931
metadata.repeals: The Currency Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Currency Ordinance, 1931 and regulates the sale of gold or sterling under Section 5 of the Currency Act, 1927. It mandates that such sales be conducted exclusively by the Imperial Bank of India at its Calcutta and Bombay head offices for specific purposes like normal trade and personal needs.

name: The Currency Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: The Currency Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance temporarily relieves the Governor General in Council of the obligation to sell gold or sterling when demanded. It suspends section 5 of the Currency Act, 1927, until a contrary notification is issued.

name: The Burma Emergency Powers Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: Burma Emergency Powers Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance confers special powers upon the Local Government of Burma and its officers to suppress rebellion and disorder. It aims to restore and maintain law and order within specified districts of Burma by granting authorities broad powers for arrest, movement restrictions, and property seizure.

name: The Wheat (Import Duty) Act, 1931

metadata.title: An Act to impose a temporary duty of customs on the importation of wheat
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a temporary customs duty of two rupees per hundredweight on the importation of wheat into ports in British India. It applies to all ports except Aden and Perim and is intended to assist the sale of wheat.

name: The Salt (Additional Import Duty) Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Salt (Additional Import Duty) Act, 1931
metadata.summary: This Act imposes an additional customs duty on salt imported into ports in British India, excluding Aden and Perim. It establishes specific rates for the sale of fine white salt by producers to the Secretary of State for India in Council and defines the price structure based on freight differences.

name: The Foreign Relations Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: The Foreign Relations Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to prevent the publication of statements likely to promote unfriendly relations between His Majesty's Government and foreign States. It imposes penalties including imprisonment or fines on anyone who makes, publishes, or circulates such statements with that intent.

name: The Vizagapatam Port Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Madras Outports Land-revenue and Shipping Fees Act, 1885
metadata.amends: The Madras Outports Land-revenue and Shipping Fees Act, 1885
metadata.summary: This document serves as an amendment to the Madras Outports Land-revenue and Shipping Fees Act, 1885. It clarifies that references to the Governor General in Council and the Gazette of India within the original enactment are deemed to have been done under this new act from its commencement.

name: The Burma Rebellion (Trials) Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: The Burma Rebellion (Trials) Ordinance, 1931
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the speedy trial of persons accused of offences connected with the recent rebellion in Burma. It establishes Special Tribunals and appoints Special Judges to try these specific cases within designated districts, while limiting appeals to only those involving severe sentences.

name: The Gold Thread Industry (Protection) Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Indian Finance Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This document amends the Indian Tariff Act, 1894 by omitting specific items related to gold and silver thread and wire from the First Schedule. It also inserts a new item regarding silver plate and manufactures not otherwise specified.

name: The Steel Industry (Protection) Act, 1931

metadata.title: Amendment of the Second Schedule to the Indian Tariff Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Second Schedule to the Indian Tariff Act, 1894 by modifying specific items related to steel rivets and railway components. It omits certain words regarding keys and distance pieces while adding new entries for steel rivets.

name: The Repealing Ordinance, 1931

metadata.title: The Repealing Ordinance, 1931
metadata.repeals: The Unlawful Association Ordinance, 1930; The Indian Press and Unauthorised News-sheets and Newspaper Ordinance, 1930; The Unlawful Instigation (Second) Ordinance, 1930
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor General under the Government of India Act, 1935. It serves to repeal three specific Ordinances from 1930 related to unlawful associations, press restrictions, and unlawful instigation.

name: NA- The Panth Piploda Courts Regulation, 1931

metadata.title: The Panth Piplods Courts (Amendment) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Panth Piplods Courts Act of 1931. It provides for the appointment of a person as a further Additional Judge of the Court of the Chief Commissioner for the disposal of cases according to law.

name: The Aligarh Muslim University Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental College Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and incorporates the Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental College at Aligarh as a university. It provides for the dissolution of previously registered societies and grants them specific powers, privileges, and tenure rights within the new university structure.

name: The Musalman Wakf Validating Act, 1930

metadata.title: The Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act validates Wakfs created before its commencement in the Punjab region. It ensures that rights, titles, obligations, or liabilities acquired before this Act do not affect the validity of these Wakfs.

name: The Hindu Gains of Learning Act, 1930

metadata.title: The Hindu Gains of Learning Act
metadata.summary: This Act clarifies that gains acquired by a Hindu through learning are not automatically considered the exclusive property of the acquirer merely because the education was imparted by family members or funded by joint resources. It defines specific terms such as 'acquirer', 'gains of learning', and 'learning' to establish rules regarding property rights within divided families.

name: The Lac Cess Act, 1930

metadata.title: The Act No. XXIV of 1930
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a customs duty known as 'lac cess' on the manufacture and marketing of Indian lac. It establishes a Committee to manage the collection of this cess and oversee the improvement, cultivation, and marketing of the industry.

name: The Silver (Excise Duty) Act, 1930

metadata.title: Sea Customs Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act governs the levy and exemption of customs duties specifically regarding silver. It outlines procedures for warehousing, penalties for contravention, and the authority to make rules for assessment and recovery of arrears.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1930

metadata.title: The Indian Finance Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act of 1894 by inserting new items into its schedules regarding super-tax on silver and other metals. It also modifies definitions related to total income under the Indian Income-tax Act.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1930

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1930
metadata.amends: various enactments specified in the First Schedule
metadata.repeals: enactments specified in the Second Schedule
metadata.summary: This Act amends specific provisions in various existing enactments listed in the First Schedule. It also expressly repeals certain other enactments that have become spent or unnecessary, as listed in the Second Schedule.

name: The Sale of Goods Act, 1930

metadata.title: The Sale of Goods Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to the sale of goods in British India. It establishes implied conditions, warranties, and rules regarding the transfer of property and risk between sellers and buyers.

name: The Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930

metadata.title: The Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for dealing with dangerous drugs, including provisions for enhanced punishment for certain offences after previous conviction. It outlines powers regarding entry, search, seizure, arrest, and penalties for contraventions of specific sections.

name: The Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929

metadata.title: The Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to restrain the solemnisation of child marriages within British India. It defines a minor as a person under eighteen years of age and prescribes specific punishments for males contracting such marriages, persons performing them, and guardians who fail to prevent them.

name: NA- The Trade Disputes Act, 1929

metadata.title: The Trade Disputes Act, 1929
metadata.summary: This document amends the Trade Disputes Act, 1929, specifically regarding section 13. It modifies provisions related to consent in writing for trade unions and restricts criminal courts from trying offenses under the amended section without prior sanction.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1928

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1928
metadata.amends: The General Clauses Act, 1897; The Indian Stamp Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend and revive certain repealed enactments specified in its schedules. It specifically targets the General Clauses Act, 1897, and the Indian Stamp Act, 1899, among others, to update their provisions.

name: The Match Industry (Protection) Act, 1928

metadata.title: The Match Industry Protection Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Match Industry Protection Act of 1894 to update the list of dutiable items. It omits specific existing items and inserts new headings for matches, undipped splints, and veneers with revised duty rates.

name: The Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act, 1928

metadata.title: An Act to amend the Hindu Law relating to exclusion from inheritance of certain classes of heirs, and to remove certain doubts
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Hindu Law regarding the exclusion of certain classes of heirs from inheritance. It specifically addresses issues related to persons governed by the Dayabhaga School and removes doubts concerning inheritance rights for individuals with diseases, deformities, or mental defects.

name: The Steel Industry (Protection) Act, 1928

metadata.title: The Steel Industry (Protection) Act, 1928
metadata.amends: The Second Schedule to the Iron and Steel Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Second Schedule to the Iron and Steel Act, 1894, to modify import duties on iron or steel items. Specifically, it removes protective duties on certain nails and wire while adjusting tariff treatment for bolts, nuts, and fencing-wire.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1928

metadata.title: The Indian Super-tax Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a super-tax on the total income of individuals and companies in British India for the year beginning April 1, 1928. It amends the Indian Income-tax Act, 1923, by specifying new tax rates based on income brackets and defining 'total income' for these purposes.

name: The Forest Act, 1927

metadata.title: The Exceeds Forest Act, 1927
metadata.repeals: The Exceeds Forest Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to forests, transit of forest-produce, and cattle-trespass in Punjab. It establishes provisions for reserved, village, and protected forests, outlines the powers of forest officers, and details penalties for contraventions.

name: The Lighthouse Act, 1927

metadata.title: The Lighthouse Act, 1927
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the erection, maintenance, and control of lighthouses in British India. It establishes the powers of the Central Government regarding general lighthouses and defines terms such as 'local lighthouse' and 'light-dues'.

name: The Sind Courts (Supplementary) Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Sind Courts Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act serves as a supplementary legislation to the Sind Courts Act, 1926. It amends various existing enactments to replace references to the 'Court of Oudh' with 'Courts of Oudh and Sind' and inserts specific provisions regarding the Chief Court of Sind.

name: The Negotiable Instruments (Interest) Act, 1926

metadata.title: Act XXVI of 1881
metadata.summary: This document amends the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 and the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. It specifically alters provisions regarding costs, interest calculations on decrees, and specific forms within the civil procedure code.

name: The Delhi Joint Water Board Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Delhi Joint Water Board Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Delhi Joint Water Board as a body corporate to maintain works supplying drinking water in bulk for the urban area of Delhi. It defines the composition of the board, including ex-officio members and nominated persons, and vests former properties of constituent bodies into the new board.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Indian Finance Act, 1926
metadata.amends: The Cotton Duties Act, 1896; The Indian Post Office Act, 1898; The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1923; The Indian Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.repeals: The Cotton Duties Act, 1896
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Cotton Duties Act of 1896 and amends several other statutes including those related to postage, paper currency, and income tax. It establishes new rates for income tax and super-tax for the year beginning April 1, 1926, and provides for the appropriation of monies to reduce public debt.

name: The Trade Unions Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Indian Trade Unions Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of Trade Unions and defines the law relating to them in British India. It establishes the framework for appointing Registrars, defining key terms like 'trade dispute' and 'executive', and outlines the requirements for applying for registration.

name: The Cotton Industry (Statistics) Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Cotton Industry (Statistics) Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for collecting statistics regarding cotton goods and yarn spun in British India. It defines key terms such as 'cotton goods', 'cotton yarn', and 'mill', and mandates that mill owners deliver returns to prescribed officers within a specified timeframe.

name: The Legal Practitioners (Fees) Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Legal Practitioners (Fees) Act, 1926
metadata.repeals: Sections 28 to 31 of the Legal Practitioners Act, 1879; Sections 17, 18, 19 and 28 of the Bombay Pleaders Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act defines the rights of legal practitioners to sue for their fees and professional services under private agreements. It also exempts legal practitioners from being sued for negligence in the conduct of their professional duties.

name: The Promissory Notes (Stamp) Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Promissory Notes (Validation) Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain promissory notes that were stamped with postage stamps of two or four annas. It applies to notes executed before January 5, 1925, which would otherwise be invalid due to the stamp description.

name: The Small Cause Courts (Attachment of Immovable Property) Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Small Cause Courts (Attachment of Immovable Property) Act, 1926
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887; The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act resolves certain doubts regarding the powers of Provincial Small Cause Courts and other courts concerning the attachment of immovable property. It amends the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887, and the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, by substituting specific clauses related to injunctions, interlocutory orders, and rules on attachment.

name: The Naturalization Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Indian Naturalization Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the naturalization of aliens resident in British India. It defines terms such as 'British subject' and outlines the conditions regarding age, birth, residence, and profession required for a certificate of naturalization.

name: The Government Trading Taxation Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Government Trading Taxation Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act determines the liability of certain Government trading operations to taxation in British India. It stipulates that such operations shall be liable to income-tax and other taxes in the same manner as any private person would be.

name: NA- The Punjab Act, 1926

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Ordinance, 1957
metadata.amends: The Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Act, 1926 to the entire Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: The Contempt of Courts Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Contempt of Courts Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act defines and limits the powers of High Courts and Chief Courts in punishing contempts of subordinate courts. It resolves doubts regarding the jurisdiction of these superior courts to punish contempt committed in respect of subordinate courts, particularly when such contempt is an offence under the Indian Penal Code.

name: NA-The Sind Courts Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Sind Courts (Capital of the Federation) (Amendment) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Sind Courts Act, 1926 by substituting a new section 43 that mandates courts to use a specific circular seal design. The new seal must feature English and Naskh script titles along with a crescent moon and star in the center. Until the new seals are issued, existing seals may continue to be used temporarily.

name: The Bar Council Act, 1926

metadata.title: The Indian Bar Councils Act, 1926
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of Bar Councils for High Courts in British India. It defines the composition of these councils, including nominated and elected members, and establishes rules regarding their terms of office and election procedures.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act serves to amend certain enactments and repeal others that have ceased to be in force or are unnecessary. It provides specific instructions for substituting text in various sections of existing laws listed in its schedules.

name: The Madras, Bengal and Bombay Children (Supplementary) Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Madras, Bengal and Act of the Indian Legislature
metadata.amends: The Children Act, 1920; The Bengal Act, 1922; The Bombay Children Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act supplements certain provisions of the Children Act, 1920, the Bengal Act, 1922, and the Bombay Children Act, 1924. It ensures that these Acts are valid as if passed by the Indian Legislature regarding appellate and revisional jurisdiction in High Courts at Madras, Fort William in Bengal, and Bombay.

name: The Oudh Courts (Supplementary) Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Oudh Courts Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act supplements the Oudh Courts Act, 1920. It amends various enactments to insert references to the Chief Court of Oudh in definitions and clauses throughout different legal codes.

name: The Coal Grading Board Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Coal Grading Board Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Coal Grading Board to determine the grade of coal intended for export from British India. It provides for the grant of certificates and shipment certificates upon inspection and payment of fees, while also outlining the board's composition and powers.

name: The Succession Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Indian Succession Act
metadata.summary: This Act governs succession to moveable property in British India, establishing rules for domicile and the effects of marriage on legal status. It details the requirements for making wills, including provisions for privileged and unprivileged wills, as well as rules for their execution, revocation, and construction.

name: The Bamboo Paper Industry (Protection) Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Bamboo Paper Industry (Protection) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the fostering and development of the bamboo paper industry in British India. It amends the Indian Tariff Act, 1894 by increasing import duties on certain kinds of paper and stationery to protect domestic industries.

name: The Carriage of Goods by Sea Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Carriage of Goods by Sea Act, 1925
metadata.amends: The Carriage of Goods by Sea Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the carriage of goods by sea in British India, incorporating rules from international conferences held in Brussels. It establishes responsibilities and liabilities for carriers under bills of lading while modifying provisions related to the evidence of receipt and weight of goods.

name: The Legislative Members Exemption Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Legislative Members Exemption Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act exempts members of the Indian Legislature and Legislative Council from liability to arrest or detention in prison under civil process during legislative meetings. It also grants exemptions from serving as jurors or assessors for a period extending fourteen days before and after such meetings.

name: The Sikh Gurdwaras (Supplementary) Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Sikh Gurdwaras (Supplementary) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act serves to supplement certain provisions of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925. It amends specific sections and subsections of that Act by inserting new text regarding appointments and vacancies.

name: The Provident Funds Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Provident Funds Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the law relating to Government and other Provident Funds across British India. It defines key terms such as 'Provident Fund', 'Railway Administration', and 'dependant' to regulate subscriptions, deposits, and payments upon contingencies.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Indian Finance Act, 1923
metadata.amends: The Indian Tariff Act, 1894; The Indian Post Office Act, 1898; The Motor Spirit (Duties) Act, 1917; The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1923; The Indian Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing laws including the Indian Tariff Act, Post Office Act, Motor Spirit Duties Act, Paper Currency Act, and Income-tax Act. It fixes salt duties, adjusts postage rates, modifies motor spirit duty calculations, updates currency definitions, and revises income tax figures effective from April 1, 1925.

name: The Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Cotton Ginning and Pressing Factories Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act regulates cotton ginning and pressing factories in British India by mandating the maintenance of specific registers for ginning and pressing activities. It also requires that pressed cotton bales be marked with serial numbers and factory marks before removal from the press-house.

name: The Obscene Publications Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Obscene Publications Act, 1926
metadata.repeals: Sections 292 and 293 of the Indian Penal Code, Act XLV of 1860
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, to give effect to the International Convention for the Suppression of the Circulation of and Traffic in Obscene Publications. It substitutes new sections into the Indian Penal Code regarding the sale, distribution, and circulation of obscene materials.

name: The Legislative Assembly (President's Salary) Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Legislative Assembly (President's Salary) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a salary for the elected President of the Legislative Assembly. The salary is set at four thousand rupees per month, determined by an Act of the Indian Legislature.

name: The Soldiers (Litigation) Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Indian Soldiers (Litigation) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the special protection for Indian soldiers in civil and revenue litigation. It provides specific rules for postponing legal proceedings against soldiers who are on leave, sick leave, or serving under special conditions such as war or overseas service.

name: The Workmen's Breach of Contract (Repealing) Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Workmen's Breach of Contract (Repealing) Act, 1925
metadata.repeals: The Workmen's Breach of Contract Act, 1859
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain enactments whereby breaches of contract by labourers were made punishable under the criminal law. It specifically targets the Workmen's Breach of Contract Act, 1859, and related sections of the Indian Penal Code and Titles Act.

name: NA- The Ajmer-Merwara Municipalities Regulation, 1925

metadata.title: The Ajmer-Merwara Municipalities Regulation (Amendment) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ajmer-Merwara Municipalities Regulation of 1925 to lower the educational qualification required for enrollment as an elector. Specifically, it substitutes a sub-clause in section 30(2) to accept holders of Upper Primary certificates or equivalent examinations.

name: NA- The Sind Municipal Boroughs Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Sind Municipal Boroughs (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Municipal Boroughs Act, 1929 to allow for the extension of a councillor's term of office by up to one year. It also adds a new section detailing the consequences if the ordinary term expires before elections are held, requiring officials to vacate their office and treating the municipality as superseded until re-elections occur within one year.

name: The Land Customs Act, 1924

metadata.title: The Land Customs Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act defines terms related to land customs and the levy of duties on goods transported by land. It grants powers to the Governor General in Council regarding notifications for specific classes or values of goods.

name: The Steel Industry (Protection) Act, 1924

metadata.title: The Steel Industry (Protection) Act, 1924
metadata.amends: The Indian Iron and Steel Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act establishes bounties to foster and develop the steel industry in British India for the manufacture of rails or fish-plates. It amends the Indian Iron and Steel Act, 1913, by adding provisions regarding duties and bounties payable based on when the manufacturing was completed relative to specific dates in 1925 and 1926.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1924

metadata.title: The Indian Finance Act, 1924
metadata.amends: Indian Tariff Act, 1894; Indian Post Office Act, 1898; Indian Finance Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act fixes duties on salt manufactured or imported into certain parts of British India and amends the Indian Tariff Act, 1894. It also updates postal rates under the Indian Post Office Act, 1898 and repeals specific sections of the Indian Finance Act, 1923.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1924

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments listed in the First Schedule and repeals specific enactments listed in the Second Schedule. It also includes provisions to ensure that repeals do not affect existing rights, liabilities, or remedies already acquired.

name: The Central Board of Revenue Act, 1924

metadata.title: The Central Board of Revenue Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes a Central Board of Revenue and amends existing enactments to transfer powers and duties from local authorities to the Central Board. It specifically revises the Indian Customs Act, 1878, by substituting references to local governments with the Chief Customs-authority and updating sections regarding appointments and official gazettes.

name: The Immigration Act, 1924

metadata.title: An Act to regulate the entry into and residence in British India of persons domiciled in other British Possessions
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the entry into and residence in British India for persons domiciled in other British Possessions. It empowers the Governor General in Council to make rules ensuring that such persons do not have greater rights than those accorded by the law of their domicile, while also establishing suitable agencies and penalties for contraventions.

name: The Cantonments Act, 1924

metadata.title: The Cantonments Act
metadata.summary: This Act defines cantonments and establishes the structure of Cantonment Authorities and Boards. It outlines procedures for taxation, property management, and the duties of executive officers within these areas.

name: NA- The Criminal Tribes Act, 1924

metadata.title: The Criminal Tribes Act, 1924 (Amendment) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Criminal Tribes Act, 1924 to address procedures when a registered member changes their place of residence. It specifically adds provisions for transferring relevant register entries to the Superintendent of Police in the new district.

name: The Mussalman Wakaf Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Mussalman Wakf Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better management of Wakf properties and ensures proper accounts are kept. It outlines obligations for mutwallis to furnish statements of particulars regarding property descriptions, income, and expenses to local courts.

name: The Legal Practitioners (Women) Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Legal Practitioners (Women) Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act removes doubts regarding the right of women to be enrolled and to practice as legal practitioners. It explicitly states that no woman shall be disqualified from admission or practice solely by reason of her sex.

name: The Malkharoda and Gaontia Villages laws Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Mallcharoda Rampur Zamindari and Gaontia Villages Laws Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act declares that the district of Sambalpur (excluding specific zamindaris) ceases to form part of the Central Provinces and is included within the Presidency of Fort William. It transfers judicial jurisdiction from the High Court at Patna to the Court of the Judicial Commissioner of the Central Provinces and validates past administrative actions in those territories.

name: The Merchant Shipping Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Merchant Shipping Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the engagement, discharge, and welfare of seamen on British ships within British India. It establishes provisions regarding certificates of competency, licenses to supply seamen, payment of wages, and the rights of distressed seamen.

name: The Official Secrets Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Official Secrets Act, 1928
metadata.amends: The Official Secrets Act, 1880; The Indian Official Secrets (Amendment) Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to official secrets in British India. It defines specific terms such as 'document', 'munitions of war', and 'prohibited place' while outlining penalties for obtaining, recording, or publishing information useful to an enemy.

name: The Cotton Cess Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Indian Cotton Cess Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a fund for the improvement and development of cotton growing, marketing, and manufacture in British India. It provides for the levy and collection of a cess on all cotton produced or consumed in mills within the territory.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends and repeals various enactments specified in its schedules. It ensures that the repeal of certain laws does not affect existing rights, liabilities, or proceedings already established.

name: The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for issuing government paper currency notes across British India, including the creation of currency agencies and offices. It defines the denominations of these notes and stipulates their status as legal tender in exchange for specific gold and silver coins.

name: The Cantonments (House-Accommodation) Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Cantonments Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the law relating to the provision of house-accommodation for military officers in cantonments. It defines key terms such as 'Brigade area', 'Cantonment Authority', and 'Command' while establishing provisions for the appropriation of houses by the Government.

name: The Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of compensation to workmen employed in certain industries who suffer injury by accident. It defines terms such as 'workman', 'injury by accident', and 'disablement' to establish the legal framework for claims against employers.

name: The Boilers Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Indian Steam-boilers Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to steam-boilers, including fittings connected directly from a boiler to a prime-mover. It defines key terms such as 'Chief Inspector' and 'Inspector' and outlines their powers regarding inspections and issuing orders for repairs or replacements.

name: The Cotton Transport Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Cotton Transport Act, 1923
metadata.repeals: IX of 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the restriction and control of cotton transport into ports, stations, and licensed areas. It defines key terms such as 'licence', 'cotton', and 'waste' to regulate the import and carriage of cotton while maintaining its quality.

name: The Mines Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Mines Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to mines in British India. It defines terms such as 'mine' and 'owner' and establishes provisions for inspections, safety regulations, and liability for serious bodily injury.

name: The Malabar (Completion of Trials) Supplementing Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Malabar (Completion of Trials) Supplementary Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act serves to supplement the Malabar (Completion of Trials) Act, 1922. It addresses legal procedures regarding appeals that would have lain to the High Court at Madras but for the expiration of a specific Ordinance.

name: NA- The Bombay Prevention of Prostitution Act, 1923

metadata.title: An Act further to amend the Bombay Prevention of Prostitution Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Bombay Prevention of Prostitution Act, 1923 to apply it to the Capital of the Federation. It introduces new definitions for terms like 'brothel' and 'prostitute', inserts a new section regarding punishments for keeping brothels or living on earnings from prostitution, and amends existing sections related to penalties and age restrictions.

name: NA- The Sind Local Boards Act,1923

metadata.title: The Sind Local Boards and Land Revenue Code (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.amends: Sind Local Boards Act, 1923 and Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879
metadata.repeals: Bombay Land Revenue Code applicable to the district of Khairpur
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Boards Act, 1923 and the Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879. It extends these laws to specific districts including Hyderabad, Tharparkar, and others, while repealing the Bombay Land Revenue Code as it applies to Khairpur.

name: NA- The Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922

metadata.title: The Punjab Town Improvement (Amendment) Act, 1957
metadata.repeals: The Bahawalpur State Town Improvement Act, 1846
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Town Improvement Act, 1922 by updating the list of districts to which it extends and adjusting specific subsections. It also provides for the repeal and re-enactment of the Bahawalpur State Town Improvement Act, 1846 when applied to certain municipalities in the specified districts.

name: The Police (Incitement to Disaffection) Act, 1922

metadata.title: The Police Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act penalizes acts causing disaffection towards His Majesty or the Government among police members. It also addresses offenses related to inducing breaches of discipline and spreading disapproval of government actions.

name: The Press Law Repeal and Amendment Act, 1922

metadata.title: The Press and Registration of Books Act, 1867
metadata.amends: The Press and Registration of Books Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This document outlines amendments to the Press and Registration of Books Act, 1867. It includes provisions regarding the definition of editors, the publication requirements for newspapers, and the duties of printers in delivering copies to local government officers.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1922

metadata.title: The Indian Amendment Act, 1922
metadata.amends: Indian Tariff Act, 1894; Indian Post Office Act, 1898; Indian Paper Currency Act, 1894; Indian Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.repeals: Act XIII of 1922
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing laws, including the Indian Tariff Act and the Indian Post Office Act, to fix salt duties and impose excise duties on kerosene. It also updates income-tax rates and repeals a previous Act regarding freight and vessel taxes.

name: The Ranchi Mental Hospital Act,1922

metadata.title: The Ranchi Mental Hospital Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Trustees for the European Hospital for mental diseases at Ranchi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition of the Board, including appointments by the Local Government and elections by specific associations, and outlines powers regarding property acquisition and financial management.

name: The Indian Income-tax Act, 1922

metadata.title: The Indian Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to income-tax, super-tax, and rent-in-kind in British India. It provides specific definitions for terms such as 'assessee', 'business', and 'Commissioner' within the context of taxation.

name: The Special Laws Repeal Act, 1922

metadata.title: The Special Laws Repeal Act, 1922
metadata.repeals: Various special enactments supplementing the ordinary criminal law (including State Offences Acts, Forfeiture Acts, and Regulations from Madras, Bengal, Punjab, etc.)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain special enactments that supplement the ordinary criminal law in India. It was assented to by the Governor General on February 25, 1922, and promulgated for general information.

name: NA- The Indian Emigration Act, 1922

metadata.title: The Indian Emigration (Amendment) Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Indian Legislature that amends section 25 of the Indian Emigration Act, 1926. It was assented to by the Governor General and published in the Gazette of India on October 8, 1932.

name: The Delhi University Act, 1922

metadata.title: The Delhi University Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and incorporates a unitary residential university at Delhi. It defines the powers of the university, including providing instruction, holding examinations, conferring degrees, and maintaining colleges and halls.

name: The Maintenance Orders Enforcement Act, 1921

metadata.title: The Maintenance Orders (Reciprocal Enforcement) Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reciprocal enforcement of maintenance orders made by courts in British India and other parts of His Majesty's Dominions. It establishes procedures for transmitting orders to reciprocating territories, taking evidence from witnesses abroad, and making provisional orders when a person fails to attend court.

name: The Indian Lac Cess Act, 1921

metadata.title: The Lac Association Act
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Indian Lac Association as a registered society to manage lac cess and related accounts. It provides powers for the Governor General in Council to make rules regarding the levy, payment, accounting, and auditing of lac cess produced in India.

name: The Hindu Transfers and Bequests (City of Madras) Act, 1921

metadata.title: Madras Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This Act declares the rights of Hindus to make transfers and bequests in favor of unborn persons within the City of Madras.
