It specifies that such transfers or wills shall not be invalid solely because they benefit unborn individuals, provided certain conditions regarding the vesting of interests are met.

name: The Enemy Missions Act, 1921

metadata.title: The Enemy Missions Validation Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This Act validates indentures transferring properties formerly held by certain Enemy Missions in British India to specific Boards of Trustees. It incorporates these bodies as corporate entities with perpetual succession and confirms the validity of previous appointments and transfers made under custodian orders.

name: The Legislative Assembly (Deputy-President's Salary) Act, 1921

metadata.title: The Legislative Assembly (Deputy-President's Salary) Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salary for the Deputy-President of the Legislative Assembly. It stipulates that a salary of one thousand rupees per month shall be paid during periods when the Deputy-President is engaged in work connected with the Assembly's business.

name: The Cutchi Memons Acts, 1920

metadata.title: The Cutchi Memons Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act enables Cutchi Memons residing in British India to be governed by Muhammadan law regarding succession and inheritance. It authorizes the Local Government to make rules prescribing the authority and form for declarations required under this Act.

name: The Imperial Bank of India Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Imperial Bank of India Act, 1920
metadata.amends: The Imperial Bank of India Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the Imperial Bank of India and facilitates the transfer of undertakings from the Presidency Banks to the new entity. It defines specific terms related to banking operations, meetings, and liabilities within the context of this transition.

name: The Indian Territorial Force Act, 1920

metadata.title: Indian Territorial Force Act
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of an Indian Territorial Force and the enrolment of persons other than European British subjects. It defines key terms such as 'enrolled', 'European British subject', and 'University Corps' within the context of military service in British India.

name: The Auxiliary Force Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Auxiliary Force Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes an auxiliary force for service in India. It establishes the rules for enrolment, preliminary training, and liability to military service for enrolled persons.

name: The Devolution Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Devolution Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act is titled the Devolution Act, 1920. It contains amendments to various enactments of the Indian Legislative Council received in September 1920.

name: The Indian Elections Offences and Inquires Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Indian Elections (Offences) Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Penal Code to provide for the punishment of malpractice at elections. It introduces new sections regarding bribery, undue influence, and personation of voters.

name: The Basel Mission Trading Company Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Indenture Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain transfers of enemy property vested in the Custodian of Enemy Property for Madras and Coorg. It constitutes the said Trustees as a corporate body to ensure the full execution of transfer intentions and terminates doubts regarding the validity of these transactions.

name: The Passport Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Indian Passport Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for passports issued or renewed by prescribed authorities in British India. It grants police officers and customs officials the power to arrest individuals who have contravened rules regarding entry into British India without a passport.

name: The Identification of Prisoners Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Identification of Prisoners Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the taking of measurements and photographs from convicts and arrested persons for identification purposes. It defines specific terms such as 'measurements' and outlines the powers of police officers and magistrates to order these procedures.

name: The Rouble Note Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Rouble Note Act, 1920
metadata.repeals: The Rouble Note Ordinance, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act defines a 'rouble note' as any currency note issued by or on behalf of the government in territories that constituted the Russian Empire on August 4, 1914. It establishes penalties for contravening provisions or failing to comply with withdrawal license conditions, including imprisonment up to three years, fines, or both, and mandates the confiscation of notes involved in such offenses.

name: The Indian Rifles Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Police Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act was received by the Governor General on August 31, 1920, and promulgated for general information. It provides for the better discipline of police officers enrolled under the provisions of the Act.

name: The Jagannath College Act, 1920

metadata.title: Act No. XVI of 1920
metadata.summary: This Act transfers the Jagannath College in Dacca from its existing trustees to the Governor of Bengal in Council. It vests all associated properties, funds, rights, and powers previously held by the trustees directly into the hands of the Local Government.

name: The Dacca University Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Dacca University Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and incorporates a unitary teaching and residential university at Dacca. It grants the University powers to provide instruction, conduct examinations, confer degrees, and manage research and knowledge dissemination.

name: The Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act provides for more effectual control over the administration of charitable and religious trusts created for public purposes. It enables trustees to obtain directions from a Court on certain matters and makes special provisions for suits against trustees.

name: The Pakistan Red Crescent Society Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Indian Red Cross Society Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the Indian Red Cross Society to continue the work carried on by the Joint War Committee during peace time. It provides for the incorporation of the society, its perpetual succession, and the power to hold property.

name: The Securities Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Indian Trustee Securities Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Government securities in India. It received assent from the Governor General on March 11, 1920, and was promulgated for general information.

name: The Indian Census Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Indian Census Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act provides for certain matters in connection with the taking of the census in India during the year 1921. It establishes the powers of the Local Government to appoint census officers and defines their duties, including the authority to require information from residents regarding household members.

name: The Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to insolvency in British India, excluding Scheduled Districts. It defines key terms such as debtor, creditor, and property, and establishes the powers of District Courts and Courts of Small Causes regarding insolvency proceedings.

name: The United Provinces Town Improvement (Appeals) Act, 1920

metadata.title: The United Provinces Town Improvement (Appeals) Act, 1920
metadata.amends: The United Provinces Town Improvement Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act modifies certain provisions of the United Provinces Town Improvement Act, 1919 to establish a specific appeal process to the High Court from Tribunal awards. It defines the grounds for such appeals, including errors of law, failure to determine material issues, or procedural defects.

name: NA- The Auxiliary Force Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Auxiliary Force Act, 1920 (Amendment Act)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Auxiliary Force Act of 1920 to update specific clauses regarding enrolled persons. It was received by the Governor General on March 3, 1931, and promulgated for general information.

name: NA- The territorial Force Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Indian Territorial and Auxiliary Forces (Amendment) Act, 1923
metadata.amends: The Indian Territorial Force Act, 1920 and the Auxiliary Forces Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Territorial Force Act, 1920, and the Auxiliary Forces Act, 1920 to address legal procedures for personnel who have ceased to belong to these forces. It allows such individuals to be taken into military custody, tried, and punished for offences committed while they were subject to those Acts, provided specific time limits are met.

name: NA-The Bombay Public Conveyances Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Bombay Public Conveyances (Karachi Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Bombay Public Conveyances Act, 1920 as it applies to the Federal Capital. It inserts a new section allowing the Government to ban specific classes of public conveyances in designated areas via notification and amends existing sections regarding contravention of such bans.

name: The Rouble Note Ordinance, 1919

metadata.title: The Rouble Note Ordinance, 1919
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the possession of rouble notes in India due to an emergency. It mandates that within six weeks, holders must deposit these notes in a government treasury or export them outside India without receiving compensation.

name: The Indemnity Act, 1919

metadata.title: The Indemnity Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act indemnifies government officers and other persons for acts done under martial law in certain districts of the Punjab and other parts of India. It confirms sentences passed by courts constituted under martial law and provides compensation for property taken or used during this period.

name: The Indian Companies Restriction Repealing Act, 1919

metadata.title: The Indian Companies (Restriction Repealing) Act, 1919
metadata.repeals: The Indian Companies (Restriction) Act, XII of 1918
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the restrictions imposed on the withdrawal of capital from the money-market by companies. It specifically revokes the provisions of the Indian Companies (Restriction) Act, XII of 1918.

name: The Poisons Act, 1919

metadata.title: The Poisons Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the importation, possession, and sale of poisons in British India. It establishes rules for granting licenses to possess or sell specified poisons, setting fees, defining eligible persons, limiting quantities, and requiring the maintenance of sales registers.

name: The Martial Law (Trials Continuance) Ordinance, 1919

metadata.title: The Martial Law (Trials Suspended) Ordinance, 1919
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the continuance and completion of trials pending before commissions or summary courts when orders suspending ordinary criminal courts are cancelled. It ensures that such trials proceed as if the suspension had not occurred, allowing convictions and sentences to be carried out.

name: The Martial Law (Sentences) Ordinance, 1919

metadata.title: The Martial Law (Sentences) Ordinance, 1919
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides that persons convicted of crimes specified in the Bengal State Offences Regulation, 1804, shall be punishable with penalties other than those provided in that Regulation. It was enacted by the Governor General under emergency powers to alter sentencing procedures for specific offenses.

name: The Punjab Courts (Supplementing) Act, 1919

metadata.title: The Punjab Courts (Supplementing) Act
metadata.summary: This Act supplements the Punjab Courts Act of 1918 by transferring jurisdiction for pending civil and criminal proceedings from the Chief Court of the Punjab to the High Court of Judicature at Lahore. It mandates that all such suits, appeals, revisions, and other proceedings be continued and concluded in the High Court as if they had been instituted there originally.

name: The Excess Profits Duty Act, 1919

metadata.title: The Excess Profits Duty Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a duty on excess profits arising from certain businesses in India. It defines the accounting period, standard profits calculation methods, and rules for levying the duty when profits exceed specific thresholds.

name: The Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Act, 1919

metadata.title: The Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the trial of persons accused of scheduled offences related to anarchical and revolutionary movements in British India. It establishes specific procedures for preferring written information, defining the composition of the Court, and ensuring speedy trials.

name: The Termination of the Present War (Definition) Act, 1919

metadata.title: The Termination of the Present War (Definition) Act
metadata.summary: This Act provides for determining the date of the termination of the present war and related hostilities. It establishes that the war shall be treated as having ended on a date declared by His Majesty in Council.

name: The Local Authorities Pensions and Gratuities Act, 1919

metadata.title: The Local Authorities Pensions and Gratuities Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act extends the powers of local authorities to grant pensions and gratuities to officers who suffer injuries or illness after August 4, 1914. It applies throughout British India, including the Sonthal Parganas, and allows these payments in addition to any existing entitlements.

name: The Indian Companies (Foreign Interests) Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Indian Companies (Restriction on Foreign Interests) Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Governor General in Council to prohibit alterations to articles of association that restrict foreign interests in certain companies without their sanction. It defines key terms such as 'British subject' and 'restrictive provision' and applies these rules to companies declared under a notification in the Gazette of India.

name: The Cotton Cloth Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Cotton Cloth (Standardisation) Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Controller to regulate the manufacture and delivery of standard cotton cloth in India. It allows the government to fix prices, define quality standards, and ensure supply at reasonable rates for the benefit of poorer classes.

name: The Cotton Cloth Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Cotton Cloth (Standardisation) Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Controller to regulate the manufacture and delivery of standard cotton cloth in India. It allows the government to fix prices, define quality standards, and ensure supply at reasonable rates for the benefit of poorer classes.

name: The Provisional Collection of Taxes Act,1918

metadata.title: Act No. XVI of 1918
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the immediate effect of Bills introduced into the Indian Legislative Council regarding taxation and customs. It stipulates that such Bills shall have temporary effect as if they were Acts of the Governor General in Council, subject to specific conditions regarding their passage or rejection.

name: The Indian Non-ferrous Metal Industry Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Indian Non-ferrous Metal Industry (Restriction) Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act temporarily restricts the persons who may engage in business connected with certain non-ferrous metals and metallic ores. It establishes a licensing system administered by the Governor General in Council, which remains in force during the war and for five years thereafter.

name: The Enemy Trading Orders (Validation) Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Enemy Trading Act, 1918
metadata.repeals: The Enemy Trading Ordinance, 1916
metadata.summary: This Act declares that notifications, orders, and rules made under the Enemy Trading Ordinance, 1916, shall be deemed to have continued in force after its repeal. It resolves doubts regarding the validity of these instruments by explicitly stating they were issued under the subsequent Enemy Trading Act, 1918.

name: The Gold Coinage Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Gold Coinage Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the coinage of a gold coin, specifically the gold mohur, at mints under the authority of the Governor-General in Council. It establishes the standard weight and fineness for the new coin and outlines procedures for handling diminished or defaced coins during wartime.

name: The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1918
metadata.repeals: The Indian Paper Currency Ordinance, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act provides that silver held on behalf of the Secretary of State for India or the Governor General in Council shall be deemed to be part of the reserve referred to in section 19 of the Paper Currency Act, 1910. It also repeals the Indian Paper Currency Ordinance, 1918.

name: The Indian Income-tax Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Indian Income-tax Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to income-tax in British India. It defines various classes of taxable income, including salaries, business profits, and interest on securities, while also establishing procedures for assessment, appeals, and refunds.

name: The Indian Companies Restriction Act, 1918

metadata.title: Indian Companies Restriction Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to control the withdrawal of capital from the money-market by companies during a period of war. It remains in force for the duration of the present war and for six months thereafter, with specific provisions regarding licenses issued by the Governor General in Council.

name: The Indian Soldiers (Litigation) Act, 1918

metadata.title: Act No. IX of 1918
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the special protection for Indian soldiers in civil and revenue litigation. It provides mechanisms for courts to suspend proceedings when a soldier serving under war conditions is unable to appear or act on their own behalf.

name: The Usurious Loans Act, 1918

metadata.title: Usurious Loans Act, 1918
metadata.repeals: Usury Laws Repeal Act, 1955
metadata.summary: This Act grants additional powers to courts in British India to handle cases involving usurious loans of money or kind. It allows courts to reopen transactions, adjust accounts, relieve debtors from excessive interest liability, and alter securities when a transaction is deemed substantially unfair.

name: The Indigo Cess Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Indigo Cess Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a cess on indigo exported from British India. The proceeds collected are intended to fund measures promoting research in the interests of the indigo industry.

name: The Cinematograph Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Cinematograph Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of exhibitions by means of cinematographs and establishes a licensing system. It defines the licensing authority, outlines conditions for granting licenses, and prescribes penalties for unauthorized use or contravention of the Act's provisions.

name: The Indian Transfer of Ships Restriction Act, 1917

metadata.title: The Restriction of Transfer of Ships Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act restricts the transfer of ships registered in British India during wartime and for three years thereafter. It defines specific categories of persons and foreign-controlled companies subject to these restrictions and outlines penalties for contravention.

name: The Post Office Cash Certificates Act, 1917

metadata.title: Cash Certificates Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act restricts the transfer of Post Office 5-year Cash Certificates and provides for the payment of such certificates belonging to deceased persons. It amends the Post Office Savings Bank Act, 1878, by specifying that consent from the Post Master General is required for transferring certificates in the name of a deceased person.

name: The Patna University Act, 1917

metadata.title: The Patna University Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and incorporates the Patna University as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's powers to impart education, conduct research, examine students, confer degrees, and supervise external colleges.

name: The Freight (Railway and Inland Steam-vessel) Tax Act, 1917

metadata.title: The Freight and Railway and Inland Steam-Vessel Tax Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a tax on goods carried by railway or inland steam-vessel in British India. It provides for the delivery of returns regarding such goods and grants the Governor General in Council the power to make rules for tax collection and administration.

name: The King of Oudh's Estate Validation Act, 1917

metadata.title: The King of Oudh's Estate Validation Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act validates three deeds of conveyance and a trust deed relating to properties formerly belonging to the late King of Oudh, Wajid Ali Shah. It declares that certain sums previously considered part of an endowment fund are no longer included in that fund but shall be treated as pensions payable to entitled persons.

name: The Super-tax Act, 1917

metadata.title: The Super-tax Act
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a super-tax on the principal income tax levied under the Indian Income-tax Act, 1886. It applies to the whole of British India and extends to dominions in alliance with His Majesty.

name: The Indian Army (Suspension of Sentences) Act, 1917

metadata.title: The Indian Army (Suspension of Sentences) Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the suspension of certain sentences passed by Courts-martial under the Indian Army Act, 1911. It also provides for other matters connected with the suspension of imprisonment or transportation during the present war.

name: The Indian Defence Force Act, 1917

metadata.title: The Indian Defence Force Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes an Indian Defence Force and provides for the compulsory enrolment of European British subjects residing in India. It defines eligibility criteria based on age and residence, establishing a framework for military service during wartime.

name: The Motor Spirit (Duties) Act, 1917

metadata.title: The Motor Spirit Duty Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a duty of six annas on each imperial gallon of motor spirit. It provides for the regulation of motor spirit manufactories, including rules regarding the issue of spirit and the recovery of unpaid duties.

name: The Inland Steam-Vessels Act, 1917

metadata.title: The Inland Steam-Vessels Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act received the assent of the Governor General on February 7, 1917, and was promulgated for general information. It establishes regulations regarding certificates of survey for inland steam-vessels, including their affixation, term, renewal, and suspension by the Local Government.

name: The Destruction of Record Act, 1917

metadata.title: The Destruction of Records Act, 1917
metadata.repeals: The Destruction of Records Act, 1879; The Official Trustees Act, 1883; The Administrator-General's Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the destruction or other disposal of documents held by courts, revenue officers, and other public officials. It defines specific authorities responsible for making rules on document disposal in different regions of India and deems previous rules made under the 1879 Act to have continued force until superseded.

name: NA- The Burma Salt Act, 1917

metadata.title: The Burma Salt Act (Amendment) Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Burma Salt Act, 1917 to update references from 'Local Government' and 'Collector' to 'Central Board of Revenue' and 'Superintendent'. It also substitutes specific clauses regarding the imposition of duties and the powers of officers under the Act.

name: The Indian Bills of Exchange Act, 1916

metadata.title: Indian Bills of Exchange Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the loss of bills of exchange payable outside British India due to circumstances arising from the present war. It allows courts to accept certified copies or other reasonable evidence in lieu of lost bills and grants indemnity against claims by other persons.

name: The Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916

metadata.title: The Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Act removes existing disabilities regarding the power of Hindus to dispose of property for the benefit of persons not yet in existence at the time of the disposition. It clarifies that such dispositions are valid even if the beneficiary does not exist, subject to specific limitations found in the Transfer of Property Act and Indian Succession Act.

name: The Enemy Trading Act, 1916

metadata.title: The Enemy Trading Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits and controls trading by hostile foreigners and hostile firms during wartime. It defines hostile foreigners and firms based on their connections to states at war with British India as of August 3, 1914, or subsequent business activities in British India.

name: The Import and Export of Goods Act, 1916

metadata.title: The Import and Export of Goods Act, 1916
metadata.repeals: The Import and Export of Goods Ordinance, LV of 1910
metadata.summary: This Act provides powers to prohibit or restrict the import and export of goods from or into British India. It defines terms such as 'import' and 'export' and grants the Governor General in Council authority to issue notifications regarding these restrictions.

name: The Indian Medical Degrees Act, 1916

metadata.title: The Indian Medical Degrees Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the grant of titles implying qualifications in western medical science and penalizes unqualified persons for assuming or using such titles. It restricts the right to confer degrees, diplomas, licenses, and certificates to specific authorities specified in the Schedule and prohibits any other person from granting or holding such documents.

name: The Foreigners' (Trial by Court-martial) Act, 1916

metadata.title: The Defence of India (Trial by Court-martial) Act, 1916
metadata.repeals: Ordinance III of 1916
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the trial of persons accused of offences against the Defence of India Rules by court-martial. It applies to foreigners who are not British subjects and allows them to be dealt with as if they were subject to military law during wartime.

name: The Benares Hindu University Act, 1915

metadata.title: Benares Hindu University Act, 1915
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and incorporates a teaching and residential Hindu University at Benares. It defines the university's authorities, officers, and powers regarding instruction in Hindu religion and other subjects.

name: The Enemy Trading Act, 1915

metadata.title: The Enemy Trading Act, 1915
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the office of custodian to manage money paid by persons prohibited from trading with foreigners under enemy trading proclamations. It outlines the powers of custodians, their appointment by the Governor General in Council, and the legal discharge provided when payments are made to them.

name: The North-West Frontier Constabulary Act, 1915

metadata.title: The North-West Frontier Constabulary Act, 1915
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the Frontier Constabulary in the Punjab Province. It defines the appointment, powers, duties, and superintendence of constabulary officers, including provisions for active service against hostile tribes.

name: The Indian Soldiers (Litigation) Act, 1915

metadata.title: The Indian Soldiers (Litigation) Act, 1915
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the special protection of Indian soldiers serving under war conditions in respect of civil and revenue litigation. It empowers designated authorities to certify that postponing proceedings against such soldiers is necessary in the interests of justice, allowing courts to delay cases until the soldier can be properly represented.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act,1915

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1915
metadata.repeals: The Assam Labour and Emigration (Amendment) Act, 1915
metadata.summary: This Act amends specific enactments listed in the First Schedule and repeals an unnecessary enactment listed in the Second Schedule. It includes savings clauses to protect existing rights, titles, and liabilities acquired before its passage.

name: The Sir Jamsetjee Jejeebjoy Baronetcy Act, 1915

metadata.title: Act No. X of 1915
metadata.repeals: Act No. XX of 1860
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Act of 1860 regarding Sir Jamsetjee Jejeebhoy's Baronetcy and associated property. It settles promissory notes of the Government of India producing an annual income of one lakh rupees and a mansion in Bombay to support the dignity of the title.

name: The Defence of India (Criminal Law Amendment) Act, 1915

metadata.title: The Defence of India (Criminal Law Amendment) Act, 1915
metadata.summary: This Act provides special measures to secure public safety and the defense of British India during wartime. It also establishes provisions for the speedy trial of certain offenses likely to jeopardize military operations or promote disaffection.

name: The Sir Sassoon Jacob David Baronetcy Act, 1915

metadata.title: An Act for settling certain securities of the late Sir Sassoon Jacob David, Baronet
metadata.summary: This Act settles the securities of Sir Sassoon Jacob David, Baronet, and establishes a corporation of trustees to manage his trust funds. The legislation ensures the support of the title and dignity of the Baronetcy for him and his heirs male.

name: NA- The Punjab Excise Act, 1914

metadata.title: The Punjab Excise (West Pakistan) Amendment Act, 1956
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Excise Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1955
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Excise Act, 1914 to update provisions regarding revenue recovery and bailability of offences. It also repeals the Punjab Excise Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1955, while ensuring that powers and rules under the repealed ordinance continue under this new Act.

name: The Second Repealing and Amending Act, 1914

metadata.title: An Act to amend certain enactments and to repeal certain other enactments
metadata.amends: The Court Fees Act, 1870; The Government Tenants (Punjab) Act, 1893; The Indian Tariff Act, 1894; The General Clauses Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing enactments including the Court Fees Act, 1870, and the Government Tenants Act, 1893. It also repeals certain other enactments to the extent mentioned in the schedule.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1914

metadata.title: The Repealing and Short title, Amending Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain existing enactments and repeals other enactments that are spent or unnecessary. It also provides savings clauses to ensure that the repeal does not affect rights, liabilities, or proceedings already acquired or in progress.

name: The Indian Motor Vehicles Act, 1914

metadata.title: The Indian Motor Vehicles Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to motor vehicles in British India. It establishes definitions for terms like 'motor vehicle' and 'public place', sets age restrictions for drivers, and outlines licensing requirements and penalties for reckless driving.

name: The Decentralization Act, 1914

metadata.title: The Decentralization Act, 1914
metadata.amends: Various enactments specified in the Schedule (including The Bengal Land Revenue Sales Act, 1859; The Police Act, 1861; etc.)
metadata.summary: This Act aims to decentralize and facilitate the administration of specific existing enactments. It amends various laws by substituting authorities, omitting references to the Governor General in Council, and inserting provisions regarding Boards of Revenue and Financial Commissioners.

name: The Indian Copyright Act, 1914

metadata.title: The Indian Copyright Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act modifies and adds provisions to the Copyright Act of 1911 specifically for its application to British India. It defines the duration of copyright for works by residents or first published in British India as ten years from the date of first publication, with specific exceptions regarding translations.

name: The Local Authorities Loans Act, 1914

metadata.title: The Local Loans Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the grant of loans to local authorities in British India. It defines local authorities, outlines permissible purposes for borrowing such as public works and famine relief, and establishes rules regarding the issuance of bills or promissory notes.

name: The Destructive Insects and Pests Act, 1914

metadata.title: The Destructive Insects and Pests Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act provides for preventing the introduction into British India of insects, fungus, or other pests that are destructive to crops. It grants powers to the Governor General in Council and Local Governments to regulate, prohibit, or restrict the importation of such articles.

name: NA- The Chittagong Port Act, 1914

metadata.title: The Chittagong Port (Amendment) Act, 1928
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Chittagong Port Act of 1914 to transfer certain powers from the Local Government to the Governor General in Council. It also reconstitutes the body of Commissioners and alters the election process for these officials.

name: The Indian Companies Act, 1913

metadata.title: The Indian Companies Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act governs the formation, administration, and regulation of companies in British India. It covers topics such as registration, share capital management, director qualifications, and meeting procedures.

name: The Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1913

metadata.title: The Mussalman Wakf Validating Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act declares the rights of Mussalmans to create wakfs (permanent dedications of property) in favor of their families, children, and descendants. It specifically validates such settlements even if the ultimate benefit for the poor or other charitable purposes is postponed until after the extinction of the family line.

name: The White Phosphorous Matches Prohibition Act, 1913

metadata.title: The White Phosphorus Matches Prohibition Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the importation, manufacture, and sale of matches made with white phosphorus. It defines white phosphorus and grants inspectors the power to take samples for analysis.

name: The Sir Currimbhoy Ebrahim Baronetey Act, 1913

metadata.title: The Sir Currimbhoy Ebrahim Baronetcy Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act settles certain properties belonging to Sir Currimbhoy Ebrahim, Baronet, in perpetuity for himself and his male heirs. It establishes the Accountant General, Bombay, the Collector of Bombay, the Chief Presidency Magistrate of Bombay, and the person in actual enjoyment of the title as trustees to support the dignity of the Baronetcy.

name: The Administrator-General's Act, 1913

metadata.title: The Administrator General's Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act defines the office, appointment, and powers of the Administrator General in British India. It outlines procedures for granting letters of administration, handling estates of persons subject to the Army Act, and managing assets until succession rights are determined.

name: The Official Trustees Act, 1913

metadata.title: The Official Trustees Act, 1913
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the office of Official Trustee for the Presidencies of Bengal, Madras, and Bombay. It defines their appointment, powers, duties, and corporate status, while also outlining procedures for audits, beneficiary inspections, and the transfer of trust property.

name: NA-The British Baluchistan Laws Regulation, 1913

metadata.title: The British Baluchistan Laws Regulation (Amendment) Regulation, 1953
metadata.summary: This Regulation amends the British Baluchistan Laws Regulation, 1913 by omitting the word 'British' from its title and preamble. It also inserts a new item into Schedule I regarding the Colonial Courts of Admiralty (Pakistan) Act, 1894.

name: The Motor Vehicles International Circulation Act, 1912

metadata.title: The Motor Vehicles Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the international circulation of motor vehicles brought temporarily into British India. It prescribes the conditions under which such vehicles may be possessed, used, and driven by persons intending a temporary stay.

name: The Delhi Laws Act, 1912

metadata.title: The Delhi Laws Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the application of laws in force in British India to the Province of Delhi. It also facilitates the extension of other enactments to that territory and establishes administrative structures under the authority of the Governor General in Council.

name: The Wild Birds and Animals Protection Act, 1912

metadata.title: The Wild Birds and Animals Protection Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better protection and preservation of certain wild birds and animals in British India. It establishes a close season during which capturing, killing, selling, buying, or possessing these species is unlawful, with specific penalties for violations.

name: The Bengal Bihar and Orissa and Assam Laws Act, 1912

metadata.title: The Bengal, Bihar and Orissa and Assam Laws Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides provisions regarding the territory formerly included within the Province of Eastern Bengal and Assam. It directs that the said Province shall be called the Province of Bihar and Orissa, appoints a Lieutenant-Governor for that Province, and forms the territory into a Chief Commissionership to be called the Chief Commissionership of Assam.

name: The Indian Life Assurance Companies Act, 1912

metadata.title: The Indian Life Assurance Companies Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of life assurance companies established within or outside British India that carry on business in British India. It establishes requirements for the deposit of government securities and outlines definitions, accounts, and audit procedures for these companies.

name: The Provident Insurance Societies Act, 1912

metadata.title: The Provident Insurance Societies Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of Provident Insurance Societies in British India. It defines key terms such as 'Court', 'financial year', and 'policy of assurance on human life' while establishing rules regarding insurable interest, registration, and the prohibition of receiving premiums for deaths of persons other than immediate family members.

name: The Lunacy Act, 1912

metadata.title: THE INDIAN LUNACY ACT, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the reception, care, and treatment of lunatics in India. It establishes procedures for judicial inquiries regarding mental health, the management of a lunatic's estate, and their discharge from asylums.

name: The Co-operative Societies Act, 1912

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of co-operative societies and amends the existing law relating to them. It defines key terms such as 'member', 'committee', and 'officer', and sets restrictions on member liability, shareholding limits, and borrowing powers.

name: NA- Punjab Municipal Act, 1911

metadata.title: The Punjab Municipal Act (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Punjab Municipal Act, 1911 to regulate the term of office for members of municipal committees. It allows the Provincial Government to extend a member's term by up to six months via notification in the Official Gazette under specific circumstances.

name: The Calcutta Improvement (Appeals) Act, 1911

metadata.title: The Calcutta Improvement (Appeals) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act modifies certain provisions of the Calcutta Improvement Act, 1911 to establish a specific process for appeals from Tribunal awards to the High Court. It defines the grounds on which such appeals may lie, including decisions contrary to law or usage, failure to determine material issues, and substantial errors in procedure.

name: The Airships Act, 1911

metadata.title: The Indian Airships Act, 1911
metadata.summary: This Act controls the manufacture, possession, use, sale, import, and export of airships in British India. It empowers the Governor General in Council or Local Government to make rules regarding licenses, fees, application forms, and identification methods for airships.

name: The Indian Factories Act, 1911

metadata.title: The Indian Factories Act, 1911
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regulating labour in factories. It establishes definitions for terms like 'factory' and 'child', sets limits on working hours, and provides specific protections regarding the employment of women and children.

name: The Prevention of Seditious Meeting Act, 1911

metadata.title: The Prevention of Seditious Meetings Act, 1911
metadata.amends: The Prevention of Seditious Meetings Act, 1907
metadata.repeals: The Continuing Act, 1910
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the prevention of public meetings likely to promote sedition or cause a disturbance of public tranquillity. It defines public meetings, establishes notice requirements for holding them in proclaimed areas, and outlines penalties for violations.

name: The Patents and Designs Act, 1911

metadata.title: The Indian Patents and Designs Act, 1911
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to the protection of inventions and designs in British India. It establishes provisions for the application, grant, term, and revocation of patents, as well as the registration and copyright of designs.

name: NA- The Criminal Tribes Act, 1911

metadata.title: The Criminal Tribes Act (Amendment) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Criminal Tribes Act, 1911 by modifying sections regarding notices, registration, and definitions for Presidency towns. It also grants the Local Government power to vary notifications restricting criminal tribes and adds provisions for arrest without a warrant for offenses under the Act.

name: NA- The Army Act, 1911

metadata.title: The Indian Army (Amendment) Act, 1914
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Army Act, 1911 to regulate the disposal of moveable property belonging to soldiers who die or desert. It establishes procedures for commanding officers to secure assets, pay debts, and distribute surplus funds to representatives or remit them to government accounts.

name: The Cantonments Act, 1910

metadata.title: The Cantonments Act, 1910
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends certain laws relating to cantonments in British India. It establishes the framework for cantonment authorities, courts, police, taxation powers, and regulations regarding spirituous liquor and intoxicating drugs within these areas.

name: The Indian Museum Act, 1910

metadata.title: The Indian Museum Act, 1910
metadata.repeals: The Indian Museum Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the Indian Museum. It establishes a body corporate known as 'The Trustees of the Indian Museum' with specific powers to manage property, collections, and operations.

name: The Electricity Act, 1910

metadata.title: The Indian Electricity Act, 1910
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to the supply and use of electrical energy in British India. It establishes provisions for granting licenses, regulating transmission, defining consumer obligations, and setting penalties for offenses related to electricity.

name: The Dourine Act, 1910

metadata.title: The Dourine Act, 1910
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of the spread of dourine in horses within British India, specifically regulating the registration and inspection of breeding horses. It empowers appointed inspectors and veterinary practitioners to search premises, prohibit breeding of infected animals, castrate or destroy affected horses, and award compensation to owners.

name: NA-The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1910

metadata.title: The Indian Paper Currency Amendment Act, 1915
metadata.repeals: The Indian Paper Currency Amendment Ordinance, 1915
metadata.summary: This Act temporarily amends the Indian Paper Currency Act, 1910 during the continuance of the present war. It substitutes specific monetary figures in section 2 of the original act and repeals a previous amendment ordinance from 1915.

name: NA-The British Baluchistan, Bazars Regulation, 1910

metadata.title: British Baluchistan Bazars (Amendment) Regulation, 1952
metadata.summary: This document is a Regulation promulgated by the Governor-General of Pakistan to further amend the British Baluchistan Bazars Regulation, 1910. It was issued on July 15, 1952, and came into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Anand Marriage Act, 1909

metadata.title: Anand Marriage Act, 1909
metadata.summary: This Act declares that marriages solemnized according to the Sikh ceremony called Anand are valid in law. It also specifies exemptions and savings regarding other marriage ceremonies and prohibited degrees of relationship.

name: The Amending (Army) Act, 1909

metadata.title: The Amending (Army) Act, 1909
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain enactments relating to the Army, specifically addressing procedures for striking off volunteer rolls and handling cases involving lunatics. It includes amendments to the Indian Army Act of 1877 regarding the powers of commanding officers and administrative medical officers.

name: The Whipping Act, 1909

metadata.title: The Whipping Act, 1909
metadata.repeals: The Whipping Act, 1864; The Indian Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1895; The Juvenile Offenders Procedure Act, 1898; The Burma Laws Act, 1898; The Whipping Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Whipping Act of 1864 and repeals several previous laws regarding whipping. It extends to British India, including British Baluchistan and frontier districts, allowing for punishment by whipping in lieu of other penalties for specific offences under the Indian Penal Code.

name: The Presidency-Towns Insolvency Act, 1909

metadata.title: The Insolvency Act, 1909
metadata.summary: This Act governs the proceedings from an act of insolvency to discharge, including the powers of courts and official assignees. It outlines procedures for adjudication, property administration, debt proof, and the rights and duties of insolvents and creditors.

name: The Code of Civil Procedure Act, 1908

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
metadata.summary: This document is the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, which was promulgated for general information and received assent on March 21, 1908. It outlines the rules governing civil suits, jurisdiction of courts, institution of suits, execution of decrees, appeals, and incidental proceedings within the Punjab region.

name: The Indian Emigration Act, 1908

metadata.title: The Indian Emigration Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the emigration of natives of India, establishing a framework for agreements, registration, and medical inspections. It outlines the powers of the Protector of Emigrants and sets rules regarding embarkation, vessel conditions, and the treatment of emigrants.

name: The Ports Act, 1908

metadata.title: The Indian Ports Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the powers of the Local Government regarding the safety of shipping and the conservation of ports. It outlines regulations for port dues, fees, charges, and the authority of harbour masters and pilots to manage vessels within port limits.

name: The Registration Act, 1908

metadata.title: The Indian Registration Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act governs the registration and deposit of documents in British India, including specific procedures for wills. It outlines the duties of registering officers, establishes fee structures, and defines penalties for offenses related to the registration process.

name: NA- The Assam Labour and Emigration Act, 1901

metadata.title: The Assam Labour and Emigration (Amendment) Act, 1908
metadata.amends: The Assam Labour and Emigration Act, 1901
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Assam Labour and Emigration Act of 1901 by substituting specific sections regarding contractor licenses, garden-sardar certificates, and permit requirements. It also outlines how fines and fees collected under the Act shall be applied to officer salaries, pensions, and the costs of transporting labourers.

name: The Indian Salt-duties Act, 1908

metadata.title: The Salt Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of duties on salt within a specific period and requires security for such payments. It also addresses the manufacture of salt after duty has been paid.

name: The Limitation Act, 1908

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the limitation of suits, appeals, and applications in British India. It also provides for suits where the prescribed period is shorter than that under the previous Indian Limitation Act, 1877.

name: The Newspapers (Incitements to offences) Act, 1908

metadata.title: The Newspapers (Incitements to offences) Act, 1908
metadata.summary: This Act provides better provisions for preventing incitements to murder and other offences in newspapers. It empowers Magistrates to make orders for the forfeiture of newspapers and attachment of printing presses when such incitements are found.

name: The Explosive Substances Act, 1908

metadata.title: The Explosive Substances Act, 1905
metadata.amends: The Indian Explosives Act, 1884; The Indian Arms Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act amends existing laws regarding explosive substances to address inadequacies in dealing with crimes involving explosives. It strengthens penalties for causing explosions, possessing explosives with intent to endanger life, and preparing to manufacture bombs.

name: The Prevention of Seditions Meetings Act, 1907

metadata.title: The Preventive Detention Act, 1907
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of public meetings likely to cause disturbance or relate to political subjects. It establishes presumptions regarding the definition of a public meeting and outlines requirements for notice and permission before holding such gatherings.

name: The Provincial Insolvency Act, 1907

metadata.title: The Provincial Insolvency Act
metadata.repeals: The Insolvency Act, 1860
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws relating to insolvency in British India, excluding Scheduled Districts. It defines terms such as 'available act of insolvency' and outlines the powers of courts regarding receivers and the duties of debtors.

name: The Central Provinces Boiler Inspection Act, 1907

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Boiler Inspection Act, 1907
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the inspection and management of steam-boilers and prime-movers in the Central Provinces. It establishes definitions for key terms, outlines the duties of inspectors, and sets procedures for the registration and numbering of boilers.

name: The Pakistan Coinage Act, 1906

metadata.title: The Indian Coinage Act, 1906
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to coinage in British India. It establishes standards for silver, nickel, and bronze coins, including their legal tender status, weight, fineness, and designs.

name: The Bengal and Assam Laws Act, 1905

metadata.title: The Bengal and Assam Laws Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Act provides provisions regarding the application of existing laws in the Province of Eastern Bengal and Assam and territories transferred from the Central Provinces to Bengal. It establishes a Board of Revenue for the new province and outlines how local governments and courts should interpret enactments following the constitutional changes of September 1905.

name: The Railway Board Act, 1905

metadata.title: The Indian Railway Board Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Act invests the Railway Board with certain powers and functions under the Indian Railways Act, 1890. It is read as part of the Indian Railways Act, 1890, and received assent on March 22, 1905.

name: The Paper Currency Act, 1905

metadata.title: The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Government Paper Currency in British India. It establishes the Department of Paper Currency, defines the roles of various officers, and regulates the issue and distribution of currency notes.

name: The Universities (Validation) Act, 1905

metadata.title: The Indian Universities (Validation) Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Act validates directions, declarations, and orders made under the Indian Universities Act, 1904 regarding the constitution of bodies corporate and provisional syndicates. It deems these actions to have been duly made, constituted, and appointed despite doubts raised about their validity.

name: ACT XIV of 1904

metadata.title: The City of Bombay Improvement Act, 1904
metadata.amends: The City of Bombay Improvement Act, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act supplements certain provisions of the City of Bombay Improvement Act, 1898. It specifically addresses appeals to the High Court under section 48, sub-section (11) of the 1898 Act and their applicability to the Code of Civil Procedure.

name: ACT XI of 1904

metadata.title: Act No. XI of 1904
metadata.summary: This Act revives and continues section 8B of the Indian Tariff Act, 1894. It ensures that the revived section remains in force starting from April 1, 1904.

name: The Co-operative Credit Societies Act, 1904

metadata.title: The Co-operative Credit Societies Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution, registration, and management of cooperative credit societies in British India. It establishes rules regarding member qualifications, limits on capital held by members, restrictions on share transfers, and the priority of society claims against members.

name: The Madras Coast-lights Act, 1904

metadata.title: The Madras Coast-Lights Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act imposes coast-light dues for the provision of lights on the coast of the Presidency of Madras. It defines terms such as 'Customs-collector' and 'ton', and specifies the rates, ports, and procedures for collecting these dues from vessels arriving in or clearing out of British India.

name: The Ancient Monuments Preservation Act, 1904

metadata.title: The Ancient Monuments Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of ancient monuments, sculptures, carvings, and other objects of historical or artistic interest. It establishes provisions for compulsory purchase, acquisition of rights, and guardianship over such sites to prevent their misuse or desecration.

name: The North-West Border Military Police Act, 1904

metadata.title: The North-West Border Military Police Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the Border Military Police Force in the North-West Frontier Province. It establishes the force's composition, defines the powers of superior officers, and outlines conditions regarding service and discipline.

name: The Local Authorities Loan Act, 1904

metadata.title: The Local Loans Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act provides further provisions regarding the borrowing powers of certain local authorities. It allows these authorities to borrow money in any manner authorized by law for the purpose of repaying previously borrowed funds.

name: The Central Provinces Courts Act, 1904

metadata.title: The Subordinate Civil Courts Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for subordinate civil courts in the Central Provinces, defining their jurisdiction and powers. It details the appointment procedures for judicial commissioners, additional judges, and ministerial officers, while also regulating appeals and the conduct of business within these courts.

name: The Poisons Act, 1904

metadata.title: The Poison Act, 1904
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the possession and sale of all poisons in certain local areas throughout British India. It specifically addresses the importation, possession, and sale of white arsenic, establishing rules for licensing, labeling, and mixing requirements.

name: NA- The Universities Act, 1904

metadata.title: The Indian Universities (Amendment) Act, 1911
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Universities Act, 1904 to modify the election process for University of India in Council and Allahabad. It specifies that ordinary Fellows shall be elected by the Senate while the remainder are elected by registered graduates.

name: The Central Provinces Municipal Act, 1903

metadata.title: The Municipal Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the conduct of business, organization, and powers of municipal committees in the Central Provinces. It covers topics including taxation, municipal funds, property management, sanitation measures, and the appointment of officers.

name: The Indian Extradition Act, 1903

metadata.title: The Indian Extradition Act, 1903
metadata.amends: The Extradition Act, 1870 and the Fugitive Offenders Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the surrender of fugitive criminals in cases involving states other than foreign states and amends existing extradition laws. It outlines powers for magistrates to issue warrants, provisions for bail, and procedures for the release or re-arrest of individuals in custody.

name: The Indian Foreign Marriage Act, 1903

metadata.title: The Indian Foreign Marriage Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the Foreign Marriage Order in Council of 1903 regarding marriages where neither party professes the Christian religion. It establishes procedures for giving notice, publishing such notices, and obtaining certificates from authorized officers before solemnizing a marriage.

name: The Probate and Administration Act, 1903

metadata.title: The Probate and Administration Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act extends the power to grant probates of wills and letters of administration having effect throughout British India to all High Courts. It also confers upon District Judges the authority to grant such probates in specific cases where assets are situated within their jurisdiction.

name: The Indian Tea Cess Act, 1903

metadata.title: The Indian Tea Cess Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a customs-duty on Indian tea exported from British India to create a fund for the tea industry. It also amends section 5 of the Indian Tariff Act, 1894, and establishes a Tea Cess Committee to receive and expend the proceeds.

name: The Indian Electricity Act, 1903

metadata.title: The Indian Electricity Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates and regulates the supply of electrical energy for lighting and other purposes. It establishes provisions for licensing, defining terms like 'energy' and 'general supply', and outlines the powers of local authorities regarding licenses and infrastructure.

name: The Works of Defence Act, 1903

metadata.title: The Indian Works of Defence Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the government to impose restrictions on land for defence purposes after providing notice. It outlines the procedures for determining and paying compensation to affected persons, including disputes over apportionment and interest on deposits.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1903

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the citation of certain enactments and amends specific laws listed in its schedules. It also repeals other specified enactments while preserving existing rights, titles, obligations, and legal procedures.

name: NA- The Provident Funds Acts, 1897

metadata.title: The Provident Funds (Amendment) Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Provident Funds Act, 1897 to protect compulsory deposits in government or railway provident funds from attachment under court decrees. It ensures that sums standing to the credit of a deceased subscriber are payable to their widow or children free from any debt incurred by them before death.

name: The Victoria Memorial Act, 1903

metadata.title: The Victoria Memorial Act, 1903
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the erection, maintenance, and management of the Victoria Memorial at Calcutta. It establishes a body of Trustees to manage the memorial's property and outlines their powers and procedures.

name: The Central Provinces Village-Sanitation Act, 1902

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Village-sanitation Act, 1902
metadata.summary: This Act provides further provisions for sanitation in villages within the Central Provinces. It establishes village panchayats to determine funds required for conservancy, water supply, and public utility improvements.

name: The United Provinces (Designation) Act, 1902

metadata.title: The United Provinces Act, 1902
metadata.summary: This Act recognizes and gives effect to the unification of territories formerly administered by the Chief Commissioner of Oudh with those of the North-Western Provinces. It officially designates the combined territory as the 'United Provinces of Agra and Oudh' and updates references in existing laws and appointments to reflect this new constitution.

name: ACT VI of 1902

metadata.title: Act No. VI of 1902
metadata.repeals: Act XIV of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the provisions of Act XIV of 1867 regarding the assessment of pan-chayat-tax in certain parts of the Central Provinces. It also amends section 48 of the Indian Income-tax Act, 1886, to abolish the pendhari tax levied under the repealed Act.

name: The Administrators General and Official Trustees Act, 1902

metadata.title: The Administrator General's Act, 1902
metadata.repeals: The Official Trustee's Act, 1864
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to Administrators General and Official Trustees, specifically regarding their appointment, duties, and remuneration. It also provides for the suspension or removal of private executors and administrators by the High Court.

name: The Indian Tramways Act, 1902

metadata.title: The Indian Tramways Act, 1902
metadata.summary: This Act applies the provisions of the Indian Railway Companies Act, 1895 to certain tramway companies. It authorizes these companies to pay interest on their paid-up share capital under conditions similar to those prescribed for railway companies.

name: The Cantonments (House-Accommodation) Act, 1902

metadata.title: The Cantonments (House-Accommodation) Act, 1902
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better provision of house-accommodation in cantonments for military officers. It establishes rules regarding the appropriation of houses, liability for rent, and procedures for arbitration disputes between owners and military tenants.

name: The Imperial Library (Indenture Validation) Act, 1902

metadata.title: The Imperial Library (Indentures Validation) Act, 1902
metadata.summary: This Act confirms and validates indentures made between the Agricultural and Horticultural Society of India, the Calcutta Public Library, and the Secretary of State for India in Council. It declares these indentures valid in law to vest property absolutely in His Majesty for the establishment of an Imperial Library in Calcutta.

name: The Tolls (Army) Act, 1901

metadata.title: The Indian Tolls (Army) Act, 1901
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding exemptions from tolls for persons and property belonging to the Army in British India. It aims to remove inconsistencies between the Army Act and various enactments of Indian legislatures while extending specific exemptions to local corps, Imperial Service Troops, and authorized followers.

name: The Lower Burma Courts Act, 1900

metadata.title: The Lower Burma Courts Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Chief Court and subordinate civil courts in Lower Burma, defining their jurisdiction, composition, and administrative control. It outlines the appointment of judges, the structure of benches, and procedures for appeals and execution of decrees within the specified territory.

name: The Prisoners Act, 1900

metadata.title: The Prisoners Act
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to prisoners in British India, covering definitions, persons under sentence, and procedures for removal. It also provides provisions for requiring prisoner attendance in court and obtaining their evidence.

name: The Church of Scotland Kirk Sessions Act, 1899

metadata.title: The Act for the Incorporation of Kirk Sessions in Scotland
metadata.summary: This Act declares that Kirk Sessions constituted in pursuance of an Act of the General Assembly of the Church of Scotland shall be bodies corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal. It grants these sessions the power to acquire, hold, dispose of property, contract, and perform all necessary acts as a body corporate.

name: The Currency Conversion (Army Annual) Act, 1899

metadata.title: The Currency Conversion Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conversion of sums into British Indian currency. It extends to the whole of British India and comes into force immediately upon promulgation.

name: The Marriages Validation (Padukkottai and Travancore) Act, 1899

metadata.title: The Act No. XV of 1899
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain marriages between Native Christians in the Native States of Pudukkottai and Travancore. It grants certificates to validate irregular marriages solemnized by specific missionaries under the provisions of the Indian Christian Marriage Act, 1872.

name: The Glanders and Farcy Act, 1899

metadata.title: The Act relating to the prevention of diseases of cattle
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Local Government to appoint inspectors and veterinary practitioners to prevent diseases in cattle, specifically horses. It grants authorities powers to enter premises, search for diseased animals, seize them, and regulate their destruction or treatment.

name: The Petroleum Act, 1899

metadata.title: The Indian Petroleum Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the importation, possession, and transport of petroleum and other substances in British India. It defines key terms such as 'petroleum', 'flashing point', and 'dangerous petroleum', and establishes powers for local governments to make rules regarding these matters.

name: The Government Buildings Act, 1899

metadata.title: The Buildings Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the erection, re-erection, construction, alteration, or maintenance of buildings within municipalities in Punjab. It specifically applies to buildings used for public service, public purposes, or those owned/occupied by the Government.

name: The Stamp Act, 1899

metadata.title: The Indian Stamp Act
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to stamps in British India. It establishes duties payable on various instruments, procedures for valuation, and penalties for executing unstamped documents.

name: NA- The Indian Arbitration Act, 1899

metadata.title: The Indian Arbitration (Amendment) Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Indian Legislature that amends the Indian Arbitration Act, 1899. It was enacted to expedite certain purposes related to arbitration proceedings.

name: The Burma Laws Act, 1898

metadata.title: The Burma Laws Act, 1898
metadata.amends: The Regulations of the Bengal Code and Acts of the Governor General in Council now in force in Upper Burma
metadata.summary: This Act declares the Regulations of the Bengal Code and Acts of the Governor General in Council that are currently in force in Upper Burma. It also makes certain provisions regarding the law in Burma and other matters, while amending, repealing, and facilitating the citation of various enactments.

name: The Central Provinces Tenancy Act, 1898

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Tenancy Act, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act defines various classes of tenants in the Central Provinces, including ordinary, occupancy, village-service, and sub-tenants. It establishes rules regarding rent fixation, payment, enhancement, and compensation for improvements made by tenants.

name: The Punjab Courts Act, 1899

metadata.title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Courts Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Courts Act of 1884 regarding appeals and the execution of decrees. It substitutes specific sections to define grounds for appeal in small cause or unclassed suits based on the value of the suit.

name: The Indian Insolvency Rules Act, 1898

metadata.title: The Indian Insolvency Rules Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act confirms rules made by the High Court regarding matters connected with insolvency under sections 4 and 76 of the Indian Insolvency Act, 1848. It also grants the Chief Justice power to authorize payments for pensions or bonuses to official assignees upon retirement.

name: The live-stock Importation Act, 1898

metadata.title: The Live-stock Importation Act, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of live-stock and related items entering British India by sea or land to prevent the spread of infectious disorders. It grants powers to local governments to make rules regarding detention, inspection, disinfection, and destruction of imported animals and contaminated goods.

name: The Code of Criminal Procedure Act, 1898

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This document outlines the Code of Criminal Procedure enacted in 1898, detailing the powers and jurisdictions of magistrates and courts. It covers provisions regarding territorial divisions, court structures outside presidency towns, arrest procedures, summons service, and the general duties of police and public assistance to magistrates.

name: The Petroleum Act,1898

metadata.title: The Petroleum Act, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Petroleum Act of 1886 by adding new sub-sections to section 4 and substituting clause (1) of section 3. It expands the definition of petroleum to include various oils such as kerosine, paraffin oil, and mineral oil, while excluding lubricating oils with a specific flash point.

name: The Post Office Act, 1898

metadata.title: The Indian Post Office Act, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the Post Office in British India. It covers various aspects including postage rates, registration, insurance, money orders, and penalties for offenses related to postal duties.

name: The Lepers Act, 1898

metadata.title: The Lepers Act, 1858
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the segregation and compulsory treatment of pauper lepers in designated asylums. It defines specific terms such as 'pauper leper' and 'leper asylum', and grants police officers the power to arrest suspected pauper lepers without a warrant.

name: The Paper Currency Act, 1898

metadata.title: The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the issue of currency notes secured by gold received in England. It amends the Indian Paper Currency Act, 1882, by adding a new section regarding the retention and accounting of gold bullion until its arrival in India.

name: The Cantonments Act, 1897

metadata.title: The Cantonments Act, 1897
metadata.repeals: Act V of 1895
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Cantonments Act, 1895 (Act V of 1895) and amends the Cantonments Act, 1889. Specifically, it substitutes certain words in section 31 regarding commanding officers.

name: The Short Titles Act, 1897

metadata.title: The Indian Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Governor General's Council received on July 22, 1897, which facilitates the citation of certain Indian Acts by their short titles. It includes a schedule listing various acts from 1837 to 1855 along with their subjects and short titles.

name: The Local Authorities (Emergency) Loans Act, 1897

metadata.title: Local Loans Act
metadata.summary: This Act enables local authorities to borrow money for temporary purposes when it is expedient to do so. It grants the Governor General in Council the power to prescribe terms, conditions, and procedures for such loans, including repayment schedules and account keeping.

name: The Bhopal Coinage Act, 1897

metadata.title: The Bhopal Coinage Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the introduction of current silver coin from Bhopal as legal tender in India. It allows for the exchange of Bhopali rupees at an agreed rate and secures a reserve to pay currency notes.

name: The General Clauses Act, 1897

metadata.title: The General Clauses Act, 1897
metadata.repeals: The General Clauses Act, 1868 and The General Clauses Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and extends the General Clauses Acts of 1868 and 1887. It provides general definitions for terms used in Acts, Regulations, and rules made by the Governor-General in Council.

name: The Reformatory Schools Act, 1897

metadata.title: The Reformatory Schools Act, 1897
metadata.repeals: Act V of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to Reformatory Schools and makes further provisions for dealing with youthful offenders. It establishes powers for the Governor General in Council regarding the use of reformatories, management rules, licensing of offenders, and inspection requirements.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1897

metadata.title: The First Schedule
metadata.summary: This document is a schedule detailing modifications to various acts as they apply to Assam. It lists specific amendments and repeals for legislation such as the Opium Act of 1857 and the Inland Emigration Act of 1893.

name: The Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897

metadata.title: null
metadata.summary: null

name: The Fisheries Act, 1897

metadata.title: The Indian Fisheries Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This Act provides for certain matters relating to fisheries in British India. It extends to the whole of British India and comes into force immediately.

name: The Sindh Incumbered Estates Act, 1896

metadata.title: The Sindh Incumbered Estates Act, 1896
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law providing for the relief of jagirdars and zamindars in Sindh. It establishes provisions for inquiries into debts, property sufficiency, and the management of incumbered estates.

name: The Central Provinces Additional Judicial Commissioner's Act, 1896

metadata.title: Central Provinces Additional Judicial Commissioner's Act
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the temporary appointment of an Additional Judicial Commissioner to assist the Judicial Commissioner of the Central Provinces. It outlines the powers and jurisdiction of the Additional Commissioner, including how appeals are handled when they are preferred from judgments passed by either the Judicial or Additional Commissioner.

name: The Inland Bonded Warehouses Act, 1896

metadata.title: Inland Bonded Warehouses Act
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment and licensing of inland bonded warehouses for the storage of salt. It provides rules for the inspection, safe custody, and removal of salt from these warehouses, as well as the security required from persons executing bonds.

name: The Cotton Duties Act, 1896

metadata.title: Cotton Duties Act, 1896
metadata.repeals: Cotton Duties Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of certain duties on cotton goods produced in British Indian mills. It repeals and re-enacts provisions from the Cotton Duties Act, 1894, while incorporating specific sections to address duty assessment, recovery, warehousing, and export refunds.

name: NA- The Abkari Act, 1895

metadata.title: The Khairpur Abkari Act (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Abkari Act of 1895 to update references regarding opium and hemp quantities in specific sections. It also omits Section 7 of the said Act and substitutes terms in marginal headings to reflect changes in intoxicant classifications.

name: The ex-King Thebaw’s Act, 1895

metadata.title: The Ex-King Thebaw's Act
metadata.summary: This Act incapacitates ex-King Thebaw from binding himself by contract to give rise to enforceable pecuniary obligations. It provides for an inquiry into his present state of indebtedness and establishes a Committee to handle claims against him or his property.

name: The Validation of Marriages (Bangalore) Act, 1895

metadata.title: Act to validate certain marriages solemnised in the Civil and Military Station of Bangalore
metadata.summary: This Act validates marriages solemnized in the Civil and Military Station of Bangalore by Reverend James Gillings, who held a license from the Government of Madras. It deems these marriages to have been valid from their date of solemnization and ensures that related certificates and register extracts are accepted as legal evidence.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1895

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1895
metadata.repeals: Various enactments specified in the First Schedule (including Acts of the Governor General in Council and Acts of the Governor of Bombay in Council)
metadata.summary: This Act expressly repeals certain obsolete enactments that have ceased to be in force and amends other specific enactments listed in its schedules. It includes provisions to save rights, titles, liabilities, and remedies acquired prior to the repeal, ensuring that the repeal does not affect existing legal principles or established procedures.

name: The Crown Grants Act, 1895

metadata.title: Act No. XV of 1895
metadata.summary: This Act explains the operation of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882, specifically regarding Crown grants. It removes doubts about the powers of the Crown and ensures that provisions related to Crown grants are construed as if the 1882 Act had not been passed.

name: The Pilgrim Ships Act, 1895

metadata.title: The Pilgrim Ships Act, 1895
metadata.repeals: Act X of 1887
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the voyages of pilgrim ships carrying passengers to or from the Hedjaz, establishing requirements for steam propulsion, tonnage, and medical officers. It outlines procedures for medical inspections, ticket issuance, and sanitary taxes while defining penalties for masters who violate these regulations.

name: The Companies (Memorandum of Association) Act, 1895

metadata.title: Act No. XII of 1893
