metadata.summary: This Act provides powers to companies regarding alterations in their articles of association or deeds of settlement. It outlines the procedure for obtaining confirmation from the High Court for such alterations and specifies conditions under which registered stores may be transferred.

name: The Validation of Proceedings (Pegu and Tenasserim) Act, 1895

metadata.title: Act No. XI of 1895
metadata.summary: This Act addresses doubts regarding the validity of proceedings and acts performed by officers in Lower Burma, specifically within the Pegu and Tenasserim Divisions. It clarifies that such proceedings and acts are deemed to have been held or done within the correct sessions division, district, sub-division, township, registration district, or sub-district where the officer exercised jurisdiction.

name: The Railway Companies Act, 1895

metadata.title: The Indian Railway Companies Act, 1895
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the payment of interest out of capital by railway companies registered under the Indian Companies Act, 1882 during the construction period. It defines specific conditions regarding share issuance, shareholder liability, and limits on interest rates to ensure financial stability for railways in British India.

name: The Extradition Act, 1895

metadata.title: The Extradition Act, 1895
metadata.summary: This Act applies the Extradition Act of 1870 to British possessions and allows for its suspension in specific foreign states. It vests powers related to the surrender of fugitive criminals in Presidency and District Magistrates, treating them as if they were part of the original 1870 Act.

name: The Cotton Duties Act, 1894

metadata.title: The Cotton Duties Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition and levy of certain duties on cotton goods produced in British Indian mills. It outlines procedures for duty assessment, collection, and exemptions for yarns exported to foreign ports.

name: The Engineer's Certificates Validation Act, 1894

metadata.title: The Engineers' Certificates Validation Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act validates certificates granted to engineers of steam-ships in the territories administered by the Governor of Bombay. It specifically recognizes certificates inadvertently granted between December 1, 1885, and February 7, 1893, under the Indian Steam-ships Act, 1884, as valid for voyages of those classes.

name: The Prisons Act, 1894

metadata.title: The Prisons Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act defines the control and duties of officers in prisons within British India. It establishes regulations regarding the admission, removal, discharge, discipline, health, and employment of prisoners.

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1894

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain obsolete enactments and amends other specified laws within the territories administered by the Governor of Bombay. It addresses regulations, rules, ordinances, and acts that have become unnecessary or require modification.

name: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This Act provides the legal framework for the government to acquire private land for public purposes. It outlines procedures for taking possession, determining compensation, and handling disputes through courts.

name: NA-The Indian Tariff Act, 1894

metadata.title: The Indian Tariff Act, 1894
metadata.summary: This document is an amendment to the Indian Tariff Act of 1894. It was published in The Gazette of India on April 9, 1933.

name: NA- The Indian Tariff Act, 1894

metadata.title: The Indian Tariff (Amendment) Act, 1902
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Tariff Act of 1894 to allow for special duties on imported sugar exceeding local production rates. It also provides definitions for 'sugar', 'refined sugar', and currency equivalents, while establishing rules for identifying sugar and assessing these duties.

name: The Tributary Mahals of Orissa Act, 1893

metadata.title: The Tributary Mahals of Orissa Act, 1893
metadata.repeals: The enactments specified in the schedule
metadata.summary: This Act provides for matters connected with the Tributary Mahals of Orissa, including the repeal of certain previous enactments and the indemnification of officers and inhabitants. It validates acts done before its commencement in exercise of executive or judicial authority and allows sentences passed in those Mahals to be carried into effect in British India.

name: The Patit Baronetcy Act, 1893

metadata.title: An Act for settling bonds or debentures of the Municipal Corporation of the City of Bombay producing an annual income of one lakh and twenty-five thousand rupees and a Mansion-house and hereditaments called 'Petit Hall' in the Island of Bombay
metadata.summary: This Act settles bonds and debentures of the Municipal Corporation of Bombay along with a mansion-house known as Petit Hall. It establishes trusts to support the title and dignity of the Baronetcy conferred upon Sir Dinshaw Manockjee Petit and his heirs.

name: The Execution of certain Capital Sentences Act, 1893

metadata.title: Act No. V of 1893
metadata.summary: This Act legalizes the execution of capital sentences within British India for cases passed by courts exercising jurisdiction over territory beyond its limits. It mandates that such executions be carried out in secure jails under specific warrants issued by authorized tribunals or courts.

name: The Porahat Estate Act, 1893

metadata.title: The Porahat Estate Act, 1893
metadata.summary: This Act annexes the estate of Porahat to the Singhbhum District and incorporates it into the Chutia Nagpur Division. It also validates all executive acts, proceedings, decrees, and sentences done in respect of the estate since 1858.

name: The Government Tenants (Punjab) Act, 1893

metadata.title: The Government Tenants (Punjab) Act, 1893
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the grant of special tenancies in certain government lands in the Punjab that are wholly or partly irrigable from government canals. It establishes procedures for maintaining registers of these tenancies and defines the rights and restrictions regarding their transfer or sale.

name: The Banker's Books Evidence Act, 1893

metadata.title: The Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 1893
metadata.summary: This Act amends the definition of 'Bankers' Books' in the existing Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 1893. It specifically adds money order offices of the Post Office to the list of institutions whose books are admissible as evidence.

name: The Lower Burma Towns Act, 1892

metadata.title: The Lower Burma Towns Act, 1892
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the administration of towns in Lower Burma by defining a 'town' and establishing the roles of ward headmen and block elders. It outlines specific duties for these local officials, including reporting crimes, assisting police investigations, arresting suspects, collecting revenue, and maintaining public sanitation.

name: The Government Management of Private Estates Act, 1892

metadata.title: The Government Management of Private Estates Act, 1892
metadata.repeals: Section 17 of the Court of Wards Act, 1879 and so much of Act II of 1881 as relates to section 17 of the said Court of Wards Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a rate on private estates under government management to cover supervision and management costs. It defines key terms such as immovable property, gross income, and the scope of estates under government management.

name: The Madras City Civil Court Act, 1892

metadata.title: The Madras City Civil Court Act, 1892
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an additional Civil Court for the City of Madras. It defines the court's jurisdiction, the appointment and powers of its judges, and outlines procedures regarding fees and officer conduct.

name: Act No. IV OF 1892

metadata.title: The Bengal Court of Wards Act, 1879
metadata.amends: The Bengal Court of Wards Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bengal Court of Wards Act, 1879 to clarify the powers of the Court regarding disqualified proprietors and guardians. It introduces provisions for retaining or withdrawing charge over property based on debts, liabilities, and court orders concerning minors.

name: The Bengal Military Police Act, 1892

metadata.title: The Bengal Military Police Act, 1892
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better regulation of the Bengal Reserve Police. It defines various classes of military police officers and establishes rules regarding their conduct, service against hostile tribes, and responsibilities during mutinies or sedition.

name: The Marriage Validation Act, 1892

metadata.title: Act No. II of 1892
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain marriages solemnized under Part VI of the Indian Christian Marriage Act, 1872 between persons where only one party is a Native Christian. It also ensures that certificates and register-books related to these validated marriages are received as valid legal evidence.

name: The Inland Emigration Act, 1891

metadata.title: An Act to extend the Inland Emigration Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Inland Emigration Act, 1882 to the whole or any portion of the Madras Presidency. It was promulgated by the Government of India on October 10, 1891, following the assent received on October 8, 1891.

name: The Punjab Municipal Act, 1891

metadata.title: The Punjab Municipal Act, 1891
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution, management, and powers of municipal committees in Punjab. It covers various aspects including elections, taxation, public health measures, and the regulation of streets and buildings.

name: The Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 1891

metadata.title: The Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 1891
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Law of Evidence to regulate the admissibility of entries in bankers' books as evidence in legal proceedings. It defines specific terms related to bank records and establishes procedures for inspecting, copying, and producing these books upon court order.

name: The Colonial Courts of Admiralty Act, 1891

metadata.title: The Colonial Courts of Admiralty (India) Act, 1891
metadata.repeals: The Courts of Admiralty Act, 1864; The Court-fees in suits instituted in the Colonial Court of Admiralty at Rangoon, Aden or Karachi Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act declares specific High Courts and District Courts in British India to be Colonial Courts of Admiralty. It also specifies court fee levies for suits in these courts regarding the slave trade and repeals previous enactments related to admiralty jurisdiction.

name: The Moorshedabad Act, 1891

metadata.title: null
metadata.summary: null

name: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1891

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Act, 1891
metadata.amends: Foreign Jurisdiction and Extradition Act, 1879; Cantonments Act, 1889
metadata.repeals: Control of Officers in Assam, Arakan and Tenasserim (VI); Control of Officers in Khasi Hills and Cachar (VII); Indigo-contracts (XII); Camp Police (XXVI); Bengal Bonded Warehouse (XXVIII); Tahsildars, Madras (VII); Ganjam and Vizagapatam (XXIV); Execution by the Court of Requests, Calcutta (XXVII); Dower (AXIX)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain obsolete enactments that have ceased to be in force or are no longer needed. It also amends specific sections of other existing laws, such as the Foreign Jurisdiction and Extradition Act, 1879, and the Cantonments Act, 1889.

name: The Easements Act, 1891

metadata.title: The Indian Easements Act Extension Act, 1891
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Indian Easements Act, 1882 to specific territories where it was previously not in force. The extension applies to Bombay, the North-Western Provinces, and Oudh.

name: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Act, 1890

metadata.title: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act amends and adds to various sections of the North-Western Provinces Act, 1876. It also addresses the annexation of the Jhansi Division to the Allahabad Division and repeals specific provisions related to scheduled district status.

name: The Census Act, 1890

metadata.title: The Indian Census Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides for certain matters in connection with the taking of the census of British India during the year 1891. It defines various officers and persons as deemed public servants or census-officers to aid in the census operations.

name: The Guardians and Wards Act, 1890

metadata.title: The Guardians and Wards Act, 1890
metadata.repeals: The Guardians and Wards Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment and declaration of guardians for minors in British India. It outlines the duties, rights, and liabilities of guardians regarding the person and property of wards.

name: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890

metadata.title: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890
metadata.repeals: Cruelty to Animals Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act defines offenses related to the cruel treatment of animals in public or private spaces and establishes penalties for such acts. It also provides for the appointment of infirmaries for animal care and outlines procedures for prosecution.

name: The Railways Act, 1890

metadata.title: The Indian Railways Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for the inspection of railways and the constitution of Railway Commissions. It outlines the powers of railway administrations regarding construction, maintenance, traffic management, and passenger carriage, while also defining penalties for offenses.

name: The Comptoir National D’Escompte de Paris Act, 1890

metadata.title: The Comptoir National D'Escompte de Paris Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Comptoir National D'Escompte de Paris to sue and be sued in its own name or through its Chief Manager within British India. It grants the company the power to exercise rights before tribunals and defines key terms such as 'notes', 'bills', and 'Chief Manager' for the purposes of this legislation.

name: The Charitable Endowments Act, 1890

metadata.title: The Charitable Endowments Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the vesting and administration of property held in trust for charitable purposes. It establishes the Treasurer of Charitable Endowments as a corporation sole with perpetual succession to manage such properties.

name: The Revenue Recovery Act, 1890

metadata.title: The Recovery Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act provides better provisions for recovering certain public demands. It empowers a Collector to issue a certificate regarding an arrear and directs another Collector to recover the amount as if it were a land-revenue arrear in their own district.

name: NA- The Bombay Salt Act, 1890

metadata.title: The Salt Law Amendment Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Salt Law Act, 1924, to transfer control over salt revenue from local governments and provincial boards to the Central Board of Revenue. It substitutes references to 'Governor in Council' with 'Governor General in Council' and redefines various administrative roles related to salt collection.

name: NA- The Bombay District Police Act, 1890

metadata.title: The Bombay District Police (Federal Capital Amendment) Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bombay District Police Act of 1890 to apply it to the Capital of the Federation. It was enacted by the Constituent Assembly and received assent from the Governor-General on April 15, 1952.

name: The Central Provinces Village-sanitation Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Village-sanitation Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act provides for better sanitation in villages within the Central Provinces by establishing elected panchayats. These village councils are empowered to determine funds and assess taxes on houses and lands to maintain roads, ensure water supply, and manage conservancy.

name: The Central Provinces Municipal Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Municipal Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for municipalities in the Central Provinces, covering their organization, powers, and functions. It details provisions regarding taxation, municipal funds, police duties, sanitary regulations, building standards, and penalties for various offences.

name: The Official Secrets Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Indian Official Secrets Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act prevents the disclosure of official documents and information belonging to Her Majesty or her government departments. It defines offenses related to obtaining, possessing, or communicating unauthorized sketches, plans, models, or knowledge regarding fortresses, arsenals, ships, and other state properties.

name: The Indemnity to certain witnesses Act, 1889

metadata.title: Act No. XIV of 1889
metadata.summary: This Act indemnifies certain witnesses from civil or criminal liability arising from statements made or evidence given during inquiries into public servant misbehaviour. It specifically protects individuals involved in proceedings related to a Commission appointed by the Governor of Bombay and investigations concerning J. M. Macpherson.

name: The Lower Burma Courts Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Lower Burma Courts Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act organizes the civil and criminal jurisdiction of courts in Lower Burma, including the Recorder's Court and Special Courts. It defines the grades, locations, and powers of various judicial officers such as Civil Judges, Deputy Commissioners, and the Judicial Commissioner.

name: The Ports Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Indian Ports Act, 1889
metadata.repeals: The Indian Ports Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to ports and port-charges in India. It establishes the powers of local governments, defines the roles of port officials like conservators, and sets out regulations for vessel safety, dues, and penalties.

name: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Kanungos and Patwaris Act, 1889

metadata.title: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Kanungos and Patwaris Act, 1889
metadata.repeals: The Kanungos and Patwaris Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the imposition of a patwari-rate in the North-Western Provinces and Oudh. It also establishes certain provisions regarding the roles and regulations for kanungos and patwaris in those regions.

name: The Succession Certificate Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Succession Certificate Act, 1889
metadata.repeals: Act XXVII of 1860; Act V of 1881; Bombay Regulation VIII of 1827 (to the extent mentioned)
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the collection of debts on successions and provides protection to parties paying debts to representatives of deceased persons. It establishes conditions for granting certificates, defines jurisdiction, and repeals earlier enactments related to succession certificates.

name: The Coroner of Madras Act, 1889

metadata.title: Act No. V of 1889
metadata.amends: Coroners Act, 1871; Coroners Act, 1881; Code of Criminal Procedure, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the office of Coroner in Madras and amends related legislation including the Coroners Acts of 1871 and 1881. It establishes Coroners for Calcutta and Bombay, outlines procedures for investigating deaths, and repeals specific sections of previous criminal procedure codes.

name: The Merchandise Marks Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Indian Trade Marks and Merchandise Marks Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to fraudulent marks on merchandise within British India. It defines terms such as 'goods', 'name', and 'trade mark' and substitutes new sections in Chapter XVIII of the Indian Penal Code regarding trade and property marks.

name: The Lower Burma Village Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Lower Burma Village Act, 1889
metadata.amends: The Burma District Cesses and Rural Police Act, 1880; The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a village system and amends the law relating to rural police in Lower Burma. It defines the powers of the Deputy Commissioner regarding headman appointments, outlines the duties of headmen and rural policemen, and specifies procedures for reporting offences and maintaining public order.

name: The Measures of Length Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Measures of Length Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act declares the imperial standard yard for the United Kingdom to be the legal standard measure of length in British India. It establishes definitions for the standard foot and standard inch based on fractions of the standard yard.

name: The Metal Tokens Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Metal Tokens Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits private persons from making, possessing for issue, or issuing pieces of metal intended to be used as money in British India. It also amends Section 28 of the Indian Penal Code regarding penalties for such offenses and defines the burden of proof in trials concerning the intent to use metal pieces as currency.

name: NA- The Madras Salt Act, 1889

metadata.title: The Salt Law Amendment Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Salt Law Act, 1924, to transfer control over salt revenue from local governments and provincial boards to the Central Board of Revenue. It substitutes references to 'Governor in Council' with 'Governor General in Council' and redefines various administrative roles related to salt collection.

name: The Burma Financial Commissioner Act, 1888

metadata.title: The Burma Financial Commissioner Act, 1888
metadata.amends: Indian Stamp Act, 1879; Destruction of Records Act, 1879; Excise Act, 1881; Upper Burma Laws Act II of 1879
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of a Financial Commissioner for Burma and defines his functions. It extends to the whole of Burma, excluding the Shan States, and validates past proceedings done by persons appointed before the Act's commencement.

name: The Soldiers Necessaries Purchase Act, 1888

metadata.title: The Soldiers' Necessaries Purchase Act, 1888
metadata.repeals: The enactments specified in the schedule (specifically Act VII of 1867 and Regulation XIV of 1832 relating to the purchase of regimental necessaries from soldiers)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain previous enactments regarding the purchase of regimental necessaries from soldiers. It specifically targets provisions from the Act of 1867 and the Regulation of the Madras Code that have not already been repealed.

name: The Shan States Act, 1888

metadata.title: The Shan States Act, 1888
metadata.summary: This Act supplements the provisions of the Upper Burma Laws Act, 1886 specifically regarding the Shan States in Upper Burma. It establishes the administration of civil and criminal justice, revenue collection, and the application of customary law within these states, subject to conditions approved by the Governor General.

name: The Supplement to Bombay and Calcutta Municipal Act, 1888

metadata.title: Supplement to Bombay and Calcutta Municipal Acts
metadata.amends: City of Bombay Municipal Act, 1888; Calcutta Municipal Consolidation Act, 1889
metadata.summary: This Act supplements the City of Bombay Municipal Act, 1888, and the Calcutta Municipal Consolidation Act, 1889. It validates decisions made by municipal authorities and magistrates as if passed by the Governor General in Council.

name: The Tolls Act, 1888

metadata.title: The Tolls Act, 1888
metadata.summary: This Act clarifies the legality of levying certain tolls on public roads and bridges within the territories administered by the Lieutenant-Governor of the Punjab. It validates past tolls collected under previous Acts and extends the authority of specific local governments to include the North-Western Provinces.

name: The Contagious Diseases Enactments Repeal Act, 1888

metadata.title: The Contagious Diseases Enactments Repeal Act, 1888
metadata.repeals: Indian Contagious Diseases Act, 1868; Municipal Lock-hospitals Act, 1868; Madras District Municipalities Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act repeals specific enactments relating to contagious diseases passed by the Governor General in Council and other authorities. It lists the repealed acts, including those from 1868 and 1884, and specifies the extent of the repeal for each.

name: The Inventions and Designs Act, 1888

metadata.title: The Inventions and Designs Act, 1888
metadata.repeals: The enactments described in the first schedule
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the protection of inventions and designs in British India. It establishes provisions for acquiring exclusive privileges, registering designs, and handling infringement suits.

name: The Reserve Forces Act, 1888

metadata.title: The Indian Reserve Forces Act, 1888
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the government, discipline, and regulation of Her Majesty's Indian Reserve Forces. It divides these forces into Active and Garrison Reserves and defines their respective liabilities regarding service beyond British India.

name: The Police Act, 1888

metadata.title: The Police Act, 1888
metadata.amends: The Police Act, 1859; The Police Act, 1861; The Bombay District Police Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to the regulation of police in British India. It allows for the creation of general police districts that span multiple presidencies or provinces and permits police officers to serve beyond their original establishment limits.

name: The Tariff Amendment Act, 1888

metadata.title: The Petroleum (Customs Duty) Act, 1888
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a customs duty on petroleum and related products. It amends the Indian Tariff Act, 1882 by adding specific articles to its second schedule.

name: The Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Punjab Land-Revenue Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for land revenue administration in Punjab, including preliminary definitions and the powers of revenue officers. It covers procedures for assessing land revenue, maintaining records of rights, and collecting dues through various processes such as attachment and sale of property.

name: The Inland Bonded Warehouses Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Inland Bonded Warehouses Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of bonded warehouses at places other than customs-ports. It stipulates that provisions regarding warehousing and duty levies on goods moved between ports shall be construed as if such non-port locations were customs-ports.

name: The Wild Birds Protection Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Wild Birds and Game Protection Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act empowers local governments and municipal authorities to make rules for the protection of wild birds and game within their territories. It defines specific terms such as 'wild bird' and 'breeding season,' and prohibits the possession, sale, or importation of wild birds or their plumage during the breeding season.

name: The Allahabad University Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Allahabad University Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a University at Allahabad with the Governor General as its Patron. It defines the university's corporate structure, including the roles of the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and Fellows, and outlines their appointment processes and terms of office.

name: The King of Oudh’s Estate Act, 1887

metadata.title: The King of Oudh's Estate Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the administration of the estate of His late Majesty the King of Oudh, Wajid Ali Shah. It grants the Governor General in Council exclusive authority to manage the estate and distribute remaining property among the family and dependents, while also indemnifying officials from legal liability regarding their actions.

name: The Burma Military Police Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Burma Military Police Act, 1887
metadata.repeals: The Upper Burma Military Police Regulation, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a military police force in Lower Burma and amalgamates it with the existing military police force. It defines various terms related to the force, including officer ranks and superior officers, and outlines procedures for discharge and punishment.

name: The Marine Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Indian Marine Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better administration of Her Majesty's Indian Marine Service. It defines various offences committed by officers and crew, establishes the jurisdiction and powers of Indian Marine Courts, and outlines procedures for trials and punishments.

name: The Electricity Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Electricity Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the supply and use of electricity in British India, including definitions related to galvanism and magnetism. It empowers public officers to enforce rules regarding licenses and penalties for unauthorized supply or obstruction.

name: The Bengal, North-Western Provinces and Assam Civil Courts Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Bengal, North-Western Provinces and Assam Civil Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Civil Courts in Bengal, the North-Western Provinces, and Assam. It establishes the ordinary and special jurisdiction of various courts, including District Judges, Subordinate Judges, and Munsifs, while also regulating their appointment, removal, and suspension.

name: The Sindh-Pishin Railway Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Sindh-Pishin Railway Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act regulates traffic on the Sindh-Pishin section of the North-Western Railway, which lies beyond the Province of Sindh. It exempts the Government from liability for injury or loss occurring to persons or property carried on that specific railway section.

name: The Native Passenger Ships Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Native Passenger Ships Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to native passenger ships in British India. It establishes regulations regarding medical officers, bills of health, and penalties for unlawful departures or fraudulent alterations of certificates.

name: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1859
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1859
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Courts of Small Causes established beyond the Presidency-towns. It defines the constitution, jurisdiction, and powers of these courts, as well as the practice and procedure applicable to them.

name: The Military Courts of Requests Abolition Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Act to abolish Military Courts of Requests
metadata.repeals: Act III of 1859; Act XII of 1868; Act XI of 1841; Act XV of 1874; Act XIV of 1855; Bengal Regulation XX of 1810
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes Military Courts of Requests and other military tribunals having jurisdiction over civil cases in Cantonments. It also repeals specific sections of previous Acts and Regulations related to these courts.

name: The Suits Valuation Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Suits Valuation Act, 1887
metadata.repeals: Act No. VII of 1873
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes the mode for valuing certain suits to determine court jurisdiction. It applies to suits other than those covered in Part I and stipulates that court-fees and values for jurisdiction purposes shall be the same as specified in the referenced sections.

name: NA-The Karachi Port Trust Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Karachi Port Trust (Amendment) Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Karachi Port Trust Act, 1886 to provide for the withdrawal or revocation of powers conferred on the Board by the Central Government. It outlines conditions under which such powers may be revoked, including procedures for notice and the subsequent vesting of property and authorities in the Central Government.

name: The Museum Act, 1887

metadata.title: The Indian Museum Act, 1887
metadata.repeals: XX of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act alters the constitution of the Trustees of the Indian Museum and confers additional powers on that body. It amends the Indian Museum Act, 1876, by substituting new sections regarding the incorporation, tenure, and appointment of trustees while deeming existing officeholders as appointed under the new provisions.

name: The General Clauses Act, 1887

metadata.title: The General Clauses Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act provides for shortening the language used in Acts of the Governor General in Council. It also defines various terms such as 'commencement', 'financial year', and 'local authority' to ensure consistent interpretation across statutes.

name: The Glanders and Farcy Act, 1886

metadata.title: Act No. XXIV of 1886
metadata.repeals: The Glanders and Fahey Act, 1879 (specifically section 1 regarding the Governor of Bombay in Council)
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Glanders and Fahey Act, 1879 to the Bombay Presidency. It was promulgated by the Governor-General of India in Council on October 22, 1886.

name: The Oudh Rent Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Oudh Rent Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the rights and obligations of under-proprietors and tenants in Oudh, specifically addressing rent payments, enhancements, and compensation for improvements. It also outlines procedures for ejectment, distress for arrears, and the determination of tenancy claims.

name: The Oudh Wasikas Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Oudh Wasikas Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act declares that certain allowances known as Oudh Wasikas are pensions within the meaning of the Pensions Act, 1871. It applies the provisions of the Pensions Act to these specific allowances as if they were standard pensions.

name: The Jhansi and Morar Act, 1886

metadata.title: Act No. XVII of 1886
metadata.summary: This Act annexes the town and fort of Jhansi, along with lands to be ceded to the British Government, to the district of Jhansi. It is enacted under the authority of the Governor General's Council to establish full sovereignty over these territories.

name: The Securities Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Indian Securities Act, 1886
metadata.repeals: Indian Securities Act, 1881; Indian Securities Act, 1885
metadata.summary: This Act received the assent of the Governor General on March 19, 1886, and was promulgated for general information. It repeals the Indian Securities Acts of 1881 and 1885 while preserving any authorities, notifications, or rules made under those previous acts.

name: The Tramways Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Indian Tramways Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the construction and regulates the working of tramways in India. It defines the powers of promoters, lessees, and local authorities regarding the establishment, maintenance, and operation of tramway undertakings.

name: The Deo Estate Act, 1886

metadata.title: Act No. IX of 1886
metadata.summary: This Act applies the Chutia Nagpur Encumbered Estates Act, 1876, to the Deo Estate in Gaya District. It modifies the original act by adding specific wording regarding persons entitled to receive maintenance and addresses debts incurred by a Raja subject to government liabilities.

name: The Petroleum Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Petroleum Act, 1886
metadata.repeals: Petroleum Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the importation, possession, and transport of petroleum and other fluids of a like nature within British India. It defines terms such as 'petroleum' and 'dangerous petroleum', establishes penalties for illegal activities, and provides powers to local governments regarding rules and exemptions.

name: The Births, Deaths and Marriages Registration Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the voluntary registration of certain births and deaths in India. It establishes the powers of Local Governments to appoint Registrars, defines the duties of Commissioners, and outlines procedures for maintaining general registry offices.

name: The Mirzapur Stone Mahal Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Mirzapur Stone Mahal Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act declares and amends the law relating to the Stone Mahal in the district of Mirzapur in the North-Western Provinces. It establishes the Government's right to levy duties on stone quarrying, storing, and transport, while defining public rights and proprietorship conditions.

name: The License-tax Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Income-tax Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a tax on income derived from sources other than agriculture in British India. It outlines the ordinary mode of assessment, collection procedures, and specific provisions for trustees, agents, and occupying owners.

name: The Lahore Tramways Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Lahore Tramways Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act grants exclusive rights to grantees over tramways and streets where they are laid. It establishes regulations regarding traffic, fare collection, the carriage of dangerous goods, and penalties for non-compliance or obstruction.

name: NA- The Indian Income Tax Act, 1886

metadata.title: Act No. XI of 1903
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Indian Income-tax Act, 1886. It substitutes specific figures and words in various sections and schedules of the said Act.

name: The Telegraphs Act, 1885

metadata.title: The Indian Telegraph Act, 1885
metadata.repeals: The Indian Telegraph Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to telegraphs in India and repeals the Indian Telegraph Act, 1876. It grants the Governor General exclusive privileges to establish and maintain telegraphs while allowing for licenses to be issued to private persons.

name: The Bengal Tenancy Act, 1885

metadata.title: The Bengal Tenancy Act, 1885
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the rights and obligations of tenants (raiyaats) holding land under the Permanent Settlement in Bengal. It defines occupancy rights, sets rules for rent enhancement and reduction, and establishes procedures regarding eviction and landlord-tenant disputes.

name: The Rangoon Water-works Act, 1884

metadata.title: The Rangoon Water-Works Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for the construction and maintenance of water-works in the Town of Rangoon. It vests existing water infrastructure, including the Royal Lake and various tanks, in the Municipal Committee for that town.

name: The Burma Gaming Act, 1884

metadata.title: The Burma Gaming Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the more effective suppression of certain forms of gaming in British Burma. It defines specific games and premises as illegal, grants powers to magistrates and police officers regarding arrests and stake collection, and amends provisions of Act III of 1867.

name: The Marriage Licenses Validation Act, 1884

metadata.title: Act XV of 1884
metadata.repeals: Act V of 1865
metadata.summary: This Act validates licenses granted to ministers of religion under Act XXV of 1864 that were in force when Act V of 1865 came into effect. It declares these licenses and the marriages solemnized under them as valid, removing doubts regarding their status after subsequent legislative changes.

name: The Settlement-officers (P.) Decisions Validation Act, 1884

metadata.title: Sett.-officers' (P.) Decisions Validation
metadata.amends: Panjab Courts Act, 1865; Panjab Courts Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act validates decisions made by settlement officers in the Punjab regarding land suits and appeals, even if those officers lacked specific authorization or were outside their local jurisdiction at the time. It clarifies that such decisions are not invalid merely because the officers were not properly invested with power to decide them, provided they would have been valid had they possessed such power.

name: The Panjab Municipal Act, 1884

metadata.title: The Panjab Municipal Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for municipalities in Punjab, covering their organization, taxation, and public health responsibilities. It outlines procedures for constituting committees, imposing taxes on immovable property, managing municipal funds, and regulating streets and buildings.

name: The Agriculturists’ Loans Act, 1884

metadata.title: The Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1884
metadata.repeals: Northern India Takkavi Act, 1879; Bombay Revenue Jurisdiction Act, 1880
metadata.summary: This Act amends and extends the Northern India Takkavi Act, 1879 to parts of British India. It provides for loans to owners and occupiers of arable land for agricultural purposes and distress relief, allowing such loans to be recovered as arrears of land revenue.

name: The Repeal of Bengal Regulation XIX, 1810, Act, 1884

metadata.title: Act No. VIII of 1884
metadata.repeals: Bengal Regulation XIX of 1810
metadata.summary: This Act repeals Bengal Regulation XIX of 1810 within the territories administered by the Lieutenant-Governor of the North-Western Provinces. The regulation covered the appropriation of rents for religious and public purposes, maintenance of bridges and buildings, and custody of escheats.

name: The Indian Steam-ships Act, 1884

metadata.title: The Indian Steam-ships Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the survey, examination, and certification of engineers and engine-drivers for steam-ships in India. It establishes powers for the Local Government regarding surveys, rule-making, and penalties for operating without valid certificates.

name: The Explosives Act, 1884

metadata.title: The Indian Explosives Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, possession, use, sale, transport, and importation of explosives in British India. It defines what constitutes an explosive and includes processes like dividing or breaking up explosives under the term 'manufacture'.

name: The Madras Partition Deeds Act, 1884

metadata.title: The Partition Act, 1884
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the effects of partition on property titles and rights within the Punjab Presidency. It provides protections for transferees in good faith who acquire property without notice of unregistered partition instruments and establishes conditions for recovering compensation from sharers who caused a privation of right.

name: The Rangoon Tramways Act, 1883

metadata.title: The Rangoon Tramways Act, 1883
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the making and regulation of street tramways in Rangoon based on an agreement with John William Darwood. It grants powers to the Grantee to construct, maintain, and use tramways while subject to confirmation by the Chief Commissioner of British Burma.

name: The Punjab District Boards Act, 1883

metadata.title: The Panjab District Boards Act, 1883
metadata.repeals: Act V of 1878
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the duties, powers, and financial procedures for District and Local Boards in the Punjab. It outlines regulations regarding taxation, officer employment, pensions, and the conditions under which the Local Government may supersede boards.

name: The Protection of Inventions Act, 1883

metadata.title: The Inventions Exhibition Act, 1883
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Inventions Exhibition Act of 1859 regarding the protection of inventions exhibited at international exhibitions in India. It clarifies that public use or knowledge of an invention after an exhibition does not prevent it from being considered a new invention for patent purposes.

name: The Land Improvement Loans Act, 1883

metadata.title: The Land Improvement Loans Act, 1883
metadata.repeals: Act XXI of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to government loans for agricultural improvements in British India. It defines specific works that qualify as improvements, such as constructing wells, drainage systems, and reclaiming waste land, while also establishing procedures for applying for loans and recovering them through installments.

name: The Indus Valley State Railway Lands Act, 1883

metadata.title: The Act No. XIII of 1883
metadata.repeals: Act X of 1880
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the application of laws in force in the Multan State Railway district to lands occupied by the Indus Valley State Railway. It also makes similar provisions for any future lands that may be annexed to the railway system.

name: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Municipalities Act, 1883

metadata.title: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Municipalities Act, 1883
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for municipal boards in the North-Western Provinces and Oudh, covering elections, appointments, and the term of office for chairmen. It outlines powers regarding taxation, fund management, police establishment, and the authority to make rules and enforce public nuisances.

name: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Local Boards Act, 1883

metadata.title: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Local Boards Act, 1883
metadata.amends: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Local Rates Act, 1878
metadata.repeals: Sections 12, 13, 14, 15 of the North-Western Provinces and Oudh Local Rates Act, 1878; Sections 12 and 14 of Act IV of 1878
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution, duties, and control of local boards in the North-Western Provinces and Oudh. It establishes the relationship between local and district boards, outlines procedures for meetings and elections, and defines the powers of government officers regarding these boards.

name: The British Burma Pilots Act, 1883

metadata.title: The British Burma Pilots Act, 1883
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the licensing and control of pilots in British Burma. It also establishes provisions for investigating certain charges against these pilots.

name: The Bombay port-dues Act, 1883

metadata.title: Act No. XI of 1888
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Ports Act, 1875 to allow for a reduction in port dues at the port of Bombay. It substitutes the existing entry in the first schedule regarding Bombay with new provisions permitting the Governor General to direct lower rates.

name: The Bikrama Singh's Estates Act, 1883

metadata.title: The Act No. X of 1883
metadata.summary: This Act settles estates belonging to Sardar Bikrama Singh and his heirs, subject to specific conditions regarding alienation and succession. It also mandates the payment of a sum by the Raja of Kapurthala to resolve claims on mesne profits.

name: The Central Provinces Tenancy Act, 1883

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Tenancy Act, 1888
metadata.summary: This Act regulates tenancy relations in the Central Provinces of India, covering definitions of various tenant classes such as occupancy and ordinary tenants. It establishes rules regarding rent fixation, enhancement, improvements, compensation for ejectment, and procedures for eviction suits.

name: The British Burma Labour Law Act, 1883

metadata.title: An Act to repeal the British Burma Labour Law, 1876
metadata.repeals: The British Burma Labour Law, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act was promulgated to repeal the British Burma Labour Law of 1876. It received the assent of the Governor General on April 19, 1883.

name: The Bengal Pilots Act, 1883

metadata.title: Act No. VI of 1883
metadata.summary: This Act empowers judges holding trials under specific legislation to arrest persons whose evidence is needed. It authorizes officers to enter vessels and detain them for the purpose of effecting an arrest, allowing aid from police or customs officers.

name: The Nazim of Bengal Act, 1883

metadata.title: An Act to repeal Act XX VII of 1854
metadata.repeals: Act XXVII of 1854
metadata.summary: This Act repeals Act XXVII of 1854, which previously governed the service and execution of processes within the precincts of the Nazim at Murshidabad. The repeal is necessitated by an indenture from 1880 where the Nawab Nazim relinquished his position, leading to the abolition of the Superintendent of the affairs of the Nizamat office.

name: The Central Provinces Local Self-government Act, 1883

metadata.title: The Local Government Act, 1883
metadata.summary: This Act establishes local administrative bodies for groups of circles and districts within the Central Provinces, defining their constitution and duties. It grants specific powers to the Chief Commissioner regarding rule-making, rate confirmation, and emergency supervision.

name: NA-The Indian Emigration Act, 1883

metadata.title: null
metadata.summary: This document amends the Indian Emigration Act, 1866 by adding a new section (106) to it. The amendment grants the Governor General in Council the power to declare conditions for Natives of India departing from British India under agreements with Her Majesty's Government to labour for hire.

name: The Madras Forest Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Madras Forest Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act clarifies doubts regarding the Madras Forest Act of 1852. It was enacted by the Governor General's Council to ensure that previous enactments do not affect the time contained in the original legislation.

name: The Punjab University Act

metadata.title: The Panjab University Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and incorporates the Panjab University at Lahore. It defines the university's objectives, including promoting European science through vernacular languages and encouraging the study of English.

name: The Burma Steam-boilers and Prime-movers Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Burma Steam-Boilers and Prime-movers Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the inspection of steam-boilers and prime-movers in British Burma. It also establishes regulations for the management of these devices by competent engineers.

name: The Jhansi Encumbered Estates Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Jhansi Encumbered Estates Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the relief of zamindars in the Jhansi Division of the North-Western Provinces who are in debt and whose immovable property is subject to encumbrances. It establishes procedures for investigating debts, determining amounts due, and facilitating the sale of properties if necessary to discharge liabilities.

name: The Indian Salt Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Indian Salt Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the levy of duty on salt and provides for penalties regarding offences against salt revenue. It outlines powers for search, seizure, arrest, and the manufacture or refining of salt and saltpetre throughout British India.

name: The Presidency Small Cause Courts Act, 1882

metadata.title: THE PRESIDENCY SMALL CAUSE COURTS ACT, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for Presidency Small Cause Courts, defining their jurisdiction and procedures. It outlines specific rules regarding the execution of decrees, recovery of immovable property possession, and the powers of court officers such as bailiffs and registrars.

name: The Companies Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Indian Companies Act, 1882
metadata.repeals: Act XX of 1866
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the formation, management, and administration of companies and associations in Punjab. It establishes rules regarding share issuance, member liability, prospectus requirements, and the protection of creditors.

name: The Transfer of Property Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Transfer of Property Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act governs the transfer of property in India, covering topics such as mortgages, foreclosure, and redemption. It establishes rules for conditional transfers, the rights of mortgagees, and procedures for suits related to immovable property.

name: The Trust Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Indian Trusts Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to private trusts and trustees in British India. It establishes the rights, powers, duties, and liabilities of trustees and beneficiaries, including provisions on trust property management and breach of trust.

name: The Inland Emigration Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Inland Emigration Act, 1882
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the emigration of labour from India to other parts of the country. It establishes procedures for licensing contractors and recruiters, medical examinations of intending labourers, and the supervision of depots.

name: NA- The Transfer of Property Supplementary Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Transfer of Property (Supplementary Amendment) Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act serves as a supplementary amendment to the Transfer of Property Act, 1882. It specifically modifies Order XLII and Order XLIII of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, by substituting certain rules regarding property transfers.

name: The Paper Currency Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1882
metadata.repeals: Act No. II of 1871
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to the Government Paper Currency and establishes Circles of Issue. It creates a Department of Paper Currency responsible for issuing promissory notes called currency notes.

name: The Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to promissory notes, bills of exchange, and cheques. It establishes rules regarding their creation, negotiation, presentment for payment or acceptance, and the liabilities of parties involved.

name: The Central Provinces Land-revenue Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Land-Revenue Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for revenue surveys and settlements within the Central Provinces. It defines the powers of settlement officers, procedures for assessing land revenue, and mechanisms for handling claims to unowned lands or disputes among proprietors.

name: The Portuguese Convention Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Portuguese Convention Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act implements a convention between the Governors General of British India and Portuguese India regarding the adoption of the British monetary system in Portuguese possessions. It mandates that coins adopted shall feature the effigy of the King of Portugal with specific legends while maintaining the value of existing coins.

name: The Factories Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Factories Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act regulates labour in factories across British India, defining what constitutes a factory and setting rules for employment. It establishes the powers of factory inspectors to examine premises and machinery, while also imposing strict restrictions on the employment of children under specific ages.

name: The Fort William Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Fort William Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better government of Fort William and establishes rules within the fort for trying persons guilty of breaches of those rules. It also defines the powers and procedures of the Fort Magistrate, including arrest without warrant and limitations on prosecution.

name: The Obstructions in Fairways Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Obstructions in Fairways Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Local Government to remove or destroy obstructions in fairways leading to ports in British India and to prevent their creation. It outlines procedures for handling removed items, including claims for expenses, disputes resolution, and the sale of unclaimed goods.

name: The Municipal Taxation Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Municipal Taxation Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Governor General in Council to prohibit the levy of municipal taxes on persons in military service or those liable to pay to the Secretary of State for India in Council. It also provides that if such prohibitory orders remain in force, the Secretary of State shall be liable to pay fair sums to Municipal Committees in lieu of the prohibited taxes.

name: The Petroleum Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Petroleum Act, 1881
metadata.repeals: The Indian Ports Act, 1875, section thirty-seven; Bengal Act No. III of 1865
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the importation, possession, and transport of petroleum and other fluids of a like nature within British India. It defines dangerous petroleum based on its flashing point and establishes penalties for contraventions regarding these substances.

name: The Securities Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Indian Securities Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act provides for matters relating to the securities of the Government of India, specifically regarding certificates and coupons issued in respect of government loans. It declares that these certificates and coupons may be transferred like promissory notes payable to bearer and outlines the discharge of the government upon payment to the bearer.

name: The District Delegates Act, 1881

metadata.title: The District Delegates Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Succession Act, 1865 by adding provisions regarding caveats against the grant of probate or letters of administration. It establishes the role of District Delegates in non-contentious cases and outlines procedures for transmitting matters to District Judges when doubt exists about granting a grant.

name: The Probate and Administration Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Probate and Administration Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act governs the granting of probate and letters of administration in India. It outlines procedures for various scenarios, including lost wills, absent executors, and special purposes.

name: The Madras Port-dues Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Madras Port-Trust Act
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Ports Act of 1875 to enhance port dues leviable at Madras. It authorizes the construction of an artificial harbour and adjusts duty rates for sea-going vessels entering the port.

name: The Taj Mahal’s Pension Act, 1881

metadata.title: An Act for the determination of claims to Taj Mahal's pension
metadata.summary: This Act provides a procedure for the District Court to determine claims regarding pensions from the estate of Taj Mahal. It outlines the process for applications, hearings, and appeals to the High Court if an order is made dismissing a claim or granting a certificate.

name: The Pegu and Sittang Canal Act, 1881

metadata.title: The Pegu and Sittang Canal Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the navigation, protection, and maintenance of the Pegu and Sittang Canal. It provides powers to detain vessels violating rules or causing danger, and allows for the seizure of cargo if tolls or charges are not paid.

name: The Madras Irrigation and Canal Company's Act, 1880

metadata.title: An Act to regulate the Traffic on the Madras Irrigation and Canal Company's Canal
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the traffic on the Madras Irrigation and Canal Company's Canal, including fares, tolls, and vessel management. It empowers the company to make rules for licensing vessels, fixing passenger and cargo limits, and regulating canal usage.

name: The Census Act, 1880

metadata.title: The Census Act, 1880
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the taking of the census in British India and defines the duties of census officers. It also outlines the powers of local governments to delegate authority and the obligations of military personnel and civilians to assist in census operations.

name: The Kazis Act, 1880

metadata.title: The Kazis' Act, 1880
metadata.repeals: Act No. XI of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Government to appoint persons to the office of Kazi, reversing a previous decision that such appointments were inexpedient. It provides procedures for local governments to select Kazis based on community desire and outlines powers regarding suspension, removal, and the appointment of deputies (Naib Kazis).

name: The Vaccination Act, 1880

metadata.title: The Vaccination Act, 1880
metadata.summary: This Act grants the power to prohibit inoculation and makes vaccination of children compulsory in specific municipalities and cantonments. It defines key terms such as 'parent', 'guardian', and 'unprotected child', and establishes procedures for extending or withdrawing the Act's application to different local areas.

name: The Courts Act, 1880

metadata.title: The Burma Courts Act, 1880
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the temporary appointment of an Additional Recorder to assist the Recorder of Rangoon. It also clarifies the jurisdiction of the Recorder and establishes rules for the Additional Recorder's duties, including sitting in special courts and handling cases pending in the Recorder's Court.

name: The Multan District Act, 1880

metadata.title: Act No. X of 1880
metadata.summary: This Act applies the law in force regarding lands occupied by the Indus Valley Railway to the Multan District. It was promulgated for the Governor General of India's Council and received assent on May 21, 1880.

name: The Burma Boundaries Act, 1880

metadata.title: The Burma Boundaries Act, 1880
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the demarcation of land and the establishment and maintenance of boundary marks in British Burma. It outlines the powers of Demarcation officers, including issuing notices to procure attendance and clearing boundary lines.

name: The Portuguese Treaty Act, 1880

metadata.title: The Portuguese Treaty Act, 1880
metadata.summary: This Act implements a separate convention between the Governors-General of British India and Portuguese India regarding extradition. It establishes procedures for delivering up persons accused or convicted of crimes committed in either jurisdiction, based on a treaty ratified in 1879.

name: NA- Act V of 1835

metadata.title: The District Cesses and Rural Police Act, 1898
metadata.amends: The Burma Land and Revenue Act, 1876
metadata.repeals: sections 81 and 32, sections 87 and 46 of the Burma Land and Revenue Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to District Cesses and Rural Police in British Burma. It provides for better provisions regarding the maintenance of rural police, local postal services, public utility works, sanitary improvements, and education.

name: The Religious Societies Act, 1880

metadata.title: The Religious Societies Act, 1880
metadata.summary: This Act confers certain powers on religious societies to hold property and manage their affairs. It provides a simplified manner for appointing new trustees when necessary and outlines the procedures for dissolving such bodies and settling their properties.

name: NA- The Bengal Cess Act, 1880

metadata.title: The Bengal Tenancy Act, 1885
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bengal Tenancy Act by inserting new sections after section sixty-four. It clarifies that suits for recovering sums due on rent-free lands can be brought against either the owner/holder or the occupier, with specific consequences regarding decrees and sales.

name: NA- The Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879

metadata.title: The Sind Local Boards and Land Revenue Code (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.amends: Sind Local Boards Act, 1923 and Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879
metadata.repeals: Bombay Land Revenue Code applicable to the district of Khairpur
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Boards Act, 1923 and the Sind Land Revenue Code, 1879. It extends these laws to specific districts including Hyderabad, Tharparkar, and others, while repealing the Bombay Land Revenue Code as it applies to Khairpur.

name: The Foreign Jurisdiction and Extradition Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Foreign Jurisdiction and Extradition Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the trial of offences committed in places beyond British India and for the extradition of criminals. It re-enacts previous legislation with amendments to clarify the powers of Political Agents and others acting under the authority of the Governor General in Council regarding jurisdiction outside British limits.

name: The Glanders and Farcy Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Glanders Act
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Local Government to appoint inspectors for detecting and managing glanders in horses within their jurisdiction. It grants these inspectors authority to seize diseased horses, certify illnesses via veterinary surgeons, and order the disinfection of premises where infected animals are found.

name: The Legal Practitioners Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Legal Practitioners Act, 1879
metadata.repeals: enactments mentioned in the first schedule hereto annexed
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to legal practitioners in British India, including advocates, pleaders, mukhtars, and revenue-agents. It establishes rules for their qualifications, enrolment, suspension, dismissal, remuneration, and penalties for illegal practice.

name: The Dekkhan Agriculturists Relief Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Agriculturists' Relief Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to agriculturist debtors by regulating the jurisdiction of subordinate judges and small cause courts in their cases. It establishes procedures for taking accounts, allowing payment by instalments, exempting certain property from attachment, and creating mechanisms for conciliation and arbitration.

name: The Transport of Salt Act, 1879

metadata.title: Act No. XVI of 1879
metadata.summary: This Act restricts the transport of salt by sea in British India. It empowers officers to search vessels, seize cargo, and arrest individuals suspected of violating salt transport regulations.

name: The Rangoon Port Commissioners Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Rangoon Port Commissioners Act
metadata.summary: This Act appoints Commissioners to manage the affairs of the Port of Rangoon. It provides for the appointment, tenure, and powers of these Commissioners regarding wharves, piers, and other port infrastructure.

name: The Hackney-Carriage Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Hackney Carriages Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act applies to municipalities in the Punjab, Oudh, Central Provinces, British Burma, Assam, Ajmer, and Coorg. It empowers local authorities to make rules for the regulation and control of hackney-carriages within municipal limits or military cantonments.

name: The Local Authorities Loan Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Local Loans Act, 1879
metadata.amends: The Local Public Works Loan Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act re-enacts the Local Public Works Loan Act of 1871 to regulate local or municipal loans for public works. It outlines the procedures for obtaining loans, making inquiries, and repaying funds through instalments.

name: The Northern Takkavi Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Land Improvement Act, 1879
metadata.repeals: Act IV of 1872
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the recovery of certain advances made to landholders in specific territories administered by Lieutenant-Governors and Chief Commissioners. It repeals section 52 of the Land Improvement Act, 1872, and establishes rules for advancing funds for agricultural objects such as seed or cattle relief.

name: The Panjab Additional Financial Commissioner’s Act, 1879

metadata.title: null
metadata.summary: This document is an Order published by the Government of India regarding the appointment and business transfer of Additional Financial Commissioners in Punjab. It stipulates that these officers hold office during the pleasure of the Governor General in Council but must vacate their positions by September 30, 1879.

name: The Elephants Preservation Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Elephants Preservation Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation of wild elephants in specific territories including the Western Provinces, Central Provinces, British Burma, and Coorg. It establishes rules regarding licenses to kill or capture elephants under strict conditions and outlines penalties for violations.

name: The Railways Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Indian Railway Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to railways in India. It defines key terms such as 'Railway' and outlines provisions regarding duties, offences, and procedures related to railway operations.

name: The Destruction of Records Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Act for the Preservation of Records, Books and Papers
metadata.repeals: The Central Provinces Laws Act, 1875; The Oudh Laws Act, 1876; The Act to authorize the destruction of records in the Presidency of Fort St. George and territories under the Lieutenant-Governors of Bengal and the North-Western Provinces, 1865; The Act to authorize the destruction of records in the Presidency of Bombay, 1869
metadata.summary: This Act establishes rules for the permanent preservation of records, books, and papers belonging to courts or in their custody. It defines the Local Controlling Revenue-Authority responsible for issuing orders regarding the disposal of such documents and specifies which previous enactments are repealed.

name: The Central Provinces Laws Act, 1879

metadata.title: Act No. IV of 1879
metadata.summary: This Act substitutes sections 182, 190, and 191 of the Code of Civil Procedure. It provides rules for judges to record reasons for their decisions in open court when they are unable to do so in English, and outlines how a successor judge may deal with such notes if the original judge dies or is removed before the conclusion of the suit.

name: The Stamp Act, 1879

metadata.title: The Indian Stamp Act, 1879
metadata.repeals: General Stamp Act, 1869
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to stamps in British India. It defines which instruments are chargeable with duty, outlines the mode of using adhesive and impressed stamps, and establishes penalties for executing unstamped instruments.

name: The Ferries Act, 1878

metadata.title: The Northern India Ferries Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act regulates private ferries in the territories administered by the Lieutenant-Governors of the Punjab and North-Western Provinces, as well as the Chief Commissioners of Oudh, Central Provinces, Assam, Ajmer, and Merwara. It establishes provisions for letting ferry-tolls by auction, recovering arrears, cancelling leases, setting toll tables, and imposing penalties for unauthorized operations or breaches of rules.

name: The Husainabad Endowment Act, 1878

metadata.title: Act No. XV of 1878
metadata.summary: This Act promulgates a deed of gift regarding the expenses of a specific Mosque and the appointment of Superintendents. It establishes that pensions for these officials and their descendants are to be paid perpetually from the treasury, while prohibiting any interference with the Mosque's property or income.

name: The Assimilation of Powers, N.W.P & Oudh Act, 1878

metadata.title: Act No. XIV of 1878
metadata.amends: Prisons Act, 1870; Oudh Civil Courts Act, 1871; Oudh Land-Revenue Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing laws in the North-Western Provinces, Punjab, and Oudh to alter the authority of the Governor General in Council and the Chief Commissioner. It specifically substitutes references to the Chief Commissioner for the Governor General in Council in various sections regarding prisons, civil courts, and land revenue acts.

name: The Central Provinces Additional Rates Act, 1878

metadata.title: Additional Rates on land
metadata.summary: This Act imposes an additional rate on estates in addition to existing settlements and cesses. It defines terms such as 'Annual value' and grants the Chief Commissioner powers to determine payment installments, make enforcement rules, grant exemptions, and vary assessments.

name: The Native Press Act, 1878

metadata.title: The Press Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act grants the Governor General in Council the power to control the printing and circulation of publications that may cause disaffection or disturb public tranquility. It defines terms such as 'newspaper', 'printer', and 'valuable security' and outlines penalties for publishing content likely to excite unrest among castes, religions, or sects.

name: The Arms Act, 1878

metadata.title: The Indian Arms Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act establishes powers to regulate the possession, manufacture, conversion, and sale of arms within British India. It also covers provisions regarding the import, export, and transport of arms, as well as penalties for breaches of these regulations.

name: The Forest Act, 1878

metadata.title: The Indian Forest Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the management of reserved and protected forests in India, including the exercise and commutation of forest rights. It establishes powers for the government to impose duties on timber, manage forests for special purposes, and regulate the transit and collection of forest produce.

name: The Sea Customs Act, 1878

metadata.title: The Sea Customs Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for sea customs in Punjab, defining the appointment and powers of customs officers. It outlines regulations regarding the prohibition or restriction of importation and exportation, as well as provisions for warehousing and drawback duties.

name: The Northern Region License Act, 1878

metadata.title: The Northern India License Act, 1878
metadata.repeals: Act No. VITI of 1877
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the licensing of certain trades and dealings in the territories under the administration of the Lieutenant-Governor of the North-Western Provinces. It defines the role of the Collector, outlines the particulars required on a license, and specifies how licenses are granted and renewed.

name: The Treasure-Trove Act, 1878

metadata.title: The Indian Treasure-trove Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to treasure-trove in British India. It establishes procedures for notifying collectors when treasure is found, determining ownership rights, and declaring treasure ownerless if no valid claim is made within a specified period.

name: The Opium Act, 1878

metadata.title: The Opium Act, 1878
metadata.repeals: The Opium Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the disposal of confiscated opium and rewards, granting powers to enter, arrest, and seize unlawfully kept opium. It also outlines procedures for searches, arrests, warrants, and the recovery of fees, duties, and penalties related to opium.

name: The Panjab Court's Act, 1877

metadata.title: The Panjab Courts' Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to courts in the Panjab. It establishes the constitution, jurisdiction, and powers of the Chief Court and subordinate civil courts within the territory administered by the Lieutenant-Governor of the Panjab.

name: The Limitation Act, 1877

metadata.title: The Indian Limitation Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the limitation of suits, appeals, and certain applications to courts. It also provides rules for acquiring ownership of easements and other property by possession.

name: The Broach and Kaira Incumbered Estates Act, 1877

metadata.title: The Broach and Kaira Incumbered Estates Act, 1877
metadata.amends: The Broach and Kaira Incumbered Estates Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to Thakurs in the districts of Broach and Kaira who are burdened by debts and mortgages on their immovable property. It establishes a legal framework for applying for estate relief, conducting inquiries into debts, appointing managers, and creating schemes for the liquidation of estates.

name: The Burma Embankment Act, 1877

metadata.title: The Burma Embankment Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the urgent execution of works related to embankments in British Burma. It grants powers to an appointed officer to impress able-bodied persons for labor and seize materials from property if necessary to prevent loss of life or extensive damage.

name: The Military Lunatics Act, 1877

metadata.title: The Military Lunatics Act, 1877
metadata.repeals: Act XXI of 1872
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the admission of military lunatics, both European and Native, into asylums within British India. It repeals the previous Act XXI of 1872 and establishes procedures for examining, admitting, maintaining, and discharging military personnel declared insane.

name: The North-Western Provinces License Act, 1877

metadata.title: The North-Western Provinces License Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a licensing system for specific trades and dealings in the North-Western Provinces, excluding those solely engaged in agriculture. It mandates that licensees pay annual fees determined by the Collector based on their trade class and requires them to renew licenses annually.

name: The Opium Act, 1877

metadata.title: The Opium Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act postpones the commencement of the Opium Act, 1876. It authorizes the Governor General in Council to specify a new effective date via Gazette notification instead of the originally scheduled April 1, 1877.

name: The Straits Settlements Emigration Act, 1877

metadata.title: The Straits Settlements Emigration Act, 1877
metadata.repeals: Act XIV of 1872
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the emigration of native labourers from the Presidency of Fort Saint George to the Straits Settlements. It establishes provisions for emigration agents, protectors, recruiters, and vessels involved in transporting these workers.

name: The Presidency Magistrates Act, 1877

metadata.title: The Presidency Magistrates' Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Presidency Magistrates' Courts and defines their constitution, powers, and local limits of jurisdiction. It outlines procedures for inquiries, trials, summonses, warrants, bail, and prosecutions in cases involving offences against the state or public servants.

name: The Registration Act, 1877

metadata.title: The Indian Registration Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for the registration of documents in British India. It outlines the establishment of registration offices, the duties of registering officers, and the procedures for presenting and registering various types of documents.

name: The Specific Relief Act, 1877

metadata.title: The Specific Relief Act, 1877
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to certain kinds of specific relief obtainable in civil suits. It establishes provisions for recovering possession of property, enforcing contracts, rectifying instruments, rescinding contracts, and granting injunctions.

name: The Opium Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Opium Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the cultivation of poppy, manufacture, possession, and sale of opium within British India. It also governs the export of opium from British territories.

name: The Museum Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Indian Museum Act, 1876
metadata.repeals: Act No. XVII of 1866
