metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management of the Museum at Calcutta, formerly known as the Indian Museum. It repeals the previous Act No. XVII of 1866 and incorporates the Trustees of the Asiatic Society of Bengal to manage the institution.

name: The Bhaunagar Act, 1876

metadata.title: Act No. XX of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act gives better effect to certain agreements regarding the villages of Bhaunagar, which were separated from the Native State of Kathiawar by the Treaty of Bassein in 1802. It declares that these Scheduled villages remain British territory and are subject to the laws in force in the Presidency of Bombay, validating executive acts and proceedings done since February 1, 1866.

name: The Dramatic Performances Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Dramatic Performances Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Local Government to prohibit public dramatic performances likely to deprave or corrupt persons. It defines buildings where performances are held for payment as 'public places' and outlines penalties for disobeying prohibition orders.

name: The Oudh Laws Act, 1876

metadata.title: THE OUDH LAWS ACT 1875
metadata.summary: This Act defines the laws to be administered in Oudh, establishing a hierarchy that prioritizes local customs not contrary to justice over Muhammadan law and Hindu law. It also outlines rules regarding dower contracts, pre-emption rights, village police appointments, and the administration of statutory instruments within the region.

name: The Oudh Land Revenue Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Oudh Land-Revenue Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act received the assent of the Governor General on October 10, 1876, and was promulgated for general information. It establishes the framework for revenue administration, settlement procedures, and the powers of various officers in Oudh.

name: The Sindh Incumbered Estates Act, 1876

metadata.title: THE SINDH INCUMBERED ESTATES ACT, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief from incumbrances for the estates of jagirdars and zamindars in Sindh. It establishes procedures for management, liquidation schemes, and the discharge of debts and liabilities.

name: The Repealing Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Repealing Act, 1876
metadata.repeals: Various Acts of the Governor General in Council (including IX of 1835, XIX of 1838, X of 1840, etc.)
metadata.summary: This Act received the assent of the Governor-General on April 1876 and is promulgated for general information. It serves to repeal specific sections or entire enactments of various previous Acts of the Governor General in Council listed in the schedule.

name: The Presidency Banks Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Provincial Banks Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the Bank of Bengal, the Bank of Madras, and the Bank of Bombay. It amends the earlier Provincial Banks Act of 1863 to address issues regarding capital, directors, shares, and business operations.

name: The Native Passenger Ships Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Native Passenger Ships Act, 1876
metadata.repeals: Acts relating to Native Passenger Ships
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to native passenger ships in British India. It establishes rules for all voyages, short voyages, and long voyages, including requirements for certificates, space provisions, and health regulations.

name: The Chutia Nagpur Encumbered Estates Act, 1876

metadata.title: THE CHUTIA NAGPUR ENCUMBERED ESTATES' ACT, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management of Chutia Nagpur encumbered estates and the settlement of debts associated with them. It outlines powers granted to a manager regarding leases, mortgages, and the investigation of claims against estate holders.

name: The Native Coinage Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Native Coinage Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Governor-General of India to declare certain coins issued by Native States as legal tender in British India. It defines 'Native State' and outlines conditions regarding fineness, weight, and design that such coins must meet.

name: The Sindh Revenue Jurisdiction Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Bombay Revenue Diction Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act received the assent of the Governor General on March 24, 1876, and was promulgated for general information. It defines the extent of Civil Court jurisdiction in matters related to land revenue within the Bombay Presidency and repeals certain previous enactments.

name: The Reformatory Schools Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Reformatory Schools Act, 1876
metadata.repeals: Section 318 of the Code of Criminal Procedure
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment and management of Reformatory Schools for male youthful offenders under the age of sixteen. It outlines the powers of courts to direct such offenders to be sent to these schools instead of undergoing imprisonment or transportation, along with specific requirements for school infrastructure and management.

name: The Revenue Agents Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Revenue Agents Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes Revenue Agents to practice in Munsifs' Courts within the Lower Provinces of Bengal. It specifically permits them to appear and act in suits under Bengal Act No. VIII of 1869 regarding landlord and tenant procedures, despite previous prohibitions found in Act No. XX of 1865.

name: The Burma Land and Revenue Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Burma Land and Revenue Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act defines the rights of landholders in British Burma and establishes the framework for land revenue assessment. It also regulates the manufacture of salt, cutch, and beeswax, along with licensing requirements and tax exemptions.

name: The British Burma Labour Law, 1876

metadata.title: The British Burma Labour Law, 1876
metadata.repeals: Madras Act No. V of 1866
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the transportation of native labourers to British Burma and their subsequent employment under service contracts. It establishes procedures for emigration agents, medical inspectors, recruiters, and depots, including licensing requirements and health examinations.

name: The Central Provinces Laws Act, 1875

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Laws Act, 1875
metadata.repeals: Bengal Regulations; Acts of the Governor General in Council; rules, regulations and enactments not being Statutes, Bengal Regulations, Acts of the Governor General in Council
metadata.summary: This Act declares and amends the law in force in the Central Provinces. It repeals various Bengal Regulations, Acts of the Governor General in Council, and other rules not specifically extended to these territories.

name: ACT No. XIX of 1875

metadata.title: An Act to provide an appeal from certain decrees of the Chief Court of the Panjab, and for other purposes
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the right to appeal from certain decrees and orders of the Chief Court of the Panjab. It also empowers the appellate court to remand suits for retrial and allows judges to make references on points of law.

name: The Law Reports Act, 1875

metadata.title: The Law Reports Act, 1875
metadata.summary: This Act establishes that only reports published under the authority of the Governor General in Council are binding on courts for cases decided after October 30, 1875. It clarifies that nothing in the Act gives further authority to judicial decisions than they would have possessed if this legislation had not been passed.

name: The Ports Act, 1875

metadata.title: The Indian Ports Act, 1875
metadata.repeals: Acts relating to Ports and Port-dues (specifically mentioned as repealed in the Second Schedule)
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to ports, port-dues, and vessels in India. It establishes regulations for entering or leaving ports, managing fires and lights, and handling salvage operations.

name: The Majority Act, 1875

metadata.title: The Indian Majority Act, 1875
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the age at which a minor domiciled in British India is deemed to have attained majority, distinguishing between those under guardianship and others. It sets the age of majority at twenty-one years for minors with appointed guardians and eighteen years for all other persons domiciled in British India.

name: ACT No. V of 1875

metadata.title: Act No. V of 1875
metadata.summary: This Act addresses doubts regarding the rights and liabilities of Native Soldiers enrolled without attestation. It stipulates that individuals receiving military pay for six months are deemed duly enlisted, enrolled, and attested.

name: The Repealing (Correction) Act, 1875

metadata.title: Act No. III of 1875
metadata.summary: This Act was promulgated to correct a clerical error found in the Repealing Act of 1874. It received assent from the Governor General on February 2, 1875.

name: The Distress Act, 1875

metadata.title: The Distress Act, 1875
metadata.summary: This Act regulates distresses for rents in the Presidency Towns. It establishes provisions for bailiffs and appraisers, the issuance of distress-warrants, and the process for the appraisement and sale of distrained property.

name: The Laws Local Extent Act, 1874

metadata.title: The Laws Local Extent Act, 1874
metadata.summary: This Act declares the local extent of certain Acts passed by various legislative bodies in British India. It consolidates laws relating to the application of these Acts across different presidencies and provinces, specifically excluding Scheduled Districts.

name: The Repealing Act, 1874

metadata.title: The Repealing Act, 1874
metadata.repeals: Various obsolete enactments listed in the Schedule (e.g., Decrees for Rent, Indigo Contracts, Quashing Batwaras, Creation of Zilas, etc.)
metadata.summary: This Act expressly and specifically repeals certain obsolete enactments that have ceased to be in force or become unnecessary due to the lapse of time and change of circumstances. It ensures that the repeal does not affect existing rights, titles, remedies, or established legal principles derived from the repealed laws.

name: The Scheduled Districts Act, 1874

metadata.title: The Scheduled Districts Act, 1874
metadata.summary: This Act ascertains the enactments in force in various parts of British India, specifically addressing territories that have not been brought within or have been removed from the operation of general Acts. It provides mechanisms for declaring which laws apply to Scheduled Districts, correcting mistakes in such declarations, and determining boundaries between these districts and other territories.

name: The European British Minors Act, 1874

metadata.title: The European British Minors Act, 1874
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the guardianship of European British minors in the Punjab and several other territories including Oudh, Central Provinces, and Assam. It defines the appointment, duties, rights, and liabilities of guardians regarding both the person and property of wards.

name: ACT No. XII of 1874

metadata.title: The Act No. XII of 1874
metadata.summary: This Act defines powers over districts in Bengal and the Lower Provinces that are vested in the Governor General in Council. It also grants the Governor General in Council the authority to withdraw such powers.

name: ACT No. VIII of 1874

metadata.title: Act No. VIII of 1874
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the exercise of powers exercised by the Lieutenant-Governor and soa of Revenve of Bengal in the territories of the Chief Commissionership of Assam. It also addresses arrangements with zamindars and compensation under a previous Act.

name: The European Vagrancy Act, 1874

metadata.title: The European Vagrancy Act, 1874
metadata.repeals: Acts No. XXI of 1869 and XXVIII of 1874
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws relating to persons of European extraction who wander in any part of British India. It establishes procedures for searching vagrants, providing government work-houses, and imposing penalties for offenses such as begging or refusing employment.

name: The British Burma Municipal Act, 1874

metadata.title: The British Burma Municipal Act, 1874
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Municipal Committees in towns within British Burma. It establishes the powers, duties, and liabilities of these committees regarding property, funds, contracts, and local administration.

name: The Privy Council Appeals Act, 1874

metadata.title: The Privy Council Appeals Act, 1874
metadata.repeals: The enactments specified in the schedule hereto annexed
metadata.summary: This Act provides for appeals to Her Majesty in Council from certain decrees and orders of Civil Courts in British India. It consolidates and amends previous laws relating to the admission of such appeals, including provisions regarding security deposits and time limits for filing applications.

name: The Kullu Appeals Act, 1874

metadata.title: The Kullu Appeals Act, V of 1874
metadata.repeals: Act No. IV of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act re-enacts the powers previously granted by Act No. IV of 1870 to the Assistant Commissioner in charge of the Kullu Sub-division, removing any time limit for their continuance. It empowers this officer to hear civil appeals from specific Tahsildars and officials within the Kullu, Seoraj, Lahoul, and Spiti regions.

name: The Foreign Recruiting Act, 1874

metadata.title: The Foreign Recruiting Act, 1874
metadata.summary: This Act grants the Governor General in Council full control over recruiting activities in British India intended for the service of Foreign States. It empowers the Governor General to prohibit or permit recruitment under specific conditions and defines offenses related to inducing persons to join foreign services, punishable by imprisonment up to seven years.

name: The Married Women's Property Act, 1874

metadata.title: The Married Women's Property Act, 1874
metadata.summary: This Act explains and amends the law relating to married women's property in British India. It declares that wages, earnings, savings, and insurance proceeds acquired by a married woman are her separate property, independent of her husband.

name: The Administrator General's Act, 1874

metadata.title: The Administrator General Act, 1874
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the designation, appointment, and qualifications for Administrators General in three Presidencies. It defines their powers and duties regarding the granting of letters of administration and probate, asset collection, and financial accountability.

name: ACT No. I of 1874

metadata.title: Act I of 1874
metadata.summary: This Act clarifies the powers and jurisdiction of Deputy Collectors within the North-Western Province. It confirms that certain Deputy Collectors appointed after April 1863 possess the same authority as those in charge of sub-divisions, effectively deeming them to have been invested with these powers from their respective appointment dates.

name: The Prince of Arcot's Privilege Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Prince of Arcot's Privilege Act
metadata.summary: This Act continues certain privileges and immunities enjoyed by Prince Azim Jah Bahddur, the Prince of Arcot, and his sons upon succeeding to the title. It specifically prohibits the commencement or prosecution of civil suits against the Prince or his family without the consent of the Governor General.

name: The Nawab Nazim's Debts Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Nawáb Nazim's Debts Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the liquidation of debts owed by the Nawab Nazim of Bengal, Behar, and Orissa. It also aims to protect his property from legal attachments and settles disputes regarding certain jewels and immovable property held for his dignity.

name: The North-Western Provinces Village and Road Police Act, 1873

metadata.title: The North-Western Provinces Village and Road Police Act, 1873
metadata.amends: The North-Western Provinces Village and Road Police Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: Act No. II of 1869; section twenty-one of Bengal Regulation XX of 1817; form No. 6 of the Appendix thereto
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Village and Road Police in the North-Western Provinces. It establishes procedures for the nomination and appointment of police personnel, outlines their specific duties regarding crime reporting and arrest, and defines liabilities for misconduct or neglect.

name: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Municipalities Act, 1873

metadata.title: The North-Western Provinces and Oudh Municipalities Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: Acts Nos. XVIII of 1864, XXII of 1865, XV of 1867, and VI of 1868
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Municipal Committees in the North-Western Provinces and Oudh. It establishes their powers regarding taxation, rule-making, and local improvements while repealing previous enactments on the subject.

name: The Lunatic Soldiers Property Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Lunatic Soldiers' Property Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the security and application of the effects of Officers and Soldiers who become insane on service but are not removed, put on half-pay, or discharged. It establishes committees to secure such property, pay necessary expenses and debts, and dispose of remaining assets for the benefit of the affected officer or soldier.

name: The Timber Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Burma Timber Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: An Act to provide for the levy of Duties of Customs in the Arracan, Pegu, Martaban and Tenasserim Provinces (XXX of 1854); An Act to give effect to certain Provisions of a Treaty between His Excellency the Earl of Elgin and Kincardine, Viceroy and Governor General of India, and His Majesty the King of Burma (IV of 1863); An Act to give validity to certain Rules relating to Forests in British Burma (VII of 1869); The Rules for the better management and preservation of the Government forests of British Burma, dated the 2nd August 1865
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to timber floated down the rivers of British Burma. It establishes duties on such timber and provides powers for the Chief Commissioner to make rules regarding floating, detention, marking, and sale of unclaimed timber.

name: The Central Provinces Municipal Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Municipal Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: Act No. XV of 1867; Act No. XXVI of 1850; Act No. XVIII of 1864; Act No. XXI of 1865
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Municipal Committees in towns within the Central Provinces. It also establishes provisions for police, conservancy, local improvements, education, and the levying of rates and taxes in such towns.

name: The Oaths Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Indian Oaths Act, 1878
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to judicial oaths, affirmations, and declarations in British India. It also repeals the law relating to official oaths and amends specific sections of the Penal Code.

name: The Panjab Appeals Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Act of the Governor General
metadata.summary: This Act regulates appeals falling within the jurisdiction of courts established in conformity with Acts No. XIX of 1865 and No. LV of 1866. It stipulates that such appeals shall be governed by the Code of Civil Procedure unless otherwise provided.

name: The Port-dues Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Burma Port-dues Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of port-dues in the ports of British Burma under the provisions of Act No. XXII of 1855. It authorizes the Chief Commissioner of British Burma to declare specific ports subject to these dues and to set maximum rates and conditions, provided the vessels are sea-going with a burden of ten tons or more.

name: The Canal and Drainage Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Northern India Canal and Drainage Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act regulates irrigation, navigation, and drainage in Northern India. It establishes procedures for water application, compensation claims, and the recovery of canal dues.

name: The Government Saving Banks Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Government Savings' Banks Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: Act XXVI of 1855
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to Government Savings' Banks in British India. It provides for the payment of deposits upon the death of a depositor, including cases involving minors, lunatics, and married women, while also repealing the previous Act of 1855.

name: The Punjab Municipal Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Panjáb Municipal Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: Act No. XV of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for municipal committees in towns within the Punjab region. It outlines the appointment, duties, and powers of these committees while providing provisions for extending the Act to other towns and defining their limits.

name: The Madras Civil Courts' Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Madras Civil Courts Act, 1873
metadata.repeals: Madras Act I of 1868
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Civil Courts in the Madras Presidency subordinate to the High Court. It establishes rules for the constitution, jurisdiction, and administration of these courts while repealing previous enactments.

name: The Ferries Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Burma Ferries Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act regulates public ferries within the territories under the administration of the Chief Commissioner of British Burma. It empowers the Chief Commissioner to declare, establish, change, or discontinue public ferries and vests their superintendence in local authorities.

name: The North-Western Provinces Rent Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Rent Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the rent of occupancy, expropriatory, and tenants-at-will in British India. It establishes grounds for enhancing or abating rent, outlines procedures for ejectment, and provides for compensation to tenants for improvements made on the land.

name: The North-Western Provinces Land-Revenue Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Revenue Act
metadata.summary: This document outlines the preliminary provisions and powers of revenue officers regarding settlement and assessment. It details the appointment, salaries, and duties of officials such as patwaris and kénungos, while also establishing procedures for recording rights and managing disputes among proprietors.

name: The Contract Act, 1872

metadata.title: The Indian Contract Act, 1872
metadata.summary: This Act defines the legal principles governing contracts, agreements, and their enforcement in India. It outlines what constitutes a valid contract, the conditions for voidable or void agreements, and the rules regarding performance, discharge, and certain relations resembling contracts.

name: NA-The Special Marriage Act, 1872

metadata.title: The Special Marriage (Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Special Marriage Act, 1872 to include Jaina religion alongside Hindu, Buddhist, and Sikh religions in various sections. It grants succession rights to children born from marriages under this Act and clarifies adoption rights for persons professing these religions.

name: NA- The Burma Courts Act, 1872

metadata.title: The Burma Courts' Act Amendment Act
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Burma Courts' Act of 1872 to address procedural matters in British Burma. It grants powers to the Judicial Commissioner regarding the distribution of business, language requirements for legal documents, and the hearing of appeals from courts of original jurisdiction.

name: NA-The Evidence Act, 1872

metadata.title: The Indian Museum Act, 1887
metadata.repeals: XX of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act alters the constitution of the Trustees of the Indian Museum and confers additional powers on that body. It amends the Indian Museum Act, 1876, by substituting new sections regarding the incorporation, tenure, and appointment of trustees while deeming existing officeholders as appointed under the new provisions.

name: The Punjab Land-Revenue Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Panjab Land Revenue Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and defines the law relating to the settlement and collection of land-revenue in the Panjab. It also addresses the duties of Revenue Officers and provides for other related purposes.

name: The Weights and Measures of Capacity Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Indian Weights and Measures of Capacity Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a uniform system of weights and measures of capacity throughout British India. It defines primary and local standards, authorizes specific units for use in government offices and contracts, and provides for the appointment of wardens to custody these standards.

name: The Punjab Canal and Drainage Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Panjab Canal and Drainage Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for the Panjab Canal and Drainage system, covering preliminary provisions, water supply applications, and compensation for interruptions. It outlines procedures for surveys, construction, maintenance, and the recovery of charges related to water usage and drainage works.

name: The Oudh Civil Courts' Act, 1871

metadata.title: Oudh Civil Courts Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the constitution and jurisdiction of civil courts in Oudh. It defines the powers of various judicial officers, including the Judicial Commissioner and Deputy Commissioners, regarding appeals and trial referrals.

name: The Bengal Regulations Repeal Act, 1871

metadata.title: Act No. XXIX of 1871
metadata.repeals: Regulation VI of 1793; Regulation XIII of 1793; Regulation XX of 1793; Regulation XXII of 1798; Regulation XXVI of 1793; Regulation XXVII of 1793; Regulation XLII of 1793; Regulation XLIV of 1798; Regulation X of 1795; Regulation XII of 1795; Regulation XLIIT of 1795; Regulation L of 1795; Regulation III of 1796
metadata.summary: This Act expressly rescinds certain Regulations of the Bengal Code that have ceased to be in force or become unnecessary. It also repeals specific regulations related to court powers, police establishment, land tenure, and tax adjustments without reviving any abolished jurisdictions or customs.

name: The Criminal Tribes' Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Criminal Tribes' Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration, surveillance, and control of certain criminal classes, tribes, and eunuchs in British India. It empowers the Local Government to declare specific groups as criminal tribes after reporting to the Governor General in Council and outlines procedures for maintaining registers, imposing penalties, and managing settlements for these groups.

name: The Land Improvement Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Land Improvement Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to advances of money by the Government for agricultural improvements in British India. It establishes procedures for applications, security requirements, and the service of notices between landlords and tenants regarding these financial advances.

name: The Local Public Works Loan Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Local Public Works Loan Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the borrowing of money by bodies corporate, municipal committees, and other persons for public works in British India. It establishes rules regarding the nature of funds used for loans, the manner of applications, inquiries, and conditions attached to such loans.

name: ACT No. XXII of 1871

metadata.title: Act No. XXII of 1871
metadata.summary: This Act amends the provisions of Act XX of 1856 regarding the collection of Chaukidart tax. It alters the dates for tax payment, changes the frequency of collection from monthly to quarterly with specific conditions, and modifies assessment limits in certain appendices.

name: The Pensions Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Pensions Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to pensions and grants of money or land-revenue by the Government. It establishes that civil courts cannot entertain suits regarding these pensions unless specific claims are made to authorized officers like Collectors.

name: ACT No. XXI of 1871

metadata.title: The Dehra Din Act
metadata.summary: This Act confirms the jurisdiction of the High Court and Board of Revenue in the North-Western Provinces, specifically regarding the Dehra Din district. It validates judgments made under previous regulations and acts within that district while excluding a specific area called Jounsar.

name: The Punjab Local Rates Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Panjab Local Rates Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of local rates on land in the Panjab to be applied to local purposes. It defines annual value based on land revenue and establishes rules for rate assessment, collection from tenants, and the management of proceeds into the general fund.

name: The Bengal Sessions Courts Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Bengal Sessions Courts Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Sessions Judges and Additional Sessions Judges in Bengal and the North-Western Provinces. It deems persons previously appointed under local government authority to be appointed under this Act and defines their jurisdiction limits.

name: The North-Western Provinces Local Rates Act, 1871

metadata.title: The North-Western Provinces Local Rates Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of local rates on land in the North-Western Provinces to be applied to specific public purposes. It defines key terms such as 'estate', 'tenant', and 'landlord' and establishes rules for rate payment based on whether a district's settlement is liable to revision.

name: The Broach Thakurs' Relief Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Broach Thakurs' Relief Act
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to Thakurs in Broach by vesting the management of their immovable property in an officer appointed by the Local Government. It bars suits and attachments against the Thakur for prior debts while allowing the government to collect rents and pay maintenance costs.

name: The Oudh Local Rates Act, 1871

metadata.title: Act No. XVII of 1871
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of rates on land in Oudh. It defines key terms such as 'land', 'landholder', and 'estate' regarding revenue assessment and outlines procedures for legal suits, appeals to the Commissioner, and the application of funds for public purposes like roads and schools.

name: The Burmese Steamer Survey Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Burmese Steamer Survey Act
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the requirements for surveying steam vessels plying within British Burma. It outlines procedures for appointing surveyors, issuing certificates of competency and service, and imposes penalties for operating without proper documentation.

name: The Income Tax Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Indian Income-tax Act
metadata.repeals: Act XVI of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act imposes duties on income arising from offices, professions, trades, and companies in British India. It repeals the previous Act XVI of 1870 regarding taxes and penalties incurred under it, while continuing its provisions for that specific period until April 1, 1872.

name: The Abolition of Financial Commissionership Act, 1871

metadata.title: An Act to abolish the Financial Commissionership of Oudh
metadata.repeals: Act No. XXXVII of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the office of Financial Commissioner in Oudh. It empowers the Governor General in Council to transfer pending appeals and invest other officials with the former Financial Commissioner's powers.

name: The Excise Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Excise Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws relating to spirituous and fermented liquors and intoxicating drugs in Northern India. It establishes regulations for the manufacture, sale, and duty on spirits, including provisions for licenses and the power to establish distilleries.

name: The Registration Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Indian Registration Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for the registration of documents and the establishment of registering officers in British India. It outlines procedures for presenting documents, the duties of registrars and sub-registrars, and specific rules regarding the registration of wills and authorities to adopt.

name: The Limitation Act, 1871

metadata.title: THE INDIAN LIMITATION ACT, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes the periods of limitation for instituting suits, appeals, and applications in British India. It also covers the computation of these periods and rules regarding legal disabilities and foreign laws.

name: The Emigration Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Indian Emigration Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the emigration of laborers from India to other countries, establishing a framework for agents, protectors, and medical inspectors. It outlines procedures for recruiting laborers, registering them, licensing vessels, and ensuring their safe conveyance.

name: The Bengal Civil Courts Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Bengal Civil Courts Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to District and Subordinate Civil Courts in Bengal. It establishes the constitution, jurisdiction, and powers of these courts while repealing previous enactments listed in the Schedule.

name: The Prisoner's Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Prisoners' Act, 1871
metadata.repeals: Act XXXVI of 1858
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws relating to prisoners confined by order of a court in British India. It establishes the authority and duties of Superintendents of prisons, outlines procedures for arrest, custody, and the management of convicts sentenced to penal servitude.

name: The Coroners' Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Coroners' Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws relating to coroners in British India. It establishes the appointment, duties, and powers of coroners regarding the inquiry into deaths, including summoning witnesses and holding inquests.

name: The Paper Currency Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Indian Paper Currency Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to government paper currency in India. It establishes the Department of Issue, defines the functions of Commissioners, regulates the supply and issue of currency notes for gold and silver, and sets rules regarding reserves and private bills.

name: ACT No. XXVIII of 1870

metadata.title: Act No. XXVIII of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act transfers the jurisdiction previously given to the Recorder at Maulmain for the Andaman Islands to the High Court of Judicature at Fort William. It authorizes the committal and trial of European British subjects charged with offenses in the Andamans by the High Court exercising its ordinary original criminal jurisdiction.

name: The Prisons’ Act, 1870

metadata.title: THE PRISONS' ACT, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to prisons in the North-Western Provinces, Oudh, Central Provinces, and British Burma. It establishes the roles of superintendents and medical officers, outlines prison offenses, and details regulations regarding confinement, visits, and correspondence.

name: ACT No. XXV of 1870

metadata.title: An Act to legalize the levy of certain duties on timber imported into Maulmain
metadata.summary: This Act legalizes the levy of certain duties on foreign timber imported into Maulmain via the River Salween during the years 1864 and 1865. It declares that all such duties levied between January 1, 1864, and December 31, 1865, were collected in accordance with law to preclude doubts regarding their legality.

name: The Oudh Taluqdars’ Relief Act, 1870

metadata.title: The Oudh Taluqdars' Relief Act
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to taluqdars in Oudh whose estates are burdened with debts and liens. It empowers the Chief Commissioner to appoint a Manager to take control of the taluqdar's immovable property upon application, thereby barring legal proceedings against the debtor for specified debts.

name: The Coinage Act, 1870

metadata.title: The Indian Coinage Act, 1870
metadata.repeals: The Regulations and Acts mentioned in the Schedule
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to coinage and the mint in India. It establishes specific standards for gold, silver, and copper coins, including their weight, fineness, and legal tender status.

name: The European British Subjects Act, 1870

metadata.title: Act No. XXII of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act confirms certain laws affecting European British subjects. It deems Acts conferring summary jurisdiction over offences to apply to European British subjects, even if not expressly referred to therein.

name: The Hindu Wills’ Act, 1870

metadata.title: The Hindu Wills Act, 1870
metadata.repeals: Bengal Regulation V of 1799
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the execution, attestation, revocation, revival, interpretation, and probate of wills made by Hindus, Jainas, Sikhs, and Buddhists in specific territories. It applies to wills created on or after September 1, 1870, within designated regions including Bengal, Madras, and Bombay.

name: ACT No. XX of 1870

metadata.title: An Act to correct two clerical errors in the Court Fees' Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to correct two specific clerical errors found in the Court Fees' Act, 1870. It amends Section 15 and Schedule I of the said Act by substituting the word 'application' for 'plaint or memorandum of appeal' and omitting the phrase 'or memorandum of appeal' from Number two in the schedule.

name: ACT No. XVIII of 1870

metadata.title: Act No. XVIII of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Governor General in Council to exempt goods from customs duties through notifications. It also grants the authority to cancel such exemptions via similar notifications.

name: ACT No. XIX of 1870

metadata.title: An Act to enable the Directors of the Bank of Bengal to act by a quorum
metadata.amends: The Act for regulating the Bank of Bengal (No. IV of 1862)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the legislation regulating the Bank of Bengal to allow its business to be managed by a quorum rather than requiring nine directors. It validates any acts previously done by fewer than nine directors, preventing them from being deemed invalid solely due to the number of attendees.

name: The Repealing Act, 1870

metadata.title: The Repealing Act, 1870
metadata.repeals: Various enactments listed in the Schedule (including statutes from 13 Geo. III and acts of the Governor General of India in Council)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals specific enactments listed in the attached schedule to the extent specified therein. It includes provisions ensuring that the repeal does not affect existing rights, titles, remedies, or established legal principles and practices.

name: The Income Tax Act, 1870

metadata.title: The Indian Income Tax Act
metadata.summary: This Act imposes duties on income and profits arising in British India. It establishes the legal framework for assessment, petition filing, appeals to commissioners, and the powers of collectors.

name: The Government Railways Act, 1870

metadata.title: Act No. XVIII of 1854 (Application to Railways belonging to Government)
metadata.summary: This Act applies the provisions of Act No. XVII of 1854 to Railways belonging to Government but worked by a Railway Company. It stipulates that these government railways should be treated as if they belonged to and were opened by a company, subject to specific modifications regarding terminology and obligations.

name: The Native Passenger Ships Act, 1870

metadata.title: The Native Passenger Ships Act, 1870
metadata.repeals: Act No. XXI of 1858; section one of Act No. II of 1860
metadata.summary: This Act regulates native passenger ships sailing between ports in British India and the Red Sea or Persian Gulf, as well as those east of the Cape of Good Hope. It aims to prevent abuses related to overcrowding and ensures safety standards for vessels carrying more than thirty passengers.

name: The Weights and Measures Act, 1870

metadata.title: The Indian Weights and Measures Act, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a uniform system of weights and measures throughout British India. It defines primary standards for weight, length, capacity, area, and solidity based on French units and authorizes the use of these new units in government offices and general commerce.

name: The Land Acquisition Act, 1870

metadata.title: The Land-Act, 1870
metadata.repeals: Act No. II of 1861 and Act No. XXII of 1863
metadata.summary: This Act provides the legal framework for the acquisition of land for public purposes in British India. It outlines procedures for declaration, enquiry into compensation value, and the power to take possession of land.

name: The Elphinstone Land Company’s Property Act, 1870

metadata.title: Act No. IX of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Elphinstone Press Company to voluntarily sell its property to the State for India in Council. It facilitates the transfer of this property to the Secretary of State in Council for public purposes, with payment made in Government stock.

name: The Murder of Female Infants Act, 1870

metadata.title: Act for the prevention of the murder of Female Infants
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of the murder of female infants in certain parts of British India. It empowers the Local Government to make rules regarding birth, marriage, and death registers, as well as provisions for police forces and penalties.

name: The Court Fees' Act, 1870

metadata.title: THE COURT FEES' ACT, 1870
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the court fees payable in High Courts, Presidency Small Cause Courts, and other courts within the Punjab. It outlines procedures for determining fee amounts, handling disputes regarding fees, and rules for refunds or exemptions.

name: The High Courts (Costs of Petitions) Act, 1870

metadata.title: An Act to enable the High Courts at the Presidency Towns to deal with costs of petitions for certain monies transferred to Government
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the High Courts at Fort William, Madras, and Bombay to determine which party pays costs for specific petitions. It addresses a previous lack of authority in these courts regarding such cost allocations under the earlier Act of 1866.

name: The Kullu Sub-division Act, 1870

metadata.title: Act No. IV of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act invests the Assistant Commissioner in charge of the Kullu Sub-division with certain appellate powers in civil cases. It extends provisions regarding appeals from decisions of lower officers to include the Assistant Commissioner, Tahsildar, and other specified officials.

name: The Agror Valley Act, 1870

metadata.title: The Agror Valley Act, 1870
metadata.repeals: The Ordinance of the fourth day of October, 1869, 'to remove the Agror Valley from the jurisdiction of the tribunals established under the general Regulations and Acts, and for other purposes'
metadata.summary: This Act removes the territory known as the Agror Valley from the jurisdiction of tribunals established under general Regulations and Acts. It provides for the administration of justice and the collection of revenue within this specific territory.

name: The Subordinate Judges and Munsifs Act, 1870

metadata.title: Act No. II of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Local Government to appoint additional Subordinate Judges or Munsifs beyond those appointed under the existing Act No. I of 1868. It specifies that while the Local Government appoints Subordinate Judges, the High Court of Judicature must nominate persons for the office of Munsif before the Local Government makes the appointment.

name: ACT No. I of 1870

metadata.title: Act to provide Rules relating to Quarantine
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Governor General of India in Council and Local Governments to make rules regarding quarantine. It specifically addresses putting vessels into quarantine, regulating their intercourse with shores or other vessels, and managing traffic between ports affected by infectious diseases.

name: ACT No. XXVI оf 1869

metadata.title: Act No. XXVI of 1869
metadata.summary: This Act corrects a clerical error in Act No. VIII of 1863 regarding the confinement of prisoners. It amends the phrase 'be situate' within the original legislation to ensure accuracy.

name: ACT No. XXV оf 1869

metadata.title: An Act to provide Rules for the manufacture, storing and sale of Alimentary Salt in the North-Western Provinces, the Panjdb, Oudh and the Central Provinces, aud for other purposes
metadata.summary: This Act establishes rules for the manufacture, storing, and sale of alimentary salt in specific territories including the North-Western Provinces, Punjab, Oudh, and the Central Provinces. It also empowers the Local Government to levy duties on manufactured salt and prescribe rules for collecting such duties.

name: ACT No. XXIII of 1869

metadata.title: Act No. XXIII of 1869
metadata.summary: This Act enhances the duties leviable under the Indian Income Tax Act. It was promulgated by the Governor General of India on November 26, 1869, and came into operation on December 1, 1869.

name: The Garo Hills Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Garo Hills Act, 1869
metadata.repeals: Act No. VI of 1835 (so far as it relates to the Khasi Hills)
metadata.summary: This Act removes the Garo Hills territory from the jurisdiction of courts established under general Regulations and Acts. It provides for the administration of civil and criminal justice, as well as revenue collection, within the said territory by officers appointed by the Lieutenant-Governor of Bengal.

name: The Volunteers Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Indian Volunteers' Act, 1869
metadata.repeals: Act No. XXIII of 1857
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the good order and discipline of Volunteer Corps in India. It also invests members with certain powers and establishes rules regarding courts martial, retirement, and the delivery of government arms.

name: ACT No. XIX Of 1869

metadata.title: An Act to facilitate administration to the estates of deceased British subjects in the Hyderabad Assigned Districts
metadata.summary: This Act was passed to facilitate the administration of estates belonging to deceased British subjects located in the Hyderabad Assigned Districts. It received the assent of the Governor General on September 3, 1869, and was promulgated for general information.

name: The General Stamp Act, 1869

metadata.title: The General Stamp Act, 1869
metadata.summary: This Act imposes stamp duties on various instruments within British India. It defines the extent of the Act, repeals previous enactments, and provides interpretations for key legal terms used throughout the legislation.

name: ACT No. XVII оf 1869

metadata.title: An Act to shorten the time for landing cargo
metadata.amends: The Consolidated Customs' Act (No. VI of 1863)
metadata.repeals: Sections LII, LIII and LIV of the said Act
metadata.summary: This Act shortens the period allowed for importing goods to land cargo from fifteen working days to a shorter duration appointed by the Local Government. It substitutes specific sections of the Consolidated Customs' Act, 1863, to implement these new time limits and procedures for carrying goods to the Custom House.

name: The Bhutan Dvars Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Bhutén Dvdrs Act, 1869
metadata.summary: This Act excludes ordinary Civil Courts from hearing suits regarding land, revenue, and rent in the territory known as the Bhutén Dvdrs. It empowers appointed officers to exercise jurisdiction over these matters and validates certain rules made by the Lieutenant-Governor of Bengal.

name: The Prisoners' Testimony Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Prisoners' Testimony Act, 1869
metadata.summary: This Act provides facilities for obtaining the evidence and appearance of prisoners in court. It also establishes procedures for serving legal process upon prisoners.

name: The Civil Courts' Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Bombay Civil Courts' Act, 1869
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to District and Subordinate Civil Courts in the Presidency of Bombay. It establishes the structure, jurisdiction, and appointment procedures for various judicial officers including District Judges and Subordinate Judges.

name: ACT No. X OF 1869

metadata.title: An Act to abolish the Police Superannuation Funds
metadata.repeals: The Police Superannuation Fund Act No. XXIV of 1859
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the Police Superannuation Funds that were previously established under earlier legislation. It mandates the transfer and payment of all sums held in these funds to the Government of India for general purposes.

name: The Land Customs (Madras and Bombay) Act, 1869

metadata.title: Land Customs (Madras and Bombay) Act, 1869
metadata.repeals: Act No. VI of 1844; Act No. XXIX of 1857
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the collection of land customs on goods passing by land into or out of foreign European settlements in the Madras and Bombay Presidencies. It repeals specific sections of earlier Acts regarding transit duties and Bombay land customs, while applying their unrepealed provisions to this new legislation.

name: The Income Tax Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Indian Income-tax Act, 1869
metadata.repeals: Act No. IX of 1868
metadata.summary: This Act imposes duties on income and profits arising from offices, property, professions, and trades. It repeals the previous Certificate Act of 1868 regarding professions and trades, except for taxes already due under that repealed act.

name: Act No. VII of 1869

metadata.title: An Act to give validity to certain Rules relating to Forests in British Burma
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain rules framed in 1865 regarding the management and preservation of Government Forests in British Burma. It also indemnifies officers and persons who acted under these rules prior to the passing of this Act, protecting them from legal proceedings.

name: The Articles of War Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Indian Articles of War
metadata.summary: This document outlines the Articles of War applicable to military personnel. It details various military offences, ranging from mutiny and desertion to specific crimes punishable by dismissal or disgraceful conduct.

name: The Divorce Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Indian Divorce Act
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to divorce and matrimonial causes specifically for persons professing the Christian religion in India. It confers jurisdiction upon certain High Courts and District Courts to grant relief, make decrees of dissolution of marriage, and handle cases of nullity under specified conditions.

name: The Rural Police (North-Western Provinces) Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Rural Police (North-Western Provinces) Act
metadata.repeals: Act No. II of 1865; Act No. II of 1866
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the maintenance of rural police in the North-Western Provinces and defines laws regarding village watchmen. It establishes three types of taxes leviable under the act: House Tax, Estate Tax, and a municipal cess on specific estate holders.

name: The Justices of the Peace Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Justices of the Peace Act, 1869
metadata.repeals: 33 Geo. III, Cap. 52
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the appointment of Justices of the Peace in British India. It empowers the Governor General and Local Governments to appoint qualified Covenanted Civil Servants and other British inhabitants as Justices of the Peace for various territories, including specific provisions for towns like Calcutta, Madras, and Bombay.

name: The Oudh Estates' Act, 1869

metadata.title: The Oudh Estates' Act, 1869
metadata.summary: This Act defines the rights of Taluqdars and others in certain estates in Oudh and regulates the succession to those estates. It clarifies legal terms such as 'Transfer', 'Will', and 'Estate' while establishing the permanent, heritable rights acquired by Taluqdars and Grantees under specific conditions.

name: The Panjab Tenancy Act, 1868

metadata.title: The Panjab Tenancy Act, 1868
metadata.repeals: Book Circular No. 83 of 1860
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to tenancy of land in the Punjab territories. It establishes provisions regarding occupancy rights, rent regulation, ejectment procedures, and tenant compensation for improvements.

name: ACT No. XXVI of 1868

metadata.title: An Act to enable Municipalities to provide for Lock-Hospitals
metadata.summary: This Act empowers Municipalities in British India to use municipal funds for maintaining lock-hospitals and preventing contagious venereal diseases. It authorizes these bodies to pay for the maintenance, medical treatment, lodging, clothing, food of detained women, and allowances for prostitutes residing within their limits, subject to Local Government sanction.

name: The Coorg Courts’ Act, 1868

metadata.title: The Coorg Courts' Act
metadata.summary: This Act defines the jurisdiction of Civil and Criminal Courts in the Province of Coorg. It establishes six grades of Civil Courts, ranging from the Court of the Sabahdar to the Court of the Judicial Commissioner, and outlines their respective powers to try suits based on the value of the subject matter.

name: ACT No. XXIV of 1868

metadata.title: An Act to prohibit the practice of inoculation in Kumaon and Garhwál
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the practice of inoculation with variolous matter in the districts of Kumaon and Garhwál. It imposes penalties on individuals who produce smallpox through inoculation or other means, as well as on those entering these districts shortly after being inoculated elsewhere without a medical certificate.

name: ACT No. XXIII of 1868

metadata.title: An Act to give validity to certain Abkdrt Rules in British Burma
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain rules regarding the sale of wine, beer, spirits, and intoxicating drugs in British Burma that were previously published by the Chief Commissioner. It grants these rules the force of law and indemnifies officers and farmers who acted under them before this Act was passed.

name: ACT No. XXII of 1868

metadata.title: An Act to bring the Mauza Kheria, in the District of Agra, under the operation of the general Regulations
metadata.summary: This Act annexes the Mauza Kheria in the District of Agra to the general regulations applicable to that district. It vests the administration of civil and criminal justice, as well as public revenue matters, in officers appointed by the Lieutenant Governor of the North-Western Provinces.

name: ACT No. XXI of 1868

metadata.title: An Act to appoint a Receiver of the property of the late Nawab of the Carnatic
metadata.summary: This Act appoints a Receiver to collect and administer the property of the late Nawab of the Carnatic, which was discovered in the District of Madras and territories of the Nizam. The Receiver is granted powers to take possession of moveable and immoveable property, sue for recovery, sell assets with High Court sanction, and represent the estate in legal proceedings.

name: ACT No. XX of 1868

metadata.title: An Act to give validity to the levy of certain Duties in Lucknow
metadata.summary: This Act validates the declaration and sanction made by the Chief Commissioner of Oudh regarding duties levied in Lucknow for the year 1865-66. It confirms that these declarations and rules were in force from May 9, 1865, to July 27, 1868, and indemnifies officers and farmers who acted under them.

name: The Oudh Rent Act, 1868

metadata.title: The Oudh Rent Act
metadata.summary: This document outlines the provisions of The Oudh Rent Act, covering preliminary definitions and the rights of landlords, under-proprietors, and tenants. It details regulations regarding rent enhancement, lease cancellations, compensation for improvements, and procedures for ejectment and distress for arrears.

name: ACT No. XVII of 1868

metadata.title: An Act to appoint «a Commission to enquire ito the failure of the Bank of Bombay
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a commission to investigate the causes and circumstances of the Bank of Bombay's inability to pay its debts and subsequent voluntary winding up. The Governor General of India in Council is empowered to appoint commissioners who will conduct a public inquiry, summon witnesses, examine evidence, and report their findings.

name: ACT No. XVI of 1868

metadata.title: The Principal Sadr Amins Act, 1868
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Principal Sadr Amins, Sadr Amins, and Munsifs in Bengal. It abolishes the office of Sadr Amin, alters officer designations, and provides for the jurisdiction of Subordinate Judges and Munsifs.

name: The High Court Fees’ Act, 1868

metadata.title: The High Court Fees Act, 1868
metadata.repeals: Sections one, three and four of Act No. XX of 1862; sections 13 of Act VIII of 1859
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the collection of fees in High Courts and Courts of Small Causes at Presidency Towns using stamps. It amends previous legislation regarding fee collection and repeals specific sections of earlier Acts.

name: The Contagious Diseases’ Act, 1868

metadata.title: The Indian Contagious Diseases' Act, 1868
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of certain contagious diseases by regulating the business of common prostitutes and brothel-keepers. It establishes a registration system managed by local government officers and prescribes penalties for unregistered individuals or those who fail to comply with notice requirements regarding changes in residence.

name: The King of Oudh’s Act, 1868

metadata.title: The King of Oudh's Act, 1868
metadata.repeals: Act VIII of 1862
metadata.summary: This Act exempts the King of Oudh from the jurisdiction of Civil Courts and prevents him from entering into contracts that create pecuniary obligations. It also stipulates that no legal suits or writs can be commenced against his person or property without the consent of the Governor General of India in Council.

name: ACT No. XI of 1868

metadata.title: An Act to exempt Timber and Woods from Import Duty
metadata.summary: This Act exempts timber and woods imported by sea into British India from customs duties. It overrides provisions in the Indian Customs Duties Act, 1867 to ensure no such charges are levied on these specific imports.

name: ACT No. IX of 1868

metadata.title: An Act for taxing Professions and Trades
metadata.repeals: Acts No. XXI of 1867 and No. XXIX of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act imposes a tax on persons exercising professions and trades in British India. It requires individuals with annual profits of 500 rupees or more to obtain an annual certificate and pay the specified duty in advance.

name: The Repealing Act, 1868

metadata.title: The Repealing Act, 1868
metadata.repeals: Various enactments listed in the schedule (e.g., Act I of 1834, Act I of 1835, etc.)
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Governor General of India in Council to expressly repeal certain enactments that had ceased to be in force or become unnecessary. It ensures that the repeal does not affect existing rights, titles, remedies, or established legal principles and jurisdictions.

name: The Panjab Appeals’ Act, 1868

metadata.title: The Panjab Appeals' Act, 1868
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to appeals and reviews of judgments in the courts established in the Panjab. It defines which courts are authorized to hear appeals, sets time limits for presenting memorandums of appeal, and outlines procedures for second appeals and reviews based on new evidence.

name: The Municipal Improvements' (North-Western Provinces) Act, 1868

metadata.title: The Municipal Improvements' (North-Western Provinces) Act, 1868
metadata.repeals: Act No. XXVI of 1850
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of Municipal Committees in the North-Western Provinces to manage local improvements, police, conservancy, and education. It also establishes powers for levying taxes, making rules and bye-laws, and addressing nuisances within designated towns.

name: ACT No. V oF 1868

metadata.title: An Act to enable the Governor of Bombay in Council to delegate to the Commissioner in Sind certain of the powers of a Local Government
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Governor of Bombay in Council to delegate specific local government powers to the Commissioner in Sind. It validates any acts performed by the Commissioner under this delegated authority as if they were done directly by the Governor.

name: ACT No. IV of 1868

metadata.title: An Act to exempt certain villages in the Bombay Presidency from the operation of the Regulations and Acts in force in that Presidency
metadata.repeals: Regulation XXIX of 1827; Act No. VI of 1842; Act No. III of 1868
metadata.summary: This Act exempts specific villages in the Bombay Presidency from certain Regulations and Acts previously applicable to that region. It achieves this by repealing sections of Regulation XXIX of 1827, Act No. VI of 1842, and Act No. III of 1868 as they relate to the listed villages.

name: ACT No. XII oF 1868

metadata.title: An Act to empower the Governor General of India in Council to suspend the operation of section 17 of Act No. XI of 1841
metadata.amends: An Act to consolidate and amend the Regulations concerning Military Courts of Requests for Native officers and soldiers in the service of the East India Company
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Governor General of India in Council to suspend the operation of section 17 of Act No. XI of 1841. The suspension applies to Military Courts of Requests for Native officers and soldiers beyond the limits of British India.

name: ACT No. III of 1868

metadata.title: The Local Government (Punjab) Act, 1868
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the Local Government of the Punjab to invest any person with the powers of an Assistant Commissioner or Tahsildar. It also validates decrees and proceedings passed by such persons before this Act was enacted.

name: ACT No. II of 1868

metadata.title: An Act to alter the rate of duty leviable on pepper exported from Cochin
metadata.summary: This Act alters the customs duty rate on pepper exported by sea from the British port of Cochin. It reduces the leviable duty to not exceed nine rupees per candy, aligning with recent reductions made by the Governments of Travancore and Cochin.

name: The General Clauses’ Act, 1868

metadata.title: The General Clauses Act, 1868
metadata.summary: This Act shortens the language used in Acts made by the Governor General of India in Council and establishes standard provisions for such legislation. It provides definitions for common legal terms like 'person', 'property', and 'year', and sets rules for interpreting gender, number, and time periods within statutes.

name: ACT NO. XXXVII of 1867

metadata.title: An Act for transferring appeals from the Court of the Financial Commissioner to the Court of the Judicial Commissioner of Oudh, and for other purposes
metadata.summary: This Act enables the transfer of appeals from the Court of the Financial Commissioner to the Court of the Judicial Commissioner in Oudh. It also establishes procedures for joint decision-making by both Commissioners and outlines the process for referring questions of law or fact to the High Court when differences of opinion arise.

name: ACT NO. XXXVI of 1867

metadata.title: Act No. XXXVI of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Governor General of India to correct an error in Act No. XVII of 1862 regarding the repeal of certain regulations. Specifically, it amends the Schedule of the 1862 Act to change the list of sections excepted from the repeal of Madras Regulation XI, 1816.

name: ACT NO. XXXV of 1867

metadata.title: An Act to provide temporary assistance to the Financial Commissioner of the Panjab
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of an Additional Financial Commissioner to assist in disposing of pending appeals in the Panjab. It outlines the procedure for transferring cases, the rules governing the additional commissioner's orders, and the duration of the Act's operation.

name: ACT NO. XXXIV of 1867

metadata.title: The Madras Salt Excise Act, 1867
metadata.repeals: Act No. XIX of 1866
metadata.summary: This Act repeals Act No. XIX of 1866 in districts where the Madras Salt Excise Act, 1867, is applicable. It renders the previous legislation and substituted sections inoperative to enable the local government to levy excise duties on salt manufactured or imported within those territories.

name: The Chief Commissioners’ Powers’ Act, 1867

metadata.title: The Chief Commissioners' Powers' Act
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Governor General of India in Council to delegate powers conferred on Local Government to Chief Commissioners of Oudh, the Central Provinces, and British Burmah. It validates acts done by these Chief Commissioners when exercising delegated powers as if they were done by the Governor General.

name: The Railway Servants’ Act, 1867

metadata.title: The Railway Servants' Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act extends provisions of the Indian Penal Code relating to public servants to persons employed by Railway Companies. It defines 'Railway Company' and deems railway officers and servants as public servants for specific sections of the Penal Code, while also expanding the definition of Government to include Railway Companies regarding legal remuneration.

name: ACT No. XXI of 1867

metadata.title: Act for the Licensing of Professions
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the licensing of professions and trades in British India. It establishes requirements for obtaining licenses, payment schedules, and the preparation of lists by local collectors.

name: ACT No. XX of 1867

metadata.title: The Act for facilitating the transshipment of goods imported into Calcutta, Madras and Bombay by steamers
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates the transshipment of goods imported into Calcutta, Madras, and Bombay by steamers without requiring immediate payment of duties. It aims to diminish delays caused by the necessity of paying duty or obtaining bonds before goods can be moved.

name: ACT NO. XXVIII of 1867

metadata.title: An Act to remove doubts as to the legality of certain sentences passed by tribunals, called Petty Sessions Courts, in the North-Western Provinces
metadata.summary: This Act addresses doubts regarding the legality of sentences passed by Petty Sessions Courts in the North-Western Provinces. It validates proceedings where multiple Magistrates sit together, establishing that such orders are valid if signed by those with the highest powers or any one when powers are equal.

name: ACT No. XXVII of 1867

metadata.title: Act No. XXVII of 1867
metadata.amends: Act No. VIII of 1859; Act No. XIV of 1865; Act No. XIX of 1865; Act No. XVIII of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act empowers Deputy Commissioners in the Central Provinces, Punjab, Oudh, and the Jhansi Division to distribute business among subordinate courts. It allows these officials to direct how court business is distributed regardless of whether the courts sit in the same place.

name: The Press and Registration of Books Act, 1867

metadata.title: An Act for the regulation of Printing-presses and Newspapers, for the preservation of copies of books printed in British India, and for the registration of such books
metadata.repeals: Act No. XI of 1835
metadata.summary: This Act regulates printing presses and periodicals containing news within British India. It mandates the preservation of three copies of every book printed or lithographed in the region and establishes a system for registering such books.

name: ACT No. XXIII of 1867

metadata.title: The Act for the suppression of murderous outrages in certain districts of the Panjab
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Lieutenant Governor of the Punjab to extend its provisions to specific parts of the territory. It establishes special procedures for dealing with fanatics who murder or attempt to murder servants of the Queen and other persons, addressing situations where general laws are deemed inadequate.

name: The Sarais Act, 1867

metadata.title: An Act for the regulation of Public Sardis and Puraos
metadata.summary: This Act was promulgated to regulate Public Sardis and Puraos in the Punjab region. It outlines specific duties for keepers, such as cleaning drains, repairing walls, and maintaining registers of animals or vehicles lodged at these facilities.

name: ACT No. XIX of 1867

metadata.title: Act No. XIX of 1867
metadata.repeals: Act No. X of 1863
metadata.summary: This Act provides further provisions for the administration of justice in the District of Darjiling. It was promulgated for general information after receiving assent on March 8, 1867.

name: The Jhansi Courts’ Act, 1867

metadata.title: The Jhansi Courts Act
metadata.summary: This Act defines the jurisdictions of various civil courts in the Jhansi and Allahabad divisions. It establishes seven grades of courts, ranging from the Court of the Tahsildar to the High Court, and specifies the monetary limits for suits each court can try.

name: ACT No. XV oF 1867

metadata.title: Act No. XV of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment, duties, and powers of Municipal Committees in towns within the Punjab. It grants the Lieutenant-Governor authority to extend provisions to specific committees, define town limits, impose taxes, and establish police forces.

name: ACT No. XVI of 1867

metadata.title: An Act to authorize the making of acting appointments to certain Judicial Offices
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the Governor General of India in Council or the Local Government to appoint persons to act as Judges in certain courts. It stipulates that such acting appointments include the power to appoint capable individuals to serve temporarily with the same powers and duties as permanent judges.

name: ACT No. XIV oF 1867

metadata.title: The Pandharti Tax Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the assessment of the Pandharti tax in specific districts of the Central Provinces for persons not engaged in agriculture. It sets limits on the tax rate and amount, authorizes the Chief Commissioner to make rules for collection and penalties, and provides for the recovery of arrears through distress.

name: The Bay of Bengal Coast-lights Act, 1867

metadata.title: An Act for the levy of enhanced Port-dues in the Ports of Moulmein and Bassein, and to provide for the establishment and maintenance of Coast Lights in the eastern part of the Bay of Bengal
metadata.amends: An Act No. XXXV of 1857 and An Act No. XXV of 1860
metadata.summary: This Act enhances port dues in the ports of Moulmein and Bassein to cover the expenses of maintaining existing and new coast lights. It also establishes specific rates for vessels based on their burden tonnage and the direction of their voyages within the Bay of Bengal region.

name: ACT No. XI oF 1867

metadata.title: Act No. XI of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Oriental Gas Company, Limited, to extend its operations from Calcutta and its environs to other places in British India. It amends Act No. V of 1857 by substituting references to specific local jurisdictions with broader terms applicable to British India.

name: The Presidency Jails’ Act, 1867

metadata.title: Act No. XII of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the custody of prisoners within the jurisdictions of Fort William in Bengal, Madras, and Bombay. It transfers custody from Sheriffs to officers appointed by the Local Government and directs writs for arrest to be executed by Police officers instead.

name: ACT No. X oF 1867

metadata.title: Act No. X of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act empowers Courts of Small Causes in the Mofussil to refer questions of law or usage arising before the hearing of suits or during the execution of decrees to the High Court. It applies to suits for amounts not exceeding five hundred Rupees as well as those exceeding that limit, allowing courts to stay proceedings or pass contingent decrees based on the High Court's opinion.

name: ACT No. IX oF 1867

metadata.title: Act No. IX of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act makes further provision for suits and other proceedings by or against the Comptoir D'Escompte of Paris. It amends Act No. VIII of 1864 to clarify that the term 'Chief Manager' includes any person acting in that capacity within the jurisdiction of the relevant court.

name: ACT No. VII oF 1867

metadata.title: An Act to reduce the pecuniary penalty for purchasing from Soldiers arms, ammunition, clothes and other articles
metadata.amends: An Act for punishing mutiny and desertion, and for the better regulation of the Army
metadata.summary: This Act reduces the maximum pecuniary penalty for purchasing arms, ammunition, clothes, and other articles from soldiers. It amends a previous Act by changing the penalty limit from twenty pounds to fifty rupees.

name: ACT No. VI oF 1867

metadata.title: An Act to enable the Lieutenant-Governor of the Panjab to alter the limits of existing Districts in any part of the Territories under his government
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Lieutenant-Governor of the Punjab to alter the limits of existing districts within his territories. It allows such changes to be made through notifications published in the Local Gazette from time to time.

name: ACT No. V oF 1867

metadata.title: Act No. V of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Indian Penal Code to the Straits' Settlement, which includes Prince of Wales' Island, Singapore, and Malacca. It specifies modifications for applying the Code to this region, including currency equivalencies and specific interpretations of certain sections regarding local laws.

name: ACT No. IV oF 1867

metadata.title: Act No. IV of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act enlarges the meaning of the word 'offence' in specific sections of the Indian Penal Code to include acts punishable by special or local laws. It also prescribes punishment for escaping from custody when security was required under Chapter XIX of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

name: ACT No. II oF 1867

metadata.title: The Prisoners' Removal Act, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the Local Government to remove prisoners sentenced by courts established by Royal Charter from one jail to another within the same territories. It also permits the removal of prisoners deemed of unsound mind to lunatic asylums or other safe custody places, with provisions for their eventual discharge if they recover their sanity.

name: The Public Gambling Act, 1867

metadata.title: Act No. III of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the punishment of public gambling and the keeping of common gaming-houses in specific territories including the North-Western Provinces, Panjab, Oudh, Central Provinces, and British Burmah. It defines terms such as 'common gaming-house' and outlines penalties for owners or occupiers who knowingly permit such houses to be used for gaming purposes.

name: ACT No. I oF 1867

metadata.title: Act No. I of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the levying of tolls on vessels navigating the River Ganges between Allahabad and Dinapore. It establishes specific rates for steamers, flats, and boats based on their burden or percentage thereof, and outlines procedures for collecting these fees.

name: The Trustees and Mortgagees' Powers' Act, 1866

metadata.title: The Trustees and Mortgagees' Powers Act, 1866
metadata.summary: This Act grants trustees and mortgagees certain powers commonly found in settlements, mortgages, and wills under English law. It aims to simplify legal instruments by making these powers incident to estates rather than requiring explicit insertion in every document, while also relieving trustees of unnecessary burdens.

name: The Trustee Act, 1866

metadata.title: The Indian Trustee Act, 1866
metadata.repeals: Act XXIV of 1841; Act No. XIV of 1852
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the conveyance and transfer of property in British India vested in mortgagees and trustees. It applies English law principles to cases involving moveable and immoveable property where such laws are applicable.

name: ACT No. XXIX of 1866

metadata.title: An Act to enlarge the jurisdiction of the Courts of Requests in the Settlement of Prince of Wales' Island, Singapore and Malacca
metadata.summary: This Act enlarges the jurisdiction of Courts of Requests in the Settlement of Prince of Wales' Island, Singapore, and Malacca to cover suits where the disputed amount does not exceed fifty dollars. It authorizes these courts to try cases for debt recovery and against inhabitants within this monetary limit. The legislation also outlines procedures for appointing bailiffs, issuing distress warrants, seizing goods, and selling them to satisfy rent arrears.

name: The Oudh Sub-Settlement Act, 1866

metadata.title: The Oudh Sub-Settlement Act, 1866
metadata.summary: This Act legalizes rules made by the Chief Commissioner of Oudh regarding subordinate proprietors' claims in territories under his administration. It grants these rules the force of law and repeals any inconsistent existing Acts, Regulations, or Rules.

name: ACT No. XXV of 1866

metadata.title: An Act to transfer to the Government of India certain securities deposited in the High Courts of Judicature at Fort William, Madras and Bombay and in the Supreme Court of the Straits' Settlement, and the proceeds of certain estates in the charge of the Administrator General of Bengal
metadata.summary: This Act transfers certain securities and sums of money deposited in specific High Courts and the Supreme Court of the Straits' Settlement to the Government of India if they have remained unclaimed for twenty years or more. It also transfers the net proceeds of estates administered under the Supreme Court of the Straits' Settlement or in the charge of the Administrator General of Bengal if they have been in custody for fifteen years or more without claim.

name: ACT No. XXIII of 1866

metadata.title: An Act to correct clerical errors in the Letters Patent for the High Court of Judicature for the Presidency of Bombay
metadata.amends: Letters Patent for the High Court of Judicature for the Presidency of Bombay
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Governor-General of India in Council to correct clerical errors found in Section 22 of the Letters Patent for the High Court of Judicature for the Presidency of Bombay. It substitutes a corrected version of the section regarding the court's ordinary original criminal jurisdiction.

name: The Marriage Act, 1866

metadata.title: The Indian Marriage Act, 1865 (Extension)
