metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Indian Marriage Act, 1865 to specific regions including the Hyderabad Assigned Districts and certain Cantonments. The extension applies specifically to Christian British subjects within these designated areas.

name: The Native Converts’ Marriage Dissolution Act, 1866

metadata.title: The Native Converts' Marriage Dissolution Act, 1866
metadata.summary: This Act legalizes the dissolution of marriages for native converts to Christianity under specific circumstances. It applies when a husband or wife changes their religion to Christianity and is subsequently deserted or repudiated by their spouse for six consecutive months on religious grounds.

name: The Registration Act, 1866

metadata.title: The Indian Registration Act, 1866
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for the registration of documents relating to immovable property and other instruments. It defines the establishment of registry offices, the duties of registering officers, and the procedures for presenting, enforcing attendance of witnesses, and depositing wills.

name: ACT No. XIX of 1866

metadata.title: An Act to enhance the price of Salt manufactured and sold under the orders of the Governor of the Presidency of Fort Saint George in Council
metadata.repeals: Section XLIII of Act No. VI of 1844
metadata.summary: This Act enhances the price of salt manufactured and sold under the orders of the Governor of the Presidency of Fort Saint George in Council. It substitutes a new section to replace Section XLIII of Act No. VI of 1844, setting a specific price per weight unit for salt consumption within subordinate territories.

name: ACT No. XVI of 1866

metadata.title: Act No. XVI of 1866
metadata.amends: The High Courts' Criminal Procedure Amendment Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act relieves the Governor-General of India in Council from the duty of signing specific commissions mentioned in Sections 22 and 44 of the High Courts' Criminal Procedure Amendment Act, 1865. Instead, a seal inscribed with 'The Seal of the Governor-General of India in Council' is to be made and used by appointed persons to stamp these commissions, rendering them equally valid as if signed personally.

name: ACT No. XIII of 1866

metadata.title: An Act to exempt certain suits in Oude from the operation of the rules of Limitation in force in that Province
metadata.summary: This Act exempts certain suits in Oude relating to land from the standard rules of limitation applicable in that province. It specifically addresses when causes of action arise and allows for the revival of dismissed suits regarding tenures cognizable in Revenue Courts if the cause arose on or after February 13, 1844.

name: ACT No. XII of 1866

metadata.title: An Act to provide for the compulsory taking of rights to form and maintain private water-courses from public works of irrigation
metadata.summary: This Act provides the legal framework for the compulsory acquisition of rights to form and maintain private water-courses through lands situated between public irrigation works and private properties. It outlines the procedures for applicants to apply to a Canal Officer, including requirements for compensation and surveys, as well as the process for local inquiries and objections by interested parties.

name: The Public Museum Act, 1866

metadata.title: An Act to provide for the establishment of a Public Museum at Calcutta
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Public Museum in Calcutta to be known as the Indian Museum. It authorizes the construction of a building on the site of the Small Cause Court for collections, records, and offices related to archaeology, natural history, and the Geological Survey of India.

name: The Companies’ Act, 1866

metadata.title: The Indian Companies Act, 1866
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws relating to the incorporation, regulation, and winding-up of trading companies and other associations in British India. It establishes rules for forming companies, limiting member liability, and managing company affairs.

name: The Pleaders, Mookhtars and Revenue Agents’ Act, 1866

metadata.title: Act No. IX of 1866
metadata.amends: The Pleaders, Mookhtars and Revenue Agents' Act, 1865; Act No. XXIX of 1865
metadata.summary: This Act extends certain provisions of the Pleaders, Mookhtars and Revenue Agents' Act, 1865 to the Sudder Court of the North-Western Provinces. It grants the Sudder Court power to make rules regarding the admission and enrolment of pleaders and mookhtars, as well as their suspension and dismissal.

name: ACT No. VII of 1866

metadata.title: Act No. VII of 1866
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of Act No. XXIII of 1840 to the Court of Judicature of Prince of Wales' Island, Singapore, and Malacca. It allows for the execution of legal process issued by authorities in the Mofussil within these specific jurisdictions under certain conditions.

name: ACT No. V of 1866

metadata.title: The Bills of Exchange Act, 1866
metadata.summary: This Act provides a summary procedure for the recovery of money due on dishonoured Bills of Exchange, Hundis, and Promissory Notes in British India. It amends existing laws to remedy inconveniences felt by persons engaged in trade and establishes specific rules for suits commenced after May 1, 1866.

name: ACT No. III of 1866

metadata.title: An Act to confer certain increased powers on the Registrars of the Recorders' Courts in British Burmah, and for other purposes
metadata.summary: This Act grants increased powers to Registrars of Recorders' Courts in British Burmah, specifically allowing them to make orders and receive evidence in the absence of a Recorder. It also empowers Registrars to administer oaths and affidavits in suits pending under the relevant court establishment act.

name: NA- The Post-office Act, 1866

metadata.title: Act to amend the Indian Post-office Act, 1864
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Post-office Act, 1864 to address the recovery of customs duties paid by postal authorities. It stipulates that when a letter or parcel with payable customs duty is received from outside British India, such duty shall be recoverable in the same manner as postage under this Act.

name: ACT No. XXX of 1865

metadata.title: Act No. XXX or 1865
metadata.summary: This Act defines and sanctions the rules for rates charged by the Madras Irrigation and Canal Company for water supply purposes other than irrigation. It limits these charges to a maximum of one Rupee per four hundred cubic yards of water.

name: ACT No. XXVIII of 1865

metadata.title: An Act to provide for the more speedy liquidation of Insolvent Traders' Estates in Bombay
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the speedy liquidation of insolvent traders' estates in Bombay. It defines key terms such as 'Trader' and 'the Court', and outlines the procedures for creditors to initiate winding up proceedings when a trader is unable to pay debts.

name: ACT No. XXVII of 1865

metadata.title: Act XXV of 1865
metadata.summary: This Act provides temporary provisions for deciding appeals in the Punjab Districts before the Chief Court is established. It authorizes the Punjab Government to invest the Financial Commissioner with judicial powers to try appeals regarding land, rent, revenue, or produce.

name: ACT No. XXIV of 1865

metadata.title: An Act to give effect to certain Warrants of Attorney and Cognovits
metadata.summary: This Act validates Warrants of Attorney and Cognovits executed on or after July 1, 1862, in the High Court of Judicature at Fort William in Bengal. It ensures that judgments signed on these warrants are treated as valid as if they were signed in the former Supreme Court, including all related executions and proceedings.

name: The Pleaders, Mookhtars and Revenue Agents’ Act, 1865

metadata.title: The Pleaders, Mookhtars and Revenue Agents' Act, 1865
metadata.amends: law relating to Pleaders and Mookhtars
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to Pleaders and Mookhtars and provides rules for their qualification, admission, enrolment, suspension, and dismissal. It also addresses similar provisions for Revenue Agents.

name: The Punjab Court’s Act, 1865

metadata.title: The Punjab Courts' Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act defines the jurisdiction of the Courts of Judicature in the Punjab and its Dependencies. It establishes seven grades of courts, ranging from the Court of the Tahsildar to the Court of the Judicial Commissioner, and outlines their respective civil and criminal powers.

name: ACT No. XVI of 1865

metadata.title: An Act to remove doubts as to the jurisdiction of the Revenue Courts in the Province of Oude in suits relating to land, and to enlarge the period of limitation in such suits
metadata.summary: This Act clarifies the jurisdiction of Revenue Courts versus Civil Courts regarding land-related suits in the Province of Oude. It also extends the period of limitation for specific classes of suits within that province.

name: The Parsee Marriage and Divorce Act, 1865

metadata.title: The Parsee Marriage and Divorce Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to marriage and divorce among the Parsee community in British India. It establishes requirements for valid marriages, including prohibitions on consanguinity, age limits, and the necessity of solemnization by a Parsee Priest with witnesses. The legislation also mandates the registration of marriages, appoints Registrars, and prescribes penalties for bigamy and violations of marriage laws.

name: The Central Provinces Courts’ Act, 1865

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Courts' Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act defines the jurisdiction of civil courts in the Central Provinces and establishes eight specific grades of courts. It outlines the monetary limits for suits that each grade of court can try, ranging from Tahsildars to Judicial Commissioners, and sets time limits for filing appeals.

name: The Succession Act, 1865

metadata.title: The Indian Succession Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act constitutes the law for British India regarding intestate and testamentary succession. It covers topics such as domicile, consanguinity, distribution of property among heirs, and the execution and construction of wills.

name: The Arm’s Act Continuance Act, 1865

metadata.title: The Arms Act Continuance Act, 1865
metadata.repeals: Act No. XXXI of 1860
metadata.summary: This Act continues the provisions of Act No. XXXI of 1860 regarding the manufacture, importation, and sale of arms and ammunition. It extends the force of that previous Act until the first day of October 1866.

name: The Administrator-General's Act, 1865

metadata.title: The Administrator General's Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act exempts the estates of deceased officers and soldiers delivered to the Administrator-General of Bengal, Madras, or Bombay from specific fee provisions. It limits the percentage commission the Administrator-General can take on such property to three percent after preferential charges are paid.

name: ACT No. VIII of 1865

metadata.title: Act No. VIII of 1865
metadata.summary: This Act validates the imprisonment and detention of persons arrested under the process of the High Court of Judicature at Fort William in Bengal. It declares such arrests made before the passing of this Act to be valid as if they were made in accordance with the Code of Civil Procedure, while also indemnifying the Sheriff and others involved.

name: The Government Forests, Act, 1865

metadata.title: Act No. VII of 1865
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the Chief Commissioner and Local Governments to manage and preserve Government forests within their territories. It establishes rules for protecting growing trees, regulating stream usage for timber transport, and ensuring the safe custody of forest produce.

name: The Marriage Act, 1865

metadata.title: The Marriage Act, 1865
metadata.repeals: Act XXV of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the solemnization of marriages in India between persons professing the Christian religion. It outlines who may solemnize these marriages, including ordained clergy, ministers of specific churches, and licensed individuals.

name: The Carriers Act, 1865

metadata.title: The Carriers' Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act defines the rights and liabilities of common carriers regarding property delivered to them for transport. It establishes limits on carrier liability based on the value of goods and specifies conditions under which carriers can limit their responsibility or remain fully liable due to negligence.

name: The Rural Police Act,1865

metadata.title: Act No. II of 1865
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better maintenance of Rural Police in the Territories under the Government of the Lieutenant-Governor of the North-Western Provinces. It authorizes proprietors to assess and collect sums from occupants for police purposes and outlines procedures for abating assessments based on inability to pay.

name: The Acts and Regulation’s Extension Act, 1865

metadata.title: The Acts and Regulations Extension Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the Governor-General of India in Council and Lieutenant-Governors to extend certain Acts and Regulations to Non-Regulation Provinces. It provides the legal framework for issuing notifications to apply laws from parts of British India to territories under immediate administration or specific provincial governments.

name: Act No. XXVI of 1864

metadata.title: The Small Causes Act, 1864
metadata.summary: This Act defines the jurisdiction of Small Cause Courts in Punjab regarding civil actions involving sums not exceeding one thousand Rupees. It establishes specific conditions under which these courts can hear cases, including requirements for the cause of action to arise within local limits or for the defendant to reside and work there.

name: Act No. XXV of 1864

metadata.title: Act XIV of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act provides further provisions for the solemnization of marriages in India for persons professing the Christian religion. It extends certain regulations and acts to specific districts, including Jhansie, Jaloun, Lullutpore, Kumaon, and Gurhwal.

name: Act No. XXIV of 1864

metadata.title: The Rules for administration of Civil Justice
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Home Department for the Lieutenant-Governor of the North-Western Provinces to govern the administration of civil justice. They provide for the establishment of courts and the trial of suits and appeals by commissioners, Tehsildars, and other officials.

name: Act No. XXI of 1864

metadata.title: Act No. XXI of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act extends the jurisdiction of Magistrates of Police in Calcutta to punish certain offences summarily. It also establishes provisions for the education and maintenance of male minors under the care of the state within the Presidency of Bombay, assigning charges to the minor's estate or the Civil Court.

name: Act No. XX of 1864

metadata.title: Act No. XX of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act removes certain tracts of country in the district of Mirzapore from the jurisdiction of the Civil, Criminal, and Revenue Courts. It vests persons claiming charges within these removed tracts under the authority of the Lieutenant-Governor.

name: Act No. XVII of 1864

metadata.title: Act XVII of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to Official Trustees and applies certain words and expressions from previous legislation to settlements. It defines the roles of Official Trustees in Bengal, Madras, and Bombay, and outlines their appointment and remuneration.

name: Act No. XIX of 1864

metadata.title: Act No. XX of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act removes certain tracts of country in the district of Mirzapore from the jurisdiction of the Civil, Criminal, and Revenue Courts. It vests persons claiming charges within these removed tracts under the authority of the Lieutenant-Governor.

name: Act No. XXII of 1864 The Cantonments Act, 1864

metadata.title: The Magistrates' Act, 1864
metadata.summary: This Act defines the powers of Magistrates in Calcutta to take cognizance of offences without a complaint and issue warrants. It extends the application of certain sections of the Code of Criminal Procedure to specific military cantonments and outlines procedures for extending the Act to other towns and ports.

name: Act No. XVIII of 1864

metadata.title: The Municipal Committee Act, 1864
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment of a Municipal Committee for the City of Lucknow. It establishes the committee's composition, including ex-officio and elected non-official members, and outlines their powers regarding street repair, lighting, drainage, and general city improvement.

name: Act No. XVI of 1864

metadata.title: The Act to amend Act VIII of 1851 (for enabling Government to levy Tolls on Public Roads and Bridges)
metadata.amends: Act VIII of 1851 (for enabling Government to levy Tolls on Public Roads and Bridges)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the provisions of Act VIII of 1851 regarding the levying of tolls on public roads and bridges. It updates the rates of toll specified in the schedule to replace those in the previous act, while allowing for pending proceedings under the old rates to continue.

name: Act No. XIV of 1864

metadata.title: The Act No. XIV of 1861
metadata.summary: This Act validates orders and proceedings made by the Joint Judge of the Konkan between February 1863 and July 1863, retroactively treating consent granted in July as if it were given earlier. It removes certain tracts of country in the Mirzapore district from the jurisdiction of local courts and vests their administration under the North-Western Provinces.

name: Act No. XIII of 1864

metadata.title: The Emigration Act, 1864
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws relating to the emigration of Native Laborers from British India. It defines specific terms such as 'emigrate' and 'emigrant', outlines which contracts are valid, and establishes regulations regarding the ports from which emigration is lawful.

name: Act No. XII of 1864

metadata.title: Act No. XII of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act gives further effect to the provisions of Act IV of 1863 regarding a Treaty between the Viceroy and Governor-General of India. It consolidates and amends laws relating to the administration of the Department of Sea Customs in India.

name: Act No. XI of 1864

metadata.title: Act No. XI of 1864
metadata.repeals: Bengal Code for receiving, trying, and deciding suits or complaints declared cognizable in the Courts of Dewanny Adawlut established in the several Zillahs, and in the Cities of Patna, Dacca, and Moorshedabad; Bengal Code For the appointment of the Hindoo and Mahomedan Law Officers of the Civil and Criminal Courts of Judicature; Bengal Code For the appointment of the Cazee-ool-Cozaat, or Head Cazee of Bengal, Behar, and Orissa
metadata.summary: This Act repeals specific sections of the Bengal Code related to suits in Dewanny Adawlut courts and the appointment of Hindoo and Mahomedan law officers. It was promulgated by the Governor-General of India in Council on March 18, 1864.

name: Act No. X of 1864

metadata.title: Act No. X or 1864
metadata.repeals: Act VIII of 1861
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of Act XXI of 1856 regarding Abkaree Revenue to any province or place under the immediate administration of the Governor-General of India in Council. It also repeals Act VIII of 1861, which was enacted for the levy of Port-dues in the Port of Amherst.

name: Act No. VIII of 1864

metadata.title: The Act No. VII of 1864
metadata.amends: Act XIV of 1843; Act XXXVI of 1855; Act XX of 1862; Act XIX of 1862
metadata.repeals: So much of Section XII of Act XIV of 1843
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the importation and manufacture of alimentary salt in the Territories administered by the Chief Commissioner of the Central Provinces. It extends specific provisions from earlier Acts regarding customs duties, the manufacture of contraband salt, and the powers of officers to search for such salt.

name: Act No. VII of 1864

metadata.title: The Act No. VII of 1864
metadata.amends: Act XIV of 1843; Act XXXVI of 1855; Act XX of 1862; Act XIX of 1862
metadata.repeals: So much of Sections XII of Act XIV of 1843, Sections III, IV, V, VI, VII, IX, X, C, XII and certain provisions of Act XXXVI of 1855, and Section II of Act XX of 1862
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the importation and manufacture of alimentary salt in the Territories administered by the Chief Commissioner of the Central Provinces. It repeals specific sections of earlier Acts regarding salt duties and extends provisions from other legislation to these territories.

name: Act No. IX of 1864

metadata.title: Act No. X or 1864
metadata.repeals: Act VIII of 1861
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of Act XXI of 1856 regarding Abkaree Revenue to any province or place under the immediate administration of the Governor-General of India in Council. It also repeals Act VIII of 1861, which was enacted for the levy of Port-dues in the Port of Amherst.

name: Act No. VI of 1864

metadata.title: The Whipping Act, 1864
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Code of Civil Procedure to the Province of Scinde. It validates orders and decisions passed by courts in Scinde under that code prior to a specific date, even without the sanction of the Governor-General of India in Council.

name: Act No. V of 1864

metadata.title: The Whipping Act, 1864
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Code of Civil Procedure to the Province of Scinde. It validates orders and decisions passed by courts in Scinde under that code prior to a specific date, even without the sanction of the Governor-General of India in Council.

name: Act No. IV of 1864

metadata.title: Act No. IV of 1864
metadata.amends: The Court of Small Causes Act, 1861
metadata.summary: This Act validates the proceedings of the Court of Small Causes in Karachi, which was constituted in 1863. It grants validity to orders and decisions passed by this court before November 28, 1863, removing doubts regarding their legal standing.

name: Act No. III of 1864

metadata.title: The Criminal Procedure Code (Aden) Act, No. VII of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act grants the Government specific powers regarding foreigners residing or sojourning in British India. It establishes rules for jury composition in cases involving European or American accused persons and outlines procedures for maintaining lists of qualified jurors.

name: Act No. II of 1864

metadata.title: The Act to bring the Jagheers of Poorwah and Khuddee, in the District of Banda, under the operation of the General Regulations
metadata.summary: This Act brings the Jagheers of Poorwah and Khuddee in the District of Banda under the administration of the General Regulations. It ensures that these lands are administered on the same system as the rest of the district, granting full force to existing laws regarding internal administration, civil and criminal justice, revenue settlement, and realization.

name: Act No. I of 1864

metadata.title: The Act to bring the Jagheers of Poorwah and Khuddee, in the District of Banda, under the operation of the General Regulations
metadata.summary: This Act brings the Jagheers of Poorwah and Khuddee in the District of Banda under the administration of the General Regulations. It ensures that these lands are administered on the same system as the rest of the district, extending full force to existing laws regarding internal administration, civil and criminal justice, revenue settlement, and realization.

name: NA- The Indus Vessels Act, 1863

metadata.title: The Indus Vessels (Amendment) Act, 1942
metadata.repeals: Sections 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 14 of the Indus Vessels Act, 1863
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indus Vessels Act, 1863 by omitting specific words from its long title and preamble regarding pilotage fees. It also repeals several sections of the original 1863 Act.

name: NA- The Religious Endowments Act, 1863

metadata.title: The Religious Endowments (Amendment) Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Religious Endowments Act of 1863 to clarify definitions regarding civil courts and religious establishments. It specifically addresses jurisdiction over mosques, temples, and other religious institutions where committees have been appointed.

name: NA- The Consolidated Customs’ Act, 1863

metadata.title: Consolidated Customs' Act Amendment Act
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 132 of the Consolidated Customs' Act (No. VI of 1863) regarding refunds on goods not shipped or relanded. It extends the time limit for making applications to re-land goods or giving notice of non-shipment from before departure to within three clear working days after the vessel leaves the port.

name: NA- Act XXV of 1863

metadata.title: An Act to amend the Law relating to the custody of prisoners within the local limits of the original jurisdiction of Her Majesty's High Court of Judicature at Fort William in Bengal
metadata.amends: An Act to amend the Law relating to the custody of prisoners within the local limits of the original jurisdiction of Her Majesty's High Court of Judicature at Fort William in Bengal
metadata.repeals: Act XVIII of 1862; Act XXV of 1863
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the custody of prisoners within the jurisdiction of the High Court at Fort William in Bengal. It transfers custody from the Sheriff of Calcutta to an Officer appointed by the Government of Bengal, specifically a Superintendent of the Presidency Jail.

name: NA- The Stamp Duties Act, 1862

metadata.title: An Act to amend Act No. X of 1862 (to consolidate and amend the Law relating to Stamp Duties)
metadata.amends: Act No. X of 1862 (to consolidate and amend the Law relating to Stamp Duties)
metadata.repeals: Section 33 of Act No. X of 1862
metadata.summary: This Act amends Act No. X of 1862, which consolidates and amends the law relating to Stamp Duties. It repeals Section 33 of the said Act and grants the Governor-General in Council powers to reduce or remit stamp duties on various deeds and instruments within the specified territories.

name: NA-The Stage-Carriages Act, 1861

metadata.title: Act No. XVI of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stage Carriages Act of 1861 to extend its provisions to carriages drawn by camels or oxen, which were previously excluded. It also clarifies that the amended Act applies to the whole of British India unless superseded by local laws.

name: NA-The Police Act, 1861

metadata.title: The Police Act, 1861 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Act, 1861 to clarify the status of police officers suspended from office and their continued subject to discipline. It also provides provisions for declaring areas as disturbed or dangerous and authorizes the employment of additional police forces in such regions at the expense of local inhabitants.

name: NA- Act No. XXXI of 1861

metadata.title: Act No. XXXII of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act amends Act No. XXXI of 1861 regarding the manufacture of saltpetre and the sale of salt derived from its refinement. It was passed by the Governor General in Council and received assent on July 18, 1867.

name: NA- ACT XXIX of 1861

metadata.title: Act XXVI of 1865
metadata.repeals: Article 83 of Act XXIX of 1861
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Articles of War for Native Officers and Soldiers in Her Majesty's Indian Army. It repeals Article 83 of Act XXIX of 1861 and replaces it with new provisions regarding minor punishments for light offences, specifying that such punishments shall be awarded without a Court Martial intervention.

name: NA- The Code of Criminal Procedure Act, 1861

metadata.title: The High Courts' Criminal Procedure Amendment Act, 1865
metadata.amends: The High Courts' Criminal Procedure Act, 1862
metadata.summary: This Act amends the procedure for Her Majesty's High Courts in Bengal, Madras, and Bombay regarding their original criminal jurisdiction. It provides mechanisms for exercising this jurisdiction outside Presidency Towns and establishes specific rules for recording charges, amendments to those charges, and the handling of examinations of witnesses.

name: NA- The Currency Act, 1861

metadata.title: The Currency Act Amendment Act, 1866
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Currency Act of 1861 to regulate the exchange of silver bullion and foreign coin for government promissory notes. It establishes a process where tenderers receive certificates acknowledging receipt and value after melting costs, with an interval before note issuance.

name: NA- The Societies Registration Act,1860

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to provide powers for the Governor of West Pakistan regarding society governance. It specifically allows the dissolution of a governing body and the reconstitution of such body under specified conditions.

name: NA- Act No. VIII of 1860

metadata.title: The Indian Telegraph Act, 1876
metadata.repeals: Act No. XXXIV of 1854; Act No. VIII of 1860
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the establishment and management of telegraphs in British India. It repeals previous acts from 1854 and 1860 while saving existing licenses and rules.

name: NA- Act XLII of 1860

metadata.title: The Courts of Small Causes Act, 1865
metadata.repeals: Act XLII of 1860; Act XII of 1861
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to Courts of Small Causes beyond the local limits of ordinary original Civil jurisdiction of High Courts. It repeals previous acts from 1860 and 1861, defines the constitution and jurisdiction of these courts, and specifies the types of suits they can hear, such as claims for money or rent not exceeding five hundred Rupees.

name: NA-The Workman's Breach of Contract Act, 1859

metadata.title: The Workman's Breach of Contract (Amendment) Act, 1920
metadata.amends: The Workman's Breach of Contract Act, 1859
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Workman's Breach of Contract Act, 1859 to further regulate complaints regarding workmen neglecting contracts. It grants magistrates discretion to order repayment of money advanced or performance of work within specific periods and conditions.

name: NA- ACT No. VII oF 1859

metadata.title: Act No. XXIII of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to Customs duties on goods imported by sea, specifically addressing duties on iron, porter, ale, beer, cider, and other similar fermented liquors. It consolidates provisions regarding these items in conformity with the provisions of Act VI of 1863.

name: NA- Act No. VIII of 1859

metadata.title: An Act to amend the procedure of the High Court of Judicature for the North-Western Provinces of the Presidency of Fort William
metadata.summary: This Act amends the procedural rules for the High Court of Judicature in the North-Western Provinces regarding its original criminal, civil, intestate, and testamentary jurisdictions. It establishes specific protocols for recording charges, handling amendments to those charges, providing copies to the accused, and determining the places where trials involving European British subjects shall be held.

name: NA- Act No. I of 1859

metadata.title: The Merchant Shipping Act, 1875
metadata.summary: This Act provides for investigations into losses of ships and charges against masters, mates, or engineers. It outlines the powers of special courts to investigate such incidents and the procedures for suspending or cancelling certificates granted by local governments.

name: NA- Act No. XXXVI of 1858

metadata.title: Act No. XVIII of 1886
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lunatic Asylum Act of 1858 to improve regulations regarding the detention and care of supposed lunatics. It introduces new sections establishing public asylums, defining procedures for sending lunatics to distant asylums, and empowering the Governor-General in Council to appoint commissioners and authorize specific asylum locations.

name: NA-The Calcutta University Act, 1857

metadata.title: The Calcutta University Act, 1921
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to the Calcutta University by substituting specific titles for government officials and bodies within the university's governing structure. It also repeals certain sections of the Indian Universities Act, 1904, as specified in the Schedule.

name: NA- The Opium Act, 1857

metadata.title: The Opium Act, 1857 (Amendment) Act, 1925
metadata.repeals: U.P. Act XXVII of 1925
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Opium Act, 1857 by substituting references to 'the Board of Revenue' with 'Government' and replacing various officer designations like 'Sub-Deputy Agents' with 'district opium officers'. It also repeals a specific United Provinces Act related to the Opium Act, 1857.

name: The Fatal Accidents Act, 1855

metadata.title: Act for Compensation
metadata.summary: This Act provides compensation to families for the loss caused by the death of a person resulting from a wrongful act, neglect, or default. It applies when such an act would have constituted a felony or other crime if death had not ensued.

name: NA- The Railways Act, 1854

metadata.title: The Railway Amendment Act, 1871
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Railway Act of 1854 to further regulate railways in India. It defines terms related to railways and establishes penalties for cattle trespassing, wilfully driving cattle on fenced lines, and endangering safety by disobeying rules or acting rashly.

name: NA- Act No. XVII of 1854

metadata.title: The Indian Post Office Act, 1866
metadata.repeals: Act No. XVII of 1854
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding the management of the Post Office and regulates postage duties. It also establishes punishments for various offences committed against the Post Office.

name: NA- The Indian Naturalization Act, 1852

metadata.title: Indian Naturalization (Amendment) Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Naturalization Act of 1852 to address specific legal definitions and procedures. It includes provisions regarding unlawful trading during wars and clarifies that certain examinations are deemed judicial proceedings.

name: NA- The Tolls Act, 1851

metadata.title: Act No. XV of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act amends the provisions of Act VIII of 1851 regarding the levy of tolls on public roads and bridges. It updates the rates specified in the schedule to replace those in the earlier act, except for pending proceedings or previously levied tolls.

name: NA- Act No. XIV of 1851

metadata.title: An Act for amending the laws for collecting a Revenue of Excise on Spirituous Liquors and Intoxicating Drugs in the Settlement of Prince of Wales' Island, Singapore and Malacca
metadata.amends: An Act for consolidating the laws for collecting a Revenue of Excise on Spirituous Liquors and Intoxicating Drugs in the Settlement of Prince of Wales' Island, Singapore and Malacca (Act No. XIV of 1851)
metadata.repeals: An Act for consolidating the laws for collecting a Revenue of Excise on Spirituous Liquors and Intoxicating Drugs in the Settlement of Prince of Wales' Island, Singapore and Malacca (Act No. XIV of 1851)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the laws regarding the collection of excise revenue on opium, spirituous liquors, and intoxicating drugs in the Settlement of Prince of Wales' Island, Singapore, and Malacca. It repeals the previous Act of 1851 (except for its own repeals) and establishes exclusive rights for farmers to manufacture and retail specific goods under government license.

name: The Caste Disabilities Removal Act, 1850

metadata.title: The Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act
metadata.summary: This Act amends Hindu Law to remove disabilities regarding inheritance for certain classes of heirs. It specifically excludes persons from being deprived of inheritance rights due to disease, deformity, or physical and mental defects.

name: NA- Act No. XXI of 1848

metadata.title: Act No. VIII of 1867
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law regarding horse-keeping in India. It was received by the Governor General on February 1867 and promulgated for general information.

name: NA- Act VI of 1848

metadata.title: The Indian Customs Duties Act, 1865
metadata.amends: The Consolidated Customs Act; Act VII of 1859; Act XXIII of 1859; Act X of 1860; Act XI of 1862; Act XXIII of 1862; Act XXIII of 1864
metadata.summary: This Act amends the laws relating to customs duties on goods imported and exported by sea in British India. It specifies new duty rates for various items listed in Schedules A and B, effective from April 1, 1865, with specific provisions for saltpetre taking effect earlier.

name: NA- Act No. X of 1841

metadata.title: Act VII of 1891
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Merchant Shipping Act of 1841 to update regulations regarding the measurement and ascertainment of tonnage for ships and vessels. It introduces specific requirements for survey certificates, modifies references to government bodies, and repeals certain outdated terms related to the East India Company.

name: NA- Act VI of 1835

metadata.title: The Banki Act, 1881
metadata.repeals: The Banka Tass Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act annexes the territory comprising the Mahal of Benki to the District of Katak. It repeals the Banka Tass Act, 1881, and stipulates that all enactments in force in the said territory shall cease to be a portion of a scheduled district on April 1, 1882.

name: NA- ACT IV of 1835

metadata.title: An Act to define and amend the Law relating to Intestate Succession among the Parsees
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law regarding intestate succession specifically for Parsees in British India. It establishes rules for dividing property among widows, children, parents, and other relatives based on gender and degree of relationship.

name: NA- ACT III of 1835

metadata.title: An Act to amend the Law of Partnership in India
metadata.summary: This Act clarifies that receiving a share of profits or interest does not automatically make a lender, servant, agent, widow, child, or seller of good-will a partner. It specifically defines conditions under which advances for loans or remuneration by profit shares do not constitute partnership liability.

name: NA- Act I of 1835

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1877
metadata.summary: This document outlines the Code of Civil Procedure enacted in 1877, establishing rules for civil suits within British India. It details provisions regarding court jurisdiction, the framing and institution of suits, party joinder, and the issuance and service of summons.

name: NA- Bengal Regulation VII of 1828

metadata.title: The Benares Family Domains Act, 1881
metadata.summary: This Act amends Bengal Regulation VII of 1828 to define the authority of the Rajah of Benares in the Mahdls. It also adds provisions allowing the Maharaja to delegate powers and modifies references to various government bodies within the North-Western Provinces.

name: Draft-The Audit Oversight Board (Appointment and Functions of Chief Executive Officer) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Audit Oversight Board (Appointment and Functions of Chief Executive Officer) Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: This document publishes a draft of rules governing the appointment and functions of the Chief Executive Officer of the Audit Oversight Board. It establishes eligibility criteria, selection procedures, term limits, remuneration, and specific disqualifications for the position.

name: S. R. O. 1324(I)/23 Pemra Eligibility Criteria and Bidding Procedure for Grant of Fm Radio Licences in The Merged Districts (Ex-Fata) Of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province

metadata.title: PEMRA Eligibility Criteria and Bidding Procedure for Grant of FM Radio Licences in Merged Districts (Ex-FATA) of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province Regulations 2023
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes the eligibility criteria and bidding procedures for granting FM radio licences in the Merged Districts (formerly Ex-FATA) of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. It defines key terms, outlines who may apply, specifies ineligibility conditions, and lists the required documents for applicants seeking a ten-year licence.

name: The Akhuwat Institute Kasur Act, 2026

metadata.title: Akhuwat Institute Kasur Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Akhuwat Institute Kasur as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its powers to provide education, conduct research, and manage property.

name: Draft-The Unlisted Companies (Buy-Back of Shares) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The Unlisted Companies (Buy-Back of Shares) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the buy-back of shares by unlisted public and private companies in Pakistan. They outline eligibility criteria, such as having distributable profits and obtaining member approval, along with specific procedures for recommending and executing share purchases.

name: Draft-The Issuance of Convertible Debt Securities through Right Offer Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: Issuance of Convertible Debt Securities through Right Offer Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: This document publishes draft regulations governing the issuance of convertible debt securities by listed companies through a right offer mechanism. It outlines specific conditions, procedural requirements, and definitions applicable to such issuances under the Securities Act, 2015 and Companies Act, 2017.

name: The PEMRA (Landing Rights Permission) Regulations, 2016 as Amended upto 2021

metadata.title: Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Landing Rights Permission) Regulations, 2016 as amended upto 2021
metadata.amends: Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Landing Rights Permission) Regulations, 2016 as amended in 2019
metadata.summary: This notification amends the PEMRA Landing Rights Permission Regulations, 2016. It substitutes the LRP fee with a Zero Tariff for two years starting from August 5, 2021, while keeping the annual fee unchanged.

name: The Self-Regulatory Organizations (Registration) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: Self-Regulatory Organizations (Registration) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for registering self-regulatory organizations with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. They outline the application process, required documents, conditions for registration validity, and procedures for renewal.

name: The Type Approval Technical Standards Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: Type Approval Technical Standards Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the technical standards and procedures for obtaining type approval for terminal equipment in Pakistan. They mandate compliance with specific international standards regarding safety, interoperability, and identity codes for devices imported or sold in the country.

name: The Cellular Mobile Network Quality of Service (QoS) Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: Cellular Mobile Network Quality of Service (QoS) Regulations, 2021
metadata.repeals: GPRS/EDGE Service (QoS) Standards Regulations, 2010; Cellular Mobile Network Quality of Service Regulations 2011; Cellular Mobile Network Quality of Service (Amendments) Regulations 2012
metadata.summary: These regulations establish minimum quality of service standards for cellular mobile communication and next generation mobile services in Pakistan. They apply to all licensees regarding network coverage, voice, SMS, and mobile broadband services, requiring specific measurement, reporting, and record-keeping. The document also defines key technical terms and sets benchmarks for parameters like network accessibility and call setup success rates.

name: The Pakistan Single Window (Deputation/ Secondment of Civil Servants) Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: The Pakistan Single Window (Deputation/ Secondment of Civil Servants) Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the deputation and secondment of civil servants from Pakistan Customs and OGAS to the Pakistan Single Window Company. They define key roles, outline selection criteria based on merit, specify terms of service including allowances, and set procedures for performance monitoring and repatriation.

name: The Mobile Device Manufacturing (MDM) Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: Mobile Device Manufacturing (MDM) Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for granting authorization to manufacture mobile devices in Pakistan under the Pakistan Telecommunication (Re-organization) Act, 1996. They outline the application procedure, eligibility criteria, obligations of the authorization holder regarding safety standards and reporting, and the duration of the authorization.

name: The PEMRA Registration / Accreditation of Television Audience Measurement (TAM)/Rating Service Regulations-2018 as amended in 2019

metadata.title: PEMRA Registration / Accreditation of Television Audience Measurement (TAM)/Rating Service Regulations-2018 as amended in 2019
metadata.amends: PEMRA Registration / Accreditation of Television Audience Measurement (TAM)/Rating Service Regulations-2018
metadata.summary: This notification amends the PEMRA Registration / Accreditation of Television Audience Measurement (TAM)/Rating Service Regulations-2018. It specifically introduces a fee for changes in directors, management, or transfer of shares.

name: Draft- The Professional Clearing Members Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: The Professional Clearing Members Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: This document publishes draft regulations proposed by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan regarding professional clearing members. It outlines the licensing requirements, application procedures, and definitions for entities providing clearing, settlement, and custody services under the Securities Act, 2015.

name: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Radio Broadcast Station Operations) Regulations, 2012 as amended in 2019

metadata.title: Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Radio Broadcast Station Operations) Regulations, 2012 as amended in 2019
metadata.amends: Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Radio Broadcast Station Operations) Regulations, 2012
metadata.summary: This document contains regulations made by the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (PEMRA) regarding radio broadcast station operations. It defines key terms such as radio advertisements, broadcasting services, and technical standards like AM and FM modulation.

name: The Competition (Leniency) Regulations, 2019

metadata.title: The Competition (Leniency) Regulations, 2019
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for granting total immunity or reduction in financial penalties to undertakings involved in prohibited agreements. They outline specific conditions applicants must meet, such as providing evidence and cooperating with investigations, to qualify for leniency under the Competition Act, 2010.

name: The Private Power and Infrastructure Board (Fee and Charges) Rules, 2018

metadata.title: The Private Power and Infrastructure Board (Fee and Charges) Rules, 2018
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the fees and charges payable by power companies, sponsors, and affiliates to the Private Power and Infrastructure Board (PPIB). They define key terms related to power projects and establish procedures for fee payment, late charges, refunds, and recovery as arrears of land revenue.

name: The Number Allocation & Administration Regulations, 2018

metadata.title: Number Allocation & Administration Regulations, 2018
metadata.summary: This document contains regulations made by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority under the powers of the Pakistan Telecommunication (Re-organization) Act, 1996. It establishes definitions for various telecommunications terms such as area codes, carrier selection, and geographic numbers to govern number allocation and administration.

name: Draft-The Modaraba Regulations, 2019

metadata.title: The Modaraba Regulations, 2019
metadata.summary: This document publishes a draft of the Modaraba Regulations, 2019 proposed by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. The regulations define key terms such as 'Certificates of Musharakah', 'equity', and 'finance' within the context of Islamic financial institutions.

name: The PEMRA Registration/Accreditation of Television Audience Measurement (TAM) / Rating Service Regulations, 2018

metadata.title: PEMRA Registration/Accreditation of Television Audience Measurement (TAM)/ Rating Service Regulations-2018
metadata.summary: This notification promulgates regulations for the registration and accreditation of companies providing Television Audience Measurement (TAM) and Rating Services in Pakistan. The rules were issued by the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (PEMRA) under powers conferred by the PEMRA Ordinance 2002 and an Amendment Act, following directions from the Supreme Court.

name: The Mobile Device Identification, Registration and Blocking Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: Mobile Device Identification, Registration and Blocking Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish a system for the identification, registration, and blocking of non-compliant mobile devices in Pakistan. They define key terms such as compliant devices, blacklists, and duplicate IMEIs to ensure technical standards are met.

name: The PEMRA Teleport Service Licensing Regulations 2018

metadata.title: PEMRA Teleport Service Licensing Regulations 2018
metadata.summary: This document establishes the PEMRA Teleport Service Licensing Regulations for 2018 to guide companies applying for teleport service licenses. The regulations define key terms related to broadcasting, licensing fees, and operational infrastructure under the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (PEMRA).

name: The Regulations for Technical Implementation of Mobile Banking, 2016

metadata.title: Regulations for Technical Implementation of Mobile Banking, 2016
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the technical framework for implementing mobile banking services in Pakistan, including money transfers and remittances. They define key terms such as 'Mobile Banking', 'Authorized Financial Institutions', and various business models like 'Any-to-any' and 'One-to-one'. The rules apply to telecom operators and third-party service providers offering these services through agreements with financial institutions.

name: The Subscribers Antecedents Verification Regulations, 2015

metadata.title: Subscribers Antecedents Verification Regulations, 2015
metadata.summary: These regulations establish procedures for mobile communication service licensees to register and verify subscriber antecedents using the NADRA database. They mandate specific documentation requirements for both Pakistani nationals and foreign nationals during SIM sales and activation.

name: The Telecommunication and Terminal Equipment Installer Regulations, 2012

metadata.title: Telecommunication and Terminal Equipment Installer Regulations, 2012
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for registering Telecommunication and Terminal Equipment Installers to ensure minimum qualification standards. They define the obligations of telecom operators and premises owners regarding the installation, maintenance, and safety of telecommunication equipment within premises.

name: The Pakistan Oil (Refining, Blending, Transportation, Storage and Marketing) Rules, 2016

metadata.title: Pakistan Oil (Refining, Blending Transportation, Storage and Marketing) Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002 to regulate specific activities within the oil sector. The document defines key terms such as blending, dealer, lubricant, and petroleum products for use under the authority's regulations.

name: The National Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2012

metadata.title: The National Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Commission on the Status of Women (NCSW) to promote the social, economic, political, and legal rights of women in Pakistan. It defines the composition of the Commission, including a Chairperson, members from provinces and specific regions, and ex-officio representatives, while outlining their appointment processes and terms of office.

name: The Mobile Virtual Network Operation Regulations, 2012

metadata.title: Mobile Virtual Network Operation Regulations, 2012
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for Mobile Virtual Network Operators (MVNOs) in Pakistan, defining terms and outlining procedures for commercial agreement approval. They specify eligibility criteria, license fees, duration, and general conditions for providing cellular mobile services without owning spectrum.

name: The Industrial Relations Act, 2012

metadata.title: The Industrial Relations Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and rationalizes the law regarding the formation of trade unions and federations in the Islamabad Capital Territory and trans-provincial establishments. It also aims to improve relations between employers and workmen, regulate collective bargaining, and provide mechanisms for settling industrial disputes.

name: The Cellular Mobile Network Quality of Service (QoS) Regulations, 2011

metadata.title: Cellular Mobile Network Quality of Service (QoS) Regulations, 2011
metadata.summary: These regulations establish minimum quality of service standards for cellular mobile communication service licensees in Pakistan. They define specific performance metrics such as network down-time, call connection time, and speech quality that must be met or exceeded. The document also outlines requirements for measurement, reporting periods, and record-keeping tasks.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Review Procedure) Regulations, 2009

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Review Procedure) Regulations, 2009
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedure for the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) to review its own orders, decisions, and determinations. They define key terms such as 'motion', 'order', and 'Rules' and outline the process for filing motions for review, including time limits and conditions for granting leave.

name: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Councils of Complaints) Rules, 2010

metadata.title: Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Councils of Complaints) Rules, 2010
metadata.summary: These rules establish Councils of Complaints at Islamabad, provincial capitals, and other designated places to handle grievances against broadcast media and distribution service operators. The document defines the composition, tenure, and functions of these councils, including their authority to recommend actions like fines or license suspension for violations.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Performance Standards (Generation) Rules 2009

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Performance Standards (Generation) Rules, 2009
metadata.summary: These rules establish performance standards for electric generation facilities to ensure efficient operation and electrical service reliability. They define key terms such as active service, ancillary services, and generation facilities, while setting requirements for voltage, frequency, and power factor limits. The document also mandates specific data reporting obligations regarding energy loss rates, availability factors, and outage statistics.

name: The Protection from Spam, Unsolicited, Fraudulent and Obnoxious Communication Regulations, 2009

metadata.title: Protection from Spam, Unsolicited, Fraudulent and Obnoxious Communication Regulations, 2009
metadata.summary: These regulations establish standard operating procedures for telecom operators to control spam, fraudulent, unsolicited, and obnoxious communications. They define key terms such as 'Operator', 'Spamming', and 'Do Not Call Register' and mandate technical measures to protect consumers.

name: The Telecom Consumers Protection Regulations, 2009

metadata.title: Telecom Consumers Protection Regulations, 2009
metadata.summary: These regulations were issued by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority to promote and protect the rights and interests of telecommunication consumers in Pakistan. They establish rules regarding service provisioning, interruptions, withdrawals, and suspension policies, requiring operators to provide prior notice for planned enhancements or unforeseen faults.

name: The Federal Board of Revenue Rules, 2007

metadata.title: The Federal Board of Revenue Rules, 2007
metadata.repeals: The Central Board of Revenue Rules, 1967
metadata.summary: These rules define the short title, definitions, and powers of the Federal Board of Revenue. They establish how the Board's functions are delegated to its members and ratified by the Board itself.

name: The Sales Tax Refund on Zero-Rated Supply, Rules, 2006

metadata.title: Sales Tax Refund on Taxable Inputs Used in Zero-Rated Supply Rules, 2006
metadata.summary: These rules establish a Fast Track Channel for registered manufacturers to claim refunds on sales tax paid for inputs used in zero-rated supplies. They define key terms, outline procedures for filing and processing claims, and specify timelines for sanctioning and payment of refunds.

name: The Accounting Separation Regulations, 2007

metadata.title: Accounting Separation Regulations, 2007
metadata.summary: These regulations mandate the preparation of separated accounts for different business units and disaggregated activities of telecommunication licensees. They apply specifically to licensees holding a position of Significant Market Power in wholesale or retail markets, requiring annual reports on profit, loss, balance sheets, and return on capital employed.

name: The Exemption of Supplies against International Tender for Earthquake Rehabilitation Rules, 2006

metadata.title: Exemption of Supplies against International Tender for Earthquake Rehabilitation Rules, 2006
metadata.summary: These rules exempt taxable supplies made by registered persons against international tenders to specific UN agencies and ICRC for earthquake rehabilitation from sales tax. The document outlines the required procedures, including contract retention, invoice issuance, and certificate attestation by the Federal Relief Commissioner.

name: The Access Promotion Regulations, 2005

metadata.title: Access Promotion Regulations, 2005
metadata.summary: These Regulations were made by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority under powers conferred by the Pakistan Telecommunication (Re-organization) Act, 1996. They establish specific compliance requirements for International Telephony Service agreements between LDI Licensees and Corresponding Operators.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Resolution of Disputes between Independent Power Producers and other Licensees) Regulations, 2003

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Resolution of Disputes between Independent Power Producers and other Licensees) Regulations, 2003
metadata.summary: This notification establishes regulations for the resolution of disputes between Independent Power Producers and other licensees under NEPRA. The regulations come into force immediately upon publication.

name: The State Bank of Pakistan Banking Service Corporation Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: An Ordinance to provide for the establishment of SBP Banking Services Corporation as a subsidiary of the State Bank of Pakistan, and for the management and control thereof
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the SBP Banking Services Corporation as a subsidiary of the State Bank of Pakistan. It outlines provisions for the management, control, and delegation of powers related to the new corporation.

name: The Pakistan Telecommunication Rules, 2000

metadata.title: The Pakistan Telecommunication Rules, 2000
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Pakistan Telecommunication (Re-organization) Act, 1996 to regulate telecommunication systems and services in Pakistan. They establish definitions for key terms, outline procedures for applying for licenses, and set conditions regarding exclusive rights and interconnection agreements.

name: The Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance, 1996

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance, 1996
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences in Islamabad as a body corporate. It outlines the objectives of the institute, including providing medical facilities, conducting research, and offering training. The document also defines the composition and appointment terms for the Board of Governors responsible for its administration.

name: The Special Courts for Speedy Trials Act, 1987

metadata.title: Special Courts for Speedy Trials Act, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Special Courts in Pakistan to ensure the speedy trial of specific offences deemed gruesome, brutal, or shocking to public morality. It outlines the constitution of these courts, their jurisdiction over pending cases, and strict procedural rules designed to expedite justice, including limits on adjournments and the ability to try accused persons in absentia.

name: PROCLAMATION OF WITHDRAWAL OF MARTIAL LAW

metadata.title: Proclamation of Withdrawal of Martial Law
metadata.repeals: Proclamation of the 25th day of March, 1969; Proclamation of the 20th day of December, 1971; Provisional Constitutional Order
metadata.summary: This Proclamation withdraws the Martial Law imposed in Pakistan since March 1969 and abolishes all associated martial law authorities and military courts. It also causes the lapse of powers held by the Chief Martial Law Administrator to issue regulations, orders, or take any action under the previous proclamations.

name: The Exit from Pakistan (Control) Rules, 1983

metadata.title: The Exit from Pakistan (Control) Rules, 1984
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Federal Government under the powers of the Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance, 1981. They specify how exit orders are to be served on individuals and outline procedures for forwarding copies to relevant authorities.

name: The Representation of the People Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Representation of the People Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the conduct of elections to the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies in Pakistan. It aims to guard against corrupt and illegal practices, determine election disputes, and establish definitions for terms used throughout the legislation.

name: The Territorial Waters and Maritime Zones Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Territorial Waters and Maritime Zones Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act declares the territorial waters and maritime zones of Pakistan, defining their limits and sovereignty. It regulates the use of these waters by foreign ships, including provisions for innocent passage and entry restrictions for warships or nuclear vessels. Additionally, it establishes the contiguous zone and continental shelf, outlining Pakistan's sovereign rights over resources and marine environment protection.

name: The Pakistan Hotels and Restaurants Act, 1976

metadata.title: Pakistan Hotels and Restaurants Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures to control and regulate the standards of service and amenities for tourists in hotels and restaurants across Pakistan. It establishes a framework including the appointment of Controllers, the formation of an Advisory Committee, and mandatory registration requirements for hotel and restaurant owners.

name: The Esso Undertakings (Vesting) Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Esso Undertakings (Vesting) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the vesting of certain undertakings of Esso Eastern Inc. in Pakistan into the Federal Government. It defines key terms such as 'Esso undertakings' to include assets, liabilities, contracts, and pension obligations related to the company's business in Pakistan, while excluding natural gas and crude oil operations.

name: The Fee-Charging Employment Agencies (Regulation) Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Fee-Charging Employment Agencies (Regulation) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The State Bank of Pakistan (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976 (XLII of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the working of fee-charging and other employment agencies that conduct business for profit within Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'employment agency' and 'competent authority', prohibits acting as a fee-charging agency without a license, and grants powers to the competent authority to inspect premises and enforce compliance.

name: The Pakistan Plant Quarantine Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Pakistan Plant Quarantine Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in Pakistan to the International Plant Protection Convention of 1951. It empowers the Federal Government to prohibit or regulate the import of articles and pests that could infect crops or plants, including provisions for examination, certification, and destruction of infected goods.

name: The Baluchistan and Sindh (High Courts) Order, 1976

metadata.title: The Baluchistan and Sind (High Courts) Order, 1976
metadata.summary: This Order establishes separate High Courts for the provinces of Baluchistan and Sind, effective from December 1, 1976. It defines the jurisdiction, powers, and appointment procedures for judges of these new courts while transferring pending cases from the former common High Court.

name: The Pakistan Railways Police Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Pakistan Railways Police Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution, regulation, and maintenance of the Pakistan Railways Police. It outlines the specific functions of this force, including preventing loss to railway property, ensuring passenger safety, maintaining law and order on railways, and investigating offences related to railway operations.

name: The Establishment of the Federal Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Federal Bank for Cooperatives and Regulation of Cooperative Banking Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Federal Bank for Cooperatives and provides for the regulation of cooperative banking in Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President under Article 89 of the Constitution because the National Assembly was not in session, following resolutions from Provincial Assemblies and Parliament.

name: The Pakistan Hotels and Restaurants Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Pakistan Hotels and Restaurants Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures to control and regulate the standards of service and amenities for tourists in hotels and restaurants across Pakistan. It establishes a framework including the appointment of Controllers and the setting up of an Advisory Committee to aid in the administration of these regulations.

name: The Esso Undertakings (Vesting) Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: Esso Undertakings (Vesting) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the vesting of certain undertakings of Esso Eastern Inc. in Pakistan into the Federal Government. It defines key terms such as 'Esso undertakings' to include assets, liabilities, and contracts related to the purchasing, storing, distributing, blending, marketing, and selling of refined petroleum products, lubricants, and chemical products.

name: The Cotton Ginning Control and Development Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Cotton Ginning Control and Development Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the operation and development of the cotton ginning industry in Pakistan. It declares that the industry shall be carried on and owned by the Federal Government or a controlled corporation, excluding all other persons except foreign investors.

name: The Rice Milling Control and Development Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Rice Milling Control and Development Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the operation and development of the rice milling industry in Pakistan. It provides for the compulsory acquisition of establishments by the Federal Government and establishes specific principles for assessing compensation, such as Break-up Value, Market Value, and Net Worth Value.

name: The Flour Milling Control and Development Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Flour Milling Control and Development Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the operation and development of the flour milling industry in Pakistan. It declares that the industry shall be owned and carried on by the Federal or Provincial Government, with specific provisions for acquiring existing establishments and defining terms related to foreign investors and management.

name: The Auqaf (Federal Control) Act, 1976

metadata.title: Auqaf (Federal Control) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for the proper management and administration of Auqaf under Federal control in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as waqf property and outlines the appointment procedures for the Administrator General, Chief Administrators, and other officers responsible for overseeing these properties.

name: The Pakistan Shipping Corporation Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Pakistan Shipping Corporation Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Shipping Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the corporation's functions to manage shipping services, acquire vessels, and undertake related activities under the authority of the Federal Government.

name: The Co-operative Farming Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Co-operative Farming Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the formation, working, and promotion of co-operative farming and allied agro-based industries based on self-help and mutual aid among farmers. It establishes conditions for the registration of co-operative farming societies, including minimum member counts and land acreage requirements, and outlines procedures for registration and amendment of bye-laws.

name: The Cotton Ginning Control and Development Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Cotton Ginning Control and Development Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the operation and development of the cotton ginning industry in Pakistan. It declares that the industry shall be carried on and owned by the Federal Government or a controlled corporation, excluding all other persons except foreign investors.

name: The Rice Milling Control and Development Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: THE RICE MILLING CONTROL AND DEVELOPMENT ORDINANCE, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the operation and development of the rice milling industry in Pakistan. It declares that the industry shall be carried on and owned by the Federal Government or a designated Corporation, excluding all other persons except foreign investors.

name: The Flour Milling Control and Development Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Flour Milling Control and Development Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the operation and development of the flour milling industry in Pakistan. It declares that specific parts of the industry shall be owned and carried on by the Federal or Provincial Government to the exclusion of other persons, with exceptions for foreign investors.

name: The Finance Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1976. It also amends certain laws, specifically the Income-tax Act, 1922, to introduce new tax charges on undisclosed income and adjust various sections regarding interest rates and business definitions.

name: The Dowry and Bridal Gifts (Restriction) Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Dowry and Bridal Gifts (Restriction) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for restrictions on dowry and bridal gifts given in connection with marriages. It defines key terms such as dowry, bridal gift, and present, and sets monetary ceilings on the value of these items to prevent excessive financial burdens.

name: The Foreign Private Investment (Promotion and Protection) Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Foreign Private Investment (Promotion and Protection) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Criminal Law Amendment (Special Court) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1976 (XVI of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the promotion and protection of foreign private investment in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as foreign capital and industrial undertakings, outlines conditions for government approval, and ensures the protection of agreements between foreign investors and local entities.

name: The System of Sardari (Abolition) Act, 1976

metadata.title: The System of Sardari (Abolition) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The System of Sardari (Abolition) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes the system of Sardari, which is described as a remnant of an oppressive feudal and tribal system. It prohibits recognized Sardars from exercising unauthorized judicial powers, maintaining private jails, arresting people without legal cause, demanding tribute, or claiming benefits from tribal land.

name: The Co-operative Farming Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Co-operative Farming Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the formation, working, and promotion of co-operative farming and allied agro-based industries based on self-help and mutual aid. It establishes definitions for terms such as 'co-operative farm', 'society', and various councils, and sets conditions for the registration of co-operative farming societies.

name: The Emigration Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Drugs Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Drugs Act, 1940; The Drugs (Generic Names) Act, 1972; The Drugs Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Drugs Act of 1940, the Drugs (Generic Names) Act of 1972, and the Drugs Ordinance of 1976. It provides for the continuation of existing licences for manufacture, import, export, or sale until new orders are passed or specific dates are fixed.

name: The Drugs Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Drugs Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the import, export, manufacture, storage, distribution, and sale of drugs within Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'drug', 'adulterated drug', and 'counterfeit drug' to establish a legal framework for these activities.

name: The Travel Agencies Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Travel Agencies Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development, regulation, and control of the profession of travel agencies in Pakistan. It establishes a regulatory committee, defines key terms such as 'travel agency' and 'tourist', and outlines the process and conditions for granting licenses to operate travel agencies.

name: The Seed Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Seed Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for controlling and regulating the quality of seeds of various varieties of crops in Pakistan. It establishes a National Seed Council and a Federal Seed Certification Agency to oversee seed standards, registration, and certification processes.

name: The Pakistan Study Centres Act, 1976

metadata.title: Pakistan Study Centres Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Pakistan Study Centres in universities and the National Institute of Pakistan Studies at the University of Islamabad. It outlines their functions, which include studying regional languages, literature, and social structures, as well as establishing degree programs and promoting research.

name: The Pakistan Tourist Guides Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Pakistan Tourist Guides Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of the profession of tourist guides in Pakistan. It establishes a regulatory committee, sets up a licensing system with specific fees and validity periods, prescribes a code of conduct, and defines penalties for unlicensed operation or violations.

name: The National Insurance Corporation Act, 1976

metadata.title: National Insurance Corporation Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Insurance Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the corporation's establishment, capital provision by the Federal Government, and its management by a Board of Directors appointed by the government.

name: The Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences Ordinance, 1976 (Punjab Ordinance No. II of 1976), and the Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences Ordinance, 1976 (X of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Act withdraws the remission of sentences granted to or earned by certain prisoners. It mandates that such prisoners must serve their full term regardless of previous remissions, covering offenses under specific military and treason laws.

name: The Members of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Exemption of Advisers from Disqualification) Act, 1976

metadata.title: Members of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Exemption of Advisers from Disqualification) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: Members of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Exemption of Advisers from Disqualification) Ordinance, 1976 (I of 1976)
metadata.summary: This Act declares that persons holding the office of Adviser to a Governor are not disqualified from being elected or chosen as members of Parliament or Provincial Assemblies. It applies when specific constitutional orders regarding the assumption of provincial functions or proclamations are in force. The Act also repeals the earlier Ordinance on the same subject.

name: The System of Sardari (Abolition) Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The System of Sardari (Abolition) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes the system of Sardari, which is described as a remnant of an oppressive feudal and tribal system derogatory to human dignity. It prohibits recognized Sardars from exercising unauthorized judicial powers, maintaining private jails, arresting persons without legal authority, taking free labor, or demanding tribute.

name: The Federal Supervision of Curricula Textbooks and Maintenance of Standards of Education Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Federal Supervision of Curricula, Text-books and Maintenance of Standards of Education Act, 1976
