metadata.summary: This Act establishes federal supervision over school curriculums and text-books to maintain educational standards. It creates a Competent Authority empowered to prepare study schemes, approve manuscripts, and direct amendments or deletions in educational materials.

name: The Foreign Private Investment (Promotion and Protection) Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Foreign Private Investment (Promotion and Protection) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the promotion and protection of foreign private investment in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as foreign capital and industrial undertakings, outlines conditions for government approval of investments, and establishes protections for agreements and repatriation facilities for investors.

name: The Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences Ordinance, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Punjab Withdrawal of Remission of Sentences Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the President to withdraw remissions of sentences granted to or earned by certain prisoners. It applies to prisoners sentenced by Courts Martial under the Pakistan Army Act, High Treason Act, Suppression of Terrorist Activities Act, Criminal Law Amendment Ordinance, and specific sections of the Penal Code or Defence of Pakistan Rules.

name: The Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 1976

metadata.title: The Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975 (XXX of 1975)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the law relating to old-age benefits for persons employed in industrial, commercial, and other organizations. It establishes an Employees' Old-Age Benefits Institution and mandates compulsory insurance for all employees in industries with ten or more workers.

name: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Elections to Reserved Seats) Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: National and Provincial Assemblies (Elections to Reserved Seats) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conduct of elections to reserved seats in the National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies. It also aims to guard against corrupt and illegal practices, determine election disputes, and address related matters.

name: The Drugs Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Drugs Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the import, export, manufacture, storage, distribution, and sale of drugs in Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President under Article 89 of the Constitution because the National Assembly was not in session.

name: The Emigration Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Emigration Ordinance, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Emigration Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Emigration Act, 1922 with certain modifications. It establishes the framework for regulating the emigration of Pakistani citizens for work abroad and defines key terms such as 'emigrant', 'skilled worker', and 'professional and technical person'.

name: The Antiquities Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Antiquities Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: the law relating to the preservation and protection of antiquities
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the previous law concerning the preservation and protection of antiquities. It defines key terms such as 'antiquity', 'dealer', and 'immovable antiquity' to establish a legal framework for their custody and protection.

name: The Members of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Exemption of Advisers from Disqualification) Ordinance, 1976

metadata.title: The Members of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Exemption of Advisers from Disqualification) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance declares that persons holding the office of Adviser to a Governor are not disqualified from being elected or chosen as members of Parliament or Provincial Assemblies. It applies when an Order under Article 232 or a Proclamation under Article 234 of the Constitution is in force, allowing the Federal Government to assume provincial functions.

name: The Pakistan Engineering Council Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Pakistan Engineering Council Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation of the engineering profession in Pakistan by constituting an Engineering Council. It establishes the Council as a body corporate with defined composition, including members nominated by the Federal Government, Provincial Governments, and Universities.

name: The Governor's Pension Order, 1974

metadata.title: The Governor's Pension Order, 1974
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the payment of a monthly pension to persons who have held the office of Governor of a Province for not less than two years without removal for misconduct. It also grants additional facilities such as exemptions from weapon licenses, free access to government guest houses, and specific allowances upon cessation of office.

name: PROCLAMATION

metadata.title: Proclamation of Withdrawal of Martial Law
metadata.repeals: Proclamation of the 25th day of March, 1969; Proclamation of the 20th day of December, 1971; Provisional Constitutional Order
metadata.summary: This Proclamation withdraws the Martial Law imposed in Pakistan since March 1969 and abolishes all associated martial law authorities and military courts. It also causes the lapse of powers held by the Chief Martial Law Administrator to issue regulations, orders, or take any action under the previous proclamations.

name: The Federal Investigation Agency (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1975

metadata.title: The Federal Investigation Agency (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1975
metadata.summary: These rules govern the appointment, promotion, and transfer of officers within the Federal Investigation Agency. They establish specific methods for filling posts based on grade levels and define the authorities competent to make these appointments.

name: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Stage Carriages (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Stage Carriages (Temporary Powers) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the temporary requisitioning of stage carriages in West Pakistan to ensure passenger transport services. It grants District Magistrates the power to order, maintain, and use motor vehicles as stage carriages while outlining procedures for appeals, compensation, and penalties for contravention.

name: The West Pakistan Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance fixes the minimum rates of wages for unskilled workers employed in certain commercial and industrial establishments in West Pakistan. It applies to establishments with fifty or more employees, excluding government services, defense-related entities, and specific public utilities.

name: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to hours and other conditions of work and employment for persons in shops, commercial, industrial, and other establishments in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'commercial establishment' while specifying its territorial application and commencement.

name: The West Pakistan Land-Revenue Act, 1967

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land-Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to land-revenue in the Province of West Pakistan. It covers matters including the making and maintenance of records-of-rights, the assessment and collection of revenue, and the appointment and functions of Revenue Officers.

name: The West Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to the sale, transport, bearing, or possession of arms, ammunition, and military stores in West Pakistan. It establishes licensing requirements for these activities and defines specific terms such as 'arms', 'ammunition', and 'cannon'.

name: The Finance Act, 1967

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1967
metadata.amends: The Post Office Act, 1898; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1965; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government and amends several existing laws. It specifically updates provisions related to the Post Office, Tariff, Finance (Supplementary), Central Excises and Salt, and Income-tax Acts.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 88

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation
metadata.summary: This regulation declares that no court proceedings can lie against any order made or action taken by a Martial Law authority. It explicitly states that this protection applies regardless of whether the authority had jurisdiction or if the action was within the scope of the regulation.

name: The Province of West Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a new force called the West Pakistan Rangers to protect border areas and maintain law and order in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines the structure, command hierarchy, recruitment conditions, and duties of the Force, including cooperation with police agencies for crime prevention and smuggling control.

name: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Local Authorities Election Commission to make recommendations regarding local authority elections in the province. It grants powers to postpone or cancel elections, extend member terms, and codify election laws across different parts of the province.

name: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Agricultural Development Finance Corporation (Recovery of Arrears) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act provides facilities to the Agricultural Development Finance Corporation for recovering its dues. It empowers agricultural concerns to pledge or mortgage property to secure loans and allows the Corporation to recover dues by disposing of such property.

name: The West Pakistan Drugs (Extension) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Drugs (Extension) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Drugs (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act extends the provisions of the Drugs Act, 1940 to the whole of the Province of West Pakistan. It also repeals the previous Drugs (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1957.

name: The West Pakistan (Montgomery Municipality) Validation of Taxes Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Montgomery Municipality) Taxes Act, Validation 1958
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain taxes imposed by the Municipal Committee of Montgomery. It deems these taxes to have been validly imposed with effect from October 1, 1958.

name: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws relating to the levy of duty on admission to entertainments in West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'entertainment', 'payment for admission', and 'proprietor' to regulate the imposition of duties.

name: The West Pakistan Good Conduct Prisoners Probational Release (Extension) Act, 1958

metadata.title: West Pakistan Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release (Extension) Act, 1958
metadata.amends: Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Act, 1920
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release (Extension) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Act extends the Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release Act, 1920 to the entire Province of West Pakistan, excluding the Federal Capital and Special Areas. It substitutes specific sections in the original 1920 Act and repeals a previous 1957 Ordinance on the same subject.

name: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly Speaker and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries and Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly Speaker and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and other privileges of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan. It received the assent of the Governor on April 8, 1958, and was deemed to have come into force on May 20, 1956.

name: The West Pakistan Horse-race Betting Tax Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Horse Race Betting Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to taxes on horse-race betting in West Pakistan onto a uniform basis. It defines key terms such as 'backer', 'book-maker', and 'totalizator' and empowers the Government to levy specific taxes on money paid into totalizators and bets made within race enclosures.

name: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of a tax on urban immovable property in the Province of West Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'assessing authority' and 'Collector', establishes the structure for rating areas, and specifies the rates at which tax is charged based on annual value.

name: The West Pakistan Finance Act , 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the continuation and enhancement of certain taxes in West Pakistan. It establishes additional land revenue surcharges in specific districts and increases agricultural income-tax in others, while also levying new taxes on cinemas and entertainment.

name: The West Pakistan Supplementary Appropriation Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Supplementary Appropriation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes further payment and appropriation of certain sums from the Provincial Consolidated Fund for the financial year 1957-58. It specifies the total amount to be paid, which is twenty-six crores sixteen lakhs fifty-six thousand and seventy rupees, to defray supplementary charges for various services and purposes listed in the Schedule.

name: The West Pakistan Appropriation Act, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Appropriation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes the payment and appropriation of certain sums out of the Provincial and Consolidated Fund for the financial year 1958-59. It specifies the total aggregate amount to be paid and applied towards defraying charges for various services and purposes listed in the Schedule.

name: The West Pakistan (Montgomery Municipality) Validation of Taxes Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Montgomery Municipality) Validation of Taxes Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain taxes imposed by the Municipal Committee of Montgomery. It deems these taxes to have been validly imposed with effect from October 1, 1956, despite the Provincial Assembly not being in session at the time.

name: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of the West Pakistan Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Act, 1957 after its expiration. It empowers the Provincial Government to use requisitioned land, release it from requisition, acquire specific lands for government works, and determine compensation.

name: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the West Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority to unify and coordinate the development of water and power resources in the province. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlines its constitution including a Chairman and Members, and grants it powers to prepare comprehensive plans for resource utilization.

name: The West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Agriculturists' Loans Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1884; Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) XII of 1884; the Act, Agriculturists' Loans (Punjab Amendment) Punjab 1951, X of 1951; Agriculturists' Act, 1955; Loans (Sind Amendment) Punjab V of 1952; Khairpur State Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the laws relating to the advancement and recovery of taccavi loans for agricultural purposes in West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor under Article 102 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.amends: law relating to Motor Vehicles in the Province of West Pakistan
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the laws relating to motor vehicles in the Province of West Pakistan. It was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Ordinance, 1958

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Ordinance, 1958
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of the expiring West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1957. It consolidates the law relating to the levy of a duty on admission to entertainments in the Province of West Pakistan.

name: The Army Validation of Proceedings Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Indian Air Force Volunteer (Discipline) Repeal Act, 1952
metadata.repeals: The Indian Air Force Volunteer (Discipline) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Indian Air Force Volunteer (Discipline) Act, 1939. It validates actions taken under the repealed Act as if done under the new legal framework upon its commencement.

name: The West Pakistan Provincial Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Legislative Assembly (Allowances of Members) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the allowances of Members of the West Pakistan Legislative Assembly. It defines key terms such as 'Assembly', 'Member', and 'Period of residence on duty' to establish eligibility for financial support.

name: The Indian Air Force Volunteer Reserve (Discipline) (Repeal) Act, 1952

metadata.title: The Indian Air Force (Discipline) (Repeal) Act, 1952
metadata.repeals: The Indian Air Force Volunteer Reserve (Discipline) Act, 1939
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Indian Air Force Volunteer Reserve (Discipline) Act, 1939. It validates actions taken under the repealed Act as if they were done under the powers conferred by the Pakistan Army and Air Force Reserves Act, 1950.

name: The Employment (Record of Services) Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Employment (Record of Services) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the compulsory maintenance of service record books for persons in certain classes of employment across Pakistan's provinces and capital. It defines key terms such as 'appropriate Government', 'employee', and 'employer', and mandates that employers must provide service books to employees upon engagement.

name: The House Building Finance Corporation Act, 1952

metadata.title: The House Building Finance Corporation Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the House Building Finance Corporation to provide financial facilities for house construction in towns and cities. The Corporation is created as a body corporate with an authorized share capital, subject to government guarantees on dividends and minimum share values.

name: NA- The Bahawalpur State Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Punjab Municipal (Executive Officers) (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Bahawulpur State Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues the provisions of the Punjab Municipal (Executive Officers) Act, 1931, as amended in 1957, after the expiry of that amendment act. It extends these provisions to specific districts including Bahawalnagar, Bahawalpur, and Rahimyar Khan while repealing the application of the 1951 Bahawulpur State Municipal Act within those areas.

name: The Agricultural Development Finance Corporation Act, 1952

metadata.title: Agricultural Development Finance Corporation Act, 1952
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Agricultural Development Finance Corporation to provide financial facilities for the development and modernization of agriculture in Pakistan. It defines the Corporation's structure, including its authorized capital, shareholding rules, and the composition of its Board of Directors and Executive Committee.

name: The Pakistan Banking (Prevention of Default and Evasion of Liabilities) Ordinance, 1947

metadata.title: Pakistan Banking (Prevention of Default and Evasion of Liabilities) Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prevents banking concerns in Pakistan from defaulting on commitments due to external pressure. It restricts banks from acting on instructions from authorities outside Pakistan regarding cheque payments or the delivery of items held in safe custody without prior approval.

name: The Transfer of Property (Pakistan) Ordinance, 1947

metadata.title: The Transfer of Property (Pakistan) Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance mandates the payment of taxes before the recognition of property transfers in Pakistan. It requires a certificate from an Income-tax Officer for registering documents relating to non-agricultural land and empowers officers to recover unpaid tax liabilities as if they were land revenue arrears.

name: The Pakistan National Guard Ordinance, 1947

metadata.title: The Pakistan National Guard Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance enables the formation of a voluntary National Guard in Pakistan to supplement the armed forces during an emergency. It establishes the organizational structure, recruitment rules, and provisions for the embodiment of the guard into the Pakistan Army.

name: The Banking Companies (Pakistan) Ordinance, 1947

metadata.title: The Banking Companies (Pakistan) Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides temporary relief to certain banking companies in the territories of Pakistan during an emergency. It empowers the Government of Pakistan to issue orders staying legal actions against these banks and restricts their ability to accept new deposits or dispose of assets.

name: The Riot and Civil Commotion Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1947

metadata.title: The Riot and Civil Commotion Risks Insurance Ordinance, 1947
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the insurance of certain property against risks arising from riots and civil commotions. It defines specific terms such as 'factory', 'Riot and Civil Commotion Risks', and establishes a scheme where the Dominion Government undertakes the liability of insuring persons against these specific risks.

name: NA- The Punjab Village Panchayat Act, 1939

metadata.title: The Punjab Village Panchayat (West Pakistan Extension and Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.repeals: Sind Village Panchayats Act, 1933; North-West Frontier Province Village Council Act, 1935; Khairpur State Dehati Adalat Act, 1939; Bahawalpur State Panchayat Act, 1943; Sind Village Sanitation Act, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends laws relating to panchayats in the Province of West Pakistan. It extends the Punjab Village Panchayat Act, 1939 to the whole of West Pakistan (excluding the Federal Capital and Special Areas) while repealing several specific acts from Sindh, NWFP, Khairpur State, and Bahawalpur State.

name: NA- The Sind District Municipal Act, 1901

metadata.title: The Sind District Municipal (West Pakistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind District Municipal Act, 1901 to allow the Provincial Government to extend the term of office for a councillor by up to one year. It also adds a new section regarding the vacancy of offices and supersession of municipalities when ordinary terms expire before elections are held.

name: Act No. I of 1897

metadata.title: The Public Servants (Inquiries) Act Amendment Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Public Servants (Inquiries) Act, 1850 by substituting specific words in section 2 and replacing section 23. It alters provisions regarding the powers of the Government to remove persons from their appointments without the sanction of the Government.

name: The Bengal Tenancy Act, 1885

metadata.title: The Bengal Tenancy Act, 1885
metadata.summary: This Act postpones the coming into force of specific provisions regarding rent deposits and distraint found in the Bengal Tenancy Act, 1885. It allows the Local Government to appoint a later date for these provisions to take effect, ensuring that related enactments continue in force until then.

name: The Land Acquisition (Mines) Act, 1885

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Mines) Act, 1883
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act of 1870 specifically regarding mines and minerals in Punjab. It provides powers to local governments to prevent or restrict the working of mines when necessary for public purposes or safety, including provisions for compensation and repairs.

name: The Central Provinces Government Wards Act, 1885

metadata.title: The Central Provinces Wards Act, 1885
metadata.repeals: Bengal Regulations LII of 1803 and VI of 1822 and section 14 of Act XL of 1858
metadata.summary: This Act provides better provisions for the superintendence of Government wards in the Central Provinces. It defines key terms such as 'Government ward' and 'landholder', establishes the jurisdiction of the Court of Wards over landholders, and outlines the powers of the Chief Commissioner.

name: The Oudh Additional Judicial Commissioner’s Act, 1885

metadata.title: The Additional Commissioner's Act
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the temporary appointment of an Additional Judicial Commissioner for Oudh by the Local Government. It stipulates that the appointed person holds office during the pleasure of the Local Government and exercises powers similar to the existing Judicial Commissioner.

name: The Power-of-Attorney Act, 1882

metadata.title: The Powers-of-Attorney Act
metadata.repeals: The Powers-of-Attorney Act, 1866
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to powers-of-attorney and repeals previous legislation from 1849 and 1866. It provides for the creation of instruments creating powers-of-attorney, including provisions regarding married women and trustees.

name: The Repealing Act, 1873

metadata.title: The Repeal Act, 1873
metadata.summary: This Act repeals certain obsolete enactments and statutes that are no longer necessary. It ensures that the repeal does not affect existing rights, remedies, or procedures established by prior laws.

name: The Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to co-operative societies in the Province of Sind. It facilitates the formation and working of these societies to promote thrift, self-help, and mutual aid among agriculturists and others with common economic needs.

name: The Christian Marriage Act, 1872

metadata.title: The Indian Christian Marriage Act, 1872
metadata.repeals: Enactments repealed
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the solemnization and registration of marriages for Native Christians in Punjab. It establishes procedures for obtaining certificates, publishing notices, and registering marriages performed by ministers or registrars.

name: ACT No. II of 1871

metadata.title: An Act to extend the Prisons' Act, 1870, to Coorg
metadata.summary: This Act extends the Prisons' Act, 1870 to the territories under the administration of the Chief Commissioner of Coorg. It includes specific modifications to the preamble and sections one and six of the original Act.

name: The Cattle-Trespass Act, 1871

metadata.title: The Cattle-Trespass Act, 1871
metadata.repeals: Acts mentioned in the schedule hereto annexed (specifically relating to trespasses by cattle)
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to trespasses by cattle in British India. It establishes provisions for pounds, pound-keepers, fines for impounded cattle, and procedures for the delivery or sale of seized animals.

name: The Punjab Laws Act, 1872

metadata.title: The Panjab Laws Act, 1872
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws relating to marriage registration, civil and criminal judicature, land revenue, insolvency, and police matters in Punjab. It also includes provisions regarding local customs, pre-emption rights, and the control of armed men and foreign vagrants.

name: ACT No. XXIV оf 1869

metadata.title: An Act to enhance the price of salt in the Presidency of Fort St. George and the duty on salt in the Presidency of Bombay
metadata.amends: Act No. VI of 1844; Act No. VII of 1861; Act No. XIX of 1866
metadata.repeals: Ordinance under the orders of the Governor of the Presidency of Madras and Bombay, dated the fourth day of October 1869
metadata.summary: This Act enhances the price of salt in the Presidency of Fort St. George and increases the duty on salt in the Presidency of Bombay. It repeals previous enactments regarding transit duties and specific salt regulations for Madras and Bombay dated October 4, 1869.

name: ACT No. XI OF 1855

metadata.title: The Act relating to holders under defective titles
metadata.summary: This Act secures the value of improvements made by bona fide holders under defective titles in cases where English law applies. It entitles such persons to compensation for buildings or improvements if they are evicted, or allows them to purchase the land interest at its value.

name: The Mesne Profits and Improvements Act, 1855

metadata.title: The Act relating to holders under defective titles
metadata.summary: This Act secures the value of improvements made by bona fide holders under defective titles in cases where English law applies. It entitles such persons to compensation for buildings or improvements if they are evicted, or allows them to purchase the land interest at its value.

name: The Public Accountants Default Act, 1850

metadata.title: The Public Accountants Default Act
metadata.summary: This Act mandates that every public accountant must provide security for the discharge of their office trusts and the accounting of all moneys under their control. It establishes rules for the amount and kind of security required by the appointing authority, subject to the President's approval.

name: NA- ACT No. VII oF 1835

metadata.title: The Passengers Act, 1855
metadata.repeals: Act II of 1860
metadata.summary: This Act amends the legislation relating to the carriage of passengers by sea. It applies specific provisions to various voyages between British India and other colonies, including those in the Straits Settlements and protected Native States.

name: The European Vagrancy Act, 1869

metadata.title: The European Vagrancy Act, 1869
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to prevent wandering by persons of European extraction throughout India. It establishes procedures for police officers to identify vagrants, order them to work-houses if employment is not immediately available, and outlines penalties for offenses such as begging and escaping from custody.

name: The Salary of the Chief Justice of Pakistan Order, 2026

metadata.title: The Salary of the Chief Justice of Pakistan Order, 2026
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes a new salary of Rs. 1,600,000 per month for the Chief Justice of Pakistan. It is promulgated under the powers conferred by the Fifth Schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

name: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2026

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2026
metadata.repeals: Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2023 (P.O. No.2 of 2023) and Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2025 (P.O. No.5 of 2025)
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary scales for the Chief Justice and other Judges of the Supreme Court of Pakistan. It specifies a monthly salary of Rs. 1,550,000 for the Chief Justice and Rs. 1,500,000 for other judges, effective from December 10, 2025.

name: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2026

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2026
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of the High Court's Order, 2023
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary scales for judges of the High Courts in Pakistan. It sets the monthly salary for the Chief Justice at Rs. 1,254,000 and for other judges at Rs. 1,205,000. The order also repeals the previous Salary of Judges of the High Court's Order, 2023.

name: The Ghurki Institute of Science and Technology Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Ghurki Institute of Science and Technology Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ghurki Institute of Science and Technology as a private sector body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, powers, and key personnel roles.

name: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2025

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2025
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2023
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes a salary of Rs. 1,600,000 per month for the Chief Justice of Pakistan. It comes into force immediately and is deemed effective from November 14, 2025.

name: The Salary of Judges of the Federal Constitutional Court Oder, 2025

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the Federal Constitutional Court Order, 2025
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes the salary for judges of the Federal Constitutional Court of Pakistan. It specifies a monthly salary of Rs. 1,550,000 for the Chief Justice and Rs. 1,500,000 for every other judge.

name: The Federal Constitutional Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 2025

metadata.title: The Federal Constitutional Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 2025
metadata.summary: This Order determines the privileges, allowances, leave of absence, and pension rights for Judges of the Federal Constitutional Court. It establishes definitions for various judicial roles, outlines types of leave accounts and limits, and specifies salary rates payable during leave.

name: The Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council Ordinance, 2025

metadata.title: Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates laws relating to the registration, licensing, and training of nurses, nurse practitioners, midwives, and related health professionals. It establishes the Pakistan Nursing and Midwifery Council and defines various qualifications and roles within the nursing and midwifery sectors.

name: The Pakistan Land Port Authority Act, 2025

metadata.title: Pakistan Land Port Authority Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Land Port Authority to administer an integrated system for cross-border movement of goods and passengers at land ports. It provides a framework for regulating, securing, and overseeing all land ports to promote trade, foster competition, and protect national interests while ensuring coordination with border agencies.

name: The Virtual Assets Ordinance, 2025

metadata.title: The Virtual Assets Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a regulatory Authority to license, regulate, and supervise Virtual Asset Service Providers in Pakistan. It aims to ensure investor protection, combat illicit activities like money laundering, and promote responsible innovation within a Shariah-compliant framework.

name: The Public Private Partnership Authority (Board Procedures) Regulations, 2024

metadata.title: Public Private Partnership Authority (Board Procedures) Regulations, 2024
metadata.amends: Public Private Partnership Authority (Board Procedures) Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the Board Procedures for the Public Private Partnership Authority, defining terms related to the Act and the Authority's structure. They outline rules regarding the composition of the Board, meeting convening procedures, quorum requirements, and the appointment of co-opted members.

name: The Islamabad Nature Conservation and Wildlife Management Act, 2024

metadata.title: The Islamabad Nature Conservation and Wildlife Management Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, preservation, conservation, and management of nature within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes a Board for Nature Conservation and Wildlife Management to oversee these functions.

name: Establishment of Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority

metadata.title: The Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2024
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority under section 3(1) of the Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2024. The document serves as an official gazette notice issued by the Cabinet Division on March 19, 2024.

name: The Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2024

metadata.title: The Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2024
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal framework for the cultivation, extraction, refining, manufacturing, and sale of cannabis plant derivatives for medicinal and industrial purposes. It creates the Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority to oversee these activities in compliance with international conventions like the Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs, 1961.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Government to Government Agreement Mode- Manner and Procedure) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Privatisation Commission (Government to Government Agreement Mode and Procedure) Rules, 2023
metadata.repeals: Privatisation (Modes and Procedures) Rules, 2001; Privatisation Commission (Valuation of Property) Rules, 2007
metadata.summary: These rules establish the manner and procedure for carrying out privatisation under the Government to Government Agreement mode. They outline specific steps including hiring financial advisers, approving reference prices, and constituting negotiation committees for agreements with foreign states.

name: SRO 899(I)/2023.- Establishment of Anti-Rape Crisis Cells in Public Hospitals of the Province of the Sindh

metadata.title: Notification establishing Anti-Rape Crises Cells in the Province of Sindh
metadata.summary: This notification establishes Anti-Rape Crises Cells in twenty-six public hospitals across the Province of Sindh. It specifies the heads and members comprising these cells for each designated hospital.

name: SRO 359(I)/2023. The PMDC Employees (Service) Regulations, 2023

metadata.title: PMDC Employees (Service) Regulations, 2023
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the service rules for regular and temporary employees of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council. They define key terms related to appointments, misconduct, medical attendance, and disciplinary proceedings under the authority of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022.

name: The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Finance (Supplementary) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: Sales Tax Act, 1990; Income Tax Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain laws relating to taxes and duties in Pakistan. Specifically, it introduces amendments to the Sales Tax Act, 1990 regarding tax rates and collection procedures, and adds new provisions to the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 concerning advance tax on share acquisitions and functions.

name: S.R.O 1760(I)/2022.- Establishment to Anti Rape Crises Cells in Public Hospitals in Province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

metadata.title: Notification establishing Anti-Rape Crises Cells in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
metadata.summary: This notification establishes Anti-Rape Crises Cells in various public hospitals within the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It specifies the heads and members for each cell, including the Deputy Commissioner, Medical Superintendent, and Concerned SP Investigation.

name: The Salary of Judges of the High Court Order, 2022

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2022
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2018
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary scales for the Chief Justice and other judges of High Courts in Pakistan. It sets the Chief Justice's salary at Rs. 949,376 per month and every other judge's salary at Rs. 912,862 per month. The order also repeals the previous Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2018.

name: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2022

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2022
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2018
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary amounts for the Chief Justice of Pakistan and other Judges of the Supreme Court. It also repeals the previous order regarding these salaries from 2018.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Board Members Privileges and Facilities) Rules, 2021

metadata.title: Privatisation Commission (Board Members Privileges and Facilities) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish the privileges and facilities for Board Members of the Privatisation Commission, including honorariums for attending meetings and travelling allowances. They also outline the procedures for processing expenditure claims and the approval process for payments by the Commission.

name: The Financial Management and Powers of Principal Accounting Officers Regulations, 2021

metadata.title: Financial Management and Powers of Principal Accounting Officers Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the responsibilities and criteria for designating principal accounting officers within Federal Government Ministries, Divisions, and attached departments. They define the scope of financial management duties, including adherence to financial propriety, effective use of resources, and accountability before Parliament.

name: Federal Govemment is pleased to appoint the 12th January, 2021 to be the date on which the said Ordrinance shall come into force..

metadata.title: The Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This notification appoints January 12, 2021, as the date for the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Ordinance, 2020 to come into force. It was issued by the Federal Government under the powers of section 1(3) of the aforementioned Ordinance.

name: The PAF Air War College Institute Ordinance, 2021

metadata.title: PAF Air War College Institute Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This Ordinance re-organizes the PAF Air War College to establish it as a premier degree awarding institute. It provides for the creation of a body corporate with perpetual succession to impart higher education in defense, security studies, and various scientific fields.

name: The Companies (Maintenance and Audit of Cost Accounts) Regulations, 2020

metadata.title: The Companies (Maintenance and Audit of Cost Accounts) Regulations, 2020
metadata.summary: These regulations mandate the maintenance of specific cost accounting records for companies engaged in production, processing, manufacturing, or mining activities. They establish procedures for the appointment, tenure, and removal of cost auditors, as well as their powers and liabilities.

name: The Civil Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 2020

metadata.title: The Civil Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules establish the grounds for disciplinary proceedings against civil servants in Pakistan, covering issues of inefficiency, misconduct, and corruption. They define key terms such as 'authority', 'charges', and 'penalty' while outlining specific minor penalties like censure, withholding of increments, and reduction in pay scale.

name: No. 398 - No. 4-6/2006-Min-I - Chief Economist / Member (Economic Policy / Planning) to be placed in SPPS-II instead of MP-I Scale

metadata.title: Resolution of the Federal Government
metadata.amends: Cabinet Division's Resolution of even No. dated 30th October, 2013
metadata.summary: This resolution supplements a 2013 Cabinet Division order regarding the placement of Chief Economists or Members (Economic Policy/Planning) in the Special Professional Pay Scale-II. It specifically applies to those appointed from the open market rather than through internal selection.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Conduct of Board Meeting) Regulations 2019

metadata.title: Privatisation Commission (Conduct of Board Meeting) Regulations 2019
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedures for the Privatisation Commission regarding the conduct of its Board meetings and the submission of cases. They define key terms, outline specific matters that must be brought before the Board, and set rules for the preparation and scheduling of these meetings.

name: Coordination and Reporting Arrangements for Deputy Chairman, Planning Commission — Notification No. 4-6/2006-Min-II

metadata.title: Resolution No. 4-6/2006-Min-L.
metadata.summary: This resolution harmonizes and improves coordination within the top hierarchy of the Planning Commission. It mandates that the Deputy Chairman report to the Minister for Planning, Development and Reform on specific areas including agenda approval, PSDP finalization, and policy matters.

name: No. 216 - No. 1/5/2018-Imp.I - Reconstitution of the Steering Committee of the Federal Government Artists' Welfare Fund

metadata.title: Notification re-constituting Steering Committee of the Federal Government Artists' Welfare Fund
metadata.summary: This notification re-constitutes the Steering Committee of the Federal Government Artists' Welfare Fund with immediate effect. It lists the official and non-official members comprising the newly formed committee.

name: No. 178 - No. F. 5/7/2018-Com - Constitution of the Cabinet Committee on CPEC (CCoCPEC)

metadata.title: Notification constituting the Cabinet Committee on China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CCOCPEC)
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the Cabinet Committee on China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CCOCPEC) within the Government of Pakistan. It details the specific composition of the committee, listing the designated ministers and officials serving as Chairman, Members, or Secretary.

name: No. 143 - No. 2-3/2017-Min-I - Appointment of Federal Ministers Daniyal Aziz and Mumtaz Ahmed Tarar and Ministers of State Ayaz Ali Shah Sheerazi and Mir Dostain Khan Domki

metadata.title: Notification appointing Federal Ministers and Ministers of State
metadata.summary: This notification appoints specific individuals as Federal Ministers and Ministers of State in Pakistan. The appointments were made by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister under Article 92 of the Constitution, with oaths administered on August 10, 2017.

name: The Election Rule, 2017

metadata.title: The Election Rules, 2017
metadata.summary: These Rules provide the procedural framework for the Election Commission of Pakistan to perform its functions under the Constitution and the Elections Act, 2017. They define key terms related to Senate elections, such as continuing candidates, exhausted ballots, and transferred votes, while also outlining the Commission's meeting procedures and mechanisms for addressing contempt.

name: The Office of Federal Ombudsman for Protection against Harassment of women at the Workplace (Employees’ Service) Rules, 2014

metadata.title: Office of Federal Ombudsman for Protection against Harassment of women at the Workplace (Employees' Service) Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the protection against harassment of women at the workplace within the Office of the Federal Ombudsman. They define key terms, outline the establishment and appointment procedures for employees across various pay scales, and set up promotion and selection boards.

name: The Competition (General Enforcement) Regulations, 2007

metadata.title: Competition (General Enforcement) Regulations, 2007
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for general enforcement procedures under the Competition Ordinance, 2007. They define key terms such as 'applicant', 'Commission', and 'undertaking' while outlining specific rules for applying for exemptions from prohibited agreements.

name: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2007

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2007
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2006
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary scales for the Chief Justice and other Judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts of Pakistan. It also repeals the previous Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2006.

name: S. R. O. 656(I)/2007 — Further Amendments in the Federal Excise Rules, 2005

metadata.title: The Federal Excise Rules, 2005
metadata.summary: This document contains further amendments to the Federal Excise Rules, 2005 issued by the Central Board of Revenue. It specifically updates definitions regarding aircraft operators and modifies rules concerning banking and non-banking financial companies.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Valuation of Property) Rules, 2007

metadata.title: The Privatisation Commission (Valuation of Property) Rules, 2007
metadata.repeals: The Privatisation Commission (Valuation of Property) Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules establish the manner and procedure for valuing property during privatisation processes in Pakistan. They define key terms, specify applicable valuation methodologies such as DCF and Balance Sheet methods, and outline the process for preparing and approving reference prices by the Commission's Board and the Cabinet.

name: S. R. O. 751(I)/2006 — Furnishing of Statements by Petroleum Companies in Compliance with S.R.O. 543(I)/2006 and 559(I)/2006

metadata.title: Sales Tax
metadata.summary: This notification directs petroleum exploration companies to furnish tax statements as stipulated in a specific tax period. The requirement is for these statements to be submitted by the 25th day of the following month.

name: S. R. O. 750(I)/2006 — Notification of Changes in Federal Excise Notification S.R.O. 652(I)/2005

metadata.title: Notification No. S.R.O. 750(I)/2006
metadata.summary: This notification directs amendments to Notification No. S.R.O. 652(I)/2005 issued by the Central Board of Revenue. The changes include inserting 'and liquefied gas' after 'natural gas' and substituting specific wording regarding time limits.

name: S.R.O. 137(1)/2006 – Amendments to S.R.O. 934(I)/2005 under Sales Tax Act, 1990

metadata.title: Notification No. S.R.O. 137(1)/2006
metadata.summary: This notification directs further amendments to Notification No. S.R.O. 934(1/2005) under the Sales Tax Act, 1990. It adds new serial numbers and entries for various textile mills and industries to the relevant table.

name: No. 126 - No. 3-4/2004-Min.I; No. 8(2)/2002-Estt.1(148) - Appointment of Muhammad Ali Durrani as Special Assistant to PM and Prof. Dr. Atta-ur-Rahman as Adviser on Science and Technology

metadata.title: The Gazette of Pakistan
metadata.summary: This notification records several appointments and acting arrangements made by the President of Pakistan in November 2005. It includes the appointment of Mr. Muhammad Ali Durrani as Special Assistant to the Prime Minister, Prof. Atta-ur-Rahman as Adviser to the Prime Minister on Science and Technology, and Mr. Justice Rana Bhagwandas to act as Chief Justice during the absence of the Chief Justice abroad. Additionally, it designates Mr. Muhammad Yaqub to act as Speaker of the National Assembly.

name: No. F. 3(4) NGO/94 — Appointment of Dr. Abdul Halim Kazi as Member, Board of Directors, Trust for Voluntary Organizations (TVO)

metadata.title: Appointment of Dr. Abdul Halim Kazi as Member, Board of Directors, Trust for Voluntary Organizations (TVO)
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Dr. Abdul Halim Kazi of Sindh as a Member of the Board of Directors for the Trust for Voluntary Organizations (TVO). The appointment is effective immediately and covers a period of three years, following approval by the Prime Minister.

name: No. 37/Cab/2005 — Appointment of Ministers as Members of the Cabinet Committee on Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation (CCERR

metadata.title: Notification appointing Ministers as Members of the Cabinet Committee on Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation
metadata.summary: This notification appoints specific Ministers as Members of the Cabinet Committee on Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation (CCERR). The committee was previously constituted via a separate notification dated October 18, 2005.

name: The Federal Excise Act, 2005

metadata.title: The Federal Excise Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to duties of excise on goods manufactured, produced, imported, or consumed in Pakistan, as well as services provided there. It defines key terms such as 'goods', 'manufacture', 'Board', and 'Collector' and establishes the scope and commencement date for these provisions.

name: The Finance Act, 2005

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 2005. It enacts new provisions and amends existing laws, specifically substituting the Central Excises Act, 1944, and making further amendments to the Customs Act, 1969.

name: The Privatisation Commission (Declaration of Fidelity and Secracy) Rules, 2003

metadata.title: The Privatisation Commission (Declaration of Fidelity and Secrecy) Rules, 2003
metadata.summary: These rules establish the requirement for the Chairman, Secretary, members, consultants, officers, and employees of the Privatisation Commission to make a declaration of fidelity and secrecy. The document outlines the specific obligations regarding compliance with the Ordinance, prevention of personal interest influencing official conduct, and adherence to government decisions.

name: Finance Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2002. It amends the Central Excises Act, 1944 to update duties, adjudication powers, and appeal procedures.

name: No. 102 - No. 4-7/2001-Min - Constitution of a Special Selection Board in the Ministry of Labour for Community Welfare Attaches

metadata.title: Constitution of Special Selection Board in Ministry of Labour, Manpower and Overseas Pakistanis for Selection of Community Welfare Attaches (CWAs)
metadata.summary: This order establishes a Special Selection Board within the Ministry of Labour, Manpower and Overseas Pakistanis. Its purpose is to handle the selection process for Community Welfare Attaches (CWAs) for posting in Pakistan Missions abroad.

name: The Trade Marks Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Trade Marks Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: law relating to trade marks and unfair competition
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to trade marks and unfair competition in Pakistan. It provides for the registration, better protection of trade marks, and the prevention of the use of fraudulent marks.

name: No. 99 - No. 4-22/90-Min.I - Circulation of a Cabinet Division O.M. for information in the Law, Justice and Human Rights Division

metadata.title: null
metadata.summary: This document is a copy of the Cabinet Division's O.N. No. 1-22/90-Min-1 dated 12th March, 2001, endorsed for information by the Law, Justice and Human Rights Division. It appears to be an internal administrative notification regarding human rights matters.

name: The Natural Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Natural Gas Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Natural Gas Regulatory Authority to foster competition and improve efficiency in natural gas transportation and distribution. It was promulgated by the President due to the suspension of the National Assembly and Senate, aiming to increase private ownership and regulate the sector.

name: The Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 1997

metadata.title: The Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws relating to narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances in Pakistan. It aims to control their production, processing, trafficking, and regulate the treatment and rehabilitation of addicts.

name: No. 4-5/97-Min-I — Assignment of Charge of the Board of Investment to Mr. Muhammad Ishaq Dar, Minister for Commerce

metadata.title: Notification No. 4-5197-Min-I.
metadata.summary: This notification directs that Mr. Muhammad Ishaq Dar shall serve as the Minister in charge of the Board of Investment with immediate effect. The order was issued by the Prime Minister following the transfer of the Board of Investment from the Ministry of Industries and Investment to the Cabinet Division.

name: No. 8(10)-B&A-96 -Notification Regarding Stamp Duty Rates in Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT), 1997

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration) Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This document is a notification regarding the Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration) Order, 1980. It references the exercise of powers conferred by the President under this specific order and relates to Clause (a) of section 9 of the Stamp Duty Act.

name: The Awami Hajj Trust Ordinance, 1996

metadata.title: The Awami Hajj Trust Ordinance, 1996
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Awami Hajj Trust to mobilize savings from pilgrims intending to perform Hajj. It provides for the investment of these funds in Islamic modes and facilitates Hajj operations and related matters.

name: No. 57 - No. 4-8/95-Min-I(B) - Deletion of the Academy for Administrative Training, Lahore, from Schedule III to the Rules of Business, 1973

metadata.title: Notification regarding deletion of Academy for Training, Lahore from Schedule III to the Rules of Business, 1973
metadata.summary: This notification deletes the Academy for Training, Lahore (now renamed Civil Services Academy) from Schedule III of the Rules of Business, 1973. The deletion follows the Academy's conversion into an autonomous body via a resolution dated August 10, 1980.

metadata.summary: This notification redesignates the Minister for Works with effect from July 28, 1994. It was issued by the Cabinet Secretariat on July 17, 1995.

name: No. 50 - No. 2-19/93-Min-I - Redesignating Maj. Gen. (Retd.) Nasirullah Khan Babar as Minister for Interior, Narcotics Control and Federal Investigation
