The document confirms his return to complete the unexpired term of office previously held by Malik Sadullah Khan, which expires on March 20, 1997.

name: The Pakistan Telecommunication Ordinance, 1990

metadata.title: Pakistan Telecommunication Corporation Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Telecommunication Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition and powers of the Board, including the appointment of Directors by the Federal Government, and outlines the Corporation's functions to establish and maintain telecommunications services across Pakistan.

name: The Registration of Printing and Publications Ordinance, 1990

metadata.title: Registration of Printing Press and Publications Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates matters relating to publications and printing presses in Pakistan. It establishes requirements for printers and publishers to make authenticated declarations before the District Magistrate and mandates specific particulars to be printed on books and papers.

name: The Special Courts for Speedy Trials Ordinance, 1990

metadata.title: Special Courts for Speedly Trial Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Special Courts in Pakistan to ensure the speedy trial of specific offences deemed gruesome, brutal, or shocking to public morality. It outlines the constitution of these courts, their jurisdiction over pending and new cases, and mandates strict procedural timelines to prevent delays in investigations and trials.

name: The Registration of Printing and Publications Ordinance, 1990

metadata.title: Registration of Printing Press and Publications Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates matters relating to publications and printing presses in Pakistan. It establishes requirements for printers and publishers to make authenticated declarations before keeping or operating a press, and it mandates specific details to be printed on books and papers.

name: The Sales Tax Act, 1990

metadata.title: Sales Tax (Amendment) Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sales Tax Act, 1951 by substituting Chapters I to XVI with new provisions outlined in the Third Schedule. It also introduces amendments to the Banks Nationalization Act, 1974 and defines key terms such as 'goods', 'input tax', and 'Board' for the purposes of the sales tax regime.

name: The Finance Act, 1990

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1990
metadata.amends: The Provisional Collection of Taxes Act, 1931; The Wireless Telegraphy Act, 1933; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1990. It amends several existing laws, including the Provisional Collection of Taxes Act, 1931, the Wireless Telegraphy Act, 1933, the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944, and the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962.

name: The National Tariff Commission Act, 1990

metadata.title: National Tariff Commission Act, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Tariff Commission as a body corporate to advise the Federal Government on tariff measures and assistance for indigenous industries. The Commission is tasked with promoting exports, improving competitiveness, and countering unfair trade practices like dumping.

name: The Registration of Printing Press and Publications Ordinance, 1989

metadata.title: Registration of Printing Press and Publications Ordinance, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates matters relating to publications and printing presses in Pakistan. It establishes requirements for the registration of printing presses, declarations by keepers and publishers, and the particulars that must be printed on books and papers.

name: The Finance Act, 1989

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1989
metadata.amends: Post Office Act, 1898; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 1989. It also amends specific existing laws, including the Post Office Act, 1898 and the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944.

name: The Registration of Printing Press and Publications Ordinance, 1989

metadata.title: Registration of Printing Press and Publications Ordinance, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates matters relating to publications and printing presses in Pakistan. It establishes requirements for declarations by keepers of printing presses and publishers, defines key terms such as 'newspaper' and 'printing press', and outlines the powers of District Magistrates regarding the authentication of these declarations.

name: The National Registration (Application to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1989

metadata.title: The National Registration (Application to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1989
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the National Registration Act, 1973 to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It extends the Act and its associated rules, notifications, and orders to these areas effective immediately upon publication.

name: The Registration of Printing Press and Publications Ordinance, 1989

metadata.title: Registration of Printing Press and Publications Ordinance, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates matters relating to publications and printing presses in Pakistan. It establishes requirements for the registration of printing presses, declarations by printers and publishers, and mandates that specific particulars be printed on books and papers.

name: The Finance Act, 1988

metadata.title: Finance Act, 1988
metadata.amends: Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Sales Tax Act, 1951; Wealth-tax Act, 1963; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1988. It also amends several existing laws including the Central Excises and Salt Act, Sales Tax Act, Wealth-tax Act, and Customs Act.

name: The National Tariff Commission Ordinance, 1988

metadata.title: The National Tariff Commission Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Tariff Commission as a body corporate to advise the Federal Government on tariff measures and assistance for indigenous industries. The Commission is empowered to investigate matters related to protecting local industry, improving competitiveness, promoting exports, and countering unfair trade practices like dumping.

name: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas (Determination of Last Preceding Census) Regulation, 1988

metadata.title: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas (Determination of Last Preceding Census) Regulation, 1988
metadata.summary: This Regulation determines that the 1972 census shall be treated as the last preceding census for the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It applies to seat allocation in the National Assembly and the application of the Delimitation of Constituencies Act, 1974.

name: The Tax Laws (Repeal) Ordinance, 1988

metadata.title: Tax Laws (Repeal) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.repeals: Central Excises and Salt Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988; Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals two specific tax laws: the Central Excises and Salt Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988, and the Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan under Article 89 of the Constitution because the National Assembly was not in session.

name: The Finance (Revised) Ordinance, 1988

metadata.title: Finance (Revised) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.amends: Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Sales Tax Act, 1951; Wealth-tax Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the Federal Government's financial proposals for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 1988. It amends several existing laws, including the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944, the Sales Tax Act, 1951, and the Wealth-tax Act, 1963, to adjust duties, rates, and administrative powers.

name: The Enforcement of Shari'ah (Revised) Ordinance, 1988

metadata.title: The Enforcement of Shari'ah (Revised) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Shari'ah as the supreme source of law in Pakistan and outlines the procedures for enforcing it. It creates a mechanism for courts to refer questions regarding laws repugnant to Shari'ah to the Federal Shari'at Court or High Courts for decision within sixty days.

name: The Registration of Printing Press and Publication Ordinance, 1988

metadata.title: Registration of Printing Press and Publications Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates matters relating to publications and printing presses in Pakistan. It establishes requirements for declarations by keepers of printing presses and publishers, as well as rules regarding the particulars that must be printed on books and papers.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1988

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 1988
metadata.amends: Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Sales Tax Act, 1951; Wealth-tax Act, 1963; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 1988. It amends several existing laws including the Central Excises and Salt Act, Sales Tax Act, Wealth-tax Act, and Customs Act.

name: The Enforcement of Shari'ah Ordinance, 1988

metadata.title: The Enforcement of Shari'ah Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Shari'ah as the supreme source of law in Pakistan and a fundamental norm for state policy. It empowers courts to refer questions regarding laws repugnant to Shari'ah to the Federal Shariat Court or High Courts for examination and decision within sixty days.

name: Order dated 29-5-1988 regarding Dissolution of the National Assembly and the Cabinet

metadata.title: The Order of the President dissolving the National Assembly
metadata.summary: This order dissolves the National Assembly and the Cabinet with immediate effect. It was issued by General Mohammad Zia-ul-Haq, President of Pakistan, citing a breakdown of law and order and the inability to govern according to the Constitution.

name: The Senate (Election of Members from the Federal Capital) Order, 1988

metadata.title: The Senate (Election of Members from the Federal Capital) Order, 1988
metadata.repeals: The Senate (Members from the Federal Capital) Order, 1973
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the manner in which members of the Senate from the Federal Capital shall be elected by the National Assembly. It applies the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 with specific modifications to replace references to provinces and provincial assemblies with references to the Federal Capital and the National Assembly.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 107 Martial Law (Pending Proceedings) Order, 1985

metadata.title: Martial Law (Pending Proceedings) Order, 1985
metadata.summary: This Order cancels most Martial Law Regulations and Orders issued after July 5, 1977, while preserving penalties for specific listed provisions. It transfers pending cases from military courts to ordinary criminal courts and grants immunity for actions taken in good faith under the Order.

name: The Election Commission Orders (Repeal) Order, 1985

metadata.title: The Election Commission Orders (Repeal) Order, 1985
metadata.repeals: The Election Commission Order, 1977 and the Election Commission (Reconstitution) Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Order was issued by the President of Pakistan on December 29, 1985, to repeal previous election-related orders. Specifically, it repeals the Election Commission Order, 1977 and the Election Commission (Reconstitution) Order, 1980.

name: The Gift-tax Act (Repeal) Order, 1985

metadata.title: The Gift-tax Act (Repeal) Order, 1985
metadata.repeals: The Gift-tax Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Order repeals the Gift-tax Act, 1963, effective from July 1, 1985. It provides for the transfer of pending proceedings to designated officers and ensures that liability for gifts made before the repeal date remains unaffected.

name: The Finance Act, 1985

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1985
metadata.amends: Wealth Tax Act, 1963; Customs Act, 1969; Income Tax Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1985. It amends several existing laws, including the Wealth Tax Act, 1963, the Customs Act, 1969, and the Income Tax Ordinance, 1979.

name: The Regional Development Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1985

metadata.title: The Regional Development Finance Corporation Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Regional Development Finance Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the corporation's authorized and paid-up share capital, specifying contributions from the National Development Finance Corporation, nationalized banks, and other financial institutions.

name: The Lahore University of Management Sciences Order, 1985

metadata.title: The Lahore University of Management Sciences Order, 1985
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Lahore University of Management Sciences as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's powers, including instruction in management sciences, awarding degrees, and establishing faculties, while ensuring admission for persons of all religions and backgrounds.

name: The International Islamic University Ordinance, 1985

metadata.title: International Islamic University Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and re-organizes the existing Islamic University, Islamabad, into an autonomous International Islamic University. It establishes the new institution with its principal seat at Islamabad to promote education, training, and research in various fields including Islamic learning and social sciences.

name: The Women's University Ordinance, 1985

metadata.title: Women's University Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Women's University with its principal seat at Islamabad. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its powers regarding instruction, research, examinations, and affiliation of colleges.

name: The Literacy Ordinance, 1985

metadata.title: The Literacy Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to encourage literacy in Pakistan by restricting the issuance of certain licenses and passports, as well as federal government employment, to literate persons only. It defines a literate person as someone certified to read a newspaper and write a simple letter, with specific provisions for physically or mentally handicapped individuals.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 105 Rehabilitation of Karachi Hotel Project Order, 1985

metadata.title: Rehabilitation of Karachi Hotel Project Order, 1985
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order appoints a Custodian to take over the ownership and administration of the Karachi Hotel Project, which includes specific railway land in Karachi. The order cancels existing leases on the railway land, terminates most contracts related to the project, and establishes a priority order for paying compensation from the sale proceeds to various creditors and the original owners.

name: The Senate (Members from Federal Capital) Order, 1985

metadata.title: The Senate (Members from the Federal Capital) Order, 1985
metadata.amends: The Senate (Members from the Federal Capital) Order, 1973
metadata.summary: This Order specifies the manner in which members of the Senate from the Federal Capital are to be chosen. It applies the rules laid down in the Senate (Members from the Federal Capital) Order, 1973, with a modification replacing references to the Speaker with references to the Chief Election Commissioner.

name: The Revival of the Constitution of 1973 Order, 1985

metadata.title: The Revival of the Constitution of 1973 Order, 1985
metadata.amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Constitution of 1973 to revive its provisions following a period of martial law. It specifies dates for the first meetings of the National Assembly, Senate, and Provincial Assemblies to facilitate elections and business transactions.

name: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Basis of Elections)(Repeal) Order, 1985

metadata.title: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Basis of Elections) (Repeal) Order, 1985
metadata.repeals: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Basis of Elections) Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order was made by the President of Pakistan to repeal a previous legal instrument regarding the basis of elections for national and provincial assemblies. It came into force immediately upon publication.

name: The house of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1985

metadata.title: The Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Third Amendment) Order, 1985
metadata.amends: The Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order amends Article 10 of the Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977. It updates the qualifications and disqualifications for members of the National Assembly, Senate, and Provincial Assemblies in accordance with the Proclamation of July 5, 1977.

name: Martial Law Regulation No. 63

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation
metadata.summary: This Regulation empowers the authority to cancel leases or allotments and order the demolition of structures that violate the Master Plan, prejudice public interest, or constitute illegal encroachment. It also prohibits depositing garbage outside designated areas and prescribes rigorous imprisonment or fines for contravention.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 94

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 94
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order establishes a Land Reforms Tribunal to inquire into contraventions of land reform laws and rules. It grants the Tribunal specific powers similar to a civil court, including summoning witnesses and receiving evidence, while also defining its jurisdiction over cases involving land disputes under martial law.

name: Martial Law Regulation No. 57

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 57
metadata.summary: This regulation empowers the Martial Law Administrator to cancel illegal acquisitions of agricultural land belonging to defunct Evacuee Trusts and order their restoration. It grants authorities the power to evict occupants, demolish structures, and use necessary force to recover possession, while nullifying any conflicting court judgments or pending cases.

name: Martial Law Regulation No. 56

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 56
metadata.summary: This regulation declares the Freemasons association unlawful and dissolved. It vests all properties belonging to the association in the respective Provincial Government without compensation and causes pending legal proceedings by the association to abate.

name: The Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Ordinance, 1982

metadata.title: Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Civil Aviation Authority to regulate and control civil aviation activities in Pakistan. It creates a body corporate responsible for developing infrastructure, managing airports, and providing essential services such as air traffic control, navigation, and search and rescue.

name: The Medical and Dental Degrees Ordinance, 1982

metadata.title: The Medical and Dental Degrees Ordinance, 1982
metadata.repeals: The Medical Degrees Act, 1916
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Medical Degrees Act, 1916 with certain modifications to regulate the conferment of medical and dental degrees in Pakistan. It restricts the authority to grant such qualifications to specified universities and designated bodies while imposing strict penalties for unauthorized conferment or false assumption of titles.

name: The Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1982

metadata.title: The Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority to manage and maintain the Korangi Fisheries Harbour within Port Qasim. It provides for the planning, construction, operation, and maintenance of the harbour to exploit fisheries resources beyond territorial waters.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1982

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 1982
metadata.amends: Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Sales Tax Act, 1951; Wealth-tax Act, 1963; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1982. It also amends several existing laws including the Central Excises and Salt Act, Sales Tax Act, Wealth-tax Act, and Customs Act.

name: The Foreign Currency Loans (Rate of Exchange) Order, 1982

metadata.title: The Foreign Currency Loans (Rate of Exchange) Order, 1982
metadata.summary: This Order declares the applicable rate of exchange for converting outstanding foreign currency loans into Pakistan currency for repayment purposes. It specifies that this rate shall be the one in force under section 23 of the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956 on the day of actual repayment.

name: S. R. O. 147 (I)|82.- Amendment in the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry Under Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: Amendment in the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry
subjects: Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry. The amendment substitutes a specific roster regarding the rotation of candidates from various provinces for the years 1981-1992.

name: The Federal Council (Majlis-e-Shura) Order, 1981

metadata.title: The Federal Council (Majlis-e-Shura) Order, 1981
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Federal Council (Majlis-e-Shura) as an interim advisory body to facilitate association and consultation regarding state affairs. It defines the composition, nomination process, term of office, and functions of the Council, including its role in discussing development plans and budgets.

name: S. R.O. 879 (I)|81.- Recognition and Classification of Pakistan Solvent Extractors’ Association, Karachi as ‘B’ Class Trade Organization

metadata.title: Trade S.R.O. Organizations 879 (1) 81
metadata.summary: This notification publishes the name of a registered trade organisation recognised under the Solvent Act, 1961. The Federal Government classifies this entity as a B' class trade organisation pursuant to section 7(3) of that Act.

name: The Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.repeals: Various Federal laws specified in the First Schedule (including The Slavery Act, 1843; The Supreme Courts' Officers Trading Act, 1848; etc.)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance revises Federal laws by expressly repealing spent or unnecessary laws and making specific amendments to others. It also includes declarations regarding the applicability of certain laws within Pakistan.

name: The Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO) and a Space Research Council to promote the peaceful uses of space. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Council, its Executive Committee, and the Commission itself.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 85

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 85
metadata.repeals: Rawalpindi Electric Licence, 1923; Jhelum Electric Licence, 1928; Abbottabad Electric Licence, 1931; Gujar Khan Electric Licence, 1935; Chakwal Electric Licence, 1935; Multan Electric Licence, 1922; Campbellpur Electric Licence, 1939; Muzaffargarh Electric Licence, 1935
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order revokes several electric licenses held by various companies in Pakistan due to the need for government control over their management. It mandates that the Water and Power Development Authority (WAPDA) take over the functions, assets, and liabilities of these companies by May 23, 1981.

name: The Population Welfare Planning Programme (Appointment and Termination of Service) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: Population Welfare Planning Programme (Appointment and Termination of Service) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the restructuring and reorganization of the Population Programme, including the appointment and termination of service for its employees. It defines key terms such as 'appointing authority', 'Council', and 'Board' within the context of Pakistan's family planning efforts.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 81

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 81
metadata.summary: This order defines a 'feature film' and mandates that no person may produce such films for public exhibition unless registered with the Federal Government. It also empowers the Federal Government to declare any film as uncertified under the Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979, and provides a mechanism for reconsideration of such declarations.

name: The Settlement of Disputes of Immovable Property (Chitral) Order, 1980

metadata.title: The Settlement of Disputes of Immovable Property (Chitral) Order, 1980
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the settlement of disputes regarding immovable property in the former State of Chitral. It establishes the authority of the Provincial Government or its authorized officers to decide these disputes and outlines the process for appeals and reviews.

name: The Distribution of Property (Chitral) Order, 1980

metadata.title: The Distribution of Property (Chitral) Order, 1980
metadata.repeals: Acceding State (Property) Order, 1961; Distribution of Property (Chitral) Regulation, 1974
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the distribution of properties in the former State of Chitral, distinguishing between State property and private property of the ex-Mehtar. It establishes the Provincial Government's authority to determine property status based on Commission recommendations and sets out procedures for review and suspension of orders.

name: The Pakistan Defence Officers Housing Authority Order, 1980

metadata.title: The Employees of Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Allocation to Provinces) Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order allocates employees of the Government of West Pakistan serving in the Electricity and Irrigation Departments to specific provinces based on their service location or permanent residence. It was issued by the President under powers conferred by the Province of West Pakistan (Dissolution) Order, 1970.

name: The Notifications Relating to Election (Rescission) Order, 1979

metadata.title: Notifications Relating to Election (Rescission) Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order rescinds all notifications issued by the Election Commission under specific sections of the Representation of the People Act, 1976 on or after September 25, 1979. It was promulgated by the President in pursuance of the Proclamation of July 5, 1977.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 66

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 66
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order establishes a Council of Elders in the North-West Frontier Province to resolve specified boundary disputes. It outlines the Commissioner's power to refer disputes to this council, pass decrees based on their findings, and manage appeals to the Governor.

name: The Protection of Rights in Industrial Property Order, 1979

metadata.title: The Protection of Rights in Industrial Property Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Order protects rights in industrial property used in production, manufacturing, or mineral extraction across Pakistan. It prohibits deprivation of such property except by law and mandates adequate compensation for any compulsory acquisition.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 58

metadata.title: The [Prime Minister's Inspection Commission] Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order establishes the Federal Inspection Commission to be constituted by the Prime Minister. The Commission is empowered to conduct inspections and inquiries into federal ministries, departments, and corporations regarding issues such as inefficiency, corruption, and mal-administration.

name: The Freedom of Association Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Freedom of Association Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order grants every citizen not in the service of Pakistan the right to form or join political parties, subject to reasonable restrictions. It mandates that political parties must account for their funds according to law and establishes a mechanism for the Supreme Court to review declarations regarding parties prejudicial to national security or Islamic Ideology.

name: The Acting Governors (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Acting Governors (Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order grants allowances and privileges to persons who held the office of Acting Governor under the Governor's (Oath of Office) Order, 1977. It stipulates that these benefits are deemed to have been admissible during the period they held office, referencing the Governors' Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Order, 1975.

name: The Freedom of Association Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Freedom of Association Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order grants every citizen not in the service of Pakistan the right to form or join political parties, subject to reasonable restrictions. It mandates that political parties must account for their funds according to law and establishes a mechanism for the Supreme Court to review declarations regarding parties prejudicial to national security or Islamic Ideology.

name: The West Pakistan (Dissolution) (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 1978

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Dissolution) (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order is made by the President to address difficulties arising from the dissolution of West Pakistan. It mandates the submission of the Comptroller and Auditor General's report for the financial year ending June 30, 1970, and grants the President powers to pass orders on unexamined accounts and authorize withdrawals from the Consolidated Fund for necessary expenditures.

name: The President’s Succession Order, 1978

metadata.title: The President's Succession Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the procedure for filling the office of President if it becomes vacant due to death, incapacity, resignation, or other reasons before a new election. It designates the Chief Martial Law Administrator (or another designated person) as the acting President and outlines the oath required upon entering office.

name: The Transfer of Managed Establishments Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Transfer of Managed Establishments Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order provides the Federal Government with the authority to invite bids and transfer shares or proprietary interests in managed establishments acquired under Article 7B of the Economic Reforms Order, 1972. It outlines the procedures for electing Board Directors, transferring administration upon such election or transfer, conducting special audits, and assuming liabilities of the establishments.

name: The West Pakistan (Dissolution) (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 1978

metadata.title: The West Pakistan (Dissolution) (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order is made by the President to address difficulties arising from the dissolution of West Pakistan. It mandates the submission of the Comptroller and Auditor General's report for the financial year ending June 30, 1970, and grants the President powers to pass orders on unexamined accounts and authorize withdrawals from the Consolidated Fund for necessary expenditures.

name: The Transfer of Managed Establishments Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Transfer of Managed Establishments Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order provides the Federal Government with the authority to invite bids and transfer shares or proprietary interests in managed establishments acquired under Article 7B of the Economic Reforms Order, 1972. It outlines the procedures for electing Board Directors, transferring administration upon such election or transfer, conducting special audits, and assuming liabilities of the establishments.

name: The Budgetary Provisions Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Budgetary Provisions Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order mandates the Federal and Provincial Governments to prepare Annual Budget Statements before the start of each financial year. It also requires the preparation of a Schedule of Authorised Expenditure authenticated by the President and Governors, which serves as the authority for withdrawing funds from consolidated funds.

name: The Acting President Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Acting President Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the procedures for acting as President if the office becomes vacant or the President is unable to perform their functions. It designates the Chief Justice of Pakistan to act in these roles and outlines the specific oath required before entering office.

name: The Abandoned Properties (Management) (Continuance in Force) Order, 1978

metadata.title: The Abandoned Properties (Management) (Continuance in Force) Order, 1978
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the continuance in force of the Abandoned Properties (Management) Act, 1975. It allows the Act to be amended or repealed by a Federal Law as if it related to a matter enumerated in the Federal Legislative List.

name: The Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Disqualification for Membership) Order, 1977

metadata.title: The Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Disqualification for Membership) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order establishes Special Courts to inquire into and decide cases of misconduct involving high-ranking officials and members of Parliament or Provincial Assemblies. It defines specific types of misconduct, outlines the procedure for references by the President or Governor, and stipulates a seven-year disqualification period for those found guilty.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDER No. 23

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 23
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Order provides for the submission of review petitions by persons compulsorily removed from government or corporation service between January 1, 1972, and July 5, 1977. It establishes Review Boards to examine these petitions after giving an opportunity to be heard, while clarifying that reinstatement does not entitle petitioners to damages or arrears.

name: The Supreme Court Judges (Oath of Office) Order, 1977

metadata.title: The Supreme Court Judges (Oath of Office) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order mandates that every Judge of the Supreme Court must take an oath of office before a specified time. It stipulates that any Judge who fails to make the required oath shall cease to hold office immediately.

name: The High Courts (Appointment of Acting Chief Justice) Order, 1977

metadata.title: The High Courts (Appointment of Acting Chief Justice) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the President to appoint a High Court Judge as Acting Chief Justice when the incumbent is acting as a Provincial Governor. It also provides for the transfer of judges between High Courts for such appointments and outlines compensation rules.

name: The High Court Judges (Scrutiny of Appointments) Order, 1977

metadata.title: The High Court Judges (Scrutiny of Appointments) Order, 1977
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Supreme Judicial Council's authority to examine records regarding High Court judges appointed between January 5, 1977, and July 5, 1977. It mandates that any judge whose appointment was not based on merit or established procedure must cease holding office immediately.

name: The Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975

metadata.title: The Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Speaker's Remuneration and Privileges Ordinance, 1965 (V of 1965), the Speaker's Allowances and Privileges Order, 1970 (P.O. No. 23 of 1970), the Chairman and Deputy Chairman of Senate (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1973 (P.O. No. 17 of 1973), and the Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1975 (IX of 1975)
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Deputy Chairman of the Senate and the Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly. It also repeals several previous Ordinances and Orders related to the remuneration and privileges of the Speaker and Chairman.

name: The Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1975

metadata.title: The Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the salaries, allowances, and privileges for the Deputy Chairman of the Senate and the Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly. It details specific financial provisions including base salary, equipment allowance, transport benefits, and official residence rights.

name: The Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1975

metadata.title: The Distribution of Revenues and Grants-in-Aid Order, 1975
metadata.repeals: Articles 3, 4 and 5 of this Order (by P.O. No. 1 of 1991); Omitted by the Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the framework for distributing net proceeds of certain taxes between the Federation and the Provinces based on recommendations from a National Finance Commission. It was promulgated by the President in pursuance of Article 160 of the Constitution to implement the Commission's findings regarding fiscal distribution.

name: The Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 1975

metadata.title: The Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the preparation and revision of electoral rolls for the election of members to the National Assembly from the Federally Administered Tribal Areas. It establishes procedures for Political Agents or Deputy Commissioners to compile these rolls, including annual revisions and corrections, while prohibiting court challenges to their validity.

name: The Pakistan (Audit and Accounts) Order, 1973

metadata.title: The Pakistan (Audit and Accounts) Order, 1973
metadata.summary: This Order determines the terms and conditions of service, term of office, and powers and functions of the Auditor-General of Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President under specific clauses of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

name: The Carriage by Air (International Convention) Act (Application to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Carriage by Air (International Convention) Act (Application to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1972
metadata.amends: The Carriage by Air (International Convention) Act, 1966
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the provisions of the Carriage by Air (International Convention) Act, 1966 to the Tribal Areas of Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President on December 1, 1972, and comes into force immediately.

name: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Provincially Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies certain laws to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas. It details the transfer of properties, funds, debts, and liabilities from a dissolved Corporation to the Federal Government or an agency determined by it.

name: The Chairman of the Federal Public Service Commission (Terms and Conditions) Order, 1972

metadata.title: The Chairman of the Federal Public Service Commission (Terms and Conditions) Order, 1972
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the salary, privileges, and allowances for the Chairman of the Federal Public Service Commission. It also specifies that other terms and conditions of service are governed by existing regulations.

name: PROCLAMATION

metadata.title: The Proclamation dated the 4th June 1955
metadata.repeals: The Proclamation dated the 29th May 1954
metadata.summary: This notification publishes a Proclamation issued by the Governor-General on June 4, 1955. The Proclamation revokes an earlier order dated May 29, 1954, which had directed the Governor of East Bengal to assume legislative powers under Section 92-A of the Government of India Act, 1935.

name: The Economic Reforms (Protection of Industries) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Economic Reforms (Protection of Industries) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation protects industries by empowering the Federal Government to intervene in debtor-creditor disputes within established undertakings. It grants the Government authority to call upon debtors to pay dues, convert debts into share capital or debentures, and revoke improper contracts made by previous management.

name: The Dir and Swat (Settlement of Disputes of Immovable Property) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Dir and Swat (Settlement of Disputes of Immovable Property) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes the legal framework for deciding disputes regarding ownership, rights, or interests in immovable property within the former States of Dir and Swat. It empowers the Provincial Government or authorized officers to adjudicate these disputes based on recommendations from a specific Commission, while explicitly excluding courts from entertaining such proceedings.

name: The Dir and Swat (Devolution and Distribution of Property) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Dir and Swat (Devolution and Distribution of Property) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation determines the classification of property in the former States of Dir and Swat as either State or private property belonging to ex-Rulers. It establishes the mechanism for distributing this private property among the respective heirs based on recommendations from a specific Commission.

name: The West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Revocation of Sales or Transfer) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation (Revocation of Sale or Transfer) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation empowers the Federal Government to revoke sales or transfers of property made by the West Pakistan Industrial Development Corporation if deemed necessary in the public interest. It establishes a committee to determine compensation for affected persons based on various factors and outlines procedures for recovering possession of the property.

name: The Enemy Property (Revocation of Sales) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Enemy Property (Revocation of Sales) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation empowers the Federal Government to revoke sales of enemy property made after September 6, 1965, if deemed necessary in the public interest. Upon revocation, the property vests back in the Custodian, who may recover possession, while a designated Committee determines compensation for the affected persons based on specific criteria.

name: The Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides for the taking over of privately managed schools and colleges by the Federal or Provincial Governments. It defines specific institutions as 'privately-managed' and stipulates that such establishments, along with their attached properties, shall vest in the respective government starting from September 1, 1972.

name: The Removal From Service (Review Petition) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Removal from Service (Review Petition) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides a mechanism for persons dismissed, removed, or reduced in rank under Martial Law Regulation No. 114 to submit a review petition to the Chief Martial Law Administrator. It establishes specific filing deadlines based on the date of the order and the employee's location, while granting the Administrator power to confirm, modify, or rescind such orders without providing an opportunity to show cause.

name: The National Press Trust (Suspension of Board of Trustees and Directors) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The National Press Trust (Suspension of Board of Trustees and Directors) Regulation, 1972
metadata.summary: This Regulation suspends the Board of Trustees and the Board of Directors of the National Press Trust and all institutions publishing publications controlled by that Trust. All powers and functions are vested in the Chairman of the National Press Trust, who may exercise them without approval from the suspended boards.

name: The Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) (Punjab) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) (Punjab) Regulation, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Co-operative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This regulation reconstitutes a martial law order regarding the repayment of loans by borrowers from cooperative banks in Punjab. It mandates specific repayment schedules for unsecured and secured loans exceeding Rs. 10,000 and outlines penalties, including imprisonment and fines, for non-compliance.

name: ORDER No. 32

metadata.title: Order No. 32
metadata.summary: This order declares that Rear Admiral U. A. Saeed (Retired) ceases to hold the office of Managing Director of the National Shipping Corporation effective December 23, 1971. It states that this order takes effect immediately and cannot be challenged in any court.

name: The Foreign Exchange Repatriation Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange Repatriation Regulation, 1972
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Regulation No. 34
metadata.summary: This regulation mandates that citizens holding foreign exchange outside Pakistan must declare it to the State Bank of Pakistan and repatriate it within a specified timeframe. It provides a bonus on repatriated funds, exempts them from certain taxes, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

name: The National and Provincial Assemblies Bye-elections (Annulment) Order, 1971

metadata.title: The National and Provincial Assemblies Bye-elections (Annulment) Order, 1971
metadata.summary: This Order annuls bye-elections held in East Pakistan for the National and Provincial Assemblies. It specifically targets elections conducted pursuant to notifications issued by the Chief Election Commissioner between September and December 1971.

name: The West Pakistan Rangers (Reconstitution) Order, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Rangers (Reconstitution) Order, 1971
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the reconstitution and continuance of the West Pakistan Rangers as a force common to the Provinces of Punjab and Sind. It modifies the provisions of the West Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959, to reflect this new status and defines the powers of the President and Provincial Governments regarding the force.

name: The Co-operative Societies (Repayment of Loans) (Sind) Regulation, 1972

metadata.title: The Co-operative Societies (Repayment of Loans) (Sind) Regulation, 1972
metadata.amends: Martial Law Order No. 18 as amended by Martial Law Order No. 26
metadata.summary: This regulation amends Martial Law Orders to reconstitute provisions regarding the recovery of loans taken by Apex Bank, Central Bank, and Co-operative Societies. It defines key terms such as 'benami loan', 'bad debt', and 'insufficiently secured' loans within the context of Sindh's cooperative banking system.

name: The Peshawar District and Tribal Areas (Settlement of Disputes) Regulation, 1971

metadata.title: The Peshawar District and Tribal Areas (Settlement of Disputes) Regulation, 1971
metadata.summary: This Regulation establishes a Council of Elders to settle specified boundary disputes in the Peshawar District and Tribal Areas. It grants the Commissioner authority to refer disputes to this Council, pass decrees based on their findings, and prevents courts from granting injunctions regarding these matters.

name: The Karachi Race Club Limited (Improvement of Management) Regulation, 1971

metadata.title: The Karachi Race Club Limited (Improvement of Management) Regulation, 1971
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Regulation was promulgated by General A.M. Yahya Khan to address the mismanagement of the Karachi Race Club Limited. It dissolves the existing Managing Committee and appoints an Administrator under the control of the Martial Law Administrator, Zone 'D', to reorganize the club's affairs and frame new Articles of Association.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION No. 76

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No. 76
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Regulation Nos. 60 and 61
metadata.summary: This regulation prohibits persons from organizing or convening public meetings, demonstrations, or processions that are not religious, funeral, or marriage events. It also forbids attendance at any such prohibited gatherings and defines specific types of locations considered 'public places' under this rule.

name: The Convention Muslim League and Awami League (Scrutiny of Funds) Regulation, 1971

metadata.title: The Convention Muslim League and Awami League (Scrutiny of Funds) Regulation, 1971
metadata.summary: This regulation declares the funds of the Pakistan Muslim League (Convention Muslim League) and the All Pakistan Awami League forfeited to the Federal Government. These funds, held in banks under the names of the parties or their representatives, are transferred to the Federal Consolidated Fund for utilization according to that fund's purposes.

name: The Judges (Compulsory leave) Order, 1970

metadata.title: The Judges (Compulsory Leave) Order, 1970
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the President to require Supreme Court and High Court Judges to proceed on compulsory leave during inquiries into their capacity or conduct. It specifies that judges on such leave receive half allowances or salary, with full pay restored if they are later cleared of misconduct.

name: The Enemy Property (Payment of Money Due to Enemy) Regulation, 1970

metadata.title: The Enemy Property (Payment of Money Due to Enemy) Regulation, 1970
metadata.summary: This Regulation empowers the Custodian of Enemy Property to issue orders for the payment of money or delivery of assets due to enemies, enemy firms, or enemy subjects. It grants the Custodian authority to take possession of property, sell assets via auction, and attach property to prevent alienation if compliance with payment orders is not met within the specified timeframe.

name: The Government Agricultural Land (Recovery of Illegal Possession) Regulation, 1969

metadata.title: The Government Agricultural Land (Recovery of Illegal Possession) Regulation, 1969
metadata.summary: This Regulation provides the legal framework for the Federal Government to recover possession of agricultural land allotted to gallantry awardees when leases expire or are terminated due to breach of covenant. It authorizes officers to evict unauthorized occupants after serving a notice and establishes specific procedures involving Martial Law Zonal Administrators and Tribunals for cases pending in courts.

name: The Living Beyond Ostensible Means (Punishment) Regulation, 1969

metadata.title: The Living Beyond Ostensible Means (Punishment) Regulation, 1969
metadata.summary: This regulation punishes persons in the service of Pakistan or serving in law-established institutions who assume a style of living beyond their ostensible means. It also penalizes those who own property disproportionate to their lawful income, either in their own name or that of their dependents.

name: The Removal From Service (Special Provisions) Regulation, 1969

metadata.title: The Removal from Service (Special Provisions) Regulation, 1969
metadata.summary: This Regulation mandates the surrender of properties acquired through unlawful means by government officials and establishes penalties for failure to comply. It outlines the authority's power to dismiss or remove civil servants for inefficiency, misconduct, corruption, or subversive activities, including specific procedures for hearings before a tribunal.

name: The Improper Acquisition of Property Regulation, 1969

metadata.title: The Improper Acquisition of Property Regulation, 1969
metadata.summary: This Regulation mandates the immediate surrender of properties acquired through unlawful means, bribery, or corruption to the Federal Government. It prescribes rigorous imprisonment and confiscation of assets for individuals who fail to submit required statements or refuse to surrender such properties without valid legal exceptions.

name: The Income Tax (Correction of Returns and False Declaration) Regulation, 1969

metadata.title: The Income Tax (Correction of Returns and False Declaration) Regulation, 1969
metadata.summary: This Regulation allows persons who filed incorrect income returns between the assessment years 1960-61 and 1968-69 to file revised or consolidated statements of their true income by July 15, 1969. It stipulates that no action will be taken against individuals for submitting incorrect original returns or for failing to file returns previously if they comply with this new provision. The document outlines the method for charging tax on 'excess income' and grants the Central Board of Revenue powers to issue necessary rules and orders.

name: The Tribal Areas (Import and Export Control) Regulation, 1968

metadata.title: The Tribal Areas (Import and Export Control) Regulation, 1968
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950, to specific Tribal Areas in Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President under powers granted by Article 223 of the Constitution.

name: The Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961 (Application to Tribal Areas of Peshawar and Dera Ismail Khan Divisions) Regulation, 1967

metadata.title: The Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961 (Application to Tribal Areas of Peshawar and Dera Ismail Khan Divisions) Regulation, 1967
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961 to the Tribal Areas of the Peshawar and Dera Ismail Khan Divisions. It was promulgated by the President under Article 223 of the Constitution.

name: The Members of the Electoral College (Functions of Local Government in Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1967

metadata.title: The Members of the Electoral College (Functions of Local Government in Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1967
metadata.summary: This Regulation confers functions on the members of the Electoral College regarding matters of local government in Tribal Areas. It extends to the whole of the Tribal Areas of West Pakistan and comes into force on dates specified by the Provincial Government.

name: The Anti-Corruption Laws (Application to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1966

metadata.title: The Anti-Corruption Laws (Application to Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1966
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies specific anti-corruption laws to the Tribal Areas of the Peshawar and Quetta Divisions. It was issued by the President on March 8, 1966, under powers conferred by the Constitution.

name: The Tribal Areas (Application of Acts) Regulation, 1965

metadata.title: The Tribal Areas (Application of Acts) Regulation, 1965
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the provisions of certain specified Acts to the Tribal Areas of Pakistan. It was promulgated by the President under Article 223 of the Constitution to extend central legislative competence to these regions.

name: The High Court Judges (Travelling Allowances) Order, 1965

metadata.title: The High Court Judges (Travelling Allowances) Order, 1965
metadata.summary: This Order determines the travelling allowances and privileges entitled to Judges of High Courts in Pakistan. It covers travel by various modes including railway, steamer, road, and air, specifying entitlements for judges, their servants, and luggage.

name: The Tribal Areas Drugs Regulation, 1964

metadata.title: The Tribal Areas Drugs Regulation, 1964
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the Drugs Act, 1940, and relevant rules to the Tribal Areas of Pakistan. It extends Parts I to IV of the Central Drugs Rules, 1945, and the West Pakistan Drugs Rules, 1958, to these areas subject to specific dates appointed by notifications.

name: The Tribal Areas (Official Secrets) Regulation, 1963

metadata.title: The Tribal Areas (Official Secrets) Regulation, 1963
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the provisions of the Official Secrets Act, 1923 to the Tribal Areas of Pakistan. It defines specific terms related to government documents, prohibited places, and penalties for spying prejudicial to state safety.

name: The Distribution of Revenues and Consolidation and Repayment of Loans Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Distribution of Revenues and Consolidation and Repayment of Loans Order, 1962
metadata.repeals: Distribution of Revenues Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the distribution of net proceeds from central taxes and duties to the Provinces starting July 1, 1962. It also consolidates outstanding provincial loans by writing them down by fifty percent and setting new repayment terms with reduced interest rates.

name: The Indo-Pakistan Disputes (Border Areas) Order, 1962

metadata.title: The Indo-Pakistan Disputes (Border Areas) Order, 1962
metadata.summary: This Order settles disputes regarding certain border areas between India and Pakistan in accordance with agreed decisions from 1960. It designates specific fields and villages as a merged area that becomes part of Pakistan for government and administration purposes, while continuing existing laws unless they are repugnant to applied laws.

name: The Administration of Karachi (Removal of Doubts) Order, 1961

metadata.title: The Administration of Karachi (Removal of Doubts) Order, 1961
metadata.summary: This Order clarifies the validity of powers and authority exercised by the Administrator of Karachi between December 1, 1960, and June 30, 1961. It declares that actions taken during this period are deemed valid and cannot be challenged in any court or by any authority.

name: The Repealing and Amending Order, 1961

name: The Repealing and Amending Ordinance, 1961

metadata.title: The Repealing and Amending Ordinance, 1961
metadata.repeals: certain Central laws
metadata.summary: This Ordinance removes obsolete or discharged Central laws from the Statute-book. It also amends certain other Central laws as specified in its schedules.

name: The Taxation of Goods (Sales and Purchases) Order, 1960

metadata.title: The Taxation of Goods (Sales and Purchases) Order, 1960
metadata.summary: This Order declares that references to the Ruler of a State include successors recognized by the President. It also clarifies that powers to impose taxes on sales and purchases are deemed to cover taxes on sale, purchase, consumption, importation, exportation, manufacture, and production of goods.

name: The West Pakistan Border Area Regulation, 1959

metadata.title: West Pakistan Border Area Regulation, 1959
metadata.summary: This Martial Law Regulation establishes committees to manage border areas in West Pakistan along the Indo-Pakistan border. It empowers these committees to declare individuals engaged in smuggling or prejudicial activities as 'undesirable persons' and direct them to surrender immovable property within the border area. The regulation also outlines procedures for evicting owners who fail to surrender property and mandates compensation payments by the Provincial Government for surrendered properties.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS No. 36

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulations
metadata.summary: This notification establishes regulations under martial law in Pakistan. It defines offenses such as bringing hatred against the armed forces, causing disaffection, promoting enmity among members, and seducing members from their duty, prescribing a maximum punishment of 14 years.

name: PROCLAMATION

metadata.title: The Proclamation dated the 4th June 1955
metadata.repeals: The Proclamation dated the 29th May 1954
metadata.summary: This notification publishes a Proclamation issued by the Governor-General on June 4, 1955. The Proclamation revokes an earlier order dated May 29, 1954, which had directed the Governor of East Bengal to assume legislative powers under Section 92-A of the Government of India Act, 1935.

name: The Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Karachi Development Authority and defines its constitution, functions, and powers. It outlines procedures for development, improvement, and housing schemes, including land acquisition and building regulations.

name: Amendment in Foreign Exchange Rules, 1952

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange Rules (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Foreign Exchange Rules, 1952 by directing the omission of rules 6, 7, and 8. It was issued by the Government of Pakistan under the Ministry of Finance on November 28, 1957.

metadata.title: The Proclamation dated the 4th June 1955

name: The Karachi Courts Order, 1956

metadata.title: The Karachi Courts Order, 1956
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962; Sind Ordinance VI of 1981
metadata.summary: This Order establishes the Court of the District Judge in Karachi and defines the appointment, powers, and jurisdiction of various judicial officers including Additional Judges and Subordinate Judges. It outlines procedures for appeals, revisions, and the control of court business while specifying limits on civil suit jurisdiction based on the subject matter value.

name: The Establishment of West Pakistan (Administration) Order, 1955

metadata.title: The Establishment of West Pakistan (Administration) Order, 1955
metadata.summary: This Order constitutes the administrative divisions of the Province of West Pakistan. It lists ten specific divisions and the districts or areas included within each.

name: PROCLAMATION

metadata.title: The Proclamation dated the 4th June 1955
metadata.repeals: The Proclamation dated the 29th May 1954
metadata.summary: This notification publishes a Proclamation issued by the Governor-General on June 4, 1955. name: PROCLAMATION

metadata.title: The Proclamation dated the 4th June 1955
metadata.repeals: The Proclamation dated the 29th May 1954
metadata.summary: This notification publishes a Proclamation issued by the Governor-General on June 4, 1955. The Proclamation revokes an earlier order dated May 29, 1954, which had directed the Governor of East Bengal to assume legislative powers under Section 92-A of the Government of India Act, 1935.

name: The Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1954

metadata.title: The Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1954
metadata.repeals: The Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Act, 1942; The Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Amendment Ordinance, 1947; The Indian Patents and Designs (Extension of Time) Amendment Act, 1948
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the extension of time limits established under the Patents and Designs Act, 1911. It allows the Controller of Patents and Designs to extend these limits due to circumstances such as active service, emergency proclamations, or the partition of India into separate Dominions.

name: The Governor-General’s Pension Act, 1954

metadata.title: The Governor-General's Pension Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a lifetime pension to individuals who held the office of Governor-General of Pakistan for at least two years and were not removed due to misconduct. The pension amount is set at two thousand rupees per month, charged against the revenues of the Federation, with provisions for suspension if the recipient holds another salaried public office.

name: The Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Act, 1954

metadata.title: The Transfer of Evacuee Deposits Act, 1954
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the transfer of certain deposits belonging to evacuees to India and the reception of similar deposits belonging to refugees in Pakistan, pursuant to an Agreement with India. It establishes the roles of Custodians and Assistant Custodians appointed by the Central Government to manage these deposits and outlines procedures for transferring movable property held by courts or managers.

name: The Essential Commodities (Declaration No. 3) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Essential Commodities (Declaration No. 3) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order declares cigarettes as an essential commodity under the Essential Commodities Act. It was made by the Governor-General of Pakistan on July 18, 1953, and came into force immediately.

name: The Baluchistan Essential Articles (Price Control and Anti-Hoarding) Regulation, 1953

metadata.title: The Baluchistan Essential Articles (Price Control and Anti-Hoarding) Regulation, 1953
metadata.summary: This Regulation regulates the possession, distribution, sale, and pricing of essential articles in Baluchistan. It empowers the Chief Commissioner to fix maximum prices, prohibit sales above those prices, control stock quantities, issue trading licenses, and mandate account maintenance.

name: The Karachi Essential Articles (Price Control and Anti-Hoarding) Ordinance, 1953

metadata.title: The Karachi Essential Articles (Price Control and Anti-Hoarding) Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of possession, distribution, sale, and prices of certain essential articles in the Capital of the Federation. It empowers the Chief Commissioner to fix maximum prices, prohibit sales above those prices, control quantities possessed by traders, require trading licenses, and mandate account maintenance.

name: The Bahawalpur (Extension of Federal Laws) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Bahawalpur (Extension of Federal Laws) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order extends various Federal enactments and rules to the State of Bahawalpur following a Supplementary Instrument of Accession. It includes specific provisions for interpreting references within these extended laws and repeals any corresponding local laws that were in force immediately before the Order's commencement.

name: The Martial Law (Indemnity) ordinance, 1953

metadata.title: Martial Law (Indemnity) Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance indemnifies servants of the Crown and other persons against legal proceedings for acts done under martial law to maintain order. It also validates sentences passed by martial law courts and confirms orders regarding the seizure or destruction of property during that period.

name: The Taxation Tribunal (Undisclosed Wealth) Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Taxation Tribunal (Undisclosed and Disclosed Wealth) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Tribunal to inquire into the tax liability of undisclosed wealth and determine the extent of such liability. It provides for the constitution of the Tribunal, defines key terms related to previous years and taxes, and outlines procedures for asset declarations and examinations by the Registrar.

name: The Manoeuvres and Field Firing (Validation) Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Manceuvres and Field Firing (Validation) Act, 1953
metadata.amends: The Manceuvres, Field Firing and Artillery Practice Act, 1938
metadata.summary: This Act validates certain military manoeuvres and field firing that took place between November 1952 and April 1953. It deems these activities to have been executed under the Manceuvres, Field Firing and Artillery Practice Act, 1938, ensuring all provisions of that earlier Act apply accordingly.

name: The Karachi Rent Restrictions Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Karachi Rent Restriction Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides provisions regarding residential and non-residential accommodation in the Capital of the Federation. It specifically aims to control rents chargeable for such accommodation and prevent eviction in certain cases.

name: The Sind Civil Courts Act, 1869 (Repeal) Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Bar Councils (Amendment) Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bar Councils Act, 1926 to include periods of legal practice in British India before August 15, 1947, when calculating eligibility for Bar Council membership. It also specifies requirements for elected members representing the Chief Court in Sind.

name: The Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953

metadata.title: Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to the government and discipline of the Pakistan Air Force. It defines persons subject to the Act, including officers, warrant officers, and enrolled personnel, while establishing provisions for service conditions, offences, punishments, and courts-martial procedures.

name: The Dangerous Cargoes Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Dangerous Cargoes Act, 1953
metadata.summary: This Act provides special powers relating to the safety of ports regarding the transit, working, and storage of dangerous cargoes. It defines terms such as dangerous cargoes, explosive, and flashing-point, and empowers the Central Government to make orders and rules for securing port safety.

name: The Finance Act, 1953

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1953
metadata.amends: The Post Office Act, 1898; The Finance Act, 1942; The Tariff Act, 1934; The Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; The Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the year beginning April 1, 1953. It amends various existing laws regarding customs duties, excise duties, postage rates, and income tax provisions.

name: The State Bank of Pakistan Order (Extension to Baluchistan) Regulation, 1953

metadata.title: The State Bank of Pakistan Order (Extension to Baluchistan) Regulation, 1953
metadata.summary: This regulation extends the State Bank of Pakistan Order, 1948, to cover the whole of Baluchistan. It applies the Order as amended from time to time and any subsequent re-enacting enactments to the region.

name: The Baluchistan Imports and Exports (Control) Regulation, 1953

metadata.title: The Baluchistan Imports and Exports (Control) Regulation, 1953
metadata.summary: This Regulation extends the life of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1947, as applied to Baluchistan. It amends Section 1 of the said Act by substituting specific dates regarding the period of control.

name: The Government of India (High Court Judges) (Amendment) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Government of India (High Court Judges) (Amendment) Order, 1935
metadata.amends: The Government of India (High Court Judges) Order, 1937
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Government of India (High Court Judges) Order, 1937 by substituting an entry in its First Schedule regarding the Chief Court of Sind. It also appoints Mr. Justice Muhammad Bakhsh P. Munshi as a Judge of the Chief Court of Sind with effect from the date he takes his seat.

name: The Karachi Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1953

metadata.title: The Karachi Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1953
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the supply of residential and non-residential accommodation in the Capital of the Federation. It specifically provides for controlling rents chargeable for such accommodation and preventing eviction in certain cases.

name: The Contempt of Courts (Capital of the Federation) Order, 1953

metadata.title: The Contempt of Courts (Capital of the Federation) Order, 1953
metadata.summary: This Order amends the Contempt of Courts Act, 1926 by inserting specific references to subordinate courts and Chief Courts into its sections. It extends to the Capital of the Federation and comes into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Civil Defence (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1951

metadata.title: The Civil Defence (Special Powers) Ordinance, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides special powers to secure the civil defence of the Federation during an emergency. It empowers the Central Government to make rules regarding air raid precautions, fire prevention, shelter construction, and the requisition of property, while also establishing principles for compensation.

name: The East Bengal Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Act, 1951

metadata.title: The Armed Forces (Disturbed Areas) (Special Powers) Act, 1951
metadata.summary: This Act preserves the provisions of the Punjab Disturbed Areas (Special Powers of Armed Forces) Ordinance, 1947. It grants specific powers to officers of the Pakistan Army or Air Force in declared disturbed areas within the Punjab.

name: The Vagrancy (Capital of the Federation) Rules, 1951

metadata.title: Vagrancy (Capital of the Federation) Rules
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Central Government under the Vagrancy (Capital of the Federation) Act, 1950. They establish procedures for arresting vagrants without a warrant and detaining them in police custody until they appear before a Special Magistrate.

name: The Chemicals Control Order, 1951

metadata.title: The Chemicals Control Order, 1951
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the Controller of Chemicals to requisition, prohibit sale, and inspect stocks of chemicals held by any person. It also authorizes the Controller to seize chemicals where contraventions are suspected and defines offenses related to violating these orders under the Essential Supplies (Temporary Powers) Act, 1946.

name: The Essential Supplies (Temporary Powers) (Chemicals) Ordinance, 1951

metadata.title: The Essential Supplies (Temporary Powers) (Chemicals) Ordinance, 1951
metadata.summary: This Ordinance enables the application of the Essential Supplies (Temporary Powers) Act, 1946 to chemicals. It was promulgated by the Governor-General in exercise of powers under the Government of India Act, 1935, due to an emergency situation.

name: The Pakistan Special Police Establishment Ordinance, 1948

metadata.title: Ordinance No. VIII of 1948
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of a Special Police Force in Pakistan to investigate offences connected with Central and Provincial matters. It vests the superintendence and administration of this force in the Central Government, specifically an officer appointed by them.

name: The Special police Establishment (War Department) Ordinance , 1943

metadata.title: The Special Police Establishment (War Department) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a special police force known as the Special Police Establishment (War Department) to investigate offences committed in connection with Central Government departments. It provides for the superintendence and administration of this force by officers appointed by the Central Government.

name: The Martial Law (Indemnity) Ordinance, 1943

metadata.title: The Martial Law (Indemnity) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides indemnity to servants of the Crown and other persons for acts done under martial law administration in British India. It protects these individuals from legal proceedings regarding actions taken to maintain order or administer martial law during specified periods, provided the acts were done in good faith.

name: The Royal Indian Navy (Powers of Command) Ordinance, 1943

metadata.title: The Royal Indian Navy (Powers of Command) Ordinance, 1943
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides powers of command over Viceroy's commissioned officers who are seconded or posted to the forces of the Royal Indian Navy. It stipulates that such officers shall be treated as naval officers of the rank of Midshipman for the purposes of discipline and punishment.

name: NA- The Reciprocity Act, 1943

metadata.title: The Reciprocity (Amendment) Act, 1943
metadata.repeals: The Immigration into India Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Reciprocity Act, 1943 to address disabilities imposed on persons of non-Indian origin domiciled in British possessions. It includes provisions for setting up machinery to ascertain matters related to entry and residence, establishing agencies to administer rules, and specifying penalties for contravention. The Act also repeals the Immigration into India Act, 1924.

name: NA-The Mines Maternity Benefit Act, 1941

metadata.title: The Mines Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 1943
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Mines Maternity Benefit Act, 1941. It specifically modifies section 5 by omitting certain words and adding a proviso regarding payment during confinement.

name: The State Prisoners (Detention of Lunatics) Ordinance, 1941

metadata.title: The State Prisoners (Detention of Lunatics) Ordinance, 1941
metadata.summary: This Ordinance authorizes the reception and detention of individuals committed to an asylum under the Bengal State Prisoners Regulation, 1818. It applies to the whole of British India and comes into force immediately.

name: The Jubbulpore and Chattisgarh Divisons (Divorce Proceedings Validation) Act, 1935

metadata.title: The Validation of Divorce Proceedings Act, 1935
metadata.summary: This Act removes doubts regarding the jurisdiction of the High Court in Jubbulpore and Chhattisgarh Divisions under the Indian Divorce Act. It validates all proceedings taken by the High Court of Allahabad between August 31, 1923, and the commencement of this Act, deeming them valid as if taken under the jurisdiction of a High Court.

name: The Tariff Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Indian Tariff Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to customs duties on goods imported into or exported from British India by sea or land. It establishes provisions for levying duties, granting preferential rates for British manufactures, and handling cases where proof of duty payment is not provided within a prescribed period.

name: The Indian Rubber Control Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Indian Rubber Control Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of the export and import of rubber from British India. It establishes two Licensing Committees, one for Indian Rubber and another for Burma Rubber, to regulate these activities.

name: The Mechanical Lighters (Excise Duty) Act, 1934
