metadata.title: The Mechanical Lighters Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act imposes an excise duty on mechanical lighters manufactured in British India and regulates their importation. It establishes definitions for terms like 'manufactory' and 'mechanical lighter', sets the duty rate, and outlines penalties for manufacturing or importing without a licence or evading payment of duties.

name: The Carriage By Air Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Indian Carriage by Air Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in British India to the Convention for the unification of certain rules relating to international carriage by air signed at Warsaw on October 12, 1929. It applies the convention's provisions regarding carriers, passengers, and consignees to international air carriage within British India, subject to specific adaptations and modifications.

name: The Dock Labourers Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Dock Labourers Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in British India to the International Convention for the protection against accidents of workers engaged in loading and unloading ships. It establishes inspectors, defines their powers to enter premises and examine machinery, and authorizes the Governor General in Council to make regulations regarding worker safety, access, lighting, and accident prevention.

name: The Indian States (Protection) Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Indian States (Protection) Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Press (Emergency Powers) Act, 1931 to provide specific protections for the Administrations of States in India. It defines criminal offenses related to conspiring to overawe a State or obstructing its administration and grants local authorities powers to prohibit public assemblies that threaten public safety.

name: The Aircraft Act, 1934

metadata.title: The Indian Aircraft Act, 1934
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Governor General in Council to make rules regulating the manufacture, sale, import, and export of aircraft. It also establishes provisions for licensing, inspection, registration, and safety measures related to aerodromes and air routes.

name: The Indian Medical Council Act, 1933

metadata.title: The Indian Medical Council Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Medical Council in India to regulate the practice of medicine and establish uniform standards for medical practitioners. It defines the composition of the Council, including members from provinces, universities, and those with recognized qualifications, as well as procedures for elections and meetings.

name: The Pakistan Medical Council Act, 1933

metadata.title: The Indian Medical Council Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Medical Council in India to regulate the practice of medicine and establish uniform standards for medical practitioners. It defines the composition of the Council, including members from provinces, universities, and those with recognized qualifications, as well as procedures for elections and meetings.

name: The Indian Tea Control Act, 1933

metadata.title: The Indian Tea Control Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control of the export and extension of tea cultivation in British India. It establishes the Indian Tea Licensing Committee to regulate these activities through by-laws, rules, and specific licensing procedures.

name: The Salt (Additional Import Duty) Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Salt (Additional Import Duty) Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Salt (Additional Import Duty) Act, 1931. It extends the operation of that Act and substitutes specific figures regarding annas and rupees in various sections.

name: The Bengal Suppression of Terrorist Outrages (Supplementary) Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Bengal Suppression of Terrorist Outrages Act, 1932 (Supplementary)
metadata.amends: The Bengal Suppression of Terrorist Outrages Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act supplements the Bengal Suppression of Terrorist Outrages Act, 1932 by establishing specific provisions for appeals against sentences passed by Special Magistrates. It defines key terms such as 'local Act' and outlines the procedure for appealing orders or sentences within thirty days to the High Court at Calcutta.

name: The Port Haj Committees Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Port Haj Committees Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Port Haj Committees in the principal presidencies of India to assist Muslim pilgrims traveling to ports on their way to the Hedjaz. It defines the composition of these committees, including nominated officials, elected representatives from local councils and municipalities, and co-opted members.

name: NA-The Bombay Weights and Measures Act, 1932

metadata.title: The Bombay Weights and Measures (Karachi Amendment) Act, 1953
metadata.amends: The Bombay Weights and Measures Act, 1932
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bombay Weights and Measures Act, 1932 to apply it to the Capital of the Federation. It specifically adds a new provision punishing the use of weights or measures marked in pounds instead of seers when selling articles measured in seers.

name: The Indian Finance Act, 1931

metadata.title: The Indian Finance Act, 1931
metadata.amends: The Indian Finance Act, 1922; The Indian Excise Act, 1907; The Indian Tariff Act, 1894; The Indian Post Office Act, 1898; The Motor Spirit Act, 1917; The Income-tax Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act amends various existing laws including the Indian Finance Act of 1922 and the Indian Excise Act to adjust duties on silver, salt, motor spirit, and other items. It also revises income-tax rates and postage fees effective from April 1, 1931.

name: The Steel Industry (Protection) Act, 1930

metadata.title: The Steel Industry (Protection) Act, 1930
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Second Schedule to the Indian Tariff Act, 1894. It specifically revises entries related to iron or steel railway track material, bar and rod, and spikes and tie-bars by substituting certain descriptions and adding new duty rates for British and non-British manufacture.

name: NA- The Cotton Textile Industry (Protection) Act, 1930

metadata.title: The Cotton Textile Industry (Amendment) Act, 1933
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Cotton Textile Industry (Protection) Act, 1930. It was enacted to continue protection for the cotton textile industry in British India.

name: The Indian (Specified Instruments) Stamp Act, 1924

metadata.title: The Indian Stamp Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the modification of certain provisions of the Indian Stamp Act, 1899, specifically regarding their application to promissory notes and other instruments. It defines specific types of instruments covered, including promissory notes payable on demand exceeding a certain amount executed after September 30, 1923.

name: The Indigo Cess (Repealing) Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Indigo Cess (Repealing) Act, 1923
metadata.repeals: The Indigo Cess Act, 1918; The Indigo Cess (Amendment) Act V of 1921
metadata.summary: This Act serves to repeal previous legislation concerning the levy of a cess on indigo. Specifically, it repeals the Indigo Cess Act, 1918, and the Indigo Cess (Amendment) Act V of 1921.

name: The Mahendra Partab Singh Estates Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Mahendra Partab Singh Estates Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the forfeiture of the estates and other property of Mahendra Partab Singh due to his treasonable alliance with His Majesty's enemies. It grants the forfeited property to his son, Prem Partab Singh, subject to specific conditions.

name: The Naval Armament Act, 1923

metadata.title: The Indian Naval Armament Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect in British India to the Treaty for the Limitation of Naval Armament signed at Washington on February 6, 1922. It regulates the building, equipping, and altering of vessels intended for war use and establishes penalties for contraventions.

name: The Indian Wireless Telegraphy (Shipping) Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Wireless Telegraphy (Shipping) Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the installation and maintenance of wireless telegraphy on ships registered in British India. It defines specific terms such as passenger steamers and outlines requirements for certified operators and watchers to ensure proper communication at sea.

name: NA- The Cutchi Memons Act, 1920

metadata.title: The Cutchi Memons Act (Amendment) Act, 1923
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Cutchi Memons Act, 1920 to clarify conditions regarding age, residency in British India, and competency to contract. It substitutes specific sub-sections within Section 2 of the original Act to define who qualifies as a person under the legislation.

name: The Calcutta High Court (Jurisdictional Limits) Act, 1919

metadata.title: The Calcutta Limits Act, 1919
metadata.summary: This Act declares and prescribes the original and civil jurisdiction limits of the High Court at Fort William in Bengal. It defines specific boundaries using pillars, streets, and rivers to establish where the ordinary original civil jurisdiction shall be exercised.

name: The Martial Law (Further Extension) Ordinance, 1919

metadata.title: The Martial Law Ordinance (Further Extension) Ordinance, 1919
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the application of the Martial Law Ordinance, 1919 to cover offences committed on or after March 30, 1919. It authorizes local governments and appointed commissions to try persons charged with such offences under martial law provisions.

name: The Martial Law (Extension) Ordinance, 1919

metadata.title: The Martial Law Ordinance, 1919
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the operation of martial law to specific districts in Punjab where ordinary courts have been suspended due to rebellion. It directs that trials for offences under the Bengal State Offences Regulation, 1804, be conducted immediately by courts-martial rather than ordinary tribunals.

name: The Bronze Coin (Legal Tender) Act, 1918

metadata.title: The Bronze Coin (Legal Tender) Act, 1918
metadata.summary: This Act declares that certain bronze coins coined outside British India shall be legal tender in the same manner as if they were coined within British India. It further stipulates that every coin declared legal tender under this Act is deemed to be Queen's coin within the meaning of section 230 of the Indian Penal Code.

name: Act No. IX of 1900

metadata.title: The Punjab Courts Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Courts Act of 1884 by adding a specific provision regarding court fees. The amendment applies to fees payable on financial applications made to the Court of the Financial Commissioner for the exercise of its revisional jurisdiction under section 84 of the Punjab Tenancy Act, 1887.

name: The Lansdowne Bridge Act, 1892

metadata.title: The Act to remove doubts as to the levy and collection of tolls upon the Lansdowne Bridge over the Indus at Sukkur in Bombay, and for other purposes
metadata.summary: This Act removes doubts regarding the levy and collection of tolls on the Lansdowne Bridge over the Indus at Sukkur in the Bombay Presidency. It validates past levies and collections made under previous authority, ensuring they are deemed duly levied even if the enabling Act was repealed.

name: NA- The Oudh Courts Act, 1891

metadata.title: The Oudh Courts Act, 1897
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Oudh Courts Act, 1891 to adjust the composition of the Judicial Commissioner's court and update procedural references. It grants the Judicial Commissioner power to make rules regarding evidence and judgments, while repealing specific sections of the original 1891 Act.

name: The Upper Burma Laws Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Upper Burma Laws Act, 1886
metadata.repeals: The Scheduled Districts Act, 1874
metadata.summary: This Act declares the law in force in Upper Burma, which was formerly under the administration of King Thebaw and became part of British India on December 31, 1885. It establishes the administrative structure for dividing territories into districts, divisions, townships, and circles, while also repealing certain enactments previously in force in that region.

name: The Lieutenant-Governor's (N.W.P) Functions Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Act No: XIX OF 1886
metadata.summary: This Act validates the discharge by the Lieutenant-Governor of certain functions previously assigned to the Governor-General in Council within the North-Western Provinces. It ensures that these functions continue to be discharged as if performed by the Governor-General, thereby maintaining legal continuity after the transfer of specific powers.

name: The Lower Burma Gaols Delivery Act, 1886

metadata.title: The Lower Burma Gaols Delivery Act, 1886
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the speedy trial of certain accused persons in custody in Lower Burma. It confers powers of a Court of Session on Magistrates and establishes provisions regarding Additional Judicial Commissioners.

name: The Bombay Municipal Debentures Act, 1876

metadata.title: The Bombay Municipal Debentures Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act exempts mortgages of rates and taxes in Bombay from stamp duty when transferred by indorsement. It validates former transfers made without proper indorsement or payment of duty and empowers the Municipal Corporation to consolidate multiple debentures into a single instrument.

name: The Calcutta University Honorary Degrees Act, 1875

metadata.title: Act No. XXI of 1875
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Calcutta Act No. II of 1857 to authorize the Syndicate to grant honorary degrees without requiring previous examinations. It also empowers the Syndicate, with the Vice-Chancellor's consent, to confer degrees on individuals deemed worthy due to their eminent position and attainments.

name: The High Courts' Criminal Procedure Act, 1875

metadata.title: The High Courts' Criminal Procedure Act, 1875
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the criminal procedure for High Courts in Punjab, detailing rules regarding jury composition, trial processes, and evidence presentation. It also outlines provisions for the examination of witnesses, the rights of the accused, and the discharge of juries.

name: The Inland Customs Act, 1875

metadata.title: The Inland Customs Act, 1875
metadata.repeals: The enactments hereto annexed
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the import of salt and export of sugar, including the establishment of customs zones and lines. It also covers the manufacture of salt and saltpetre, defines various terms related to customs officers and goods, and prescribes penalties for contraventions.

name: The Sir Jamsetjee Jeejeebhoy’s Loan Act, 1875

metadata.title: An Act to secure the repayment of a Loan by the Government of India to Sir Jamsetjee Jeejeebhoy, Baronet
metadata.summary: This Act secures the repayment of a loan provided by the Government of India to Sir Jamsetjee Jeejeebhoy, Baronet. It establishes trusts for the annual income generated from promissory notes and addresses the succession of the baronetcy title.

name: The Fisheries Act, 1875

metadata.title: The Burma Fisheries Act, 1875
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the exclusive right of fishing in British Burma and provides for the disposal of such rights by the Deputy Commissioner. It establishes rules regarding the erection of weirs, licensing procedures, and penalties for offenses related to unauthorized fishing or obstruction.

name: The Law Reports Act, 1875

metadata.title: The Indian Law Reports Act, 1875
metadata.summary: This Act aims to reduce the volume and cost of law reports while improving their quality. It extends the authority of High Court decisions beyond local limits for citation purposes.

name: The Income Tax Act, 1872

metadata.title: THE INDIAN INCOME TAX ACT
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of taxes arising from property and trade in British India. It defines key terms such as 'Income', 'Company', and 'Person' and outlines provisions regarding returns, deductions, and penalties.

name: The Emigration Act, 1870

metadata.title: An Act to enable the Governor General in Council to increase the fee payable under section 31 of the Emigration Act
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Governor General in Council to increase fees payable under section 31 of the Emigration Act, 1864. It also grants authority to reduce such fees if necessary.

name: The Administrator-General's Act, 1867

metadata.title: THE ADMINISTRATOR GENERAL'S ACT, 1867
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the office of Administrator General in the three Presidencies and defines their designation, appointment, and qualifications. It outlines the rights, powers, and duties regarding the administration of estates for deceased persons, including Hindus, Mahammadans, Buddhists, and soldiers, as well as procedures for granting certificates and letters of administration.

name: Act No. XXVIII of 1864

metadata.title: Act No. XXVII of 1864
metadata.repeals: Act XVI of 1811
metadata.summary: This Act substitutes certain declarations for the oaths previously administered to Justices of the Peace in the Punjab. It empowers the Council to extend provisions relating to the Abkari Act and amends laws regarding revenue administration in the provinces under the Lieutenant-Governor of the Punjab.

name: Act No. XXVII of 1864

metadata.title: The Act to substitute certain declarations for the oaths of qualification taken by Justices of the Peace
metadata.amends: Act XXI of 1856 (to Abkari consolidate Revenue in the Presidency of Fort William in Bengal)
metadata.repeals: Act XVI of 1811
metadata.summary: This Act substitutes specific declarations for the traditional oaths of qualification taken by Justices of the Peace to accommodate conscientious persons who object to taking such oaths. It extends provisions relating to the manufacture and sale of spirits and intoxicating liquors from the Presidency of Fort William in Bengal to other provinces under the Lieutenant-Governor of the Punjab.

name: NA-The Pakistan Penal Code Act, 1860

metadata.title: Act XXVII of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Indian Penal Code by substituting and adding new sections regarding liability for acts done by several persons, definitions of offences, and conspiracies against the government. It also introduces specific provisions concerning exciting disaffection, keeping lottery offices, and causing death by rash or negligent acts.

name: The Hindu Widows' Re-Marriage Act, 1856

metadata.title: The Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act
metadata.summary: This Act removes legal obstacles to the remarriage of Hindu widows in territories under the East India Company. It declares that marriages of widows are valid and their children legitimate, while also addressing property rights and guardianship upon remarriage.

name: NA-The Bengal State Prisoners Regulation, 1818

metadata.title: Bengal State Prisoners Regulation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Bengal State Prisoners Regulation of 1818 to update specific sections regarding leased areas and union states. It was promulgated by the President of Pakistan on November 18, 1958, following a proclamation issued on October 7, 1958.

name: The Sharing of Declaration of Assets of Civil Servants Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Sharing of Declaration of Assets of Civil Servants Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) to share simplified versions of civil servant asset declarations with banking companies. The regulations define specific compliance requirements for banks, including the use of secured email addresses and focal persons, as well as the process for obtaining consent and certificates before accessing information.

name: The Pakistan Single Window Evidence of Identity (E0I) Rules, 2022

metadata.title: The Pakistan Single Window Evidence of Identity (EOI) Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for users to subscribe to the Pakistan Single Window (PSW) system by providing evidence of identity through an electronic verification process. They define the validity period of user identification, procedures for renewal, and conditions regarding access, security responsibilities, and suspension or cancellation of credentials.

name: The Defence Industrial Production and Regulatory Authority of Pakistan Ordinance, 2026

metadata.title: Defence Industrial Production and Regulatory Authority of Pakistan Ordinance, 2026
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Defence Industrial Production and Regulatory Authority to supervise and regulate Pakistan's defence industrial sector. It aims to enhance national security, defence preparedness, and technological sovereignty while improving the country's stature in global defence markets.

name: Regulations for the Appointments /Promotions of Faculty / Teaching Staff / Examiners / Principals / Deans / Vice Chancellors in undergraduate & postgraduate Medical & Dental institutions / medical universities of Pakistan, 2025

metadata.title: Regulations for the Appointments / Promotions of Faculty / Teaching Staff / Examiners / Principals / Deans / Vice Chancellors in undergraduate & postgraduate Medical & Dental institutions / medical universities of Pakistan 2025
metadata.summary: These regulations prescribe the criteria for appointments and promotions of faculty, teaching staff, examiners, principals, deans, and vice-chancellors in medical and dental institutions across Pakistan. They establish eligibility requirements, define acceptable qualifications, and outline procedures for recognizing teaching experience, including specific rules regarding foreign experience and institutional validation.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Electric Power Procurement) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Electric Power Procurement) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the procurement of electric power by suppliers in Pakistan. They define key terms related to competitive auctions, bidding processes, and the roles of the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority and independent administrators.

name: The Finance Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2022
metadata.amends: Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance, 1961; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2022. It also amends several existing laws, including the Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance, 1961 and the Customs Act, 1969.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Uniform System of Accounts) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Uniform System of Accounts) Regulations, 2022
metadata.amends: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Uniform System of Accounts) Rules, 2009
metadata.summary: These regulations establish a uniform system of accounts for generation companies and persons licensed under the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997. They mandate the maintenance of separate books of accounts for regulated activities and require the filing of certified regulatory accounts with the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Electric Power Supplier) Regulations, 2022

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Electric Power Supplier) Regulations, 2022
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for granting electric power supply licenses under the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority. They define key terms such as competitive suppliers and suppliers of last resort, and outline the application process for obtaining a license to supply electric power.

name: The Inland Revenue Reward Rules, 2021

metadata.title: The Inland Revenue Reward Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish a uniform incentive regime for the detection of tax evasion, meritorious services, and outstanding performance within the Inland Revenue field. They define eligible persons, specified statutes, and designated entities to facilitate claims for rewards by officers and informers.

name: The Assets Declaration (Procedure and Conditions) Rules, 2019

metadata.title: The Assets Declaration (Procedure and Conditions) Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure and conditions for filing asset declarations under the Assets Declaration Ordinance, 2019. They specify requirements for filing returns, declaring foreign assets, and paying applicable taxes to avoid penalties.

name: The Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Rules, 2019

metadata.title: The Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: These rules are made under section 61 of the Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act, 2017 to prescribe procedures for administrators, initiating officers, and approving authorities. They define terms by reference to existing acts, establish pay scales for adjudicating authority members, and outline processes for provisional attachment and confiscation of both immovable and movable property.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Import of Electric Power) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Import of Electric Power) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedure for importing electric power from foreign countries or specific territories in Pakistan. They define key terms such as Buyer, Seller, and Import of Power within the context of the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Competitive Bidding Tariff (Approval Procedure) Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Competitive Bidding Tariff (Approval Procedure) Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedure for approving tariffs arrived at through a competitive bidding process for generation and transmission. They define key terms, outline the duties of relevant agencies during the bidding process, and set conditions for conducting such bids in compliance with applicable laws.

name: The Insurance Accounting Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Insurance Accounting Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These regulations prescribe the accounting standards and reporting requirements for insurers in Pakistan, specifically regarding Regulatory Returns and Published Financial Statements. They mandate compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards adopted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan and establish specific rules for life and non-life insurance businesses.

name: The Share Registrars and Ballotters Regulations, 2017

metadata.title: The Share Registrars and Ballotters Regulations, 2017
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for licensing share registrars and ballotters in Pakistan. They define eligibility criteria, application procedures, and specific functions required of licensed entities under the Securities Act, 2015.

name: The Securities Exchanges (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: The Securities Exchanges (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: This document establishes the Securities Exchanges (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016, made by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan. It outlines the procedures for applying for a securities exchange license, including required documents and fees, as well as the criteria for granting such licenses and the conditions that must be met.

name: The Credit Rating Companies Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: The Credit Rating Companies Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: This document establishes the Credit Rating Companies Regulations, 2016, made by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan under powers conferred by the Securities Act, 2015. It defines key terms related to credit ratings and companies, sets out prohibitions on unlicensed activities, and specifies eligibility criteria for obtaining a license to act as a credit rating company.

name: The Securities Brokers (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016

metadata.title: The Securities Brokers (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016
metadata.summary: This document establishes the Securities Brokers (Licensing and Operations) Regulations, 2016, made by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan under powers conferred by the Securities Act, 2015. It outlines preliminary definitions, licensing prohibitions, eligibility criteria for becoming a licensed securities broker, and operational requirements.

name: The National Electric Power Regulazory Authority (Complaint Handling and Dispute Resolution Procedure) Rules, 2015

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Complaint Handling and Dispute Resolution Procedure) Rules, 2015
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for handling complaints and resolving disputes before the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA). They define key terms such as 'complaint', 'licensee', and 'tribunal' within the context of the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power Act, 1997. The document outlines specific requirements for filing complaints, including time limits, necessary particulars, and the process for registration and respondent replies.

name: The Customs Reward Rules, 2012

metadata.title: The Customs Reward Rules, 2012
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for granting cash rewards to officers of the Pakistan Customs Service and informers who assist in cases involving duty evasion, tax evasion, or confiscation of goods. The document defines eligibility criteria, methods for determining reward amounts based on realized duties or confiscated goods value, and procedures for disbursing funds to a welfare scheme.

name: The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Distribution Service Operations) Regulations, 2011

metadata.title: Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (Distribution Service Operations) Regulations, 2011
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for operating distribution services under the Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (PEMRA). They define key terms related to broadcasting, licensing, and subscriber equipment while setting criteria for obtaining licenses to operate distribution service networks.

name: The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Up-front Tariff (Approval & Procedure) Regulations, 2011

metadata.title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Upfront Tariff (Approval & Procedure) Regulations, 2011
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedure for the development and approval of upfront tariffs by the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA). They define key terms, outline the process for determining tariffs based on various energy sources, and specify the requirements for applicants seeking to opt for an upfront tariff.

name: The Punjab Partnership (Registration of Firms) Rules, 1932

metadata.title: The Punjab Partnership (Registration of Firms) Rules, 1932
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the short title, definitions, and specific forms for statements and notices required under the Punjab Partnership Act, 1932. They establish procedures for maintaining the Register of Firms, amending entries, protesting records, preparing indexes, and issuing certificates of registration.

name: The Class Value Added Services Licensing and Registration Regulations 2007

metadata.title: Class Value Added Services Licensing and Registration Regulations 2007
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for licensing and registration of Class Value Added Services in Pakistan. They define key terms related to telecommunications services, outline open and technology-neutral licensing principles, and specify application procedures.

name: The Islamabad Building Regulations, 1963

metadata.title: The Islamabad Building Regulations, 1963
metadata.summary: This document establishes the building regulations for Islamabad, covering administrative matters, space requirements, structural standards, and fire precautions. It outlines specific rules for construction plans, site operations, drainage, sanitary provisions, and means of escape in case of emergencies.

name: The Specified Areas (Restriction on Brick Kilns) Regulation, 1962

metadata.title: The Specified Areas (Restriction on Brick Kilns) Regulation, 1962
metadata.summary: This regulation restricts the establishment and operation of brick kilns within specified areas to protect public health and safety. It imposes specific conditions on land excavation, such as slope limits and depth restrictions, and requires prior approval from the Capital Development Authority for running a brick kiln.

name: The Land Acquisition Regulation, 1961

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition Regulation, 1961
metadata.summary: This regulation was made by the Capital Development Authority under powers conferred by section 51 of the Capital Development Authority Ordinance, 1960. It outlines procedures for excluding certain government lands from acquisition, marking and measuring land, publishing public notices, and handling claims for compensation or objections regarding measurements.

name: The Land Use (Restriction on Graveyards) Regulation, 1961

metadata.title: The Land Use (Restriction on Graveyards) Regulation, 1961
metadata.summary: This Regulation restricts the use of existing graveyards in areas acquired by the Capital Development Authority. It designates specific locations for burials and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

name: The Defense Forces of Pakistan Act, 2026

metadata.title: The Defense Forces of Pakistan Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Defense Forces Headquarters and defines the powers and functions of the Chief of the Defense Forces. It provides for multidomain integration, restructuring, and optimum jointness of the Armed Forces under Article 243 of the Constitution.

name: The Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority (Licensing) Rules, 2026

metadata.title: The Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority (Licensing) Rules, 2026
metadata.summary: These rules establish the licensing framework for regulated activities related to cannabis and industrial hemp under the Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority Act, 2024. They define various license categories covering cultivation, processing, research, supply chain management, and comprehensive operations, along with classification criteria based on scale and risk.

name: The Institute of Management, Sciences and Technology Act, 2026

metadata.title: Institute of Management, Sciences and Technology Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Management, Sciences and Technology as a body corporate within the private sector. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, composition, and powers to acquire property.

name: The Disposal of Public Assets Regulations, 2026

metadata.title: Disposal of Public Assets Regulations, 2026
metadata.summary: These Regulations establish the framework for the disposal of public assets by the Public Procurement Regulatory Authority. They define key terms related to sales methods, such as auctions and framework agreements, and outline prohibited corrupt and fraudulent practices during the disposal process.

name: The National Agri-trade and Food Safety Authority Act, 2026

metadata.title: National Agri-trade and Food Safety Authority Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Agri-trade and Food Safety Authority (NAFSA) to regulate quality aspects of agricultural products, agrochemicals, plants, and animals used for food or feed. It aims to facilitate international and inter-provincial trade by ensuring compliance with recognized sanitary and phytosanitary measures and quality standards.

name: The Federal Prosecutor General (Terms and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2024

metadata.title: The Federal Prosecutor General (Terms and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2024
metadata.summary: These rules establish the terms and conditions of service for the Federal Prosecutor General in Pakistan. They define entitlements regarding pay, allowances, leave, pension, and general conduct while restricting private practice and specific legal engagements.

name: The IP Whitelisting Regulations, 2024

metadata.title: IP Whitelisting Regulations, 2024
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the registration and whitelisting of IP addresses (IPv4 and IPv6) to allow Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) services in Pakistan. They define eligibility criteria, application procedures via the PTA online portal, fee structures, and validity periods for various licensees including call centers.

name: SRO 1912(I)/2024. Extension of Application of the State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act, 2023 to Pakistan Railways

metadata.title: Notification extending the application of the State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act, 2023 to Pakistan Railways
metadata.summary: This notification extends the complete application of the State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act, 2023 to Pakistan Railways. It was issued by the Federal Government under the powers conferred by section 3(2) of the said Act.

name: SRO 1391(I)/2024 Establishment of Federal Criminal Prosecution Service in ICT

metadata.title: Notification establishing the Federal Criminal Prosecution Service
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the Federal Criminal Prosecution Service within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It is issued pursuant to section 3 of the Federal Prosecution Service Act, 2023.

name: ALLOCATION OF BUISNESS OF ACT TO THE INTERIOR DIVISION

metadata.title: Federal Prosecution Service Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This notification allocates the business of the Federal Prosecution Service Act, 2023 to the Interior Division. It also designates the Federal Criminal Prosecution Service as an attached department of the Interior Division.

name: SRO 1311(I)/2024. Notification Regarding Addition of Master of Health Professions Education (MHPE) Degree at Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University

metadata.title: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This notification directs amendments to the Second Schedule of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022. Specifically, it adds a new entry for the Master of Health Professions Education (MHPE) degree at Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Medical University.

name: SRO 1279(I)/2024 Establishment of Sub-Committee For The Implementation of National Sex Offenders Register

metadata.title: Notification appointing members of the sub-committee for the implementation of National Sex Offender Register
metadata.summary: This notification establishes a sub-committee to implement the National Sex Offender Register (NOSR) under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021. It authorizes the Chairperson to appoint specific members to this sub-committee, including representatives from police services, legal departments, NADRA, and the National Police Bureau.

name: SRO 1077(I)/2024. Withdrawal of Recognition of Bahawalpur Medical College, Bahawalpur with Effect from 19th April, 2024

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 1077(1)/2024
metadata.summary: This notification withdraws the recognition of Bahawalpur Medical College effective April 19, 2024. It is issued under section 33 of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022.

name: The Anti-Rape (Sex Offenders Register) Rules, 2023

metadata.title: The Anti-Rape (Sex Offenders Register) Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for creating and maintaining a Sex Offenders Register managed by NADRA. The register contains specific personal details of convicted sex offenders to assist in investigations and prosecutions under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021.

name: SRO. 833(I) 2023. Designate the Court of Mr. Adnan Rasool Larik, AD&SJ (West)/Judge GBV court of Sessions Division (West), Islamabad

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O. 830(I) of 2023
metadata.summary: This notification designates Mr. Adnan Rasool Larik as the judge for the GBV court of Sessions Division (West) in Islamabad to try offences under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021. It was issued by the Federal Government in consultation with the Chief Justice of the Islamabad High Court and supersedes a previous notification dated January 4, 2023.

name: The Day Care Centres Act, 2023

metadata.title: The Day Care Centres Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of day care centres in both public and private establishments that have at least seventy employees. It outlines the responsibilities of the Federal Government and private entities to set up these facilities, along with penalties for non-compliance.

name: SRO 455(I)/2023. Notified Members of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council for 4 years.

metadata.title: Notification S.R.O.455 (I)/2023
subjects: Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act
metadata.summary: This notification appoints specific individuals as members of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council for a period of four years. The appointments are made under Section 3 of the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council Act, 2022, following recommendations from the Search and Nomination Committee and with the approval of the Prime Minister.

name: S. R. O. 45(I)/2023.- Designate the Courts of AD&SJs in sub-divisions of following Districts in column No. 2 as Special Courts in the Punjab

metadata.title: S.R.O. 45(1)/2023
metadata.summary: This notification designates specific Additional District and Sessions Judges (AD&SJs) in the Punjab as Special Courts. It applies to courts in the districts of Bahawalpur, Gujranwala, and Sialkot under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021.

name: S.R.O. 2031(I)/2022 .— Designate the Courts of AD&SJ as special Courts in Province of Khyber Pakhthunkhwa

metadata.title: S.R.O. 2031(I)/2022
metadata.summary: This notification designates specific Additional District and Sessions Judges in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as Special Courts. These courts are authorized to exercise jurisdiction under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021 for cases involving gender-based violence and child protection.

name: S.R.O. 2029(I)/2022 .— Designate the Courts of AD&SJ as special Courts in Province of Sindh

metadata.title: Notification designating Special Courts in Sindh under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This notification designates specific Additional District and Sessions Judges in the province of Sindh as Special Courts. These courts are authorized to exercise jurisdiction under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021 within territories specified in an accompanying table.

name: The Torture and Custodial Death (Prevention) and Punishment) Act, 2022

metadata.title: The Torture and Custodial Death (Prevention and Punishment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act provides protection to persons during custody from acts of torture perpetrated by public officials. It aims to effectively implement the United Nations Convention against Torture and criminalize all acts of torture within Pakistan.

name: S.R.O. 1938(I)/2022 Establishment to Anti Rape Crises Cells in Public Hospitals in Province of Punjab

metadata.title: S.R.O. 1938()/2022
metadata.summary: This notification establishes Anti-Rape Crises Cells in various public hospitals across the Province of Punjab. The cells are composed of specific heads and members, including Deputy Medical Commissioners and Concerned SPs, as detailed in the accompanying table.

name: S.R.O. 1759(I)/2022.- Establishment to Anti Rape Crises Cells in Public Hospitals in Province of Punjab

metadata.title: Notification establishing Anti-Rape Crises Cells in public hospitals of the Province of the Punjab
metadata.summary: This notification establishes Anti-Rape Crises Cells in various public hospitals across the Punjab province. It designates specific heads and members for these cells in accordance with section 4 of the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021.

name: S.R.O. 1758(I)/2022.- Establishment to Anti Rape Crises Cells in Public Hospitals in Islamabad

metadata.title: Notification establishing Anti-Rape Crises Cells
metadata.summary: This notification establishes Anti-Rape Crises Cells in specific public hospitals to handle offences under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021. It details the composition of these cells, including the head and members for each designated hospital.

name: Notification Regarding Amendments to the Companies (Registration Offices) Regulations, 2018

metadata.title: The Companies (Registration Offices) Regulations, 2018 (Amendment)
metadata.summary: This notification amends the Companies (Registration Offices) Regulations, 2018 by updating Annexure-D to include digital issuance of documents. It specifically inserts a new serial number regarding applications for certified copies of documents filed in physical form.

name: SRO 1190(I)/2022. Constitution of Special Committee

metadata.title: Notification appointing a Special Committee under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021
metadata.repeals: Notification No. S.R.O 113(KE)/ 2021
metadata.summary: This notification appoints a Special Committee on a pro bono or honorary basis to perform functions under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021. The committee includes representatives from various ministries, provinces, law enforcement agencies, and civil society organizations.

name: Finance Supplementary Act, 2022

metadata.title: Finance (Supplementary) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act further amends certain laws relating to taxes and duties in Pakistan. Specifically, it introduces amendments to the Customs Act, 1969, and the Sales Tax Act, 1990 to update provisions regarding customs procedures, withholding tax thresholds, digital invoicing authorities, and excise duties on specific goods.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Food Safety Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Food Safety Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Islamabad Food Authority to regulate food safety and standards within the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines key terms related to food, adulteration, and business operations while aiming to protect public health.

name: The Federal Public Service Commission (Validation of Rules) Act, 2021

metadata.title: Federal Public Service Commission (Validation of Rules) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act validates the rules regulating competitive examinations conducted by the Federal Public Service Commission in 2016 and 2017. It deems these rules, along with their amendments and related proceedings, to have been validly made and held from the date of their original notification.

name: The Protection of Journalists and Media Professionals Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Protection of Journalists and Media Professionals Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal and institutional framework to promote, protect, and ensure the independence, impartiality, safety, and freedom of expression for journalists and media professionals in Pakistan. It defines key terms such as 'Journalist', 'Media professional', and 'Intimidation' to create specific protections against attacks and harassment within the media sector.

name: The Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes special investigation teams and special courts to ensure the expeditious redressal of rape and sexual abuse crimes against women and children. It provides for efficacious procedures, speedy trials, and specific definitions regarding victims, children, and sex offenders within the legal framework.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Senior Citizens Act, 2021

metadata.title: The Islamabad Capital Territory Senior Citizens Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Fund and an autonomous Senior Citizens Council to ensure the well-being, comfort, and dignity of elderly residents in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It defines key terms such as 'Senior Citizen' (60 years or older) and outlines the composition and powers of the newly formed Council.

name: SRO 617(I)/2021.— Designate all Courts of Session Judges throughout Pakistan as Special Court Under the Ordinance

metadata.title: Notification designating all Courts of Session Judges as Special Court under the Anti-Rape (Investigation & Trial) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This notification designates all Courts of Session Judges throughout Pakistan as Special Courts. It is issued pursuant to the Anti-Rape (Investigation & Trial) Ordinance, 2020, following consultation with the Chief Justice of Pakistan.

name: National Assembly resolves to extend the AntiRape (Investigation and Trial) Ordinance, 2020, (No XVI of 2020) for a further period of one hundred and twenty days

metadata.title: The Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This notification records a resolution by the National Assembly to extend the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Ordinance, 2020. The extension grants an additional period of one hundred and twenty days effective from April 13, 2021.

name: S. R O. 328(I)2021. Appointment a Special Committee

metadata.title: Notification appointing a Special Committee under the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Ordinance, 2021
metadata.summary: This notification appoints a Special Committee to oversee matters related to the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Ordinance, 2021. The committee includes representatives from various ministries, forensic science agencies, commissions on the status of women, and civil society organizations.

name: The Privatisation Commission Employees (Discipline) Regulations 2019

metadata.title: Privatisation Commission Employees (Discipline) Regulations, 2019
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the disciplinary framework for employees of the Privatisation Commission, including definitions of misconduct and competent authority. They outline procedures for initiating proceedings, conducting inquiries, imposing penalties such as dismissal or reduction in rank, and managing suspensions.

name: The Finance Act, 2020

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 2020
metadata.amends: Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance, 1961; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning on July 1, 2020. It also amends several existing laws, including the Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance, 1961 and the Customs Act, 1969.

name: The China Pakistan Economic Corridor Authority Ordinance, 2019

metadata.title: The China Pakistan Economic Corridor Authority Ordinance, 2019
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the China Pakistan Economic Corridor Authority as a body corporate to manage activities related to the corridor. It aims to accelerate economic growth, unlock production potential, and develop sound public policies by integrating stakeholder advice.

name: The Voluntary Declaration of Domestic Assets Act, 2018

metadata.title: Voluntary Declaration of Domestic Assets Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the voluntary declaration of domestic assets held in Pakistan to address large-scale non-reporting and under-reporting. It defines key terms such as 'declarant', 'domestic assets', and 'holder of public office' while applying to citizens, companies, and associations except specific government officials.

name: The Institute of Science and Technology Bahawalpur Act, 2018

metadata.title: Institute of Science and Technology Bahawalpur Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Science and Technology, Bahawalpur as a degree-awarding institution. It grants the institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while defining its structure, powers, and purposes.

name: The Health Services Academy (Restructuring) Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Health Services Academy (Restructuring) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act restructures the Health Services Academy (HSA) established under the 2002 Ordinance into a degree-awarding institute. It grants the HSA academic, financial, and administrative autonomy while improving governance and management to enhance the quality of higher education in Pakistan.

name: The Foreign Asset (Decleration and Repatriation) Ordinance, 2018

metadata.title: The Foreign Assets (Declaration and Repatriation) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the declaration and repatriation of assets and income held outside Pakistan to address non-reporting and under-reporting issues. It applies to all citizens of Pakistan wherever they may be, with specific provisions regarding holders of public office.

name: The Marine Insurance Act, 2018

metadata.title: The Marine Insurance Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides the law relating to marine insurance and matters connected thereto. It defines key terms such as marine insurance, maritime perils, and insurable property, while regulating contracts of marine insurance and avoiding wagering or gaming agreements.

name: The Senate (Election of Members from The Federal Capital) Order, 2018

metadata.title: The Senate (Election of Members from the Federal Capital) Order, 2018
metadata.amends: The Senate (Members from the Federal Capital) Order, 1988
metadata.repeals: The Senate (Members from the Federal Capital) Order, 1988
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the manner in which members of the Senate from the Federal Capital (Islamabad) shall be elected by the National Assembly. It applies the Election Act, 2017 with specific modifications to replace references to provinces and provincial assemblies with those of the Federal Capital and the National Assembly respectively.

name: The Right of Access to Information Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Right of Access to Information Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the right of citizens to access information held by public bodies in a transparent and effective manner. It aims to promote government accountability, reduce corruption, improve economic growth, and uphold fundamental rights under Article 19A of the Constitution.

name: The Costs of Litigation Act, 2017

metadata.title: The Costs of Litigation Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to regulate costs in legal proceedings. It introduces provisions for awarding actual litigation costs to successful parties, imposing specific fees for adjournments caused by a party's failure to appear, and allowing courts to award special costs against parties making false or vexatious averments.

name: The Salary of the Judges of the High Court Order, 2016

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of the High Courts Order, 2015 (P.O. No. 8 of 2015)
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary scales for Judges of the High Courts in Pakistan, setting the Chief Justice's salary at Rs. 713,280 and other judges' salaries at Rs. 685,847 per month. It comes into force immediately but is deemed effective from July 1, 2016, and explicitly repeals the previous order issued in 2015.

name: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2016

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2016
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2015
metadata.summary: This President's Order establishes new salary scales for the Chief Justice of Pakistan and other Judges of the Supreme Court, effective from July 1, 2016. It also repeals the previous Salary of Judges of the Supreme Court Order, 2015.

name: The National Defence University Act, 2011

metadata.title: The National Defence University Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the National Defence University at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university academic, financial, and administrative autonomy to impart higher education in national defence and security fields.

name: The Competition Ordinance, 2010

metadata.title: The Competition Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Competition Commission of Pakistan to maintain and enhance competition in all spheres of commercial and economic activity. It aims to enhance economic efficiency and protect consumers from anti-competitive behaviour by regulating mergers, abuse of dominant positions, and deceptive marketing practices.

name: The Benazir Income Support Program Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The Benazir Income Support Programme Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Benazir Income Support Programme as a body corporate to provide financial assistance and social protection to economically distressed persons and families. Its primary objectives include enhancing the financial capacity of the poor, implementing targeted upliftment policies, and reducing poverty through equitable wealth distribution.

name: The National Defence University Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The National Defence University Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Defence University at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Senate, and President, and grants it academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

name: The Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan (Re-Organization and Conversion) Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Reorganization and Conversion Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the re-organization and conversion of the Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan into a public limited company known as Industrial Development Bank Limited. It establishes the legal framework for transferring all assets, liabilities, contracts, and undertakings from the existing bank to the new company under the Companies Ordinance, 1984.

name: The National Vocational and Technical Education Commission Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: National Vocational and Technical Education Commission Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Vocational and Technical Education Commission (NAVTEC) to regulate, coordinate, and provide policy direction for technical and vocational education in Pakistan. It creates an autonomous body corporate with a Board comprising government secretaries, private sector representatives, and other members to oversee these functions.

name: The Sacked Employees (Reinstatement) Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The Sacked-Employees (Reinstatement) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides relief to persons in corporation or government service who were dismissed, removed, or terminated between November 1996 and December 1998. It mandates the immediate reinstatement of eligible employees to a scale higher than their substantive post at the time of termination.

name: The Prevention of Electronic Crimes Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: Prevention of Electronic Crimes Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal provisions to prevent actions directed against the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic systems, networks, and data. It establishes punishments for such misuse and creates mechanisms for the investigation, prosecution, and trial of related offences.

name: The National Vocational and Technical Education Commission Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The National Vocational and Technical Education Commission Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Vocational and Technical Education Commission (NAVTEC) as an autonomous body to regulate, coordinate, and provide policy direction for technical and vocational education in Pakistan. It creates a Board to manage the Commission's affairs and defines the composition of the Board, including ex-officio members from various ministries and private sector representatives.

name: The Sacked Employees (Reinstatement) Ordinance, 2009

metadata.title: The Sacked Employees (Reinstatement) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides relief to persons in corporation or Government service who were dismissed, removed, or terminated between November 1996 and December 1998. It mandates the immediate reinstatement of eligible employees on a scale higher than their substantive post at the time of termination.

name: The Protection from Health Related Effects of Radio Base Station Antennas Regulations, 2008

metadata.title: Protection from Health Related Effects of Radio Base Station Antennas Regulations, 2008
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the ICNIRP 1998 guidelines as national standards to protect the public from health-related effects of radio base station antennas. They mandate compliance procedures, specific installation requirements for towers and hazard lights, and the submission of certificates by all terrestrial wireless operators.

name: The Prevention of Electronic Crimes Ordinance, 2008

metadata.title: Prevention of Electronic Crimes Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of actions directed against the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic systems, networks, and data. It establishes mechanisms for the punishment of such actions as well as for the investigation, prosecution, and trial of related offences.

name: The Competition Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: The Competition Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for free competition in all spheres of commercial and economic activity to enhance efficiency and protect consumers. It establishes the Competition Commission of Pakistan to maintain and enhance competition while regulating mergers, abuse of dominant positions, and anti-competitive agreements.

name: The Defence Housing Authority Islamabad Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Defence Housing Authority Islamabad Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Defence Housing Authority Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition and powers of the Authority's Governing Body and Executive Board to manage housing and development projects within the specified area.

name: The Islamabad Capital Territory Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Promotion) Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital Territory Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Promotion) Ordinance, 2007
subjects: Federal Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Regulatory Authority to register, regulate, and promote privately managed educational institutions in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It aims to ensure uniformity in curricula, academic standards, and teaching staff qualifications while promoting transparency and discipline.

name: The National Defence University Ordinance, 2007

metadata.title: National Defence University Ordinance, 2007
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National Defence University at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It provides for the university's academic, financial, and administrative autonomy, including its structure, property rights, and ability to set up campuses.

name: The Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority Ordinance, 2006

metadata.title: Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority Ordinance, 2006
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Earthquake Reconstruction and Rehabilitation Authority (ERRA) as an autonomous body corporate to manage post-disaster recovery. It empowers the Authority to conduct damage assessments, formulate comprehensive development programs, and oversee reconstruction projects in areas affected by the earthquake.

name: The Pakistan Intellectual Property Rights Organization Ordinance, 2005

metadata.title: Pakistan Intellectual Property Rights Organization Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Intellectual Property Rights Organization as a body corporate to protect intellectual property rights in Pakistan. It defines the roles of the Policy Board and the Director General, outlining their functions, powers, and responsibilities regarding policy formulation, regulation, and administration.

name: The Salary of Judges of Superior Court Order, 2003 (Repealed by P.O.NO.3 of 2004)

metadata.title: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2003
metadata.repeals: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order determines the salaries for Judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts in Pakistan. It sets specific monthly amounts for the Chief Justice and other judges at both levels, effective from July 1, 2003.

name: The Contempt of Court Ordinance, 2003

metadata.title: The Contempt of Court Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the exercise of powers by courts to punish for contempt in Pakistan. It defines various types of contempt, including civil, criminal, and judicial contempt, and outlines the jurisdiction and punishment procedures for such offenses.

name: The Air University Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Air University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Air University at Islamabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's governing bodies, constituent units, and powers to conduct research, award degrees, and manage affiliated institutions.

name: The Freedom of Information Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Freedom of Information Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for transparency and freedom of information to ensure citizens have improved access to public records. It aims to make the Federal Government more accountable to its citizens by regulating how public bodies maintain, publish, and disclose official records.

name: The National School of Public Policy Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The National School of Public Policy Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the National School of Public Policy as a body corporate with headquarters in Lahore. It defines the school's functions, including instruction, research, and advisory services to the Federal Government, while also setting up a Board of Governors to oversee its administration.

name: The Press Council of Pakistan Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Press Council of Pakistan Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Press Council of Pakistan as an autonomous and independent body to implement an Ethical Code of Practice. It defines key terms such as journalist, newspaper, and publisher, and outlines the Council's structure, financial resources, and powers to make rules regarding public records.

name: The Railway Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Railway Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Railway Regulatory Authority to foster competition and encourage private sector investment in Pakistan's railway network. It provides a legal framework for regulating passenger and goods train operations while protecting public interest and defining key terms related to licenses, infrastructure, and emergencies.

name: The Industrial Relations Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: The Industrial Relations Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends, consolidates, and rationalizes the laws relating to the formation of trade unions and the regulation of relations between employers and workmen. It also addresses the avoidance and settlement of disputes arising between them.

name: The Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002

metadata.title: Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.repeals: Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Marketing of Petroleum Products (Federal Control) Act, 1974. It was promulgated to facilitate the deregulation of the downstream oil sector and encourage private investment by transferring Federal Government shares in Pakistan State Oil Company Limited.

name: The Privatisation Commission Advisors/SeniorConsultants, consultants/Transaction Managers and Technical Assistants (Terms and Conditions of Appointment) Regulations, 2002

metadata.title: Privatisation Commission Advisors/Senior Consultants, Consultants/Transaction Managers and Technical Assistants (Terms and Conditions of Appointment) Regulations, 2002
metadata.summary: This regulation establishes the terms and conditions for appointing Advisors, Senior Consultants, Transaction Managers, and Technical Assistants to the Privatisation Commission. It defines specific roles, outlines a two-year initial contract term renewable on agreed terms, and sets strict rules regarding confidentiality, intellectual property rights, and restrictions on outside employment during the contract period.

name: Cancellation of Exemption from Section 14 of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 Granted to Platinum Commercial Bank Limited — S.R.O. 106(I)/2002

metadata.title: The notification issued by Finance Division vide No. F. 8(2)Bkg. IV/2002, dated 5th July, 2002 regarding non application of Section 14 of BCO, 1962, On Platinum Commercial Bank Limited
metadata.repeals: The notification issued by Finance Division vide No. F. 8(2)Bkg. IV/2002, dated 5th July, 2002 regarding non application of Section 14 of BCO, 1962, On Platinum Commercial Bank Limited
metadata.summary: This notification cancels a previous order issued by the Finance Division on July 5, 2002. The cancelled order concerned the non-application of Section 14 of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962, specifically regarding Platinum Commercial Bank Limited.

name: The Qualification to Hold Public Offices Order, 2002

metadata.title: Qualification to Hold Public Offices Order, 2002
metadata.summary: This Order imposes limitations on holding the highest public offices in Pakistan to strengthen democratic institutions. It prohibits any person who has held the office of Prime Minister or Chief Minister for two terms from being qualified to hold those offices again, regardless of whether the terms were completed.

name: The Islamabad Capital territory Local Government Elections Order, 2001

metadata.title: Islamabad Capital territory Local Government Elections Order, 2001
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the Chief Election Commissioner to conduct Local Government Elections in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It grants the Commissioner authority to prepare electoral rolls, delimit wards, and take necessary steps to effectively carry out the elections.

name: The Foreign Currency Accounts (Protection) Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: Foreign Currency Accounts (Protection) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides legal protection for holders of foreign currency accounts in Pakistan against deprivation or restriction. It ensures that account holders can continue to operate, sell, withdraw, and transfer funds within or outside the country without interference.

name: The Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Suspension of Trade Unions and existing Agreements) Order, 2001

metadata.title: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation (Suspension of Trade Unions and Existing Agreements) Order, 2001
metadata.summary: This Order suspends all trade unions, associations, and organizations within the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation. It also suspends existing agreements, awards, and settlements between the Corporation and its employees while allowing the Board of Directors to prescribe new terms if deemed expedient.

name: The President's Succession Order, 2001

metadata.title: President's Succession Order, 2001
metadata.summary: This Order provides for the succession to the office of the President of Pakistan in case the office becomes vacant. It stipulates that the Chief Executive shall assume the role of President and outlines the procedure for taking an oath before the Chief Justice of Pakistan.

name: The Ad hoc Public Accounts Committee (Composition and Functions) Order, 2001

metadata.title: Ad hoc Public Accounts Committee (Composition and Functions) Order, 2001
metadata.summary: This Order establishes an Ad hoc Public Accounts Committee to examine government accounts and audit reports following the suspension of the National Assembly. It provides for the committee's composition, appointment procedures, terms of office, internal rules, and specific functions regarding the clearance of unfinished audit business.

name: The Private Security Companies Ordinance, 2001

metadata.title: The Private Security Companies Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation, licensing, and control of private security companies operating in the Islamabad Capital Territory. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'private security company' and 'security guard', prohibits these entities from wearing uniforms similar to armed forces or police, and mandates that no person can carry on this business without a valid license.

name: The Local Government Elections Order, 2000

metadata.title: Local Government Elections Order, 2000
metadata.summary: This Order empowers the Chief Election Commissioner to conduct Local Government Elections for the Provinces. It grants the Commissioner authority to prepare electoral rolls, delimit wards, and take necessary steps to effectively carry out the elections.

name: The Corporate and Industrial Restructuring Corporation Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Corporate and Industrial Restructuring Corporation Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition, restructuring, rehabilitation, management, disposition, and realization of non-performing loans and other assets of various banks and financial institutions. It aims to assist the business sector by dealing with distressed enterprises and promoting the rehabilitation of the national economy.

name: The Insurance Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Insurance Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the insurance business in Pakistan by dividing it into life and non-life categories. It establishes requirements for insurers regarding registration, capital, solvency, accounts, audit, and market conduct.

name: The National Insurance Corporation (Reorganization) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: National Insurance Corporation (Reorganization) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the conversion of the National Insurance Corporation into a public limited company under the Companies Ordinance, 1984. It facilitates the immediate vesting of the Corporation's property, rights, and liabilities into the new Company while simultaneously dissolving the Corporation.

name: The Micro-finance Bank Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: Micro-finance Bank Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Micro-finance Bank (MfB) as a body corporate to provide sustainable micro-finance services to poor persons, particularly women. Its primary objective is to mobilize funds and alleviate poverty through community building and social mobilization.

name: The Juvenile Justice System Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Juvenile Justice System Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the protection of children involved in criminal litigation and their rehabilitation within society. It also addresses the re-organization of juvenile courts and related matters.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 2000. It also amends specific sections of the Central Excises Act, 1944 regarding duty collection, adjudication powers, and appeal timelines.

name: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000

metadata.title: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the dismissal, removal, compulsory retirement, and reduction to lower posts or pay scales of certain persons in government and corporation service. It applies to the whole of Pakistan and comes into force immediately.

name: The Supreme Court Judges (Pensionary Benefits) Order, 2000

metadata.title: The Supreme Court Judges (Pensionary Benefits) Order, 2000
metadata.summary: This Order provides for pensionary benefits to Judges of the Supreme Court who cease to hold office under specific conditions. It deems such judges to have retired at age 65 and entitles them to full pension and related benefits.

name: The Oath of Office (Judges) Order, 2000

metadata.title: Oath of Office (Judges) Order, 2000
metadata.repeals: Oath of Office (Judges) Order No. 10 of 1999
metadata.summary: This Order mandates that judges of Superior Courts in Pakistan must take a specific oath of office to continue or enter their positions following the Proclamation of Emergency and Provisional Constitution Order No. 1 of 1999. It outlines the procedure for administering this oath by the President, Chief Executive, Governor, or nominated persons and repeals the previous Oath of Office (Judges) Order No. 10 of 1999.

name: The Oath of Office (Judges) Order, 1999

metadata.title: Oath of Office (Judges) Order, 1999
metadata.summary: This Order mandates that judges of Superior Courts appointed after its commencement must take an oath of office before entering upon their duties. It was promulgated by the Chief Executive under the Proclamation of Emergency and Provincial Constitution Order No. 1 of 1999 to enable judges to discharge their functions during the suspension of the Constitution.

name: The Finance Act, 1999

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1999
metadata.amends: The Professions Tax Limitation Act, 1941; The Central Excises Act, 1944; The Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1999. It also amends several existing laws, including the Professions Tax Limitation Act, 1941, the Central Excises Act, 1944, and the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947.
