name: The Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) (Repeal) Order, 1998

metadata.title: Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) (Repeal) Order, 1998
metadata.repeals: Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 1975
metadata.summary: This Order was made by the President of Pakistan to repeal the Preparation of Electoral Rolls (Federally Administered Tribal Areas) Order, 1975. It comes into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 1998

metadata.title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 1998
metadata.summary: This Order prescribes the specific monthly salaries for the Chief Justice and other judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts of Pakistan. It comes into force immediately upon publication.

name: The Finance Act, 1998

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1998
metadata.amends: Trusts Act, 1882; Regulation of Mines and Oil-fields and Mineral Development (Government Control) Act, 1948; Wealth Tax Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1998. It amends several existing laws, including the Trusts Act, 1882, the Regulation of Mines and Oil-fields Act, 1948, and the Wealth Tax Act, 1963.

name: The Foreign Exchange (Temporary Restrictions) Ordinance, 1998

metadata.title: The Foreign Exchange (Temporary Restrictions) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance imposes temporary restrictions on dealings in foreign exchange during the period a Proclamation of Emergency is in force. It suspends protections under the Protection of Economic Reforms Act, 1992 and other laws regarding the right to bring, hold, sell, or transfer foreign exchange.

name: No. 5(11)-95 - No. 5(11)-95-Admn.IV - Assumption of charge of the post of Director-General (BPS-20), National Tariff Commission, Islamabad by Mr. Ijaz Ahmad

metadata.title: Notification No. A(5y9S-Admm.IIl
metadata.summary: This notification announces that Mr. Ijaz Alumen has assumed the charge of Director-General at the National Tariff Commission in Islamabad. The appointment is effective from October 8, 1995, and was issued by the Section Officer on behalf of the Ministry of Commerce.

name: No. 7(15)/90-Admn-I Empowerment of Joint Secretary as Director Trade Organization

metadata.title: Notification No. 7(15/90-Admml.)
metadata.repeals: Notification No. 1(4)/87-T.O.-1 dated 21st August, 1995
metadata.summary: This notification empowers Mr. Naeem Baig, Joint Secretary in the Ministry of Commerce, to perform the functions of the Director Trade Organization. The order is effective from September 26, 1995, and supersedes a previous notification dated August 21, 1995.

name: The Loans for Agricultural, Commercial and Industrial Purposes Act (Application to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province and Balochistan Province) Regulation, 1994

metadata.title: The Loans for Agricultural, Commercial and Industrial Purposes Act (Application to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province and Balochistan Province) Regulation, 1994
metadata.repeals: any law, instrument, custom or usage having the force of law corresponding to the provisions of the Loans for Agricultural, Commercial and Industrial Purposes Act, 1973 in the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas
metadata.summary: This Regulation applies the Loans for Agricultural, Commercial and Industrial Purposes Act, 1973 to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the North-West Frontier Province and Balochistan Province. It comes into force immediately upon publication and causes any corresponding local laws in those areas to cease operating.

name: The Finance Act, 1994

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1994
metadata.amends: Trust Act, 1982; Insurance Act, 1938; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1994. It also amends several existing laws, including the Trust Act, 1982; the Insurance Act, 1938; and the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944.

name: The Anti-Narcotics Task Force Ordinance, 1991

metadata.title: Criminal Law (Fifth Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.amends: Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860); Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Pakistan Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898. It also provides for the constitution of an Anti-Narcotics Task Force to investigate offences related to narcotics trafficking.

name: The Protection of Economic Reforms Ordinance, 1991

metadata.title: Protection of Economic Reforms Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance creates a liberal environment for savings and investments by releasing economic resources from unnecessary controls. It provides legal protection to existing economic reforms, including immunities for foreign currency accounts and the continuation of fiscal incentives for industrialization.

name: The Special Courts for Speedy Trials Ordinance, 1991

metadata.title: The Special Courts for Speedy Trials Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Special Courts in Pakistan to ensure the speedy trial of specific offences. It defines the composition of these courts, grants them exclusive jurisdiction over designated cases, and outlines procedures for transferring cases and taking cognizance.

name: The Terrorist Affected Areas (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1991

metadata.title: The Terrorist Affected Areas (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the suppression of acts of terrorism, subversion, and other heinous offences in terrorist-affected areas. It establishes special courts and grants powers to magistrates to utilize police and civil armed forces for arrests, searches, and destruction of illicit positions within declared zones.

name: The Terrorist Affected Areas (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1991

metadata.title: The Terrorist Affected Areas (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the suppression of acts of terrorism, subversion, and other heinous offences in terrorist-affected areas. It establishes special courts and defines the powers of magistrates to utilize police and civil armed forces for arresting suspects and destroying illicit arms dumps.

name: The Finance Act, 1991

metadata.title: Finance Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1991. It also amends specific sections of the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944 regarding duty levies and recovery of government dues.

name: S. R. O. 353 (1) 90 Empowerment of Joint Secretary to Perform Functions of Director of Trade Organizations

metadata.title: S.R.O. 353 (I),90
metadata.amends: Ministry of Commerce Notification No. T (4)/87-T O. I.
metadata.summary: This notification empowers Syed Shabbir Hussain Shah, Joint Secretary of the Ministry of Commerce, to perform the functions of the Director of Trade Organizations. The appointment is made under the Trade Organizations Ordinance 1961 and supersedes a previous notification dated May 10, 1989.

name: S. R. O. 23 (1) 87 Empowerment of Joint Secretary to Perform Functions of Director of Trade Organization

metadata.title: S.R.O. 23 (D187)
metadata.summary: This notification empowers Mr. Muhammad Naseem Qureshi to perform the functions of the Director of Trade Organizations under the Trade Organizations Ordinance, 1961. The appointment is effective from December 22, 1986, and remains in force until further orders.

name: S.R.O. 881(I)/86 — Declaration of Pakistan Steel Participation Term Certificates as Approved Securities

metadata.title: S.R.O. 881 (1), 86
metadata.summary: This notification declares Participation Term Certificates (PTCS) of Pakistan Steel as approved securities. It is issued under the powers of section 5(a)(ii) of the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962.

name: The Finance Act, 1986

metadata.title: The Finance Act, 1986
metadata.amends: Transfer of Property Act, 1882; Post Office Act, 1898; Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Customs Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Act gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1986. It also amends several existing laws including the Transfer of Property Act, Post Office Act, Workmen's Compensation Act, Central Excises and Salt Act, and Customs Act.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1983

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: Post Office Act, 1898; Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Customs Act, 1969; Income Tax Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 1983. It amends several existing laws including the Post Office Act, Central Excises and Salt Act, Customs Act, and Income Tax Ordinance.

name: S.R. O. 117 (I)/82.- Recognition and Classification of Pakistan Melters Association, Lahore as ‘A’ Class Trade Organization

metadata.title: S.R.O. 117(1)182
metadata.summary: This notification publishes the name of the Pakistan Melters Association as a registered trade organization. It recognizes and classifies the association, located in Lahore, as an 'A' class trade organisation under the Trade Organisations Ordinance, 1961.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1981

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944; Sales Tax Act, 1951; Customs Act, 1969; Income Tax Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 1981. It amends several existing laws including the Central Excises and Salt Act, Sales Tax Act, Customs Act, and Income Tax Ordinance.

name: The Finance Ordinance, 1979

metadata.title: Finance Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year beginning July 1, 1979. It also amends specific sections of the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944 regarding duties, offences, penalties, and reporting requirements.

name: The Antiquities Act (Application to the Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1973

metadata.title: A Festival of Chariots: How Music and the Arts Take the Hindu Temple Experience to the Streets
metadata.summary: This article examines the Rath Yatra festival, specifically focusing on its celebration in North America through parades in New York City and Los Angeles. It explores how music, dance, and visual arts transform urban spaces into sacred environments by bringing temple worship practices to the public streets.

name: The Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the corporation's management structure, including the composition and powers of its Board of Directors, and defines its functions, financial provisions, and regulatory framework.

name: The Short Titles Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Short Titles Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: Short Titles Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance assigns short titles to specific Martial Law Regulations and Martial Law Orders for the facility of reference. It was promulgated by the President under the powers of the Interim Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan while the National Assembly was not in session.

name: The Pakistan Science Foundation Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: Pakistan Science Foundation Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: Pakistan Science Foundation Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Science Foundation as a body corporate to promote and finance scientific activities relevant to the country's socio-economic needs. It outlines the foundation's functions, including conducting research, establishing science centers, and managing funds through a Board of Trustees.

name: The Pakistan Coast Guards Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Pakistan Coast Guards Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution and regulation of the Pakistan Coast Guards. It outlines the powers of the Federal Government to maintain the force, appoint officers, and define their functions including preventing smuggling and illegal immigration.

name: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Qualifications for Membership) Act, 1972

metadata.title: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Qualifications for Membership) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Qualifications for Membership) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes the qualifications required for membership of the National Assembly or a Provincial Assembly in Pakistan. It specifies that candidates must be citizens of Pakistan, at least twenty-five years old, and have their names on the relevant electoral roll.

name: The Development of Industries (Federal Control) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Development of Industries (Federal Control) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: Development of Industries (Federal Control) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Board of Industrial Management to ensure efficient management of industries under Federal control. It declares that the development of specified industries is expedient in the public interest and grants the Board powers to issue directions, require information, and manage funds.

name: The Companies (Appointment of Trustees) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The Companies (Appointment of Trustees) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Civil Commotion Compensation Fund Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the management of the affairs of certain companies by appointing a trustee when it is in the public interest. It vests the company's assets and liabilities in the appointed trustee and outlines the powers, duties, and financial procedures associated with this arrangement.

name: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Qualification for Membership) Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Qualifications for Membership) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The National and Provincial Assemblies (Qualifications for Membership) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the qualifications required for a person to become a member of the National Assembly or a Provincial Assembly in Pakistan. It specifies that candidates must be citizens of Pakistan, at least twenty-five years old, and have their names on the relevant electoral roll.

name: The Diplomatic and Consular Privileges Ordinance, 1972

metadata.title: Diplomatic and Consular Privileges Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: Diplomatic and Consular Privileges Act, 1972 (9 of 1972)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance gives effect in Pakistan to the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, 1961, and the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations, 1963. It grants privileges and immunities to diplomatic and consular missions and personnel in accordance with these international conventions.

name: MARTIAL LAW ORDERS No. 15

metadata.title: Martial Law Order No. 15
metadata.summary: This notification appoints Brigadier Muhammad Aslam Khan as the Martial Law Administrator for Zone 6. The appointment is made during the temporary absence of Major General M. Umrao Khan.

name: The Scheduled Castes (Declaration) Ordinance, 1957

metadata.title: The Scheduled Castes (Declaration) Ordinance, 1957
metadata.summary: This Ordinance declares specific castes of non-Muslims to be Scheduled Castes for the purposes of the Constitution. It specifies that these declarations extend to the whole of West Pakistan and the Capital.

name: The Protective Duties Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Protective Duties Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act enables the Central Government to immediately impose protective customs duties on specific imported goods produced outside British India. It provides the legal framework for such imposition when urgently necessary to protect domestic industries and outlines procedures for continuing these duties through subsequent legislation.

name: The Oil Seeds Committee Act, 1946

metadata.title: The Indian Oilseeds Committee Act, 1946
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the creation of a fund to be expended by a specially constituted committee. The legislation regulates the improvement and development of oilseed cultivation, production, manufacture, and marketing within British India.

name: The Indian Transfer of Ships Restriction (Repealing) Act, 1922

metadata.title: The Indian Transfer of Ships Restriction Act, 1922
metadata.amends: The Indian Transfer of Ships Restriction Act, 1917
metadata.repeals: The Indian Transfer of Ships Restriction Act, 1917
metadata.summary: This Act removes restrictions imposed on the transfer of ships registered in British India. It repeals the Indian Transfer of Ships Restriction Act, 1917.

name: The Martial Law Ordinance, 1919

metadata.title: Ordinance No. I of 1919
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the trial of persons charged with offences under the Bengal State Offences Regulation, 1804, in districts where martial law has been established in Punjab. It mandates that such trials be conducted by commissions consisting of three members appointed by the Local Government rather than regular courts-martial.

name: The Companies (Branch Registers) Act, 1900

metadata.title: The Indian Companies (Branch Registers) Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act authorizes certain companies to keep branch registers for their members in the United Kingdom. It stipulates that entries in these British registers are deemed part of the company's main register of members and outlines procedures for discontinuing such registers.

name: The Legal Representatives' Suits Act, 1855

metadata.title: The Act No. XII. of 1855
metadata.summary: This Act enables executors, administrators, or representatives of a deceased person to sue and be sued for wrongs committed during the deceased's lifetime. It allows actions to be maintained against these representatives if the original action would have been maintainable against the deceased person within one year of their death.
